papers.title: CoCo-IR: Contextual Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Current instruction-based image retrieval systems are powerful but limited to single-turn interactions, failing to capture the iterative nature of complex, real-world visual searches. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Contextual Composed Image Retrieval (CoCo-IR), a novel task that enables users to progressively refine search results through interactions. We address this new task by proposing a new model based on a Large Multimodal Model (LMM) that functions as a context-aware reasoner for CoCo-IR. Our model interprets the entire interaction history to generate Transformable Image Embeddings (TIE) that evolve across turns. To fuel the model training without expensive human annotations, we develop a fully autonomous, scalable data engine that leverages LMMs to generate high-quality contextual retrieval data, and uses model-guided verification to mine challenging hard negatives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance: We achieve 39.4 mAP@5 on the challenging single-turn benchmark CIRCO; furthermore, on our new CoCo-IR benchmark, our model maintains robust performance with 44.1 R@1 on 4-turn dialogues, dramatically outperforming existing methods (28.2 4-turn R@1) that fail to handle multi-turn context. Project page: https://CoCo-IR.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的图像检索任务 Contextual Composed Image Retrieval (CoCo-IR)，让用户通过多轮交互逐步细化检索结果。作者基于大型多模态模型 (LMM) 构建上下文感知推理器，生成可跨轮演进的 Transformable Image Embeddings (TIE)，并设计全自动数据引擎生成训练数据。实验在单轮基准 CIRCO 上达到 39.4 mAP@5，在 4 轮对话的 CoCo-IR 基准上达到 44.1 R@1，显著优于无法处理多轮上下文的现有方法 (28.2 R@1)。
Motivation: 现有时基于指令的图像检索系统只能进行单轮交互，无法刻画真实复杂视觉搜索中迭代式精化的需求，因而需要引入并解决支持多轮上下文交互的检索任务。
Method: 提出基于 LMM 的模型作为 CoCo-IR 的上下文感知推理器，利用完整交互历史生成可跨轮演化的图像嵌入 TIE；同时开发全自动可扩展数据引擎，借助 LMM 生成高质检索数据，并用模型引导的验证机制挖掘困难负样本。
Result: 在单轮基准 CIRCO 上取得 39.4 mAP@5；在新提出的 CoCo-IR 基准上，4 轮对话取得 44.1 R@1，远超现有方法的 28.2 R@1。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作首次定义了多轮上下文化组合图像检索任务，并证明基于 LMM 的上下文感知方法能有效处理多轮检索交互。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Objects as Audio-Visual Modal Sound Fields
papers.abstract_en: While modern 3D reconstruction excels at modeling object geometry and appearance, it largely ignores the rich acoustic cues revealed through physical interaction. Object impact sounds convey material, stiffness, and structural properties that complement vision, yet existing impact sound modeling approaches either rely on expensive physics-based simulation or require large datasets to generalize in a purely data-driven manner. We introduce Audio-Visual Modal Sound Field (AV-MSF), a novel object-level acoustic representation reconstructed from multi-view images and only a few impact sound recordings. AV-MSF builds on 3D Gaussian Splatting integrated with dense 3D visual feature to provide a strong geometry-aware prior, and represents the impact sound field using compact, physically meaningful modal parameters, enabling robust few-shot reconstruction. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that AV-MSF achieves state-of-the-art impact sound rendering, outperforming both physics-based and data-driven baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate downstream applications enabled by our representation, including contact localization and object sound editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Audio-Visual Modal Sound Field (AV-MSF)，一种从多视图图像和少量冲击声录音重建的物体级声学表示。该方法在 3D Gaussian Splatting 中集成稠密 3D 视觉特征以提供几何感知先验，并用紧凑且物理上有意义的模态参数表示冲击声场，实现鲁棒的少样本重建。实验在两个真实数据集上达到最先进的冲击声渲染效果，并展示了接触定位和物体声音编辑等下游应用。
Motivation: 现代 3D 重建主要建模物体几何与外观，忽略了物理交互中丰富的声学线索；物体冲击声能反映材料、刚度等视觉之外的属性，但现有冲击声建模要么依赖昂贵的物理仿真，要么需要大规模数据才能以纯数据驱动方式泛化。
Method: 提出 AV-MSF：在 3D Gaussian Splatting 上集成稠密 3D 视觉特征作为几何感知先验，并将冲击声场表示为物理上有意义的紧凑模态参数，从而以少量冲击声录音实现鲁棒的少样本声学重建。
Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上，AV-MSF 取得最先进的冲击声渲染效果，优于基于物理仿真和基于数据驱动的基线方法；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该表示除高质量冲击声渲染外，还支持接触定位 (contact localization) 和物体声音编辑等下游应用；未提及具体局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, procedures, verifiers, routing decisions, and rejected routes only after role-owned review and, when available, task-native verification. Model weights remain fixed; self-evolution occurs through persistent runtime state and control policy, with autonomous execution between operator-owned escalation points. Across seven GPT-5.5 benchmark arenas, Argus achieves about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot while using 1.41 times the aggregate tokens. After verification-gated self-evolution, mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens and 15% less active workflow time per task than startup waves, while recording 34 verifier recoveries and 22 strict review-loop rescues. Argus also reaches 76.8% on AARRI-Bench and a 28.0-point gap on mathematical data synthesis, with competitive GPU-kernel and language-model-training results. Beyond benchmarks, an optimized RWKV6 kernel was merged upstream; a multi-day mathematics campaign retained falsified routes and proof-backed frontier updates; and six paper pipelines completed 254 missions with 16 stage rollbacks. These results show that a fixed-weight, self-evolving harness can revise, recover, and accumulate verified approaches while producing structured trajectories for future supervised and reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Argus，一个用于长时程推理 (long-horizon reasoning) 的持久化、自进化智能体运行时。Argus 由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 四种角色在持久项目状态上执行有界任务，区分稳定用户意图与操作目标、约束和验证标准，并通过角色所有者的审查与任务原生验证来接纳记忆、技能、流程、验证器、路由决策和拒绝路径。模型权重固定，自进化仅发生在持久运行时状态与控制策略层面。摘要报告 Argus 在七个 GPT-5.5 基准竞技场上达到约 78% 的 SWE-Bench Pro 成绩（Direct Copilot 为 59%），并展示验证门控自进化带来的 token 与时间节省。
Motivation: 长时程推理需要一种智能体运行时，它既能在证据支持当前方案时保持持久推进，又能在测量揭示失败、隐藏约束或目标设定错误时转向。现有方法缺乏这种可持久化并可自我修正的运行时支撑。
Method: Argus 采用 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 四角色协作，在持久项目状态上执行有界任务；将稳定用户意图与操作目标、约束和验证标准分离；所有记忆、技能、流程、验证器、路由决策和被拒绝路径均需经过角色所属审查及任务原生验证。自进化通过持久运行时状态和控制策略实现，模型权重保持固定，在操作者拥有的升级点之间自主执行。
Result: 在七个 GPT-5.5 基准竞技场上，Argus 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上达到约 78%，而 Direct Copilot 为 59%，总 token 消耗为后者的 1.41 倍。经过验证门控的自进化后，成熟的 SWE-Bench 波次相比启动波次每任务减少 21% 的 solve-input token 和 15% 的主动工作流时间，并记录 34 次验证器恢复和 22 次严格审查循环救援。此外达到 AARRI-Bench 76.8%、数学数据合成 28.0 分的差距，并在 GPU 内核和语言模型训练上有竞争力；RWKV6 内核已合并上游，六个论文流水线完成 254 个任务并出现 16 次阶段回滚。
Conclusion: 结果表明，一个固定权重、自进化的运行时框架能够在长时程推理中修正、恢复并积累经验证的方法，同时为未来的监督学习和强化学习生成结构化轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to facilitate the recursive retrieval of code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts of millions of tokens in length. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a ~50B-token mixture containing ~6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by ~10B tokens of instruction tuning. Our training ablations and experimental evaluations against 18 state-of-the-art open-weight long-context LMs show that supplanting just 12% of traditional context-extension corpora with OctoLong data yields substantial gains in long-range retrieval, long-term state tracking, repository-level code understanding, and downstream agentic tasks, while also enhancing API usage in short-context coding scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OctoLong 上下文工程流水线，利用 AST 解析器、语言服务器后端和包管理器递归检索代码引用，构建具有丰富依赖关系、长度达数百万 token 的代码上下文。基于该数据对 600M 到 14B 参数的开源基座模型进行上下文扩展中训练（mid-training）并指令微调，得到 OctoLong-Instruct 系列模型。在与 18 个开源长上下文模型的对比中，仅用 OctoLong 数据替换传统上下文扩展语料的 12%，即在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解和下游智能体任务上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有长上下文语料以书籍、学术文章和代码仓库为主，这些资源有限且缺乏长距离依赖，难以满足上下文扩展训练对依赖丰富数据的需求。
Method: 提出 OctoLong 上下文工程流水线，组合 AST 解析器、语言服务器后端和包管理器，递归检索代码引用，构建达到数百万 token 的依赖密集代码上下文。随后在约 50B token 混合语料（含约 6.2B token 的 OctoLong 代码上下文）上进行上下文扩展中训练，并辅以约 10B token 的指令微调。
Result: 与 18 个 SOTA 开源长上下文 LM 相比，仅用 OctoLong 数据替换 12% 的传统上下文扩展语料，即在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解和下游智能体任务上获得显著提升，同时增强了短上下文编码场景中的 API 使用能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调依赖丰富的跨仓库代码上下文作为上下文扩展语料的有效性：少量替换即可带来长上下文多任务收益，并对短上下文代码能力产生正迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. We call such problems cross-skill long-horizon tasks: multi-step tasks whose steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier outputs. Existing benchmarks often evaluate individual skills, lacking a principled way to measure how well a model switches between skills. We address this gap from both the evaluation and training sides. We introduce Skill Entropy, a measure of the difficulty of switching from one skill to another. We then propose Skill^2-Bench, a benchmark of cross-skill long-horizon tasks built over 558 skills across 9 verifiable and open-ended domains. Each task is assigned a task-level skill-entropy score and grouped into three difficulty levels. Evaluating 8 frontier and 4 open-source models on Skill^2-Bench reveals a skill-switching gap: accuracy decreases on higher-entropy tasks. We then turn skill entropy from a benchmark scale into a training signal. We propose Skill-Entropy RL, an RL framework where the model predicts not only the answer at each step but also the skill used to produce it. The reward combines step-level correctness with a skill-entropy reward that measures the alignment between the model-predicted skill sequence and the gold skill sequence. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B, Skill-Entropy RL improves the Skill^2-Bench score from 34.4% to 68.4% and from 14.6% to 40.1%, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. The same pipeline can be applied to off-the-shelf training data such as OpenR1-Math, indicating that skill entropy is a reusable training signal. Code available at: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill Entropy（技能熵）作为衡量长程推理中模型在不同技能之间切换难度的指标，并构建了跨技能长程任务基准 Skill^2-Bench（覆盖 558 个技能、9 个可验证领域）。在此基础上提出 Skill-Entropy RL 训练框架，让模型在每步同时预测答案和所用技能，并用技能序列对齐的熵奖励进行强化学习，在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-1.7B 上显著提升基准分数。
Motivation: 现有基准大多单独评估单一技能，缺乏度量模型在推理链中切换不同技能能力的原理性方法；多步任务中不同步骤需要不同推理技能且依赖先前输出，这一能力缺口尚未被系统研究。
Method: 定义 Skill Entropy 作为技能间切换难度的度量，构建按任务级技能熵分数分为三个难度等级的 Skill^2-Bench 基准；训练侧提出 Skill-Entropy RL，模型每一步不仅预测答案还预测所用技能，奖励由步骤级正确性与技能熵奖励（度量模型预测技能序列与黄金技能序列的对齐程度）相结合。
Result: 在 Skill^2-Bench 上评测 8 个前沿模型和 4 个开源模型，发现高熵任务上准确率下降，呈现技能切换差距；Skill-Entropy RL 使 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 从 34.4% 提升至 68.4%，Qwen3-1.7B 从 14.6% 提升至 40.1%，优于竞争基线，且该流程可直接用于 OpenR1-Math 等现成训练数据。
Conclusion: 作者认为技能熵可作为可复用的训练信号，从基准尺度转化为强化学习奖励，并强调该技能原生（skill-native）视角对长程推理的评测与训练均有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
papers.abstract_en: Modern Greek is absent from NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval models and from major multilingual retrieval benchmarks, despite being important for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in legal, energy, financial, and medical applications. We present an end-to-end adaptation of the Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek, including corpus mining, synthetic supervision, retrieval model training, reranker adaptation, reader fine-tuning, and a new benchmark called HERA. Our study shows that a parameter-free BM25 baseline outperforms several off-the-shelf multilingual dense retrieval models on specialist Greek corpora. After fine-tuning on 65,773 Greek retrieval pairs, a Nemotron 1B embedder improves nDCG@10 from 0.362 to 0.835 and substantially outperforms its unadapted counterpart. The learned language competence transfers to general-domain Greek, although the advantage over BM25 remains domain-dependent. We further adapt a cross-encoder reranker and demonstrate consistent improvements across specialist domains. Finally, we LoRA-tune a Nemotron 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts reader for grounded generation, increasing judged answer correctness from 29.4% to 66.9% while significantly improving faithfulness and citation quality. We also introduce HERA, the first large-scale Greek benchmark for retrieval-augmented generation, and release our adapted models and benchmark to support future research on Greek-language RAG systems.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Includes release of the HERA benchmark and Sophea Nemo RAG models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现代希腊语在 NVIDIA Nemotron 检索栈及多语言检索基准中的缺失，提出一套端到端适配方案，涵盖语料挖掘、合成监督、检索模型训练、重排器适配与生成器微调，并发布首个大规模希腊语 RAG 基准 HERA。研究表明，在专业希腊语语料上，参数免费的 BM25 基线优于多种现成多语言稠密检索模型；在 65,773 条希腊语检索对上微调后，Nemotron 1B 嵌入模型的 nDCG@10 从 0.362 提升到 0.835，并显著超过未适配版本。作者还 LoRA 微调 Nemotron 30B-A3B MoE 阅读器用于有依据生成，将判定答案正确率从 29.4% 提升到 66.9%，并改善了忠实度与引用质量。
Motivation: 现代希腊语在法律、能源、金融和医疗等专业领域的检索增强生成 (RAG) 应用中很重要，但 NVIDIA Nemotron 检索模型和主流多语言检索基准均未覆盖该语言，缺乏专门适配的检索与生成能力。
Method: 构建覆盖检索全链路的端到端适配流程：进行专业语料挖掘、合成训练数据构造、检索模型微调、cross-encoder 重排器适配，以及用 LoRA 微调 Nemotron 30B-A3B 混合专家 (MoE) 生成器进行有依据生成 (grounded generation)，并提出新基准 HERA。
Result: 在专业希腊语语料上，BM25 基线优于多种现成多语言稠密检索模型；微调 Nemotron 1B 嵌入器后 nDCG@10 从 0.362 提升至 0.835；适配重排器在各专业领域带来一致改进；LoRA 微调生成器将判定答案正确率从 29.4% 提升至 66.9%，并显著提升忠实度与引用质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习到的语言能力可迁移到通用领域希腊语，但对 BM25 的优势仍具有领域依赖性；作者发布了 HERA 基准和适配模型，以支持希腊语 RAG 系统的后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Understanding 3D scenes is fundamental to embodied intelligence, requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including visual and geometric cues. However, the relevance of these modalities often varies across queries. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically rely on fixed modality combinations, overlooking query-dependent modality needs. Such a rigid design can introduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while underutilizing more informative ones, leading to wasted computation and diluted reasoning. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SmartMage, a unified MLLM that dynamically orchestrates heterogeneous modalities for semantic-aware 3D scene understanding. Specifically, SmartMage incorporates: (1) a Semantic-guided Modality Adaptive RouTng (SMART) module that selects task-relevant modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality; and (2) a Modality-Aware Gating Expert (MAGE) module that leverages modality priors to guide expert activation, fostering adaptive specialization in multimodal reasoning. Empirically, SmartMage achieves state-of-the-art performance across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks, and attains competitive results on RGB-only video understanding benchmarks. In our diagnostic benchmark ScanFacet, tasks are divided into fine-grained semantic categories, enabling analysis of modality combinations preferred by each semantic type. The observed modality-semantic patterns provide further evidence of SmartMage's effectiveness. Project page: https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SmartMage，一个统一的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)，通过动态编排异构模态来提升 3D 场景理解。模型包含语义引导的模态自适应路由 (SMART) 模块和模态感知门控专家 (MAGE) 模块，在五个 3D 场景理解基准上取得 SOTA 结果，并在 RGB-only 视频理解基准上获得有竞争力表现。作者还引入诊断基准 ScanFacet，按细粒度语义类别分析各语义类型偏好的模态组合。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 通常依赖固定模态组合，忽视不同查询对模态的相关性差异，导致无关模态引入语义噪声、信息丰富的模态未被充分利用，从而浪费计算并稀释推理能力。
Method: 提出 SmartMage，包含两个核心组件：SMART 模块利用语义先验、文本-模态对齐和模态质量选择任务相关模态；MAGE 模块利用模态先验指导专家激活，促进多模态推理中的自适应特化。
Result: 摘要报告 SmartMage 在五个 3D 场景理解基准上达到 SOTA，并在 RGB-only 视频理解基准上取得有竞争力结果；诊断基准 ScanFacet 的模态-语义模式分析进一步验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 动态模态编排与模态感知专家激活可以根据语义类型自适应选择模态组合，减少无关模态噪声并增强有效模态利用，从而提升 3D 场景理解表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
papers.abstract_en: Gradient descent on a factored model $W = UV^\top$ is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not. We trace the difference to the gauge symmetry of the loss, its invariance under $(U, V) \mapsto (UQ, VQ)$. Gradient flow's low-rank mechanism is available to an optimizer only if that optimizer is gauge-equivariant, a condition necessary for the transfer but not sufficient for low-rank recovery. Gradient descent, momentum, "shared-scalar" Adam, Muon, and Shampoo satisfy it. Adam, RMSProp, and the other coordinate-wise methods do not. A structure theorem characterizes the memoryless equivariant rules as exactly the Gram-determined left preconditioners, and a transfer theorem carries gradient flow's pathwise properties to common-scalar flows. We then sort nine update rules on underdetermined matrix sensing by recovery error against the planted ground truth. A one-parameter family from coordinate-wise to shared-scalar preconditioning restores the bias monotonically, isolating anisotropy as the cause. A "spectral schedule" reconciles two opposing reports about Muon: equal-rate updates recover exactly low-rank targets but lose their edge as the spectral tail grows. In transformers, Adam separates two gauge-equivalent initializations at the first step, where the equivariant optimizers stay at float precision, and ends with the per-head invariants $W_Q^\top W_K$ 56% apart in relative Frobenius distance, a gap no per-head rotation can close. On two hyperspectral datasets at matched training loss, gradient descent cuts held-out error by 43-44% at the lowest sampling density, and at lower effective rank. Basis choice is therefore not a tuning detail but a decision about which interpolant the optimizer selects.
papers.comment: 22 pages main text + appendices, 5 figures. Code, seeds, and raw run records: https://github.com/idevender/loss-basis-adam
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究为何在因子化模型 W = UV^top 上，梯度下降隐式偏向低秩解而 Adam 不偏向。作者将差异归因于损失函数的规范对称性 (gauge symmetry) 与优化器的规范等变性 (gauge-equivariance)，并用结构定理刻画无记忆等变规则恰为 Gram 决定的左预条件子，再用传递定理把梯度流的路径性质推广到共享标量流。实验在欠定矩阵感知、Transformer 和两套高光谱数据集上验证了各优化器的行为差异。
Motivation: 现有研究关注梯度下降的低秩隐式偏差，但 Adam 从相同的小初始化出发却无法恢复低秩解，背后的机制尚不明确；论文试图解释这一差异并判断优化器对基的选择如何影响最终插值结果。
Method: 通过规范对称性分析提出等变条件是低秩机制可迁移的必要但不充分条件；用结构定理证明无记忆等变预条件子等价于 Gram 决定的左预条件子，用传递定理把梯度流的路径性质推广到共享标量流；构造从坐标式到共享标量预条件化的单参数族以隔离各向异性效应，并提出一种谱调度 (spectral schedule) 来调和关于 Muon 的两种矛盾结果；在矩阵感知、Transformer 每头不变量和高光谱数据上做实验。
Result: 九个更新规则在欠定矩阵感知上的排序显示，单参数族从坐标式到共享标量预条件化会单调恢复低秩偏差；在 Transformer 中 Adam 在第一步就区分两个规范等价的初始化，最终每头不变量 W_Q^top W_K 的相对 Frobenius 距离相差 56%；在匹配训练损失的两套高光谱数据上，梯度下降在最低采样密度下将留出误差降低 43-44%，且有效秩更低。
Conclusion: 基的选择不是调参细节，而是决定优化器选择哪个插值函数的决策；规范等变性是梯度下降低秩机制迁移的必要条件，而坐标式方法如 Adam 因不满足该条件而失去此偏差。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Predicting Brain Morphometry with MT-GNN: Mesh Evolution in Continuous Time with Graph-Based Metric Tensor Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Predicting how a subcortical structure's shape will evolve from a few prior scans could support prognosis and clinical-trial enrichment. Existing longitudinal mesh predictors either extrapolate shape trajectories via high-dimensional embeddings or regress vertex deformations directly. We instead predict the surface's intrinsic geometry in continuous time: a single per-structure graph network predicts the future per-vertex first fundamental form (metric tensor) for an arbitrary causal multiple-visit history and an arbitrary prediction horizon, conditioned on a Fourier encoding of the lead time. The predicted metric is decoded into a surface by a differentiable As-Rigid-As-Possible solver, and the model is trained end-to-end on the rigid-aligned vertex error. Training through the reconstruction keeps the decoded prediction a valid surface and consistently improves it. On 14 subcortical structures from the ADNI dataset, the proposed mesh evolution model (MT-GNN) predicts best among the evaluated methods at every horizon ($-2.29\%$ mean vertex error vs. the temporal mean, $p{=}6.1{\times}10^{-5}$, beating it on 14/14 structures), ahead of geodesic shape regression (DCM, $-0.19\%$) and a mesh transformer (TransforMesh, $-0.45\%$; $p{=}1.2{\times}10^{-4}$), with the lead widening as the horizon grows.

TL;DR: 本文提出 MT-GNN，一种基于图神经网络的网格演化模型，用于在连续时间上预测皮层下结构表面的形态变化。模型从多次先验扫描中预测每个顶点的第一基本形式（度量张量），并通过可微的 As-Rigid-As-Possible 求解器将其解码为表面，整个过程端到端训练。在 ADNI 数据集的 14 个皮层下结构上，MT-GNN 在所有预测时域上均取得最佳顶点误差，且优势随时域增长而扩大。
Motivation: 现有纵向网格预测器要么通过高维嵌入外推形状轨迹，要么直接回归顶点变形，难以在预测时保持表面的有效性。作者希望仅利用少量先验扫描预测皮层下结构形状的未来演化，以支持预后判断和临床试验富集。
Method: 提出一个单一的按结构组织的图网络，以领先时间的傅里叶编码为条件，对任意因果多次访问历史和任意预测时域预测未来每个顶点的第一基本形式（度量张量）。预测的度量由可微的 As-Rigid-As-Possible 求解器解码为表面，模型以刚体对齐后的顶点误差为损失进行端到端训练。
Result: 在 ADNI 的 14 个皮层下结构上，MT-GNN 在所有时域上预测最佳，平均顶点误差相对时间均值改善 -2.29%（p=6.1×10^-5），并在 14/14 个结构上胜出；优于测地线形状回归 DCM（-0.19%）和网格 Transformer TransforMesh（-0.45%，p=1.2×10^-4），且时域越长优势越明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过重建过程进行训练既能保证解码出的预测是一个有效表面，也能持续改进预测质量；该方法在脑结构形态演化预测上优于现有的形状回归与网格 Transformer 方法。

papers.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 存在的模态不平衡（Modality Imbalance）问题，提出 OPD-V 这一视觉 OPSD 范式。作者用 Zoom-In Image 构造 Positive Teacher、用 Mask Image 构造 Negative Teacher，并利用 Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins 定义 Modality-Balance Trust Region 来选择用于自蒸馏的 on-policy tokens。实验在 6 个基准、4 个 MLLM 骨干和 5 种后训练方法上一致提升推理性能，同时降低训练成本。
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 方法从多种输入来源提取 privileged information 来引导自蒸馏，但忽略了 MLLM 推理中固有的模态不平衡问题：当文本信息主导生成时，模型无法充分整合多模态输入，导致精心设计的 privileged information 未被充分利用。
Method: 构造呈现不同程度模态不平衡的 Positive Teacher（Zoom-In Image）与 Negative Teacher（Mask Image），通过对比其推理正确性和 token logits 变化，揭示 Modality Balance 本身可作为 privileged information；据此用 Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins 定义 Modality-Balance Trust Region，筛选自蒸馏所用的 on-policy tokens。
Result: 在 6 个基准、4 个 MLLM 骨干和 5 种后训练方法上的实验表明，OPD-V 一致提升推理性能，并减少训练成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Modality Balance 可以作为 OPSD 中的 privileged information，OPD-V 通过正负教师实例化该信息，从而改善多模态推理中的自蒸馏效果。

papers.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
papers.abstract_en: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, use high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines overcomplete equal-norm tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: a Flat Randomized Response version and a Metric-Aware Laplace version, the latter being better suited to higher codebook bit-width regimes. We show that SSTQ achieves optimal mean squared error scaling while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per client, where $N = Θ(d)$ is the frame size. We also derive a surrogate privacy-aware codebook objective that reduces the codebook-dependent MSE scaling from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Finally, we empirically evaluate SSTQ against established baselines on federated learning tasks using CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ)，一种在分布式优化中同时实现局部差分隐私 (local differential privacy) 与低通信成本的向量量化框架。SSTQ 结合超完备等范数紧框架 (overcomplete equal-norm tight frames)、坐标子采样和隐私感知的一维量化，并给出 Flat Randomized Response 与 Metric-Aware Laplace 两种变体。摘要声称在仅使用 ceil(log2 N)+b 比特/客户端的前提下达到最优均方误差 (MSE) 缩放。
Motivation: 在分布式优化中兼顾局部差分隐私与低通信开销仍然困难；现有向量量化方法如 vqSGD 依赖高维几何构造，但带来不利的、随维度变化的方差。
Method: 提出 SSTQ 框架，核心是组合超完备等分范数紧框架、坐标子采样 (coordinate subsampling) 与隐私感知的一维量化；包含 Flat Randomized Response 和更适合高码率 (codebook bit-width) 的 Metric-Aware Laplace 两个版本。
Result: SSTQ 在每客户端仅使用 ceil(log2 N)+b 比特、N=Θ(d) 的条件下达到最优 MSE 缩放；所推导的隐私感知码本替代目标 (surrogate codebook objective) 将码本相关的 MSE 缩放从 O(4^b) 降至 O(2^b)。在 CIFAR-10 和 Fashion-MNIST 的联邦学习任务上相比既有基线展现出更好的效用与通信效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SSTQ 以极低的比特预算实现了最优 MSE 缩放，并通过新的码本目标改善了高码率下的均方误差；实验在两类联邦学习基准上验证了其有效性与通信优势。

papers.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long context reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is usually constrained by the fact that a single inference trajectory has to simultaneously explore the context, store intermediate state, verify evidence, and produce the final answer. This becomes particularly difficult in tasks that require extraction, counting, ordering, or multi-hop reasoning, where an early mistake can propagate until the final response. In this work, we propose Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM), an inference-time architecture, in which the same underlying model is called repeatedly as a sequence of fresh reasoning roots. Each root receives the original problem and context, but does not inherit the full conversational history. Instead, it receives a compact plain-text summary, a plain-text blackboard, and some durable task-specific artifacts written by predecessor roots. The motivation is to manage the context by chopping into partial tasks rather than one large inference response; in each staged computation, intermediate artifacts can be inspected, corrected, and extended by a later fresh inference by the same model. We describe the system model, handoff mechanism, artifact workspace, and evaluation protocol for this system. We study when fresh-context artifact continuation gives a measurable gain in accuracy over direct LLM answering even with recursive tool-calling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM)，一种推理时 (inference-time) 架构，让同一个基础模型被反复调用为一系列全新的推理根 (fresh reasoning roots)。每个根不继承完整对话历史，而是接收原始问题、上下文、前序根写下的紧凑纯文本摘要、纯文本黑板 (blackboard) 以及持久任务特定工件；目标是把长上下文推理拆成部分任务，使中间工件可被后续推理检查、纠正和扩展。摘要描述了系统模型、交接机制、工件工作区和评估协议，并研究在递归工具调用下 fresh-context artifact continuation 何时比直接 LLM 回答带来可测量的准确率增益。
Motivation: 长上下文推理受限于单个推理轨迹必须同时探索上下文、存储中间状态、验证证据并生成最终答案；在提取、计数、排序或多跳推理等任务中，早期错误会沿轨迹传播到最终响应。
Method: 提出 Chained RLM 推理时架构：同一模型被反复调用为一系列 fresh reasoning roots，每个根接收原始问题、上下文、紧凑纯文本摘要、纯文本黑板和前一推理根产生的持久任务特定工件，而不继承完整对话历史。通过把长推理切成部分任务，中间工件可被后续新鲜推理检查、纠正和扩展。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；它报告作者描述了系统模型、交接机制、工件工作区和评估协议，并研究 fresh-context artifact continuation 在何种条件下相比直接 LLM 回答（即使带递归工具调用）能产生可测量的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过将长上下文推理切分为部分任务并让中间工件可被后续推理检查、纠正和扩展来管理上下文；作者同时指出需要明确的评估协议，且增益是否存在取决于具体条件。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become the de facto standard for image encoding across many perception tasks. Despite their empirical success, it remains mechanistically unclear how they encode low-level features, given their lack of inductive biases: ViTs process information globally rather than relying on local structure. Biological visual systems, in contrast, build low-level features, such as orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex, by combining information from small, localized regions of the visual field. These features are general-purpose representations, shared and required across multiple specialized neural pathways, unlike higher-level, task-specific semantic features. This raises the question if such biologically-grounded features arise in ViTs. In this work, we systematically study how orientation selectivity emerges in ViTs by introducing a suite of neuroscience-inspired metrics: representational similarity score (RSS), orientation recruitment score (ORS), and orientation tuning bandwidth to quantify how orientation is encoded in representational geometry and as a function of model depth. Through extensive analysis, we find that: (1) the training paradigm is the strongest determinant of orientation selectivity, with models sharing an objective, peaking at comparable relative depths regardless of scale (2) many units are orientation-selective early in training, with early-to-middle layers recruiting more such units over time, while deeper layers lose selectivity and broaden their tuning toward semantic encoding and (3) our metrics offer a mechanistic heuristic for how many layers to unfreeze for best downstream generalization. Our framework presents a way to track biologically-grounded features during ViT training, probes how desired properties are encoded in transformer representations, and builds a systematic understanding of how ViTs generalize across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个受视觉皮层启发的分析框架 IRIS，用三类神经科学启发的指标（representational similarity score、orientation recruitment score、orientation tuning bandwidth）系统研究视觉 Transformer（ViT）中方向选择性（orientation selectivity）的出现规律。摘要报告三个主要发现：训练目标比模型规模更能决定方向选择性；训练早期就有许多单元具有方向选择性，且早期到中层会随时间招募更多此类单元，而深层逐渐丧失选择性、转向语义编码；这些指标可用来启发选择解冻多少层以获得最佳下游泛化。
Motivation: ViT 缺乏归纳偏置，以全局方式处理信息，其如何编码低级特征在机制上仍不清楚；而生物视觉系统通过局部感受野构建方向选择性等通用低级特征。作者想探究这种生物学基础的特征是否会在 ViT 中自然涌现，并理解其随训练和深度的变化。
Method: 引入三个神经科学启发的量化指标：representational similarity score (RSS)、orientation recruitment score (ORS) 和 orientation tuning bandwidth，分别度量方向信息在表征几何中的编码方式、方向选择性单元被招募的比例以及方向调谐带宽，并沿模型深度维度进行分析。
Result: 分析发现：(1) 训练范式（共享目标）是方向选择性最强的决定因素，不同规模的模型在相对深度相近的位置达到峰值；(2) 训练早期已有许多方向选择性单元，早期到中间层随时间招募更多此类单元，而深层失去选择性并拓宽调谐转向语义编码；(3) 所提指标可作为解冻多少层以获得最佳下游泛化的机制性启发。

papers.title: DASyR-LLM: Domain-Aware Symbolic Regression with LLMs for Kinetic Model Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Kinetic model discovery is a central challenge in chemical engineering, as accurate rate expressions are essential for understanding and controlling chemical and biological processes. Symbolic regression (SR) has emerged as a powerful data-driven approach for identifying interpretable kinetic models, but usually operates without domain knowledge, often exploring physicochemically implausible models. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for injecting domain expertise into this search. Here, we introduce an LLM-guided SR framework, embedding an LLM module within an iterative SR algorithm for automated kinetic model discovery. The LLM performs two roles at each iteration: (1) a qualitative physicochemical critique of the best SR candidates, and (2) the proposal of new candidate rate expressions guided by the SR-generated models and embedded chemical knowledge. Our framework is evaluated on four in silico case studies of increasing complexity, spanning heterogeneous catalysis and bioprocess systems. Results show the LLM-guided framework reduces iterations to identify the ground-truth model by $41.7-79.3\%$ versus a state-of-the-art SR framework, with the LLM directly proposing the correct model structure in over half of the guided runs. In practical settings, where each iteration typically requires a new wet-lab experiment, this translates into a substantial reduction in experimental effort. Predictive performance on an independent validation set is equivalent between both approaches, with $R^2>0.98$ in all case studies. Ablation studies indicate that both the SR component and the LLM scale contribute to this performance, with a reduced-size LLM largely retaining discovery efficiency. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can effectively inject domain knowledge into scientific model discovery, paving the way toward fully automated, domain-aware kinetic modelling pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DASyR-LLM，一种将大语言模型 (LLM) 嵌入迭代符号回归 (SR) 算法的动力学模型发现框架。LLM 在每轮迭代中担任两个角色：对当前最优 SR 候选进行物化定性批判，并基于 SR 生成模型与化学知识提出新的候选速率表达式。在四个复杂递增的 in silico 案例研究（涵盖多相催化和生物过程）中，该框架相比先进 SR 框架将识别真实模型的迭代次数减少 41.7%-79.3%，且在超过一半的引导运行中由 LLM 直接提出正确模型结构；独立验证集上预测性能与基线相当，所有案例 R²>0.98。消融研究显示 SR 组件与 LLM 规模均贡献性能，缩小版 LLM 仍大幅保留发现效率。
Motivation: 动力学模型发现是化学工程的核心挑战，而符号回归虽能识别可解释速率表达式，但通常不利用领域知识，常探索物理化学上不合理的模型。作者希望借助 LLM 向搜索过程注入领域专长，以减少实验迭代成本并实现自动化、领域感知的动力学建模。
Method: 提出 LLM 引导的 SR 框架：在迭代 SR 算法中嵌入 LLM 模块，每轮执行两项任务——对最佳 SR 候选进行定性物理化学批判，以及根据 SR 生成模型和内置化学知识提出新的候选速率表达式。
Result: 在四个 in silico 案例上，相比先进 SR 框架，找到真实模型的迭代次数降低 41.7%-79.3%；超过一半的引导运行中 LLM 直接提出正确模型结构；独立验证集预测性能相当，所有案例 R²>0.98。消融实验表明 SR 组件和 LLM 规模均起作用，缩小版 LLM 基本保留发现效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 能有效将领域知识注入科学模型发现，为全自动、领域感知的动力学建模流程铺平道路；该框架在实验迭代成本高昂的实际场景中可显著减少实验工作量。

papers.title: Robust and Efficient Motion Reasoning for Privacy-Aware Classroom Incident Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Can computer vision help make classrooms safer? In this pilot study, we investigate privacy-aware and computationally efficient classroom incident recognition from CCTV-style observations. This setting remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and few methods designed for the privacy, efficiency, and generalization demands of real-world deployment. We introduce a novel hybrid benchmark combining generative CCTV-style videos with real-world classroom pose data, and propose a lightweight, but robust motion-reasoning framework motivated by the observation that many incidents differ more in motion direction, speed, acceleration, and intensity than in pose alone. To that end, our method first constructs hierarchical kinematic representations of human actions. Our method then distills hierarchical, multi-order kinematic reasoning from a large teacher into a much smaller single-order student, enabling efficient per-person inference while preserving expressive motion understanding. Experiments show that our model outperforms substantially larger baselines at less than one-tenth of their computational cost, while also demonstrating stronger out-of-domain motion reasoning and zero-shot synthetic-to-real generalization. We will publicly release the benchmark, codebase, and supporting tools to facilitate further research in privacy-aware classroom safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一项针对隐私感知教室 incident recognition（课堂事件识别）的初步研究，面向 CCTV 风格观测，提出一个结合生成式 CCTV 风格视频与真实课堂姿态数据的混合基准，并设计轻量且鲁棒的运动推理框架。该方法先构建人类动作的层次运动学表示，再从大型教师模型中蒸馏出层次化、多阶运动学推理能力到更小的单阶学生模型，从而在保持表达力的同时实现高效的单人推理。实验表明，该模型以不到十分之一的计算成本超越显著更大的基线，并展现出更强的跨域运动推理与零样本合成到真实泛化能力。
Motivation: 课堂事故识别的隐私、效率与泛化需求在真实部署中尚未被充分研究，且现有基准和适配方法都有限。作者观察到许多事件相比姿态本身，更多在运动方向、速度、加速度和强度上存在差异，因此需要专门针对运动推理的方法。
Method: 提出一个混合基准，结合生成式 CCTV 风格视频与真实课堂姿态数据；方法上先构造人类动作的层次运动学表示，再通过知识蒸馏将大型教师模型中的层次化多阶运动学推理压缩到更小的单阶学生模型，以支持高效的逐人推理。
Result: 实验显示，该模型在不到十分之一计算成本下优于显著更大的基线模型，并且在跨域运动推理和零样本合成到真实场景泛化上表现更强。
Conclusion: 作者强调该运动推理框架可用于隐私感知的课堂安全，并将公开基准、代码库及辅助工具以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stable Density Ridges: Consistency and Convergence of Subspace Constrained Mean Shift
papers.abstract_en: The Subspace Constrained Mean Shift (SCMS) algorithm is a popular nonparametric method for extracting density ridges, which serve as a low-dimensional representation of high-dimensional data. It is a widely held belief in the literature that SCMS trajectories converge to the classical density ridge, which we call the "static ridge", defined via the density gradient and the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the density's Hessian. In this paper, we demonstrate that this assumption does not hold in general, as the static definition fails to account for the rotation of the trailing eigenspace along the continuous flow of the algorithm's underlying vector field. To resolve this, we propose a paradigm shift by introducing the "stable ridge", a novel geometric structure defined through the lens of dynamical systems and the Jacobian of the projected density gradient. We prove that this stable ridge is the true theoretical target of the SCMS algorithm. Building upon this foundation, we develop a generalized SCMS framework utilizing a constant step size, establishing its uniform R-linear convergence and topological surjectivity onto the stable ridge. We further derive the rates of convergence for estimating the stable ridge in terms of the Hausdorff distance. Finally, we expose that the original SCMS algorithm suffers from polynomial-time computational complexity, which is caused by implicitly coupling the step size to the smoothing bandwidth via the Mean Shift operator, and demonstrate how our generalized framework provides a statistically consistent and more efficient solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究子空间约束均值漂移 (Subspace Constrained Mean Shift, SCMS) 算法的收敛目标，指出文献中普遍认为 SCMS 轨迹收敛到经典“静态脊”(static ridge) 的假设在一般情况下不成立，因为静态定义未考虑沿底层向量场连续流动时尾随特征空间 (trailing eigenspace) 的旋转。作者提出以动力系统视角和投影密度梯度 Jacobian 定义的“稳定脊”(stable ridge)，证明它才是 SCMS 的真实理论目标，并建立广义 SCMS 框架的一致 R-线性收敛 (uniform R-linear convergence)、拓扑满射性 (topological surjectivity) 以及 Hausdorff 距离下的估计收敛速率。摘要还揭示原版 SCMS 因 Mean Shift 算子将步长与平滑带宽隐式耦合而具有多项式时间计算复杂度，广义框架则提供统计一致且更高效的方案。
Motivation: 现有文献普遍假定 SCMS 轨迹收敛到基于密度梯度及 Hessian 特征值/特征向量定义的静态脊，但该假设在一般情形下不成立；静态定义忽略了尾随特征空间沿底层向量场连续流动时的旋转，导致理论目标与实际轨迹不一致。
Method: 通过动力系统与投影密度梯度的 Jacobian 引入“稳定脊”这一新几何结构，将其确立为 SCMS 的理论目标；在此框架下提出使用恒定步长 (constant step size) 的广义 SCMS，并证明其对稳定脊具有一致 R-线性收敛和拓扑满射性。
Result: 严格证明稳定脊是 SCMS 算法的真实收敛目标，并推导稳定脊估计在 Hausdorff 距离下的收敛速率。摘要进一步指出原版 SCMS 因 Mean Shift 算子将步长与平滑带宽耦合而具有多项式时间计算复杂度，广义框架则统计一致且更高效。
Conclusion: 本文主张将密度脊的定义从静态几何转向动态系统意义下的稳定脊，以匹配 SCMS 算法的实际行为；广义恒定步长框架在统计一致性和计算效率上均优于原算法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reward Structure Shapes the Interaction Between Episodic Exploration and Neural Memory in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In partially observable reinforcement learning, agents face a dual bottleneck: they must explore to encounter rewarding states and retain that experience in memory to optimize their policies. Exploration bonuses and memory architectures are traditionally evaluated in isolation, leaving their interaction unmeasured, and standard notions of sparse reward conflate temporal signal density with what the reward actually supervises. We present a controlled study crossing episodic exploration bonuses with diverse neural memory architectures across three environments that vary how the content of memory is acquired. An identical bonus signal yields three distinct interaction patterns: it amplifies architectural capacity differences where memory content must be actively discovered and retained unsupervised; equalizes architectures to a shared ceiling where the content, once sought out, is a single reward-supervised cue; and is null where the observation stream is purely scheduled. Controlled reward manipulations verify that these patterns track reward structure rather than density: a dense reward neutralizes a bonus only if it directly supervises the required latent memory, and a small avoidable penalty on exploratory actions (leaving the optimum unchanged) induces policy convergence to suboptimal stationary states, which either bonus resolves. We then formalize reward sparsity with observation-anchored reward machines, separating structural sparsity (an automaton reproduces the return without the task-required history) from potential sparsity (the one-step reward misprices local exploratory actions); the resulting vocabulary organizes the three regimes by the retention burden each task exposes. Together, these results show exploration and memory are complements, not substitutes: a bonus induces exposure, and only memory converts exposure into return.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测强化学习中奖励结构如何调节情景探索（episodic exploration）与神经记忆（neural memory）之间的交互。通过三个环境交叉探索奖励与记忆架构，作者发现相同奖励信号产生三种不同交互模式：放大架构差异、将架构拉平到共同上限、以及完全无效。受控奖励操作验证这些模式由奖励结构而非时间密度决定，并用 observation-anchored reward machines 形式化奖励稀疏性，区分结构稀疏性与潜在稀疏性。结论是探索与记忆是互补而非替代。
Motivation: 探索奖励与记忆架构传统上被孤立评估，二者交互未被量化，且标准稀疏奖励概念混淆了时间信号密度与奖励实际监督的内容。在部分可观测强化学习中这构成双重瓶颈：既要探索到奖励状态，又要在记忆中保留经验以优化策略。
Method: 提出受控实验框架，在三个环境中交叉使用情景探索奖励与多种神经记忆架构，环境按记忆内容获取方式变化；辅以受控奖励操作验证交互模式是否由奖励结构决定，并使用 observation-anchored reward machines 形式化奖励稀疏性，将结构稀疏性（automaton 无需任务所需历史即可复现回报）与潜在稀疏性（单步奖励错误定价局部探索行为）分离。
Result: 相同的奖励信号在三个环境中分别产生三种模式：在需要无监督主动发现并保留记忆内容时放大架构容量差异，在内容被寻求后是单一奖励监督线索时把架构拉平到共同上限，在观测流纯调度时完全无效。受控操作显示密集奖励只有直接监督所需潜在记忆时才中和奖励，小而可避免的探索惩罚会使策略收敛到次优驻留态，而两种奖励都能解决。
Conclusion: 摘要强调探索与记忆是互补而非替代：奖励诱导暴露，只有记忆将暴露转化为回报。稀疏性形式化词汇表按每个任务暴露的保留负担组织三个机制。全文未涉及任何气象或降水临近预报内容。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Representational separation between unitary and channel quantum generative models via shared classical randomness at shallow depth
papers.abstract_en: Near-term quantum hardware limits circuit depth and often imposes geometrically local connectivity for quantum generative models, restricting the output distributions accessible to shallow unitary Born models. Introducing stochasticity into a unitary quantum Born model can improve the empirical generative performance of the resulting channel model and, for a restricted small-scale architecture, has been proven to represent a strictly larger family of distributions than its unitary counterpart. However, whether such randomness provides a provable separation at fixed shallow depth for arbitrarily large systems has remained open. Here, we show that shared classical randomness, a comparatively weak resource from entanglement theory, is sufficient to establish such a strict scalable representational separation over the corresponding shallow unitary Born model. More specifically, we augment bounded-connectivity shallow unitary circuits, followed by computational-basis measurements, with spatially separated local Pauli operations, whose joint application is controlled by a single classically sampled random bit. The resulting shallow-depth channel model generates long-range correlations in the classical output distribution that no purely unitary shallow-depth model with bounded connectivity can reproduce. For one-dimensional nearest-neighbour architectures, reproducing such distributions with a purely unitary model can require depth $Ω(N)$ in the worst case. We further show that measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) provides a natural implementation of the required shared classical randomness through suitable adaptation of the random measurement outcomes. Numerical experiments on MBQC-based generative models support the analytical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究浅层量子生成模型的表达能力，证明共享经典随机性（shared classical randomness）足以在固定浅层深度下，使有界连接（bounded connectivity）的通道量子模型（channel model）严格超越对应的幺正Born模型（unitary Born model）。作者将有界连接浅层幺正电路与计算基测量结合，并加入由单一经典随机比特控制的局域Pauli操作，所得模型能产生纯幺正浅层模型无法复现的长程关联。在一维最近邻结构下，纯幺正模型最坏需要深度Ω(N)才能复现这些分布；测量型量子计算（MBQC）可自然实现所需共享经典随机性，数值实验支持分析结果。
Motivation: 近期量子硬件限制电路深度和几何局域连接，这约束了浅层幺正Born模型可访问的输出分布；向模型中引入随机性可提升经验生成性能，但随机性是否能在固定浅层深度下对任意大规模系统提供严格的表达能力分离，此前尚未解决。
Method: 在浅层有界连接幺正电路后接计算基测量，并加入由单个经典采样随机比特联合控制、空间分离的局域Pauli操作，构造浅层深度通道生成模型；同时利用MBQC通过适应性地调整随机测量结果来实现所需共享经典随机性。
Result: 该浅层通道模型能生成纯有界连接幺正浅层模型无法产生的长程关联；在一维最近邻架构下，纯幺正模型最坏需要深度Ω(N)；基于MBQC的生成模型数值实验与分析结果一致。
Conclusion: 共享经典随机性虽在纠缠理论中是较弱资源，却足以在任意大规模浅层有界连接架构下确立严格可扩展的表示分离；MBQC提供自然实现途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
papers.abstract_en: AI-supported care planning can help clinicians, patients, caregivers, and care teams coordinate complex decisions across clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental needs. However, many AI systems present recommendations as fixed outputs, limiting stakeholders' ability to inspect, challenge, and revise plans when they conflict with clinical judgment, patient values, or real-world feasibility. We present CoPlan - a Co-Intelligent and Contestable Interface for Human-AI Care Planning. CoPlan uses a multi-agent workflow in which specialized AI agents generate candidate interventions and supporting or challenging arguments, while human care planners can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before final plan generation. Through this design, CoPlan combines co-intelligence, in which humans and AI agents contribute complementary expertise, with contestability, where recommendations remain open to inspection, revision, and justification. We demonstrate CoPlan in an aging-in-place care planning scenario. The system supports adaptive care team recruitment, role-based argument review, final care plan generation, and practical follow-up through scheduling agents. This work contributes a contestable care planning interface and a design framing for trustworthy human-AI care planning that preserves human agency and clinical accountability.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on Next Generation AI Systems (NGEN-AI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoPlan，一个面向人类-AI 协同护理规划的、可争辩 (contestable) 的界面。系统采用多智能体工作流，由专门 AI 代理生成候选干预措施及支持或质疑性论点，人类护理规划者可在最终计划生成前接受、拒绝、修改或添加论点。论文在 aging-in-place（居家养老）护理规划场景中进行了演示，涉及自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论证审查、最终护理计划生成，以及通过调度代理实现的后续跟进，并以此提出一种保持人类能动性与临床问责的可信人-AI 护理规划设计框架。
Motivation: 许多 AI 系统将推荐作为固定输出呈现，限制了临床医生、患者、照护者等利益相关者在推荐与临床判断、患者价值观或现实可行性冲突时进行检查、质疑和修订计划的能力。
Method: CoPlan 采用多智能体工作流：专门 AI 代理生成候选干预措施以及支持性或挑战性论点，人类护理规划者可以接受、拒绝、修改或添加论点，之后再生成最终护理计划；系统还支持自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论证审查和调度代理驱动的后续跟进。
Result: 论文在 aging-in-place 护理规划场景中演示了该系统，展示其支持自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论证审查、最终护理计划生成与实用后续调度；摘要未报告定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 本文贡献了一个可争辩的护理规划界面，并提出一种可信人-AI 护理规划的设计框架，强调保留人类能动性和临床问责。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BnBERT-iPET: Sparse Few-Shot Language Modeling for Bengali via Lottery Ticket Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks have shown impressive success in NLP tasks owing to their complex structure and huge number of edges. Achieving state-of-the-art performance in natural language processing with a large pre-trained model such as BERT is expensive and time-consuming, carries a large carbon footprint, and is difficult to realize on machines with minimal computational capability. This creates a barrier to training complex models for resource-constrained languages such as Bengali. However, in a complex neural model, not all edges are equally impactful, and the contributions of some of them can be neglected. Pruning promises to reduce the memory footprint of regular networks, shorten the training time of ever-growing networks, and increase inference efficiency without sacrificing comparable performance. In this work, we introduce BnBERT-iPET, a sparse few-shot language modeling approach for Bengali, and experimentally show that a lightweight few-shot-learned language model retaining only 10% of the edges of an initial model such as BERT can perform neck and neck with much larger models on challenging tasks for a resource-constrained language such as Bengali. By learning from few shots through iterative pattern exploiting training and achieving 90% sparsity with the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis pruning technique, our pruned BnBERT-iPET model proves to be a tough competitor to state-of-the-art language models such as Bangla Electra, Indic-BERT, and XLM-RoBERTa on downstream tasks over standard benchmark datasets of the Bengali language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BnBERT-iPET，一种面向孟加拉语的稀疏少样本语言建模方法。作者结合迭代模式利用训练 (iterative pattern exploiting training, iPET) 与彩票假设修剪 (Lottery Ticket Hypothesis)，得到仅保留原模型 10% 边（即 90% 稀疏度）的轻量模型，并在孟加拉语下游任务上与 Bangla Electra、Indic-BERT、XLM-RoBERTa 等大模型表现相当。
Motivation: 大型预训练模型（如 BERT）训练成本高、耗时长且碳足迹大，难以在算力受限设备上运行，尤其阻碍资源受限语言（如孟加拉语）的建模；而复杂网络中并非所有边都同等重要，修剪有望在不显著牺牲性能的前提下降低内存占用、缩短训练时间并提升推理效率。
Method: 提出 BnBERT-iPET 方法：通过迭代模式利用训练进行少样本学习，并采用彩票假设修剪技术获得 90% 稀疏度，仅保留初始模型 10% 的边。
Result: 摘要报告称，只保留 10% 边的轻量少样本模型在孟加拉语标准基准数据集的下游任务上与远大于自身的模型旗鼓相当，并与 Bangla Electra、Indic-BERT、XLM-RoBERTa 等先进模型展开有力竞争。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过彩票假设修剪与少样本训练结合，轻量稀疏模型可以在资源受限语言的 NLP 任务中取得接近大模型的性能，为低算力环境下的孟加拉语建模提供可行方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multimodal Spatiotemporal Atmospheric Data Assimilation with Latent Flow-matching
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) uses Bayesian inference to update the state of a numerical forecast model with observed data. In this study, we propose a fundamentally different, unified approach to atmospheric data assimilation. We use latent video flow-matching to sample temporally consistent trajectories from a prior trained using ERA5 reanalysis (69 variables over an 8-day window). We also use posterior sampling to assimilate real observation sources, such as those from the NOAA Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive and the Integrated Surface Database. Because the prior generates a continuous trajectory, it naturally propagates information between observed and unobserved frames. Therefore, we can perform various DA tasks, such as filtering and smoothing, simply by changing the observed frames. Moreover, we generate full-state ensemble forecasts directly from sparse observations, achieving performance competitive with state-of-the-art observation-to-forecast models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜变量视频流匹配（latent video flow-matching）的大气数据同化方法，用 ERA5 再分析数据训练先验以生成时间一致的完整轨迹，再通过后验采样同化真实观测。由于先验生成连续轨迹，信息会在观测帧与未观测帧间自然传播，因此仅改变观测帧即可完成滤波、平滑等不同 DA 任务。摘要还报告该方法可直接从稀疏观测生成全状态集合预报，性能与最先进的观测到预报模型相当。
Motivation: 传统数据同化依赖贝叶斯推断来更新数值预报模型状态，作者希望提出一种根本不同的统一替代方案，使同一框架能灵活支持多种同化任务并利用连续轨迹传播信息。
Method: 使用 latent video flow-matching 在 ERA5 再分析（8 天窗口、69 个变量）上训练时间一致轨迹的先验，并利用后验采样同化来自 NOAA 综合探空档案（Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive）和综合地面数据库（Integrated Surface Database）的真实观测。

papers.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon search agents must make multiple sequential actions (steps) to search, retrieve, verify, and integrate evidence to reach a final answer. However, existing methods for training these agents typically treat all steps within a trajectory uniformly during both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), failing to distinguish useful actions from erroneous or redundant ones. In this paper, we propose Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC), a fine-grained credit assignment framework for training long-horizon search agents by converting sparse trajectory-level outcomes into dense step-level supervision that rewards useful actions (even in failed trajectories) while suppressing erroneous or redundant actions. Specifically, given a potentially obscure query and its corresponding ground-truth answer, ABC first performs Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery, which traces back from the answer to recover intermediate clues required to solve the question. It then applies Clue-Anchored Step Scoring to evaluate each search step against these clues, converting sparse binary outcome supervision into dense step-level rewards. Based on these rewards, we develop ABC-SFT, which reweights the loss of each turn, and ABC-GRPO, which uses the step-level scores as rewards in GRPO. Building on this framework, we train ABSeeker based on Qwen3.5-4B with only 8.5k examples. ABSeeker achieves 37.3% on BrowseComp and 39.1% on BrowseComp-ZH. With context management, the scores further improve to 55.3% and 52.9%, respectively, significantly outperforming same-scale (4B) agents and even matching the performance of larger ones (approximately 30B). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of answer-backtracked step-level credit assignment for training long-horizon search agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC)，一种面向长程搜索智能体的细粒度信用分配框架，将稀疏的轨迹级结果转化为稠密的步级监督信号，用于奖励有用动作并抑制错误或冗余动作。基于该框架训练的 ABSeeker（Qwen3.5-4B，仅 8.5k 示例）在 BrowseComp 上取得 37.3%、在 BrowseComp-ZH 上取得 39.1%，加入上下文管理后分别提升至 55.3% 和 52.9%，超过同规模 4B 智能体并与约 30B 的更大模型相当。
Motivation: 现有训练长程搜索智能体的方法在监督微调 (SFT) 和强化学习 (RL) 中对轨迹内的所有步骤一视同仁，无法区分有用动作与错误或冗余动作，导致训练信号粗糙。
Method: ABC 先执行 Answer-Backtracked Clue Recovery，从答案回溯恢复解题所需的中间线索；再用 Clue-Anchored Step Scoring 将每个搜索步骤与线索比对，把稀疏的二值结果监督转化为稠密的步级奖励。基于这些奖励，作者提出 ABC-SFT（对每轮损失重新加权）和 ABC-GRPO（将步级分数作为 GRPO 的奖励），并在此基础上训练 ABSeeker。
Result: ABSeeker 在 BrowseComp 上达到 37.3%、在 BrowseComp-ZH 上达到 39.1%；配合上下文管理后分别提高到 55.3% 和 52.9%，显著优于同规模 4B 智能体，并与约 30B 参数的更大模型表现相当。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，基于答案回溯的步级信用分配能有效训练长程搜索智能体，为搜索、检索、验证和整合证据的序列决策提供更细粒度的监督信号。

papers.title: HexMIL: Hierarchical Attention MIL for Ante-Hoc Explainable Detection of AI-Manipulated CT Volumes
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of medical deepfakes, i.e., medical images manipulated by deep generative models, poses a significant threat to clinical workflows. However, existing detectors suffer from two critical limitations: poor generalization to unseen generative architectures for manipulation detection and lack of interpretability. In this context, we present HexMIL (Hierarchical EXplainable Multiple Instance Learning), a mask-free medical deepfake detector that simultaneously addresses both limitations using only binary volume-level supervision. HexMIL decomposes each CT volume into a two-level hierarchy of patches and slices, aggregated via independent Gated Attention modules whose weights are directly combined into a full-resolution 3D attention volume that localizes the manipulated sub-region without any pixel-level annotation. Unlike post-hoc methods such as Grad-CAM, HexMIL's attention weights constitute the exact forward computation driving the classification decision, providing ante-hoc and structurally faithful spatial attribution. We evaluate HexMIL on M3DSynth and CT-GAN datasets under a rigorous cross-generator generalization protocol, training on a single generative architecture and testing on unseen ones. HexMIL outperforms all baselines by $+9.1$ AUC and $+9.4$ F1 in out-of-domain classification, and achieves the best average IoU and Pointing Game score in localization. Project page: opontorno.github.io/hexmil.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), November 10--14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HexMIL（Hierarchical EXplainable Multiple Instance Learning），一种无需像素级掩码的医学 deepfake 检测器，仅在体积级二分类标签监督下工作。它将 CT 体分解为 patch 与 slice 的两级层次结构，通过独立 Gated Attention 模块聚合，并把注意力权重直接组合成全分辨率 3D 注意力体以定位被操纵子区域。与 Grad-CAM 等事后方法不同，HexMIL 的注意力权重就是驱动分类决策的前向计算本身，属于 ante-hoc 且结构忠实的空间归因。
Motivation: 医学 deepfake（由深度生成模型操纵的医学图像）对临床工作流构成威胁，而现有检测器在跨未见生成架构的泛化上表现较差，且缺乏可解释性。
Method: 将每个 CT 体积分解为 patches 和 slices 的两级层次结构，用独立的 Gated Attention 模块聚合，模块权重直接组合成全分辨率 3D 注意力体用于定位，无需像素级标注；整个训练仅使用体积级二分类监督。
Result: 在 M3DSynth 与 CT-GAN 数据集上采用跨生成器泛化协议（在单一生成架构上训练、在未见架构上测试），HexMIL 在域外分类上比所有基线高出 +9.1 AUC 和 +9.4 F1，并在定位任务上取得最佳平均 IoU 与 Pointing Game 分数。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法同时缓解了泛化与可解释性两个局限，注意力权重构成分类决策的精确前向计算，从而提供 ante-hoc 和结构忠实的空间归因。

papers.title: Lesion Detection in CT with Frozen Self-Distilled Features: SALT, a Spatially Adaptive Label-Guided Temperature
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pretraining objectives are spatially uniform: the teacher temperature and the per-patch loss weight are identical everywhere in the image, so a lesion a few patches wide contributes no more to the training signal than the surrounding parenchyma. Prior work biases the views toward annotated regions, which changes what the model sees but adds no pressure on the objective. We instead condition the targets of self-distillation, a method we call SALT (Spatially Adaptive Label-guided Temperature). Weak, box-derived labels, available only during pretraining, define a compact region on the encoder's patch grid, inside which the teacher's softmax temperature is sharpened and the masked-patch loss is up-weighted. The objectives, the masking policy and the centering statistics are otherwise unchanged, and at every downstream use the encoder is a plain feature extractor with no labels and no conditioning. We evaluate by freezing the encoder and training only a lightweight multi-depth CenterNet-style head, detecting lesions in 3D on four CT cohorts, and we isolate the mechanism against a backbone identical in architecture, pretraining data, schedule and label-guided cropping but with no target conditioning. We report patch-level separability, 3D detection stratified by cohort and by lesion size, box quality, and a detector-free probe in which a single frozen patch embedding re-identifies a lesion in a follow-up scan without registration, masks or fine-tuning. Because the conditioning is expressed through a spatial indicator rather than through label semantics, the formulation admits any weak spatial annotation; we instantiate and validate it for lesions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SALT（Spatially Adaptive Label-guided Temperature），一种在自监督预训练阶段按空间位置调整自蒸馏目标的方法。对于由框级弱标签在编码器 patch 网格上定义的紧凑区域，SALT 锐化教师 softmax 温度并提高掩码 patch 损失的权重，而掩码策略、中心化统计等其余目标保持不变；下游使用时编码器是无需标签和条件化的普通特征提取器。作者在四个 CT 队列上用冻结编码器和轻量多深度 CenterNet 风格头部进行 3D 病灶检测，并与架构、预训练数据、调度和标签引导裁剪相同但没有目标条件化的骨干对比。
Motivation: 现有自监督预训练目标在空间上是均匀的，只有几个 patch 宽的病灶对训练信号的贡献不比周围实质组织更大；先前工作只是让视图偏向标注区域，改变了模型看到的内容，但没有对优化目标本身施加压力。
Method: SALT 利用仅在预训练阶段可用的框级弱标签，在编码器 patch 网格上定义一个紧凑区域，在该区域内锐化教师的 softmax 温度并上调掩码 patch 损失权重；其余目标、掩码策略和中心化统计保持不变，且下游使用时编码器不携带任何标签或条件信息。
Result: 摘要报告了 patch 级可分性、按队列和病灶大小分层的 3D 检测、框质量，以及一个无检测器探针实验：单个冻结 patch embedding 可在无需配准、掩码或微调的情况下在随访扫描中重新识别病灶。
Conclusion: 由于条件化通过空间指示符而非标签语义表达，该公式可以接受任意弱空间标注；作者在病灶检测任务上实例化并验证了这一方法。

papers.title: Hierarchical Graph Memory for LLM Agents with Path-level Localization and Rewrite
papers.abstract_en: Agents for long term reasoning require a memory that can be efficiently and effectively updated over time, as new facts and external feedback continue to arrive. Recently, graph memory has been adopted to offer structural organization for multi-hop retrieval and reasoning. However, existing methods store all memories in a flat graph, and accumulated historical memories can introduce irrelevant contexts and increase the cost of evidence selection during retrieval. Moreover, they typically update memory units independently, requiring repeated unit-wise rewrite to cover related changes. To address these issues, we propose HiGram, an evolving hierarchical graph memory framework with path-level localization and rewriting. Specifically, we first propose a hierarchical graph memory, which organizes the memory into coarse-to-fine architecture composed of upper-level nodes and MemoryUnits, thereby reducing the amount of irrelevant information during retrieval. We further propose MicroGraph-based path-level localization, which leverages query and update conditioned MicroGraphs to identify support subgraph and evidence path before rewrite. Finally, we propose a coordinated rewriting method that jointly revises intra-unit memory and inter-unit dependencies, enable valid dependency structures updating in the localized evidence path. Experiments on benchmarks for long-term conversational question answering and conflict-aware memory evaluation demonstrate that our method demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines in answer quality and token efficiency. Besides, our method improves answer accuracy and query-valid evidence selection under dynamic, static, and conditional conflicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiGram，一种面向长期推理 LLM 智能体的分层图记忆框架，通过粗细粒度层级组织（上层节点与 MemoryUnits）、基于 MicroGraph 的路径级定位以及协调式重写，解决平面图记忆中无关信息累积和单元独立更新导致的覆盖成本问题。实验在长期对话问答与冲突感知记忆基准上显示答案质量和 token 效率提升，并在动态、静态和条件冲突下改善答案准确率与查询有效证据选择。
Motivation: 现有图记忆方法将所有记忆存储在平面图中，历史记忆累积会引入无关上下文并增加检索时证据选择的成本；同时记忆单元通常被独立更新，需要重复的单元级重写才能覆盖相关变化。
Method: 提出分层图记忆架构，将记忆组织为上层节点和 MemoryUnits 的粗到细结构；提出基于查询和更新条件的 MicroGraph 的路径级定位，在重写前识别支持子图和证据路径；最后提出协调式重写方法，联合修正单元内记忆与单元间依赖，使有效的依赖结构在局部证据路径中更新。
Result: 在长期对话问答和冲突感知记忆评估基准上，HiGram 相比基线在答案质量和 token 效率上有显著提升；在动态、静态和条件冲突下，该方法还提高了答案准确率和查询有效证据选择。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层组织与路径级定位、协调重写相结合，可以减少检索中的无关信息并支持依赖结构的有效更新，从而提升长期推理智能体的记忆性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出分层图记忆架构，将记忆组织为上层节点和 MemoryUnits 的粗到细结构；提出基于查询和更新条件的 MicroGraph 的路径级定位，在重写前识别支持子图和证据路径；最后提出协调式重写方法，联合修正单元内记忆与单元间依赖，使有效的依赖结构在局部证据路径中更新。
summary_sections.result: 在长期对话问答和冲突感知记忆评估基准上，HiGram 相比基线在答案质量和 token 效率上有显著提升；在动态、静态和条件冲突下，该方法还提高了答案准确率和查询有效证据选择。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调分层组织与路径级定位、协调重写相结合，可以减少检索中的无关信息并支持依赖结构的有效更新，从而提升长期推理智能体的记忆性能。

papers.title: MALT: Lightweight Curvature-Aware Muon via Diagonal Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: Muon has recently emerged as a promising alternative to AdamW for language model pretraining by orthogonalizing momentum matrices using Newton-Schulz iterations. Although Muon mitigates gradient anisotropy, it does not explicitly account for the curvature geometry of the loss landscape and may therefore remain sensitive to curvature anisotropy. We bridge this gap by proposing MALT (Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided Preconditioning), which uses lightweight diagonal preconditioners to reduce the sensitivity of Muon to curvature anisotropy. Specifically, MALT uses two-sided diagonal preconditioners with low memory and computational overhead to approximately capture the curvature geometry of the loss landscape. It orthogonalizes the preconditioned momentum using Newton-Schulz iterations and maps the result back to define the update direction, while norm grafting controls the update magnitude. To improve the robustness of MALT to stochastic gradient noise, we further propose MALTER (MALT with Adaptive stEpsize Rescaling). Convergence guarantees are provided for MALT in the stochastic non-convex setting. Experiments on GPT-2 Small, Medium, and Large pretraining show that the proposed methods outperform Muon while maintaining nearly the same memory footprint and wall-clock time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MALT（Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided Preconditioning），一种在 Muon 优化器基础上加入轻量级双面对角预条件器的语言模型预训练优化方法。MALT 用低成本的双面对角预条件器近似损失曲面的曲率几何，对预条件后的动量做 Newton-Schulz 正交化并映射回更新方向，同时用范数嫁接（norm grafting）控制更新幅度。作者还提出带自适应步长重缩放的 MALTER 变体以增强对随机梯度噪声的鲁棒性，并在 GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large 预训练上验证效果。
Motivation: Muon 通过 Newton-Schulz 迭代对动量矩阵做正交化，缓解了梯度各向异性，但并未显式利用损失曲面的曲率几何，因此对曲率各向异性仍可能敏感。本文希望用轻量级对角预条件来弥补这一空白。
Method: 提出 MALT，使用内存和计算开销低的双面对角预条件器来近似捕捉损失曲率；对预条件动量执行 Newton-Schulz 正交化并映射回原空间以定义更新方向，更新幅度由范数嫁接控制。在此基础上提出 MALTER，加入自适应步长重缩放以提升对随机梯度噪声的鲁棒性，并在随机非凸设置下给出收敛保证。
Result: 在 GPT-2 Small、Medium 和 Large 的预训练实验中，MALT 与 MALTER 均优于 Muon 基线，同时保持几乎相同的内存占用和墙钟时间。摘要还报告了随机非凸条件下的收敛性理论结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过在 Muon 中加入轻量级双面对角预条件，可以有效降低对曲率各向异性的敏感性，在几乎不增加开销的前提下提升语言模型预训练效果。

papers.title: Item Response Theory for AI Safety
papers.abstract_en: Language models differ in how safely they behave and these differences are measured by safety benchmarks. But aggregated benchmark scores are hard to trust and interpret, because benchmarks duplicate one another, correlate heavily, and models may sandbag when they detect evaluation. To address these issues, we draw on Item Response Theory (IRT), a statistical toolkit for measuring these latents from performance on items with inferred psychometric properties. We fit IRT models to eight safety benchmarks across 192 language models, the largest psychometric analysis of LLM safety evaluations to date, and contribute three results. First, we find that three interpretable factors of refusal strictness, truthfulness, and contextual harm explain most of the variance between models across benchmarks. Second, psychometrically selected items recover full benchmark scores with lower error than random subsets of the same size, and roughly ten adaptively chosen items suffice for several individual benchmarks, cutting evaluation cost by 97-99%. Third, IRT supports audits of individual models, showing that it can be used to detect naive sandbagging and changes of model behind APIs. Overall, we show IRT is a ready-made toolkit for reading, reducing, and auditing safety benchmarks, which we recommend frontier labs and evaluators adopt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用项目反应理论 (Item Response Theory, IRT) 来测量语言模型的安全行为差异，对 192 个模型在 8 个安全基准上的表现进行心理测量学分析。摘要报告称发现拒绝严格程度、真实性和情境危害三个可解释因子解释了模型间大部分差异；心理测量学挑选的题目能以更低误差恢复完整基准分数，约 10 个自适应题目即可替代若干整基准，评估成本降低 97-99%；IRT 还可用于检测朴素 sandbagging 和 API 背后模型的更换。作者建议前沿实验室和评估者采用 IRT 作为安全基准的阅读、简化和审计工具。
Motivation: 聚合的基准分数因基准之间重复、高度相关以及模型在检测到评估时可能 sandbagging 而难以信任和解释，需要更可靠的统计工具来测量隐藏特质 (latents)。
Method: 借鉴心理测量学中的项目反应理论，对 8 个安全基准、192 个语言模型的题目级表现拟合 IRT 模型，识别潜在因子并利用题目心理测量属性进行题目选择与个体模型审计。
Result: 发现拒绝严格度、真实性和情境危害三个可解释因子主导模型间方差；心理测量学选择的题目比同规模随机子集误差更低，约 10 个自适应题目即可覆盖若干单个基准，评估成本降低 97-99%；IRT 还能检测朴素 sandbagging 与 API 后端模型更换。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 IRT 是现成的工具包，可用于阅读、缩减和审计安全基准，并建议前沿实验室与评估者采用。

papers.title: Capability-Gated Planning: Cost-to-Goal Discovery and the Limits of Myopic Experiment Selection
papers.abstract_en: Systems that automate scientific discovery must repeatedly decide which experiment to run, which hypothesis to test, which tool to build, and when to stop. Many systems make these decisions by maximizing a myopic score such as expected information gain per unit cost or a learned plausibility score. We identify a structural limitation of this approach. Some actions are constructive: they acquire an epistemic capability (an instrument, assay, pipeline, simulator, or abstraction) whose value lies not in the information returned immediately but in the future actions it makes available. When the least-cost route to a confident answer requires a chain of such constructions, a planner that scores actions only by information obtainable within a bounded horizon cannot value the first construction: it yields no information within the horizon and is dominated by any measurement with positive information, however small. We formulate goal-directed discovery as a stochastic shortest-path problem in belief space in which constructive experiments change the downstream action graph, and prove that for every lookahead depth d there is an instance on which every myopic information-maximizing planner has an unbounded approximation ratio, and a related instance on which it never reaches the goal. The mechanism is a capability-indistinguishability lemma: within the horizon, acquiring a capability can be observationally indistinguishable from paying for a null action. This establishes capability gating as a reachability axis of difficulty distinct from curvature (submodularity) and information order (adaptivity gaps). We introduce CG-Plan, an incremental replanner with a capability-aware cost-to-go heuristic h = h_cap + h_exp. In a controlled testbed, the performance gap appears only under gating, persists for every fixed horizon, and arises when near-miss hypotheses come from a data-consistent proposer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动化科学发现系统中的实验选择问题，指出现有基于近视评分（如单位成本期望信息增益）的规划器存在结构性缺陷：某些动作是建设性的（constructive），其价值在于获取一种认识能力（如仪器、流程、模拟器），而非立即返回信息。作者将目标导向的发现过程形式化为信念空间中的随机最短路径问题，并证明对任意前瞻深度 d，近视信息最大化规划器的近似比无界，且存在永远无法到达目标的实例；随后提出带能力感知成本到目标启发式的增量重规划器 CG-Plan。
Motivation: 许多自动化发现系统通过最大化近视评分来决定下一步实验，但建设性动作只有在解锁未来动作后才产生价值；当到达可信答案的最短路径需要一串此类建设时，有界前瞻的规划器无法给第一个建设动作估值，因为它在前瞻窗口内不产生任何信息。
Method: 将目标导向发现建模为信念空间中的随机最短路径问题，其中建设性实验会改变下游动作图；证明能力不可区分引理（capability-indistinguishability lemma），即在窗口内获取能力与执行空动作在观测上不可区分；提出 CG-Plan，一个使用能力感知成本到目标启发式 h = h_cap + h_exp 的增量重规划器。
Result: 证明对每个前瞻深度 d，都存在一个实例使任何近视信息最大化规划器获得无界近似比，并存在一个相关实例使其永远无法到达目标；在受控测试平台上，性能差距仅在能力门控（gating）下出现，对每个固定前瞻窗口都持续存在，且当近似正确的假设来自数据一致的提议者时产生。
Conclusion: 能力门控被确立为一条独立于曲率（次模性）和信息顺序（自适应差距）的可达性难度轴，表明近视规划器需要能力感知的成本到目标估计才能处理建设性动作链。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning When to Stop: Prefix-Optimal Dynamic Diffusion Policies for Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies are a powerful policy class for continuous control, but their iterative denoising process creates a substantial computational bottleneck. Reducing this cost requires adapting the number of denoising steps to the difficulty of each action while preserving task performance. We introduce Prefix-Optimal Generative Policies (POGP), a framework that learns a prefix value function at every intermediate denoising step through a Bellman-style recursion over the denoising chain. The prefix value function serves two purposes: it provides an auxiliary training objective that encourages intermediate outputs to become high-quality actions, and it enables a test-time stopping rule that terminates denoising when additional steps are unlikely to produce meaningful improvement. Across four MuJoCo environments and comparisons with 12 baselines, POGP reduces the required number of denoising iterations by approximately 2.7-fold while retaining near-full task performance. Compared with state-of-the-art dynamic diffusion baselines, prefix training also improves final task performance by approximately 3.5%. These results indicate that supervising intermediate denoising steps is useful not only for adaptive early stopping, but also as an auxiliary objective that improves the learned policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prefix-Optimal Generative Policies (POGP)，针对扩散策略 (diffusion policy) 在连续控制中因迭代去噪带来的计算瓶颈。方法在每个中间去噪步学习前缀值函数 (prefix value function)，通过 Bellman 风格的递归沿去噪链优化，既作为辅助训练目标鼓励中间输出成为高质量动作，也提供测试时停止规则。在四个 MuJoCo 环境和 12 个基线的比较中，POGP 将所需去噪迭代数减少约 2.7 倍并保留近乎完整的任务性能，相比动态扩散 SOTA 基线还将最终任务性能提升约 3.5%。
Motivation: 扩散策略是连续控制中的强策略类，但迭代去噪过程带来显著计算瓶颈；降低该成本需要根据每个动作的难度自适应调整去噪步数，同时保持任务性能。
Method: 提出 POGP 框架，通过 Bellman 式递归在去噪链的每个中间去噪步学习一个前缀值函数；该值函数同时用作辅助训练目标，并提供测试时终止去噪的停止规则。
Result: 在四个 MuJoCo 环境及与 12 个基线的比较中，所需去噪迭代数减少约 2.7 倍且任务性能近乎完整；与最先进的动态扩散基线相比，前缀训练还带来约 3.5% 的最终任务性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，监督中间去噪步骤不仅对自适应提前停止有用，还能作为辅助目标改善学习到的策略。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Optimizing What Policies Learn From: Recoverability-aware Rollout Intervention Learning
papers.abstract_en: Critic-free group-based reinforcement learning has become a scalable approach for post-training large language models. However, most existing methods allocate the same number of rollouts to every task and trajectory state, even though some rollouts provide much more useful learning signals than others. Recent work has started to treat rollout generation as an adaptive decision, but two important limitations remain. First, intervention strategies are often based on fixed heuristics and therefore cannot adjust as the policy changes during training. Second, these methods usually decide only how many rollouts to generate, without explicitly controlling where and how to intervene. To address these limitations, we propose Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning (RAIL), a training-time framework that learns how to generate rollouts based on the improvement produced by each intervention. RAIL models intervention selection as an online contextual-bandit problem and trains a recoverability controller using intervention traces collected through a shadow-to-live procedure. This allows the controller to keep learning while the underlying policy evolves. We evaluate RAIL in terms of effectiveness, adaptivity, expressiveness, and efficiency. Across multiple settings, RAIL consistently improves performance under limited rollout budgets. These results show that recoverability-aware intervention provides a principled way to generate more informative and less redundant rollouts, leading to stronger learning signals during post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Recoverability-Aware Intervention Learning (RAIL)，一种用于大语言模型后训练的训练时框架，通过学习每个干预产生的改进来决定如何生成 rollout。RAIL 将干预选择建模为在线上下文赌博机问题，并通过 shadow-to-live 流程收集干预轨迹来训练可恢复性控制器，使控制器能在策略演化过程中持续学习。作者在有效性、自适应性、表达力和效率多个维度评估，称在有限 rollout 预算下一致提升了性能。
Motivation: 现有无评论家 (critic-free) 的基于组的强化学习为每个任务和轨迹状态分配相同数量的 rollout，但不同 rollout 的学习信号价值差异很大；已有自适应 rollout 生成方法依赖固定启发式，无法随策略变化调整，且只控制 rollout 数量，不控制干预的位置和方式。
Method: 提出 RAIL 框架，将干预选择建模为在线上下文赌博机问题，训练一个 recoverability controller，使用 shadow-to-live 流程收集干预轨迹；该控制器在底层策略演化时仍持续学习，从而基于每个干预带来的改进自适应地生成 rollout。
Result: 在多种设置下，RAIL 在有限 rollout 预算下持续提升性能，并产生信息量更大、冗余更少的 rollout，从而提供更强的后训练学习信号。摘要未给出具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 作者认为可恢复性感知的干预为生成更具信息性、更少冗余的 rollout 提供了一种原则性方法，能增强后训练中的学习信号；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MultiPathFormer: Towards a Foundation Model for Multipath Wireless Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in machine learning have enabled training of wireless foundation models, which aim to support tasks such as channel estimation, beam prediction, and localization based on wireless signals. Existing wireless foundation models typically pretrain on channel tensors using masked reconstruction over subcarriers, antennas, or time but ignore the physical characteristics of wireless propagation. In this work, we propose to instead use multipath propagation as the fundamental pretraining object. We present MultiPathFormer, an autoregressive foundation model that represents each transmitter-receiver link as an ordered sequence of continuous-valued path tokens and pretrains with next-path prediction. We introduce an Environmental RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) mechanism and a first-path codebook on top of the transformer backbone, leveraging environment knowledge to improve path statistics estimation like delay and power by up to 59%. MultiPathFormer pretrained on 27 environments transfers to unseen users and, after scenario-specific fine-tuning, outperforms training the corresponding models from scratch in new environments. Across downstream tasks, it outperforms SOTA channel-based foundation models, achieving 5.57 m mean localization error, 0.914 top-3 beam accuracy, 0.994 line-of-sight classification accuracy, and 0.561 channel estimation NMSE. These results show that path-level pretraining can learn reusable representations of wireless propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiPathFormer，一个以多径传播（multipath propagation）为预训练对象的无线基础模型。它将每个发射-接收链路表示为有序的连续值路径 token 序列，并用下一路径预测（next-path prediction）进行自回归预训练；同时引入 Environmental RAG 机制和首路径码本（first-path codebook）。摘要报告其在路径统计量估计、跨环境迁移以及信道估计、波束预测和定位等下游任务上取得增益。
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型通常在信道张量上用子载波、天线或时间维度的掩码重建进行预训练，忽略了无线传播的物理特性。作者主张将多径传播本身作为预训练对象，以学习可复用的传播表示。
Method: 以 Transformer 为骨干，将每条收发链路表示为一个有序的连续值路径 token 序列，通过下一路径预测进行自回归预训练；并设计 Environmental RAG 机制和首路径码本来注入环境知识，以改进路径统计量估计。
Result: 摘要称该方法在延迟和功率等路径统计量估计上最高提升 59%；在 27 个环境上预训练后可迁移到未见用户，经场景微调后优于在新环境中从头训练对应模型；下游任务上取得 5.57 m 平均定位误差、0.914 top-3 波束精度、0.994 视距分类准确率和 0.561 信道估计 NMSE。
Conclusion: 路径级预训练能够学习无线传播的可复用表示，并在多个下游任务上超越基于信道张量的 SOTA 基础模型。摘要未说明该方法的局限或适用边界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bag-of-Visual-Words for Spatial Mapping of Lung Adenocarcinoma Growth Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Spatial mapping of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) growth patterns across whole slide images (WSIs) requires resolving architectural context at the region level, yet existing methods operate at the individual tile level and produce generic morphological clusters rather than clinically defined pattern maps. We propose a weakly supervised Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW) pipeline that learns a visual vocabulary from frozen foundation model embeddings extracted from a small set of annotated regions of interest (ROIs). Pattern prototypes are constructed as mean BoVW histograms of same-label ROIs and used for nearest-prototype classification of sliding-window regions under Jensen--Shannon divergence. The resulting predictions are projected onto the WSI tile grid to produce interpretable spatial pattern maps. We evaluate the method on 87 CPTAC-LUAD patients using three foundation model encoders and multiple vocabulary sizes on two clinically motivated tasks. For tumour/healthy classification, the best configuration achieves a balanced accuracy of $0.974$ with H-Optimus-1, approaching the $0.987$ obtained by a supervised SVM trained on mean-pooled WSI embeddings. For binary histologic grade classification, the BoVW pipeline achieves higher balanced accuracy than the supervised baseline for all encoders, suggesting that ROI-level pattern decomposition preserves grade-relevant heterogeneity that is attenuated by global mean pooling.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种弱监督的 Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW) 流程，用于对肺腺癌 (LUAD) 全切片图像 (WSI) 进行空间生长模式映射。该方法从少量标注 ROI 的冻结基础模型嵌入中学习视觉词汇，以平均 BoVW 直方图构建模式原型，并在 Jensen-Shannon 散度下进行最近原型分类，将预测投影到 WSI tile 网格以生成可解释的空间模式图。在 87 例 CPTAC-LUAD 患者上，肿瘤/健康分类的最佳配置达到平衡准确率 0.974（H-Optimus-1），接近监督 SVM 的 0.987；在二分类组织学分级任务上，BoVW 对所有编码器均优于监督基线。
Motivation: 现有方法在单个 tile 级别操作，只产生通用形态聚类而非临床定义的模式图，无法在区域级别解析肺腺癌生长模式所需的架构上下文。
Method: 提出弱监督 BoVW 流程：从少量标注 ROI 的冻结基础模型嵌入中学习视觉词汇表，将同标签 ROI 的平均 BoVW 直方图作为模式原型，使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度对滑动窗口区域进行最近原型分类，并将预测投影回 WSI tile 网格以生成空间模式图。
Result: 在 87 例 CPTAC-LUAD 患者上，使用三种基础模型编码器和多种词汇表大小评估两个临床任务；肿瘤/健康分类的最佳配置（H-Optimus-1）达到平衡准确率 0.974，接近监督 SVM 的 0.987；二分类组织学分级任务中，BoVW 对所有编码器都取得比监督基线更高的平衡准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ROI 级模式分解保留了被全局平均池化削弱的等级相关异质性，因此弱监督 BoVW 在分级任务上优于监督基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the remarkable recent progress of video world models, social interaction between users and the characters within these worlds remains unsupported. To fill this gap, we present HelloWorld, a video world model that enables social interaction with in-world characters. With a single button press, users can prompt the on-screen character to respond toward the camera, e.g., turning to the viewer, waving, nodding, or speaking a short greeting. To make these interactions natural, we propose a self-distillation pipeline that finetunes the video generation model on data synthesized by itself. Each synthesized clip contains both social interactions and camera motion, allowing the model to learn camera-pose conditioning without degrading interaction quality. At inference, we further introduce a training-free module that determines when the interaction occurs. Upon a button press, it modulates the cross-attention masks of the DiT so that the interaction-related text prompt attends only to the frames within the press window, temporally localizing the character's response. We further build HelloWorldBench, a 400-sample benchmark with three social interaction metrics alongside three conventional metrics, for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that HelloWorld surpasses a variety of baselines in interaction quality, while maintaining state-of-the-art picture aesthetics and camera-pose following. Project page: https://github.com/AlayaLab/HelloWorld
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HelloWorld，一个支持用户与视频世界模型中角色进行社交互动的视频世界模型。用户按一次按钮即可让屏幕角色作出朝向镜头、挥手、点头或简短问候等回应。方法包括用自蒸馏流水线在自合成数据上微调视频生成模型，以及推理时通过无训练模块调制 DiT 的 cross-attention masks 来时间定位交互。作者还构建了 HelloWorldBench 基准，实验显示其在交互质量上超越多种基线。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽有显著进展，但不支持用户与世界中角色之间的社交互动，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出自蒸馏流水线，用模型自身合成的包含社交互动与相机运动的数据微调视频生成模型，使模型学习相机姿态条件而不损害交互质量；推理时引入无训练模块，在按钮按下时调制 DiT 的 cross-attention masks，使交互相关文本提示只作用于按下窗口内的帧，从而时间定位角色的响应。
Result: 在 HelloWorldBench（400 样本，含三个社交互动指标和三个常规指标）上，HelloWorld 在交互质量上超越多种基线，同时保持领先的画面美学与相机姿态跟随。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够实现自然的角色社交互动，同时维持生成质量与相机姿态控制；未明确提及局限性。项目页面已公开。
Relevance: 0
