papers.title: VQ-VAD: Vector-quantized Motion Representation Learning for Human-centric Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is inherently challenging due to the scarcity of anomalies and the large visual variability in surveillance footage, including changes in lighting, viewpoint, and human appearance. To mitigate visual noise and address privacy concerns, recent work has shifted to pose-based VAD, which focuses on motion dynamics rather than raw video data. However, existing pose-based approaches model human behavior in continuous latent spaces, limiting their ability to learn compact motion patterns necessary for robust behavior analysis. We address this by proposing Vector-Quantized Video Anomaly Detection (VQ-VAD), a novel human-centric anomaly detection framework that learns discrete motion representations. VQ-VAD adapts Vector-Quantized GAN (VQ-GAN), originally developed for image generation, to operate on keypoint sequences and construct a motion codebook of normal behavior. Trained exclusively on normal motion sequences, VQ-VAD detects anomalies by identifying high reconstruction errors when an observed motion sequence cannot be mapped to the learned codebook. We conduct extensive experiments across three complementary evaluation settings, including in-domain, cross-domain, and cross-dataset generalization, on four anomaly detection benchmarks. VQ-VAD achieves strong in-domain accuracy (81.83% on HR-SHT [15]), effective cross-domain transfer from CMU Panoptic [14] (76.69% on HR-SHT [15] without retraining), and competitive cross-dataset robustness. The code base for this work is available at https://github.com/TeCSAR-UNCC/VQ-VAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VQ-VAD，一个基于向量量化 (vector quantization) 的人体中心视频异常检测框架。它将原本用于图像生成的 VQ-GAN 适配到关键点序列上，构建正常行为的离散运动码本，仅在正常序列上训练，并通过重建误差识别异常。实验在四个基准上涵盖同域、跨域与跨数据集泛化设置，并在 HR-SHT 上报告了同域准确率 81.83%。
Motivation: 现有基于姿态 (pose-based) 的视频异常检测方法在连续潜空间中建模人类行为，难以学习足够紧凑的运动模式；同时原始视频数据存在视觉噪声和隐私问题，需要更简洁的运动表示。
Method: 提出 VQ-VAD，将 VQ-GAN 的向量量化机制迁移到关键点序列，学习正常行为的运动码本 (motion codebook)。模型仅用正常运动序列训练，异常检测依据是待测序列无法被映射到码本时产生的高重建误差。
Result: 摘要报告 VQ-VAD 在 HR-SHT 上达到 81.83% 的同域准确率，在不重新训练的情况下从 CMU Panoptic 跨域迁移到 HR-SHT 达到 76.69%，并在跨数据集设置中表现出竞争力的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为学习离散运动表示能提升姿态基视频异常检测的鲁棒性，并公开了代码库。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于姿态 (pose-based) 的视频异常检测方法在连续潜空间中建模人类行为，难以学习足够紧凑的运动模式；同时原始视频数据存在视觉噪声和隐私问题，需要更简洁的运动表示。
summary_sections.method: 提出 VQ-VAD，将 VQ-GAN 的向量量化机制迁移到关键点序列，学习正常行为的运动码本 (motion codebook)。模型仅用正常运动序列训练，异常检测依据是待测序列无法被映射到码本时产生的高重建误差。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 VQ-VAD 在 HR-SHT 上达到 81.83% 的同域准确率，在不重新训练的情况下从 CMU Panoptic 跨域迁移到 HR-SHT 达到 76.69%，并在跨数据集设置中表现出竞争力的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为学习离散运动表示能提升姿态基视频异常检测的鲁棒性，并公开了代码库。

papers.title: Beyond Reprojection Error: Camera Calibration with 3D Targets
papers.abstract_en: In 3D reconstruction, camera calibration is an essential element for achieving high fidelity and accuracy of the reconstructed geometry. While existing approaches rely upon 2D planar calibration, this work proposes a framework tailored for 3D reconstruction that is based on predicting scene rays, which adds flexibility to the reconstruction pipeline and enables the use of recent advances in camera models. Novel metrics, reconstruction and intersection error, derived from predicted scene rays are employed in combination with a bootstrapping procedure that statistically evaluates different calibration objects and calibration pipelines for both intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters. The results show that the generalized distortion model more faithfully captures physical camera effects and yields an improvement in calibration accuracy. Reprojection error is shown to be a potentially misleading indicator of 3D accuracy, and the proposed ray-based metrics provide a more holistic assessment. An icosahedron calibration target is designed to enrich calibration information for 3D reconstruction together with a ring-feature-based detector. The icosahedral target yields approximately 40% lower mean intersection and more stable calibration across bootstrap trials on synthetic data, while real-data performance demands very tight fabrication tolerances.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. To appear in the proceedings of Computer Graphics International (CGI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向3D重建的相机标定框架，不依赖传统2D平面标定，而是基于预测场景射线 (scene rays) 进行标定，并引入重建误差与相交误差 (intersection error) 作为新指标。作者结合广义畸变模型，设计了一个二十面体标定目标 (icosahedron calibration target) 及环形特征检测器。结果表明射线基指标比重投影误差更能反映3D精度，二十面体目标在合成数据上平均相交误差降低约40%，但真实数据对制造公差要求极高。
Motivation: 现有相机标定方法依赖2D平面标定，重投影误差 (reprojection error) 可能误导3D重建精度；3D重建场景需要更灵活、更贴近真实物理效应的标定框架。
Method: 提出基于预测场景射线 (scene rays) 的标定框架，结合广义畸变模型，使用新定义的重建误差与相交误差作为评估指标，并采用bootstrap程序统计评估不同标定物体与标定流程的内外参；设计了二十面体标定目标配合环形特征检测器。
Result: 广义畸变模型更忠实捕获物理相机效应并提升标定精度；重投影误差可能误导3D精度评估，射线基指标更全面。合成数据上二十面体目标的平均相交误差降低约40%，bootstrap试验中标定更稳定；真实数据性能需要极紧的制造公差。
Conclusion: 本文强调射线基标定指标和立体标定目标对3D重建标定的价值，但真实场景下对制造精度要求苛刻，是其适用范围的主要限制。

papers.title: Provable Limits and Certified Deferral for Verbalized Uncertainty in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Small open-weight language models increasingly run in private, offline, and cost-sensitive settings, where the key deployment question is not only what a model answers but when it should defer to a human. We study whether verbalized confidence can support risk-controlled deferral, evaluating eleven instruction-tuned models from three families, 0.5B to 14B parameters, on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA with 25,168 local predictions. Three theoretical results delimit what calibration can provide: strictly monotone calibration preserves the risk-coverage frontier and error-detection AUROC; temperature scaling cannot calibrate models whose confidence stays above one half while accuracy falls below it; and a Clopper-Pearson procedure converts a 200-question calibration set into a finite-sample risk certificate under an i.i.d. deployment assumption. Empirically, eight of 22 model-task pairs hit the temperature-scaling infeasibility floor within one percentage point of the predicted bound. Platt scaling reduces ECE to as low as 0.02, yet certified autonomy at a 20% risk budget is granted to only three model-task pairs and to none at 10%. We also identify and repair an answer-ordering artifact in the multiple-choice form of TruthfulQA. Calibration gives confidence semantics; certified deferral determines when small models are safe to use.
papers.comment: Accepted at MIWAI 2026 (The 19th International Conference on Multi-disciplinary Trends in Artificial Intelligence), to appear in Springer LNAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小型开放权重语言模型在私有、离线、低成本场景中能否用言语化置信度（verbalized confidence）支持风险可控的延迟决策（deferral）。作者在三个家族共 11 个指令微调模型（0.5B 至 14B 参数）的 ARC-Challenge 和 TruthfulQA 上做了 25,168 个本地预测，给出三个理论结果界定校准的极限，并实证发现温度缩放不可行边界、Platt 缩放可将 ECE 降至 0.02 但认证自主性极少。文中还识别并修复了 TruthfulQA 多选题形式的答案排序伪影。
Motivation: 小模型部署的关键问题不仅是模型回答什么，还包括何时应当把任务交给人类；论文针对言语化置信度能否支撑风险控制下的延迟决策这一问题展开研究。
Method: 结合理论证明与大规模实证：证明严格单调校准保持风险-覆盖前沿和误差检测 AUROC；证明温度缩放无法校准那些置信度始终高于 1/2 而准确率低于 1/2 的模型；用 Clopper-Pearson 程序在 i.i.d. 部署假设下将 200 题校准集转换为有限样本风险证书。实证部分评估 11 个模型、22 个模型-任务对，并修复 TruthfulQA 的答案排序伪影。
Result: 22 个模型-任务对中有 8 对在预测边界一个百分点内触及温度缩放的不可行下限；Platt 缩放将 ECE 最低降至 0.02，但在 20% 风险预算下只有 3 个模型-任务对获得认证自主性，10% 预算下则没有任何一对。
Conclusion: 校准赋予置信度以语义，认证延迟决定小模型何时可安全使用；在严格风险预算下，小模型可获得认证的自主性非常有限。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Hardware Design and Security in the Era of Chiplets and LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The semiconductor industry is undergoing a dual revolution: the shift toward heterogeneous 2.5D chiplet systems and the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows. While these paradigms offer unprecedented benefits in yield, modularity, design productivity, etc., they radically expand the hardware attack surface. This paper provides a unified analysis of these frontiers, ranging from attacks on chiplet systems (including hardware stacks for LLM acceleration) across architectural, logical, and physical levels, to various exploits against LLM-driven EDA pipelines. To secure chiplet systems, we review a powerful defense approach that leverages 2.5D split manufacturing and active interposers for physically isolated Root of Trust (RoT) architectures. To secure LLM-driven EDA pipelines, we first identify native threats and then review state-of-the-art defense techniques. Finally, we discuss how LLM systems can advance hardware security efforts for modern systems, including chiplets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述性论文，统一分析半导体行业两大变革——异构 2.5D chiplet 系统与 LLM 驱动的 EDA 流程——所带来的硬件攻击面扩张。作者从架构、逻辑和物理层面梳理针对 chiplet 系统（含 LLM 加速硬件栈）的攻击，并综述基于 2.5D 拆分制造与有源中介层（active interposer）的物理隔离可信根（RoT）防御，以及针对 LLM 驱动 EDA 流水线的原生威胁与防御技术。
Motivation: 面向 chiplet 与 LLM 集成的新范式在良率、模块化、设计效率等方面带来收益，但也大幅扩展了硬件攻击面，现有安全分析尚未将这些前沿统一起来。
Method: 采用统一分析框架，覆盖从架构、逻辑到物理层面的 chiplet 攻击，以及针对 LLM 驱动 EDA 流水线的攻击与防御；同时讨论 LLM 系统如何反过来推进现代系统（含 chiplet）的硬件安全。
Result: 该论文为综述性工作，未报告新的实验数据；主要产出是对攻击面和防御方法的系统梳理，包括 2.5D 拆分制造和有源中介层实现物理隔离 RoT 的防御思路。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，保障 chiplet 系统和 LLM 驱动 EDA 流水线需要新的安全机制，并指出 LLM 技术可为现代硬件安全提供助力；但具体防护效果与研究局限需要结合原文进一步评估。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RepairFormer: Automated Repair of Structured Inputs Using Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Structured input files such as JSON, DOT, OBJ, INI, S-expression, and TinyC are widely used in software systems, but small corruptions can cause parsers to reject otherwise useful data. Repairing such inputs is important because malformed configuration, program, and data files can interrupt testing, analysis, deployment, and downstream automation even when most of the original content remains intact. Existing repair techniques can produce structurally valid inputs, but they often rely on deletion or repeated search, which may lose original content and result in semantic incorrectness. This paper presents RepairFormer, a transformer-based framework for structured input repair. The approach formulates repair as a supervised sequence generation task and uses format tags, oracle validation, and boundary-localized repair to generate valid outputs while preserving content. The boundary workflow focuses generation on the detected fault region, reducing the input size, and supporting repair of longer files. In evaluation, RepairFormer achieves a 88% in repair and 94% in recovery, showing strongest content preservation when repairs are successful. Additional experiments on our benchmark shows RepairFormer repairs 97.57% and recovers 94.29% with 5x faster runtime compared to state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RepairFormer 是一个基于 Transformer 的结构化输入修复框架，针对 JSON、DOT、OBJ、INI、S-expression、TinyC 等被轻微损坏的结构化文件。该方法将修复建模为有监督的序列生成任务，结合格式标签 (format tags)、oracle 校验和边界定位修复 (boundary-localized repair)，在生成有效输出的同时尽量保留原始内容。摘要报告其在评估中达到 88% 的修复率和 94% 的恢复率，并在作者自己的基准上达到 97.57% 的修复率和 94.29% 的恢复率，同时比现有方法快 5 倍。
Motivation: 结构化输入文件在软件系统中广泛使用，微小损坏就会导致解析器拒绝接收大部分仍然有效的数据，进而中断测试、分析、部署和下游自动化。现有修复技术虽能生成结构有效的输入，但常依赖删除或反复搜索，可能丢失原始内容并造成语义错误。
Method: 将修复问题表述为监督式序列生成任务，引入格式标签、oracle 校验以及边界定位修复机制；边界工作流将生成集中于检测到的故障区域，减小输入规模，从而支持更长文件的修复。
Result: 摘要报告 RepairFormer 在修复任务上达到 88% 的修复率和 94% 的恢复率，且在修复成功时表现出最强的内容保留能力；在作者自建基准上，修复率达到 97.57%，恢复率达到 94.29%，运行时间比现有最优方法快 5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调边界定位的 Transformer 修复方法能在提升结构化输入修复速度的同时更好地保留原始内容；但实验主要基于作者自建基准，且论文为 5 页短文，结论的泛化性有待进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MarsCast: Transfer Learning of AI Weather Foundation Models to Planetary Atmospheres
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the transferability of Earth weather foundation models to planetary atmospheres by adapting the GraphCast graph neural weather forecasting model to Mars. While GraphCast achieves state-of-the-art performance for terrestrial forecasting, its applicability to non-Earth environments remains unexplored. Using the Mars Climate Database (MCD), which provides global atmospheric fields across vertical altitude levels (similar to Earth pressure levels), we evaluate zero-shot and fine-tuned GraphCast predictions of Martian temperature and wind fields. Zero-shot forecasts produce a surprisingly accurate depiction of current conditions but fail to reproduce diurnal variability and rapidly decay toward climatological mean states. To address this limitation, we fine-tune GraphCast using MCD variables and top-of-atmosphere solar radiation forcing while holding humidity constant. Fine-tuning enables rapid learning of Martian thermal variability. Within as few as 10 training epochs, the model begins to capture the diurnal cycle and forecasts up to 10 days reproduce seasonal and vertical temperature structure. Prediction quality improves with training sample size and exhibits sensitivity to seasonal initialization. These results demonstrate that Earth-trained AI weather models can be adapted to simulate Martian atmospheric dynamics, providing a pathway toward rapid planetary weather prediction to support mission operations, dust storm risk mitigation, and future human exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将地球天气基础模型迁移到行星大气，具体做法是把 GraphCast 图神经网络天气预测模型适配到火星。作者使用火星气候数据库 (MCD) 的全球大气场数据，评估零样本和微调后的 GraphCast 对火星温度和风场的预测能力，发现微调能在很少的训练轮次内学会火星热力日变化，并复现长达 10 天的季节和垂直温度结构。
Motivation: GraphCast 在地球天气预报上达到领先性能，但能否用于非地球环境尚未探索；面向火星任务规划、沙尘暴风险缓解和未来载人探索，需要快速的行星天气预报能力。
Method: 将 GraphCast 迁移到火星：使用 MCD 提供类似地球气压层的垂直分层全球大气场，评估零样本预测，并用 MCD 变量、大气层顶太阳辐射强迫进行微调，同时保持湿度恒定。
Result: 零样本预测能大致反映当前状态，但无法再现日变化且迅速衰减到气候平均态；微调 10 个 epoch 后模型开始捕捉日循环，10 天预报能再现季节和垂直温度结构，预测质量随训练样本量增加而提升，并对季节初始化敏感。
Conclusion: 结果表明地球训练的 AI 天气模型可以适配到火星大气动力学模拟，为快速行星天气预测提供了一条途径，以支持任务运行和沙尘暴风险应对。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: The Effect of Perceived Race and Gender on Police Language Use: Experimental Evidence from VR Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Against the backdrop of violence in police interactions with the U.S. public, we explore how deferentially police officers speak to virtual characters depicted as Black adult males in vir- tual reality (VR) simulations. We evaluate the effect of seeing and communicating with these characters through a causal in- ference lens, where the assignment of the Black man character to a police officer and simulation is the treatment variable. Our (marginal) average treatment effect AT E measures the social impact of the character on the deference of officer statements with each turn of the conversation. Soberingly, we find that most officers speak less deferentially to Black man characters, except for White, biracial, and multiracial female officers, es- pecially in settings where the VR character was known to be a suspect. Across a full conversation of a typical VR scene, these marginal AT Es can result in notable changes in def- erence of tone (two to several points difference on a scale of 0-10), above and beyond that due to the initial effect of per- ceiving a Black male character. Even more disconcerting is that this can contribute to conversation breakdowns that po- tentially result in violence or danger to both the public and the police. We also explored the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for ATE estimation. From our methods com- parison analysis, including model validation against synthetic data, we provide unique scientific insights on LLM-assisted methodologies for ATE estimation. As such, for ATE esti- mation with multilevel data with text, we recommend mixed effects models with the inverse propensity treatment weighted (iptw) approach, which utilized an LLM for text feature cre- ation. While we also tested LLMs for finetuning prediction models ultimately for ATE estimation, we conclude they are an area for further development and refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用虚拟现实（VR）模拟实验，从因果推断视角考察警员与虚拟黑人男性角色对话时的语言恭敬程度（deference）。研究发现大多数警员对黑人男性角色说话时恭敬度下降，但白人、双种族及多种族女性警员除外，尤其在VR角色被设定为嫌疑人时更为明显。边际平均处理效应（ATE）在整段对话中可造成0-10分尺度上2到数分的语气恭敬度差异，并可能导致对话破裂。作者还比较了多种ATE估计方法，推荐结合LLM生成文本特征的反概率加权（IPTW）混合效应模型。
Motivation: 针对美国警察与公众互动中的暴力背景，探究警察对VR中呈现为黑人成年男性的角色是否以更低恭敬度说话，以量化种族和性别感知对警察语言使用的因果影响。
Method: 在VR模拟中将黑人男性角色分配给警员和模拟场景作为处理变量，计算每个对话回合的边际平均处理效应（ATE）；并比较多种ATE估计方法，包括混合效应模型、基于LLM的特征创建与微调预测模型，并用合成数据验证。
Result: 多数警员对黑人男性角色的说话恭敬度更低，白人、双种族和多种族女性警员例外；当角色为嫌疑人时效应更强，整段对话累计恭敬度差异达0-10分尺度的2到数分；方法比较推荐使用LLM进行文本特征创建的反概率加权（IPTW）混合效应模型，LLM微调预测模型被认为仍需改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调种族和性别感知显著影响警员语言恭敬度，可能促成对话破裂并给公众和警察带来危险；在多层文本数据的ATE估计中，IPTW混合效应模型优于纯LLM方案，LLM在ATE估计中仍需进一步发展和完善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Instruction-based Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based video editing (IVE) is an emerging field with broad applications, yet evaluating editing models remains challenging. Existing benchmarks suffer from two major limitations: limited task coverage inherited from image editing, which overlooks video-specific dimensions, and inadequate metrics that fail to measure instruction fidelity, allowing incorrect edits to receive high scores due to strong visual priors from the original video. To address these issues, we introduce a comprehensive and structured benchmark for IVE. Our benchmark decomposes editing tasks into multiple video-specific dimensions, including spatial, temporal, audio, and reference-based editing, extending beyond conventional frame-level evaluation. It also distinguishes explicit and implicit instructions and incorporates reasoning-based scenarios to better reflect real-world requirements. Furthermore, we propose an evaluation framework that assesses editing quality from four complementary dimensions: accuracy, preservation, realism, and consistency, using both human judgments and state-of-the-art vision-language models. To emphasize instruction fidelity, we introduce an accuracy-aware penalty mechanism that conditions other scores on accuracy, preventing visually plausible but incorrect edits from receiving inflated evaluations. Extensive experiments on representative open-source and commercial models show that current IVE models remain far from satisfactory. OmniEdit-Bench provides a comprehensive and reliable testbed for evaluating instruction-based video editing and offers insights into future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniEdit-Bench，一个面向指令式视频编辑 (instruction-based video editing, IVE) 的结构化综合基准。基准将编辑任务分解为空间、时间、音频和参考编辑等视频特有维度，并区分显式/隐式指令及推理式场景；评估框架从准确性、保持性、真实性和一致性四个互补维度进行评价，并引入以准确性为条件的惩罚机制。对代表性开源与商业模型的广泛实验表明，当前 IVE 模型在该基准上仍远未令人满意。
Motivation: 现有 IVE 基准存在两大局限：任务覆盖有限，多继承自图像编辑而忽略视频特有维度；指标无法衡量指令遵从度，因为原视频的强视觉先验可能让错误编辑也获得高分。
Method: 构建覆盖多视频特有维度（空间、时间、音频、参考编辑）的基准，并加入显式/隐式指令区分和推理式场景；提出包含 accuracy、preservation、realism、consistency 四维的评估框架，结合人类判断与先进视觉语言模型，并通过 accuracy-aware penalty 机制使其他分数以准确性为条件，防止视觉上合理但错误的编辑被高估。
Result: 摘要报告在代表性开源和商业模型上的大量实验显示，当前 IVE 模型的表现仍远未令人满意 (far from satisfactory)。
Conclusion: OmniEdit-Bench 为指令式视频编辑提供了全面且可靠的测试平台，并为未来研究方向提供见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient Immunity: Null-Space Resistance to Malicious Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Released aligned large language models remain vulnerable to malicious downstream finetuning. Existing defenses are largely designed for the fine-tuning-as-a-service (FTaaS) paradigm or rely on downstream users to follow additional safety procedures, and therefore do not directly address the setting we study: a provider controlled partially protected open-weight (PPOW) release setting in which most weights remain trainable while a small safety-critical component is preserved at release. We propose a Unidirectional Safety Gate (USG), instantiated as a Null Space Cubic Layer together with an Inverse Adapter inserted after the final Transformer layer. During downstream fine-tuning, the cubic layer suppresses or blocks gradients from harmful samples whose hidden states fall in a calibrated protected region, while the Inverse Adapter restores the base model's forward behavior. In practice, we calibrate a threshold using defender-held harmful data, allowing protection to generalize to nearby in-distribution harmful samples. Across six evaluated model-dataset settings, USG keeps post-finetuning attack success rate close to the pre-release level under a fixed release threshold, while maintaining high safe-pass rates on easier settings and exhibiting a clearer safety-utility trade-off on unsafe samples from BeaverTails. These results suggest that release-time representation-space blocking can raise the cost of malicious downstream adaptation without requiring downstream cooperation. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/Gradient-Immunity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部分受保护的开源权重（PPOW）发布场景提出一种单向安全门（Unidirectional Safety Gate, USG），由空空间三次层（Null Space Cubic Layer）和反向适配器（Inverse Adapter）构成，插入最终 Transformer 层之后。在下游微调时，该三次层会抑制或阻断来自有害样本（其隐藏状态落入已标定的受保护区域）的梯度，而反向适配器保持基座模型的前向行为。在六个模型-数据集设置下，固定发布阈值时 USG 使微调后攻击成功率接近发布前水平，同时保持较高的安全通过率。
Motivation: 已发布的对齐大语言模型仍易受恶意下游微调攻击；现有防御多面向微调即服务（FTaaS）范式或依赖下游用户遵守额外安全流程，无法直接处理本文研究的 PPOW 发布设置：大部分权重保持可训练，仅少量安全关键组件在发布时被保留。
Method: 提出 USG，具体实现为紧随最终 Transformer 层的 Null Space Cubic Layer 与 Inverse Adapter 组合。在微调期间，三次层抑制或阻断隐藏状态处于已标定受保护区域的有害样本的梯度，Inverse Adapter 则恢复基座模型的前向行为；防御方用自己持有的有害数据标定阈值，使保护泛化到邻近的分布内有害样本。
Result: 在六个模型-数据集设置下，固定发布阈值时 USG 将微调后的攻击成功率保持在接近发布前水平，并在更简单设置上维持高安全通过率；在 BeaverTails 的不安全样本上呈现出更清晰的安全-效用权衡。
Conclusion: 结果表明，发布时在表征空间层面进行阻断可以提高恶意下游适配的成本，且无需下游用户配合；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
papers.abstract_en: Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a system that can adapt its representation, execution strategy, and hardware mapping to each workload and target GPU. We present SparseDitto, an LLM-based system that constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU. SparseDitto supports SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM within a unified design framework. A lightweight additive model ranks established strategies using structural features of the input matrix. An architecture-aware planner then proposes several candidate designs. Coding and verification agents implement and refine them using measurements from the target GPU. Across three sparse operators and a diverse set of matrices, SparseDitto achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 2.68x over cuSPARSE on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, with a maximum of 146.61x. On an NVIDIA H200 GPU, it achieves 2.79x, with a maximum of 78.5x. Its generated SpMM kernels also accelerate full-batch GCN training by up to 3.39x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparseDitto 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体系统，针对每个稀疏矩阵、算子和目标 GPU 自动构建定制化 GPU kernel，统一支持 SpMV、SpMM 和 SpGEMM。摘要报告其在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上的几何平均加速比相对 cuSPARSE 为 2.68x、最大 146.61x，在 H200 上为 2.79x、最大 78.5x，生成的 SpMM kernel 还可将全批量 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39x。
Motivation: 稀疏矩阵 kernel 的 GPU 性能强烈依赖输入稀疏模式和执行策略，例如同一矩阵上 cuSPARSE 在 CSR 与 Blocked-ELL 之间可存在 350x 性能差距；对多种数据格式、专用系统和稀疏编译器研究表明，没有任何单一实现在不同稀疏模式与算子上始终占优，因此需要能按负载和 GPU 自适应表示、执行策略与硬件映射的系统。
Method: 提出统一设计框架 SparseDitto：用轻量级加性模型基于输入矩阵结构特征对已有策略排序，再由架构感知规划器提出多个候选设计，编码与验证智能体在目标 GPU 上通过实测实现并细化这些候选。
Result: 在三个稀疏算子和多种矩阵上，SparseDitto 在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上取得相对 cuSPARSE 的几何平均加速比 2.68x、最大 146.61x；在 NVIDIA H200 上为 2.79x、最大 78.5x；其生成的 SpMM kernel 将全批量 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39x。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统能够为每个矩阵、算子和目标 GPU 自适应地选择表示、执行策略与硬件映射，并证明该统一框架可覆盖 SpMV、SpMM 与 SpGEMM。

summary_sections.tldr: SparseDitto 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体系统，针对每个稀疏矩阵、算子和目标 GPU 自动构建定制化 GPU kernel，统一支持 SpMV、SpMM 和 SpGEMM。摘要报告其在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上的几何平均加速比相对 cuSPARSE 为 2.68x、最大 146.61x，在 H200 上为 2.79x、最大 78.5x，生成的 SpMM kernel 还可将全批量 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39x。
summary_sections.motivation: 稀疏矩阵 kernel 的 GPU 性能强烈依赖输入稀疏模式和执行策略，例如同一矩阵上 cuSPARSE 在 CSR 与 Blocked-ELL 之间可存在 350x 性能差距；对多种数据格式、专用系统和稀疏编译器研究表明，没有任何单一实现在不同稀疏模式与算子上始终占优，因此需要能按负载和 GPU 自适应表示、执行策略与硬件映射的系统。
summary_sections.method: 提出统一设计框架 SparseDitto：用轻量级加性模型基于输入矩阵结构特征对已有策略排序，再由架构感知规划器提出多个候选设计，编码与验证智能体在目标 GPU 上通过实测实现并细化这些候选。
summary_sections.result: 在三个稀疏算子和多种矩阵上，SparseDitto 在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上取得相对 cuSPARSE 的几何平均加速比 2.68x、最大 146.61x；在 NVIDIA H200 上为 2.79x、最大 78.5x；其生成的 SpMM kernel 将全批量 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39x。

papers.title: From Score Matrices to Football-Aware Match-State Simulation: An Auditable LLM Harness for Exact-Score Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Football score forecasting combines a strong statistical core with a difficult contextual edge. Dynamic Poisson-family models estimate team strength, expected goals, and coherent score probabilities, but do not directly understand roles, tactical matchups, motivation, or how a first goal changes behaviour. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such concepts, yet are not calibrated probability engines. We combine both components through an auditable information harness. This paper documents four iterations: V1, a dynamic score-driven Dixon-Coles baseline; V2, which maps LLM contextual ratings back into expected-goal parameters; V3, which replaces scalar correction with goal-by-goal simulations over a frozen score-candidate set; and V4, which adds shared first-breakthrough and post-goal cascade judgments, time-aware stopping, and deterministic tail candidates. The harness defines input semantics, supplies pre-match evidence, and constrains the LLM to an inspectable reasoning route. On a chronological replay of the first 150 matches of the 2025-26 English Premier League, V1 achieved 10.0% Top-1 and 26.7% Top-3 exact-score accuracy. V3 reached 12.0% and 30.0%, while V4 reached 14.7% and 30.7%. V4 increased candidate coverage from 77.3% to 84.7%, although no added tail candidate became a Top-3 exact hit. V1's native 1X2 distribution achieved 53.3% argmax accuracy, 0.9878 log loss, 0.5870 Brier score, and 0.2095 ranked probability score. These results are exploratory: the development slice is not an untouched benchmark, and temporal input isolation cannot exclude outcome memory in a closed LLM. The contribution is an auditable hybrid architecture, a clear design evolution, and negative findings showing where football-aware simulation does and does not improve score selection.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Interim chronological benchmark on the first 150 matches of the 2025-26 English Premier League
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可审计的混合信息管线 (auditable information harness)，将动态 Poisson 族统计模型与 LLM 的上下文推理结合，用于足球比赛精确比分 (exact-score) 的重排序。作者记录了四个迭代版本：V1 为动态 Dixon-Coles 基线，V2 将 LLM 上下文评级映射回期望进球参数，V3 在冻结的比分候选集上做逐球模拟，V4 增加首次破门与进球后级联判断、时间感知停止和确定性尾部候选。在 2025-26 英超前 150 场比赛的时间顺序回放中，V4 的 Top-1 精确比分准确率达 14.7%，Top-3 达 30.7%，候选覆盖率从 77.3% 提升到 84.7%。
Motivation: 动态 Poisson 族模型能估计球队实力、期望进球和连贯的比分概率，但不理解角色、战术对位、动机或首球如何改变比赛行为；LLM 能推理这类概念，却并非校准的概率引擎。作者旨在把两者组合起来，同时保持推理过程可检查。
Method: 构建可审计的信息管线：定义输入语义、提供赛前证据，并把 LLM 限制到可检查的推理路径。具体包括四个迭代：V1 动态 score-driven Dixon-Coles 基线；V2 把 LLM 情境评级映射为期望进球参数；V3 用逐球模拟替代标量修正；V4 加入共享的首破门与进球后级联判断、时间感知停止和确定性尾部候选，用于对候选比分集合重排序。
Result: 在 2025-26 英超前 150 场的时间顺序回放中，V1 达到 10.0% Top-1 和 26.7% Top-3 精确比分准确率；V3 达到 12.0% 和 30.0%；V4 达到 14.7% 和 30.7%。V4 把候选覆盖率从 77.3% 提升到 84.7%，但没有新增的尾部候选进入 Top-3 精确命中。V1 的原生 1X2 分布取得 53.3% argmax 准确率、0.9878 log loss、0.5870 Brier score 和 0.2095 ranked probability score。
Conclusion: 作者明确说明结果是探索性的：开发切片并非未触碰的基准，时间输入隔离也无法排除封闭 LLM 中的结果记忆。论文的贡献是可审计的混合架构、清晰的设计演进，以及展示足球感知模拟在哪些方面改善或未改善比分选择的负面发现。

papers.title: ArtAnno: Annotating Implicit Semantics in Artworks through LLM Agent-Driven Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: High-quality annotation of artworks is essential for computational art research, yet extracting implicit semantics remains challenging due to the reliance on culturally grounded meanings and deep contextual knowledge behind the images. Current AI-assisted annotation tools often lack assistance or rely on one-way workflows where experts have to perform extra manual calibrations to improve AI models, resulting in limited efficiency. To address this, we propose Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation(BiHAA), a closed-loop framework in which skills and domain knowledge base evolve through real-time interaction and bidirectional HAI augmentation. Informed by a formative study with 20 artwork annotators from different backgrounds, we implement this framework in ArtAnno, an artwork annotation system driven by a multi-agent architecture. The system includes a Proactive Agentic Support Module, where AI augments humans through semantic mining and label suggestion, and an Interaction-Driven Evolution Module, where human expertise continuously enhances the AI through distilling annotation trajectories into reusable experience. Evaluation through a user study and two case studies demonstrates that our framework and system improve annotation efficiency, enable knowledge accumulation, and reduce the effort of information seeking and verification for annotators with limited domain expertise. We conclude by discussing broader implications and future directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双向人机增强（Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation, BiHAA）闭环框架，并实现为 ArtAnno，一个面向艺术品隐式语义标注的多智能体系统。系统包含主动智能体支持模块（AI 通过语义挖掘和标签建议增强人类）与交互驱动演化模块（人类通过将标注轨迹提炼为可复用经验来增强 AI）。基于 20 名标注者的形成性研究，用户研究和两个案例研究显示该系统提升了标注效率、促进知识积累，并减少缺乏领域专长的标注者的信息检索与验证负担。
Motivation: 艺术品的高质量标注对计算艺术研究至关重要，但隐式语义依赖图像背后的文化含义和深层语境知识，提取困难；现有 AI 辅助标注工具缺乏协助，或采用单向流程，需要专家额外手动校准来改进 AI，导致效率受限。
Method: 提出 BiHAA 闭环框架，让技能和领域知识库通过实时交互与双向人机增强（bidirectional HAI augmentation）持续演化；基于不同背景的 20 名艺术品标注者的形成性研究，将框架实现为多智能体架构的 ArtAnno，包括主动智能体支持模块和交互驱动演化模块。
Result: 用户研究和两个案例研究显示，该框架和系统提升了标注效率、支持知识积累，并减少了缺乏领域专长标注者在信息检索与验证上的努力。
Conclusion: 摘要总结该框架和系统在艺术品隐式语义标注中的有效性，并讨论更广泛的应用意义与未来方向。

papers.title: Canonical Joint Energy-Based Model on CIFAR-10: failure modes and practical indistinguishability of Predictor-Corrector and SGLD samplers
papers.abstract_en: Joint Energy-Based Models (JEM) unify classification and generation within a single network and support out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Canonical JEM training relies on stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD); a theoretically motivated alternative, the Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampler, has not previously undergone a systematic replication test on the canonical model. We reproduce canonical JEM on WideResNet-28-10 without normalisation layers on two independent runs and test whether PC retains its theoretical advantage without an annealed noise schedule, across three protocols: PC replacing SGLD throughout the roughly 130 training epochs; cold-start generation (FID); and refinement-style multi-OOD detection (AUROC). The reconstruction reaches 92.88% test accuracy and buffer-FID 44.46 (canonical: 92.9% and 38.40). We document two failure modes: catastrophic late-training divergence via the canonical outlier-buffer mechanism (both SGLD runs and, with the same signature, both PC runs), and run-dependent SVHN OOD-discrimination dynamics. No method-level advantage of PC over SGLD is observed on any protocol: at inference the absolute AUROC difference stays below 0.007 across all ten checkpoint-OOD pairs and the FID difference below 0.5; on the training protocol a hierarchical seed-by-image bootstrap gives a 95% confidence interval on the macro-averaged AUROC difference that contains zero, while a seed-level equivalence test with two runs per method cannot establish formal equivalence. The data are consistent both with equivalence and with a small directional effect. This practical indistinguishability is theoretically expected: under fixed noise the PC predictor step degenerates by construction, so its guarantees do not transfer to canonical JEM.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Under review at Discover Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在无归一化层的 WideResNet-28-10 上对规范联合能量模型 (JEM) 进行两次独立复现，系统比较 Predictor-Corrector (PC) 采样器与标准 SGLD 采样器。摘要显示 PC 在训练、冷启动生成 (FID) 和 refinement 式多 OOD 检测 (AUROC) 三种协议下均未表现出方法级优势，实际效果与 SGLD 不可区分；同时记录了两个失败模式：晚期训练发散和运行依赖的 SVHN OOD 判别动态。
Motivation: JEM 通过同一网络统一分类、生成和 OOD 检测，其规范训练依赖 SGLD；理论上更优的 PC 采样器此前未在规范模型上进行系统性复现检验，作者希望验证该理论优势在无退火噪声调度时是否保留。
Method: 复现规范 JEM（WideResNet-28-10，无归一化层）并进行两次独立运行；在约 130 轮训练中用 PC 替换 SGLD，并通过三种协议评估：PC 全程替换 SGLD 的训练协议、冷启动生成 (FID) 以及 refinement 式多 OOD 检测 (AUROC)。
Result: 复现达到 92.88% 测试准确率和 buffer-FID 44.46（规范值分别为 92.9% 和 38.40）；PC 相对 SGLD 无方法级优势：推理时所有十对 checkpoint-OOD 的绝对 AUROC 差低于 0.007，FID 差低于 0.5；训练协议中分层 seed-by-image bootstrap 给出的宏观平均 AUROC 差 95% 置信区间包含零，而两方法各两次运行的 seed 级等价检验无法建立形式等价。
Conclusion: 摘要记录两个失败模式：经由规范 outlier-buffer 机制的灾难性晚期训练发散（SGLD 与 PC 均有相同特征）以及随运行变化的 SVHN OOD 判别动态；PC 与 SGLD 的实际不可区分性在理论上可预期，因为固定噪声下 PC 预测步退化，其理论保证无法转移到规范 JEM。数据既与两方法等价一致，也与存在小方向性效应一致。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Short-term load forecasting under EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments: Results from a 41-day live challenge on the aggregated German transmission-grid load
papers.abstract_en: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) play a vital role in the electric power industry. It serves infrastructure that European and German law designate as critical. Determinism, reproducibility, and auditability are engineering requirements rather than optional extras. STLF is no longer purely an accuracy problem. It is also a software-engineering and compliance problem. This paper describes results from a 41-day live challenge that evaluated a complete STLF pipeline for the aggregated German transmission-grid load. The pipeline is based on the open-source Python library spotforecast2-safe, which implements the EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments by design. The pipeline predicts the 24 hourly load values of a target day from European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E) data. It includes anomaly detection and gap-aware data preparation, calendar and weather covariates, a recursive multi-step forecasting algorithm, and hyperparameter tuning. Forecast accuracy is measured against the official ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast. The EU-AI act compliant spotforecast2-safe pipeline beats the ENTSO-E baseline. In-context models show competitive performance. Transparent, low-cost, and auditable local models (referred to as macl2l in this paper) are competitive with more than 100-million-parameter large, energy-intensive pre-trained foundation models such as chronos-2. The challenge infrastructure, the complete submission history of all teams, and the frozen final leaderboard are publicly available.

TL;DR: 本文报告了一个历时 41 天的实时挑战赛结果，用于评估面向德国输电网总负荷的完整短期负荷预测（STLF）流程。该流程基于开源 Python 库 spotforecast2-safe，按 EU-AI Act 要求以安全关键环境合规性进行设计，使用 ENTSO-E 数据，并包含异常检测、缺口感知的数据准备、日历与天气协变量、递归多步预测算法及超参数调优。摘要称该合规流程在预测精度上击败了官方 ENTSO-E 日前预测基线，并且低成本的局地模型（文中称为 macl2l）与超过 1 亿参数的基础模型（如 chronos-2）具有竞争力。挑战基础设施、所有团队的提交历史以及冻结的最终排行榜均已公开。
Motivation: 短期负荷预测服务于欧洲和德国法律认定的关键基础设施，确定性、可复现性和可审计性是工程要求而非可选项；STLF 不再仅是精度问题，也涉及软件工程与合规问题。
Method: 提出并公开了一个完整的 STLF 流程：基于 ENSO-E 数据预测目标日 24 个小时负荷，包含异常检测、缺口感知的数据准备、日历与天气协变量、递归多步预测算法和超参数调优，并通过 41 天实时挑战赛进行评测。
Result: EU-AI-Act 合规的 spotforecast2-safe 流程击败了 ENTSO-E 基线；上下文内模型（in-context models）表现有竞争力；局地模型 macl2l 与超过 1 亿参数的高能耗预训练基础模型 chronos-2 相比同样具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 透明、低成本、可审计的局地模型能够在负荷预测中与大规模预训练基础模型竞争；公开的挑战基础设施、提交历史和排行榜有助于审计与复现，体现了将合规性融入设计（by design）的价值。

papers.title: Algorithm-Driven SVARs: Navigating the Wilderness of Big Data
papers.abstract_en: Every SVAR result is conditional on two choices: the restrictions that identify the shock and the variables on which they operate. The literature disciplines the first; the second is chosen by hand. We develop a Bayesian methodology that constructs information sets, uses an out-of-sample criterion, and retains the largest system it admits. Under recursive identification, output rises with housing production rather than household credit alone. For monetary policy, an anchor-free joint Bayesian proxy SVAR with multiple instruments strengthens the credit spread channel. A core system augmented with the selected corporate spread identifies expected default risk as a potent transmission margin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯方法来自动构建 SVAR 的信息集（information set），用样本外准则筛选变量并保留可容纳的最大系统，从而将原先由人工选择的变量集合纳入建模框架。在递归识别下，该方法发现住房生产而非家庭信贷单独推动产出上升；在货币政策分析中，无锚定（anchor-free）的联合贝叶斯代理 SVAR 配合多个工具变量强化了信用利差渠道，而加入所选公司利差的核心系统将预期违约风险识别为重要的传导渠道。
Motivation: 结构向量自回归（SVAR）的每个结果都取决于两个选择：识别冲击的约束以及这些约束作用的变量集合。文献已经系统化了第一个选择，但第二个选择仍然由人工决定，这可能导致结论对变量选择敏感。
Method: 开发一种贝叶斯方法论：自动构建信息集，采用样本外（out-of-sample）准则，并保留该方法所允许的最大系统；同时引入无锚定的联合贝叶斯代理 SVAR（joint Bayesian proxy SVAR），支持多个工具变量。
Result: 递归识别下产出随住房生产而非仅随家庭信贷上升；对货币政策而言，多工具变量的联合贝叶斯代理 SVAR 强化了信用利差渠道；用所选公司利差扩增的核心系统将预期违约风险识别为有力的传导渠道。
Conclusion: 作者强调变量集合的选择对 SVAR 结论影响显著，所提出的贝叶斯方法为这一环节提供了一种系统化、数据驱动的处理方式。

papers.title: Link prediction on multi-relational graphs from an influence propagation perspective
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the existence and type of links (edges) between nodes in a multi-relational graph is key for applications from social interaction prediction to knowledge relationship identification. Enhancing local features with relevant global information is crucial for accurate link prediction, yet it remains challenging. We address this by modeling the relationship between node pairs as node influence. That is, whether the node influence can be propagated and what type of influence is propagated indicates where and what type the edge is, which will be the most relevant local and global information to predict the edges. To this end, we extend the Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) epidemic model to capture the influence propagation of nodes on a large scale through sub-graph structures. Subsequently, these sub-graphs are compressed using virtual edges, thereby substantially reducing the computation associated with utilizing the global graph structure. Finally, we propose the Influential Graph Neural Predictor, referred to as IGNP, a link prediction framework guided by influence propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method, which outperforms strong baselines by a large margin on the widely used and real-world datasets.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从影响力传播 (influence propagation) 的角度研究多关系图上的链接预测，将节点对之间是否存在边以及边的类型建模为节点影响力的传播结果。作者扩展 Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) 流行病模型，通过子图结构在大规模图上捕获影响力传播，并用虚拟边压缩子图以降低全局结构计算成本，进而提出 Influential Graph Neural Predictor (IGNP) 链接预测框架。实验表明该方法在广泛使用的真实数据集上大幅优于强基线。
Motivation: 多关系图中的链接预测需要同时判断边是否存在及其类型，仅靠局部特征不够，必须融入相关全局信息；如何高效地结合局部与全局信息仍是挑战。
Method: 将节点对之间的关系视为节点影响力，判断影响力能否传播以及传播的类型对应边的位置与类型；扩展 SIR 流行病模型在子图结构上刻画大规模节点影响力传播，再用虚拟边压缩子图以减少全局结构计算，最终提出由影响力传播引导的链接预测框架 IGNP。
Result: 在广泛使用的真实数据集上，IGNP 以较大幅度超越强基线，摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将链接预测建模为影响力传播、并结合子图压缩是有效的方向，但没有讨论方法局限或更细的适用范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Revealed Rationality: Label-Free Evaluation and Regularization from Representation Theorems
papers.abstract_en: Representation theorems in decision theory establish that behavior satisfies certain axioms if and only if it can be rationalized by a well-defined objective. I argue that this ``if and only if'' structure provides a potentially useful foundation for label-free evaluation and regularization of LLMs and other AI systems. Axiom compliance can be checked from the model's own responses to synthetic choice problems, with no external labels or human feedback, and the penalties are readily computable. Because the axioms are necessary and sufficient, the resulting checks exhaust the implications of the relevant rationality standard for the elicited data: a model that passes cannot be rejected on rationality grounds by any further test of the same data. I discuss three instantiations: probabilistic coherence via a theorem of de Finetti, preference rationality via Afriat's theorem, and subjective expected utility via a theorem of Echenique and Saito (2015), each yielding a continuous penalty that is zero whenever behavior can be rationalized. Since coherence does not restrict which objective rationalizes behavior, these penalties complement rather than replace other evaluation and training signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用决策论中的表示定理 (representation theorems) 为大语言模型等 AI 系统提供无标签评估与正则化。其核心逻辑是：行为满足某些公理当且仅当能被某个良定义的目标函数理性化，因此可从模型对合成选择问题的自身回答中检验公理符合度，无需外部标签或人类反馈。作者给出三个实例：基于 de Finetti 定理的概率一致性、基于 Afriat 定理的偏好理性、基于 Echenique-Saito (2015) 定理的主观期望效用，每个都产生一个在行为可理性化时取零的连续惩罚项。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估与训练通常依赖外部标签或人类反馈；决策论中的表示定理提供“当且仅当”的充要结构，使理性标准可以仅从模型自身响应中检验，从而形成无标签的评估与正则化基础。
Method: 利用表示定理的充要性，将公理符合度转化为可从模型对合成选择问题的响应中直接计算的连续惩罚项；通过 de Finetti、Afriat 和 Echenique-Saito (2015) 三个定理实例说明惩罚的计算方式，并指出通过检验即穷尽了该数据上理性标准的全部含义。
Result: 摘要未报告实证数据，主要结果是理论论证：由于公理是必要且充分的，这些检验穷尽了所提取数据上理性标准的全部含义，通过检验的模型不会被同一数据的任何进一步理性检验拒绝；且惩罚在行为可理性化时为零。
Conclusion: 作者强调，因为一致性并不限制哪种目标函数理性化行为，这些惩罚是对其他评估与训练信号的补充而非替代，为 AI 系统的理性评估提供了基于决策论的新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Emulation using Generalized Stratified Sampling for Performance-Based Risk Optimization of Structures
papers.abstract_en: Metamodels are instrumental in reducing the computational burden associated with nested reliability analyses and optimization loops in Performance-Based Risk Optimization (PBRO) of structures under stochastic loads. In this context, stochastic emulators are particularly useful because they approximate response distributions while accounting for the intrinsic stochasticity of the simulator. Among these methods, Stochastic Polynomial Chaos Expansion (SPCE) is especially attractive because it does not require replications of nonlinear analyses at fixed input conditions. However, SPCE may present limitations in accurately representing extreme responses in the tails of structural response distributions. To address this limitation, this study proposes a framework that combines Generalized Stratified Sampling (GSS) with SPCE. The GSS scheme partitions the input space into strata according to the intensity of the hazard, improving the representation of extreme responses, while independent SPCE emulators are trained within each stratum. The conditional exceedance probabilities estimated in each stratum are then recombined using the total probability theorem to evaluate the probabilistic constraints. The proposed GSS-SPCE framework is applied to the optimal design of buckling-restrained brace cross-sectional areas in a two-story steel building. The objective is to minimize the initial construction cost while satisfying prescribed probabilistic performance constraints. Results show that the proposed framework accurately estimates structural response distributions, including their tail regions, while substantially reducing the number of nonlinear model evaluations required for PBRO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对结构在随机荷载下的基于性能的风险优化（PBRO）中嵌套可靠度分析与优化循环计算负担大的问题，提出将广义分层抽样（Generalized Stratified Sampling, GSS）与随机多项式混沌展开（SPCE）相结合的框架。GSS 按灾害强度将输入空间分层，并在每层内训练独立的 SPCE 仿真器，再用全概率定理重组各层的条件超越概率。方法应用于两层钢结构建筑中屈曲约束支撑截面面积的优化设计，目标是最小化初始造价并满足概率性能约束。
Motivation: SPCE 虽不需要对非线性分析进行固定输入条件下的重复计算，但在准确表示结构响应分布尾部极端响应方面存在局限，而可靠度约束恰恰依赖尾部行为。
Method: 提出 GSS-SPCE 框架：通过 GSS 将输入空间按灾害强度分层，在各层内独立训练 SPCE 仿真器估计条件超越概率，并利用全概率定理将这些概率重组以评估概率约束。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能准确估计结构响应分布及其尾部区域，同时大幅减少 PBRO 所需的非线性模型评估次数。
Conclusion: 该框架为结构 PBRO 提供了一种兼顾尾部分布精度与计算效率的随机仿真策略；摘要中的验证案例为两层钢建筑的屈曲约束支撑设计。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法能准确估计结构响应分布及其尾部区域，同时大幅减少 PBRO 所需的非线性模型评估次数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为结构 PBRO 提供了一种兼顾尾部分布精度与计算效率的随机仿真策略；摘要中的验证案例为两层钢建筑的屈曲约束支撑设计。

papers.title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: Knowledge Flow, Modality Synergy, Early Unification, and Recipes
papers.abstract_en: Vision offers a critical axis for advancing foundation models, driving a shift towards natively unified multimodal pretraining. Despite this momentum, the design space and the fundamental mechanisms of how modalities interact during unified training remain underexplored. We provide empirical clarity through a systematic exploration of multimodal pretraining. Our controlled experiments on both synthetic and large-scale real-world datasets yield four key insights into the physics of multimodal pretraining: (i) Knowledge Flow: We disentangle how language, visual understanding, and visual generation transfer knowledge across modalities, revealing distinct patterns of influence and asymmetry; (ii) Synergy vs. Competition: We show that data "complexity" largely determines whether modalities are synergistic, identify architectural choices that promote synergy: such as shared attention and normalization with modality-specific feed-forward layers, and find that these behaviors generalize across different visual tokenizer designs; (iii) Early Unification: Unifying modalities from the very early stages and training them jointly is shown to be more effective than late alignment or sequential training. This process uncovers a vision laziness phenomenon, where delayed integration leads models to rely on language priors; (iv) Recipes: We derive efficient pretraining recipes that achieve strong generative performance using only 5% of the compute budget. These core findings are subsequently validated at scale by training multiple 13.5B MoE models on 2T tokens. We hope this study provides a principled foundation for understanding and scaling multimodal pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多模态预训练进行系统探索，通过合成与大规模真实数据实验，总结出知识流动、模态协同与竞争、早期统一以及高效训练配方四类经验规律，并用13.5B MoE模型在2T tokens规模上验证。摘要显示，早期联合统一训练优于晚期对齐或顺序训练，且仅用5%计算预算即可获得强生成性能。
Motivation: 尽管原生统一多模态预训练正在兴起，但设计空间以及统一训练中模态如何交互的基本机制仍未被充分探索，缺乏经验层面的清晰认识。
Method: 在合成和真实数据上开展受控实验，系统梳理多模态预训练行为，包括跨模态知识流动、数据复杂度对模态协同与竞争的影响，以及能够促进协同的架构选择，并据此推导高效预训练配方。
Result: 摘要报告四个关键发现：语言、视觉理解和视觉生成之间存在不对称的知识传递；数据复杂度决定模态是协同还是竞争；早期统一训练优于晚期对齐或顺序训练，并揭示视觉惰性现象；仅用5%计算预算即可达到强生成性能。这些结论随后在13.5B MoE模型和2T tokens的训练中得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者希望这项研究为理解和扩展多模态预训练提供一个原则性基础。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: ORACLE: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning-Based Analog Circuit Design Optimizer with Large Language Models-Guided Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Analog circuit design automation using reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for reducing manual effort. However, many existing RL-based methods focus on single-objective optimization. Even methods designed for multi-objective (MO) problems often reduce multiple design specifications to a single scalar reward. This simplification limits the ability to capture the true Pareto trade-off among competing objectives and often leads to suboptimal designs. Moreover, requiring the model to be retrained from scratch whenever the desired MO specifications change remains a key limitation. To address these challenges, we present ORACLE, an open-source RL-based framework for MO analog circuit design optimization that replaces scalar reward optimization with vector-valued learning and preference-aware conditioning. ORACLE represents a true MO analog circuit design optimizer that uses a preference vector to specify the relative weights of multiple objectives, enabling a single trained model to generate designs across diverse trade-off settings without retraining. We further propose two preference-guidance strategies, namely normalized-weight guidance and cosine-aligned guidance, to improve convergence. In addition, we incorporate a large language model (LLM)-guided action selection mechanism to filter actions that are likely to lead to suboptimal designs or increased runtime. Our results show that, on multiple circuit topologies with 2,000 test cases, ORACLE reduces runtime by 20.4x - 104.4x compared to state-of-the-art approaches. It also meets 99.9% of the 2,000 target specifications, and achieves 5.1x - 318.6x better figure of merit in the resulting output specs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORACLE，一个基于强化学习（RL）的开源多目标模拟电路设计优化框架。它用向量值学习和偏好感知条件化（preference-aware conditioning）替代标量奖励优化，通过偏好向量指定多目标相对权重，使单个训练模型无需重训即可覆盖多种权衡设置。作者还提出两种偏好引导策略及 LLM 引导的动作选择机制，并在 2,000 个测试用例上报告了显著的运行时缩减与规格满足率提升。
Motivation: 现有基于 RL 的模拟电路设计自动化方法多为单目标优化，多目标方法也常把多个设计规格压缩成单一标量奖励，难以刻画目标间的 Pareto 权衡并导致次优设计；此外，期望的多目标规格变化时需要从头重训模型，这是关键局限。
Method: ORACLE 采用向量值学习与偏好感知条件化，用偏好向量指定多个目标的相对权重，使一个训练好的模型能生成不同权衡设置下的设计而无需重训；提出 normalized-weight guidance 和 cosine-aligned guidance 两种偏好引导策略改善收敛，并引入 LLM 引导的动作选择机制过滤可能导致次优设计或增加运行时（runtime）的动作。
Result: 在多个电路拓扑的 2,000 个测试用例上，ORACLE 相比 state-of-the-art 方法将运行时降低 20.4x–104.4x，满足 2,000 个目标规格中的 99.9%，并在输出规格上取得 5.1x–318.6x 更好的品质因数（figure of merit）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ORACLE 作为开源 RL 框架，通过向量化奖励与偏好条件化实现真正的多目标模拟电路优化，避免因规格变化而重训模型，并提升收敛速度与设计效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Promptable Animal Pose Tracking Across Species
papers.abstract_en: Animal pose estimation and tracking is important for wildlife monitoring and conservation research, and with limited expert time for labelling automated approaches are imperative. While human pose estimation and tracking has seen rapid progress thanks to large annotated datasets, animal pose remain challenging, due to large morphological and behavioural differences between species and limited annotated data. Existing approaches either optimise generic keypoint localisation from annotated datasets (such as APTv2) with poor generalisation, or track custom keypoints using visual tracking, at the cost of performance. In this paper, we demonstrate that vision foundation models trained on large datasets can be used effectively to track animal pose with limited labelled data. We propose two models, one unsupervised and the other supervised, to track user-selected keypoints in videos. The supervised approach delivers superior tracking accuracy by employing a keypoint prompt encoder to explicitly inject structural priors from a reference frame into feature matching. In parallel, the unsupervised route provides strong cross-species robustness by leveraging diverse foundation-model features for training-free correspondence matching. Extensive evaluation on challenging animal video benchmarks APTv2 and TigDog demonstrates that our framework achieves strong performance while maintaining an effective balance between accuracy and generalisation, offering a practical solution for real-world animal behaviour analysis and conservation applications.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on CV4Ecology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于视觉基础模型（vision foundation models）的跨物种动物姿态跟踪框架，包含监督和无监督两种模型，用于跟踪用户选择的关键点。监督方法通过关键点提示编码器（keypoint prompt encoder）显式注入参考帧的结构先验到特征匹配中，无监督方法则利用多样化基础模型特征进行无需训练的对应匹配（training-free correspondence matching）。在APTv2和TigDog基准上评估，该框架取得强性能并在精度与泛化间保持平衡。
Motivation: 动物姿态估计与跟踪对野生动物监测和保护研究很重要，但物种间形态和行为差异大且标注数据有限。现有方法要么依赖标注数据集优化通用关键点定位（如APTv2）导致泛化差，要么用视觉跟踪跟踪自定义关键点但性能受限。
Method: 提出两个模型：监督模型使用关键点提示编码器，将参考帧的结构先验显式注入特征匹配；无监督模型利用基础模型的多样化特征进行无需训练的对应匹配，以增强跨物种鲁棒性。
Result: 在挑战性动物视频基准APTv2和TigDog上的广泛评估表明，该框架取得强性能，并在准确性和泛化之间实现有效平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为现实世界的动物行为分析和保护应用提供了实用解决方案，表明视觉基础模型可以在有限标注数据下有效跟踪动物姿态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Protoreasoning in Tiny Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We show that tiny transformers can profitably employ a simple form of Chain of Thought, which we call protoreasoning, allowing us to study step-by-step reasoning on ~1M-parameter models and opening up opportunities for much more detailed experimentation and analysis than is feasible for larger models. Current Large Language Models exhibit impressive step-by-step reasoning, but we have yet to understand its generality, i.e., when and how LLMs learn genuinely general algorithms rather than "bags of heuristics." Such questions are hard to settle on compute-intensive frontier models trained on opaque data. To work at model scales far below the threshold for natural-language competence, we define reasoning-friendly tasks on Dyck languages (sentences of correctly nested brackets). We find that protoreasoning traces substantially close the out-of-distribution generalization gap, and ablations confirm that the trace's content, not merely its extra tokens, drives the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究约一百万参数的微型 Transformer 能否通过一种简单形式的 Chain of Thought（思维链）——作者称之为 protoreasoning——获得逐步推理能力。作者在 Dyck 语言（正确嵌套括号的句子）上设计对微小模型友好的推理任务，发现 protoreasoning 的推理踪迹能显著缩小 out-of-distribution 泛化差距，且消融实验表明收益来自踪迹内容本身而非额外 token。
Motivation: 理解 LLM 的逐步推理究竟何时学到通用算法而非启发式集合，是当前尚未解决的问题，但在计算密集的前沿模型和不透明数据上很难验证。作者希望将模型尺度降低到远低于自然语言能力门槛的水平，以便进行更细粒度、可重复的实验。
Method: 作者在约 1M 参数的微型 Transformer 上采用简单形式的 Chain of Thought（protoreasoning），并基于 Dyck 语言构造无需自然语言能力的推理友好任务，以研究逐步推理机制。
Result: 摘要报告 protoreasoning 踪迹大幅缩小了分布外泛化差距；消融实验确认，收益由踪迹的内容驱动，而非仅仅由于额外 token 数量的增加。
Conclusion: 该工作表明微型 Transformer 也能从简单的思维链形式中获益，为逐步推理的通用性问题提供了更易实验分析的研究途径。

papers.title: SciCode-Verified: How Benchmark Defects Underestimated the Scientific-Coding Ability of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: SciCode is the standard measure of the scientific-coding ability of language models: research-level problems that demand both frontier scientific theory and its implementation as working numerical code. It is a component of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and a standing evaluation in government and national-laboratory suites. Yet its scores have recently plateaued: the strongest 2026 models cluster tightly around 60\% subproblem accuracy, and a successor model ties its predecessor. We trace this stagnation to defects in the benchmark itself. A per-problem, domain-expert audit of all 65 test problems uncovers 263 defects; 192 of them, spread across 91\% of the main problems, cause correct, instruction-following solutions to be wrongly rejected---through non-reproducible gold answers, over-tight tolerances, or self-contradictory specifications. Critically, 78\% of these score-suppressing defects require specialized physics or mathematics knowledge to detect, not mere clerical proofreading. We corrected every confirmable defect to produce SciCode-Verified. The corrections add only the specifications a well-posed problem requires, repair grading, and tighten the tests that were too lenient; every change is recorded with its justification and independently re-checked by a second domain expert. We re-evaluate twelve frontier model snapshots on the corrected benchmark and find a substantial recovery: subproblem accuracy rises from 45--60\% to 84--98\%, and main-problem accuracy from 9--27\% to 69--92\%. State-of-the-art models are far more proficient in scientific coding than SciCode has suggested---the bottleneck was not model capability, but the quality of the evaluation instrument. We release SciCode-Verified with its complete audit trail as the corrected public standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 SciCode 基准本身存在大量缺陷，导致语言模型的科学编码能力被系统性低估。作者对全部 65 个测试问题进行了逐题领域专家审计，发现 263 个缺陷，其中 192 个会使正确且遵循指令的解答被误判为错误。修正这些缺陷后得到 SciCode-Verified，并重新评估 12 个前沿模型快照，子问题准确率从 45–60% 升至 84–98%，主问题准确率从 9–27% 升至 69–92%。
Motivation: SciCode 是衡量语言模型科学编码能力的标准基准，但最近成绩出现平台期：2026 年最强模型的子问题准确率集中在 60% 左右，后继模型与前任持平。作者认为这一停滞源于基准自身的缺陷，而非模型能力不足。
Method: 对 SciCode 全部 65 个测试问题开展逐题、按领域专家审计，找出并修正可确认的缺陷；修正只补充良构问题所需的规格、修复评分逻辑并收紧过于宽松的测试，每处修改都记录理由并由第二位领域专家独立复核，最终重新评估 12 个前沿模型快照。

papers.title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: The capabilities of an LLM agent depend not only on its model but on the harness: the executable program that constructs context, invokes tools, verifies results, and recovers from failure. Recent work shows that evolving the harness yields persistent improvements without updating model weights. Existing approaches, however, assume that all execution experience can be routed to a single optimizer, which evolves one harness along a sequential trajectory. Real agent ecosystems violate that assumption: users, organizations, and environments generate isolated streams of experience that cannot be pooled, so the experience most worth learning from is exactly the experience that cannot be directly centralized. We introduce EvolveNet, a paradigm of collaborative harness evolution that moves experience extraction to the data. A shared harness is broadcast to data-local agent deployments, each of which evolves it on its own workload. Only the resulting program adaptations are composed into an updated shared harness and redistributed, so that every participating agent inherits operational experience discovered by the others. By shifting the aggregation boundary from raw workloads to learned adaptations, EvolveNet keeps workloads local and allows multiple evolutionary searches to proceed concurrently with reduced serial depth. Because independently modified programs cannot be averaged like model parameters and may conflict when composed, EvolveNet introduces scope-typed, evidence-guided program aggregation. Across five settings spanning text-to-SQL, data-science coding, competitive programming, software engineering, and agentic workflows, EvolveNet improves the shared harness in all five, with the largest gains under heterogeneous workloads, and ablations attribute the improvement to composition of adaptations from different agents rather than to selecting among them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvolveNet，一种协作式 harness 演化范式，用于 LLM agent 的自我改进。不同于现有方法假设所有执行经验可路由到单一优化器、沿顺序轨迹演化一个 harness，EvolveNet 将共享 harness 广播到数据本地的 agent 部署，各自在自己负载上演化，仅将程序改编（adaptations）聚合回更新的共享 harness 并重新分发。为避免独立改编无法像模型参数那样平均且组合时可能冲突，EvolveNet 引入 scope-typed、evidence-guided 的程序聚合。在 text-to-SQL、数据科学编码、竞赛编程、软件工程和 agentic workflows 五个设置上均提升共享 harness，异构负载下收益最大，消融显示改进来自不同 agent 改编的组合而非选择。
Motivation: 真实 agent 生态系统中，用户、组织和环境会产生彼此隔离的经验流，这些经验无法被集中汇总，而最有学习价值的恰恰是不能直接集中的部分；现有单一优化器假设因此失效。EvolveNet 将经验提取转移到数据本地，使无法池化的经验也能参与 harness 演化。
Method: EvolveNet 把共享 harness 广播给数据本地 agent 部署，每个部署在自己工作负载上独立演化 harness，只将学习到的程序改编组合成更新后的共享 harness 并重新分发。通过把聚合边界从原始负载转移到学得的改编上，负载保持本地，并允许多个演化搜索并发进行、降低串行深度；同时引入 scope-typed、evidence-guided 的程序聚合来处理改编冲突。
Result: 在 text-to-SQL、数据科学编码、竞赛编程、软件工程和 agentic workflows 五个设置中，EvolveNet 均改进了共享 harness，且在异构工作负载下取得最大增益。消融实验表明改进来自不同 agent 改编的组合，而非在改编间进行选择。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将聚合边界从原始工作负载转移到学得的改编上，可以保持数据本地性并让多个演化搜索并发进行；协作式 harness 演化使每个参与的 agent 都能继承其他 agent 发现的操作经验。

papers.title: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models are essential for long-horizon planning and exploration, yet they suffer from compounding errors. Post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these models, but they hit a verification bottleneck: for arbitrary action sequences, no ground-truth future state exists to measure long-term drift. Our key insight is that reversible action cycles make this verification possible: a sequence composed with its inverse must analytically return to the initial state, yielding annotation-free supervision on long-horizon correctness. Building on this, we introduce WorldCycle, a self-verifiable RL framework that constructs closed action cycles and their repeated executions from ordinary action sequences, and optimizes two complementary rewards: a spatial closure reward enforcing symmetry between mirrored forward and reverse segments, and a temporal consistency reward aligning states across repeated cycle executions. These rewards force the model to learn actions as consistent state operators rather than memorized temporal patterns, and extend naturally to out-of-distribution composite action cycles that the base model handles poorly. We further release CycleBench, a diagnostic benchmark for state-returning ability under complex action structures. WorldCycle reduces state returning drift by up to 44% and lifts composite-action accuracy nearly 4x over the base model, providing a vital foundation for physically grounded world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldCycle，一种为长时程视频世界模型（video world models）设计的自验证强化学习（RL）框架。核心思想是利用可逆动作循环（reversible action cycles）构造无标注监督：动作序列与其逆序列组合后应解析地回到初始状态。摘要报告该方法将状态回归漂移（state returning drift）最多降低 44%，并在复合动作（composite action）准确率上相对基础模型提升近 4 倍，同时发布诊断基准 CycleBench。
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型在长时程规划与探索中受累积误差（compounding errors）困扰；后训练方法（如 RL）因缺乏任意动作序列对应的真实未来状态而难以验证长期漂移，形成验证瓶颈。
Method: 从普通动作序列构造闭环动作循环并反复执行，优化两个互补奖励：空间闭合奖励（spatial closure reward）约束前向与反向片段的镜像对称性，时间一致性奖励（temporal consistency reward）对齐多次循环执行间的状态；由此让模型把动作学习为一致的状态算子（state operators）。该方法可推广到基础模型难以处理的分布外复合动作循环，并配套发布诊断基准 CycleBench。
Result: 摘要报告 WorldCycle 将状态回归漂移最多降低 44%，复合动作准确率较基础模型提升近 4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为这类可验证循环监督为物理上有根据的世界模型（physically grounded world models）提供了重要基础；摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: SpecRoll: Fast-Slow Verifier-Feedback Adaptation for Speculative Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but autoregressive rollout generation remains a major efficiency bottleneck. Speculative decoding can accelerate generation, yet applying it during RL is difficult because the target policy continually evolves: static proposers become stale, while frequent drafter updates add substantial overhead. We introduce SpecRoll, a speculative rollout engine that preserves the target model's sampling distribution while adapting at two timescales. Lightweight future-token heads generate parallel proposals, while our proposed Reflex module uses delayed verifier feedback to perform bounded, trajectory-local hidden-state corrections without backpropagation. A complementary slow path updates the head parameters only when sustained degradation is detected. SpecRoll combines these mechanisms with concurrency-aware sparse-tree verification and exact target verification, leaving the target rollout distribution and GRPO objective unchanged. Across five models ranging from 1.5B to 14B and three mathematical reasoning datasets, SpecRoll achieves 1.26-2.15x generation speedup and 1.21-2.04x end-to-end speedup over vanilla GRPO. It also outperforms FastGRPO in both generation and end-to-end time across all 15 matched settings, with an average pairwise end-to-end gain of 1.18x. Controlled ablations show that the fast and slow adaptation paths provide complementary benefits. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecRoll-26062006.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecRoll 是一种面向强化学习 (RL) 后训练阶段的推测性 rollout 引擎，旨在加速大语言模型的自回归生成而不改变目标策略的采样分布。它通过轻量级未来 token 头生成并行提议，并利用 Reflex 模块基于延迟的验证器反馈进行无需反向传播的轨迹局部隐状态修正，同时以慢路径仅在检测到持续退化时更新头参数。在五个模型（1.5B 到 14B）和三个数学推理数据集上，SpecRoll 相对 vanilla GRPO 实现了 1.26-2.15x 的生成加速和 1.21-2.04x 的端到端加速，并在全部 15 个匹配设置中优于 FastGRPO。
Motivation: RL 后训练能提升大语言模型的推理能力，但自回归 rollout 生成是主要效率瓶颈；推测解码可用于加速，但在 RL 中目标策略持续演化，静态提议者会过期，而频繁更新 drafter 又带来大量开销。
Method: SpecRoll 在双时间尺度上适配：快路径使用轻量级未来 token 头生成并行提议，并由 Reflex 模块利用延迟验证器反馈进行有界、轨迹局部的隐状态修正（无需反向传播）；慢路径仅在检测到持续性能退化时更新头参数。同时结合并发感知的稀疏树验证 (sparse-tree verification) 和精确目标验证，保持目标 rollout 分布和 GRPO 目标不变。
Result: 在 1.5B 到 14B 的五个模型和三个数学推理数据集上，相对 vanilla GRPO 获得 1.26-2.15x 生成加速和 1.21-2.04x 端到端加速；在全部 15 个匹配设置中均优于 FastGRPO，平均配对端到端增益为 1.18x；受控消融显示快、慢两条适应路径具有互补收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SpecRoll 在保持目标模型采样分布和 GRPO 目标不变的前提下，通过双时间尺度适配和稀疏树验证显著加速 RL rollout，并已提供源代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ContextMaster: Interactive Multi-Shot Video Creation via Fixed-Budget Sparse Context Routing
papers.abstract_en: Recent video models increasingly support generation, reference conditioning, and editing within a single model, yet typically expose them as separate operations over fixed inputs. Practical creation unfolds across multiple shots, requiring one model to generate from text, follow a reference, or edit source footage while maintaining shared history. We formalize this setting as interactive multi-shot video creation (IMVC) and introduce ContextMaster, a unified model with a role-aware context representation for these operations. An interactive model must retain access to an expanding history without allowing the context read cost at each denoising step to grow. ContextMaster combines reusable clean context states with fixed budget sparse context routing and uses ConstraintSink to keep task constraints visible. To address the dual challenges of sparse context access and inference with few denoising steps, we propose a two-stage privileged context distillation framework, which transfers full context behavior from a dense teacher through consistency distillation and then refines deployment rollouts with distribution matching. Experiments on the three primitive tasks demonstrate improved task fulfillment and consistency across shots over specialized baselines. User studies further validate flexibly composed workflows, while the model reaches 16 FPS on a single GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ContextMaster，一个面向交互式多镜头视频创建（IMVC）的统一模型，用角色感知上下文表示同时支持文本生成、参考条件生成和编辑。方法结合可复用的干净上下文状态与固定预算稀疏上下文路由（fixed-budget sparse context routing），并用 ConstraintSink 保持任务约束可见；针对稀疏上下文访问和少步数推理，提出两阶段特权上下文蒸馏框架，先从密集教师通过一致性蒸馏迁移完整上下文行为，再用分布匹配优化部署 rollout。实验在三个基础任务上显示相比专门基线更好的任务完成度和跨镜头一致性，用户研究验证灵活组合的工作流，模型在单 GPU 上达到 16 FPS。
Motivation: 现有视频模型通常把生成、参考条件与编辑作为固定输入上的独立操作，而实际创作跨多镜头展开，需要同一个模型在共享历史下完成这些操作；交互式模型还必须让每步去噪的上下文读取成本不随历史增长。
Method: 提出 ContextMaster 统一模型，采用角色感知上下文表示，结合可复用干净上下文状态和固定预算稀疏上下文路由来控制读取成本，并用 ConstraintSink 保持任务约束。训练上提出两阶段特权上下文蒸馏：先通过一致性蒸馏从密集教师迁移完整上下文行为，再通过分布匹配细化部署时的 rollout。

papers.title: Towards Valid B-Rep Generation: Training-Free Wireframe Anomaly Detection and Repair
papers.abstract_en: Multi-stage boundary representation (B-Rep) generation leverages intermediate wireframes to synthesize CAD models. However, geometric and topological risks in these wireframes -- such as self-intersections, edge collapses, and disconnected vertices -- can propagate to invalid final B-Reps. Mitigating such failures by retraining large generative models is computationally prohibitive. We propose Wireframe Detection and Repair (WDR), a training-free framework that intervenes at the intermediate wireframe stage to improve downstream B-Rep validity. WDR features a Geometric-Topology Anomaly Detector (GTAD) that combines parallel VLM-based coarse screening with geometric and topological detectors to predict downstream invalidity risk and route generation to dedicated branches. An Energy-Guided Geometric-Topology Repair (EGGTR) module then performs detector-triggered guided regeneration through geometry and topology branches. By scaling test-time computation via Energy-Guided Resampling and training-free guidance for diffusion models, WDR can be integrated into autoregressive and diffusion pipelines without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in kernel-checked validity while largely retaining the measured diversity and distributional quality of synthesized CAD models. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.comment: AAAI 2027 submission; 9-page main paper plus supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WDR，一个无需训练的框架，用于在中间线框阶段检测并修复 B-Rep 生成中的几何与拓扑异常，从而提升下游 CAD 模型的合法性。该方法结合基于 VLM 的粗筛与几何/拓扑检测器，并通过能量引导的再生成进行修复，可集成到自回归和扩散管线中。实验表明，在基本保持合成 CAD 模型多样性与分布质量的同时，核检查有效性得到持续改进。
Motivation: 多阶段 B-Rep 生成依赖中间线框，但线框中的自相交、边塌陷和断开顶点等几何与拓扑风险会传播到最终无效的 B-Rep。通过重训练大型生成模型来缓解这些失败在计算上不可行，因此需要一个无需重训练的干预方案。
Method: WDR 框架包括几何-拓扑异常检测器 (GTAD) 和能量引导几何-拓扑修复模块 (EGGTR)。GTAD 结合并行 VLM 粗筛与几何/拓扑检测器来预测下游无效风险并路由生成到专用分支；EGGTR 通过能量引导重采样和面向扩散模型的无训练引导，在几何与拓扑分支上执行检测器触发的再生成。
Result: 大量实验显示该方法在核检查有效性 (kernel-checked validity) 上持续改进，同时基本保留合成 CAD 模型的多样性 (diversity) 和分布质量 (distributional quality)。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 WDR 无需重训练即可在中间线框阶段干预，并可无缝集成到自回归和扩散生成管线中；代码将在论文被接收后公开。

papers.title: UG-UMRE: Uncertainty-Guided Modality Augmentation and Distributional Calibration for Unified Multimodal Relation Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Relation Extraction (UMRE) aims to identify intra-modal and cross-modal relations between textual entities and visual objects. However, existing UMRE studies still encounter two critical issues: ignoring inherent aleatoric uncertainty causes noise propagation, and deep-seated heterogeneity between distinct modal distributions hinders alignment. To address these issues, we propose the Uncertainty-Guided UMRE Network (UG-UMRE). Specifically, we design an Uncertainty-Driven Unimodal Augmentation (UDUA) module, which models features as Gaussian distributions based on the Variational Information Bottleneck. By incorporating an uncertainty-aware self-supervised contrastive learning mechanism, UDUA effectively filters out noise while maintaining semantic consistency. Furthermore, we introduce the Joint Aleatoric Uncertainty Alignment (JAUA) module as a global semantic pre-calibration mechanism. JAUA leverages probabilistic distribution consistency to construct a shared latent space, eliminating the distributional gap by synchronizing cross-modal statistical properties, thereby laying a robust foundation for fine-grained interaction. Experiments on three benchmark datasets (UMRE, MORE, and MNRE) demonstrate that UG-UMRE achieves state-of-the-art performance. Further analysis validates the pluggable and effective performance of the proposed UDUA and JAUA modules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性引导的统一多模态关系抽取网络（UG-UMRE），针对现有 UMRE 研究忽略固有 aleatoric uncertainty 导致噪声传播、以及不同模态分布之间的异质性阻碍对齐这两个问题。该方法包含 UDUA 与 JAUA 两个模块，并在 UMRE、MORE 和 MNRE 三个基准数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有的统一多模态关系抽取（UMRE）研究存在两个关键问题：忽略固有的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）会造成噪声传播；不同模态分布之间深层的异质性会阻碍跨模态对齐。
Method: 设计 Uncertainty-Driven Unimodal Augmentation (UDUA) 模块，基于变分信息瓶颈（Variational Information Bottleneck）将特征建模为高斯分布，并通过不确定性感知的自监督对比学习机制在过滤噪声的同时保持语义一致性；同时提出 Joint Aleatoric Uncertainty Alignment (JAUA) 模块，利用概率分布一致性构建共享潜在空间，通过同步跨模态统计特性来消除分布差异，为细粒度交互提供全局语义预校准。
Result: 在 UMRE、MORE 和 MNRE 三个基准数据集上的实验表明，UG-UMRE 取得了 state-of-the-art 性能；进一步分析验证了 UDUA 和 JAUA 模块具有即插即用（pluggable）且有效的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过不确定性引导的模态增强与分布校准可以同时缓解噪声传播和模态异质性对齐问题，且所提 UDUA 与 JAUA 模块具备即插即用性。

papers.title: A General Sufficient Condition for Rewriting Horn-ALCHI Atomic Queries into GQL
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of the ISO standard GQL introduces a powerful query language extending first-order logic with controlled recursion, raising the question of its applicability to evaluation of ontology-mediated queries (OMQs). We focus on OMQs consisting of atomic queries over ontologies expressed in Horn-ALCHI, an expressive Description Logic that is not, in general, first-order rewritable. To address this, we introduce DL automata, a novel formalism that captures the semantics of such OMQs via runs over fact sets. We then identify a large class of DL automata that can be rewritten into unions of conjunctive two-way regular path queries (UC2RPQs), a central fragment of GQL. Our class of automata relies on a stratification of their states, ruling out specific forms of cyclic dependencies known to raise the complexity. This yields a broad class of Horn-ALCHI OMQs that are GQL-rewritable.
papers.comment: 27 pages. Technical report of a paper to appear at ISWC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 ISO 标准 GQL 的查询能力，研究 Horn-ALCHI 本体上的原子查询能否重写为 GQL 可评估的形式。作者提出 DL 自动机 (DL automata) 这一新形式化工具，用事实集上的运行 (runs) 刻画这类本体介导查询 (OMQ) 的语义，并基于状态分层排除特定循环依赖，识别出一大类可重写为 UC2RPQ (union of conjunctive two-way regular path queries) 的自动机，从而得到一大类 GQL-可重写的 Horn-ALCHI OMQ。
Motivation: GQL 在表达力上扩展了一阶逻辑并引入受控递归，但其能否用于本体介导查询的求值尚不明确；而 Horn-ALCHI 作为表达力较强的描述逻辑，一般不满足一阶可重写性，因此需要寻找其可重写为 GQL 子语言的充分条件。
Method: 引入 DL 自动机这一新形式化机制，以事实集上的运行捕捉 Horn-ALCHI 原子查询 OMQ 的语义；然后对自动机状态进行分层，排除会提升复杂度的特定循环依赖，并刻画可重写为 UC2RPQ 的自动机类别。
Result: 摘要识别出一大类 DL 自动机可被重写为 UC2RPQ（GQL 的核心片段），并由此得到一大类 GQL-可重写的 Horn-ALCHI OMQ。
Conclusion: 该工作从理论上给出 Horn-ALCHI 原子查询可重写为 GQL 的一般充分条件，属于描述逻辑与图查询语言之间的可重写性研究。

papers.title: A geometry-based deep equilibrium model for image restoration under multiplicative Gamma noise
papers.abstract_en: We propose a deep learning framework for image restoration from images degraded by both multiplicative Gamma noise and blur. Unlike conventional deep equilibrium (DEQ) models that rely on implicit neural regularization, the proposed method learns an explicit and interpretable regularizer parameterized by geometric priors associated with surface area and mean curvature. To minimize the resulting variational model, we develop a mirror descent algorithm tailored to the commonly used Gamma-noise fidelity terms. Leveraging the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property for functions defined in $o$-minimal structures, we establish the global convergence of the generated iterates to a critical point. Experimental results on both grayscale and color image restoration demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative model-based approaches while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art DEQ models based on implicit regularization, despite requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于图像恢复的几何先验深度均衡（DEQ）框架，针对同时受乘性 Gamma 噪声和模糊影响的图像。与依赖隐式神经正则化的传统 DEQ 模型不同，该方法学习一个显式、可解释的正则化项，由表面积和平均曲率等几何先验参数化；为最小化对应的变分模型，作者设计了适配 Gamma 噪声保真项的镜像下降（mirror descent）算法。利用 o-minimal 结构中函数的 Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz 性质，证明了迭代序列全局收敛到临界点。实验表明，在灰度与彩色图像恢复上，该方法一致优于有代表性的基于模型的方法，并在训练参数大幅减少的情况下取得与基于隐式正则化的先进 DEQ 模型相当的性能。
Motivation: 乘性 Gamma 噪声与模糊并存时的图像恢复仍具挑战性，而传统 DEQ 模型依赖隐式神经正则化，可解释性与理论保证不足；本文希望通过显式几何先验正则化提升可解释性并给出收敛性分析。
Method: 在 DEQ 框架内引入由表面积和平均曲率参数化的显式可解释正则项，并提出适配 Gamma 噪声保真项的镜像下降算法；借助 o-minimal 结构中函数的 Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz 性质建立全局收敛性。
Result: 灰度与彩色图像恢复实验中，该方法一致优于代表性基于模型的复原方法；在训练参数明显更少的前提下，性能与基于隐式正则化的现有 DEQ 模型相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为，带有显式几何先验正则化的 DEQ 模型能够在更少参数下接近隐式正则化 DEQ 的性能，并具备可证明的全局收敛性；其适用范围限于乘性 Gamma 噪声与模糊下的图像恢复问题。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CheMLFlow: An Open-Source Platform for Cheminformatics and Materials Informatics Applications
papers.abstract_en: CheMLFlow is an open-source platform for building and executing end-to-end, high-throughput, and agentic workflows for scientific and technological applications. CheMLFlow targets a common bottleneck in scientific machine learning development, where researchers often need to assemble data acquisition, curation, representation, model training, validation, screening, interpretation, and reporting into a reproducible pipeline, even when their primary research contribution concerns only one stage. CheMLFlow provides modular workflow components, ready-to-run reference pipelines, standardized artifacts, and evaluation outputs that reduce orchestration overhead and support benchmarking across methods and datasets. The platform is designed to be extensible, reproducible, and automation friendly, with pluggable representations and models, deterministic splits, explicit run artifacts, batch execution, and report generation. As scientific software increasingly moves toward agent assisted experimentation, CheMLFlow's configuration driven workflows and structured outputs also provide a practical interface for coding agents to help users construct experiments, inspect results, and summarize findings under human supervision. This article describes the system architecture, core workflows, and benchmarks that reach literature performance for quantum mechanical, physicochemical and bioactivity property prediction, and use cases involving time series datasets demonstrating applications beyond molecular chemistry datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CheMLFlow，一个用于构建和执行端到端、高通量且具代理能力 (agentic) 科学工作流的开源平台。该平台面向科学机器学习开发中的常见瓶颈，提供模块化工作流组件、可直接运行的参考流水线、标准化产物和评估输出，以降低编排开销并支持跨方法与数据集的基准测试。作者报告其在量子力学、物理化学和生物活性性质预测上达到文献水平性能，并展示了超出分子化学数据集的时序数据应用用例。
Motivation: 科学机器学习研究者常常需要把数据获取、清洗、表示、模型训练、验证、筛选、解释和报告组装成可复现流水线，即使其主要研究贡献只涉及其中某一阶段；这种编排负担成为常见瓶颈。
Method: CheMLFlow 提供模块化工作流组件、可插拔的表示与模型、确定性数据划分、显式运行产物、批量执行和报告生成；其配置驱动的工作流与结构化输出也为编码代理 (coding agents) 提供接口，支持在人类监督下帮助用户构建实验、检查结果并总结发现。
Result: 摘要报告该系统在量子力学、物理化学和生物活性性质预测的基准测试上达到文献水平性能，并给出时间序列数据集上的用例，说明其适用范围可扩展到分子化学数据集之外。
Conclusion: 文章描述了系统架构、核心工作流与基准测试，强调平台的可扩展性、可复现性与自动化友好性，并指出配置驱动的工作流可作为智能体辅助科学实验的实用接口。

papers.title: Unleashing the Potential of Vision-Language Models for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that a simple linear probe on frozen representations from modern vision foundation models (VFMs) can achieve state-of-the-art AIGI detection performance, substantially outperforming specialized detectors in challenging in-the-wild scenarios. This finding has established DINOv3 as the dominant foundation-model baseline for subsequent improvements. However, we find that the vision-language model Perception Encoder (PE) holds greater potential for AIGI detection, because its language-aligned representation preserves high-level provenance semantics. Specifically, PE exhibits stronger local provenance organization than DINOv3 in its frozen feature space. However, semantic-agnostic linear probing fails to exploit this structure, as PE-Linear still underperforms DINOv3-Linear by 4.1% on In-the-Wild. Based on this observation, we propose Semantic Prototype Calibration (SPC), which constructs category prototypes from forensic semantic information and calibrates them with supervised data. We apply SPC to PE and refer to the resulting detector as PE-SPC. Our analysis shows that this simple design achieves stronger generalization. Across cross-generator, post-processing, and in-the-wild benchmarks, PE-SPC surpasses the previous DINOv3 baseline and achieves new state-of-the-art results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通用AI生成图像（AIGI）检测中的表示选择问题。作者发现视觉语言模型的Perception Encoder（PE）因其语言对齐表示保留了高级来源语义，在冻结特征空间中展现出比DINOv3更强的局部来源组织，但普通线性探针无法利用该结构（PE-Linear在In-the-Wild上比DINOv3-Linear低4.1%）。为此提出Semantic Prototype Calibration（SPC），从取证语义信息构造类别原型并用监督数据校准，应用到PE上得到PE-SPC检测器，在跨生成器、后处理和in-the-wild基准上超过DINOv3基线并达到新SOTA。
Motivation: 现有前沿AIGI检测主要依赖视觉基础模型（VFM）冻结特征的线性探针，DINOv3成为主导基线；但这类语义无关的探针无法利用视觉语言模型中语言对齐表示所蕴含的来源语义结构，导致PE的潜力未被释放。
Method: 提出Semantic Prototype Calibration（SPC）：基于取证语义信息构造类别原型（category prototypes），并用监督数据对原型进行校准；将该方法应用于视觉语言模型的Perception Encoder，形成PE-SPC检测器。
Result: 摘要报告PE-SPC在跨生成器、后处理和in-the-wild基准上全面超过此前的DINOv3基线，取得新的state-of-the-art结果；同时指出PE-Linear在In-the-Wild上比DINOv3-Linear低4.1%，而SPC能弥补该差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为简单设计的SPC即可实现更强的泛化，语言对齐表示中的来源语义结构是PE在AIGI检测上优于DINOv3的关键，为后续检测器设计提供了新方向。

papers.title: State2State: Environment-Derived Mid-Training for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training LLM agents commonly relies on supervised fine-tuning from expert trajectories or online reinforcement learning over human-specified tasks with handcrafted verifiers. Though effective, both remain bottlenecked by externally specified tasks and supervision signals, limiting the scalability and diversity of agent training. We study an environment learning paradigm in which agents acquire interaction and manipulation capabilities solely through environment interaction, without externally specified tasks. We propose State2State, an environment-derived mid-training method that converts explored environment states into training objectives, challenging agents to reach a specified target state. By deriving tasks from environment exploration and verifying success through rule-based state matching, State2State provides scalable and verifiable training objectives without expert supervision or manual task design. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that State2State improves agent performance as a standalone environment-learning stage in most settings. As initialization for downstream RL, it further improves final performance and learning efficiency, with promising evidence of cross-environment generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 State2State，一种面向 LLM agent 的环境派生中途训练（mid-training）方法：让 agent 仅通过与环境的交互来获取操作能力，而不再依赖外部指定任务、专家轨迹或手工验证器。方法将探索到的环境状态转换为“到达指定目标状态”的训练目标，并用基于规则的状态匹配验证成功。在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上的实验表明，它作为独立训练阶段在多数设置下能提升 agent 性能，作为下游强化学习的初始化还能改善最终表现和样本效率，并展示出跨环境泛化的初步证据。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 训练普遍依赖专家轨迹的监督微调或基于人工指定任务与手工验证器的在线强化学习，但两者都受外部任务和监督信号制约，限制了训练的可扩展性与多样性。作者希望探索一种仅通过环境交互获取能力的训练范式，摆脱对外部任务设计的依赖。
Method: State2State 从环境探索中自动派生任务：将已探索的环境状态转化为训练目标，要求 agent 从当前状态到达指定目标状态；成功与否通过基于规则的状态匹配进行验证，因此无需专家监督或手动任务设计，从而提供可扩展且可验证的训练目标。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上的实验显示，State2State 在大多数设置中作为独立的环境学习阶段能提升 agent 性能；作为下游强化学习的初始化时，它进一步改善了最终性能和训练效率，并给出了跨环境泛化的初步证据。
Conclusion: 作者认为，从环境派生并可通过规则匹配验证的训练目标可以免去专家监督和手动任务设计，为可扩展的 agent 训练提供了一条新路径；同时摘要也指出跨环境泛化的证据目前只是初步的。
Relevance: 0
