papers.title: SVI-DAG: A Structured Variational Inference Approach to Bayesian Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian causal discovery seeks to determine the posterior distribution of causal theories, which are interpreted as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) that explain the observed data. The resulting posterior allows systematic reasoning regarding epistemic uncertainty within these theories. Nonetheless, finding such graphs is difficult due to identifiability problems and limited observational data. Furthermore, precisely approximating posterior over graphs is challenging given vast range of potential DAGs. Recent Bayesian approaches have addressed some of these challenges, yet they remain limited as they fail to encode dependencies between edges, and lack principled ways to incorporate domain knowledge as inductive biases during the search process. To overcome these limitations, we propose SVI-DAG, a structured variational inference approach to Bayesian causal discovery using observational data and prior beliefs that uses normalizing flows to model dependencies between edges, supporting expressive and multimodal posterior learning over DAGs. To mitigate mode seeking behaviour in evidence lower bound optimization and promote mode coverage, we use stein variational gradient descent to update the node potentials using a kernel in acyclicity space. We evaluate SVI-DAG against 5 state-of-the-art Bayesian DAG learning methods and demonstrate superior performance in uncertainty quantification while remaining competitive in terms of structural accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SVI-DAG，一种用于贝叶斯因果发现的结构化变分推断方法，利用归一化流 (normalizing flows) 建模 DAG 中边之间的依赖关系，并用 Stein 变分梯度下降在有向无环图 (DAG) 空间进行推断，支持表达能力强且多模态的后验学习。作者在观测数据和先验知识下进行推断，并与 5 种 SOTA 贝叶斯 DAG 学习方法比较，声称在不确定性量化上表现更优，同时在结构准确性上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯 DAG 学习方法未能编码边之间的依赖关系，也缺乏将领域知识作为归纳偏置引入搜索过程的原则性方式，导致后验近似受限。
Method: 提出结构化变分推断框架 SVI-DAG：使用归一化流对边之间的依赖关系建模，以支持表达能力强、多模态的 DAG 后验；在证据下界 (ELBO) 优化中，利用核函数在有向无环图空间上通过 Stein 变分梯度下降更新节点势能，以缓解模式寻求行为并促进模式覆盖。
Result: 摘要报告 SVI-DAG 在与 5 种 SOTA 贝叶斯 DAG 学习方法的比较中，在不确定性量化方面表现更优，同时在结构准确性方面保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SVI-DAG 通过建模边依赖并融入领域知识，改善了贝叶斯因果发现中的后验表达与不确定性量化，但摘要未提及具体实验细节或局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optimal Training-Time Scaling in Gradual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: In gradual adaptation, how should the training time on each task change as the number of intermediate tasks increases? We study this question for overparameterized linear regression tasks that change smoothly and share a zero-loss solution. With $N$ tasks and training time $s_N$ on each, the final learning progress converges to a continuum curve when $Ns_N\toτ$. The limiting progress is $Θ(τ)$ for small $τ$ and $Θ(τ^{-1})$ for large $τ$, so both very short and very long training produce little progress. It follows that optimal per-task training times scale as $s_N^\star=Θ(N^{-1})$, equivalently $Ns_N^\star=Θ(1)$. Experiments on gradually rotated MNIST and a natural Yearbook time shift are consistent with less per-task training as the path is divided more finely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究渐进适应 (gradual adaptation) 中每个中间任务的训练时间应如何随任务数量变化的问题。作者针对共享零损失解的过参数化线性回归任务建模，证明当任务数 N 与每任务训练时间 s_N 满足 Ns_N→τ 时，最终学习进展收敛到连续曲线。摘要给出的理论结果是进展在小 τ 时为 Θ(τ)、大 τ 时为 Θ(τ^{-1})，因此最优每任务训练时间满足 s_N^*=Θ(N^{-1})，即 Ns_N^*=Θ(1)。在逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和自然 Yearbook 时间偏移上的实验与“路径分割越细、每任务训练越少”的结论一致。
Motivation: 渐进适应中尚不清楚如何随中间任务数量增加而调整每个任务的训练时间；理解这一缩放规律有助于设计更高效的多任务或连续学习训练策略。
Method: 对随任务平滑变化且共享一个零损失解的过参数化线性回归进行理论分析，在 Ns_N→τ 的极限下把离散训练过程归结为一条连续曲线，并刻画最终进展作为 τ 的函数；同时用逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和 Yearbook 时间偏移数据做实验验证。
Result: 摘要报告最终学习进展在小 τ 时按 Θ(τ) 增长、在大 τ 时按 Θ(τ^{-1}) 衰减，因而存在使进展最大的有限 τ；最优每任务训练时间为 s_N^*=Θ(N^{-1})，等价于总训练时间 Ns_N^* 为常数。实验与理论缩放预期一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为路径被划分得越细，每个任务应分配的训练时间越少；理论结论限定在共享零损失解的过参数化线性回归场景，图像实验提供一致的实证支持。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究渐进适应 (gradual adaptation) 中每个中间任务的训练时间应如何随任务数量变化的问题。作者针对共享零损失解的过参数化线性回归任务建模，证明当任务数 N 与每任务训练时间 s_N 满足 Ns_N→τ 时，最终学习进展收敛到连续曲线。摘要给出的理论结果是进展在小 τ 时为 Θ(τ)、大 τ 时为 Θ(τ^{-1})，因此最优每任务训练时间满足 s_N^*=Θ(N^{-1})，即 Ns_N^*=Θ(1)。在逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和自然 Yearbook 时间偏移上的实验与“路径分割越细、每任务训练越少”的结论一致。
summary_sections.motivation: 渐进适应中尚不清楚如何随中间任务数量增加而调整每个任务的训练时间；理解这一缩放规律有助于设计更高效的多任务或连续学习训练策略。
summary_sections.method: 对随任务平滑变化且共享一个零损失解的过参数化线性回归进行理论分析，在 Ns_N→τ 的极限下把离散训练过程归结为一条连续曲线，并刻画最终进展作为 τ 的函数；同时用逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和 Yearbook 时间偏移数据做实验验证。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告最终学习进展在小 τ 时按 Θ(τ) 增长、在大 τ 时按 Θ(τ^{-1}) 衰减，因而存在使进展最大的有限 τ；最优每任务训练时间为 s_N^*=Θ(N^{-1})，等价于总训练时间 Ns_N^* 为常数。实验与理论缩放预期一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为路径被划分得越细，每个任务应分配的训练时间越少；理论结论限定在共享零损失解的过参数化线性回归场景，图像实验提供一致的实证支持。

papers.title: Consistency-Driven Co-Evolution for Self-Supervised Cross-Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: As chart images, tabular data, and visualization code play increasingly important roles across diverse domains, cross-representation understanding across these modalities poses fundamental challenges for AI systems: the relationships across representations are inherently \textit{one-to-many}, supervision is ambiguous and costly, and model optimization lacks a principled signal that is both direction-adaptive and representation-generalizable beyond task-specific objectives. We introduce CoCoEvolve to improve consistency across chart, table, and code representations. Instead of treating cross-representation mapping as a one-to-many problem, we define explicit one-to-one correspondences and optimize models using agreement between representations, without additional annotations. During training, CoCoEvolve@Train performs co-evolution across the chart-table-code cycle, while CoCoEvolve@Test applies the same consistency objective at inference time for test-time co-optimization. We also present CoCoEvolve@Eval, an evaluation suite covering all six cross-representation tasks. Across four benchmarks, CoCoEvolve improves performance in both training-time and test-time settings. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/CoCoEvolve/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoCoEvolve，用于提升图表、表格与代码三种表示之间的一致性理解。作者把跨表示映射从一对多问题重新定义为显式的一对一对应，并仅用表示间的协议（agreement）作为优化信号，无需额外标注。方法在训练时进行 chart-table-code 循环上的协同演化，推理时也用同一一致性目标做测试时协同优化，并配套了覆盖六种跨表示任务的评估套件 CoCoEvolve@Eval。
Motivation: 图表图像、表格数据和可视化代码在各类领域中越来越重要，但跨表示理解存在本质的一对多关系、监督信号模糊且代价高，且缺乏既能方向自适应又能跨表示泛化的原则性优化信号。
Method: 定义显式的一对一跨表示对应关系，以表示间一致性（agreement）作为优化目标；CoCoEvolve@Train 在训练中跨 chart-table-code 循环协同演化，CoCoEvolve@Test 在推理时应用同一目标进行测试时间协同优化，并构建 CoCoEvolve@Eval 评估套件覆盖全部六种跨表示任务。
Result: 在四个基准上，摘要报告 CoCoEvolve 在训练时和测试时两种设置下均提升性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将一致性目标同时用于训练期与测试期协同优化，可以改善图表、表格与代码之间的跨表示学习效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Chain Is Only as Strong as Its Weakest Link: A Scoping Review of System Integration Audits in AI
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems become increasingly integrated into diverse interfaces and applications, model-centric audits are insufficient to address risks arising from interactions among system components and deployment environments. System integration has long been central to software audits in safety-critical domains such as aerospace. However, its role in AI auditing remains underexplored. Scanning through 4,259 documents, we present a scoping review of AI audits that treat system integration as a core tenet of evaluation (n = 58). Using reflexive thematic analysis, we analyze their elements, actors, enablers, and constraints. We find that the corpus represents an emerging yet still fragmented form of AI auditing: few existing measures target integration-specific risks; large gaps remain in meeting traditional audit expectations; and access to necessary information and resources significantly influences audit design. Nonetheless, integration can be categorized across three sites (inter-component, system-environment, and multi-system), each serving the functions of risk exploration, risk determination, coordination, and procedural regularity. Deviating from other types of evaluations, these audits assess qualities specific to system integration, including compatibility, completeness, and oversight. This review calls on the AI community to prioritize system integration as a core strategy for addressing AI risk, and to develop audit practices capable of capturing failures across components, environments, and systems beyond the reach of component-level evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对以系统集成为核心的 AI 审计进行范围综述（scoping review）。作者扫描 4,259 篇文献，最终纳入 58 篇，通过反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）归纳其要素、参与者、使能因素与约束。研究发现该领域仍呈碎片化：针对集成特定风险的现有措施很少，与传统审计期望的差距较大，信息与资源的可获取性显著影响审计设计；同时集成可划分为组件间、系统-环境、多系统三类场所，承担风险探索、风险判定、协调与程序规范性等功能。
Motivation: 模型中心（model-centric）的 AI 审计不足以处理系统组件与部署环境交互所产生的风险；系统集成审计在航空航天等安全关键领域早有传统，但其在 AI 审计中的角色尚未被充分研究。
Method: 采用范围综述方法扫描 4,259 篇文献，纳入将系统集成作为评估核心要义的 58 项 AI 审计研究，并运用反思性主题分析对这些审计的要素、行动者、使能因素与约束进行归纳与分类。
Result: 摘要显示语料代表一种新兴但仍碎片化的 AI 审计形式：很少有现有措施针对集成特定风险，满足传统审计期望方面存在较大缺口，信息与资源获取显著影响审计设计；集成可在三类场所中实现风险探索、风险判定、协调与程序规范性等功能，且此类审计评估兼容性、完整性、监督等系统集成特有属性。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁 AI 社区将系统集成作为应对 AI 风险的核心策略，并发展能够捕获组件间、环境与系统层面失败的审计实践，以弥补组件级评估无法覆盖的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An active-learning framework for real-time depth perception from monocular vision streams
papers.abstract_en: Biological visual systems can perceive depth from monocular vision flow, continuously integrating temporal visual cues while maintaining a balance between stability and plasticity in dynamic environments. In contrast, artificial perception models deployed on resource-constrained edge devices are typically trained in a static offline manner and remain frozen after deployment, often suffering severe performance degradation under domain shifts. While large-scale models may encode broad knowledge through massive parameter redundancy, lightweight networks face a static optimization dilemma: forcing compact models to learn universal geometric representations is computationally inefficient and often leads to performance saturation. To resolve this issue, an Online Active Learning (OAL) mechanism is introduced to endow compact neural networks with the capability to adapt continuously during operation. A closed-loop Predict-Evaluate-Correct learning paradigm is established to actively select high-confidence, information-rich signals from streaming visual input. Crucially, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is employed not merely to prevent catastrophic forgetting, but to enforce Selective Plasticity, preserving parameters that encode globally relevant structural knowledge while allowing local alignment to newly observed environments. Built upon a MobileNetV3-Small backbone, the proposed system achieves approximately a 75% reduction in computational cost while maintaining competitive depth estimation accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that adaptability is not solely determined by model size, but rather by how effectively parameter plasticity is regulated in dynamic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对部署在资源受限边缘设备上的轻量级深度感知模型在动态环境中性能退化的问题，提出在线主动学习 (Online Active Learning, OAL) 机制，使紧凑网络在运行过程中持续自适应。系统建立在 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干上，采用闭环的 Predict-Evaluate-Correct 学习范式，并结合弹性权重巩固 (Elastic Weight Consolidation, EWC) 实现选择性可塑性，在保持竞争力深度估计精度的同时降低约 75% 的计算成本。
Motivation: 现有的边缘设备感知模型通常离线静态训练并在部署后冻结，面对域偏移时性能严重退化；轻量网络被迫学习通用几何表征既计算低效又容易性能饱和，存在静态优化困境。
Method: 引入在线主动学习机制，建立闭环 Predict-Evaluate-Correct 学习范式，从流式视觉输入中主动选择高置信度且信息量丰富的信号进行在线更新；同时使用 EWC 不仅防止灾难性遗忘，还强制执行选择性可塑性，保留编码全局结构知识的参数并允许向新环境的局部对齐。
Result: 在 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干上，系统在保持有竞争力的深度估计精度的同时实现约 75% 的计算成本降低；实验结果表明适应性并不主要由模型规模决定，而取决于动态环境中参数可塑性的有效调控。
Conclusion: 作者强调在线更新与选择性可塑性调控是紧凑模型在动态环境下保持适应性的关键，方法适用于资源受限设备上的单目深度感知任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhancing Low Back Pain Assessment with Diffusion Models for Lumbar Spine MRI Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces a diffusion-based framework for robust and accurate semantic segmentation of lumbar spine MRI scans from patients with low back pain (LBP), regardless of whether the scans are T1- or T2-weighted. We compared with advanced models for segmenting vertebrae, intervertebral discs (IVDs), and spinal canal using the SPIDER dataset. The results showed that SpineSegDiff achieved a segmentation performance comparable to that of the state-of-the-art non-diffusion nnUnet, particularly in improving the identification of degenerated IVDs. In addition, the uncertainty maps generated by our model provide valuable insights for clinical review, enhancing the robustness and reliability of the segmentation results. The potential of diffusion models to enhance the diagnosis and management of LBP through more precise analysis of pathological spine MRI is underscored by our findings.
papers.comment: Maria Monzon and Thomas Iff contributed equally to this work. Published in Proceedings of The 8th International Conference on Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL 2025), PMLR volume 301, pages 1145-1163, 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Machine Learning Research 301:1145-1163, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型 (diffusion model) 的腰椎MRI语义分割框架 SpineSegDiff，用于腰痛 (LBP) 患者的 T1/T2 加权扫描，分割椎体、椎间盘 (IVDs) 和椎管。在 SPIDER 数据集上，其分割性能与先进非扩散模型 nnU-Net 相当，尤其在退化椎间盘识别上有所提升，并生成不确定性图辅助临床审查。
Motivation: 腰痛患者的腰椎MRI分割需要适应不同加权序列 (T1/T2) 且对退化椎间盘等病理区域保持鲁棒性，现有模型在这些方面仍有改进空间。
Method: 采用扩散模型作为分割骨干，构建 SpineSegDiff 框架，直接在腰椎 MRI 上执行语义分割，并利用模型内在的不确定性生成能力输出不确定性图。
Result: 在 SPIDER 数据集上的实验表明，SpineSegDiff 的分割性能与 SOTA 非扩散模型 nnU-Net 相当，特别改善了退化椎间盘的识别；其不确定性图能提供对临床审查有价值的见解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调扩散模型有望通过更精确的病理脊柱MRI分析增强腰痛的诊断与管理，但未提及局限性与临床部署细节。

papers.title: Visual Representation Matters: Exploiting Temporal Differences in Video-to-Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video-to-audio (V2A) generation extends image-to-audio generation (I2A) by introducing consecutive frames that provide essential temporal cues for audio synthesis. However, existing conditional diffusion-based V2A methods typically enhance visual conditioning with additional audio-visual supervision, acoustic structure prediction, or reasoning from large multimodal models, requiring extra networks or strong inductive biases. Inspired by recent advances in visual representation learning, we introduce TD-V2A, which leverages temporal differences (TD) as the key representation that distinguishes V2A from I2A, enriching visual conditioning with minimal architectural modification. We first investigate TD at both the frame and feature levels to identify the most effective representation level at which TD complements visual representations. Based on these findings, we develop a hierarchically continual learning strategy and an annealed temporal differences guidance method to progressively learn and exploit TD information during diffusion training and sampling process, respectively. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that effectively exploiting TD through our proposed framework significantly improves end-to-end V2A generation quality, even outperforming dedicated V2A representations such as contrastive audio-visual pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TD-V2A，一种基于条件扩散的视频到音频（V2A）生成方法，将时间差异（temporal differences, TD）作为区分 V2A 与图像到音频（I2A）的关键视觉表示，以最小架构改动增强视觉条件。作者先在帧级和特征级考察 TD 的最有效表示层级，再设计层次连续学习策略与退火 TD 引导方法，在扩散训练和采样中逐步利用 TD 信息。基准实验表明该方法显著提升端到端 V2A 生成质量，甚至优于对比视听预训练等专用 V2A 表示。
Motivation: 现有 V2A 条件扩散方法通常需要额外的音频-视觉监督、声学结构预测或大模型推理来增强视觉条件，这引入了额外网络或强归纳偏置。作者希望利用视觉表示学习的最新进展，以最小架构改动挖掘时间差异这一 V2A 区别于 I2A 的关键信息。
Method: 先在帧级与特征级研究时间差异，确定 TD 与视觉表示互补的最有效层级；基于此提出层次连续学习策略（hierarchically continual learning strategy）和退火时间差异引导方法（annealed temporal differences guidance），分别用于扩散训练与采样过程中逐步学习和利用 TD 信息。
Result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示，有效利用 TD 能显著改善端到端 V2A 生成质量，并且超过如对比视听预训练（contrastive audio-visual pretraining）这类专用的 V2A 表示。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间差异作为视觉表示的有效维度，无需额外网络即可显著提升 V2A 生成质量。结论范围限定在基于扩散的 V2A 生成任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Shared Rollouts Fail in Defensive Driving Evaluation: A NAVSIM Score Basis Audit
papers.abstract_en: Defensive driving scores are useful only when they preserve distinctions between policies that observe surrounding actors and those that do not. Re-simulation benchmarks may use reference-conditioned forgiveness, under which an agent receives credit when the logged human reference fails a compliance channel. When agent and reference share an unstable rollout transformation, this rule can propagate shared reference failures into broad compliance credit. We audit this risk in NAVSIM v2.2 original scene single-stage scoring. Under the affected documented-stack condition on the audited numerical backend, the route-blind Ignore-All probe and a route-aware actor-blind probe outrank human replay and PDM-Closed over the complete 12,146-token navtest split. A fresh installation following the public specification reproduces rollout divergence on a fixed 32-token diagnostic set. A same-source dependency stack control and an exact-input diagnostic isolate dependency-sensitive numerical behavior in the shared velocity refit. On a 450-token control pool, replacing only the solver eliminates rollout divergence and restores blind-last ordering while keeping forgiveness enabled. Thus, the numerical instability is the direct trigger. Reference-conditioned forgiveness propagates the resulting shared reference failures into compliance credit. We contribute an audit protocol requiring score basis and stack disclosure, blind probes, overwrite reporting, and rollout stability tests before using such scores for defensive driving claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 NAVSIM v2.2 原始场景单阶段评分进行了审计，发现当智能体与日志人类参考共享不稳定的 rollout 变换时，reference-conditioned forgiveness 会把共享参考失败扩散为广泛合规得分。在受影响的文档化依赖栈与数值后端下，不观测道路的 Ignore-All 探针和 route-aware actor-blind 探针在整个 12,146-token navtest 分割上超过 human replay 和 PDM-Closed；在 450-token 控制池中仅替换 solver 即可消除 rollout 发散并恢复盲探针垫底排序。作者据此提出包含评分基础与依赖栈披露、盲探针、覆盖报告和 rollout 稳定性测试的审计协议。
Motivation: 防御性驾驶评分只有在能够区分“观测周围参与者”与“不观测周围参与者”的策略时才有效；重用模拟基准中的 reference-conditioned forgiveness 在智能体与参考共享不稳定 rollout 变换时，可能把参考失败传导为广泛的合规信用，从而破坏评分的区分能力。
Method: 作者对 NAVSIM v2.2 原始场景单阶段评分进行审计：在受影响条件下比较 route-blind Ignore-All 探针与 route-aware actor-blind 探针；通过全新安装复现 rollout 发散，并使用同源依赖栈控制和精确输入诊断定位共享 velocity refit 中对依赖敏感的数值行为；最后在 450-token 控制池中仅替换 solver 验证因果链。
Result: 在受影响的文档化数值后台上，两个盲探针在完整 12,146-token navtest 分割上胜过 human replay 和 PDM-Closed；全新安装可在固定 32-token 诊断集上复现 rollout 发散；仅替换 solver 即可在保持 forgiveness 开启的情况下消除发散并恢复盲探针垫底排序，说明数值不稳定是直接触发因素。
Conclusion: 数值不稳定直接触发共享参考失败，而 reference-conditioned forgiveness 将其传播为合规信用；在将此类评分用于防御性驾驶结论前，应要求披露评分基础和依赖栈，并执行盲探针、覆盖报告和 rollout 稳定性测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Latent Communication Pay? A Causal Audit of Relayed KV Caches in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems relay key--value caches instead of text and credit their gains to exchanged ``latent thoughts''. That credit is a claim about \emph{which} example's cache is relayed, not merely that one is. We audit it causally in released systems. The cache is replaced with deranged (mismatched-example), zeroed, and moment-matched random counterparts, under two regimes defined by whether the receiver needs the sender's private information. Where it does, the battery reads ceiling: 100\% against 23--25\% for answer-irrelevant relays on the primary backbone, a contrast replicated across three families, five checkpoints, and a prose document-QA surface. Where it does not, a pre-registered five-seed protocol establishes equivalence within 2.8 points, a margin anchored to the audited system's reported gain, under Holm-corrected TOST on GSM8K and ARC-Challenge across three Qwen3 scales and on MedQA at 8B (one cell shows a small detected advantage inside the margin); a second family shows no detected advantage. A large cache effect need not be a pairing effect. In one natural cell, zeroing the relay costs 14.7 points; a mismatched cache, 0.4. Nor is need sufficient: under the same test, delivered channels span ceiling (LatentMAS's native relay), partial (KVComm's layer subset), and no detected example-specific transfer (C2C's released projector). Benchmark deltas do not by themselves establish latent-thought transmission; establishing it takes a mismatched-cache audit, which we release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多智能体 LLM 系统中继 KV 缓存 (KV cache) 的"潜在思想"通信进行因果审计，用错配样本缓存 (mismatched-example cache)、置零缓存和矩匹配随机缓存替换原始中继缓存，区分接收方是否需要发送方私有信息两种场景。在需要私有信息的场景下，主骨干上正确率高达 100%，而答案无关中继仅为 23–25%，该对比在三个模型家族、五个检查点和文档问答任务上复现；在不需要私有信息时，预注册的五种子协议在 Holm 校正的 TOST 检验下显示等价（差距在 2.8 分以内）。作者指出较大的缓存效应未必是"配对效应"，并发布了错配缓存审计工具。
Motivation: 现有系统把多智能体 LLM 的性能提升归因于中继的"潜在思想"，但这实际上是关于中继了哪个样例缓存的主张，需要因果层面的验证，而不能仅凭基准分数差异下结论。
Method: 采用因果审计：将中继缓存替换为错配样例、置零和矩匹配随机版本，并在两种场景下比较；不需要私有信息时采用预注册的五种子协议，配合 Holm 校正的 TOST 等价性检验，在 GSM8K、ARC-Challenge 和 MedQA 等多个规模与模型家族上进行验证。
Result: 需要发送方私有信息时，主骨干上相关中继达到 100% 而答案无关中继仅 23–25%；不需要私有信息时，三个 Qwen3 规模上等价性在 2.8 分以内，且第二个模型家族未发现可检测的优势。一个自然单元中，置零缓存损失 14.7 分而错配缓存仅损失 0.4 分；不同系统通道表现从满天花板（LatentMAS）到部分（KVComm）再到无可检测的样例特定迁移（C2C）。
Conclusion: 基准分数的提升本身不能证明潜在思想的传递，必须辅以错配缓存审计；大缓存效应不等于配对效应，且接收方需要私有信息也不是充分条件。作者强调审计工具已随论文发布。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: STEP-OPD: Rethinking Output Targets and Internal Dynamics in On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become an effective approach for consolidating multiple task-specialized image generation models into a single student. However, existing OPD methods optimize the student mainly to match the teacher's output velocity, making the teacher the upper limit of the optimization objective. While output-level supervision alone leaves the student's blockwise representation evolution underconstrained, which weakens the transfer of capabilities that must be progressively developed across layers. We propose STEP-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework for image generation that extends the student's learning target beyond the teacher and introduces explicit constraints on its internal representation evolution. Instead of treating the teacher as the final target, we use the velocity difference between each task-specific teacher and the shared base model as a direction for further learning and add a scaled version of this difference to the teacher velocity. In addition, we align the direction and magnitude of representation changes between the student and teacher, enabling the student to learn how representations are progressively transformed across network blocks. Experiments on compositional alignment, text rendering, and human preference show that our method consistently improves Standard OPD methods. In particular, it increases the GenEval score of DiffusionOPD from 0.927 to 0.961, while also improving OCR and all preference-based metrics. The resulting unified student surpasses the corresponding single-task teachers across all three capability groups, showing that output extrapolation enables beyond-teacher learning. And representation change alignment provides complementary guidance for the student's internal transformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STEP-OPD，一种面向扩散模型图像生成的在线蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 框架，旨在突破以教师模型为上限的优化目标，并约束学生模型的内部表示演化。核心做法是将各任务特定教师与共享基础模型之间的速度差按比例叠加到教师速度上，同时对齐学生与教师逐块表示变化的方向和幅度。实验表明该方法在组合对齐、文本渲染和人类偏好评估上一致优于标准 OPD 方法。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 方法主要让学生匹配教师的输出速度，使教师成为优化目标的上限，且仅靠输出级监督会让学生逐块的表示演化缺乏约束，削弱需要跨层逐步发展的能力迁移。
Method: 提出 STEP-OPD：不把教师当作最终目标，而是用每个任务特定教师与共享基础模型之间的速度差作为进一步学习的方向，并将该差值的缩放版本加到教师速度上；此外，对齐学生与教师表示变化的方向和大小，让学生学习表示在各级网络块之间如何逐渐变换。
Result: 在组合对齐、文本渲染和人类偏好评估上，该方法一致改进标准 OPD 方法；其中将 DiffusionOPD 的 GenEval 分数从 0.927 提升到 0.961，同时改善 OCR 和所有基于偏好的指标。统一后的学生模型在全部三类能力上超过对应的单任务教师。
Conclusion: 摘要强调输出外推 (output extrapolation) 能实现超出教师的 (beyond-teacher) 学习，而表示变化对齐为学生的内部变换提供了互补的指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating the Diagnostic Robustness of Vision-Language Models Under Visual and Textual Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Standard accuracy metrics for VLMs often mask significant reliability failures in sensitive domains. In this work, we utilize a histopathology-validated brain MRI dataset to systematically assess the diagnostic robustness of four VLM families under evidence-preserving perturbations. By reordering anatomical slices and swapping target label positions, we evaluate whether models maintain consistent predictions when clinical evidence remains invariant. Our results reveal significant vulnerabilities in presentation-order stability, with models exhibiting prediction flips in up to 48.9% of cases under simple sequence reversals. We further identify a textual selection bias, where label reordering triggers inconsistent diagnoses in up to 67.8% of cases despite identical visual inputs. Negative-control tests further reveal diagnostic overcommitment: models generate categorical diagnoses in up to 76.1% of cases after expert-annotated lesion slices are removed. These results demonstrate that high accuracy can overestimate clinical reliability, masking sensitivity to sequential presentation and textual framing that is not captured by aggregate accuracy. Our findings highlight the necessity of stability-based metrics for the deployment of VLMs in safety-critical clinical applications. Our evaluation data and code will be made public upon acceptance.

papers.title: Variational Bounds for Perceptron Learning from Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a variational approach to a finite-temperature continuous-spin perceptron trained on a Gaussian mixture. The model allows for a broad class of concave utilities and log-concave separable prior measures on the spins. By combining the interpolation method with log-concavity and concentration estimates, we derive lower and upper minimax variational bounds for the limiting quenched pressure. Remarkably, the two bounds differ only in the order of optimization of two variational parameters, while all remaining extrema are controlled by the concave--convex structure of the variational potential. Whenever the two optimizations commute, the two bounds match and identify the solution of the model. The same potential yields the fixed-point equations as stationarity conditions and provides a unified route to the computation of the ground-state energy, training loss, and generalization error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在高斯混合数据上训练的有限温度连续自旋感知机，引入变分方法。作者结合插值方法 (interpolation method)、对数凹性与集中估计，推导出极限淬火压力 (quenched pressure) 的极小极大变分下界与上界。两个界仅在两个变分参数的优化顺序上不同；当优化可交换时，两界匹配并给出模型解。
Motivation: 现有平均场与插值方法在处理具有一般凹效用函数和对数凹可分离先验的连续自旋感知机时，缺少统一的变分刻画，难以同时获得压力下界、上界以及不动点方程。
Method: 提出变分方法处理有限温度连续自旋感知机，允许广泛的凹效用函数和对数凹可分离先验测度；利用插值方法结合对数凹性与集中估计，推导下界与上界变分公式，并通过变分势能的凹-凸结构控制所有剩余极值。
Result: 摘要报告两个变分界只相差两个变分参数的优化顺序；当两种优化顺序可交换时，两界相等并确定模型解。同一变分势能还给出不动点方程作为驻点条件，并提供计算基态能量、训练损失和泛化误差的统一途径。
Conclusion: 作者认为该变分框架为结构化数据上的感知机学习提供统一求解路径，并在变分优化可交换时精确识别模型解。

papers.title: Training Crossroads for Recurrent Vision Transformers: Recurrence, Neural ODEs, and Deep Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong image-recognition performance, but their parameter count grows linearly with depth when each block is independently parameterized. Single-block recurrent ViTs (bViT) remove this growth by repeatedly applying one shared block. Rather than proposing a new architecture, we fix a bViT and provide a controlled empirical characterization of three training and inference regimes under a common CIFAR-100 protocol, asking: (i)~when does recurrence beat independently parameterized depth---at matched FLOPs or at matched parameter memory? (ii)~when a residual recurrent block is trained through an ODE solver, does solver order act as numerical refinement or as an architectural bias? and (iii)~what does robustness beyond the training horizon cost in nominal accuracy? We find that standard ViTs remain preferable when FLOPs are the primary constraint, whereas recurrent ViTs offer a better accuracy--parameter trade-off under memory constraints. Consistent with the standard view of residual networks as Euler discretizations of ODEs, the continuous-time analogue of a residual recurrent block is the state-subtracted vector field $\dot{z}=F_θ(z)-z$; although known in principle, this distinction is easy to violate when the block is wrapped as a black-box vector field, and we qualify the cost at few accuracy points. Because the vector field is learned jointly with the solver, higher-order solvers act as a solver-induced architectural bias rather than a numerical-accuracy improvement, and their gains are not uniform. Finally, stage-wise deep supervision traces an accuracy--robustness frontier: it does not improve nominal accuracy, but degrades gracefully far beyond the training horizon, where naive recurrence collapses to near-random performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文不提出新架构，而是固定单块循环视觉 Transformer（bViT），在统一 CIFAR-100 协议下对三种训练/推理机制做受控实证刻画：循环与独立参数化深度（匹配 FLOPs 或参数内存）、ODE 求解器阶数的作用、超过训练时域的鲁棒性代价。摘要报告标准 ViT 在 FLOPs 受限时更优，而循环 ViT 在内存约束下提供更好的精度-参数权衡；高阶求解器更多表现为求解器诱导的架构偏置而非数值精度提升；阶段式深度监督不提升名义精度，但能在超出训练时域时优雅退化。
Motivation: 单块循环 ViT 通过重复应用共享块来消除参数随深度线性增长，但何时在给定 FLOPs 或参数内存下胜过独立参数化深度、以及 ODE 训练和深度监督的影响，仍缺乏受控的实证比较。
Method: 固定一个 bViT，在共同 CIFAR-100 协议下比较三种机制：匹配 FLOPs 或参数内存下的循环与深度比较、用 ODE 求解器训练残差循环块并分析求解器阶数、以及阶段式深度监督 (stage-wise deep supervision) 与朴素循环的对比。
Result: 标准 ViT 在 FLOPs 为主要约束时仍更可取；循环 ViT 在内存约束下提供更好的精度-参数权衡。残差循环块的连续时间类比是状态相减向量场 $\dot{z}=F_\theta(z)-z$；高阶求解器充当架构偏置，收益并不均匀。阶段式深度监督不改进名义精度，但超越训练时域时退化优雅，而朴素循环塌缩至近随机性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调残差循环块被包装为黑盒向量场时容易违反正确的连续时间形式（状态相减），并会付出若干精度点的代价；该结论可为循环视觉 Transformer 的训练与推理机制选择提供指导。

papers.title: A-SR: Self-Evolving Agentic LLMs for Symbolic Regression via Hierarchical Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression aims to discover closed-form equations from data, but existing LLM-guided methods often rely on a unified proposal loop that compresses heterogeneous search failures into a scalar score and a single prompt. We propose A-SR, a self-evolving agentic framework that shifts the control unit from expression edits to role-conditioned evidence views. A-SR coordinates formula discovery through routing among coordination protocols, an online evaluator-reward role policy, and state-routed process memory. During search, evaluator feedback characterizes reliability and productivity, updates role-level utilities, and routes elite motifs, failure traces, and validity diagnostics to different agents. The framework self-evolves at two timescales: within a run, it adapts the search process without updating LLM parameters; across runs, recorded trajectories can be distilled into open-source LLMs as role-conditioned proposal priors. Averaged over the four LSR-Synth scientific domains in LLM-SRBench, A-SR improves Acc@0.01 over baselines from 25.79% to 48.30% with Llama3.1-8B, while A-SR-LoRA improves the corresponding Qwen3-4B result from 24.58% to 38.29%. On four real-world scientific discovery tasks, A-SR obtains the best in-distribution or out-of-distribution normalized mean squared error on 7 of 8 reported metrics.

papers.title: Persistent Object Narratives for Token-Efficient Video Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have made strong progress in open-ended video understanding. However, their visual interfaces remain token-intensive and provide limited explicit structure for linking recurring object evidence across time. We introduce SlotNarrative, a slot-based interface that organizes a video into persistent object narratives represented by compact object-state tokens. Rather than compressing frame-wise features before establishing temporal correspondence, SlotNarrative first groups visual features into object-like slots and then associates recurring observations with clip-level object entries through a lightweight, parameter-free memory that integrates multiple complementary matching cues. Each retained entry is serialized into two token types: an identity token that summarizes persistent object appearance and a set of state tokens that encode segment-level appearance, geometry, visibility, and trajectory information. This design yields an interface of only 144 allocated visual-token positions for a frozen Video-LLM, independent of the number of sampled frames. Across multiple datasets, SlotNarrative achieves a favorable trade-off between accuracy and visual-token count compared with prior compact Video-LLM interfaces. Experimental results establish persistent object narratives as a compact, structured, and temporally organized visual interface for Video-LLMs. Our code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SlotNarrative，一种基于槽位 (slot) 的视频语言模型 (Video-LLM) 视觉接口，将视频组织成由紧凑对象状态 token 表示的持久对象叙事 (persistent object narratives)。其核心是先对视觉特征分组为对象槽，再通过轻量级无参数内存结合多种互补匹配线索将重复出现的目标关联到片段级对象条目，并为每个条目序列化出身份 token 和状态 token。该接口仅占用 144 个视觉 token 位置，且与采样帧数无关；在多个数据集上相比既有紧凑接口取得了准确率与视觉 token 数量的较好折中。
Motivation: 现有 Video-LLM 的视觉接口 token 开销大，且缺乏显式结构来跨时间关联反复出现的对象证据，限制了开放域视频理解中的效率与结构化表达。
Method: SlotNarrative 先对帧级视觉特征进行对象化槽分组以建立时间对应关系，再通过轻量级、无参数的记忆整合多种互补匹配线索，将重复观察关联到片段级对象条目；每个条目被序列化为身份 token（汇总持续对象外观）和一组状态 token（编码片段级外观、几何、可见性和轨迹信息）。该设计将接口限制为 144 个视觉 token 位置，独立于采样帧数，并适配冻结的 Video-LLM。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上，SlotNarrative 相比先前的紧凑 Video-LLM 接口在准确率与视觉 token 数量之间取得更有利的折中，并验证了持久对象叙事作为紧凑、结构化和时间组织的视觉接口的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为持久对象叙事是一种紧凑、结构化且具有时间组织的 Video-LLM 视觉接口，并将公开代码。摘要未提及该方法在天气或降水相关领域的适用性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Cooking beyond Frames: A Stereo Event Camera Dataset in the Kitchen
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras, also known as neuromorphic cameras, have gained significant attention in recent years due to their high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low power consumption. While many studies and datasets in neuromorphic vision have focused on automotive and drone applications, human-centric daily-life scenarios remain largely underrepresented, despite their importance for developing and benchmarking event-based perception systems. Moreover, the few existing event-based human activity datasets are typically recorded with scripted human actions, limiting their ability to capture natural human behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EventKitchen, a large-scale stereo event camera benchmark dataset of human cooking activities in the kitchen. EventKitchen is egocentrically collected from 10 participants in 13 diverse kitchens, where the participants wear a helmet with multiple sensors and naturally perform cooking activities, without any scripted actions. EventKitchen comprises 5.5 hours of stereo event recordings with synchronized RGB, depth, and IMU data. We provide human annotations for 10,762 action segments and 13,482 bounding boxes. We train baseline models on EventKitchen to perform multiple event-based tasks, including action recognition, object detection, and stereo depth estimation. By capturing natural, real-world human activities, EventKitchen establishes a challenging benchmark for neuromorphic vision beyond autonomous driving.

papers.title: The Neural Echo: A Signal Processing Perspective for Understanding Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the neural echo as a tool for understanding the behavior of neural networks. It generalizes the model-based concepts of impulse responses, diffusion echoes, and filter echoes to learning-based methods. It provides local, space-adaptive impulse responses and filter kernels for a neural network, its so-called echoes. These echoes depend on the input image and can be visualized to understand the learned dynamics of the network via an affine mapping. Neural echoes build a bridge from classical signal processing to modern explainable AI. They are very general and can be applied to both image-to-image and classification networks, with convolutional or fully connected structure, of feedforward or recurrent type, including modern transformer networks. Network differentiability is not required. In the differentiable case, neural echoes comprise concepts based on the network Jacobian, such as saliency maps and the analysis of adversarial perturbations, as special instances. As a simple blueprint to explain our framework, we derive neural echoes for the denoising convolutional neural network (DnCNN). Our experiments suggest that this network weights pixels based on their spatial and gray value distances. This not only clarifies its behavior, but also shows that it can reproduce key concepts of classical model-based denoisers such as bilateral filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“神经回声”(neural echo) 作为理解神经网络行为的工具，将经典信号处理中的脉冲响应、扩散回声和滤波回声概念推广到基于学习的方法。该方法为网络提供依赖于输入图像的局部、空间自适应脉冲响应与滤波核，并可通过仿射映射可视化网络学到的动态，从而在经典信号处理与可解释 AI 之间建立桥梁。作者以去噪卷积神经网络 (DnCNN) 作为示例推导神经回声，实验表明该网络按像素的空间与灰度值距离加权，能够复现双边滤波等经典模型驱动去噪器的关键思想。
Motivation: 神经网络行为难以用经典信号处理工具直接解释，现有可解释性方法缺乏与脉冲响应、滤波核等经典概念的统一联系。作者希望将模型驱动的回声概念推广到学习型方法，为理解网络动态提供一个通用且可视化的分析框架。
Method: 提出神经回声框架，为给定输入图像定义局部且空间自适应的脉冲响应与滤波器核，并通过仿射映射刻画网络的局部行为。该框架非常通用，适用于图像到图像与分类网络、卷积或全连接结构、前馈或循环类型乃至现代 Transformer；网络可微性不是必需，在可微情形下它涵盖基于网络 Jacobian 的显著图 (saliency map) 与对抗扰动分析等特例。
Result: 以 DnCNN 为蓝图推导神经回声后，实验提示该网络根据像素的空间距离和灰度值距离进行加权，说明其行为可以复现双边滤波等经典模型驱动去噪器的核心概念。
Conclusion: 作者认为神经回声搭建了从经典信号处理到现代可解释 AI 的桥梁，并可用于澄清去噪等任务中网络学到的动态；摘要未讨论其在其他任务上的局限或失败情形。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Nonparametric Goodness-of-fit Testing under Covariate Shift
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops procedures for nonparametric goodness-of-fit testing under covariate shift, where labelled data are drawn from a source population but goodness-of-fit is evaluated for a target population. The distribution mismatch is quantified by either a bounded moment condition or a sub-exponential tail condition on the target-to-source density ratio. Our method combines truncated importance-weighting kernel ridge regression with a multiplier bootstrap to construct confidence sets for the regression function. The truncation stabilizes the importance- weighting kernel ridge regression as well as the bootstrap calibration, making our approach applicable even when the density ratio has heavy tails. We prove nonasymptotic validity and sharpness of the resulting confidence sets under suitable operator compatibility conditions, and establish explicit error rates for coverage probability under specific conditions on the target- to-source density ratio and on the spectral decay of the kernel integral operator. Numerical experiments corroborate our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协变量偏移 (covariate shift) 下的非参数拟合优度检验：标注数据来自源总体，但需要在目标总体上评估拟合优度，分布失配通过目标-源密度比的矩条件或亚指数尾条件刻画。方法将截断重要性加权核岭回归 (truncated importance-weighting kernel ridge regression) 与乘子自助法 (multiplier bootstrap) 结合，构造回归函数的置信集，并证明其非渐近有效性、锐度与显式覆盖误差率。
Motivation: 在迁移或领域适配场景中，训练数据与评估总体分布不一致，标准的拟合优度检验不再有效；需要通过密度比刻画分布失配，并在可能重尾的密度比下构造可靠的置信集。
Method: 提出结合截断重要性加权核岭回归与乘子自助法来构造置信集；截断操作用于稳定加权核岭回归及自助校准，使方法在密度比具有重尾时仍适用。
Result: 在合适的算子相容性条件下证明了置信集的非渐近有效性和锐度，并针对目标-源密度比条件与核积分算子谱衰减给出了覆盖概率的显式误差率；数值实验验证了理论结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为非参数拟合优度检验在协变量偏移下的覆盖性质提供了可证明的保障，并明确可处理重尾密度比情形；摘要未声明具体应用领域或实际数据基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards a satellite image manipulation and deepfake localization benchmark dataset
papers.abstract_en: Verifying the authenticity of satellite imagery has become increasingly critical given advances in generative artificial intelligence. Highly realistic synthetic imagery produced for malicious purposes (deepfakes) can have major consequences in the remote sensing domain, where this data is a fundamental source of information for science applications, planning, logistics, and monitoring. The remote sensing community lacks high-quality, fine-grained manipulation datasets suitable for training and evaluating detection and image forensics algorithms. Existing datasets are lacking and those that do exist either provide no ground truth masks for evaluating manipulation localization, or consist of entire images generated by GANs or diffusion models, which are inadequate for measuring localization performance. To address this gap, we describe a preliminary dataset construction process and prototype benchmark dataset for satellite image manipulation detection and localization. The dataset contains 60 images total, with 30 images carefully manipulated using three manipulation types including copy-paste splicing and diffusion model inpainting, and 30 authentic images. Each image is accompanied by a ground-truth mask and acquisition metadata, enabling both pixel-level localization metrics, image metadata studies, and analyses of how manipulation detection performance relates to image collection parameters. We describe the dataset construction process and present this initial release to support further research in image forensics and geospatial deepfake detection. The prototype dataset can be downloaded at https://huggingface.co/datasets/geodf/fmow-fake-small.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感领域缺乏高质量、细粒度卫星图像篡改数据集的缺口，描述了一个初步的数据集构建流程和原型基准数据集。该原型包含60张图像，其中30张使用复制-粘贴拼接和扩散模型修复等三种篡改类型处理，另外30张为真实图像；每张图像均附带ground-truth掩膜和采集元数据，支持像素级定位评估、图像元数据研究以及篡改检测性能与采集参数关系的分析。数据集已公开发布，旨在支持图像取证与地理空间deepfake检测研究。
Motivation: 生成式AI使得伪造卫星图像日益逼真且可能带来严重后果，但遥感社区缺少适合训练和评估检测与取证算法的高质量、细粒度篡改数据集。现有数据集要么不提供用于评估篡改定位的ground-truth掩膜，要么整张图像由GAN或扩散模型生成，无法衡量定位性能。
Method: 提出一个包含60张图像的原型数据集构建流程，其中30张真实图像，30张通过复制-粘贴拼接、扩散模型修复（diffusion model inpainting）等三种篡改类型进行精细处理，并为每张图像提供ground-truth掩膜与采集元数据。
Result: 当前版本为包含60张图像的原型基准，支持像素级定位指标、图像元数据研究以及篡改检测性能与图像采集参数之间关系的分析。
Conclusion: 本文仅描述初步数据集构建流程并发布原型版本，目的是为图像取证和地理空间deepfake检测领域的进一步研究提供基础资源。

papers.title: RegisterBridgeMM: A Register-Centric Framework for RGB-Infrared Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: RGB-infrared (RGB-IR) object detection benefits from complementary visible and thermal cues, but effective fusion remains challenging under illumination changes, weather variation, and cluttered scenes. Existing RGB-IR fusion methods often trade expressive patch-level interaction for lighter but more constrained adaptation mechanisms. We empirically observe that pretrained register tokens contain both modality-shared and modality-specific information on paired RGB-IR inputs, suggesting that they can serve as a compact substrate for cross-modal communication. Building on this observation, we propose RegisterBridgeMM, a register-mediated fusion framework organized as a three-stage register lifecycle. Aggregate preserves per-modality register summarization inherited from pretraining; Bridge performs bidirectional register-to-patch reading with consensus-residual regulation; and Project translates the resulting register summary into spatially adaptive calibration of patch features. This register pathway avoids dense patch-to-patch cross-modal interaction while preserving the pretrained patch representation. With both backbone streams frozen, RegisterBridgeMM achieves the highest mAP50-95 among the evaluated methods on all four benchmarks: LLVIP, M3FD, DroneVehicle, and FLIR-Aligned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RegisterBridgeMM，一个以寄存器（register token）为中心的 RGB-红外（RGB-IR）目标检测融合框架。作者观察到预训练寄存器令牌在配对 RGB-IR 输入上同时包含模态共享与模态特有信息，因此设计了三阶段寄存器生命周期：Aggregate 保留各模态预训练的寄存器摘要，Bridge 执行双向 register-to-patch 读取并加入 consensus-residual 调节，Project 将寄存器摘要转化为 patch 特征的空间自适应校准。该路径避免密集 patch-to-patch 跨模态交互，且在冻结两个骨干流的条件下，于 LLVIP、M3FD、DroneVehicle 和 FLIR-Aligned 四个基准上取得所评估方法中最高的 mAP50-95。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-IR 融合方法常在表达性的 patch 级交互与更轻量但受限的自适应机制之间取舍，且光照变化、天气变化和杂乱场景使融合仍具挑战；需要一种既能保留预训练 patch 表示、又避免密集跨模态交互的紧凑通信方式。
Method: 提出基于预训练寄存器令牌的三阶段融合框架：Aggregate 保持从预训练继承的逐模态寄存器摘要；Bridge 通过双向 register-to-patch 读取并配合共识-残差（consensus-residual）调节实现跨模态通信；Project 将寄存器摘要翻译为 patch 特征的空间自适应校准。整个流程保持两个骨干流冻结，避免密集的 patch 级跨模态交互。
Result: 摘要报告，在两个骨干流均冻结的设置下，RegisterBridgeMM 在 LLVIP、M3FD、DroneVehicle、FLIR-Aligned 全部四个基准上达到所评估方法中最高的 mAP50-95。
Conclusion: 作者认为寄存器令牌可作为紧凑的跨模态通信媒介，该寄存器路径在避免密集 patch 级交互的同时保留预训练 patch 表示，并在多个 RGB-IR 检测基准上展现了优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Control under Stationary Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Control policies optimized in simulation can perform poorly in the real system when the parameters $x$ of the simulator are estimated from limited data but the resulting parameter uncertainty is not represented inside the simulation. A common way to incorporate such ambiguity is to simulate each trajectory of the system under a randomly drawn value for $x$. Since the policy cannot observe the drawn value, it must initially choose controls that perform well across many possible parameter values. However, if the policy progressively observes the system, it can often gradually infer the value of $x$, so that ambiguity vanishes. Over time, the policy then specializes to its estimate of $x$ and loses its robustness. This is undesirable in many real systems, where latent factors are expected to shift. In financial markets, for example, a policy hedging a derivative payoff should remain robust to changes in the volatility regime. To induce such continual robustness, we propose training policies in simulators where ambiguity varies with the system's state but does not systematically decay over time. We formalize this requirement as stationary ambiguity: the simulator should induce a stationary filter process over the latent state. We show how to construct such simulators and demonstrate, on hedging problems, that policies trained under stationary ambiguity preserve robustness to latent factors over time, leading to strong performance on real market data. As a modeling principle, stationary ambiguity informs many simulator design decisions: which models make realistic simulators, how their parameters should be randomized, and how simulator and policy should be initialized. While our experiments focus on hedging, stationary ambiguity may also be useful for other sequential control problems driven by exogenous stochastic processes with shifting latent structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对仿真参数不确定性导致的策略失稳问题，提出“平稳模糊性”(stationary ambiguity) 的建模原则：在仿真训练中让潜在状态上的模糊性不随时间系统性衰减，从而保持策略对潜在因素的持续鲁棒性。作者展示如何构造这类模拟器，并在金融对冲问题上验证，称在真实市场数据上取得良好表现。
Motivation: 仿真中从有限数据估计的参数存在不确定性，但若策略随观测逐步推断出真实参数值，模糊性会消失，策略将专精于估计值并失去鲁棒性；在金融市场等系统中潜在因子会漂移，因此需要持续稳健的策略。
Method: 提出训练策略的模拟器设计原则，要求模拟器对隐状态诱导一个平稳滤波过程 (stationary filter process)，使模糊性随系统状态变化但不随时间衰减；并给出构造此类模拟器的方案，以及模型选择、参数随机化和初始化等设计决策。
Result: 在对冲问题上的实验表明，在平稳模糊性下训练的策略能够随时间保持对潜在因子的鲁棒性，并在真实市场数据上表现良好。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 摘要将平稳模糊性视为模拟器设计的一般原则，认为它可能适用于其他由外生随机过程和漂移隐结构驱动的序列控制问题；本文的实验场景聚焦于对冲。

papers.title: ContextWeave: A Real-World Workflow Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Memory is essential as language agents move from isolated tasks to long-horizon, stateful workflows, yet existing evaluations often reduce it to retrieval or question answering. We introduce ContextWeave, a longitudinal benchmark that evaluates whether recalled experience improves downstream agent performance in realistic office-work streams. ContextWeave reconstructs privacy-preserved, multi-month workflows of 14 participants into 1,005 executable tasks, including 568 core evaluation tasks, with instructions, containerized environments, trajectories, and task-specific rubrics. It measures workspace quality and alignment with participant-specific preferences, complemented by diagnostics of relevance, continuity, solvability, and robustness to misleading recall. Across six memory components under a fixed model, the strongest configuration raises Workspace Score from 68.08 to 78.20 and Preference Score from 41.50 to 70.60. With a fixed memory component, recall improves both outcomes for all five tested base models, although gains vary substantially. Our analysis shows that actionable, experience-rich memory supports workflow continuation and reduces redundant exploration more effectively than compact summaries, while it can also be more susceptible to misleading recall. These findings motivate memory systems that optimize not only retrieval relevance but also reliable use during execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ContextWeave，一个面向语言代理 (language agent) 的纵向基准 (longitudinal benchmark)，用来评估记忆召回是否真正提升真实办公室工作流中的下游代理表现。该基准把 14 名参与者的隐私保护多月经工作流重建为 1,005 个可执行任务（其中 568 个为核心评测任务），并附带指令、容器化环境、轨迹和逐任务评分标准。在固定模型下比较六种记忆组件，最强配置将 Workspace Score 从 68.08 提升到 78.20，将 Preference Score 从 41.50 提升到 70.60；固定记忆组件时，召回提升对全部五个基础模型均有效，但提升幅度差异明显。
Motivation: 现有对语言代理记忆的评测常把记忆简化为检索或问答任务，无法回答“被召回的经验是否改善下游代理在长周期、有状态工作流中的实际表现”这一核心问题。
Method: 构建 ContextWeave 基准：将 14 名参与者数月真实办公工作流在隐私保护前提下重建为可执行的纵向任务集，提供指令、容器化环境、轨迹与任务评分标准，并评测工作区质量 (Workspace Score) 和对参与者个性化偏好的对齐 (Preference Score)，辅以相关性、连续性、可解性及对误导性召回的鲁棒性诊断。
Result: 固定模型下，六种记忆组件中表现最强的配置使 Workspace Score 从 68.08 升至 78.20、Preference Score 从 41.50 升至 70.60；固定记忆组件时，召回对全部五个测试基础模型的两种指标均有改进。分析还显示，可操作的、经验丰富的记忆比紧凑摘要更能支持工作流延续并减少冗余探索，但也更容易受误导性召回影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为记忆系统不应只优化检索相关性，还需保证召回内容在执行中被可靠使用，这为设计兼顾经验丰富度与误导鲁棒性的记忆机制提供了依据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Intrinsic-Hybrid Latent Diffusion Models for Generative Modeling on Unknown Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Intrinsic Hybrid Latent Diffusion Model (ILDM), a generative framework that integrates probabilistic dimensionality reduction with geometry-aware diffusion on unknown manifolds. While diffusion models (DMs) have achieved state-of-the-art results in high-dimensional data synthesis, they rely on large training datasets and ignore intrinsic geometric structure. Latent diffusion models (LDMs) address the high dimensionality by learning a latent space, but they typically impose a Euclidean structure, failing to capture the underlying manifold geometry, especially problematic in data-sparse regimes. ILDM addresses these limitations by interpreting the latent space as a chart of an unknown Riemannian manifold, with geometry and uncertainty quantified through a probabilistic decoder. The forward process is a hybrid diffusion that switches between Riemannian and Euclidean dynamics based on local uncertainty, where the Riemannian component is governed by a probabilistic metric tensor derived from the decoder. To learn the generative dynamics, we introduce an approximate denoising score matching method tailored to the hybrid diffusion setting, enabling a backward process defined by hybrid Langevin dynamics. Experiments on COIL-100, MNIST, and cardiac MRI datasets demonstrate that ILDM significantly improves generation quality, achieving lower FID and LPIPS scores compared to standard diffusion and latent diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出内在混合潜扩散模型 (ILDM)，将概率降维与未知流形上的几何感知扩散相结合，用于高维数据生成。与标准扩散模型和潜扩散模型 (LDM) 相比，ILDM 把潜空间解释为未知黎曼流形的一张图，并通过概率解码器刻画几何与不确定性；前向过程在黎曼与欧几里得动力学之间按局部不确定性切换，后向过程由混合 Langevin 动力学定义。在 COIL-100、MNIST 和心脏 MRI 数据集上的实验显示，ILDM 取得更低的 FID 和 LPIPS 分数。
Motivation: 扩散模型在依赖大数据集的同时忽略了数据的固有几何结构；潜扩散模型虽降低了维度，却通常强加欧几里得结构，无法刻画未知流形的几何，这在数据稀疏场景下尤为不利。
Method: ILDM 将潜空间视作未知黎曼流形的图，用概率解码器量化几何和不确定性；前向过程是混合扩散，依据局部不确定性在黎曼动力学和欧几里得动力学之间切换，其中黎曼分量由解码器导出的概率度量张量控制。作者还针对该混合扩散设置提出近似的去噪分数匹配方法，使后向过程由混合 Langevin 动力学定义。
Result: 在 COIL-100、MNIST 和心脏 MRI 数据集上的实验表明，ILDM 相比标准扩散模型和潜扩散模型显著提升生成质量，取得更低的 FID 与 LPIPS 分数。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是：通过概率解码器引入黎曼几何感知的潜空间，并以不确定性驱动的混合扩散建模生成动力学，能够改善生成质量；论文的实验范围限于图像类数据集。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Global Attention-Fused Image Cropping with Attention-Guided and Global-Aligned Crop Evaluator
papers.abstract_en: Image cropping aims to improve image aesthetics by preserving important content within an appropriately composed region. However, most existing methods focus primarily on salient regions and therefore have limited sensitivity to the global relationships among the main image components. To address this limitation, we propose Global Attention-Fused Image Cropping (GAFIC), which consists of an Attention-Guided Feature Fusion (AGFF) and a Global-Aligned Crop Evaluator (GACE). AGFF aggregates the importance of local regions to construct a global representation that captures both image structure and local details. GACE aligns candidate crop features with this global representation, enabling crop evaluation to remain sensitive to boundary changes. We further combine three ranking losses across multiple scales to obtain accurate and stable crop scores. Extensive experiments on the GAIC and CPC datasets demonstrate that GAFIC outperforms existing image-cropping methods, particularly in terms of accuracy and stability. Unlike pixel-level retargeting methods such as seam carving, inpainting, and diffusion-based synthesis, GAFIC does not synthesize or modify the retained pixels; instead, it selects an aesthetically preferred crop from the source image, making it suitable for scenarios where pixel integrity and efficient batch processing are important. The source code is available at https://github.com/AIVRC/GAFIC.git.
papers.comment: The source code is available at https://github.com/AIVRC/GAFIC.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAFIC（Global Attention-Fused Image Cropping）图像裁剪方法，由注意力引导特征融合（AGFF）和全局对齐裁剪评估器（GACE）组成。AGFF 聚合局部区域重要性以构建同时包含图像结构与局部细节的全局表示，GACE 将候选裁剪特征与该全局表示对齐，使评估对边界变化敏感。在 GAIC 和 CPC 数据集上的实验表明，GAFIC 在准确性和稳定性上优于现有图像裁剪方法，且不修改或合成保留像素。
Motivation: 现有图像裁剪方法主要关注显著区域，对主要图像组件之间的全局关系敏感性有限，导致裁剪评估无法充分利用全局结构信息。
Method: 提出 GAFIC 框架，包含 AGFF 与 GACE 两个模块；AGFF 负责将局部区域重要性聚合成全局表示，GACE 将候选裁剪特征与全局表示对齐以提升评估的边界敏感性，并组合多个尺度上的三种排序损失以获得准确稳定的裁剪分数。
Result: 在 GAIC 和 CPC 数据集上的大量实验表明，GAFIC 在准确性和稳定性方面优于现有图像裁剪方法。
Conclusion: GAFIC 不进行像素级合成或修改，而是从源图像中选择美学上更优的裁剪区域，适用于像素完整性和高效批处理重要的场景；源代码已开源。

papers.title: When Diffusion Models Forget Who You Are: Identity Preservation in Face Inpainting under Large Occlusions
papers.abstract_en: Face inpainting with diffusion models has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet preserving identity fidelity under significant occlusion and conflicting text guidance remains a major challenge. To address this issue, we present Reference Semantic Inpainting for Face (ReSem-Face), a cascaded diffusion framework that introduces an explicit identity-conditioned semantic prior for multi-reference face inpainting. Our approach distills representative identity features from multiple references to reconstruct missing semantic regions, which then guide the diffusion process through a multi-stream conditioning architecture. This design provides strong semantic constraints when pixels are absent and stabilizes identity reconstruction while remaining compatible with prompt-driven edits. Experiments on CelebAHQ-IDI-5 and VGGFace2 demonstrate that ReSem-Face yields more reliable identity-preserving completion under severe semantic masks and improves text-controlled editing quality compared with representative baselines.

papers.title: Rethinking Pixel Mean Flows via Interval Denoiser
papers.abstract_en: Modern diffusion and flow-based models are increasingly moving toward few-step, latent-free generation to bypass the computational overhead of multi-step sampling and the reconstruction bottlenecks of external autoencoders. We propose the Interval Denoiser, a theoretically rigorous framework for latent-free generation. Derived directly from the flow matching ODE, it establishes an exact analytical mapping for intermediate trajectory states. Unlike prior formulations, our prediction is shown to reside on a low-dimensional manifold across any time interval, making the regression tractable for a network operating directly on pixels. Furthermore, by avoiding empirical algebraic substitutions, our formulation correctly isolates the pure time derivative to prevent biased gradient evaluations and ensure exact first-order optimization. By analyzing this objective, we equip our framework with residual clipping and a time-sampling curriculum, enabling effective long-interval training and improving few-step performance. Trained from scratch on ImageNet 256x256, our model achieves an FID of 4.55 in one step (1-NFE) and 3.98 in two steps (2-NFE) without perceptual losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Interval Denoiser，一个从 flow matching ODE 直接导出的无隐空间 (latent-free) 生成框架，为中间轨迹状态建立精确解析映射。该预测被证明落在低维流形上，并且通过避免经验代数替换来隔离纯时间导数，从而保证精确的一阶优化。配合残差裁剪与时间采样课程，在 ImageNet 256x256 上从零训练，达到 1 步 (1-NFE) FID 4.55、2 步 (2-NFE) FID 3.98，且不使用感知损失。
Motivation: 现代扩散与 flow 模型正逐步转向少步、无隐空间生成，以规避多步采样的计算开销和外部自编码器的重建瓶颈；现有公式缺乏严格的理论框架。
Method: 从 flow matching ODE 导出精确的中间轨迹状态解析映射，证明预测位于低维流形，避免经验代数替换并隔离纯时间导数；进一步引入残差裁剪 (residual clipping) 和时间采样课程 (time-sampling curriculum) 以支持长间隔训练。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上从零训练，1 步推理 FID 为 4.55，2 步推理 FID 为 3.98，且无需感知损失。
Conclusion: 该公式化方法能实现有效的长间隔训练并提升少步生成性能，为无隐空间的少步生成提供了理论一致的框架。

papers.title: StaticSegFormer: An Efficient High-Performance Semantic Segmentation Based on Static Structured Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning enhances the efficiency of deep neural networks (DNNs) by eliminating groups of parameters during inference. Previous methods mostly reduce computational complexity (FLOPs), while semantic segmentation performance (mIoU) slightly drops. Accordingly, recent dynamic structured pruning methods aim at reducing the performance drop, while lowering the FLOPs even more. However, on the ADE20K and Cityscapes benchmarks, our study reveals that on a GPU platform such dynamic methods exhibit a surprisingly low frame rate far below a simple static approach, while having comparable results in mIoU and FLOPs. To address this issue, we propose a static structured pruning method for attention layers, that achieves both, a lower FLOPs and a high frame rate [fps] of the SegFormer network, the latter increased by up to 34% relative on the Cityscapes dataset, while having no mIoU performance drop at all. Our so-called StaticSegFormer method is strongest for small encoders and large images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StaticSegFormer，一种针对 SegFormer 注意力层的静态结构化剪枝方法。研究发现在 ADE20K 和 Cityscapes 基准上，动态结构化剪枝方法在 GPU 上的帧率远低于简单静态方法，尽管 mIoU 和 FLOPs 相当；为此作者提出静态剪枝方案，在降低 FLOPs 的同时提升帧率，并保持 mIoU 不下降。
Motivation: 现有动态结构化剪枝方法旨在减少语义分割性能下降并进一步降低 FLOPs，但在 GPU 平台上实际帧率远低于简单静态方法，说明现有方法忽略了推理速度这一实际效率指标。
Method: 提出一种针对注意力层的静态结构化剪枝方法，并将其应用于 SegFormer 网络，目标是在降低 FLOPs 的同时获得高帧率。
Result: 在 Cityscapes 数据集上帧率相对提升最高达 34%，且 mIoU 完全没有下降；该方法对小编码器和大图像最为有效。
Conclusion: 静态结构化剪枝相比动态方法在 GPU 上具有更高的实际推理效率，StaticSegFormer 能在不损失语义分割性能的前提下显著提升帧率。

papers.title: Segmentation Pre-training for Label-Efficient Lumbar Spine Degeneration Grading
papers.abstract_en: Automated assessment of degenerative pathology in the lumbar spine on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) requires access to large-scale datasets of expert-annotated radiological gradings. In contrast, segmentation pseudo-labels can be generated by automated tools at negligible radiologist cost. We examine whether pre-training on segmentation can effectively replace a fraction of the manual grading annotations required for downstream supervision. We pre-train a 3D ResNet encoder to segment the vertebrae, intervertebral discs (IVDs), and the spinal canal, then fine-tune lightweight task-specific grading heads using different proportions of the available training data, ranging from $10\%$ to $100\%$. On a multicentre dataset of ${\sim}2{,}000$ subjects across 11 pathologies, segmentation pre-training, achieving a Dice score of $0.94$ against pseudo-labels, improved the task-averaged (macro) one-vs-rest ROC-AUC at all proportions. With only 20\% of grading labels after pre-training, the method achieved near full-supervision performance, with the largest gains observed for either low-prevalence or spatially grounded pathologies.
papers.comment: The 2nd MICCAI Workshop on Efficient Medical AI (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用分割预训练替代一部分腰椎退变分级所需的人工标注。作者用伪标签预训练一个 3D ResNet 编码器，分割椎体、椎间盘（IVDs）和椎管，然后用不同比例（10% 到 100%）的分级标注微调轻量级任务头。在约 2,000 名受试者、11 种病理的多中心数据集上，分割预训练在所有标注比例下都提升了任务平均（macro）one-vs-rest ROC-AUC；仅用 20% 的分级标签即可接近全监督性能。
Motivation: 腰椎 MRI 的退变病理自动评估依赖大量专家标注的放射学分级数据，获取成本高；而分割伪标签可由自动化工具以极低放射科医生成本生成。论文想验证分割预训练能否有效替代一部分下游监督所需的手动分级标注。
Method: 先在一个 3D ResNet 编码器上执行分割预训练任务，目标是椎体、椎间盘（IVDs）和椎管，随后为不同分级任务接入轻量级任务头，并使用 10% 到 100% 的训练标注比例进行微调。
Result: 分割预训练在伪标签上达到 0.94 的 Dice score，并在所有标签比例下改善任务平均（macro）one-vs-rest ROC-AUC；预训练后仅用 20% 的分级标注就能接近全监督性能，最大收益出现在低患病率或空间定位明确的病理上。
Conclusion: 作者认为分割预训练可以有效替代部分手动分级标注，显著降低标签需求，且在低患病率或空间上可定位的病理上获益最大。

papers.title: MGSB: Manifold Gated Signature Branch Pressure-Domain Baseline Architecture for Two-Phase Pipeline Flows Under Distributional Shift
papers.abstract_en: Leak detection models for multiphase pipelines often degrade when deployed under flow regimes that differ from training. Existing evaluations typically assess performance under in-distribution operating conditions, masking failures caused by regime transitions such as bubble-to-slug flow. We propose the Manifold Gated Signature Bias (MGSB), a regime-aware architecture combining regime-conditioned feature fusion, a TT-RoughPath encoder, and Mean-Teacher consistency regularization to improve robustness under distribution shift. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, MGSB achieves a detection F1 of 0.930 and an OOD F1 of 0.783, substantially outperforming CNN-LSTM and fully connected baselines under severe feature corruption. Ablations show the proposed architecture, not the training procedure, is the primary contributor to OOD robustness, while Mahalanobis-distance analysis confirms the held-out conditions are genuinely out-of-distribution. These results show that explicit regime-aware modelling is a practical path toward robust, sensor-agnostic leak detection in industrial multiphase pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多相管道泄漏检测模型在部署时遭遇与训练不同的流型(flow regime)而性能退化的问题，提出 MGSB (Manifold Gated Signature Bias) 架构，结合流型条件特征融合、TT-RoughPath 编码器和 Mean-Teacher 一致性正则化。在 leave-one-group-out 评估下，MGSB 达到检测 F1 0.930、OOD F1 0.783，显著优于 CNN-LSTM 和全连接基线；消融实验表明鲁棒性主要来自架构本身而非训练过程，Mahalanobis 距离分析也确认了留出条件确实属于分布外。
Motivation: 多相管道泄漏检测模型在流型与训练分布不同的工况下会退化，而现有评估通常仅在分布内条件下进行，掩盖了如泡状流向段塞流转变等流型切换所导致的失败；因此需要显式感知流型的鲁棒建模。
Method: 提出 MGSB 架构，包含流型条件特征融合(regime-conditioned feature fusion)、TT-RoughPath 编码器以及 Mean-Teacher 一致性正则化，并在 leave-one-group-out 协议下评估其对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 leave-one-group-out 评估中，MGSB 的检测 F1 为 0.930，OOD F1 为 0.783，在严重特征损坏下大幅超过 CNN-LSTM 和全连接基线；消融显示架构而非训练流程是 OOD 鲁棒性的主要贡献者。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式流型感知建模是实现工业多相管道中鲁棒且传感器无关的泄漏检测的实用路径。

papers.title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-based router that dispatches the task to one of four frontier fixers. Adding a new fixer requires no retraining. On the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the benchmark's official capped budget tier, SuperScout matches the best single model's solve rate (159 of 266 for SuperScout, 158 for the best model) at about a fifth of the total cost per solve, and the reported configuration sits above the random traffic-splitting baseline. A no-router ablation, always the cheapest fixer with the handoff, ties the routed system on this benchmark, so the handoff rather than the routing decision carries the result. A paired calibration study points to the mechanism: the handoff appears to redistribute rather than add solving ability, lifting the three cheaper fixers while slightly hurting the strongest, though at $N=99$ the per-fixer effects are directional only; the searcher's hidden states improve cost routing on the calibration labels while the handoff's own text does not. The searcher's compute adds less than half a cent of GPU time per task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuperScout，一种面向代码智能体的成本感知路由系统：先用 7B 规模的搜索器（searcher）侦察仓库并生成结构化的交接报告（handoff），其中的可复现声明经沙箱验证、虚假声明被剥离，再由基于简历的 router 利用搜索器的隐藏状态和任务文本把任务分发给四个前沿修复器。在 SWE-bench Pro 的完整 Python 切片（266 个任务）及官方封顶预算档下，SuperScout 的解决数（159/266）追平最佳单模型（158/266），而单次求解总成本约为其五分之一，且配置优于随机流量切分基线。不过，去掉 router、只用最便宜修复器加 handoff 的消融与完整系统持平，说明结果主要由 handoff 而非路由决策贡献。
Motivation: 前沿语言模型可以解决仓库级软件问题，但每次尝试成本高昂；现有路由仅根据问题文本选择模型，未利用仓库内部信息。
Method: SuperScout 让一个 7B 搜索器先探索仓库并生成结构化 handoff，其可复现声明经沙箱验证、虚假声明被删除；随后将搜索器隐藏状态与任务文本喂给基于简历的 router，由它把任务派发给四个前沿修复器，新增修复器无需重训练。还配了对标定数据的成对校准研究来分析机制。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Pro Python 切片（266 任务）的官方封顶预算档下，SuperScout 解决 159 个任务，最佳单模型解决 158 个，而每解决一个任务的总成本约为后者的五分之一，且高于随机流量切分基线；无 router 消融（始终用最便宜修复器加 handoff）与完整路由系统打平。校准研究显示 handoff 是重新分配而非新增求解能力：提升了三个较便宜修复器、略微损害最强修复器，但在 N=99 下各修复器效应仅为方向性；搜索器的隐藏状态改善成本路由，而 handoff 文本本身不能；搜索器计算开销每任务不足半美分 GPU 时间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在本基准上承载结果的是 handoff 而非路由决策；隐藏状态有助于成本路由，而 handoff 文本本身没有；各修复器的效应在 N=99 时仅为方向性证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privileged, but Biased: How PI-Conditioned Teachers Break Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation (SD) has emerged as a compute-efficient alternative to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: a self-teacher, conditioned on privileged information (PI) about the answer such as a reference solution, supplies dense per-token supervision to a student that never sees it. Reported gains, however, come almost exclusively from narrow, low-difficulty settings, leaving open a basic question: as a lone objective, with no reward term, does SD teach anything? We reproduce SDPO's reported gains in its easy setting, then apply the identical setup to difficult tasks and find that it does not. Across question answering, mathematics, coding, and multi-turn agentic tool use, across reasoning modes, model sizes, and forms of PI, and under both the SDPO and OPSD recipes, the per-token loss falls steadily while validation accuracy does not improve and typically degrades. We explain this failure through a single causal chain from the loss to the model it produces. The chain begins with PI bias: having seen one particular reference solution, the teacher's per-token target is pulled toward that trajectory rather than toward correctness in general, an effect we quantify with a PI Bias Score. Trained to match this target everywhere, the student's objective becomes nearly blind to whether a rollout is correct, and the loss it assigns falls mostly on low-information tokens like stopwords, punctuation, uncertainty markers, rather than those that determine the answer; within correct rollouts the exploratory tokens incur the highest divergence, so it penalizes the hesitation that reasoning requires. The result is a flatter, less decisive student that is no better at reasoning: as a lone objective, SD optimizes a signal decoupled from task success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自蒸馏 (self-distillation, SD) 作为唯一目标、不含奖励项时能否真正教会学生模型。作者复现了 SDPO 在其简单设置中的收益，但将相同设置迁移到困难任务后发现失败：跨问答、数学、编码、多轮智能体工具使用，以及不同推理模式、模型规模和 PI 形式，逐 token 损失持续下降而验证准确率不提升且通常下降。作者用一个从损失到模型的单一因果链解释失败，起点是 PI 偏差 (PI bias)：教师因看到特定参考解而使逐 token 目标偏向该轨迹，学生被迫匹配该目标后对 rollout 是否正确几乎失明，损失主要落在低信息 token 上，最终得到更平坦、更不果断的学生模型。
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏报告的收益几乎全部来自狭窄、低难度的设置，开放的基本问题是：作为唯一目标、不含奖励项时，SD 到底能否教会模型任何东西。
Method: 作者在 SDPO 的简单设置中复现其报告收益，然后将相同设置应用于困难任务，覆盖问答、数学、编码、多轮 agentic 工具使用，并跨推理模式、模型规模与 PI 形式，同时使用 SDPO 和 OPSD 两种配方；还提出 PI Bias Score 来量化教师目标被单一参考解拉向特定轨迹的程度。
Result: 在困难任务上，逐 token 损失稳定下降但验证准确率不提升且通常下降；损失主要落在 stopwords、标点、不确定性标记等低信息 token 上，而在正确 rollout 中探索性 token 产生最高分歧，因此惩罚推理所需的犹豫。结果学生模型变得更平坦、更不果断。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，作为唯一目标，SD 优化的是与任务成功脱钩的信号；PI 偏差通过从损失到模型的单一因果链导致失败，即使损失下降也不能带来推理能力提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Above-ground Biomass Estimation with Geospatial Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of Above-Ground Biomass (AGB) from satellite imagery is essential for the large-scale monitoring of carbon stocks, yet it remains a challenging regression task at global scale. Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising machine learning paradigm to derive general-purpose representations from Earth observation data, but their utility for quantitative regression tasks like biomass estimation remains largely unexplored, as most benchmarks emphasize classification and segmentation. Here, we present a comprehensive benchmark of GFMs for global-scale AGB estimation using the AGBD dataset, a machine learning-ready benchmark spanning diverse biomes and geographies. We distinguish two ways in which GFMs reach practitioners: (i) models distributed as weights to be run by the user, which we evaluate as frozen encoders within the PANGAEA benchmarking framework; and (ii) models distributed as ready-to-use, pre-computed embedding products, for which we evaluate AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) and TESSERA. We compare 11 GFMs available on PANGAEA and both embedding products against a fully supervised state-of-the-art (SOTA) model, assess their geographical and temporal generalization abilities, as well as agreement with the ESA CCI biomass product on independent reference data. Our results show that GFMs run as frozen encoders substantially underperform with respect to the supervised SOTA model, whereas pre-computed embedding products prove highly effective. An MLP trained on AEF embeddings outperforms the supervised SOTA model trained on AGBD features, and the same SOTA model trained on AEF embeddings (optionally augmented with selected raw features) achieves the best overall result, while also generalizing better across space and time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对地理空间基础模型（Geospatial Foundation Models, GFM）在全球尺度地上生物量（Above-Ground Biomass, AGB）估算中的表现进行了系统基准测试。作者使用 AGBD 数据集，在 PANGAEA 框架下评估 11 个以冻结编码器形式提供的 GFM，并评估 AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 与 TESSERA 两个预计算嵌入产品。结果显示冻结编码器型 GFM 明显不如全监督 SOTA 模型，而预计算嵌入产品非常有效；基于 AEF 嵌入训练的 MLP 超过在 AGBD 特征上训练的监督 SOTA 模型。
Motivation: 从卫星影像准确估算 AGB 对碳储量的大尺度监测至关重要，但全球规模的回归任务仍然困难。GFM 已成为从地球观测数据学习通用表征的潜力范式，但多数基准聚焦分类和分割，其用于生物量估算等定量回归任务的价值尚未被充分探究。
Method: 提出一个基于 AGBD 数据集的 GFM 全球 AGB 估算综合基准，覆盖多种生物群系和地理区域。作者区分两种 GFM 使用方式：一类是作为权重分发、需用户自行运行的模型，在 PANGAEA 基准框架中作为冻结编码器评估；另一类是可直接使用的预计算嵌入产品，评估 AEF 和 TESSERA。作者将 11 个 PANGAEA 上的 GFM 及两个嵌入产品与全监督 SOTA 模型比较，并评估地理与时间泛化能力及与 ESA CCI 生物量产品在独立参考数据上的一致性。
Result: 以冻结编码器运行的 GFM 相对监督 SOTA 模型明显表现不佳，而预计算嵌入产品效果显著。基于 AEF 嵌入训练的 MLP 优于在 AGBD 特征上训练的监督 SOTA 模型；用 AEF 嵌入（可选添加精选原始特征）训练同一 SOTA 模型取得最佳总体结果，并展现出更好的时空泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，对于 AGB 估算这类定量回归任务，预计算嵌入产品比冻结编码器型 GFM 更有效，且将嵌入加入监督模型可同时提升精度与时空泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Effectiveness of Adaptation Strategies for VLM-Based Federated Learning in Remote Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of deep learning models across decentralized image archives without requiring data centralization. This paradigm is particularly relevant in remote sensing (RS), where legal regulations, privacy concerns, and bandwidth constraints restrict data sharing. However, the presence of training data heterogeneity across clients (known as non-IID data) can impede convergence and limit the generalization capability of the aggregated global model. To mitigate the adverse effects of training data heterogeneity, vision-language models (VLMs) can be leveraged in FL due to their transferable representations, which have demonstrated robustness under distribution shifts. However, their large parameter size may substantially increase communication overhead and local computational complexity in federated settings. Therefore, it is crucial to select an appropriate VLM adaptation strategy that balances the generalization ability with the communication and computational constraints. To address this issue, in this paper, we present the first comparative study of VLM adaptation strategies for FL in the context of RS image classification. We investigate full fine-tuning, encoder-specific fine-tuning, prompt learning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning, and analyze them with respect to three criteria: 1) generalization capability under non-IID data, 2) communication overhead, and 3) local computational complexity. Experiments on BigEarthNet-S2, EuroSAT, RESISC45, and ImageNet reveal distinct trade-offs between task specialization, cross-domain generalization, and efficiency. Based on our findings, we derive a guideline for the selection of an appropriate VLM adaptation strategy in FL for RS image classification under different operational constraints. The code of this work is publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/FL-RS-VLM.
papers.comment: Accepted at the SPIE Artificial Intelligence and Image and Signal Processing for Remote Sensing, Edinburgh, Scotland, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在遥感图像分类的联邦学习（FL）场景下，首次系统比较了视觉-语言模型（VLM）的多种适应策略，包括全微调（full fine-tuning）、编码器特定微调、提示学习（prompt learning）和低秩适应（LoRA）。研究从非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下的泛化能力、通信开销和本地计算复杂度三个标准展开分析，并在 BigEarthNet-S2、EuroSAT、RESISC45 和 ImageNet 数据集上揭示了任务特化、跨域泛化与效率之间的权衡，最后给出面向不同运行约束的适应策略选择指南。
Motivation: 遥感数据因法规、隐私和带宽限制难以集中共享，FL 是相关训练范式，但客户端间的 non-IID 数据会阻碍收敛并限制全局模型泛化。VLM 的迁移表征有助于缓解数据异质性，但其参数量大会显著增加 FL 中的通信开销和本地计算复杂度，因此需要系统比较合适的 VLM 适应策略。
Method: 对四种 VLM 适应策略在 FL 遥感图像分类背景下进行对比研究，分别评估其在 non-IID 数据下的泛化能力、通信开销和本地计算复杂度，并依据实验结果归纳选择指南。
Result: 在 BigEarthNet-S2、EuroSAT、RESISC45 和 ImageNet 上的实验显示出任务特化、跨域泛化与效率之间存在明显的不同权衡。
Conclusion: 根据研究发现提出了在 FL 遥感图像分类中针对不同运行约束选择 VLM 适应策略的指南，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are commonly trained through reinforcement learning with sparse trajectory-level rewards, which offer limited guidance on how strongly individual tokens should be updated. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) addresses this by re-scoring generated tokens under a privileged replay view to obtain dense, token-level supervision. However, we identify a confounding issue: the resulting support may reflect both the privileged information contained in the replay view and score shifts induced by the replay scaffold, making it difficult to attribute the support specifically to that information. This issue is especially pronounced when future environment observations serve as privileged information, since replaying them requires reconstructing an extended scaffold that itself perturbs token scores. To resolve this confounding, we propose Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation (OCSD), which contrasts two structurally matched replay views, Full and Observation-Ablated, differing only in whether the actual future observation is present, to derive an observation residual that discounts score changes shared by the replay scaffold. OCSD then applies this residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates at high-uncertainty steps, while preserving the trajectory-level update direction. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across three Qwen3 model scales show that OCSD consistently outperforms strong baselines. Diagnostic analyses further confirm that the calibrated residual aligns better with local environment feedback. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yiy1x/OCSD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出观察校准自蒸馏 (Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation, OCSD)，用于改进大语言模型智能体的强化学习训练。作者指出 On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 在利用未来环境观察作为特权信息时，token 级监督会混杂特权信息与重放脚手架 (replay scaffold) 引起的分数偏移；OCSD 通过对比 Full 与 Observation-Ablated 两种结构匹配的重放视图得到观察残差，并在高不确定性步骤用该残差调制 token 级 GRPO 更新。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 上、三个 Qwen3 模型规模下均优于强基线。
Motivation: 稀疏轨迹级奖励对单个 token 应如何更新提供的指导有限；OPSD 通过重放视图重新评分生成 token 来获得稠密监督，但所得支持信号难以区分是来自重放视图中的特权信息还是重放脚手架本身造成的分数偏移，尤其当未来环境观察作为特权信息时需要重建扩展脚手架，进一步干扰 token 分数。
Method: 提出 OCSD，对比两个结构匹配的重放视图 Full 与 Observation-Ablated，二者仅在是否包含实际未来观察上不同，从而得到观察残差 (observation residual) 以折扣重放脚手架共有的分数变化。该残差被用于在高不确定性步骤调制 token 级 GRPO 更新，同时保留轨迹级更新方向。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Search-QA 三个基准上、横跨三个 Qwen3 模型规模，OCSD 持续优于强基线；诊断分析进一步表明校准后的残差与局部环境反馈更对齐。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过结构匹配视图的对比可以解耦特权信息与重放脚手架对 token 分数的影响，从而更可靠地把稠密监督归因于未来观察；代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: RepoProbe: Benchmarking Architecture-Aware Repository Comprehension with Checklists
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into software engineering has shifted the focus from function-level generation to repository-scale assistance. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on bug reports from GitHub Issues, which often allow models to bypass genuine understanding via pattern matching on error logs. This misalignment under-measures Edit Bias, which refers to premature generation, where models prematurely propose code modifications instead of understanding the existing repository architecture. Furthermore, current LLM-as-a-Judge scalar scoring suffers from high variance and low interpretability. This work introduces RepoProbe, a novel benchmark for evaluating repository-level code understanding through open-ended Q&A using GitHub Discussions, which focuses on open-ended architectural inquiries rather than defect reporting. To ensure rigorous evaluation, we propose a Checklist-Based Verification Protocol that decomposes answers into atomic, verifiable facts, thereby replacing subjective ratings with objective verification. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs reveals a persistent gap between high clarity and evidencegrounded technical correctness. It also quantitatively confirms the prevalence of edit bias, in which models prioritize code generation instead of architectural analysis. Finally, we demonstrate that our verification protocol significantly improves evaluation reliability compared to traditional evaluations with scalar scoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RepoProbe，一个用于评估大语言模型仓库级代码理解的基准，数据来源是 GitHub Discussions 中的开放式架构问题，而非传统 benchmark 常用的 GitHub Issues 缺陷报告。作者同时提出基于检查清单的验证协议 (Checklist-Based Verification Protocol)，把模型回答拆解为原子化、可验证的事实，以客观验证替代主观打分。对 SOTA LLM 的评测显示模型在表达流畅度与证据支撑的技术正确性之间存在持续差距，并定量确认了 edit bias 的普遍性。
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码理解 benchmark 大多依赖 GitHub Issues 的 bug 报告，模型可通过匹配错误日志的模式绕过真正的架构理解，导致 edit bias（模型过早提出代码修改而非先理解现有仓库架构）被低估；此外，LLM-as-a-Judge 的标量打分方差高、可解释性差。
Method: 构建 RepoProbe 基准，使用 GitHub Discussions 中的开放式架构问答任务替代缺陷报告式任务；并设计基于检查清单的验证协议，将模型答案分解为原子可验证事实，用客观核查取代主观评分。
Result: 对 SOTA LLM 的评估发现，模型的高表达清晰度与证据支撑的技术正确性之间存在持续鸿沟；结果定量确认了 edit bias 的普遍性，即模型倾向于生成代码而非进行架构分析；验证协议相比传统标量打分显著提升了评估可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者认为以开放式架构问答和检查清单式客观验证为基础的 RepoProbe，能更可靠地衡量仓库级代码理解，并揭示现有模型重代码生成、轻架构分析的倾向。
