papers.title: Continual-Learning Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Parameterized Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) incorporate governing equations into neural-network training and can approximate PDE solutions without requiring large observational datasets. Parameterized PINNs (ParamPINNs) further take physical parameters as inputs, allowing a single model to represent a family of PDE solutions over a parameter domain. Existing ParamPINNs, however, still face inefficient training, uneven accuracy across parameters, and overfitting to a limited set of sampled parameter tasks, which can impair generalization to unsampled parameters. To address these issues, we propose a continual-learning physics-informed neural network (CL-PINN), which treats PDE instances at different parameter values as related tasks and learns them sequentially. CL-PINN combines Bayesian-optimization-based active parameter selection, task-wise dynamic loss weighting, sparse physics-constrained replay, and an optional parameter subnetwork to improve task allocation and knowledge retention under bounded active-task capacity. It requires no observational data and is designed to solve parameterized PDEs over relatively broad parameter domains under limited computational resources. Multi-seed evaluations on five benchmarks, including one continuous function and four parameterized PDEs, show that Bayesian selection substantially reduces objective-loss queries relative to grid-greedy search, while sparse replay mitigates forgetting of earlier tasks. Under the prescribed within-case resource protocols, CL-PINN generally provides higher and more balanced solution accuracy than fixed-sampling and grid-greedy baselines. CL-PINN offers a practical route toward learning PDE solutions that generalize across physical parameters and has the potential to support reusable physics-informed surrogates for large-scale engineering parameter studies.
papers.comment: 124 pages in total, including the main text (63 pages, 25 figures, and 16 tables) and supplementary material (61 pages, 30 figures, and 17 tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种持续学习物理信息神经网络（CL-PINN），用于求解参数化偏微分方程（PDE）。该方法将不同参数取值下的 PDE 实例视为相关任务并顺序学习，结合基于贝叶斯优化的主动参数选择、任务级动态损失加权、稀疏物理约束回放和可选参数子网络，在无需观测数据的情况下改善任务分配与知识保持。五个基准上的多随机种子评估表明，CL-PINN 在规定的资源协议下比固定采样和网格贪心基线获得更高且更均衡的精度。
Motivation: 现有参数化 PINN（ParamPINN）存在训练效率低、不同参数下精度不均以及对有限采样参数任务过拟合的问题，这会损害对未采样参数的泛化能力。
Method: CL-PINN 将不同参数值下的 PDE 实例视为相关任务并顺序学习，组合使用基于贝叶斯优化的主动参数选择、任务级动态损失加权、稀疏物理约束回放（sparse physics-constrained replay）以及可选的参数子网络，以在有限活动任务容量下改进任务分配和知识保留。
Result: 在包含一个连续函数和四个参数化 PDE 的五个基准上，贝叶斯选择相比网格贪心搜索大幅减少目标损失查询次数，稀疏回放缓解了对早期任务的遗忘；在规定的同案例资源协议下，CL-PINN 通常比固定采样和网格贪心基线提供更高且更均衡的解精度。
Conclusion: CL-PINN 为学习跨物理参数泛化的 PDE 解提供了一条实用路径，并有潜力支持大规模工程参数研究中的可复用物理信息代理模型。

papers.title: IMFACT: Counterfactual Explanations for Time Series via Intrinsic Mode Function Substitution
papers.abstract_en: Oscillatory signals, such as vibration, carry class-discriminative information in specific frequency bands; perturbing them in raw feature space for counterfactual analysis easily destroys their temporal structure and produces physically implausible results. In this work, we introduce IMFACT (IMF-based counterfACTuals), a model-agnostic framework for generating plausible counterfactual explanations for time series classifiers that operates in the decomposition space of Empirical Mode Decomposition. An input signal is split into Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs), and selected IMFs are progressively substituted with those of a Nearest Unlike Neighbour (NUN) until the classifier flips to the target class. We evaluate six IMF-selection strategies and a multi-NUN cycling extension on two UCR benchmarks (FaultDetectionA, FruitFlies). The variance-based strategy with three NUNs outperforms two prominent baseline techniques on reliability and plausibility metrics, while cycling across three NUNs yields the best proximity across both datasets.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 2 figure, 2 tables, accepted at XKDD Workshop at ECML-PKDD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IMFACT，一个模型无关的反事实解释框架，用于时间序列分类器。它在经验模态分解 (Empirical Mode Decomposition) 空间中，将输入信号分解为内在模态函数 (IMF)，并用最近异类邻居 (NUN) 的 IMF 逐步替换选中的成分，直到分类器翻转到目标类别。作者在两个 UCR 基准上评估了六种 IMF 选择策略和一种多 NUN 循环扩展，结果显示基于方差的策略在可靠性和合理性上优于两个基线方法。
Motivation: 振动等振荡信号在特定频带携带类别判别信息，在原始特征空间扰动会破坏时间结构并产生物理上不合理的反事实样本。
Method: 模型无关框架 IMFACT：对输入信号进行 EMD 分解得到 IMF，按策略选择部分 IMF，用最近异类邻居 (NUN) 的相应 IMF 替换，迭代直到分类器输出目标类别。论文评估了六种 IMF 选择策略，并提出跨多个 NUN 循环替换的扩展。
Result: 在 UCR 的 FaultDetectionA 和 FruitFlies 基准上，基于方差的策略搭配三个 NUN 在可靠性和合理性指标上超过两个基线；跨三个 NUN 的循环策略在两个数据集上取得最佳邻近性 (proximity)。
Conclusion: 在 EMD 分解空间中生成反事实解释能保留时间结构并产生更合理的样本；摘要强调了 IMF 替换策略与多 NUN 循环对解释质量的影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NSF-HRPT: Neural Semantic Field meets Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree for Safety-Critical Scenario Assessment
papers.abstract_en: The ability to accurately assess and anticipate risks in safety-critical scenarios is crucial for autonomous driving systems. While existing research has made progress in collision prediction, accurately quantifying risk levels from monocular vision inputs remains challenging due to the complex dynamics of multi-agent interactions and the inherent uncertainty in real-world environments. To address these challenges, we present NSF-HRPT, a novel framework that combines learning-based perception with structured reasoning for quantitative risk assessment. Our approach features a Neural Semantic Field (NSF) that learns to model scene semantics, trajectory predictions, and probabilistic Time-to-Collision (TTC) distributions from simulation data. During inference, the pre-trained NSF serves as a prior for our Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree (HRPT), which enables efficient parallel computation and spatial reasoning about multi-agent risks. Additionally, we introduce a Sim2Real enhancement strategy that improves real-world applicability without retraining by incorporating priors from foundation models. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on synthetic benchmarks and delivers competitive, near-state-of-the-art results on real-world datasets for both TTC estimation accuracy and risk localization precision. The proposed method provides an effective solution for real-time risk awareness from monocular camera inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NSF-HRPT 框架，将基于学习的感知与结构化推理相结合，用于自动驾驶安全关键场景的定量风险评估。其核心是一个从仿真数据训练的神经语义场 (Neural Semantic Field, NSF)，用于建模场景语义、轨迹预测和概率化碰撞时间 (probabilistic Time-to-Collision, TTC) 分布；推理时预训练 NSF 作为分层风险感知树 (Hierarchical Risk Perception Tree, HRPT) 的先验，支持多智能体风险的并行计算与空间推理。作者还引入 Sim2Real 增强策略，无需重训练即可融入基础模型先验以提升真实世界适用性；评估显示该方法在合成基准上达到当前最优，在真实数据集上接近当前最优。
Motivation: 现有研究在碰撞预测上已有进展，但仅从单目视觉输入准确量化风险等级仍很困难，难点在于多智能体交互的复杂动力学与真实环境中的固有不确定性。
Method: 框架由三部分组成：从仿真数据学习场景语义、轨迹预测和概率化 TTC 分布的 NSF；推理阶段将预训练 NSF 作为先验的 HRPT，用于高效并行计算与多智能体风险的空间推理；以及引入基础模型先验的 Sim2Real 增强策略，在不需要重训练的情况下改善真实世界适用性。

papers.title: Guideline-as-Oracle: Zero-Annotation Training of an Ophthalmic Telephone Triage Agent
papers.abstract_en: Scaling supervision for multi-turn medical agents is difficult because expert dialogue annotation is costly and clinical conversations are privacy-restricted. We introduce Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO), which compiles American Academy of Ophthalmology guidance into a 70-row operational rule table and uses it as the sole source of instance-level supervision for 3,000 training dialogues, reserving human labeling for evaluation. Because converting rules into dialogues is itself a design problem, we catalog eight construction strategies, including cited-row tier assignment, one-fact boundary pairs, metadata-only repair, and label repair, and characterize the evidential status of each: labeling mechanism, null, confounded, or evaluated only as a package. Fine-tuning a 9B backbone on this corpus yields GAO-Triage, improving agreement with a 201-case operational reference from 61.7% to 74.1% (exact McNemar p=0.0046) and emergent-case recall from 9.5% to 69.0%; the gains persist across a second seed and patient simulator. None of the seven general-purpose systems we test dominates GAO-Triage on both metrics, and GAO-Triage requires no frontier model at inference time. Permuting label-dialogue assignments collapses the model to a constant-routine predictor, indicating that the signal lies in guideline-derived assignment rather than dialogue surface form. Label repair coincides with the disappearance of a late-training safety degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO)，将美国眼科学会指南编译为一张 70 行的操作规则表，并仅以此作为 3,000 段训练对话的实例级监督来源，从而在不做专家对话标注的情况下微调 9B 模型得到 GAO-Triage。摘要报告该模型在 201 例操作参考上的一致性从 61.7% 提升到 74.1%（精确 McNemar p=0.0046），突发情况召回从 9.5% 提升到 69.0%，收益在第二个随机种子和患者模拟器上保持。作者还归纳了八种从规则构造对话的策略，并指出置换标签-对话配对会使模型退化为固定例程预测器。
Motivation: 多轮医疗智能体的监督扩展很困难，因为专家对话标注成本高昂，且临床对话受隐私限制难以获取，导致大规模实例级监督稀缺。
Method: GAO 将美国眼科学会指南编译为操作规则表，作为训练对话的唯一监督信号；由于从规则生成对话本身是设计问题，作者系统整理了八种构造策略并刻画其证据状态，例如带引用的层级分配、单事实边界对、仅元数据修复和标签修复，并区分了标注机制、空值、混淆以及仅作为整体评估等情况。
Result: 在 201 例操作参考上，GAO-Triage 将一致性从 61.7% 提升到 74.1%（精确 McNemar p=0.0046），紧急情况召回从 9.5% 提升到 69.0%；七种通用系统中没有一种在两个指标上同时优于 GAO-Triage，且该方法推理时无需前沿模型。
Conclusion: 置换标签-对话分配会使模型崩溃为常数例程预测器，表明学习信号来自指南派生的分配而非对话表层形式；标签修复与训练后期安全退化消失同时出现，说明规则派生的监督还可以影响安全相关行为。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel on complex tasks through long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, but their lengthy intermediate steps cause severe overthinking that inflates inference cost. KV-cache compression is a common solution, yet existing reasoning-oriented methods apply a uniform policy across the trajectory and judge compression only by what it removes from the cache. Two observations point the other way. First, a reasoning state's tolerance to context loss varies along the trajectory, and process reward tracks it: deleting tokens at high-reward steps preserves accuracy far better than deleting the same budget at random. Second, compression is not free on the generation side, since a smaller cache leads the model to generate more tokens, partly canceling the saving. Together these motivate coordinating both sides under a single process reward. We propose ReCo (Reward-Coordinated Compression), a step-wise framework in which a lightweight process-reward estimator scores each completed step and drives three components: (1) reward-adaptive KV-cache compression that shrinks the retained cache harder at high-reward steps and less at low-reward ones, (2) a reward-banded penalty on reflection tokens that curbs redundant generation, and (3) confidence-based early stopping that triggers when the reasoning is reliable. Across three reasoning models and six benchmarks, ReCo reduces generated tokens by 37%-65% and end-to-end latency by 2.08x-2.35x over Full CoT, all while largely preserving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型 (Large Reasoning Models, LRMs) 在长链思维 (chain-of-thought, CoT) 推理中的过度思考与推理成本膨胀问题，提出 ReCo (Reward-Coordinated Compression)，一个由过程奖励 (process reward) 统一协调 KV-cache 压缩与生成的逐步框架。摘要报告在三个推理模型和六个基准上，ReCo 相比完整 CoT 将生成 token 减少 37%-65%，端到端延迟降低 2.08 倍到 2.35 倍，同时基本保持准确率。
Motivation: LRMs 依赖长 CoT 取得高性能，但冗长的中间步骤造成过度思考 (overthinking)，推高推理开销。现有面向推理的 KV-cache 压缩方法在整个推理轨迹上采用统一策略，且只根据其从缓存中删除了什么来判断压缩质量；摘要指出推理状态对上下文丢失的容忍度随轨迹变化，且压缩本身在生成端并非免费——更小的缓存会让模型生成更多 token，部分抵消节省。
Method: 提出 ReCo 框架：一个轻量级过程奖励估计器为每个已完成步骤打分，并驱动三个组件——(1) 奖励自适应 KV-cache 压缩，在高奖励步骤更激进地缩减缓存、低奖励步骤缩减较少；(2) 对反思 token (reflection tokens) 施加按奖励分带 (reward-banded) 的惩罚以抑制冗余生成；(3) 基于置信度的早停，在推理可靠时触发。
Result: 摘要在三个推理模型和六个基准（包括数学与推理类任务）上报告，ReCo 相比 Full CoT 减少生成 token 37%-65%，端到端延迟提升 2.08 倍到 2.35 倍，同时大幅保留准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将压缩与生成纳入同一过程奖励进行协调，可以同时缓解过度思考带来的 token 膨胀和缓存压缩在生成端的负面反馈；论文状态为工作进展中 (Work in progress)，修订仍在进行。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Embedding Large Language Models into Flow Controls: An Agentic Framework for Adaptive and Trustworthy Automated Cooking
papers.abstract_en: Automated cooking robots have traditionally relied on predefined procedures and rule-based control, ensuring stable execution but offering limited personalization, whereas recent large-model approaches support natural language interaction but often suffer from opaque decision making and unreliable execution in real kitchens. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an agentic framework that systematically decomposes personalized cooking requirements into structured and verifiable control programs rather than directly mapping language to actions. Multiple AI agents collaboratively transform user intents into canonical recipes, workflow programs with explicit flow control, and executable Python code grounded in an atomic action library. The system consists of three tightly coupled stages: offline recipe-to-code generation through multiple agents, online closed-loop execution with supervisory intervention enabled by multimodal perception, and post-run adaptation that updates user preference models for long-term personalization. Real-world experiments on a physical cooking platform demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves reliable task completion, transparent execution logic, and effective anomaly handling across diverse personalized scenarios, validating its practicality for trustworthy automated cooking in real environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型多智能体 (agentic) 框架的自动化烹饪系统，将个性化烹饪需求分解为结构化、可验证的控制程序，而非直接将语言映射为动作。系统包含离线配方到代码生成、在线闭环执行与多模态监督干预、以及运行后用户偏好模型更新三个阶段。在真实物理烹饪平台上的实验表明该方法能实现可靠任务完成、透明执行逻辑和有效异常处理。
Motivation: 传统烹饪机器人依赖预定义流程和规则控制，执行稳定但个性化能力有限；而近期大模型方法支持自然语言交互，但决策不透明且在实际厨房中执行不可靠。
Method: 提出多智能体协同框架，将用户意图依次转化为规范食谱、带显式流程控制的工作流程序，以及基于原子动作库的可执行 Python 代码；系统由离线多智能体食谱到代码生成、在线多模态感知下的闭环执行与监督干预、运行后用户偏好自适应的后处理三个阶段紧密耦合而成。
Result: 在真实物理烹饪平台上的实验显示，该框架在多样化个性化场景中实现了可靠的任务完成、透明的执行逻辑和有效的异常处理，验证了其在真实环境中可信自动化烹饪的实用性。
Conclusion: 作者强调将大语言模型嵌入流程控制、以可验证程序而非直接动作映射的方式，是构建可信自动烹饪系统的可行路径。

papers.title: FUSEP: A Multi-Center Benchmark for Diverse Tasks in Early Pregnancy Fetal Ultrasound Screening
papers.abstract_en: A large number of infants with congenital anomalies are born each year globally, especially in areas with underdeveloped medical resources. Currently, fetal ultrasound screening is the most common modality for early pregnancy anatomy detection. This modality can detect anomalies earlier and provide opportune treatment advice. However, the lack of an ultrasound dataset on early fetal gestation has slowed down the development of automated assisted diagnosis. In this work, we present a benchmark dataset for Fetal Ultrasound Screening in Early Pregnancy to facilitate intelligent ultrasound examination and assisted diagnosis called FUSEP. Our dataset consists of two ultrasound views recommended by the international guideline, i.e., Crown-rump Length (CRL) and Nuchal Translucency (NT) views in three hospitals, totaling 4,017 ultrasound images, with 45,820 box-level expert-level annotations. Our dataset and baseline present the following three contributions: 1) Our medical experts annotated a total of 14 key anatomical structures in two views using a box-level format; 2) Our data is collected extensively from different sonographers, devices, scanning angles, hospitals, etc; 3) We report the performance of the semi-supervised learning, fully supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA), and source-free UDA in ultrasound images multi-object detection. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first publicly available dataset and benchmark for fetal early pregnancy ultrasound screening. We believe that FUSEP and benchmark can contribute to the medical community in the development of multiple tasks such as standard plane recognition, quality control on ultrasound images, automated assisted diagnostics in early fetal pregnancy, medical multi-object detection, domain adaptation for object detection, etc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FUSEP，一个面向早孕期胎儿超声筛查的多中心基准数据集，包含来自三家医院的 4,017 张 CRL 和 NT 两个国际指南推荐切面的超声图像，以及 45,820 个框级专家标注，覆盖 14 个关键解剖结构。作者报告了全监督、半监督、无监督域适应 (UDA) 和源-free UDA 在超声图像多目标检测上的基线性能，并称这是首个公开的早孕胎儿超声筛查数据集与基准。
Motivation: 全球每年有大量先天异常婴儿出生，尤其在医疗资源欠发达地区；超声筛查可较早发现异常并提供治疗建议，但缺乏早孕期超声数据集，阻碍了自动化辅助诊断的发展。
Method: 构建 FUSEP 数据集：从三家医院、不同超声医师、设备和扫描角度下收集国际指南推荐的 CRL 与 NT 两个切面图像，由医学专家以框级格式标注 14 个关键解剖结构，并在该数据集上评估半监督学习、全监督学习、无监督域适应 (UDA) 和源-free UDA 四种范式下的多目标检测基线。
Result: 数据集包含 4,017 张超声图像和 45,820 个框级专家标注，覆盖 14 个解剖结构，跨医院、设备与扫描角度收集，并报告了四种学习范式下的检测性能。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 FUSEP，一个面向早孕期胎儿超声筛查的多中心基准数据集，包含来自三家医院的 4,017 张 CRL 和 NT 两个国际指南推荐切面的超声图像，以及 45,820 个框级专家标注，覆盖 14 个关键解剖结构。作者报告了全监督、半监督、无监督域适应 (UDA) 和源-free UDA 在超声图像多目标检测上的基线性能，并称这是首个公开的早孕胎儿超声筛查数据集与基准。
summary_sections.motivation: 全球每年有大量先天异常婴儿出生，尤其在医疗资源欠发达地区；超声筛查可较早发现异常并提供治疗建议，但缺乏早孕期超声数据集，阻碍了自动化辅助诊断的发展。
summary_sections.method: 构建 FUSEP 数据集：从三家医院、不同超声医师、设备和扫描角度下收集国际指南推荐的 CRL 与 NT 两个切面图像，由医学专家以框级格式标注 14 个关键解剖结构，并在该数据集上评估半监督学习、全监督学习、无监督域适应 (UDA) 和源-free UDA 四种范式下的多目标检测基线。
summary_sections.result: 数据集包含 4,017 张超声图像和 45,820 个框级专家标注，覆盖 14 个解剖结构，跨医院、设备与扫描角度收集，并报告了四种学习范式下的检测性能。

papers.title: Explicit Language Memory for Long-Horizon Planning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for connecting visual perception, language understanding, and robotic control. However, existing VLA models still face major challenges in long-horizon tasks: sparse expert demonstrations constrain cross-task compositional generalization; the non-Markovian nature of long-horizon tasks makes it difficult for policies conditioned only on current observations to maintain temporal consistency; limited closed-loop error correction allows execution errors to accumulate; and end-to-end action fine-tuning may weaken the high-level semantic representations of vision-language model (VLM) backbones. To address these issues, we propose a hierarchical long-horizon VLA architecture with an explicit language-memory module. The central idea is to convert discrete temporal observations into a coherent textual memory sequence with temporal logic. The system is decoupled into a high-level VLM and a low-level VLA: the high-level VLM performs semantic reasoning through a visual question answering training paradigm, while the low-level VLA executes precise continuous control conditioned on subtask instructions and visual observations. The high-level VLM recursively updates both language memory and subtask instructions using the previous memory as a contextual anchor, enabling persistent temporal tracking and dynamic correction during long-horizon execution. We evaluate the proposed method in multiple simulation environments and conduct sim-to-real experiments on a real robotic platform. The results demonstrate that explicit language memory improves the success rate and robustness of VLA models on complex long-horizon tasks while providing an interpretable semantic account of the decision process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在长时程任务中的不足，提出一种带显式语言记忆（explicit language memory）模块的层次化 VLA 架构。其核心思想是将离散时间观测转换为带时序逻辑的连贯文本记忆序列，并将系统解耦为高层 VLM 与低层 VLA：高层 VLM 通过视觉问答训练范式进行语义推理并递归更新语言记忆与子任务指令，低层 VLA 依据子任务指令和视觉观测执行连续控制。作者在多个仿真环境和真实机器人平台上进行验证，结果表明显式语言记忆能提升复杂长时程任务的成功率与鲁棒性，并提供可解释的决策语义描述。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在长时程任务中面临多个挑战：稀疏专家示范制约跨任务组合泛化、长时程任务的非马尔可夫性使仅依赖当前观测的策略难以保持时序一致性、闭环纠错能力有限导致执行误差累积，以及端到端动作微调可能削弱 VLM 骨干的高层语义表征。这些问题使得长时程规划与执行在现有范式下缺乏可靠的时序跟踪与纠错机制。
Method: 提出层次化长时程 VLA 架构，引入显式语言记忆模块：将离散时序观测转化为具有时间逻辑的连贯文本记忆序列。系统由高层 VLM 与低层 VLA 解耦组成，高层 VLM 采用视觉问答（VQA）训练范式进行语义推理，并以上一时刻记忆作为上下文锚点递归更新语言记忆与子任务指令，从而实现长时程执行中的持续时序跟踪与动态修正；低层 VLA 负责基于子任务指令和视觉观测的精确连续控制。
Result: 摘要报告，在多种仿真环境及真实机器人平台的 sim-to-real 实验中，显式语言记忆显著提升了 VLA 模型在复杂长时程任务上的成功率和鲁棒性，同时为决策过程提供了可解释的语义描述。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式语言记忆为长时程 VLA 规划提供了一种有效的层次化解耦方案，能在提升任务成功率与鲁棒性的同时保留决策的可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Splat-Based Metal Artifact Reduction in Cone-Beam CT via Compact Attenuation Modeling
papers.abstract_en: X-ray computed tomography (CT) suffers from severe metal artifacts when high-attenuation objects such as dental fillings or orthopedic implants are present. These artifacts originate from the polychromatic nature of X-rays, where attenuation varies strongly with photon energy and material composition, breaking the monochromatic assumption used by conventional reconstruction algorithms. Recent neural rendering approaches attempt to address this mismatch through differentiable polychromatic projection models, but they still struggle with smoothness bias, loss of fine structures, and prohibitive computation when extended to large-scale cone-beam CT. We introduce a splat-based metal artifact reduction framework that incorporates a physically grounded polychromatic forward model into a continuous Gaussian representation for cone-beam CT. Each Gaussian encodes the energy-dependent attenuation of the underlying material using a compact material parameterization, which enables efficient joint optimization of geometric and material properties without relying on a metal mask. This compact attenuation formulation captures the essential variation across biological tissues and metallic implants, allowing our model to explain metal-induced nonlinearity while preserving high-frequency structure. Experiments on simulated and real cone-beam CT scans show that our method converges significantly faster and suppresses metal artifacts more effectively than existing reconstruction and neural field-based approaches.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 splat 的锥束 CT 金属伪影去除框架，将物理可解释的多色 X 射线前向模型嵌入连续高斯表示中。每个高斯通过紧凑的材料参数化编码能量依赖的衰减，从而在没有金属掩膜的情况下联合优化几何与材料属性，在解释金属引起的非线性同时保留高频结构。在模拟和真实锥束 CT 扫描上的实验表明，该方法比现有重建方法和神经场方法收敛更快、金属伪影抑制更有效。
Motivation: 常规 CT 重建基于单色假设，而多色 X 射线中高衰减物体（如牙科填充物或骨科植入物）会导致严重金属伪影；现有神经渲染方法虽引入可微多色投影模型，但仍存在平滑偏差、细结构丢失以及扩展到大规模锥束 CT 时计算量过大的问题。
Method: 提出 splat-based 金属伪影减少框架，将物理上合理的多色前向模型集成到连续高斯表示中；每个高斯用紧凑材料参数化描述能量依赖的衰减，无需依赖金属掩膜即可高效联合优化几何与材料属性。
Result: 在模拟和真实锥束 CT 扫描上，该方法相比现有重建与神经场方法收敛显著更快，并更有效地抑制金属伪影。
Conclusion: 紧凑衰减建模能够捕获生物组织和金属植入物之间的关键衰减差异，从而解释金属引起的非线性并保留高频结构；摘要没有提及对极端金属伪影或大规模临床数据的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InsightEmb: Learning Action-Intent Embeddings for Agentic Insight Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents accumulate reusable insights from prior trajectories, making retrieval increasingly important for turning accumulated experience into actionable guidance. At each decision step, retrieving the right insight can help the agent progress toward its goal, a setting we refer to as agentic insight retrieval. However, existing retrieval methods primarily model semantic similarity, while overlooking whether a retrieved insight resolves the agent's current decision bottleneck. We propose InsightEmb, a contrastive embedding framework that learns transferable progress-oriented retrieval geometry using only mathematical reasoning data. InsightEmb jointly learns to align concrete situations with abstract heuristic rules and to cluster reasoning trajectories with similar progress structures. We evaluate InsightEmb on dynamic agent tasks and a static skill-retrieval benchmark. Without any environment-specific training, InsightEmb improves over all these evaluations, surpassing the performance of existing reasoning embedding models. These results suggest that the geometry of state-insight matching can transfer across domains, enabling effective training from publicly available reasoning data without expensive environment-specific supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InsightEmb，一个用于智能体洞察检索（agentic insight retrieval）的对比学习嵌入框架。智能体在每个决策步骤需要检索能帮助解决当前决策瓶颈的洞察，而现有方法只建模语义相似度。InsightEmb 仅用数学推理数据训练，学习面向进展的可迁移检索几何，在动态智能体任务和静态技能检索基准上无需环境特定训练即优于现有推理嵌入模型。
Motivation: 自改进智能体会从过往轨迹中积累可复用洞察，检索这些洞察以转化为可执行的指导越来越重要；现有检索方法主要建模语义相似度，忽略了检索到的洞察是否解决智能体当前的决策瓶颈。
Method: InsightEmb 是一个对比嵌入框架，联合学习将具体情境与抽象启发式规则对齐，并对具有相似进展结构的推理轨迹进行聚类；训练只依赖数学推理数据，无需环境特定监督。
Result: 在动态智能体任务和静态技能检索基准上，无需任何环境特定训练，InsightEmb 在所有评估中均超越现有推理嵌入模型的性能。
Conclusion: 结果表明状态-洞察匹配的几何结构可以跨领域迁移，因此可以利用公开可得的推理数据进行有效训练，避免昂贵的环境特定监督。

papers.title: Trace, Verify, and Correct: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress, their spatial reasoning may still produce intermediate judgments inconsistent with the input image, allowing errors to propagate through the reasoning chain and affect the final answer. Existing methods mainly improve spatial reasoning through training or additional spatial information, without considering whether the reasoning process itself is faithful to the model input. Our study shows that unfaithful reasoning chains significantly reduce final-answer accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a modular and training-free framework for spatial reasoning verification and correction. The framework constructs a Spatial Evidence Graph (SEG), which associates atomic spatial evidence extracted from Chain-of-Thought reasoning with visual entities, spatial relations, source steps, and visual evidence. Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment (SERA) evaluates the reliability of visual evidence based on object existence, localization, and geometric measurements. The framework then identifies the earliest spatial evidence unit contradicted by reliable visual evidence and guides the original MLLM to revise the subsequent reasoning and final answer. Across 15 model-dataset settings, our method achieves an average accuracy of 68.94%, outperforming the compared baselines by 8.55 percentage points on average. Our code will be open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）空间推理中中间判断与输入图像不一致、错误沿推理链传播的问题，提出一个无需训练（training-free）的模块化框架。该框架构建空间证据图（SEG），将思维链（Chain-of-Thought）中提取的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤和视觉证据关联，并通过空间证据可靠性评估（SERA）基于物体存在性、定位和几何测量检验视觉证据，定位最早被可靠证据反驳的空间证据单元后引导原模型修正后续推理与最终答案。在15个模型-数据集设定上平均准确率为68.94%，平均超出对比基线8.55个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法主要通过训练或引入额外空间信息来提升空间推理，未考虑推理过程本身是否忠实于模型输入；研究表明不忠实的推理链会显著降低最终答案准确率。
Method: 提出模块化、无需训练的验证与修正框架：先构建空间证据图（Spatial Evidence Graph, SEG），将思维链中的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤和视觉证据关联；再由空间证据可靠性评估（Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment, SERA）基于物体存在性、定位和几何测量评估视觉证据可靠性；找到与可靠视觉证据矛盾的最早空间证据单元后，引导原始MLLM修订后续推理和最终答案。
Result: 在15个模型-数据集设定上，该方法平均准确率达到68.94%，平均比对比基线高出8.55个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过验证视觉证据并修正最早被反驳的空间证据单元，可以提升MLLM空间推理对输入的忠实度与最终答案准确率；代码将开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出模块化、无需训练的验证与修正框架：先构建空间证据图（Spatial Evidence Graph, SEG），将思维链中的原子空间证据与视觉实体、空间关系、来源步骤和视觉证据关联；再由空间证据可靠性评估（Spatial Evidence Reliability Assessment, SERA）基于物体存在性、定位和几何测量评估视觉证据可靠性；找到与可靠视觉证据矛盾的最早空间证据单元后，引导原始MLLM修订后续推理和最终答案。
summary_sections.result: 在15个模型-数据集设定上，该方法平均准确率达到68.94%，平均比对比基线高出8.55个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过验证视觉证据并修正最早被反驳的空间证据单元，可以提升MLLM空间推理对输入的忠实度与最终答案准确率；代码将开源。

papers.title: PURPOSE: Poisoning Conflict Resolution in RAG via Proxy-Fact-Grounded Updates
papers.abstract_en: In Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), post-retrieval conflict resolution arbitrates among noisy or contradictory retrieved passages. However, the robustness of this safeguard against knowledge poisoning has not been adequately studied. Existing black-box poisoning methods all assert the target answer in frontal contradiction with what the resolver treats as settled, the very signal these methods are built to detect. We propose PURPOSE, a strict black-box poisoning attack that reframes the injection as an update that minimizes conflict, rather than as a counter-claim. PURPOSE extracts query-related facts approximating the resolver's possible reference, then grounds a pivot event in them to keep the injection consistent with what the resolver might verify while steering the generator toward the target answer. Across three QA benchmarks, five generators, and three conflict-resolution methods, PURPOSE attains the highest attack success rate (ASR) in 35 of 45 settings and exceeds the strongest prior attack with +9.7 mean ASR points. These results show that our poisoning method is effective against conflict resolution in RAG and identify non-contradicting injection as a practical mode to enhance poisoning attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PURPOSE，一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）中检索后冲突消解（post-retrieval conflict resolution）机制的严格黑盒投毒攻击。与现有方法正面断言目标答案、与消解器已认定的信号直接冲突不同，PURPOSE 将注入重构为最小化冲突的更新：先抽取与查询相关的事实来近似消解器可能的参考，再将一个枢轴事件（pivot event）锚定在这些事实上，使注入内容与消解器可能验证的信息保持一致，同时把生成器引向目标答案。在三个 QA 基准、五个生成器和三种冲突消解方法上，PURPOSE 在 35/45 个设置中取得最高攻击成功率（ASR），并比此前最强攻击平均高出 9.7 个 ASR 点。
Motivation: RAG 中检索后冲突消解被用作对抗噪声或矛盾检索片段的防线，但其对知识投毒（knowledge poisoning）的鲁棒性研究不足。现有黑盒投毒方法都在正面反驳消解器已认定的内容，而这恰恰是消解器设计用来检测的信号，因此容易被识别。
Method: PURPOSE 是一种严格黑盒投毒攻击，它将投毒注入重新表述为冲突最小化更新而非反断言。该方法提取与查询相关的事实以近似消解器可能的参考，并将枢轴事件锚定在这些事实上，使注入内容与消解器可能验证的信息一致，同时引导生成器输出目标答案。
Result: 在三个 QA 基准、五个生成器和三种冲突消解方法的组合下，PURPOSE 在 35 个设置（共 45 个）中达到最高 ASR，并相对此前最强攻击平均提升 9.7 个 ASR 点。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明该投毒方法能有效对抗 RAG 中的冲突消解，并指出非矛盾式注入（non-contradicting injection）是增强投毒攻击的一种实用模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Attention, Anomalies! Handling Attention Layers in Unsupervised Federated Outlier Detection
papers.abstract_en: Attention layers are the backbone of today's most powerful and impactful models. Models with multi-million and billion parameters rely on contextual knowledge provided by attention layers. However, their use goes well beyond just being the core component of large language models. One particularly interesting application is in Memory Augmented Autoencoders (MemAE), specifically for unsupervised representation learning in outlier detection tasks. It was shown that attention helps these models be more effective in centralized learning scenarios. Our work aims to address the lack of specialized aggregation techniques in Federated Learning (FL) when it comes to MemAE models. In this paper we analyze the intricacies of the architecture behind Memory Augmented Autoencoders, and propose novel, guided approaches to effectively aggregate these models in federated scenarios. We demonstrate our approach on non-IID datasets and show that these novel aggregation schemes are more robust when dealing with numerous edge nodes in environments with unbalanced datasets, specifically for unsupervised anomaly detection scenarios. This approach improves the performance of even very shallow autoencoders, allowing them to be used in resource constrained environments.
papers.comment: Submitted to the 4th IEEE International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习（Federated Learning）中 Memory Augmented Autoencoders (MemAE) 缺乏专门聚合技术的问题，分析其注意力层架构，并提出新的引导式（guided）聚合方法来有效聚合这些模型。作者在非 IID 数据集上验证了该方法，表明在边缘节点众多、数据集不均衡的环境中聚合更鲁棒，尤其适用于无监督异常检测场景，且能提升很浅的自编码器性能以用于资源受限环境。
Motivation: 注意力层是 MemAE 在无监督表示学习和异常检测任务中有效性的关键，集中式学习场景已证明其优势，但联邦学习场景下缺乏针对 MemAE 模型的专门聚合技术。
Method: 剖析 Memory Augmented Autoencoders 的架构细节，提出新型引导式聚合方案，专门处理注意力层并用于联邦场景下的模型聚合。
Result: 在非 IID 数据集上的实验显示，所提聚合方案在处理大量边缘节点和不均衡数据集时更鲁棒，尤其针对无监督异常检测；即使很浅的自编码器也能获得性能提升，从而适用于资源受限环境。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了联邦学习中 MemAE 聚合技术的空白，改进的聚合方法可增强浅层自编码器在联邦异常检测任务中的可用性；摘要未报告具体数值或与基线的量化对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Pose Sensitivity in Splat-based Computed Tomography under Sparse-view Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: X-ray computed tomography (CT) reconstructs volumetric representations of objects from projection images obtained by transmitting X-rays through a target. Recent splat-based tomography, which represents a volume as a continuous distribution of 3D Gaussians, has demonstrated both high reconstruction quality and fast convergence in cone-beam sparse-view CT. However, when deployed in real CT systems with limited and non-uniform view distributions, we observe distinctive streak and strip artifacts that are far more pronounced than in conventional reconstruction methods. Through detailed analysis, we show that these artifacts primarily originate from pose inaccuracies in the acquisition geometry rather than from view sparsity itself. We revisit pose sensitivity in the splatting formulation and derive a stable gradient-based framework that jointly refines geometric parameters during reconstruction. Our study not only identifies how pose perturbations propagate through the differentiable projection operator but also reveals why splat-based CT is particularly vulnerable to geometric misalignment. The resulting formulation remains lightweight and easily integrable into existing pipelines while substantially improving reconstruction fidelity under real-world sparse-view conditions.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于3D高斯溅射（splat-based）的稀疏视图锥束CT重建中的姿态敏感性问题。作者发现，在真实CT系统有限的非均匀视角分布下，该方法会产生比传统重建方法更明显的条状伪影，并通过分析指出这些伪影主要源于采集几何中的姿态不准确而非视角稀疏本身。他们推导了一个稳定的基于梯度的框架，在重建过程中联合细化几何参数，并揭示了姿态扰动如何通过可微投影算子传播以及溅射CT为何对几何错位特别脆弱。
Motivation: splat-based CT在锥束稀疏视角重建中表现优异，但部署到真实CT系统时，有限的非均匀视角分布会引发远比传统方法严重的条状伪影，影响重建保真度。
Method: 通过详细分析定位伪影来源为采集几何的姿态误差，重新审视溅射公式中的姿态敏感性，并推导了一个轻量的、基于梯度的联合细化框架，在重建过程中同时优化几何参数。
Result: 摘要称所提框架能显著提升真实稀疏视角条件下的重建保真度，且易于集成到现有流程中，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 研究表明溅射CT对几何错位尤为敏感，联合细化几何参数的梯度框架可有效地缓解该问题，且保持轻量化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simile Understanding in Text-to-Image Models: An Evaluation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Similes provide a compact and expressive way to describe visual characteristics in text prompts. Recent text-to-image models (t2i models) can produce visually compelling outputs from simile prompts, yet even frontier models frequently misinterpret the metaphorical vehicle and confuse it with the object. These systematic failures reveal a gap between figurative language and object-level visual grounding in t2i models. To investigate this issue, we propose a scalable evaluation framework for simile understanding. Our framework includes (1) a controlled simile dataset in which metaphorical vehicles are drawn from a predefined set of object-detectable categories and combined with diverse templates, (2) automatic grounding metrics based on YOLO (You Only Look Once) detection, and (3) text encoder layer analysis using Diffusion Lens to track how metaphorical vehicles emerge during generation. Experiments across architecturally diverse t2i models reveal consistent literalization failure patterns. We further discuss potential mitigation strategies for improving simile grounding in t2i models.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper at ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展的明喻（simile）理解评估框架，用于检验文生图（text-to-image）模型能否把比喻表达中的喻体（metaphorical vehicle）映射到正确的视觉对象。框架包含受控明喻数据集、基于 YOLO 检测的自动定位指标，以及用 Diffusion Lens 分析的文本编码器层工具。实验显示架构多样的 t2i 模型存在一致的"字面化"（literalization）失败模式，即把喻体误当作目标对象。
Motivation: 前沿 t2i 模型在明喻提示下经常误读隐喻喻体并将其与描述对象混淆，说明模型在比喻语言与对象级视觉定位之间存在系统性能力缺口。
Method: 提出评估框架，包括三部分：从预定义的对象可检测类别中抽取喻体并搭配多样模板生成受控明喻数据集；基于 YOLO 检测的自动定位指标；利用 Diffusion Lens 分析文本编码器各层，追踪喻体在生成过程中的涌现方式。
Result: 在架构多样的 t2i 模型上的实验揭示出一致的字面化失败模式，即模型倾向于把喻体当作字面对象来处理。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了改善 t2i 模型明喻定位能力的潜在缓解策略。摘要未报告具体数值结果或基准对比。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EviGraph: Evidence-Guided Autonomous Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research agents can generate hypotheses, execute experiments, and draft manuscripts, yet their outputs often contain unsupported claims and inconsistencies between research questions, experiments, results, and conclusions. We argue that this problem is partly architectural: existing systems organize research as sequential pipelines but do not explicitly maintain or validate the evolving claim-evidence structure across stages.In this paper, we introduce EviGraph, an autonomous research framework that represents the research process as a typed evidence graph containing Problem, Gap, Hypothesis, Experiment, Finding, and Claim nodes. The graph serves as the operational state of the agent rather than a post-hoc record. EviGraph inspects evidence chains for missing dependencies, semantic misalignment, and result-claim inconsistencies, localizes the earliest weak node, and regenerates its affected downstream subgraph. Graph checkpointing prevents unsuccessful repairs from corrupting previously validated evidence. Manuscripts are generated only after every retained claim is grounded in a validated evidence chain.Experiments on ARC-Bench-ML and NanoResearch-20 show that EviGraph outperforms the compared end-to-end research-agent baselines in overall research performance, improves Claim Support Rate by 40.19% over the strongest baseline, and achieves 87.73% Experimental Data Consistency. These results demonstrate the value of explicit evidence-state maintenance for reliable autonomous research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviGraph 是一个自主研究代理框架，将研究过程表示为由 Problem、Gap、Hypothesis、Experiment、Finding、Claim 节点组成的有类型证据图，并以此作为代理的运行状态而非事后记录。框架通过检查证据链中的缺失依赖、语义错位和结果-声明不一致来定位最早的薄弱节点，并重新生成受影响的下游子图；只有每条保留的声明都基于经过验证的证据链，才生成稿件。在 ARC-Bench-ML 和 NanoResearch-20 上，EviGraph 在整体研究性能上优于端到端研究代理基线，Claim Support Rate 比最强基线提升 40.19%，Experimental Data Consistency 达到 87.73%。
Motivation: 现有的自主研究代理常产生无支撑的主张，以及研究问题、实验、结果与结论之间的不一致；作者认为这在架构上源于现有系统将研究组织为顺序流水线，而未跨阶段显式维护和验证不断演化的声明-证据结构。
Method: 提出 EviGraph，将研究过程建模为包含六类节点的类型化证据图，并让该图作为代理的操作状态；代理检查证据链的缺失依赖、语义错位和结果-声明不一致，定位最早的薄弱节点，再生其受影响的下游子图，并通过图检查点防止失败的修复破坏已验证证据；仅在所有保留声明均被验证证据链支持后才生成稿件。

papers.title: Dense Metric Depth Completion from Sparse Direct Time-of-Flight Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Direct Time-of-Flight (dToF) sensors provide highly accurate metric depth and are more robust than indirect ToF systems in challenging real-world conditions. However, their high manufacturing cost and limited photodiode array size produce depth maps that are extremely sparse, low-resolution, and noisy, making them unsuitable for VR/XR, robotics, and 3D perception tasks that require dense metric depth. Existing monocular and depth completion methods struggle to handle the unique sampling patterns and hardware artifacts of dToF devices, and their performance often deteriorates significantly under severe sparsity or noise. We present a generalizable framework for dense metric depth completion from sparse dToF measurements, capable of operating across diverse sensor types, sparsity levels, and noise conditions. Our model employs a depth-guided dual-branch Vision Transformer encoder that processes RGB images and sparse dToF measurements separately, while a masked joint attention module allows depth tokens to reliably guide image features without being overwritten by them. A lightweight decoder reconstructs dense metric depth efficiently, without diffusion-based or refinement-heavy post-processing. To address the scarcity of paired training data, we introduce a comprehensive dToF simulation pipeline that reproduces the characteristics of flash, sub-VGA flash, and rotating sensors, including hardware-induced degradation, irregular sparsity, and realistic noise distributions. Trained entirely on synthetic data, our model achieves strong zero-shot generalization across 6 datasets and 3 real dToF devices, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and computational efficiency. This establishes a robust and practical solution for dense metric depth completion from sparse direct ToF sensors. Our code and models are open-sourced. See https://vclab.kaist.ac.kr/cvpr2026p3.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向稀疏直接飞行时间 (dToF) 传感器的稠密度量深度补全框架，用深度引导的双分支 Vision Transformer 编码器分别处理 RGB 图像和稀疏 dToF 测量，并通过掩码联合注意力模块让深度 token 引导图像特征。模型在纯合成数据上训练，无需扩散或精细后处理，即可在 6 个数据集和 3 种真实 dToF 设备上实现零样本泛化，兼顾精度与计算效率。
Motivation: dToF 传感器能提供高精度度量深度，但制造成本高且光电二极管阵列有限，导致深度图极度稀疏、低分辨率且带噪声，难以直接用于 VR/XR、机器人和 3D 感知。现有单目和深度补全方法无法应对 dToF 特有的采样模式与硬件伪影，在严重稀疏或噪声下性能明显下降。
Method: 提出一个可泛化的稀疏 dToF 深度补全框架，采用深度引导的双分支 Vision Transformer 编码器分离处理 RGB 与稀疏 dToF 数据，掩码联合注意力机制让深度 token 可靠引导图像特征；轻量解码器直接重建稠密度量深度，避免扩散或重后处理。作者还引入 dToF 仿真 pipeline，复现 flash、sub-VGA flash 和旋转传感器的硬件退化、不规则稀疏性与噪声分布。
Result: 摘要报告模型仅用合成数据训练，即在 6 个数据集和 3 个真实 dToF 设备上取得强零样本泛化，并在精度与计算效率上超过现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为稀疏直接 ToF 传感器的稠密度量深度补全提供了稳健且实用的解决方案，并开源代码与模型。

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Can Be Unreliable in Implicit-Influence Settings
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is increasingly treated as an important safety layer for frontier reasoning models. Most monitorability evaluations study explicit-influence settings: setups where the prompt directly incentivizes the model to hide something, e.g., by instructing it to perform a hidden side-task. A complementary axis for CoT-monitor evaluations is implicit-influence settings, where the prompt contains no instruction to hide, but the model's behavior is still shaped by features of the task or context, e.g. an irrelevant detail about a candidate that biases a hiring rating. We introduce the first benchmark that directly compares CoT monitorability under the two regimes. We test how model behavior changes in the presence of a nudge to choose a particular option. The nudge is delivered either as a casual aside (implicit), or as a direct instruction to act on the nudge and to conceal having done so (explicit). The benchmark spans four task formats (binary choice, numeric rating, multiple-choice QA, open-ended coding) and seven frontier extended-thinking models. Under explicit influence, a CoT monitor detects 60-94% of behavior shifts: even models instructed to conceal it leak the instruction into their CoT. Under implicit influence, the same factors still shift behavior, but detection falls by 41-46 percentage points in two of our four settings. Realistic system-prompt additions (of the kind a developer might deploy to reduce off-topic bias) lower implicit detection further, to as low as 5%, while preserving the behavioral influence itself. These results suggest that monitorability estimates obtained in explicit-influence settings may over-estimate monitorability, and that monitorability can be further decreased by well-intentioned deployment choices. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/agatha-duzan/implicit-vs-explicit-influence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出第一个直接比较显式影响 (explicit-influence) 与隐式影响 (implicit-influence) 设置下 CoT 监控 (chain-of-thought monitoring) 可靠性的基准，覆盖四种任务格式和七个前沿 extended-thinking 模型。结果显示，在显式影响下 CoT 监控能检测 60-94% 的行为偏移，而在隐式影响下检测率在两个设置中下降 41-46 个百分点；添加常见的系统提示后检测率最低降至 5%，但行为影响依然存在。作者认为显式影响设置可能高估监控能力。
Motivation: 现有 CoT 可监控性评估大多针对显式影响设置，即提示直接指示模型隐藏行为，但现实部署中提示往往不包含隐藏指令，模型行为仍会受任务或上下文特征影响，这一互补维度缺乏直接比较的基准。
Method: 构建一个基准，以 casual aside（隐式）或直接指令并要求隐瞒（显式）两种方式施加选择特定选项的 nudge，在二元选择、数值评分、多项选择问答和开放式编程四种任务格式及七个模型上对比行为变化与 CoT 监控的检测表现，并测试类似开发者部署的 system-prompt 添加对检测的影响。
Result: 显式影响下 CoT 监控检测到 60-94% 的行为偏移，即使模型被指示隐瞒也会把指令泄露到推理中；隐式影响下行为仍被改变，但四个设置中有两个检测率下降 41-46 个百分点，现实系统提示添加使最低检测率降至 5% 且不消除行为影响。
Conclusion: 在显式影响设置中获得的监控能力估计可能高估真实可监控性，且善意部署选择（如减少离题偏差的系统提示）可能进一步降低 CoT 监控的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Integrating Adaptive Experience Replay and Online Uncertainty Estimation in Safe Actor-Critic Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Safe actor-critic control often treats barrier filtering, uncertainty estimation, and experience replay as separate modules, even though each changes the data used for learning and control. We develop an integrated architecture in which the uncertainty estimate updates the obstacle geometry used by a control barrier function, filter interventions and estimation residuals determine replay priority, and the critic learns from the executed rather than nominal action. We instantiate the architecture on a two-dimensional robot-navigation task with corrupted obstacle measurements and compare six component-matched configurations under common training budgets, random seeds, sensor streams, exploration, and disturbances. Evaluation includes a moderate post-training test, an eleven-level perception-noise sweep, and an exploratory extreme-stress test at multiplier $6.0$. In the extreme test, the integrated configuration recorded no contacts and reached the goal in all five evaluation seeds. Its mean cost was $7.63\pm0.44$ and its obstacle-belief root-mean-square error was $3.52\pm0.55$ cm. The uncertainty-estimation ablation also recorded no contacts but reached the goal in four of five seeds, with mean cost $8.96\pm2.08$ and belief error $11.08\pm1.23$ cm. A finite-training bound clarifies replay exposure, and a robust barrier condition states the required estimation-error and feasibility assumptions. The results support coupling estimation, safety filtering, and replay on this benchmark; broader safety and convergence claims require further study.
papers.comment: Code, deterministic seeds, data, figures, and protocol files are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21515850 and https://github.com/SDNT8810/safe-actor-critic-aer-ue-reproducibility
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对安全actor-critic控制中障碍滤波、不确定性估计与经验回放被割裂处理的问题，提出一种集成架构：不确定性估计用于更新控制障碍函数中的障碍物几何，滤波干预与估计残差决定回放优先级，critic 学习的是实际执行动作而非名义动作。作者在含损坏障碍物测量的二维机器人导航任务上，用六个组件匹配配置在共同训练预算、随机种子、传感器流、探索和扰动下进行比较。极端压力测试（乘数6.0）中，集成配置在所有五个评估种子中均无接触并到达目标，平均代价7.63±0.44，障碍信念RMSE 3.52±0.55 cm；去掉不确定性估计的消融也无接触但仅四/五种子到达目标，代价8.96±2.08，信念误差11.08±1.23 cm。文中还给出有限训练界与鲁棒障碍条件，结论是此基准支持耦合估计、安全滤波与回放，但更广泛的安全与收敛声明需进一步研究。
Motivation: 安全actor-critic控制通常把屏障滤波、不确定性估计和经验回放当作独立模块处理，而每个模块都会改变学习与控制所用的数据，这种割裂可能损害整体安全性与样本效率。
Method: 提出集成架构：不确定性估计实时更新控制障碍函数（control barrier function）中的障碍物几何；用滤波干预和估计残差决定经验回放优先级；critic 从实际执行动作而非名义动作中学习。该架构在二维机器人导航任务上实例化，并与其余组件匹配配置比较，评估包含适度训练后测试、十一级感知噪声扫描以及极端压力测试。
Result: 在极端压力测试（乘数6.0）中，集成配置无接触并在全部五个评估种子到达目标，平均代价7.63±0.44，障碍信念RMSE 3.52±0.55 cm；不确定性估计消融亦无接触但仅四/五种子到达目标，平均代价8.96±2.08，信念误差11.08±1.23 cm。同时导出了有限训练界和鲁棒障碍条件，后者明确了所需估计误差与可行性假设。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持在该基准上耦合估计、安全滤波与经验回放，但明确指出更广泛的安全与收敛保证仍需进一步研究，即结论的范围限于当前机器人导航基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Prompts Become Pixels: Prompt-Region Grounding for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models increasingly reason over screenshots and documents where the task itself may be written in pixels. Yet benchmarks usually place questions in text, leaving it unclear whether models use the same instruction equally well across channels. We introduce Visualized Task Semantics (VTS), a controlled intervention that moves the question into the image while keeping the source problem and answer fixed. Across six MLLMs and four benchmarks, accuracy drops in all 24 model-task pairs, by 17.8 points on average. Models often transcribe the visual question correctly yet fail to use it, exposing a semantic channel gap beyond OCR. To reduce this gap, we present prompt-region grounding, whose core design aligns the question region with typed semantics and recovers its clean representation from a masked view. At matched training cost, our method raises four-benchmark VTS accuracy from 58.0 to 66.3 while preserving accuracy on the original interface, and requires no OCR or region metadata at inference. Reading task-bearing text and grounding it as an instruction for reasoning are distinct capabilities.

papers.title: A GitOps-Driven Annotation Catalog for Fully Automatic Railway Operations
papers.abstract_en: Automatic train operation (ATO) at grade of automation 3 and above (GoA3-GoA4) requires robust AI-based perception systems capable of reliably detecting obstacles and railway-specific objects under real-world conditions. The effectiveness of these modern artificial intelligence approaches depends heavily on large-scale, high-quality, and highly dynamic annotated datasets. However, managing metadata, maintaining provenance, and tracking the iterative evolution of these annotations impose significant infrastructural and regulatory requirements. Existing monolithic data catalogs often suffer from massive operational overhead, poor integration into developer workflows, and severe documentation drift. This paper introduces an innovative, lightweight GitOps-based architecture for metadata management. By leveraging Data-as-Code principles, Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and Static Site Generation (SSG), the proposed approach establishes a seamless, developer-centric workflow. This ensures an traceability, enforces strict regulatory compliance, and automatically generates a highly performant dataset overview.
papers.journal_ref: 16th International Conference on Advanced Computer Information Technologies in Zlín, Czech Republic, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向轨道交通全自动运行（GoA3-GoA4）场景，提出一种基于 GitOps 的轻量级标注元数据管理架构，用于管理铁路感知数据集的大规模标注、来源追溯和迭代演进。方法结合 Data-as-Code、CI/CD 流水线与静态站点生成（SSG），构建开发者友好的数据集管理流程，并自动生成高性能的数据集概览。
Motivation: ATO 中基于 AI 的感知系统依赖大规模、高质量且动态更新的标注数据，但现有单体式数据目录存在运营开销大、与开发者工作流集成差以及文档漂移严重等问题，难以满足可追溯性和监管合规要求。
Method: 提出基于 GitOps 的元数据管理架构，利用 Data-as-Code 原则将标注元数据视为代码，通过 CI/CD 流水线进行版本化和自动化处理，并使用静态站点生成技术自动产出数据集概览页面。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要从架构层面说明该方法能实现可追溯性、强制监管合规并自动生成高效的数据集概览。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GitOps 驱动的标注编目架构可以替代传统单体数据目录，在满足铁路自动驾驶监管要求的同时改善开发者工作流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-View Face and Gesture Animation with Dynamic Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Creating photorealistic 3D human avatars with realistic upper-body motion remains challenging. Existing approaches either focus on the head and overlook hand gestures, or reconstruct the full body but fail to preserve fine-grained facial fidelity and hand pose accuracy. As a result, current methods struggle to capture the subtle dynamics of facial expressions and hand gestures that are crucial for natural human communication. While methods based on full-body parametric models enable avatar reconstruction from monocular or multi-view inputs, they often lack accurate facial animation and detailed hand articulation. To address these limitations, we propose MVFGA, a novel multi-view-consistent pipeline for generating realistic upper-body avatars. Our approach models the face and hands separately and fuses them with a parametric upper-body mesh model, enabling the capture of fine-grained facial expressions and hand poses for accurate upper-body avatar reconstruction. We then splat 3D Gaussians onto the obtained mesh, enabling high-quality rendering of dynamic avatars from novel viewpoints. Furthermore, we introduce MVFGA-MoCap, a multi-view upper-body motion capture dataset featuring controlled facial expression sequences, diverse hand gestures, and free-form communication. Experiments show that MVFGA generates visually realistic avatars with high-fidelity facial expressions and hand motions, outperforming baselines for upper-body avatar animation. Project page: https://dfki-av.github.io/MVFGA/
papers.journal_ref: Computer Graphics Forum, 45(8), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MVFGA，一种多视图一致的上半身虚拟化身生成管线：将人脸与手部分开建模，再与参数化上半身网格融合，并将 3D 高斯泼溅到网格上以支持新视角高质量渲染。作者还发布了 MVFGA-MoCap 多视图动作捕捉数据集，包含受控面部表情序列、多样化手势与自由交流动作。摘要报告该方法在面部表情和手部运动保真度上优于现有上半身化身动画基线。
Motivation: 现有方法要么只关注头部而忽略手势，要么重建全身但难以保持精细的面部保真度和手部姿态精度；基于全身参数模型的方法也缺乏准确的面部动画和精细的手部关节表达。
Method: MVFGA 将面部和手部分别建模，并与参数化上半身网格融合，捕获细粒度面部表情和手部姿态；随后将 3D 高斯泼溅到所得网格上，实现从新视角渲染动态化身。
Result: 实验表明 MVFGA 生成的化身视觉逼真，面部表情与手部运动保真度高，在上半身化身动画任务上优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分离建模面部与手部并融合参数化上半身网格，能够捕捉自然交流中关键的面部与手势细微动态。

papers.title: YOLOv14:Unified Cross-Domain Real-Time Object Detectionwith Adaptive Multi-View Representation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time object detectors achieve remarkable accuracy under controlled conditions, yet degrade sharply on non-ideal inputs: fisheye distortion, game-rendered characters, aerial viewpoints, and 360° panoramas. We present YOLOv14, aunified detection framework addressing these challenges through four synergisticinnovations. (1) Deformable Area-Attention (D-AAttn) replaces rigid attentiongrids with learned 2D deformation fields, enabling adaptive sampling under geometric distortion. (2) Game2Real Domain Adaptation aligns rendered-game and photographic feature distributions via Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN)and adversarial domain confusion, allowing game characters are detected as realhumans. (3) Multi-View Conditioning injects learned viewpoint embeddings intothe backbone with a cross-view contrastive loss that pulls same-class features fromdifferent perspectives closer. (4) An Adaptive Augmentation Policy automaticallyclassifies each input' scene type and routes to optimal augmentations, while a DynamicScaleRouter learns per-input feature pyramid weights. Together, YOLOv14achieves 49.1 mAP on COCO val2017 at 2.91 ms (T4 GPU), and delivers substantial gains on fisheye (+4.1 mAP), panorama (+6.6 mAP), drone (+6.4 mAP), andgame-character (+26.1 mAP) benchmarks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: YOLOv14 提出一个统一的跨域实时目标检测框架，通过四项协同设计应对鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染、航拍视角和 360° 全景等非理想输入。四项创新包括可变形区域注意力 (Deformable Area-Attention, D-AAttn)、基于 AdaIN 与对抗域混淆的 Game2Real 域自适应、多视角条件注入与跨视角对比损失，以及自适应增强策略和动态尺度路由。摘要报告在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP、T4 GPU 上 2.91 ms，并在鱼眼、全景、无人机和游戏角色基准上分别提升 4.1、6.6、6.4 和 26.1 mAP。
Motivation: 现有实时检测器在受控条件下精度高，但在鱼眼畸变、游戏渲染、航拍视角和全景图像等非理想输入上性能急剧下降，缺少统一处理这些跨域场景的检测框架。
Method: 提出四个协同组件：可变形区域注意力用学习到的 2D 变形场替代刚性注意力网格；Game2Real 域自适应通过 Adaptive Instance Normalization (AdaIN) 和对抗域混淆对齐渲染游戏与真实照片的特征分布；多视角条件注入将学习的视角嵌入加入骨干网络，并用跨视角对比损失拉近不同视角下同类特征；自适应增强策略自动分类输入场景并路由到最优增强，Dynamic Scale Router 学习逐输入的特征金字塔权重。
Result: 摘要报告 YOLOv14 在 COCO val2017 上达到 49.1 mAP，T4 GPU 推理耗时 2.91 ms；在鱼眼 (+4.1 mAP)、全景 (+6.6 mAP)、无人机 (+6.4 mAP) 和游戏角色 (+26.1 mAP) 基准上均带来显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调四项创新共同构成统一跨域实时检测框架，能够在不牺牲 COCO 精度的前提下显著改善多种非理想输入下的检测表现。

papers.title: Diagnosing Tool-Selection Reasoning in LLM Agents with Canary Tools
papers.abstract_en: Agent evaluations tell us that a model picked the wrong tool, but rarely why. We introduce canary tools: diagnostic probe tools planted in an agent's Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool set, each engineered to probe one specific tool-selection weakness. A six-type taxonomy (semantic decoys, parameter traps, capability mirages, prerequisite blindness, temporal decoys, and granularity traps) turns a single "wrong tool" outcome into a multi-dimensional profile of how a model reasons about tools. We evaluate eight models -- six hosted and two 8B open-weight -- spanning three capability tiers, on 120 tasks across three canary-density conditions and three seeds (8,640 runs), plus a 2,880-run subtlety ablation. Task success is graded by a provider-independent judge, corroborated by a second independent judge (Cohen's kappa = 0.75). We report three findings. First, susceptibility drops sharply as models get more capable: the per-task canary susceptibility rate (CSR) ranges about 36x across models, lowest for Claude Opus 4.8 and highest for Llama 3.1 8B. Second, capability tier alone does not predict safety: the most susceptible hosted model is mid-tier, and within a provider the cheaper model can be the safer one. Third, the taxonomy is capability-stratified: capability mirages most reliably trap frontier models, while the other types are largely inert on strong models but fire on small open models, so they discriminate by capability rather than being weak. Softening each canary's give-away phrase leaves frontier CSR essentially unchanged, evidence that the probes measure reasoning, not phrase-spotting. Susceptibility also predicts task failure (Spearman rho = -0.34), while the most robust models are not significantly degraded by canary pressure. We release the framework, canary schemas, tasks, and logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 canary tools（金丝雀工具）这一诊断方法，在 LLM 智能体的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 工具集中植入针对性探针工具，用于定位工具选择推理的具体失败模式。作者定义六类工具选择弱点（semantic decoys、parameter traps、capability mirages、prerequisite blindness、temporal decoys、granularity traps），并用 8 个模型、120 个任务、三种 canary 密度条件和三个随机种子（8,640 次运行）进行评测。结果显示模型能力越强越不容易被 canary 捕获，但能力层级本身不能 predict 安全性；同一 provider 内更便宜的模型可能更安全。
Motivation: 现有智能体评测只能告诉研究者模型选错了工具，却无法解释选错的原因。作者希望把单一的“工具选择错误”结果转成多维度的推理弱点画像，以便更细粒度地理解模型如何对工具进行推理。
Method: 设计六类 canary tools，每类专门探测一种工具选择推理缺陷，植入 MCP 工具集中；任务成功率由 provider 无关的 judge 评判，并用第二个独立 judge 佐证（Cohen's kappa = 0.75）。评测覆盖 6 个托管模型和 2 个 8B 开源权重模型，横跨三个能力层级。
Result: 逐任务 canary 易感率（CSR）在模型间相差约 36 倍，最低为 Claude Opus 4.8，最高为 Llama 3.1 8B；最易感的托管模型反而是中端模型。capability mirages 最容易捕获前沿模型，其余类型对强模型基本不生效但会对小模型触发。弱化每个 canary 的提示性短语后前沿模型 CSR 基本不变，说明探针测的是推理而非短语匹配；CSR 与任务失败呈 Spearman rho = -0.34。
Conclusion: 作者认为 canary tools 衡量的是工具推理能力而非表面模式匹配，且最鲁棒的模型不会因 canary 压力而显著退化；研究公开了框架、canary schema、任务和日志。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有智能体评测只能告诉研究者模型选错了工具，却无法解释选错的原因。作者希望把单一的“工具选择错误”结果转成多维度的推理弱点画像，以便更细粒度地理解模型如何对工具进行推理。
summary_sections.method: 设计六类 canary tools，每类专门探测一种工具选择推理缺陷，植入 MCP 工具集中；任务成功率由 provider 无关的 judge 评判，并用第二个独立 judge 佐证（Cohen's kappa = 0.75）。评测覆盖 6 个托管模型和 2 个 8B 开源权重模型，横跨三个能力层级。
summary_sections.result: 逐任务 canary 易感率（CSR）在模型间相差约 36 倍，最低为 Claude Opus 4.8，最高为 Llama 3.1 8B；最易感的托管模型反而是中端模型。capability mirages 最容易捕获前沿模型，其余类型对强模型基本不生效但会对小模型触发。弱化每个 canary 的提示性短语后前沿模型 CSR 基本不变，说明探针测的是推理而非短语匹配；CSR 与任务失败呈 Spearman rho = -0.34。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 canary tools 衡量的是工具推理能力而非表面模式匹配，且最鲁棒的模型不会因 canary 压力而显著退化；研究公开了框架、canary schema、任务和日志。

papers.title: What We Observe as LLM Behavior Can Be a Side-effect of Inference Backend
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark scores are reported as properties of a model, yet the inference framework used to produce them, such as HuggingFace, vLLM, or Ollama, are considered non-influential and their names and versions are almost never disclosed. In this work we investigate how much this choice can influence the model output. In a fully-crossed study (three instruction-tuned models x five inference frameworks x six benchmarks x four generation modes) we investigate how different tools (wrappers/backend) influence benchmark scores and how their score changes is influenced by generation hyper-parameters. We find backend to be a non-negligible factor where even under greedy, sampling-noise-free decoding, changing the backend can significantly alter models performance and this effect is structural and strongly model-dependent. Decomposing the variance according to generation mode reveal that considerable portion of the variability (roughly 39\%) a practitioner sees out-of-the-box can stem from the backend, while the remaining stems from sampling noise and each framework's default generation parameters, both of which are avoidable by disclosing and matching the generation configuration. These divergences are more pronounced on factual than on social-bias benchmarks. Overall, benchmark numbers are not backend-agnostic therefore, we recommend disclosing the backend, its version, and the full generation configuration, also using deterministic decoding for cross-backend comparison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理后端（如 HuggingFace、vLLM、Ollama）对 LLM 基准分数的影响，在三个指令微调模型、五个推理框架、六个基准和四种生成模式的完全交叉设计中展开实验。摘要发现后端是一个不可忽略的因素，即使在贪婪解码下更换后端也会显著改变模型性能，且这种效应具有结构性和强模型依赖性。作者建议在报告基准结果时公开后端、版本以及完整生成配置，并在跨后端比较时使用确定性解码。
Motivation: 基准分数通常被当作模型本身的属性，但产生这些分数的推理框架被认为无影响，其名称和版本几乎不被披露。该论文旨在量化推理后端对模型输出和基准分数的影响程度。
Method: 采用完全交叉实验设计，组合三个指令微调模型、五个推理框架、六个基准和四种生成模式，分析后端工具（wrapper/backend）对分数的影响，并按生成模式对方差进行分解。
Result: 后端是显著影响因素，即使在贪婪、无采样噪声的解码下更换后端也会显著改变性能，且该效应具有结构性和模型依赖性；可归因于后端的方差约占 39%，其余来自采样噪声和框架默认生成参数。这些差异在事实性基准上比在社会偏见基准上更明显。
Conclusion: 基准分数并非与后端无关，因此建议披露后端及其版本和完整生成配置，并在跨后端比较时采用确定性解码，以避免将后端效应误归因于模型本身。

papers.title: A 6G Integrated Sensing and Communication Framework for Railway Intrusion Detection and Collision Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) combines sensing and communication to efficiently utilize wireless resources and is emerging as a key paradigm for next-generation wireless networks. By leveraging the wide bandwidth, high frequencies, and massive antenna arrays of 5G-Advanced and 6G systems, ISAC enables physical-layer sensing using Channel State Information (CSI). The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Release 19 identifies 32 potential ISAC use cases, with particular emphasis on detecting and tracking moving objects. In this work, we address the Sensing for Railway Intrusion Detection use case, where intruders, including wildlife, entering a railway track can pose serious collision risks. We generated 22,695 CSI matrices with corresponding ground truth using a 3D-rendered railway environment and the Sionna radio simulator. We developed a machine learning model combining a three-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network to detect intruders in the track danger zone and estimate their real-time position relative to the train, velocity, and time to collision. On synthetic CSI data, the model achieves 99.57% intruder-detection accuracy on a balanced test set and a combined Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.4240 for position, velocity, and time-to-collision prediction. These results demonstrate the potential of CSI-based ISAC sensing with machine learning for reliable railway intrusion detection. The complete codebase for CSI generation, preprocessing, and model development is publicly available at https://github.com/EdgeIntelligenceLab/6g-isac-railway-intrusion-detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 6G 集成传感与通信 (ISAC) 中的铁路入侵检测用例，利用信道状态信息 (CSI) 进行物理层感知。作者基于 3D 渲染铁路环境与 Sionna 仿真器生成 22,695 个 CSI 矩阵及真实标签，并开发了 3D CNN 与 BiLSTM 结合的机器学习模型，用于检测轨道危险区内的入侵者并估计其位置、速度与碰撞时间。在合成 CSI 数据上，模型在平衡测试集上达到 99.57% 的入侵检测准确率，位置、速度与时间到碰撞预测的合并 MAE 为 0.4240。
Motivation: 3GPP Release 19 列出了 32 个潜在 ISAC 用例，其中检测和跟踪移动物体受到重点关注；铁路入侵者（包括野生动物）进入轨道会带来严重碰撞风险，因此需要可靠的入侵检测方案。
Method: 利用 5G-Advanced 和 6G 的宽带宽、高频段和大规模天线阵列，通过 CSI 实现物理层感知；使用 Sionna 仿真器生成合成 CSI 数据集，并构建三维卷积神经网络 (3D CNN) 与双向长短期记忆网络 (BiLSTM) 的组合模型，同时完成入侵检测与实时位置、速度、碰撞时间估计。
Result: 在合成 CSI 数据的平衡测试集上，模型取得 99.57% 的入侵检测准确率；位置、速度和时间到碰撞预测的合并平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.4240。
Conclusion: 结果表明基于 CSI 的 ISAC 感知结合机器学习具备实现可靠铁路入侵检测的潜力；完整代码库已公开。

papers.title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Dense Event Classification of Offshore Wind Infrastructure in Sentinel-1 Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring of offshore wind energy infrastructure life cycles, especially during the deployment phase, is an important contribution for stakeholders to make informed decisions in a phase of increasing deployment activities. ESA's Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) mission produces large data archives that enable the global monitoring of offshore wind infrastructure. Turning these high-volume archives into information requires algorithms that automatically extract single event labels from dense time series at a global scale. In this study, we present a structured comparison of ten deep learning model-training variants for the dense classification of Sentinel-1 based offshore wind infrastructure time series, aiming to advance rule-based event classification of this task. We trained LSTM, Transformer, and fully connected model variants with monotemporal, unidirectional, and bidirectional context awareness, each with and without self-supervised pretraining. Among these, the supervised BiLSTM performs best, raising the target AUC score from 0.7853 for the rule-based baseline to 0.8509, and the perfect match rate from 0.3508 to 0.5063. Combining the BiLSTM predictions with the existing baseline labels in a label-transition-minimising ensemble further improves agreement with the test data. Using these improved labels, we isolate the deployment phase of individual turbines at a global scale and conduct a regional and subregional analysis covering 2016-01-01 to 2025-03-31, reporting median deployment durations of 84 d (China), 242 d (EU), and 258 d (UK). Deployment-related drivers, including legal regulations such as subsidies, and environmental conditions, emerge clearly from the analysed results across multiple spatial scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了十种深度学习模型变体，用于对 Sentinel-1 合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 时间序列中的海上风电基础设施进行密集事件分类，目标是推进该任务的基于规则的事件分类。有监督 BiLSTM 表现最佳，将目标 AUC 从规则基线的 0.7853 提升至 0.8509，完美匹配率从 0.3508 提升至 0.5063；将 BiLSTM 预测与既有基线标签结合为最小化标签转移的集成后，与测试数据的一致性进一步提升。基于改进后的标签，作者在全球尺度上识别出单个风机的部署阶段，并报告 2016-01-01 至 2025-03-31 期间中国、欧盟和英国的部署时长中位数分别为 84 天、242 天和 258 天。
Motivation: 海上风电基础设施生命周期（尤其是部署阶段）的监测有助于利益相关者在部署活动增加的背景下做出知情决策，而 Sentinel-1 SAR 任务积累的海量时间序列需要能在全球尺度上自动提取密集事件标签的算法。
Method: 训练了 LSTM、Transformer 和全连接模型变体，分别采用单时相 (monotemporal)、单向 (unidirectional) 和双向 (bidirectional) 上下文感知，每种变体再配合或不配合自监督预训练，共构成十种训练方案；此外还将 BiLSTM 预测与既有规则基线标签组合成标签转移最小化集成。
Result: 有监督 BiLSTM 为最佳单模型，目标 AUC 从 0.7853 提升至 0.8509，完美匹配率从 0.3508 提升至 0.5063；集成方案进一步改善与测试数据的一致性。基于改进标签的全球部署阶段分析显示，中国、欧盟和英国的部署时长中位数分别为 84 天、242 天和 258 天，补贴等法规和环境条件等部署驱动因素在多个空间尺度上清晰显现。
Conclusion: 作者认为有监督 BiLSTM 与标签转移最小化集成的组合能够显著超越基于规则的基线，并支撑全球及区域尺度的海上风电部署阶段分析。

papers.title: A Multi-Sensor Dataset for Monitoring the Operational Environment of Rail Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Reliable environment monitoring is essential for the safe and efficient operation of automated railway systems, covering all Grades of Automation (GoA), from partially automated (GoA2) to fully automated operation (GoA4). Artificial Intelligence (AI) plays a central role in enabling these systems to detect, classify, and react to potential hazards in real time. The development of such AI-based perception systems requires large volumes of accurately annotated data for training and validation. Within the Digitale Schiene Deutschland (DSD) program, DB InfraGO AG and understandAI GmbH have developed a comprehensive multi- sensor dataset tailored to the needs of railway environment perception. This dataset contains over 7 million high-quality annotations of both railway-specific and general perception objects, captured under varying operational scenarios. The finalized dataset can now be requested at the DB InfraGO AG and serve as a valuable resource for advancing AI-driven environment monitoring in the railway domain.
papers.journal_ref: 9th International Conference on Intelligent Traffic and Transportation, Amsterdam, Netherlands, September, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个面向铁路车辆运行环境监测的多传感器数据集，由 DB InfraGO AG 与 understandAI GmbH 在 Digitale Schiene Deutschland (DSD) 项目下开发。该数据集包含超过 700 万个高质量标注，涵盖铁路特定目标与通用感知目标，并在多种运行场景下采集，可服务于从 GoA2 到 GoA4 的自动化铁路感知系统训练与验证。数据集现已完成，可通过 DB InfraGO AG 申请获取。
Motivation: 自动化铁路系统（覆盖 GoA2 至 GoA4）的安全高效运行依赖可靠的环境监测，而基于 AI 的感知系统需要大量精确标注数据进行训练和验证；现有条件下缺乏面向铁路环境感知需求的大规模综合性多传感器数据集。
Method: 在 DSD 项目框架下，联合采集并标注了一个多传感器数据集，包含铁路特定和通用感知对象的超过 700 万个高质量标注，覆盖不同运行场景。
Result: 数据集已最终完成，包含超过 700 万个高质量标注，并已开放申请。
Conclusion: 该数据集可作为推进铁路领域 AI 环境监测研究的重要资源，但摘要未提及与降水、降雨或天气预测相关的内容。

papers.title: Design Choices That Matter: A Functional ANOVA Analysis for Remote Sensing Multi-Label Classification
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking deep learning (DL) models for multi-label classification (MLC) of remote sensing images (RSI) typically yields rankings that do not generalize beyond the evaluated datasets. In this work, we move beyond rankings by employing functional analysis of variance (fANOVA) to systematically quantify the contributions of individual design choices and their interactions to performance variability. We conduct two empirical analyses covering 48 and 20 DL models, respectively, spanning design choices such as network architecture, fine-tuning strategy, learning strategy, and initialization. By applying fANOVA across seven MLC RSI datasets, we construct dataset meta-representations that capture design-choice sensitivity profiles. Hierarchical clustering of these meta-representations reveals that datasets naturally group according to how they respond to design decisions, with patterns strongly linked to intrinsic dataset properties such as scale, spatial resolution, and label space complexity. Our findings show that for large-scale datasets, fine-tuning strategy and architecture are dominant factors, while in data-limited regimes, initialization becomes decisive. For intermediate regimes, the interaction between architecture and learning strategy governs performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像多标签分类（MLC）中深度学习模型基准排名难以跨数据集泛化的问题，采用功能方差分析（fANOVA）系统量化各设计选择及其交互作用对性能变异的影响。作者在分别覆盖48个和20个DL模型的两组实验中，考察网络架构、微调策略、学习策略和初始化等设计维度，并在七个MLC遥感数据集上构建描述设计选择敏感性轮廓的数据集元表征。对这些元表征做层次聚类后发现，数据集按其响应设计决策的方式自然分组，且该分组与尺度、空间分辨率和标签空间复杂度等内在属性密切相关。
Motivation: 遥感图像多标签分类的深度学习基准通常只给出排名，而这些排名无法推广到评测数据集之外；需要一种更系统的方法来量化不同设计选择对性能变异的贡献及其交互作用。
Method: 使用功能方差分析（fANOVA）对两组分别包含48个和20个DL模型的经验分析进行归因，覆盖网络架构、微调策略、学习策略和初始化等设计选择，并在七个MLC RSI数据集上构建反映设计选择敏感性轮廓的数据集元表征，再通过层次聚类揭示数据集间的关系。
Result: 对于大规模数据集，微调策略和架构是主导因素；在数据有限场景下，初始化起决定性作用；在中间规模场景，架构与学习策略的交互主导性能。数据集分组模式与尺度、空间分辨率、标签空间复杂度等内在属性密切相关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅依赖基准排名无法揭示设计选择的真实贡献，fANOVA结合数据集元表征可以刻画数据集对设计决策的响应模式，并指出不同数据规模区间由不同设计因素主导。

papers.title: UniWorld-View: Large-Baseline View Synthesis via Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The abundance of casually captured monocular videos and images on social media provides a valuable source for immersive content creation, where generating novel views from such sparse observations can greatly enhance user experiences. However, producing photorealistic and geometrically consistent views with precise camera control remains challenging when input coverage is extremely limited. Reconstruction-based approaches such as NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) deteriorate severely under sparse inputs and fail to explicitly handle occlusions. Generative methods ease data requirements but still struggle with large-baseline view synthesis due to inaccurate or implicit geometric guidance. To overcome these limitations, we introduce UniWorld-View, a unified framework for controllable large-baseline novel view synthesis from monocular inputs. UniWorld-View integrates explicit 3D guidance with generative diffusion modeling to enable precise camera control and geometrically consistent view generation. The geometric guidance is obtained through an occlusion-aware point cloud rendering strategy that resolves visibility ambiguities and provides accurate priors for diffusion-based synthesis. By coupling this rendering strategy with powerful video diffusion backbones, UniWorld-View achieves high-fidelity novel view generation even under extreme camera motions and wide-baseline changes, and can further provide multi-view videos for downstream dynamic 3DGS reconstruction. Experiments on the WorldScore benchmark and zero-shot NVS benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of UniWorld-View in controllability, geometric consistency, and visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniWorld-View，一个面向单目输入的可控大基线新视角合成统一框架，将显式 3D 引导与生成式扩散建模相结合。通过遮挡感知点云渲染策略解决可见性歧义并提供精确几何先验，配合视频扩散骨干，在极端相机运动与宽基线变化下仍能生成高保真新视图，并可输出多视角视频用于下游动态 3DGS 重建。实验在 WorldScore 基准和零样本 NVS 基准上验证了可控性、几何一致性与视觉保真度。
Motivation: 稀疏输入下 NeRF 和 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 等重建方法性能严重退化，且难以显式处理遮挡；生成式方法虽降低数据要求，但因几何引导不准确或隐式，仍难以应对大基线视图合成。
Method: 提出统一框架，集成显式 3D 引导与生成式扩散建模；其中通过遮挡感知点云渲染策略消除可见性歧义、为扩散合成提供准确先验，并与强大的视频扩散骨干相耦合。
Result: 在 WorldScore 基准和零样本 NVS 基准上的实验表明，该方法在可控性、几何一致性和视觉保真度方面有效；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在大基线、极端相机运动下保持高保真新视图生成，并可为动态 3DGS 重建提供多视角视频，体现出生成式与显式几何引导结合的潜力。

papers.title: Teaching MLLMs to Say No: Generalized Referring Expression Comprehension via Refusal Calibrated GRPO
papers.abstract_en: We tackle the challenging yet underexplored task of Generalized Referring Expression Comprehension (GREC), which requires a model to localize the object described by a textual expression when it exists (positive sample) and to refuse output when it does not (negative sample). Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at localizing existing objects, they often fail to reject nonexistent ones due to the absence of negative samples during training, producing hallucinated bounding boxes. Existing post-training approaches such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) enhance refusal behavior but usually degrade localization accuracy on positive samples, undermining the model's core competence. To address this, we propose Refusal-Calibrated Group Relative Policy Optimization (RC-GRPO), a calibrated RL strategy that strengthens the refusal ability of MLLMs while preserving localization performance. It enforces "None" outputs in rollouts for valid advantage estimation on negative samples and applies a penalty to prevent over-refusal on positives, achieving a balanced trade-off between accuracy and reliability. A second-stage reasoning reinforcement further consolidates causal understanding and interpretability. Experiments on three GREC benchmarks demonstrate that RC-GRPO attains superior localization accuracy while maintaining strong refusal capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究广义指代表达理解（GREC）任务，要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在文本描述的对象存在时定位它（正样本），不存在时拒绝输出（负样本）。作者指出由于训练中缺乏负样本，MLLM 常对不存在对象输出幻觉边界框，而现有 SFT 和 RL 后训练虽能增强拒绝行为却损害正样本定位精度。为此提出 RC-GRPO，一种校准的强化学习策略，在保持定位性能的同时增强拒绝能力，并在三个 GREC 基准上取得优于现有方法的定位精度与拒识能力。
Motivation: MLLM 在 GREC 任务中因训练缺少负样本而无法拒绝不存在的对象并产生幻觉边界框；现有后训练方法（SFT、RL）在提升拒绝行为时往往会降低正样本的定位精度，破坏模型核心能力。
Method: 提出 Refusal-Calibrated Group Relative Policy Optimization（RC-GRPO）：在 rollouts 中强制负样本输出 'None' 以获得有效的 advantage 估计，并对正样本施加惩罚以防止过度拒绝，从而平衡准确性与可靠性；随后加入第二阶段推理强化，进一步巩固因果理解与可解释性。
Result: 在三个 GREC 基准上的实验表明，RC-GRPO 在保持强拒绝能力的同时获得了更优的定位精度。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过校准的强化学习策略可以在定位精度与拒绝可靠性之间取得平衡，避免以往方法中拒绝能力与定位能力相互损害的困境。

papers.title: Traceable LLM-Generated Hazard Scenarios for Operational Safety Analysis of Aviation Systems Using ASRS Reports
papers.abstract_en: Operational hazard analysis of aviation system operations must consider interactions among weather, ATC actions, airspace constraints, aircraft operations, and human factors - distinct from the functional hazard assessment applied at the aircraft-system level. We present an AI-assisted approach that generates candidate hazard scenarios from NASA's Aviation Safety Reporting System (ASRS). Given a target adverse outcome, it produces a structured hypothesis as categorical factors and a narrative scenario describing an operational event sequence consistent with the structure. Each scenario includes by a plausibility score from historical co-occurrence evidence and traceability to the most similar held-out ASRS reports. We then propose a hybrid variant, conditioning narrative generation on a structured hypothesis produced via evolutionary abduction, improving correctness and reducing variability. We evaluate multiple large language models, zero-shot versus few-shot prompting, and optional fine-tuning, measuring how prompting and model choice affect the validity and realism of the generated structures and narratives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种 AI 辅助方法，从 NASA 航空安全报告系统 (ASRS) 中生成可追溯的危险场景 (hazard scenarios)，用于航空系统运行层面的安全分析。给定目标不利结果，方法输出由分类因素组成的结构化假设和对应的事件序列叙述，并为每个场景提供基于历史共现的合理性分数及对最相似留出 ASRS 报告的追溯。作者还提出一种混合变体，用进化溯因 (evolutionary abduction) 生成结构化假设来条件化叙述生成，并评估多种大语言模型、零样本与少样本提示以及可选微调对生成结构和叙述有效性与真实性的影响。
Motivation: 航空系统运行的危险分析必须考虑天气、ATC 行动、空域约束、航空器运行和人为因素之间的交互，这不同于飞机系统层面的功能危险评估，需要从运行安全报告数据中系统化生成候选危险场景。
Method: 针对目标不利结果，方法生成一个结构化假设（分类因素）和一段与结构一致的操作事件序列叙述；每个场景还附带基于历史共现证据的合理性分数，以及到最相似留出 ASRS 报告的追溯。混合变体通过进化溯因生成结构化假设，再用该假设约束叙述生成。
Result: 摘要报告对多个大语言模型、零样本与少样本提示以及可选微调进行了评估，测量提示方式和模型选择如何影响生成结构与叙述的有效性和真实性；混合变体被称可提升正确性并降低变异性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于 ASRS 报告的 AI 辅助场景生成可为运行安全分析提供带可追溯依据的危险场景，且通过结构化假设引导叙述能够改善生成质量。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Personalized Federated Sparse Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated adaptation of time-series foundation models (TSFMs) is attractive for building energy forecasting because meter data are private, distributed, and highly non-IID. However, a single parameter-sharing strategy is unlikely to serve all pretrained TSFMs or building clients: fully shared adapters can suppress building-specific temporal behavior, while fully local adaptation discards cross-building transfer. We propose a personalized federated sparse adaptation framework with a heterogeneous temporal mixture-of-experts (MoE) adapter placed after the pretrained TSFM representation. A sequence-level router maps each 168-hour context window to a top-$k$ subset of experts specialized for periodicity, long-range interactions, local variation, trend-residual structure, and multi-resolution behavior. We compare global FL, local training, and personalized FL variants with globally shared or client-private expert banks. Across 50 buildings and three TSFM backbones, personalization consistently outperforms Global FL-MoE and Local MoE, while the best sparse-adaptation strategy varies by backbone and metric. Routing behavior further reveals client-level expert specialization, expert concentration, and near-uniform routing across backbones, showing that federated TSFM adaptation should be both client-aware and backbone-aware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 在联邦学习下的个性化稀疏适配，面向楼宇能耗预测场景。作者在预训练 TSFM 表征后放置异构时间混合专家 (MoE) adapter，用序列级 router 把 168 小时上下文窗口映射到 top-k 专家子集；在 50 栋建筑和三种 TSFM 骨干上，个性化方案一致优于 Global FL-MoE 与 Local MoE。路由分析还显示客户端级专家特化、专家集中度以及跨骨干的近均匀路由现象。
Motivation: 楼宇电表数据是私有、分布式且高度非 IID 的，联邦适配 TSFM 具有吸引力；但单一参数共享策略难以同时适配所有预训练 TSFM 和建筑客户端：完全共享的 adapter 会压制建筑特有的时间行为，完全本地的适配则丢弃跨建筑迁移。
Method: 提出个性化联邦稀疏适配框架，在预训练 TSFM 表征后加入异构时序混合专家 (MoE) adapter。序列级 router 将每个 168 小时上下文窗口映射到针对周期性、长程交互、局部变化、趋势-残差结构和多尺度行为专门化的 top-k 专家子集；同时对比全局 FL、本地训练和个性化 FL 变体，并考虑全局共享或客户端私有专家库。
Result: 在 50 栋建筑和三种 TSFM 骨干上，个性化方法一致优于 Global FL-MoE 和 Local MoE；最佳稀疏适配策略随骨干与评估指标变化。路由行为还揭示了客户端层面的专家特化、专家集中度以及跨骨干的近均匀路由。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联邦 TSFM 适配应当同时是客户端感知 (client-aware) 和骨干感知 (backbone-aware) 的；本文的实证范围限于楼宇能耗预测的 50 栋建筑与三种 TSFM 骨干。
