summary_sections.motivation: 楼宇电表数据是私有、分布式且高度非 IID 的，联邦适配 TSFM 具有吸引力；但单一参数共享策略难以同时适配所有预训练 TSFM 和建筑客户端：完全共享的 adapter 会压制建筑特有的时间行为，完全本地的适配则丢弃跨建筑迁移。
summary_sections.method: 提出个性化联邦稀疏适配框架，在预训练 TSFM 表征后加入异构时序混合专家 (MoE) adapter。序列级 router 将每个 168 小时上下文窗口映射到针对周期性、长程交互、局部变化、趋势-残差结构和多尺度行为专门化的 top-k 专家子集；同时对比全局 FL、本地训练和个性化 FL 变体，并考虑全局共享或客户端私有专家库。
summary_sections.result: 在 50 栋建筑和三种 TSFM 骨干上，个性化方法一致优于 Global FL-MoE 和 Local MoE；最佳稀疏适配策略随骨干与评估指标变化。路由行为还揭示了客户端层面的专家特化、专家集中度以及跨骨干的近均匀路由。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调联邦 TSFM 适配应当同时是客户端感知 (client-aware) 和骨干感知 (backbone-aware) 的；本文的实证范围限于楼宇能耗预测的 50 栋建筑与三种 TSFM 骨干。

papers.title: Suppression Sticks, Locality Is Fragile: A Closed-Loop Target-and-Control Audit of Task-Vector Negation in VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Task-vector arithmetic offers a closed-form way to modify a model, yet its behavioral locality remains unclear in closed-loop robot control. We present a target-and-control audit of per-skill task-vector subtraction from multitask vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across all ten LIBERO-Goal skills, subtraction produces three qualitatively different regimes: target-control separation for five skills, resistance for three, and global collapse for two. On held-out initial states, the five suppressible targets remain at 0% success; however, mean baseline-normalized control retention is only 52%, and each target-suppressing edit materially harms at least one nominally unrelated control. Additional Goal panels show separation across tested policies with continuous-regression, discrete-token, and flow-matching action heads, whereas we observe no clean separation on Spatial and control collapse on the tested Object and Long-horizon panels. Mean task-vector cosine does not account for this variation. A matched-norm control identifies a local sign asymmetry around one Goal anchor, while multi-vector outcomes vary with anchor and scale. Retain-aware gradient baselines provide data-dependent comparators but require removal-time data and optimization; subtraction is data- and gradient-free only at edit time, assuming precomputed expert deltas. Finally, a single-skill relearning probe is consistent with behavioral masking, not certified unlearning. These results characterize task-vector subtraction as a fast but brittle intervention and underscore the need for closed-loop target-and-control evaluation when assessing locality in embodied model editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多任务视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略逐技能任务向量减法 (task-vector subtraction) 的行为局部性 (locality) 做了闭环目标与控制审计。在全部十个 LIBERO-Goal 技能上，减法产生三种定性不同的状态：五个技能出现目标-控制分离 (target-control separation)，三个出现抵抗，两个出现全局崩溃。摘要总结任务向量减法是一种快速但脆弱的干预，并强调在具身模型编辑中评估局部性时需要闭环目标-控制评估。
Motivation: 任务向量算术提供修改模型的闭式方法，但在闭环机器人控制中其行为局部性尚不清晰；既往评估方式可能忽略对无关控制行为的附带损害。
Method: 对来自多任务 VLA 策略的逐技能任务向量减法进行目标-控制审计，覆盖 LIBERO-Goal 全部十个技能；同时包括匹配范数对照 (matched-norm control)、保留感知梯度基线 (retain-aware gradient baselines) 以及单技能重学习探针 (relearning probe)。
Result: 在保留初始状态 (held-out initial states) 上，五个可抑制目标保持 0% 成功率，但均值基线归一化控制保留率仅 52%，且每个目标抑制编辑都会显著损害至少一个名义上无关的控制。Goal 面板在连续回归、离散 token 与 flow-matching 动作头的策略上均显示分离，而 Spatial 面板无干净分离，测试的 Object 与 Long-horizon 面板出现控制崩溃；均值任务向量余弦无法解释该差异。匹配范数对照在某个 Goal 锚点附近发现局部符号不对称，单技能重学习探针与行为掩蔽 (behavioral masking) 一致，而不等同于受认证的遗忘 (certified unlearning)。
Conclusion: 减法仅在编辑时是数据与梯度无关的（假设预计算专家增量），而保留感知基线需要移除时数据和优化。摘要强调任务向量减法快速但脆弱，评估具身模型编辑局部性时需要进行闭环目标-控制审计。

papers.title: The Sample Complexity of Distributionally Robust PAC Learning under Cressie--Read Divergences
papers.abstract_en: We study distributionally robust PAC learning for the $0$--$1$-loss, where adversarial perturbations of the data distribution are constrained by a Cressie--Read divergence of order $k>1$ and radius $ρ\geq 0$. For hypothesis classes with VC dimension $d$, we establish realizable and agnostic sample-complexity bounds tight up to constant and logarithmic factors, respectively; ordinary empirical risk minimization attains both rates up to logarithmic factors. For target accuracy $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ and confidence $δ\in(0,1)$, their respective orders are \[ \max\!\left\{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}, \frac{ρ^{\frac 1{k-1}}}{\varepsilon^{k_\star}} \right\}\cdot(d+\log δ^{-1}) \qquad\text{and}\qquad \max\!\left\{\frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}, \frac{ρ^{\frac1{k-1}}}{\varepsilon^{k_\star\vee 2}} \right\}\cdot(d+\log δ^{-1}), \] where $k_\star={k}/{(k-1)}$. For every fixed $ρ>0$, robustness changes the realizable $\varepsilon$-dependence from $\varepsilon^{-1}$ to $\varepsilon^{-k_\star}$ as $\varepsilon\downarrow0$. In the agnostic case, for $1<k<2$, robustness changes the $\varepsilon$-dependence from $\varepsilon^{-2}$ to $\varepsilon^{-k_\star}$, whereas for $k\geq2$ the exponent remains the classical $2$, with nontrivial $ρ$-dependence. Building on the known scalar reduction of robust $0$--$1$ risk to ordinary classification error, our analysis reveals a scale-sensitive interaction between the statistical estimation of classification error and its amplification by robustness, sharply explaining the transition in the agnostic rate. We extend the previously studied $χ^2$-divergence case to every Cressie--Read order $k>1$, close its upper--lower gaps, and recover standard PAC learning rates as $ρ\to0$, unlike previous bounds that fail to interpolate correctly in this limit.

papers.title: Active-SWE: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Proactive Bug Fixing without Issue Reports
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted in software engineering (SWE) scenarios, capable of fixing a specific bug in large-scale codebase. However, existing SWE benchmarks typically assume that high-quality issue reports with detailed information are always available, which is easily violated in practice due to the complexity of report acquisition and curation. To address this, we introduce Active-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on proactively discovering and fixing multiple bugs without report guidance, covering 1,663 tasks across six bug categories and eight languages. Beyond shifting the focus from existing reactive bug fixing to proactive bug fixing, Active-SWE enables a more in-depth evaluation by expanding the scope from fixing a specific recorded bug to multiple-bug fixing and potential bug discovery scenarios. To construct Active-SWE, we propose a novel difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline with a dual-track evaluation framework, facilitating comprehensive evaluation of proactive bug-fixing capability. Extensive experiments reveal that most state-of-the-art coding agents struggle with proactive bug-fixing tasks, demonstrating limited performance in locating and resolving recorded bugs, handling multiple bug fixing scenarios, and discovering valid potential bugs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Active-SWE，一个用于评测编码智能体 (coding agents) 主动发现并修复多个 bug 的基准，覆盖 1,663 个任务、六个 bug 类别和八种语言。与现有 SWE 基准依赖高质量 issue report 不同，Active-SWE 要求智能体在没有报告指导的情况下主动定位和修复 bug。实验表明大多数 SOTA 编码智能体在主动 bug 修复任务上表现有限。
Motivation: 现有 SWE 基准通常假设高质量 issue report 总是可用，但现实中报告的获取与整理复杂且成本高；因此需要评测编码智能体在没有报告指导时主动发现和修复 bug 的能力。
Method: 提出难度感知的任务构建流水线 (difficulty-aware task formulation pipeline) 和双轨评估框架 (dual-track evaluation framework)，将评测从单个记录 bug 的被动修复扩展到多 bug 修复与潜在 bug 发现场景。
Result: 在 1,663 个任务上的实验显示，大多数 SOTA 编码智能体在主动 bug 修复上表现不佳，在定位和修复已记录 bug、处理多 bug 修复场景以及发现有效潜在 bug 方面能力有限。
Conclusion: Active-SWE 将关注点从被动 bug 修复转向主动 bug 修复，并通过多 bug 与潜在 bug 发现场景提供更深入的评测，同时暴露出现有编码智能体在无报告指导下的明显短板。

papers.title: MOAT: Model-Agnostic Randomized Transformations for preventing Efficiency Degradation Attacks on ViTs
papers.abstract_en: To adopt the Vision Transformers (ViTs) in resource-constrained environment, token pruning is widely used to reduce computational cost without impacting accuracy. However, adversaries have developed targeted attacks against said token pruning techniques to undermine such attempts to make ViTs efficient. In this paper, we propose MOAT, a model-agnostic pre-processing defense pipeline that applies a combination of input transformations to protect efficient ViT implementations against adversarial efficiency attacks. MOAT operates directly on the input without requiring modifications to the model architecture or token pruning mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that, across all evaluated ViT models, MOAT limits GFLOPs degradation under adversarial attacks to within 3.4% of the original unattacked model.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for publication at IEEE ISVLSI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高效 Vision Transformer (ViT) 部署中 token pruning 技术的安全漏洞，提出 MOAT，一种与模型无关 (model-agnostic) 的输入预处理防御流水线。MOAT 直接在输入上施加组合变换，无需修改模型架构或 token pruning 机制。摘要报告在评估的所有 ViT 模型上，MOAT 能将对抗性效率攻击 (efficiency degradation attacks) 下的 GFLOPs 退化限制在未受攻击原始模型的 3.4% 以内。
Motivation: 在资源受限环境中，token pruning 被广泛用于在不影响精度的前提下降低 ViT 的计算开销，但攻击者已开发出针对这类 token pruning 技术的定向攻击，削弱 ViT 高效化的努力，因此需要一种不改动模型结构的防御手段来保护高效 ViT 实现。
Method: 提出 MOAT，一种 model-agnostic 的预处理防御流水线，对输入施加一组输入变换 (input transformations) 的组合，直接作用在输入侧，不修改模型架构或 token pruning 机制即可增强鲁棒性。
Result: 实验结果显示，在全部评估的 ViT 模型上，对抗攻击引起的 GFLOPs 退化被限制在原始未受攻击模型的 3.4% 以内。
Conclusion: 摘要的核心结论是，纯输入侧的变换预处理可以抵御针对 token pruning 的效率攻击，且不要求改动模型本身；该方案面向资源受限环境下的高效 ViT 部署，但摘要未展开不同 ViT 架构与攻击策略下的具体差异。

papers.title: Kathleen Writes: Autoregressive Generation and Data Scaling Without Attention
papers.abstract_en: Papers 1-2 of the Kathleen series showed that a byte-level, attention-free architecture built from a wavetable encoder and multi-scale reverberant state can match strong baselines on classification at ~450-700K parameters, without pretraining. We ask whether the same ingredients can generate. (1) Scaling: on byte-level language modeling (WikiText-103, raw UTF-8, no tokenizer), the reverberant model beats a parameter-matched transformer at every dataset scale measured (2-512 MB), e.g. 1.84 vs 2.04 bits/byte at 512 MB with ~0.5M parameters; the transformer needs more than 512 MB to match what the attention-free model learns from 32 MB. (2) Measurement: we introduce FORM DISTANCE, a non-parametric, gaming-resistant instrument for "reads like text": nine statistical axes of human text define a reference cloud, and five constructed fakes are all rejected. (3) Generation: decoding policy dominates architecture -- widening the sampler halves the same model's distance (3.17 to 1.52), and a retrieval-augmented decoding scheme takes the frozen model further (1.52 to 1.14) with no training step involved; the ablation attributes the gain to the sparse phrase dose itself, not the selection gate. The gain has a sharp boundary condition: the phrases must come from the model's own training corpus -- a 40x larger foreign library helps not at all, an effect the attention twin shares, consistent with in-context integration being a capability of scale. We also report four architectural additions that did not help, and a computed lexicon reaching 94% of a learned table's top-1 accuracy at one fifth of the parameters. Everything runs offline; all experiments are reproducible on a free Kaggle T4.
papers.comment: Paper 3 of the Kathleen series. 11 pages, 3 figures. All experiments reproducible on a free Kaggle T4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 Kathleen 系列的第三篇论文，考察一种字节级、无注意力 (attention-free) 的架构（由 wavetable 编码器和多尺度混响状态组成）能否从分类扩展到自回归生成。作者在 WikiText-103 的原始 UTF-8 字节级语言建模上报告，该混响模型在每个数据规模上均优于参数匹配的 Transformer，并引入一种非参数化的文本拟真度度量 FORM DISTANCE。文章还发现解码策略（如加宽采样器和检索增强解码）对生成效果的影响大于架构本身，且该收益只有在短语来自模型自身训练语料时才成立。
Motivation: 前两篇 Kathleen 论文已证明无注意力架构在约 450-700K 参数、无预训练条件下可在分类任务上匹配强基线；本文想回答同样的设计能否用于生成任务，并检验其数据规模扩展行为。
Method: 在字节级语言建模上比较混响模型与参数匹配的 Transformer，覆盖 2-512 MB 的数据规模；提出 FORM DISTANCE，一种基于九种统计轴的非参数化、抗游戏化的文本拟真度度量；测试加宽采样器与基于检索增强的解码策略，并报告若干未起作用的架构添加。
Result: 在 512 MB 数据、约 0.5M 参数下，混响模型达到 1.84 bits/byte，而 Transformer 为 2.04 bits/byte；Transformer 需要超过 512 MB 数据才能匹配无注意力模型从 32 MB 学到的效果。加宽采样器将同一模型的 FORM DISTANCE 从 3.17 降到 1.52，检索增强解码进一步降到 1.14；但短语必须来自模型自身训练语料，40 倍大的外部语料库无帮助。计算得到的词表在五分之一参数下达到学习表 top-1 准确率的 94%。
Conclusion: 作者认为解码策略在生成中的主导作用超过架构选择，而短语注入收益的边界条件暗示上下文集成 (in-context integration) 是一种与规模相关的能力；所有实验可在免费 Kaggle T4 上离线复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diverse and Plausible Algorithmic Recourse via Tractable Recourse Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic recourse seeks to help individuals reverse unfavorable automated decisions by recommending actionable changes that achieve a desired outcome. As an individual usually has several distinct routes to a favorable decision, and different people can act on different ones, a recourse system should offer multiple realistic alternatives rather than one. Existing approaches formulate recourse as an optimization problem that constructs one or a small set of counterfactuals rather than modeling the underlying space of feasible solutions, and in practice each sacrifices diversity, plausibility, or feasibility to secure the others. We propose Tractable Recourse Distributions, a probabilistic framework that represents the space of feasible alternatives for a given factual instance as a probability distribution over favorable outcomes. For commonly used cost functions based on proximity and the number of feature changes, we show that this distribution admits an exact representation as a probabilistic circuit, obtained by exponentially tilting the circuit; each individual's distribution is therefore available in closed form, without retraining the model. Sampling from these distributions naturally produces diverse and plausible recourses, while the tilting parameters provide explicit control over their proximity and sparsity. Experiments on standard algorithmic recourse benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework attains diversity, plausibility, and feasibility simultaneously, while retaining sufficient probability mass over feasible counterfactuals for rejection sampling to be practical. A visual study on MNIST illustrates how the tilt strength trades proximity against validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tractable Recourse Distributions，一种概率框架，将算法救济（algorithmic recourse）中给定事实样本的可行反事实空间建模为关于有利结果的概率分布。对基于邻近性和特征改动数的常见代价函数，作者证明该分布可通过概率电路（probabilistic circuit）的指数倾斜精确表示，且每个个体的分布存在闭式解，无需重训练模型。采样这些分布可自然得到多样且合理的 recourse，倾斜参数则显式控制邻近性与稀疏性。实验表明该方法能同时获得多样性、合理性与可行性，并使拒绝采样（rejection sampling）保持实用，MNIST 可视化展示了倾斜强度对邻近性与有效性的权衡。
Motivation: 现有算法救济方法通常将问题构建为优化问题，只生成一个或少量反事实，而不是建模底层可行解空间，实际中往往在多样性、合理性、可行性之间相互取舍。由于个体可能有多种不同行动路径，救济系统应当提供多个贴近现实的备选方案。
Method: 提出一个概率框架，将给定事实实例的可行替代方案空间表示为有利结果上的概率分布。对基于邻近性和特征改动数的常用代价函数，证明该分布可由概率电路通过指数倾斜（exponential tilting）精确表示；每个个体的分布以闭式形式给出，无需重训练模型。从这些分布中采样自然产生多样且合理的 recourse，倾斜参数提供对邻近性与稀疏性的显式控制。
Result: 在标准算法救济基准数据集上的实验显示，该框架能同时达到多样性、合理性与可行性，并在可行反事实上保留足够概率质量，使拒绝采样实际可行。MNIST 上的可视化研究展示了倾斜强度如何权衡邻近性与有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过概率电路和指数倾斜构造显式分布，可以在不牺牲其他性质的前提下同时获得多样、合理且可行的算法救济，并提供对邻近性与稀疏性的显式控制。摘要未给出具体数值结果或与基线的详细对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SurgNarrator: A Generative Retrieval Framework for Surgical Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Surgical procedures unfold as structured and recurring clinical events, whose real-time understanding via intraoperative surgical videos is critical for intraoperative decision-making and support. However, existing video understanding methods force a trade-off: autoregressive video-language models support comprehensive reasoning but are not practical for time-sensitive clinical applications, whereas contrastive models offer low latency but struggle with complex scene understanding. Recently, generative retrieval has been explored for general-domain video understanding, but transferring it to surgery is not trivial because near-identical visual appearances may indicate semantically distinct events, and the terminology involved is highly surgery-specific. To this end, we propose SurgNarrator, a new generative retrieval framework tailored for surgical video understanding. We construct a well-curated surgery-centric vocabulary from surgical captions to define a clinically meaningful retrieval space. We then adapt the pre-trained Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B to learn discriminative clinical representations with a temporally-aware contrastive objective. During inference, a hierarchical, procedure-aware retrieval strategy narrows the search space to the relevant procedure type, delivering fast and effective responses. Our method is comprehensively evaluated on twelve benchmarks in a zero-shot setting and achieves consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing output-stage latency by more than two orders of magnitude compared with the generative baseline.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurgNarrator，一个面向手术视频理解的生成式检索框架 (generative retrieval framework)。作者从手术字幕构建手术专属词汇表，并适配 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 以学习带时间感知对比目标 (temporally-aware contrastive objective) 的判别性临床表示；推理时采用分层、流程感知的检索策略，在 12 个基准的零样本设置中取得一致性提升，并将输出端延迟相比生成式基线降低两个数量级以上。
Motivation: 现有手术视频理解方法存在权衡：自回归视频语言模型支持综合推理但不符合时间敏感临床需求，对比模型延迟低但难以处理复杂场景理解。将通用领域的生成式检索迁移到手术场景并不直接，因为视觉外观相近可能对应语义不同的事件，且术语高度手术特异。
Method: 提出 SurgNarrator 框架，包括从手术字幕构建精心整理的手术中心词汇表以定义有临床意义的检索空间，将预训练 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 适配为学习判别性临床表示并采用时间感知对比目标，推理时使用分层的流程感知检索策略缩小到相关手术类型的搜索空间。
Result: 在十二个基准的零样本设置下，方法相对最先进基线取得一致的性能提升，并相比生成式基线将输出端延迟降低两个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成式检索框架可兼顾手术视频理解的速度与复杂场景理解能力，但其有效性与手术专属词汇构建和流程感知检索策略的设计直接相关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differential 6-DOF Pose Estimation with Provable First-Order Immunity to Camera Calibration Errors
papers.abstract_en: Accurate six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion estimation is essential for robotic manipulation, autonomous systems, and structural displacement monitoring. Conventional 3D-2D methods estimate absolute camera poses independently at each time and recover platform motion through camera-to-platform extrinsics, making them sensitive to extrinsic calibration errors, especially for micromotion. We present a differential pose estimation method that directly recovers platform motion from inter-frame image displacements and known 3D control points. By differencing perspective projection equations, using a depth-invariance approximation, and modeling motion on SE(3), the method avoids independent absolute-pose estimation and supports both monocular and multi-camera systems. We prove that translational extrinsic errors cancel exactly, while rotational errors induce a bounded perturbation determined by calibration error, motion magnitude, and observation geometry. We also derive generic observability conditions, a Cramer-Rao lower bound, and a bias-eliminated consistent estimator, and characterize the validity limits of the approximations. Extensive synthetic and real-world experiments establish a new state of the art for 6-DOF platform micromotion estimation, outperforming representative PnP and generalized-PnP methods in accuracy, calibration robustness, and computational efficiency. With five control points and 0.5-pixel image noise, the monocular solver obtains a combined pitch-yaw rotation RMSE of 10.09 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.70 mm, and a runtime of 0.34 ms. The binocular solver achieves a rotation RMSE of 10.58 arcsec, a translation RMSE of 3.91 mm, and a runtime of 0.27 ms. Code will be released upon publication at https://github.com/zyoungszu/pami2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种差分的 6-DOF 平台微运动估计方法，直接从帧间图像位移与已知 3D 控制点恢复平台运动，避免逐帧绝对位姿估计。作者证明了平移外参误差可以精确抵消，旋转误差只引入有界扰动，并给出可观测性条件、Cramér-Rao 下界与消除偏差的一致估计器。合成与真实实验表明该方法在精度、标定鲁棒性和计算效率上优于代表性 PnP 与 generalized-PnP 方法。
Motivation: 传统 3D-2D 方法在各时刻独立估计绝对相机位姿，再通过相机到平台的外参恢复平台运动，因此对外参标定误差敏感，尤其对微运动场景影响显著。
Method: 通过对透视投影方程作差分，利用深度不变近似，并在 SE(3) 上建模运动，直接由帧间图像位移和已知控制点估计平台运动；方法同时支持单目与多相机系统，并推导了可观测性条件、CRLB 以及可消除偏差的一致性估计器。
Result: 合成与真实实验中，该方法在 6-DOF 平台微运动估计上取得新的最佳结果。以 5 个控制点和 0.5 像素图像噪声为例，单目求解器得到俯仰-偏航旋转 RMSE 为 10.09 角秒、平移 RMSE 为 3.70 mm、耗时 0.34 ms；双目求解器旋转 RMSE 为 10.58 角秒、平移 RMSE 为 3.91 mm、耗时 0.27 ms。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法避免了独立绝对位姿估计，对外参标定误差具有可证明的一阶免疫性，并建立了 6-DOF 平台微运动估计的新基准；代码将在发表后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Easy to Complete, Hard to Choose: Investigating LLM Performance on the ProverbIT Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed computational linguistics and achieved remarkable performance across numerous natural language processing tasks, yet significant gaps persist in understanding how these systems process culturally embedded linguistic expressions. This paper introduces ProverbIT, a novel Italian benchmark comprising 100 multiple-choice questions designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to complete Italian proverbs. We assess 13 frontier models, including Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and traditional LLMs, across three tasks: proverb completion, multiple-choice selection with correct answers, and multiple-choice selection without correct answers. Our evaluation reveals surprising results: while nearly all models demonstrate knowledge of the proverbs through successful completion tasks, performance drops dramatically when transitioning to multiple-choice formats without correct answers, with even state-of-the-art reasoning models showing substantial degradation. Through detailed Chain-of-Thought analysis of two LRMs, we uncover that models exhibit a strong bias toward selecting literal synonyms and frequently mention correct proverb endings during reasoning without successfully identifying their absence from the given options. These findings suggest that current LLMs rely heavily on memorized patterns rather than deeper semantic understanding of culturally grounded expressions, highlighting important limitations in their reasoning capabilities for figurative language comprehension.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Eleventh Italian Conference on Computational Linguistics (CLiC-it 2025), pages 722-734
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProverbIT，一个包含 100 道选择题的意大利语谚语基准，用来评估 LLM 对文化嵌入式表达的补全与理解。作者测试了 13 个前沿模型（含 Large Reasoning Models 与传统 LLM），覆盖谚语补全、带正确答案与不带正确答案的多选题三类任务。结果显示模型在补全任务上表现良好，但在无正确答案的多选题上显著退化；思维链分析表明模型偏向选择字面同义词，并倾向于在推理中提及正确的谚语结尾却未能识别其不在选项中，说明当前 LLM 更多依赖记忆而非对比喻语义的深层理解。
Motivation: LLM 在许多 NLP 任务上表现优异，但对文化嵌入式语言（如谚语）的处理仍存在明显不足，现有基准缺少针对意大利语谚语的系统评估。
Method: 构建 ProverbIT 意大利语谚语基准，含 100 道多选题，并设计三个任务：谚语补全、带正确选项的多选题、不带正确选项的多选题；对 13 个模型（包括 LRM 与常规 LLM）进行评估，并对两个 LRM 进行 Chain-of-Thought 分析。
Result: 几乎所有模型都能成功完成谚语补全，但转到无正确答案的多选题时性能大幅下降，包括最先进的推理模型；思维链分析显示模型表现出强烈的字面同义词选择偏差，并常在推理中提及正确的谚语结尾但未能发现其不在选项中。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前 LLM 依赖记忆化模式而非对文化表达语义的深层理解，在比喻性语言理解上存在明显局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Differentiating Through Dual Prices: End-to-End Policy Learning Under Capacity Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Many social services assign scarce resources, such as housing assistance or hospital interventions, to people who arrive one at a time: each arrival must receive a decision immediately, and the long-run usage of every resource must stay within its capacity. We study how to learn such an assignment policy from logged observational data. The standard pipeline is decision-blind: fit one outcome model per arm by regression, price each capacitated resource from the fitted models, and assign each arrival the arm whose predicted outcome minus price is largest. We instead train the outcome models end-to-end, differentiating an off-policy estimate of the deployed policy's value through the dual prices themselves. We study two formulations: an exact nonconvex one, and a convex relaxation whose optimum always satisfies the capacity constraints in expectation and which is suboptimal by at most a term linear in the smoothing temperature and logarithmic in the number of arms. Every method is evaluated in a queueing simulation with resources replenished at their capacity rates. Across six datasets, the two end-to-end variants take the top slots on a deployment-adjusted value index at every delay cost, including zero; when capacities are binding, decision-blind baselines frequently violate them and incur much longer queueing delays. On the largest dataset, a hospital cohort of seventy thousand patients, end-to-end training also achieves significantly higher policy value, a margin that survives a capacity-matched neural baseline. Flexible decision-blind regression remains the stronger pure predictor where ground truth is measurable; end-to-end training is best suited to settings where resources are genuinely scarce and feasibility matters.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 2 algorithms. Includes a technical appendix with full proofs, an excess-value decomposition, ablations, and reproducibility details. Code: https://github.com/mahdisalmani/end2end-capacity-constrained-policy-learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在容量约束下从记录型观测数据学习即时分配策略的问题，资源（如住房援助或医院干预）逐人到访且长期使用量不能超出容量。标准流程是决策盲（decision-blind）的：先为每个臂回归拟合结果模型，再据此给容量资源定价，最后指派“预测结果减价格”最大的臂。作者改为端到端训练结果模型，通过将对偶价格（dual prices）本身进行微分来优化部署策略价值的 off-policy 估计，并给出精确非凸与凸松弛两种形式，在队列仿真和六个数据集上进行评估。
Motivation: 标准决策盲流程把结果模型拟合与容量定价分开，可能忽略容量可行性和部署后的真实价值；当资源稀缺且必须即时决策时，需要一种能把容量约束纳入学习的端到端训练方法。
Method: 提出端到端策略学习框架，对部署策略价值的 off-policy 估计通过对偶价格进行端到端微分；研究精确非凸形式和凸松弛形式，其中凸松弛的最优解在期望上总能满足容量约束，次优性界由平滑温度的线性项和臂数的对数项组成。方法在资源按容量速率补给的队列仿真中评估。
Result: 在六个数据集上，两种端到端变体在所有延迟成本（包括零）下都占据部署调整价值指数的前两名；容量约束紧时，决策盲基线频繁违反约束并产生更长的排队延迟。在最大的七万患者医院队列数据集上，端到端训练也显著提升策略价值，该优势在容量匹配的神经基线面前仍然保持。
Conclusion: 在真实结果（ground truth）可测量的场景下，灵活的决策盲回归仍是更强的纯预测器；端到端训练最适合资源真正稀缺、可行性至关重要的分配场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Automatic Statistical Test for Rationally Expressible Algorithms by Selective Inference, with Applications to Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Selective inference (SI) provides statistically valid $p$-values for hypotheses selected by applying an algorithm to the data, correcting for the bias that arises when the same data are used both to select and to test a hypothesis. Developing an SI procedure for a new algorithm, however, has required an expert to derive, and then implement, the selection event, i.e., the conditions under which the hypothesis is selected. Repeating this specialized effort for every new algorithm is why exact SI has so far been available for only a narrow class. We propose AutoSI, a framework that removes this barrier in two ways. First, AutoSI constructs the selection event automatically from the algorithm's individual operations, so the user only writes the algorithm as ordinary NumPy-like code and derives nothing by hand. Second, AutoSI broadens the class of selection events SI can handle: existing exact methods are limited to selection events characterized by linear or quadratic inequalities in the data, whereas AutoSI covers any algorithm expressible through rational functions of the data (ratios of polynomials). We prove that the $p$-values computed by AutoSI are exactly valid in finite samples. We demonstrate AutoSI on three feature-selection methods, each written in a few dozen lines of code. One of these methods, the lasso with its tuning parameter selected by cross-validated $R^2$, cannot be handled within existing exact SI frameworks and is made possible by AutoSI. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that the resulting $p$-values control the type I error rate (i.e., the false positive rate) at the nominal level while retaining high power.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSI，一个自动构建选择性推断 (selective inference) 中选择事件 (selection event) 的框架。用户只需以类似 NumPy 的普通代码编写算法，AutoSI 即可自动从算法的单个操作构造选择事件，无需手工推导。该方法将精确 SI 的适用范围从线性或二次不等式扩展到任意可由数据的有理函数（多项式之比）表达的算法，并证明其 p 值在有限样本下精确有效。作者在三个特征选择方法上演示了 AutoSI，其中带交叉验证 R² 选择正则化参数的 lasso 无法被现有精确 SI 框架处理，而 AutoSI 可以实现。
Motivation: 发展一个新的选择性推断程序需要专家为每个新算法手工推导并实现选择事件，这一专门化工作导致精确 SI 目前只适用于很窄的算法类别。本文旨在消除这一障碍，让用户无需手工推导即可对任意可理性表达的算法进行有效的统计推断。
Method: 提出 AutoSI 框架，从算法的个体操作自动构造选择事件，并证明其覆盖所有可以通过数据的有理函数（多项式之比）表达的算法。该方法在有限样本下给出精确有效的 p 值，且不需要用户手工推导选择条件。
Result: 在三个特征选择方法上进行演示，每个方法只需几十行代码，其中包括一个现有精确 SI 框架无法处理的 lasso（其正则化参数由交叉验证 R² 选择）。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，所得 p 值在保持较高功效的同时将第一类错误率控制在名义水平。
Conclusion: AutoSI 扩展了精确选择性推断可处理的算法类别，使任意有理函数可表达的算法都能自动获得有效的选择性 p 值，降低了使用 SI 的专业门槛。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrating Artificial Guilt: Neurally Grounded Reward Shaping for Prosocial Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning often adds social terms to individual rewards, yet the scale of those terms is usually chosen by hand. We ask whether a guilt signal can instead be calibrated from human neural and behavioural data and transferred to artificial agents. Using the public SoDec responsibility fMRI dataset (40 participants), we fit a subject-fixed-effects regression of momentary-happiness changes on outcome-type counts and recover a guilt weight as the Partner-negative minus Social-negative contrast ($\hat{w}=1.118$, Cohen's $d=0.214$). We embed this weight in a two-agent Social Lottery environment and train independent Proximal Policy Optimization actor-critics under four shaping regimes: neurally calibrated, uniform constant, zero (selfish), and a unit-coefficient oracle. Across 1{,}000 evaluation episodes per condition, the calibrated agents track the human Social safe-choice rate most closely ($0.459$ vs.\ human $0.484$; $\mathrm{KL}=0.0012$), while the other three conditions deviate by one to three orders of magnitude in KL. Human neurobehavioural priors can therefore act as quantitative constraints on prosocial reward shaping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用人类神经与行为数据来标定多智能体强化学习中的“内疚”权重，替代人工设定社会奖励项尺度。作者在 SoDec 责任判断 fMRI 数据集（40 名被试）上拟合幸福感变化的固定效应回归，得到内疚权重为 Partner-negative 减 Social-negative 对比（w=1.118，Cohen's d=0.214），并将其嵌入双智能体 Social Lottery 环境，用独立 PPO actor-critic 在四种塑形机制下训练。结果表明，神经标定的智能体最接近人类 socially safe 选择率（0.459 vs 人类 0.484，KL=0.0012），其余条件与人类的 KL 偏差高一到三个数量级。
Motivation: 合作式多智能体强化学习常向个体奖励中加入社会项，但这些社会项的尺度通常靠人工选择，缺少定量依据。
Method: 使用公开 SoDec 责任判断 fMRI 数据集，通过被试固定效应回归将瞬时幸福感变化对结果类型计数建模，恢复内疚权重；然后在双智能体 Social Lottery 环境中比较四种奖励塑形机制：神经标定、均匀常数、零（自私）和单位系数 oracle，训练独立 PPO actor-critic。
Result: 在每种条件 1,000 个评估回合中，神经标定智能体的 Social safe 选择率（0.459）最接近人类（0.484），KL 为 0.0012；其他三种条件与人类的 KL 偏差大一到三个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要认为人类神经行为先验可以作为亲社会奖励塑形的定量约束，从而替代手工设定社会项尺度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MobileWAM: Bridging World Action Models to Mobile Manipulation with Chain-of-Foresight
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) built on video generation backbones are a rising recipe for robot learning, yet remain confined to tabletop manipulation. Mobile manipulation demands simultaneous locomotion and whole-body manipulation amid scene-scale dynamics, yet is still dominated by dynamics-blind visual encoders with hand-crafted coordination. We bridge this gap with MobileWAM, a mixture-of-transformers architecture that fuses a pretrained video diffusion transformer with a lightweight action expert through layerwise joint attention, translating internet-scale motion priors into whole-body control. To reconcile the heterogeneous dynamics of moving and manipulating, each feed-forward layer of the action expert becomes a three-expert mixture of shared, locomotion, and manipulation experts, softly routed by the motion intent in the action tokens. To densify supervision, we further propose Chain-of-Foresight (CoF): intermediate representations sequentially predict a chain of future latent chunks, each step conditioned on its predecessor. CoF pairs naturally with our decoupled video--action denoising scheme. At deployment, the WAM serves as a pure current-frame encoder; foresight acts only through gradients, so at inference the foresight chain and video generation are discarded, leaving only policy-level cost. MobileWAM surpasses state-of-the-art mobile manipulation policies on ManiSkill-HAB and fine-tunes to a real ARX Lift2 mobile manipulator across diverse tasks with strong generalization. Code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobileWAM，一种面向移动操作 (mobile manipulation) 的世界动作模型 (WAM)。它基于视频扩散 Transformer 与轻量动作专家 (action expert) 的混合架构，通过逐层联合注意力 (layerwise joint attention) 将互联网规模的运动先验转化为全身控制；并引入 Chain-of-Foresight (CoF) 中间表示来稠密化监督。摘要报告其在 ManiSkill-HAB 上超过现有移动操作策略，并能在真实 ARX Lift2 移动机械臂上微调且泛化良好。
Motivation: 现有基于视频生成骨干的 WAM 仅限桌面操作，而移动操作需要同时进行移动与全身操作并应对场景级动态，但当前方法仍依赖对动力学不敏感的视觉编码器与手工设计的协调机制，存在明显空白。
Method: 采用混合 Transformer 架构，将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 与轻量动作专家耦合；动作专家的每个前馈层变为共享、移动、操作三种专家的混合，并按动作 token 中的运动意图进行软路由。为稠密化监督，提出 Chain-of-Foresight：中间表示逐级预测未来潜变量块 (latent chunks)，每步以上一步为条件；该方法与解耦的视频-动作去噪方案配合。部署时 WAM 仅作为当前帧编码器，foresight 只通过梯度作用，推理时丢弃 foresight 链与视频生成。
Result: 摘要称 MobileWAM 在 ManiSkill-HAB 上超越最先进的移动操作策略，并在真实 ARX Lift2 移动机械臂的多种任务上微调后展现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 WAM 扩展到移动操作的关键在于融合异构动态（移动与操作）并通过 foresight 提供稠密监督，且推理成本仅保留策略级开销。

papers.title: CSGen: A Multi-Domain Curvilinear Structure Generation Model via Hierarchical Multimodal Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Curvilinear structure analysis is an important and fundamental task in multimedia. However, the controllable generation of images with precise curvilinear structure objects remains an open challenge. To address this, we propose CSGen, a hierarchical multimodal diffusion model that synthesizes high-fidelity images precisely aligned with multiple control conditions. The CSGen is built upon three key innovations: 1) We construct a multi-domain and multimodal dataset, including over 24K samples from 5 domains and 7 different types of annotations, to train the unified generation model. 2) We propose a novel hierarchical progressive control strategy that decouples topology clues from visual context by a phased signal injection, mitigating semantic drift while ensuring the topological integrity of sparse structures. 3) We design a sparsity-aware loss re-weighting mechanism to address the extreme sparsity of curvilinear structures, significantly enhancing the attention on thin and fragile structures during optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CSGen generates images with superior structure accuracy and visual realism, significantly improving downstream segmentation performance while maintaining robustness across diverse prompts. Our results confirm CSGen as a scalable, data-centric paradigm for the analysis of complex curvilinear structures in diverse multimedia applications. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ShanZard/CSGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CSGen，一个面向多域曲线结构（curvilinear structure）图像生成的分层多模态扩散模型。模型基于包含 5 个域、7 种标注类型的 24K+ 样本数据集进行统一训练，通过分层渐进式控制策略解耦拓扑线索与视觉上下文，并用稀疏感知损失重加权机制缓解曲线结构的极端稀疏性。实验表明 CSGen 能生成结构精度更高、视觉更真实的图像，并显著提升下游分割性能。
Motivation: 曲线结构分析是多媒体中的基础任务，但可控地生成包含精确曲线结构对象的图像仍是一个开放性挑战。
Method: 提出分层多模态扩散模型 CSGen，核心创新包括：构建多域多模态数据集；设计分层渐进式控制策略，通过分阶段信号注入将拓扑线索与视觉上下文解耦，减少语义漂移并保证稀疏结构的拓扑完整性；设计稀疏感知损失重加权机制，加强对细薄脆弱结构的优化关注。
Result: 大量实验表明 CSGen 在结构准确性和视觉真实性上优于现有方法，并显著提升下游分割性能，且对多样化提示保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者将 CSGen 视为一种可扩展的、以数据为中心的曲线结构分析范式，适用于多种多媒体应用场景。

papers.title: Overcoming Statistical Bias in Action-Controllable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models aim to predict how visual environments evolve under an agent's actions. Yet future frames are often highly predictable from visual inertia and recurring motion patterns alone. This creates a shortcut: models can fit the data by exploiting statistical biases without making their visible dynamics meaningfully depend on the action. As a result, different actions may produce similar futures, while motion may persist even under zero action. The key question is how to reduce reliance on statistical shortcuts from dominating action-conditioned prediction. We argue that action control requires more than injecting action features; it requires enforcing consistency under counterfactual changes to actions and observations. Based on this insight, we introduce CoCo, a Counterfactual Consistency framework to enhance action controllability through two complementary constraints. Multi-step counterfactual consistency constrains reference, inverse-action, and zero-action rollouts, while action-spatial counterfactual consistency enforces consistent predictions under mirrored scenes and transformed actions. Together, they reduce reliance on statistical shortcuts from substituting for action-dependent dynamics. We further introduce Action Response Consistency (ARC) and Drift Energy (DE) to assess action controllability, together with Mini-SSMB for same-state, multi-action counterfactual evaluation. On Mini-SSMB, our full model achieved ARC_inv of 0.412 and ARC_ref of 0.483, while reducing DE by 17.07% relative to the baseline. On VP2 visual planning, it achieves the highest average success rate among SOTA models, at 73.1%. Experiments on BAIR and RoboNet further show that these gains preserve video prediction quality and transfer across model settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动作条件世界模型 (action-conditioned world models) 中的统计捷径问题提出 CoCo 框架，主张动作可控性需要通过反事实一致性约束来实现，而非仅注入动作特征。作者引入多步反事实一致性与动作-空间反事实一致性两类约束，并提出 ARC、DE 指标和 Mini-SSMB 基准进行评估。实验显示该方法在 Mini-SSMB 上显著降低漂移能量，并在 VP2 视觉规划上取得最高平均成功率。
Motivation: 未来帧往往可由视觉惯性和周期性运动模式预测，模型会利用这种统计偏差拟合数据，而不让可见动态真正依赖于动作，导致不同动作产生相似未来甚至零动作下运动持续。作者认为单纯注入动作特征不足以实现动作控制，需要减少统计捷径对动作条件预测的主导。
Method: 提出 CoCo (Counterfactual Consistency) 框架，通过两个互补约束增强动作可控性：多步反事实一致性约束参考 (reference)、逆动作 (inverse-action) 和零动作 (zero-action) 的 rollout；动作-空间反事实一致性约束镜像场景与变换动作下预测的一致性。同时引入 Action Response Consistency (ARC) 和 Drift Energy (DE) 指标，以及同状态多动作反事实评估基准 Mini-SSMB。
Result: 在 Mini-SSMB 上，完整模型取得 ARC_inv 0.412、ARC_ref 0.483，并将 DE 相对基线降低 17.07%；在 VP2 视觉规划上以 73.1% 的平均成功率超过现有 SOTA 模型。BAIR 和 RoboNet 实验表明这些提升不损害视频预测质量，并可跨模型设置迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作控制需要保证动作与观测的反事实变化下预测一致性，CoCo 通过两类一致性约束降低了统计捷径的依赖，且其收益能保持预测质量并在不同模型设置间迁移。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DisMix: Order-Aware Mixup for Medical Imaging via Disentangling Ordinal and Non-Ordinal Features
papers.abstract_en: Image mixup is a widely adopted data augmentation strategy, yet it is ill-suited for ordinal classification tasks such as medical disease grading, where labels encode a progression of severity. By indiscriminately blending disease-severity cues (ordinal) with appearance-level variation (non-ordinal), standard mixup produces samples that distort the very ordinal structure that underpins clinical severity grading. We introduce DisMix, an order-aware mixup framework for ordinal classification. DisMix disentangles ordinal and non-ordinal features via a dual-codebook VQ-VAE, allowing each subspace to be mixed independently: ordinal codes are interpolated to produce meaningful intermediate ranks, while non-ordinal codes are varied to introduce appearance diversity without corrupting the ordinal signal. Across four medical imaging datasets, DisMix shows the best aggregate performance among six image mixup baselines paired with six ordinal classifiers and remains effective under data scarcity and clinical grading variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DisMix，一种面向有序分类 (ordinal classification) 的顺序感知 mixup 框架，针对医学疾病分级等任务。其核心是用双码本 VQ-VAE 将有序特征（疾病严重程度线索）与非有序特征（外观变化）解耦，然后分别混合：有序码插值生成有意义的中间等级，非有序码变化以引入外观多样性而不破坏有序信号。摘要报告在四个医学影像数据集上，DisMix 在六种 mixup 基线搭配六种有序分类器的对比中取得最佳综合性能，并在数据稀缺和临床分级变异场景下仍然有效。
Motivation: 标准 mixup 数据增强不适用于医学疾病分级等有序分类任务，因为对疾病严重程度线索与外观变化的无差别混合会扭曲支撑临床严重度分级的序结构。
Method: 引入 DisMix，利用双码本 VQ-VAE 将有序与非有序特征解耦，并允许两个子空间独立混合：有序码通过插值产生中间排名，非有序码通过变化增加外观多样性。
Result: 在四个医学影像数据集上，DisMix 在六个 mixup 基线搭配六个有序分类器的综合对比中表现最佳，且在数据稀缺与临床分级变异条件下仍保持有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调顺序感知的 mixup 设计能够更好地保持有序分类中的严重度进展结构，其验证范围限于医学影像分类任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Active Learning Guided Design Space Refinement for Scalable Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Advanced materials discovery increasingly relies on machine learning and Bayesian optimization to explore large discrete design spaces under limited evaluation budgets. However, conventional Bayesian optimization (BO) can become inefficient as candidate spaces grow, often evaluating low-value regions before reaching informative areas. We propose an active-learning (AL)-guided adaptive search-space refinement framework combined with multi-objective BO to accelerate materials optimization while preserving Pareto-relevant regions. We evaluate the approach on CH4/N2 separation in covalent-organic frameworks and pressure-vessel design with material-direction stress components and thickness objectives. Results show that the AL-guided refinement reduces the candidate space by approximately half while preserving more than 99 percent of the original hypervolume. The reduced-space strategy improves early convergence and cumulative Pareto-front discovery from the BO, demonstrating efficient large-scale materials optimization across constrained autonomous materials discovery settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种由主动学习 (active learning) 引导的自适应搜索空间细化框架，将其与多目标贝叶斯优化 (multi-objective BO) 结合，用于加速材料发现中的大规模离散设计空间优化。方法在共价有机框架 (COF) 的 CH4/N2 分离以及压力容器设计两个问题上评估，结果显示候选空间约缩小一半，同时保留超过 99% 的原始超体积 (hypervolume)，并改善早期收敛与 Pareto 前沿发现。
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化在候选空间规模增大时效率下降，往往先评估低价值区域，难以及时到达信息量大的区域，限制了有限评估预算下的材料优化。
Method: 提出主动学习引导的自适应搜索空间细化框架，结合多目标 BO，在优化过程中动态保留与 Pareto 前沿相关的区域并缩小候选空间，从而提升采样效率。
Result: 在 CH4/N2 分离的 COF 筛选和压力容器设计任务中，候选空间减少约一半，同时保留超过 99% 的原始超体积；细化后的空间改善了 BO 的早期收敛速度和累积 Pareto 前沿发现。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架在约束型自主材料发现场景下能实现高效的大规模材料优化；其适用范围和局限需要结合具体材料任务进一步考察。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: YOLO-PVC: 2D-to-3D Consolidation of Slice-wise Detections for Volumetric Liver Tumor Localization in MRI
papers.abstract_en: Slice-wise 2D object detectors are increasingly applied to volumetric data due to their computational efficiency and scalability, yet they often yield fragmented and unstable predictions along the depth axis. We propose YOLO-PVC, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework for 2D-to-3D consolidation of slice-wise detections. The method enforces depth continuity, aggregates bounding box coordinates using robust percentile statistics, and further refines axial extent through a lightweight MLP-based calibration module. Unlike naïve stacking or averaging strategies, YOLO-PVC explicitly addresses missing detections and outlier slices along the depth dimension. Experiments on 3D liver MRI volumes across three tumor categories demonstrate consistent improvements over multiple aggregation baselines. The heuristic PVC achieves an overall $\mathrm{IoU}_{3D}$ of $0.665$, while the calibrated variant further improves performance to $0.710$, with high planar overlap ($\mathrm{BEV\ IoU} \approx 0.78$). These results demonstrate that structured geometric consolidation provides an effective and practical solution for volumetric liver tumor localization in clinical MRI.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AI4M3D Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Spotlight)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 YOLO-PVC，一个轻量且与检测器无关的框架，用于将逐切片 2D 检测结果整合为 3D 目标定位。方法通过深度连续性约束、基于稳健百分位统计的边界框聚合，以及轻量 MLP 校准模块细化轴向范围，显式处理缺失检测和异常切片。实验在 3D 肝脏 MRI 上跨三类肿瘤表明，与多种聚合基线相比有一致提升：启发式 PVC 的总体 IoU_3D 为 0.665，校准变体提升至 0.710，平面重叠 BEV IoU 约 0.78。
Motivation: 逐切片 2D 检测器在体积数据上计算高效且可扩展，但沿深度轴常产生碎片化和不稳定的预测；简单的堆叠或平均策略无法解决缺失检测和离群切片问题。
Method: 提出模型无关的 2D 到 3D 整合框架 YOLO-PVC，包含深度连续性强制、基于稳健百分位统计的边界框坐标聚合，以及基于 MLP 的轴向范围校准模块。
Result: 在 3D 肝脏 MRI 的三类肿瘤数据上，启发式 PVC 达到总体 IoU_3D 0.665，校准变体进一步提升到 0.710，BEV IoU 约 0.78，且一致优于多个聚合基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化的几何整合为临床 MRI 中的体积肝脏肿瘤定位提供了有效且实用的方案。

papers.title: AI Literacy for Legal Translation: Developing Digital Resilience
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI is transforming legal translation by introducing opportunities alongside linguistic, technical, legal, ethical and cognitive risks. This chapter examines the implications of AI for professional legal translation and proposes an AI literacy framework tailored to the profession. It argues that AI does not change the fundamental objectives of legal translation but requires an extension of professional competence through AI literacy. The proposed framework comprises four mutually reinforcing dimensions, foundational, procedural, critical and strategic, and conceptualises AI literacy as a transversal component of legal translation competence that fosters digital resilience. It further discusses the pedagogical implications of this framework by proposing classroom activities designed to develop AI literacy in legal translator education, enabling future translators to integrate AI critically, responsibly and in accordance with professional standards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向法律翻译职业的章节式研究，讨论生成式人工智能给法律翻译带来的机遇与语言、技术、法律、伦理和认知层面的风险。作者提出一个由基础性、程序性、批判性和战略性四个相互强化的维度构成的 AI 素养框架，将 AI 素养视为法律翻译能力的横向组成部分，以培养数字韧性；同时讨论该框架在法律翻译教育中的教学应用，并设计课堂活动。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 正在改变法律翻译，带来机会的同时也引入语言、技术、法律、伦理和认知风险，而现有职业能力框架尚未系统纳入 AI 素养，需要为该职业定制专门的素养框架。
Method: 提出面向法律翻译职业的 AI 素养框架，包含基础性 (foundational)、程序性 (procedural)、批判性 (critical) 和战略性 (strategic) 四个相互增强的维度，并把 AI 素养概念化为法律翻译能力的横向组成部分；此外提出培养该素养的课堂活动设计。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI 并不改变法律翻译的根本目标，但要求通过 AI 素养扩展专业能力；该框架旨在让未来译者在遵守职业标准的前提下批判、负责地整合 AI，并强调其在法律翻译教育中的教学意义。

papers.title: A/B Agent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Strategy Iteration in Industrial A/B Testing
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recommendation strategy iteration heavily relies on large-scale A/B experimentation. Traditional tuning requires experts to repeatedly design strategies, configure experiments, analyze results, and adjust parameters, making the process labor-intensive and time-consuming. Meanwhile, valuable knowledge from historical experiments is often fragmented, making systematic reuse difficult through manual expert effort alone. Existing RAG agents partially alleviate this burden by retrieving prior strategies, but typically organize experience in a flat manner, overlooking the hierarchical relationships among business scenarios, recommendation stages, optimization objectives, and experimental contexts. This often results in mismatched retrieval and limited cross-scenario transfer, while preventing agents from continuously refining strategies and parameters through sequential A/B feedback. % To address these limitations, we propose A/B Agent, a closed-loop A/B agent for industrial recommendation strategy optimization. The framework comprises three tightly coupled core components: Historical Strategy Knowledge Organization, Autonomous Target-Aware Strategy Generation, and Experiment-Guided Strategy Self-Evolution. It organizes historical strategies into a hierarchical experience tree, retrieves transferable evidence through multi-path Tree-RAG to generate executable strategies, and continuously analyzes online A/B feedback to guide autonomous tuning and update the experience tree for self-evolution. Extensive offline and online evaluations demonstrate its effectiveness, including a 4.829% improvement in GMV in a real-world short-video e-commerce recommendation system while maintaining positive gains across all guardrail metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A/B Agent，一个面向工业推荐策略优化的闭环 A/B 智能体。它将历史策略组织成分层经验树 (hierarchical experience tree)，通过多路径 Tree-RAG 检索可迁移证据并生成可执行策略，再根据线上 A/B 反馈自动调参并更新经验树实现自进化。离线与在线评估显示，在真实短视频电商推荐系统中 GMV 提升 4.829%，且所有护栏指标 (guardrail metrics) 保持正向收益。
Motivation: 工业推荐策略迭代依赖大规模 A/B 实验，传统人工调参流程劳动密集且耗时；历史实验知识碎片化，难以系统复用。现有 RAG 智能体以扁平方式组织经验，忽略业务场景、推荐阶段、优化目标与实验上下文之间的层级关系，导致检索不匹配、跨场景迁移有限，也无法通过 A/B 反馈持续优化策略与参数。
Method: 提出包含三个紧密耦合组件的闭环框架：历史策略知识组织、自主目标感知策略生成、实验引导的策略自进化。具体包括将历史策略组织为分层经验树，通过多路径 Tree-RAG 检索可迁移证据以生成可执行策略，并持续分析线上 A/B 反馈来指导自动调参与更新经验树。
Result: 离线与在线评估表明方法有效：在真实短视频电商推荐系统中 GMV 提升 4.829%，同时所有护栏指标均保持正向收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层经验组织、多路径检索与 A/B 反馈闭环相结合，可实现工业推荐策略的自动化迭代与跨场景迁移；但在线结果仅报告了单一业务场景，其他实验细节未在摘要中给出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masked diffusion enables coherent beat tracking
papers.abstract_en: Current neural networks for beat tracking generate invalid outputs, such as consecutive downbeats and erratic tempo changes, even when these are not present in the training data. Heavy post-processing techniques can alleviate these problems, but the original cause of this inconsistent behaviour remains unknown. We hypothesise that it stems from inadequate modelling of multiple plausible output beat grids, resulting in an invalid mixture of competing interpretations. We propose a masked diffusion approach that properly models multiple outputs and enables the model to build coherent predictions through iterative inference. We devise three modifications to standard masked diffusion that enable its application to beat tracking: independent masking of beats and downbeats during training and inference, a balanced masking scheduler for inference, and peak-picking across inference steps. Our approach reduces erratic behaviours and improves beat-tracking performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络节拍跟踪（beat tracking）输出无效结果（如连续下拍、异常速度变化）的问题，提出掩码扩散（masked diffusion）方法，通过迭代推理构建连贯的节拍网格预测。作者对标准掩码扩散做了三项修改：训练与推理时独立掩码节拍和下拍、平衡掩码调度器、跨推理步骤的峰值拾取，从而减少不稳定行为并提升跟踪性能。
Motivation: 现有节拍跟踪神经网络即使训练数据中不存在异常模式，也会生成连续下拍和剧烈速度变化等无效输出；重度后处理只能缓解问题，未解决根源。作者假设根源在于对多个合理输出节拍网格的建模不足，导致竞争解释被无效混合。
Method: 提出掩码扩散方法以显式建模多个可能的输出节拍网格，并通过迭代推理逐步形成一致预测。针对节拍跟踪任务设计了三项修改：训练和推理阶段对节拍与下拍分别独立掩码、推理时使用平衡的掩码调度器、在推理步骤间进行峰值拾取。
Result: 摘要报告该方法减少了异常行为并提升了节拍跟踪性能，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为合理的多输出建模和迭代推理能解决节拍跟踪中的不一致性问题，其适用性基于所提出的三类掩码扩散改进。

papers.title: Visual Anchoring in Diffusion: Multimodal Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Skeleton Action Recognition (ZSAR) remains ambiguous when unseen actions share similar skeleton joint dynamics but differ in objects or scene context. RGB provides these missing cues, yet existing multimodal methods typically maintain independent skeleton and RGB scoring branches and fuse their outputs. Without using unlabeled test data for adaptation or fusion calibration, a fixed fusion weight cannot capture class-pair-dependent modality reliability, while an adaptive rule lacks target-side feedback for deciding which branch should dominate. We bypass this weight-selection problem via the classify-by-generation paradigm, where each class is scored by how accurately a text-conditioned denoiser predicts the noise added to the skeleton feature. This formulation separates the progressively corrupted skeleton from fixed conditioning, allowing RGB and text to jointly condition a single class-scoring function rather than produce independent scores. We instantiate this idea as Multimodal Triplet Diffusion for Skeleton-Text Matching (TDSM-MM), augmenting a text-conditioned denoising Transformer with a non-diffused RGB condition token that serves as a stable visual anchor during skeleton data reconstruction. Our proposed TDSM-MM has been ablated via extensive experiments and achieved the best inductive accuracy on three of four NTU-60/120 splits and surpasses the transductive state-of-the-art on NTU-120 96/24 (i.e., 71.3% vs. 69.1%), without test-time adaptation, suggesting that diffusion-based methods can be a promising direction for zero-shot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的多模态零样本骨架动作识别方法 TDSM-MM，采用 classify-by-generation 范式：用文本条件去噪器对骨架特征预测噪声的准确度来给类别打分，并引入非扩散的 RGB 条件 token 作为视觉锚点。实验在 NTU-60/120 的四个划分中三个取得最佳归纳精度，并在 NTU-120 96/24 上以 71.3% 超过 69.1% 的直推式（transductive）先进方法，且无需测试时自适应。
Motivation: 零样本骨架动作识别在未见动作具有相似骨架关节点动态但物体或场景上下文不同时仍存在歧义；RGB 能提供缺失线索，但现有多模态方法通常维持独立骨架与 RGB 打分分支再融合输出，固定融合权重无法刻画类别对相关的模态可靠性，自适应规则又缺少目标侧反馈来决定哪个分支应主导。
Method: 绕过权重选择问题，采用 classify-by-generation 范式：每个类别按文本条件去噪器预测骨架特征所加噪声的准确程度打分；该公式将逐渐被破坏的骨架与固定条件分离，使 RGB 与文本联合条件化单一类别打分函数。具体实例 TDSM-MM 在文本条件去噪 Transformer 上增加一个非扩散的 RGB 条件 token，作为骨架数据重建期间稳定的视觉锚点。
Result: 消融实验表明 TDSM-MM 在 NTU-60/120 的四个划分中三个取得最佳归纳精度；在不使用测试时自适应的情况下，于 NTU-120 96/24 上达到 71.3%，超过直推式先进方法的 69.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为扩散方法可成为零样本学习的有前景方向；该方法无需测试时自适应，但适用场景为骨架动作识别，与天气相关任务无关。

summary_sections.motivation: 零样本骨架动作识别在未见动作具有相似骨架关节点动态但物体或场景上下文不同时仍存在歧义；RGB 能提供缺失线索，但现有多模态方法通常维持独立骨架与 RGB 打分分支再融合输出，固定融合权重无法刻画类别对相关的模态可靠性，自适应规则又缺少目标侧反馈来决定哪个分支应主导。
summary_sections.method: 绕过权重选择问题，采用 classify-by-generation 范式：每个类别按文本条件去噪器预测骨架特征所加噪声的准确程度打分；该公式将逐渐被破坏的骨架与固定条件分离，使 RGB 与文本联合条件化单一类别打分函数。具体实例 TDSM-MM 在文本条件去噪 Transformer 上增加一个非扩散的 RGB 条件 token，作为骨架数据重建期间稳定的视觉锚点。
summary_sections.result: 消融实验表明 TDSM-MM 在 NTU-60/120 的四个划分中三个取得最佳归纳精度；在不使用测试时自适应的情况下，于 NTU-120 96/24 上达到 71.3%，超过直推式先进方法的 69.1%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为扩散方法可成为零样本学习的有前景方向；该方法无需测试时自适应，但适用场景为骨架动作识别，与天气相关任务无关。

papers.title: DAC-Pose: Dual-Agent Collaborative Framework for Pose-Guided Human Generation
papers.abstract_en: AI agents have emerged as a powerful new paradigm in generative image synthesis, enabling systems to perform complex semantic reasoning rather than passive pixel-level mapping. In pose-guided human generation, conventional methods inevitably produce severe visual artifacts under drastic viewpoint shifts, fundamentally because they lack the cognitive capacity to logically deduce unseen regions and model complex spatial deformations. To bridge this gap, we propose DAC-Pose, a novel agent-driven multimodal framework that reformulates single-view human generation as a collaborative dual-agent system. DAC-Pose integrates two complementary components, namely, the Prior Semantic Reasoning (PSR) agent and the Discrepancy-Aware Visual Encoding (DAVE) agent. Functioning as a cognitive engine, PSR utilizes collaborative reasoning to deduce the fine-grained attributes of unseen regions. Concurrently, acting as a specialized visual perception agent, DAVE quantifies and encodes viewpoint-induced spatial misalignments, continuously feeding robust spatial constraints back into the generative process. This autonomous feedback loop between semantic deduction and visual perception ensures high-fidelity detail synthesis. Extensive experiments on the DeepFashion and Market-1501 benchmarks validate the superiority of our agent-driven paradigm. Notably, DAC-Pose excels in preserving texture alignment and identity consistency under drastic viewpoint changes. The code is available at https://github.com/AIVRC/DAC-Pose.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAC-Pose，一个面向姿态引导人体生成的双智能体协作框架，将单视角人体生成重构为 Prior Semantic Reasoning (PSR) 与 Discrepancy-Aware Visual Encoding (DAVE) 两个智能体的协同推理与感知循环。PSR 负责推断不可见区域的细粒度属性，DAVE 量化视角变化引起的空间错位并提供鲁棒空间约束，从而在剧烈视角变化下保持纹理对齐与身份一致性。在 DeepFashion 和 Market-1501 基准上的实验验证了该智能体驱动范式的有效性，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有姿态引导人体生成方法在剧烈视角变化下会产生严重视觉伪影，根本原因是缺乏逻辑推理不可见区域和建模复杂空间形变的能力，而非单纯的像素级映射问题。
Method: 提出双智能体协作框架 DAC-Pose：PSR 智能体作为认知引擎，通过协作推理推断不可见区域的细粒度属性；DAVE 智能体作为视觉感知模块，量化并编码视角引起的空间错位，持续向生成过程反馈空间约束，形成语义推理与视觉感知之间的自主反馈循环。
Result: 在 DeepFashion 和 Market-1501 基准上的实验表明，DAC-Pose 在剧烈视角变化下特别擅长保持纹理对齐和身份一致性，验证了智能体驱动范式的优越性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将生成任务建模为协作双智能体系统可显著改善姿态引导人体生成在极端视角下的细节保真度，并公开了代码以促进复现。

papers.title: Agreement Before Diversity: Verification-First Complementarity for Heterogeneous Language-Model Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous language-model ensembles expand the space of candidate responses, yet they lack a principled criterion for when a newly generated answer should supersede an already supported one. We decouple candidate headroom from replacement authority, rendering the latter as an explicit, auditable object. Our proposed method, Agreement-Before-Diversity (ABD), is a frozen, label-free decision rule: an anchor answer is retained if two additional trusted samples corroborate it under a fixed equivalence relation; otherwise, it is replaced by a heterogeneous synthesis. For this gating mechanism, we prove two exact identities. The first shows that the accuracy gap relative to unconditional synthesis is determined jointly by the agreement coverage and the anchor's advantage on the protected subset. The second shows that the gap relative to never synthesizing reflects a contrast between authorized recovery and authorized destruction. Neither identity assumes independence or calibrated confidence, and the expected inference cost is approximately eight minus five times the coverage in number of calls. Under blind, exact-ID evaluation, ABD achieves 59.43% on the complete LiveCodeBench-v6 (vs. 52.57% for Single9 and 52.00% for HAC; n = 175) and 75.00% on an untouched GPQA-Diamond split (both controls at 72.78%; n = 180). Furthermore, these identities localize every aggregate difference to an enumerable protected stratum: no discordant items occur among the 3 protected cases on LiveCodeBench, where coverage bounds the gate's contribution to 1.71 points a priori; 13 versus 8 discordant cases among 132 on GPQA-Diamond; and 12 versus 0 among 71 under a frozen anchor perturbation. Diversity supplies potential; verification structure supplies authority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agreement-Before-Diversity (ABD)，一种冻结的、无需标签的决策规则，用于异构语言模型集成：当两个额外的可信样本在固定等价关系下佐证锚定答案时保留该答案，否则用异构合成 (heterogeneous synthesis) 替换。作者证明了两个精确恒等式，刻画该门控相对无条件合成与从不合成的准确率差距，且不假设独立性或校准置信度。在盲法、精确 ID 评估下，ABD 在 LiveCodeBench-v6 上达到 59.43%（对比 Single9 的 52.57% 和 HAC 的 52.00%，n=175），在未触碰的 GPQA-Diamond 划分上达到 75.00%（两个对照均为 72.78%，n=180）。
Motivation: 异构语言模型集成扩大了候选答案空间，但缺少一个原则性标准来判断一个新生成的答案何时应取代已有受支持的答案。作者主张将候选性能余量 (headroom) 与替换权 (replacement authority) 解耦，并将后者作为显式、可审计的对象。
Method: 提出 ABD 门控机制：锚定答案在固定等价关系下被两个额外可信样本佐证则保留，否则被异构合成替换；该规则冻结且无需标签。作者证明两个精确恒等式：相对无条件合成的准确率差距由一致性覆盖 (agreement coverage) 与锚定在受保护子集上的优势共同决定，相对从不合成的差距则反映授权恢复与授权破坏之间的对比。期望推理调用数约为 8 减 5 倍覆盖度。
Result: 盲法精确 ID 评估下，ABD 在完整 LiveCodeBench-v6 上达到 59.43%（Single9 为 52.57%，HAC 为 52.00%，n=175），在未触碰的 GPQA-Diamond 划分上达到 75.00%（两个对照均为 72.78%，n=180）。这些恒等式将聚合差异定位到可枚举的受保护层：LiveCodeBench 上 3 个受保护案例中无不一致项，覆盖度先验地将门控贡献限制在 1.71 分；GPQA-Diamond 上 132 例中不一致案例为 13 对 8；冻结锚定扰动下 71 例中为 12 对 0。
Conclusion: 作者强调，多样性提供潜力，验证结构提供权威；ABD 的可审计门控可以在不假设独立性或校准置信度的情况下提升异构集成准确率，并把误差来源局部化为可枚举的受保护子集。

papers.title: An entropic explanation of insistence on sameness in autism
papers.abstract_en: An information theory-based framework is proposed in attempt to explain insistence on sameness in autism as an instance of a general behavior pattern in which an individual tries to reduce surprise and uncertainty. It offers a new definition of autism as an impairment in which cognitive functions are restricted to discrimination, memorization and prediction of tangible properties of the environment. An analogy between insistence on sameness and constrained minimization of the entropy metric is observed and examined for a set of assumptions that describe cognitive limitations of a person with autism. The metric is given by the formula $D_H(R, M) = H(R|M) + H(M|R)$, where $R$ represents sequences of random stimuli, $M$ is a memory that stores and retrieves them, and where $H(.|.)$ denotes their conditional entropies interpreted as surprise and uncertainty, respectively. It is first inferred that to minimize the metric an individual can learn about $R$ (and store that knowledge in $M$) or can restrict $R$ to the already known $M$. Then, it is concluded that insistence on sameness is a manifestation of the latter. Moreover, it is shown that the proposed framework: (1) Helps to quantify the concepts of surprise, uncertainty, sensory overload and deprivation, anxiety, comfort zone, disappointment, disorientation, pedantry, rigidness, observance or aberrant precision. (2) Leads to a list of guidelines for learning therapies and daily care routines, and allows them to be defined as optimization algorithms and implemented as programs for robotic live-in caregivers. (3) Can be validated with the help of a Turing test-like approach that requires no experiments involving individuals with autism. The framework-if positively validated-will provide formal foundations and design guidelines for therapies aimed at improving self-reliance of individuals with autism in basic activities of daily living.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, a preprint of the accepted article
papers.journal_ref: Śliwiński P (2026) An entropic explanation of insistence on sameness in autism. Frontiers in Computational Neuroscience. 19:1714428
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于信息论的框架，将自闭症中的坚持相同性解释为个体试图减少惊讶和不确定性的普遍行为模式的具体表现。作者将自闭症定义为认知功能局限于对环境可感知属性的辨别、记忆和预测，并类比坚持相同性与熵度量约束最小化的关系。该度量由公式 D_H(R, M) = H(R|M) + H(M|R) 给出，其中 R 是随机刺激序列，M 是存储和检索它们的记忆。
Motivation: 现有对自闭症坚持相同性行为的解释缺乏形式化基础，本文尝试用信息论中的惊讶与不确定性概念来统一解释该行为，并提供一个可量化、可验证的理论框架。
Method: 提出熵度量 D_H(R, M)，论证最小化该度量有两种途径：学习刺激 R 并将其知识存入记忆 M，或把 R 限制为已知的 M，并推断坚持相同性是后一种策略的表现。框架还给出量化惊讶、不确定性、感觉过载等概念的方式，并导出可转化为优化算法的学习疗法与日常护理指南，以及无需自闭症个体参与实验的图灵测试式验证方法。
Result: 摘要称该框架能够量化惊讶、不确定性、感觉过载与剥夺、焦虑、舒适区、失望、迷失方向、迂腐、刻板、遵守或异常精确等概念；可生成学习疗法和日常护理指南，并将其定义为优化算法以实现机器人照护者程序；还可通过图灵测试式方法进行验证。
Conclusion: 该框架若得到正向验证，将为改善自闭症个体基本日常活动自理能力的疗法提供形式化基础和设计指南。

papers.title: Why Ranking Anomaly Detection Algorithms Isn't as Reliable as You May Think
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is a safety-critical machine learning problem with applications ranging from fraud detection to network intrusion prevention and industrial monitoring. Despite the large number of proposed anomaly detection algorithms, many novel methods claim state-of-the-art performance. However, many authors do so under benchmark settings that are not aligned with one another. This lack of comparability raises concerns regarding the reproducibility and reliability of anomaly detection benchmarks. In this work, we study the impact of common benchmarking choices on the stability of algorithm rankings. Using seven representative anomaly detection algorithms and 690 datasets from the OddBench benchmark suite, we analyze how rankings change under varying dataset selections, evaluation metrics, hyperparameter configurations, and random seeds. To quantify this effect, we introduce a rank instability metric measuring the variability of algorithm rankings across benchmark settings. Our results show that algorithm rankings in anomaly detection are highly unstable. In many cases, almost every competitive algorithm can appear as the best-performing method under some benchmark configuration. Among the studied factors, dataset selection and hyperparameter choice contribute most strongly to ranking uncertainty, while random seeds and evaluation metrics have a comparatively limited impact. We also observe that reliable benchmarking requires substantially larger and more diverse dataset collections than the ones commonly used in prior work.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICPR Workshop on Workshop on Reproducible Research in Pattern Recognition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异常检测（anomaly detection）算法基准测试中排名不稳定性的来源。作者使用七种代表性异常检测算法和 OddBench 基准套件中的 690 个数据集，系统变化数据集选择、评估指标、超参数配置和随机种子，并引入一种排名不稳定度量（rank instability metric）来量化排名变化。结果表明异常检测算法排名高度不稳定，数据集选择和超参数选择是排名不确定性的主要来源，而随机种子和评估指标影响相对有限。
Motivation: 异常检测是安全关键问题，但许多新方法在互不一致的基准设置下声称达到最佳性能，缺乏可比性，引发对异常检测基准可重复性和可靠性的担忧。
Method: 使用七种代表性异常检测算法在 690 个 OddBench 数据集上，通过变化数据集选择、评估指标、超参数配置和随机种子来系统分析排名变化，并引入排名不稳定度量量化算法排名在不同基准设置下的可变性。
Result: 算法排名在异常检测中高度不稳定，在许多情况下几乎每个竞争算法都能在某种基准配置下成为最佳方法。其中数据集选择和超参数选择贡献最大，随机种子和评估指标影响较有限；可靠基准测试需要比以往工作更大且更多样化的数据集集合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调异常检测算法间的排名比较应谨慎解读，并指出可靠的基准测试需要更大、更多样化的数据集集合。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究异常检测（anomaly detection）算法基准测试中排名不稳定性的来源。作者使用七种代表性异常检测算法和 OddBench 基准套件中的 690 个数据集，系统变化数据集选择、评估指标、超参数配置和随机种子，并引入一种排名不稳定度量（rank instability metric）来量化排名变化。结果表明异常检测算法排名高度不稳定，数据集选择和超参数选择是排名不确定性的主要来源，而随机种子和评估指标影响相对有限。

papers.title: The Order Is the Guarantee: Verifier-Budgeted Code Deletion with Static-First Learned Proposals
papers.abstract_en: Frontier coding models now match or exceed strong human reference points on programming benchmarks, yet benchmark success does not imply maintainable software. Prompt-driven "vibe coding" is additive: new branches, guards, and fallbacks accumulate faster than obsolete logic is removed. We study the inverse problem-how an Al system should remove code when execution-verification capacity is finite. We formulate redundant-code reduction as proposal scheduling: a ranker orders single-statement deletion candidates, an execution suite accepts the first candidate that passes, and a budget bounds how many candidates may be tested. Our central observation is that candidate order, not model confidence, is the control surface a deployment can reason about. DELSCOUT instantiates two schedules. Given representative target-domain validation, a five-slot budget spends three slots on deterministic shortest-first candidates and two on complementary learned candidates; across nine MBPP replications with 0.5B, 0.6B, and 8B rankers this raises verified-deletion coverage by 9.5% relative (+6.7 accepted tasks) while consuming slightly fewer verifier calls than the matched static baseline. Without such validation the same rankers can lose coverage under shift, so we instead evaluate the complete static prefix first and append learned candidates only afterwards; for a deterministic verifier this makes coverage and character reduction non-decreasing by construction, at a measured 4.8-62.5% increase in verifier calls. MBPP+ then erases the in-domain advantage, showing that scheduling governs search while the test suite alone governs what "preserving behavior" means. The result is an auditable division of labor: models widen the search for removable code, order bounds the damage a mis-ranked proposal can do, and execution retains authority over every committed deletion.

papers.title: HiSC: Hierarchical Spatial Clustering Token Compression for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) enable spatial reasoning over multi-view scenes but suffer from substantial token redundancy due to duplicated observations and large uninformative regions, leading to high computational cost. Although visual token compression has shown promise in accelerating 2D VLMs, it fails to capture the structured nature of 3D scenes and leads to incomplete spatial coverage and loss of fine-grained details. In this paper, we propose \textbf{HiSC}, a training-free framework for hierarchical spatial clustering token compression in 3D VLMs. HiSC lifts token compression from token-level selection to cluster-level processing by organizing tokens into spatially grounded clusters using joint geometric and semantic cues. Specifically, we first introduce a \textbf{spatial graph-based merging (SGraM) strategy} that models cross-view redundancy as spatial connectivity and consolidates physically consistent regions, effectively merging extremely similar redundant tokens prior to LLM inference. We then propose a \textbf{spatial clustering-based pruning (SCluP) paradigm} within LLM inference, which performs hierarchical compression across clusters and within clusters, preserving object instance completeness while retaining fine-grained details for important regions. Extensive experiments on diverse 3D reasoning benchmarks show validate the effectiveness of HiSC, particularly under high visual token pruning ratios. Besides, HiSC achieves over 90\% token reduction with minimal performance degradation. Code is accessible at https://github.com/elecreak/HiSC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiSC，一种用于 3D 视觉-语言模型 (3D VLM) 的训练无关 (training-free) 分层空间聚类 token 压缩框架。HiSC 将 token 压缩从 token 级选择提升到簇级处理，先通过空间图合并 (SGraM) 合并跨视角冗余 token，再在 LLM 推理内部用空间聚类剪枝 (SCluP) 做簇间与簇内分层压缩。在多种 3D 推理基准上验证有效，尤其在高视觉 token 剪枝率下，可实现超过 90% 的 token 削减且性能下降很小。
Motivation: 3D VLM 处理多视角场景时存在大量 token 冗余，来源包括重复观测和大的无信息区域，导致计算成本高；现有面向 2D VLM 的视觉 token 压缩方法无法捕捉 3D 场景的结构化特性，会造成空间覆盖不完整和细粒度细节损失。
Method: 提出训练无关框架 HiSC，使用联合几何与语义线索将 token 组织为空间接地簇 (spatially grounded clusters)。具体包含两种策略：SGraM（空间图合并）将跨视角冗余建模为空间连通性，在 LLM 推理前合并物理一致区域；SCluP（空间聚类剪枝）在 LLM 推理内部进行跨簇和簇内分层压缩，保留对象实例完整性及重要区域的细粒度细节。
Result: 在多种 3D 推理基准上的实验表明 HiSC 有效，尤其在高视觉 token 剪枝比下；摘要报告其实现超过 90% 的 token 削减，同时性能退化很小。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 token 压缩提升到空间簇级、结合几何与语义线索，可以在不训练的情况下显著降低 3D VLM 的计算开销，并为高剪枝率下的 3D 场景理解提供可行方案；代码已公开。

papers.title: On MUON optimization: From non-convergence to an error analysis with Polar Express and the Newton-Schulz polynomial from implementations
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimization methods are the standard instruments for the training of deep neural networks (DNNs). In many relevant artificial intelligence (AI) systems - such as popular large language models (LLMs)-not the standard SGD scheme is used as the optimization method but instead suitable accelerated variants of SGD are employed. One of the most popular methods of such accelerated SGD variants is the momentum orthogonalized by Newton-Schulz (MUON) optimizer proposed by Jordan et al. in 2024. The MUON optimizer exploits the special matrix structure of the weight parameters in the training of the DNNs and, in its original form, employs five Newton-Schultz (NS) matrix steps in each MUON iteration. In this work we propose and study a generalized variant of the MUON optimizer involving an arbitrary number of generalized NS steps with polynomials of possibly arbitrary high degree. The considered optimizer covers MUON with the original NS polynomial as well as MUON combined with the recently proposed Polar Express method as special cases. For a simple class of stochastic optimization problems (SOPs) we show for almost every mini-batch size that MUON fails to converge to the solution of the SOP as the number of gradient steps converges to infinity. We also establish an error analysis for MUON with the generalized NS steps that provides convergence rates in terms of the number of gradient steps and in terms of the size of the mini-batch. We illustrate our general error analysis for MUON in the case of several concrete examples including quadratic stochastic optimization problems (SOPs) as well as $\ell_2$ regularized logistic regression for binary classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 2024 年 Jordan 等人提出的 MUON 优化器（momentum orthogonalized by Newton-Schulz）的理论性质，并提出其广义变体：在每次 MUON 迭代中使用任意数量的广义 Newton-Schulz（NS）步骤，这些步骤允许任意高次多项式。作者对一类简单的随机优化问题（SOP）证明，在几乎所有的 mini-batch 尺寸下，MUON 不收敛到问题解；同时给出广义 NS 步骤下的误差分析，得到关于梯度步数和 mini-batch 尺寸的收敛率，并在二次 SOP 与 ℓ2 正则化逻辑回归等例子中加以说明。
Motivation: MUON 在大型语言模型训练中作为加速 SGD 变体被广泛采用，但其收敛性缺乏理论保证，原始实现固定使用五次 NS 矩阵步骤，且对 mini-batch 尺寸的依赖不清楚。本文旨在填补这一理论空白并推广该优化器。
Method: 提出采用任意数量、任意次多项式广义 NS 步骤的 MUON 一般化版本，将原始 NS 多项式与 Polar Express 方法作为特例纳入统一框架；在此基础上证明非收敛性并建立误差分析。
Result: 对一类简单 SOP，证明了在几乎所有 mini-batch 尺寸下 MUON 随梯度步数趋于无穷而不收敛到解；建立包含梯度步数和 mini-batch 尺寸的收敛率估计，并在二次 SOP 与 ℓ2 正则化逻辑回归上给出具体说明。
Conclusion: 作者指出通用 MUON 系列中的非收敛现象，并通过广义 NS 多项式框架给出可验证的误差界；分析限于简单随机优化问题类别，未直接覆盖深层神经网络训练场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRCoRSurg: Temporal-Relational Co-Reasoning for Surgical Video Triplet Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding complex surgical scenes requires recognizing multiple interdependent entities, such as instruments, actions, and targets, while maintaining their relational consistency across time. Existing surgical triplet recognition methods struggle to jointly model intra-frame label dependencies and inter-frame temporal semantics in a unified manner. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework that integrates spatial, relational, and temporal cues for robust surgical triplet recognition. Specifically, class-specific spatial priors are first extracted through a multi-scale encoder. These priors are then refined by a Label Correlation Modeling module with multi-scale class activation map-guided relational extraction (MS-CAMRE), enabling the model to capture both static co-occurrence patterns and dynamic contextual dependencies among triplet components. Furthermore, a Bidirectional Temporal-Relational Fusion Attention (BTRFA) module harmonizes temporal and relational representations to achieve coherent temporal reasoning. We also introduce a new evaluation metric, the Triplet Consistency Error Rate (TCER), which quantitatively measures the model's ability to preserve causal and semantic consistency across triplets. Extensive experiments on the CholecT45 and ProstaTD datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving AP_IVT by 5.1 percent and 7.8 percent, respectively. Moreover, according to TCER, our approach achieves relative reductions of more than 36 percent and 25 percent on the two datasets, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework in temporal-relational co-reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出统一框架 TRCoRSurg，用于手术视频三元组识别（器械-动作-目标，instrument-action-target）。框架先由多尺度编码器提取类特定空间先验，再经带多尺度类激活图引导关系提取（MS-CAMRE）的标签关联建模模块和双向时序-关系融合注意力（BTRFA）统一建模帧内标签依赖与帧间时序语义，并引入新评估指标 TCER。在 CholecT45 和 ProstaTD 数据集上 AP_IVT 分别提升 5.1% 和 7.8%，TCER 相对降低超过 36% 和 25%。
Motivation: 现有手术三元组识别方法难以在统一框架中联合建模帧内标签依赖和帧间时序语义，而复杂手术场景需要识别器械、动作、目标等多种相互依赖实体并维持其跨时间的关系统一性。
Method: 提出统一框架：先通过多尺度编码器提取类特定空间先验；再由 MS-CAMRE 模块进行标签关联建模，同时捕捉静态共现模式和动态上下文依赖；最后用 BTRFA 模块融合时序与关系表征，实现连贯的时序推理，并定义新指标 TCER 衡量跨三元组的因果和语义一致性。
Result: 在 CholecT45 和 ProstaTD 数据集上达到最先进水平，AP_IVT 分别提升 5.1% 和 7.8%；按 TCER 指标，两数据集分别获得超过 36% 和 25% 的相对降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调空间、关系和时序线索的统一建模能有效提升手术视频三元组识别的性能与时序-关系共推理能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: COSMO: Consensus-Driven Shift Modulation for Source-Free Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a source-trained model to an unlabeled target domain without source data, a practical setting under privacy or storage constraints. Yet its self-generated supervision can reinforce source bias under substantial domain shifts. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) offer complementary semantic knowledge, but the relative reliability of the source model and VLM varies across target samples. Existing cross-model guidance does not explicitly account for this variation and may overwrite valid source-derived evidence under conflict, a failure we term source-derived evidence forgetting. We formulate VLM-guided SFDA as a sample-wise reliability-allocation problem and propose Consensus-Driven Shift Modulation (COSMO). COSMO replaces expert-to-expert guidance with co-adaptation through an anchored shared consensus. It first forms a sample-specific initial consensus that favors the more concentrated prediction. During adaptation, COSMO re-aggregates both branches' evolving evidence and regulates how far the resulting consensus moves from its initial anchor based on consensus uncertainty and training progress. This keeps the shared supervision anchored yet adaptive. Across four benchmarks, COSMO achieves state-of-the-art performance under matched VLM backbones. Further analyses indicate that it better balances the retention of valid source-derived evidence with the absorption of complementary VLM evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Consensus-Driven Shift Modulation (COSMO)，用于源自由域适应 (source-free domain adaptation, SFDA)，将 VLM 引导的 SFDA 形式化为样本级可靠性分配问题。COSMO 用锚定共享共识替代专家间直接引导，实现源模型与 VLM 两支的共适应，避免冲突时覆盖有效源证据。在四个基准上，匹配相同 VLM 主干时达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: SFDA 仅用目标域无标签数据适配源训练模型，在域偏移较大时自生成监督会强化源偏差；而预训练 VLM 与源模型的相对可靠性随样本变化，现有跨模型引导未显式考虑这种变化，冲突时可能覆盖有效源证据，造成 source-derived evidence forgetting。
Method: COSMO 先基于两支预测中更集中的预测形成样本级初始共识，再在适应过程中重新聚合两分支演化的证据，并根据共识不确定性和训练进度调节最终共识相对初始锚点的移动幅度，使共享监督保持锚定又自适应。
Result: 在四个基准数据集中，COSMO 在匹配的 VLM 主干设置下取得 state-of-the-art 性能；进一步分析表明它能更好地平衡保留有效源证据与吸收 VLM 互补证据。
Conclusion: 摘要指出将 VLM 引导的 SFDA 视为样本级可靠性分配，并借助锚定共识进行共适应，可以缓解源证据遗忘并提升域适应效果。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: Rethinking Reservoir Pruning: A Dynamical Perspective for Echo State Networks
papers.abstract_en: Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer an efficient framework for temporal prediction, but their randomly initialized reservoirs are often over-parameterized and dynamically redundant. Existing pruning methods largely rely on static connectivity or activation statistics, which may overlook neurons that shape input-driven state transitions. We propose Dynamical Mode Pruning (DMP), a reservoir pruning method that ranks neurons by their contribution to dominant transition modes obtained from a trajectory-averaged Jacobian Gramian. DMP removes low-impact units and retrains only the readout. Experiments on chaotic and real-world time-series benchmarks show that DMP improves or preserves forecasting accuracy while reducing redundant reservoir components. Our results suggest that dynamical influence is a useful criterion for reservoir refinement beyond static structural importance alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamical Mode Pruning (DMP)，一种针对回声状态网络 (Echo State Network, ESN) 的储备池剪枝方法。DMP 通过轨迹平均的 Jacobian Gramian 获取主导转移模态，按神经元对这些模态的贡献排序，移除低影响单元并仅重训读出层。在混沌和真实世界时间序列基准上，DMP 能提高或保持预测精度，同时减少冗余的储备池组件。
Motivation: 现有 ESN 剪枝方法多依赖静态连接或激活统计，可能忽略塑造输入驱动状态转移的神经元；而随机初始化的储备池通常过参数化且动力学冗余。
Method: 提出 DMP，利用轨迹平均的 Jacobian Gramian 得到主导转移模态，依据神经元对这些模态的贡献进行排序和剪枝，移除低影响单元后只重训读出层。
Result: 在混沌和真实世界时间序列基准上，DMP 相比静态重要性剪枝能够提高或保持预测精度，同时减少冗余储备池组件。
Conclusion: 结果表明动力学影响 (dynamical influence) 是超越静态结构重要性的储备池精简准则；摘要未涉及降水或天气领域的扩展。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: When Absence Is Evidence: Evaluating Completeness-Sensitive Negative Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked whether something is absent from a record, list, or retrieved context. Yet non-observation licenses a negative answer only when evidence completely covers the query scope; otherwise, the answer should remain unknown. We call this completeness-sensitive negative reasoning. We introduce CROWN-QA, comprising CROWN-Synth, a controlled paired core that fixes the question and observed facts while varying only query-relative coverage, and CROWN-Real, a real-document contrast-set evaluation with controlled coverage variants. Across three LLM families, models show unstable closure judgments and substantial over-closure, failing to reliably distinguish a justified negative answer (Certified-Negative) from insufficient evidence (Unknown). The dominant CROWN-Synth failure is asymmetric: models often recognize implicitly complete evidence yet treat implicitly partial evidence as query-covering. Prompting redistributes errors between over- and under-closure rather than consistently resolving them. Structured certificate elicitation traces many errors to evidence-coverage mischaracterization. CROWN-Real shows that the core partial-coverage asymmetry persists on real-document content, while its strength and the balance between over- and under-closure vary by model, prompt, and source.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在处理‘某事物是否缺失’类问题时的推理能力，提出完整性敏感否定推理 (completeness-sensitive negative reasoning) 的概念，并构建 CROWN-QA 基准，包含控制变量的成对合成核心 CROWN-Synth 与真实文档对照集 CROWN-Real。在三个 LLM 家族上的实验显示，模型难以可靠区分合理否定答案 (Certified-Negative) 与证据不足 (Unknown)，存在显著过度闭合 (over-closure) 和不对称失败模式。
Motivation: LLM 经常被询问某记录、列表或检索上下文中是否缺少某事物，但只有在证据完整覆盖查询范围时，非观察 (non-observation) 才能支持否定答案，否则应回答 Unknown；现有模型对此缺乏可靠判别能力。
Method: 提出 CROWN-QA 评估框架：CROWN-Synth 固定问题与已知事实、仅变化查询相对覆盖度以形成受控配对样本；CROWN-Real 则基于真实文档构造覆盖度可控的对照集，并在多个 LLM 家族上测试，辅以结构化证书抽取 (structured certificate elicitation) 分析错误来源。
Result: 摘要报告模型在闭合判断上不稳定且存在显著过度闭合，常把隐式部分证据误判为覆盖查询；提示策略只能在过度闭合与欠闭合之间重新分配错误而非一致解决；CROWN-Real 显示部分覆盖不对称性在真实文档上持续存在，其强度与误差平衡随模型、提示和来源变化。
Conclusion: 作者强调模型需要更好的完整性敏感否定推理能力，并将多数错误追溯至对证据覆盖度的错误刻画；该研究表明仅靠提示调整无法稳定改善此类推理。
Relevance: 5
