papers.title: Joint UAV Flight and Opportunistic Routing under Reinforcement Learning for Delay-Tolerant Networks
papers.abstract_en: The growing deployment of delay-tolerant networks (DTNs) has made store-carry-forward (SCF) communication indispensable under sparse connectivity. However, intermittent contacts, finite buffers, and limited message time-to-live (TTL) often give rise to sparse delivery and congestion, leading to substantial end-to-end performance degradation. To address this challenge, this study explores the joint optimization of decentralized opportunistic routing and controllable unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight, aiming to enlarge future contacts through discrete UAV headings while enabling per-node replication under contact-limited observations. Building upon this architecture, we study cooperative factored routing--UAV control under centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) and propose JUROR (Joint UAV flight and Opportunistic Routing, based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework. In our design, we first cast the problem as a factored partially observable Markov decision process with sequential motion--routing coupling and a per-step team reward; subsequently, decentralized actors act on local observations while a training-time critic uses global statistics, and an optional multi-horizon hotspot predictor provides auxiliary supervision. Simulation results over four traffic modes demonstrate effective gains over PRoPHET and MaxProp, while retaining contact-limited decentralized execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究延迟容忍网络（DTN）中无人机（UAV）飞行与机会路由的联合优化问题，提出基于近端策略优化（PPO）的 JUROR 框架。作者将问题建模为带序贯运动-路由耦合的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（factored POMDP），采用集中训练与分散执行（CTDE）架构，使分散演员基于局部观测决策，训练时评论家利用全局统计信息。仿真结果表明，在四种流量模式下 JUROR 相比 PRoPHET 和 MaxProp 有性能提升，同时保持接触受限的分散执行。
Motivation: DTN 在稀疏连接下依赖存储-携带-转发（SCF）通信，但间歇接触、有限缓冲和消息 TTL 会导致投递稀疏与拥塞，造成端到端性能显著下降。现有研究缺乏对分散机会路由与可控 UAV 飞行的联合优化，而 UAV 的航向决策可以主动扩大未来接触机会。
Method: 提出 JUROR 框架，将联合优化问题建模为 factored POMDP，包含顺序的运动-路由耦合与每步团队奖励；在 CTDE 范式下，分散演员使用局部观测，训练期评论家使用全局统计信息，并提供可选的多时域热点预测器（multi-horizon hotspot predictor）作为辅助监督。
Result: 摘要报告在四种流量模式的仿真中，JUROR 相比 PRoPHET 和 MaxProp 取得有效增益，同时保留接触受限条件下的分散执行能力。
Conclusion: 本文强调将 UAV 航向控制与逐节点复制决策联合优化可以提升 DTN 投递性能，并通过 CTDE 在训练时利用全局信息、执行时保持分散性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: EgoCross is a cross-domain egocentric video question answering benchmark designed to evaluate whether multimodal large language models can generalize beyond common daily-life scenarios. The first EgoCross Challenge was hosted at the Third EgoVis Workshop at CVPR 2026 and evaluated models on first-person videos from four target domains: surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal perspectives. Each test example consists of an egocentric video clip, a question, and four candidate answers, from which the model must select the correct option. This technical report introduces the challenge task, benchmark resources, and two official Codabench tracks. The Source-Limited Track restricts participants to the official baseline model and a small support set, whereas the Open-Source Track permits broader choices of models and training data under rules that prohibit the manual construction of target-domain training data. In total, the challenge received more than 1,500 submissions from over 130 participants, with 19 teams participating in the Open-Source Track and 38 teams in the Source-Limited Track. We further present the official leaderboard results and summarize the winning solutions from both tracks. We hope that this report will serve as a useful technical reference for advancing cross-domain egocentric video understanding. All resources, including the challenge data, baseline implementation, and code released by the winning teams, are made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 EgoCross，一个跨领域第一视角视频问答基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型能否泛化到手术、工业装配、极限运动和动物视角四个目标领域。首次 EgoCross 挑战赛在 CVPR 2026 的第三届 EgoVis 研讨会上举办，包含 Source-Limited 与 Open-Source 两个官方 Codabench 赛道，共收到超过 1500 次提交、来自 130 多名参与者。报告还公布了官方排行榜结果并总结了两个赛道的获胜方案。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型通常只在常见日常生活场景的第一视角视频上评测，缺少对跨领域泛化能力的系统检验；EgoCross 旨在评估模型能否推广到非日常领域的第一视角视频问答任务。
Method: 构建每个测试样本包含一段第一视角视频、一个问题与四个候选答案的视频问答基准，模型需选出正确选项。挑战赛设置两条赛道：Source-Limited Track 限制参与者使用官方基线模型和一个小规模支持集；Open-Source Track 允许更广泛的模型与训练数据选择，但禁止手工构造目标域训练数据。
Result: 挑战赛共收到超过 1500 次提交、来自 130 多名参与者，其中 19 支队伍参加 Open-Source Track，38 支队伍参加 Source-Limited Track。官方报告中公布了排行榜结果和两个赛道的获胜方案总结。
Conclusion: 作者希望该报告为推进跨领域第一视角视频理解提供技术参考，并已公开挑战数据、基线实现和获胜队伍代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EASy: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized LLM-based agents. However, most existing systems primarily optimize task success while giving limited consideration to execution efficiency under practical constraints such as executor capability and computational cost. Existing router-based methods have limited ability to reason over rich, evolving task contexts, multi-step dependencies, and intermediate execution feedback, and often generalize poorly to unseen executors. We propose EASy, a trainable agentic framework that jointly optimizes task performance and computational efficiency through reinforcement learning. EASy equips an LLM-based orchestrator with explicit knowledge of the capability and cost profiles of heterogeneous executors, enabling context-sensitive coordination beyond performance-only routing. It further introduces a milestone-plan-act workflow that decomposes complex tasks into manageable milestones, constructs dependency-aware execution graphs, assigns suitable executors, and parallelizes independent steps while adapting subsequent decisions to intermediate outcomes. To train the orchestrator, we develop a tree-structured rollout procedure that explores alternative milestone decompositions and execution plans, together with multi-component rewards that capture task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning, embodied decision-making, and deep research benchmarks show that EASy consistently achieves stronger performance-efficiency trade-offs than strong agentic baselines.

Motivation: 现有智能体系统大多只优化任务成功率，很少在真实约束下考虑执行器能力与计算成本；基于路由器的方法难以对丰富的演化上下文、多步依赖和中间执行反馈进行推理，且对未见执行器的泛化能力弱。
Method: 提出 EASy，一种可训练的智能体框架，用强化学习联合优化任务表现和计算效率；编排器被显式赋予异构执行器的能力与成本画像，实现超越纯性能路由的上下文敏感协调。系统采用 milestone-plan-act 流程，通过树结构 rollout 探索替代的里程碑分解与执行计划，并用包含任务正确性、执行效率和轨迹完整性的多组件奖励来训练编排器。

papers.title: MetaVideoAgent: Automated Video-Agent Evolution for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding requires locating sparse, question-relevant evidence in long, multimodal videos. Real-world video distributions differ in modality-specific information density, content structure, and evidence patterns, causing fixed video-agent designs to incur redundant processing or fail when mismatched. Extending automated agent evolution from text to video is challenging because full long-video execution makes candidate validation expensive, failures propagate across coupled evidence-processing stages, and complex preprocessing, perception tools, and localization strategies make code-level updates difficult to implement reliably. We introduce MetaVideoAgent, a framework that automatically evolves a video agent for a target distribution. It profiles information density and evidence requirements from sparsely sampled frames and associated queries to guide initial design, then compresses localized failures into independently executable minimal validation tasks. It constructs evidence-grounded Gold Paths, audits Student trajectories, aggregates recurring failures across samples, and attributes them to responsible modules. A modular agent representation constrains each update to the primary responsible module and its necessary dependencies. We further introduce VA-EvoBench, covering eight video distributions with separate evolution and held-out splits. With four evolution iterations per distribution, MetaVideoAgent improves every initial agent and raises macro-average accuracy from 38.44% to 51.47%, at an average evolution cost of 3.54M tokens per distribution. The evolved agents outperform the strongest prior fixed-design video agent by 6.39 percentage points while using the fewest tokens and video frames per question among the compared video agents. We will release all code and data to support reproducible research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaVideoAgent，一个面向目标视频分布自动演化视频智能体的框架，用于长视频理解中稀疏证据的定位。框架通过稀疏采样帧与关联查询刻画信息密度和证据需求，将局部失败压缩为可独立执行的最小验证任务，并基于证据构建 Gold Paths 来审计 Student 轨迹、归因失败模块。作者同时引入覆盖八个视频分布的 VA-EvoBench，每个分布仅四次演化迭代即提升所有初始智能体，宏平均准确率从 38.44% 提升到 51.47%，平均演化成本为每个分布 3.54M tokens。
Motivation: 长视频理解需要在多模态长视频中定位稀疏且与问题相关的证据，而真实视频分布在模态信息密度、内容结构和证据模式上存在差异，导致固定设计的视频智能体要么冗余处理要么因不匹配而失败。将自动化智能体演化从文本扩展到视频面临候选验证昂贵、失败在耦合证据处理阶段间传播、以及代码级更新难以可靠实现等挑战。
Method: MetaVideoAgent 先从稀疏采样帧和关联查询中刻画信息密度与证据需求以指导初始设计，再压缩局部失败为可独立执行的最小验证任务，构造证据支撑的 Gold Paths，审计 Student 轨迹，跨样本聚合重复失败并归因到负责模块。模块化智能体表示将每次更新限制在主负责模块及其必要依赖上，同时引入包含八个视频分布、带独立演化集和留出集的 VA-EvoBench。
Result: 在八个视频分布上，每个分布经过四次演化迭代后，MetaVideoAgent 改善了所有初始智能体，宏平均准确率从 38.44% 升至 51.47%，平均演化成本为 3.54M tokens。演化后的智能体比最强的固定设计视频智能体高出 6.39 个百分点，且在对比的视频智能体中每个问题使用的 tokens 和视频帧数最少。
Conclusion: 作者认为自动演化能够使视频智能体适配目标分布并显著提升长视频理解准确率，同时保持较低的资源开销；代码和数据将全部公开以支持可复现研究。摘要未讨论方法的失败模式或非视频领域的外推效果。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Breaking the Curse ofMultilinguality inMany-to-Many Speech-to-Text Translation via a Resource-AwareMixture of Speech Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant success in speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, when processing multilingual speech inputs, a single speech encoder shared across all languages suffers from the curse of multilinguality: languages at different resource levels compete for limited representation capacity, leading to strong high-resource performance but substantial degradation on low-resource speech. To address this problem and improve multilingual consistency, we propose MSRT, a novel framework built around a resource-aware Mixture of Speech Encoders (MoSE). MoSE uses an explicit language router to assign each utterance to an appropriate expert encoder. A frozen expert preserves high-resource language capabilities, while a trainable expert adapts to and specializes in medium- and low-resource languages. We further introduce a five-stage curriculum learning strategy that substantially reduces data dependence, requiring only 10 hours of paired S2TT data per language for effective alignment. We conduct extensive experiments on 45 languages, systematically evaluating all $45 \times 44$ translation directions. Our 4B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming substantially larger baselines. Empirical analyses show that MoSE improves high-, medium-, and low-resource languages simultaneously, with the largest gains on low-resource speech, thereby breaking the curse of multilinguality without compromising high-resource performance. To support future multilingual S2TT research, we release our code and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言语音到文本翻译（S2TT）中单一共享语音编码器面临的多语言诅咒问题，提出 MSRT 框架，其核心是资源感知的语音编码器混合（MoSE）。MoSE 通过显式语言路由器将每条话语分配给专家编码器：冻结的专家保留高资源语言能力，可训练的专家专精中低资源语言；并引入五阶段课程学习策略，每语言仅需 10 小时配对数据即可有效对齐。作者在 45 种语言、全部 45×44 个翻译方向上实验，4B 参数模型达到当前最优，优于更大的基线模型，且同时改善高、中、低资源语言，低资源语音增益最大。
Motivation: 多语言 S2TT 中，单一共享语音编码器使不同资源量级语言竞争有限表示容量，导致高资源语言表现强而低资源语音明显退化；这种多语言诅咒降低了多语言一致性，需要专门的建模方案。
Method: 提出 MSRT 框架，围绕资源感知 MoSE 构建：用显式语言路由器把话语分配给合适的专家编码器；冻结一个专家编码器以保持高资源能力，训练另一专家编码器使其中低资源语言特化；此外加入五阶段课程学习，显著降低数据依赖，每语言只需 10 小时配对 S2TT 数据。
Result: 摘要报告在 45 种语言、系统评估全部 45×44 个翻译方向上的实验；4B 参数模型取得最优性能，超过规模明显更大的基线；MoSE 同时提升高、中、低资源语言，最大提升出现在低资源语音，且不损害高资源性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MoSE 有效打破了多语言诅咒，在不牺牲高资源表现的前提下改善低资源翻译，并公开代码与模型以支持后续多语言 S2TT 研究。

papers.title: ACA-GS: Adaptive-Capacity Anchored Gaussian Splatting for Compact Dynamic Radiance Fields
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) enable high-fidelity, real-time spatiotemporal rendering, but expose a fundamental trade-off between motion expressiveness and storage efficiency. While anchor-based designs achieve compactness through anchor-level parameter sharing, their rigid uniform parametrization enforces fixed Neural Gaussian counts and feature budgets per anchor. Consequently, insufficient fidelity is addressed by excessive anchor density, rather than lightweight, targeted increases in Neural Gaussian count or feature capacity, resulting in memory waste. To overcome this rigidity, we introduce an adaptive-capacity anchor-based framework that dynamically allocates the representational capacity based on local spatiotemporal demands. Adaptive Anchor Cardinality varies the number of Neural Gaussians per anchor, concentrating primitives in regions of high geometric or motion complexity while suppressing redundancy. In parallel, Adaptive Anchor Feature Masking modulates anchor-level feature channels, assigning rich features to complex regions and lightweight representations to simpler ones. Experiments on MPEG, Panoptic Sports, and N3DV datasets demonstrate substantial storage reduction without degrading visual quality. Notably, on challenging MPEG sequences with complex motion, our method achieves up to 1.5x higher compression than state-of-the-art anchor-based methods while preserving comparable quality.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACA-GS，一种自适应容量锚定高斯泼溅 (adaptive-capacity anchor-based Gaussian Splatting) 方法，用于紧凑动态辐射场。针对 anchor-based 4D Gaussian Splatting 中固定 Neural Gaussian 数量与特征预算导致内存浪费的问题，作者引入自适应 anchor 基数 (Adaptive Anchor Cardinality) 和自适应 anchor 特征掩码 (Adaptive Anchor Feature Masking)，按局部时空复杂度动态分配表示容量。在 MPEG、Panoptic Sports 和 N3DV 数据集上，摘要报告在保持视觉质量的同时显著降低存储，并在复杂运动的 MPEG 序列上比最先进 anchor-based 方法压缩率最高提升 1.5 倍。
Motivation: 4D Gaussian Splatting 在运动表达力与存储效率之间存在权衡；anchor-based 设计采用固定均匀参数化，强制每个 anchor 有固定 Neural Gaussian 数量和特征预算，导致为提升保真度只能增加 anchor 密度，造成内存浪费。
Method: 提出自适应容量 anchor-based 框架。Adaptive Anchor Cardinality 根据局部时空需求改变每个 anchor 的 Neural Gaussian 数量，在高几何或运动复杂度区域集中基元并抑制冗余；Adaptive Anchor Feature Masking 调制 anchor 级特征通道，为复杂区域分配丰富特征、为简单区域分配轻量表示。
Result: 在 MPEG、Panoptic Sports 和 N3DV 数据集上，摘要报告显著降低存储且不损害视觉质量；在复杂运动的 MPEG 序列上，相比最先进 anchor-based 方法压缩率最高提升 1.5 倍，同时保持相当质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过按局部时空复杂度动态分配表示容量，可以打破 anchor-based 4DGS 中固定参数化的刚性，在保持质量的同时提升压缩率。

papers.title: PhysMind: From Video to Executable Worlds for Training-Free Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable physical reasoning from video requires understanding how objects move, interact, and respond to interventions. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle to interpret these dynamics and reason reliably about future and counterfactual outcomes. We introduce PhysMind, a training-free agentic framework that constructs one reusable, question-agnostic executable world per video. PhysMind recovers a temporally consistent dynamic scene through object segmentation, mesh reconstruction, and 6D pose tracking, then fits analytic continuous-time dynamics and latent physical parameters without unrolling a time-stepped simulator. Given a question, it inspects, continues, or edits the world and answers from the resulting trajectories and interactions. Relative to direct chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with the same VLM, PhysMind improves accuracy by 38.23 points on CLEVRER and 8.08 points on Physion++. On counterfactual questions, it exceeds the strongest evaluated VLM baseline, GPT-5.5, by 19.25 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysMind 是一个免训练 (training-free) 的智能体框架，针对每个视频构建一个可复用、与问题无关的可执行世界 (executable world)，用于物理推理。它通过目标分割、网格重建和 6D 位姿跟踪恢复时间一致的动态场景，并拟合解析形式的连续时间动力学与潜在物理参数。给定问题时，框架对该世界进行检查、延续或编辑，并从生成的轨迹与交互中得出答案。相比同一 VLM 的直接 chain-of-thought (CoT) 推理，PhysMind 在 CLEVRER 上提升 38.23 点、在 Physion++ 上提升 8.08 点，在反事实问题上超过最强基线 GPT-5.5 达 19.25 点。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型 (VLM) 难以从视频中理解物体如何运动、相互作用以及对外部干预的响应，导致对未来和反事实结果的推理不可靠。
Method: PhysMind 先通过目标分割、网格重建和 6D 位姿跟踪恢复时间一致的动态场景，并拟合解析连续时间动力学和潜在物理参数，无需展开时间步进模拟；随后按问题检查、延续或编辑该可执行世界，从轨迹和交互中回答。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在同 VLM 的直接链式推理基础上，将 CLEVRER 准确率提升 38.23 点，Physion++ 提升 8.08 点；在反事实问题上超出最强 VLM 基线 GPT-5.5 达 19.25 点。
Conclusion: PhysMind 提供一种免训练的、每个视频一个可复用可执行世界的方式，以改善视频中的物理推理能力。

papers.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
papers.abstract_en: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. When retained text contains an answer but deleted text defines the entity needed to interpret it, we call the result referential dangling. At a compression ratio of 0.30, Beaver, which ranks coherent chunks using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, leaves the answer path incomplete in 34-54% of bridge examples across three multi-hop question answering datasets. On a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six hard compressors we test exhibit dangling at rates up to 60%, and every document in LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA contains at least one dangling reference. On dangling examples evaluated with Qwen3-8B, reinserting the missing supporting paragraph while removing nonsupporting paragraphs to maintain the token budget improves accuracy by 29-34 percentage points (p < 0.0001), recovering at least 88% of the gap to contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Stronger answer models do not absorb the loss: on MuSiQue, GPT-5.5 is 8.8 points less accurate on compressed contexts than on contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Finally, we train a compact classifier to rank omitted sentences by whether they are needed to interpret retained text and reinsert the top-ranked candidates without support annotations at inference. On HotpotQA with Qwen3-8B, this automatic restoration improves accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31. Hard compressors should optimize both relevance and referential completeness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别硬提示压缩（hard prompt compression）中的一种结构性失败模式：独立评分并保留高分段落的流程会拆分依赖的证据对，导致保留文本含有答案、但解释答案所需的实体定义被删除，作者称之为指称悬空（referential dangling）。在压缩率0.30下，Beaver 在多跳问答数据集的bridge示例上有34-54%的答案路径不完整；六个硬压缩器在HotpotQA上的悬空率最高达60%，LongBench-v2单文档问答的每个文档都至少含一处悬空引用。重新插入缺失的支持段落可显著提升准确率，且训练的分类器可在无需支持标注的情况下自动恢复被删句子。
Motivation: 已有硬提示压缩方法独立地对 token、句子或 chunk 打分并按预算保留高分单元，忽视了依赖证据对被拆分的问题；当保留答案而删除定义实体的文本时，下游模型无法正确解释答案。作者还指出，更强的答案模型也无法吸收这种由压缩引入的损失。
Method: 作者形式化定义 referential dangling，并在多个数据集上测量其发生率；随后训练一个紧凑分类器，对已删除句子按“是否被需要以解释保留文本”进行排序，推理时无需支持标注即可把排名靠前的候选句子重新插入到压缩上下文中。
Result: 在0.30压缩率下，Beaver 在三个多跳QA数据集的bridge示例上34-54%答案路径不完整；所有六个硬压缩器在共享HotpotQA集合上的悬空率最高达60%。使用Qwen3-8B评估时，重新插入缺失支持段落并移除非支持段落以维持token预算，准确率提升29-34个百分点（p < 0.0001），恢复至保留双支持段落的语境差距的至少88%；GPT-5.5在MuSiQue上压缩上下文比保留双支持段落低8.8个百分点。在HotpotQA上，自动恢复使准确率提升4.7点，压缩率仅从0.30变为0.31。
Conclusion: 硬压缩器应同时优化相关性和指称完整性（referential completeness），而不只是保留高相关性单元；自动恢复可在几乎不改变压缩率的情况下显著改善压缩上下文上的问答准确率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Talk2Sensors: 3D Visual Grounding in Autonomous Driving via Sensor-Adaptive Physical Cue Matching
papers.abstract_en: As a key capability for embodied intelligence, 3D visual grounding (3DVG) has been predominantly studied in indoor scenes with RGB-D or point-cloud inputs, while existing outdoor extensions largely rely on monocular images alone. Both settings fall short of real-world outdoor perception, where heterogeneous sensors capture complementary yet distinct physical properties, such as visual texture, 3D geometry, and object kinematics, that are indispensable for flexible and robust query-adaptive grounding but remain under-exploited. To bridge this gap, we introduce Talk2Sensors, the first multi-sensor 3D visual grounding dataset built upon camera, LiDAR, and 4D radar. It contains 8,682 language instructions and 20,558 referred objects, with diverse prompts explicitly aligned with sensor-specific physical cues. Furthermore, we propose TSFormer, a unified Transformer-based framework for language-guided 3D visual grounding in autonomous driving. TSFormer adopts a coarse-to-fine property-aware fusion strategy: the Language-Routed Property Sampler first performs coarse text-conditioned feature retrieval by modulating sensor sampling weights with query-level linguistic cues, while the subsequent Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter module conducts fine-grained modality arbitration and text-guided refinement to determine the precise referred spatial location. This design enables dynamic routing of appearance, geometry, and motion cues according to the semantic requirements of each prompt, preventing dense modalities from overwhelming sparse but critical sensor signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TSFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks: it improves over the strongest baseline by 8.05 mAP on Talk2Sensors, and transfers to the monocular Mono3DRefer benchmark with 53.05\% Acc@0.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Talk2Sensors，首个基于相机、LiDAR 与 4D 雷达的多传感器 3D 视觉定位 (3D visual grounding) 数据集，包含 8,682 条语言指令和 20,558 个被指目标，并为提示词显式对齐传感器特定的物理线索。作者进一步提出统一 Transformer 框架 TSFormer，采用由粗到细的属性感知融合策略，在 Talk2Sensors 上超过最强基线 8.05 mAP，并可迁移到单目 Mono3DRefer 基准取得 53.05% Acc@0.5。
Motivation: 现有 3D 视觉定位主要面向室内 RGB-D 或点云输入，室外扩展多依赖单目图像，未能利用真实室外感知中相机、LiDAR、4D 雷达等异构传感器提供的互补物理属性（视觉纹理、3D 几何、物体运动学），而这些线索对灵活鲁棒的查询自适应定位至关重要。
Method: 提出 TSFormer，一个用于自动驾驶语言引导 3D 视觉定位的统一 Transformer 框架，采用由粗到细的属性感知融合：Language-Routed Property Sampler 通过查询级语言线索调制传感器采样权重，进行粗粒度文本条件特征检索；Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter 模块执行细粒度模态仲裁与文本引导精化，确定精确的被指空间位置。
Result: 大量实验表明 TSFormer 在多个基准上达到最先进性能：在 Talk2Sensors 上比最强基线提升 8.05 mAP，并迁移到单目 Mono3DRefer 基准获得 53.05% Acc@0.5。
Conclusion: 该设计可根据每个提示词的语义需求动态路由外观、几何和运动线索，避免密集模态淹没稀疏但关键的单传感器信号，是多传感器室外 3D 视觉定位的一种有效方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于LLM的搜索代理面临的安全风险，指出搜索和页面观察的传递通道是脆弱的安全边界：在受限工具中介威胁模型下，即使每轮查询只追加一个受控结果，协调的轨迹级证据操控也能显著提升攻击成功率。作者提出策略驱动的长时程攻击系统，并引入Authority-Chain Hijack（ACH）策略，将孤立的搜索结果和页面内容操控转化为跨来源的连贯证据链，在完整SafeSearch测试集上达到55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR。还提出Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution（TGSE），从执行轨迹自动改进攻击策略，最强单一设置在留出评估中达到71.4% / 95.0%。
Motivation: 现有搜索代理安全研究主要关注静态网页内容注入，但现代代理会发出后续查询并交叉核对多个来源，单个被注入页面容易被稀释或拒绝；因此搜索和页面观察的传递通道本身是一个未被充分研究的脆弱安全边界，可能被利用来反复引导代理的证据收集和最终答案形成。
Method: 提出受限工具中介威胁模型，攻击者每轮查询仅向搜索结果中追加一个受控结果，并跨整个轨迹协调证据。引入Authority-Chain Hijack（ACH），一种专家精炼的攻击策略，把零散的搜索与页面操控组合成看似相互佐证的证据链；同时提出Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution（TGSE），从执行轨迹中自动演化更优攻击策略，替代手动设计。
Result: ACH在所有基线中取得最高Overall ASR，在完整SafeSearch测试集上达到55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR；TGSE的最强单一设置在留出评估中达到71.4% ASR / 95.0% MaxN ASR。
Conclusion: 摘要表明搜索工具返回内容是脆弱的安全通道，轨迹级协调攻击能显著提高成功率，并展示轨迹驱动策略演化可自动改进攻击者，而无需人工重新设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Is a Skill Worth? Structure-Aware Shapley Valuation of Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are increasingly optimized by automated feedback loops, producing long structured artifacts whose internal value remains unclear. We study skill valuation: assigning credit to the internal units of a fixed skill, such as rules, examples, scripts, and heuristics, under a fixed agent and held-out task distribution. Skill valuation differs from data or prompt-span valuation because skill units are structured: they may depend on other units, belong to a document hierarchy, trigger agent behavior, and consume limited prompt context. We introduce SkillSV, a structure-aware Shapley-style framework for skill valuation. SkillSV compiles a skill into units, dependencies, and hierarchy, so that only valid counterfactual skills are evaluated. It uses paired deletion and length-neutral padding to separate content value from context cost, and estimates the resulting values with a rollout-budgeted estimator for noisy agent evaluations. On four agentic benchmarks, we assess the faithfulness, actionability, and explanation of SkillSV: it recovers unit interactions, preserves aggregate skill lift, and guides safe pruning and compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体技能（agent skills）的内部估值问题，即在固定智能体和留出任务分布下，将信用分配给技能内部单元（规则、示例、脚本、启发式等）。作者提出结构感知的 Shapley 风格框架 SkillSV，将技能编译为单元、依赖关系和层级，只评估有效的反事实技能，并用成对删除和长度中性填充区分内容价值与上下文成本，配合有预算的 rollout 估计器处理噪声评估。在四个智能体基准上验证了其忠实性、可操作性和解释性。
Motivation: 智能体技能越来越多地由自动反馈回路优化，产生长结构化的工件，但其内部单元的价值不清晰。技能估值不同于数据或提示跨度估值，因为技能单元具有结构：可能依赖其他单元、属于文档层级、触发智能体行为并消耗有限的提示上下文。
Method: 提出 SkillSV，一种结构感知的 Shapley 风格估值框架。它将技能编译为单元、依赖关系和层级，从而只评估有效的反事实技能；使用成对删除（paired deletion）和长度中性填充（length-neutral padding）分离内容价值与上下文成本；并用 rollout-budgeted 估计器处理噪声的智能体评估。
Result: 在四个智能体基准上，SkillSV 能够恢复单元交互、保持聚合技能提升（aggregate skill lift），并指导安全的剪枝和压缩。摘要报告了其在忠实性（faithfulness）、可操作性（actionability）和解释性（explanation）方面的评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构感知的 Shapley 估值能为智能体技能的内部单元提供可靠信用分配，支持技能的安全剪枝和压缩；局限性未在摘要中具体说明。

papers.title: OutLangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting for UAV Outdoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting embeds open-vocabulary language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting, providing an efficient explicit representation for text-driven 3D scene understanding. However, existing methods are limited to indoor or small-scale scenes, and tend to fail in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) outdoor scenes, where severe occlusions and long distance viewpoints often lead to incorrect semantic activations and missing target responses. In this paper, we present OutLangSplat which adapts language Gaussian representations to UAV outdoor scenes by improving feature representation and aggregation reliability. For the feature representation, a 2D-3D dual-branch representation with region-based alignment and fusion is designed to improve spatial consistency, reducing incomplete target responses and background misactivations. For the feature aggregation, we introduce a training-free contribution and consistency-aware Gaussian feature aggregation strategy that leverages pixel contribution reliability and cross-view semantic consistency to suppress unreliable responses from noisy viewpoints. A new dataset is provided by manually annotating various objects on four real-world public UAV outdoor scene datasets. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first accessible dataset of open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding for UAV outdoor scenes. Quantitative evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate that OutLangSplat outperforms SOTA methods on both open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and instance localization tasks. The datasets and codes will be open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OutLangSplat，将 3D 语言高斯泼溅 (3D Language Gaussian Splatting) 适配到无人机 (UAV) 户外场景。方法包含 2D-3D 双分支特征表示与免训练的贡献和一致性感知高斯特征聚合，并在四个真实无人机户外数据集上人工标注构建了新数据集。摘要报告其在开放词汇语义分割与实例定位任务上优于现有 SOTA 方法，数据集与代码将开源。
Motivation: 现有 3D 语言高斯泼溅方法局限于室内或小规模场景，在无人机户外场景中会因严重遮挡和远距离视角导致语义激活错误与目标响应缺失。
Method: 设计 2D-3D 双分支特征表示，通过基于区域的对齐与融合提升空间一致性；并提出免训练的贡献与一致性感知高斯特征聚合策略，利用像素贡献可靠性和跨视图语义一致性抑制噪声视角带来的不可靠响应。
Result: 定量评估与消融实验表明，OutLangSplat 在开放词汇语义分割和实例定位任务上均优于 SOTA 方法，摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了首个面向无人机户外场景的开放词汇 3D 场景理解数据集，并计划开源数据集与代码。

papers.title: ColorFD: A Finite-Difference Guided Black-Box Physical Adversarial Attack for Remote Sensing Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although deep neural network-based remote sensing object detectors have achieved strong performance, they remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing studies mainly focus on digital or white-box settings, whereas black-box physical attacks remain underexplored. These attacks are often constrained by limited physical feasibility and inefficient optimization in high-dimensional search spaces. To address these challenges, this paper proposes ColorFD, a black-box physical attack based on multiple pure-color patches. The patch positions and color parameters are jointly optimized using Differential Evolution (DE). A target-wise fitness and selection mechanism evaluates the attack state of each target and preserves target-specific improvements during evolution. Two guidance strategies further constrain the patch search space. Key-region localization identifies sensitive regions through finite-difference color probing. Common-feature extraction provides category-level spatial priors and avoids repeated localization. Although evaluated on aircraft, the formulation is not inherently restricted to this category. Experiments on YOLOv3u, YOLOv5u, and Faster R-CNN show that ColorFD outperforms the tested black-box patch method across all evaluated detectors and remains competitive with strong white-box baselines. Physical-world experiments further demonstrate that the optimized pure-color patches can be transferred from the digital domain to real imaging conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ColorFD，一种基于多纯色色块的黑盒物理对抗攻击方法，用于遥感目标检测。该方法使用差分进化（DE）联合优化色块位置和颜色参数，并通过目标级适应度和选择机制、关键区域定位（有限差分颜色探测）和共同特征提取等策略约束搜索空间。在YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u和Faster R-CNN上的实验表明，ColorFD优于所测试的黑盒色块方法，并与强白盒基线相当，物理世界实验验证了纯色色块的可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注数字或白盒设置下的对抗攻击，黑盒物理攻击研究不足，且受限于物理可行性和高维搜索空间中的低效优化。
Method: 提出ColorFD，利用差分进化联合优化多个纯色色块的位置和颜色参数；引入目标级适应度和选择机制以保留特定目标的改进；采用关键区域定位（通过有限差分颜色探测识别敏感区域）和共同特征提取（提供类别级空间先验）两种引导策略约束补丁搜索空间。
Result: 在YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u和Faster R-CNN上的实验显示，ColorFD在所有评估检测器上优于所测试的黑盒色块方法，并与强大的白盒基线竞争；物理世界实验表明优化的纯色色块能从数字域迁移到真实成像条件。
Conclusion: 该方法在飞机类别上评估，但公式并不限于该类别；摘要强调黑盒物理攻击的可行性以及引导策略的有效性。

papers.title: VoxStruct3D: Structure-Leading Flow Matching for Voxel-Space 3D MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity 3D MRI synthesis requires both globally coherent anatomy and fine-grained voxel-level detail. Although latent diffusion makes volumetric generation tractable, its image autoencoder introduces a reconstruction bottleneck that can limit the fine detail recoverable in the final volume. We present VoxStruct3D, a voxel-space flow-matching framework that directly models full-resolution MRI volumes using a clean-data prediction objective. Its Volumetric Voxel Generator (VVG) combines factorized 3D patch embedding with overlapping upsampling, time-modulated residual refinement, and skip fusion, enabling neighboring tokens to jointly reconstruct shared voxel regions and suppress patch-boundary artifacts. To complement direct voxel-space modeling with an explicit anatomical prior, we further introduce a Structure-First, Image-Follows (SFIF) strategy. A frozen pretrained 3D medical encoder and a StructVAE extract compact structure tokens that preserve dominant anatomy, while a structure-leading schedule keeps their trajectory ahead of the image trajectory. Patch-Aligned RoPE spatially aligns the unequal token grids, and asymmetric attention enforces one-way guidance from structure to image. Experiments on pathological and healthy T1-weighted brain MRI datasets show that VoxStruct3D achieves the strongest overall performance across feature-distribution alignment, sample diversity, and perceptual quality, producing anatomically coherent and visually realistic volumes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VoxStruct3D，一种直接在体素空间建模全分辨率 3D MRI 的流匹配 (flow matching) 框架，使用 clean-data prediction 目标来避免潜空间自编码器的重建瓶颈。其 Volumetric Voxel Generator (VVG) 结合分解式 3D patch 嵌入、重叠上采样、时间调制残差精化与 skip fusion，以抑制 patch 边界伪影；同时引入 Structure-First, Image-Follows (SFIF) 策略，用冻结的 3D 医学编码器和 StructVAE 提取结构 token 引导图像生成。实验在病理与健康 T1 加权脑 MRI 数据集上表明该方法在特征分布对齐、样本多样性和感知质量方面取得最强综合性能。
Motivation: 潜在扩散模型虽然使体素级生成可行，但图像自编码器引入重建瓶颈，限制最终体素中可恢复的细粒度细节，因此需要直接在体素空间建模全分辨率 MRI 并显式加入解剖先验。
Method: VoxStruct3D 采用体素空间流匹配框架：VVG 用分解式 3D patch 嵌入与重叠上采样让相邻 token 联合重建共享体素区域，并用时间调制残差精化和 skip fusion 抑制 patch 边界伪影；SFIF 策略通过冻结的预训练 3D 医学编码器和 StructVAE 提取压缩结构 token，以结构领先的调度、Patch-Aligned RoPE 对齐不等长 token 网格，并用非对称注意力实现从结构到图像的单向引导。
Result: 在病理与健康 T1 加权脑 MRI 数据集上，VoxStruct3D 在特征分布对齐、样本多样性和感知质量上取得最强综合性能，生成解剖连贯且视觉真实的体素级体积。
Conclusion: 作者强调直接体素空间流匹配结合结构领先的引导策略，能够在保持全局解剖一致性的同时恢复细粒度体素细节，优于基于潜在扩散的体积生成方法。

papers.title: Representing Visual Evidence for Item Difficulty Prediction: Visual Textualization and Image-Native Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Predicting item difficulty from content can provide an initial estimate for newly developed questions before sufficient student responses are available. Existing approaches typically represent the question stem and answer choices as text. When mathematics items contain visual components, a common pipeline first textualizes that evidence and then applies a text predictor. We ask: how should visual evidence be represented for item difficulty prediction? We compare question text alone, visual textualization, which expresses visual evidence in language, and image-native modeling, which retains the original image. Using Eedi items with difficulty calibrated from student responses, we train large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) directly for difficulty regression. Both visual interfaces achieve the lowest point estimates, although the leading systems cannot be reliably ordered. Open-VLM textualization yields lower RMSE point estimates for all evaluated LLMs, while broader adaptation does so for all image-native VLMs. Test-time interventions show dependence on the paired full-item image, but do not isolate the additional visual component. The two visual interfaces also make partially complementary item-level errors and differ substantially in computational workflow. Thus, textualization should not be treated as the only practical interface: image-native modeling is a competitive alternative whose effectiveness depends on how the VLM is adapted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在基于内容预测题目难度时，视觉证据应如何表示。作者使用来自 Eedi 的、以学生作答校准过难度的题目，对比三种表示：仅题目文本、视觉文本化 (visual textualization)、以及保留原始图片的图像原生建模 (image-native modeling)，并直接训练 LLM 和 VLM 做难度回归。摘要报告两种视觉接口都取得最低的点估计误差，但领先系统之间无法可靠排序；图像原生建模是文本化的有竞争力替代方案。
Motivation: 现有方法通常把题干和选项当作文本处理；当数学题包含视觉成分时，常见流程是先对视觉证据做文本化，再用文本预测器。作者质疑这种默认做法，提出需要回答视觉证据应如何表示才能更好地预测题目难度。
Method: 在 Eedi 题目上比较三种输入表示，即纯文本、视觉文本化（将视觉证据转成语言）和图像原生建模（保留原始图片），并用 LLM 与 VLM 直接进行难度回归；同时做测试时干预，考察对完整题目图像的依赖。
Result: 两种视觉接口（文本化与图像原生）都取得最低的点估计误差，但领先系统间无法可靠排序。Open-VLM 的文本化对所有被评估的 LLM 都给出更低的 RMSE 点估计，而更广泛的适配对所有图像原生 VLM 都更优；测试时干预显示结果依赖配对的完整题目图像，但无法分离出额外视觉成分的单独作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调文本化不应被视为唯一实用的接口，图像原生建模是有竞争力的替代方案，其效果取决于 VLM 的适配方式；两种视觉接口在题目级错误上部分互补，且计算流程差异明显。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究在基于内容预测题目难度时，视觉证据应如何表示。作者使用来自 Eedi 的、以学生作答校准过难度的题目，对比三种表示：仅题目文本、视觉文本化 (visual textualization)、以及保留原始图片的图像原生建模 (image-native modeling)，并直接训练 LLM 和 VLM 做难度回归。摘要报告两种视觉接口都取得最低的点估计误差，但领先系统之间无法可靠排序；图像原生建模是文本化的有竞争力替代方案。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法通常把题干和选项当作文本处理；当数学题包含视觉成分时，常见流程是先对视觉证据做文本化，再用文本预测器。作者质疑这种默认做法，提出需要回答视觉证据应如何表示才能更好地预测题目难度。
summary_sections.method: 在 Eedi 题目上比较三种输入表示，即纯文本、视觉文本化（将视觉证据转成语言）和图像原生建模（保留原始图片），并用 LLM 与 VLM 直接进行难度回归；同时做测试时干预，考察对完整题目图像的依赖。
summary_sections.result: 两种视觉接口（文本化与图像原生）都取得最低的点估计误差，但领先系统间无法可靠排序。Open-VLM 的文本化对所有被评估的 LLM 都给出更低的 RMSE 点估计，而更广泛的适配对所有图像原生 VLM 都更优；测试时干预显示结果依赖配对的完整题目图像，但无法分离出额外视觉成分的单独作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调文本化不应被视为唯一实用的接口，图像原生建模是有竞争力的替代方案，其效果取决于 VLM 的适配方式；两种视觉接口在题目级错误上部分互补，且计算流程差异明显。

papers.title: Relational Response Fields: A General Theory of Black-Box LLM Response Consistency and Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Black-box language-model reliability is commonly pursued by sampling, prompting, voting, verifying, or iteratively revising individual answers. We ask a prior question: \emph{what determines whether a collection of black-box responses is recoverable at all?} We represent responses to typed transformations of a query as a \emph{relational response field} (RRF). Edge transports encode how valid responses must change under paraphrase, scaling, decomposition, refactoring, or other task symmetries; anchors encode independently trusted evidence such as execution or a verifier. For relation operator $D$, anchor operator $A$, and at most $k$ corrupted response nodes, we identify $γ_k(D,A)$ as the intrinsic difficulty of black-box response recovery. It is positive exactly when every $k$-node corruption is identifiable; it gives a deterministic stability bound proportional to $1/γ_k$; and a matching two-point minimax lower bound shows that no estimator can improve this dependence. Thus consistency is not truth: relation-only methods are blind to null directions, including shared hallucinations. We derive sparse field-repair algorithms while separating information-theoretic identifiability from the stronger null-space conditions required by convex optimization. Controlled theorem tests and black-box mathematics/code experiments evaluate four theory-fixed consequences: consistency--truth separation, anchor phase transitions, redundancy saturation, and cross-model, cross-task prediction of repair difficulty. The results support $γ_k(D,A)$ as a measurable property of a response-recovery instance, rather than a score attached to one repair heuristic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出关系响应场 (relational response field, RRF) 框架，把黑盒语言模型对查询变换（释义、缩放、分解、重构等）的合法响应变化建模为边传输，把独立可信证据建模为锚点。作者定义 γ_k(D,A) 作为至多 k 个损坏节点下响应恢复的内在难度，证明其正性等价于可识别性，并给出 1/γ_k 的确定性稳定界以及匹配的两点极小极大下界。受控理论测试和黑盒数学/代码实验表明，一致性并不等于真实性，仅依赖关系的方法会忽视共享幻觉等零方向。
Motivation: 现有黑盒语言模型可靠性通常通过采样、提示、投票、验证或迭代修订单个答案来追求，但很少追问：什么条件下一个响应集合在本质上可恢复？作者希望从信息论和优化两个层面刻画黑盒响应恢复的内在困难。
Method: 将响应集合表示为关系响应场，边传输编码任务对称下有效响应必须如何变化，锚点编码执行结果或验证器等独立可信证据；对关系算子 D 和锚点算子 A 定义 γ_k(D,A)，并推导稀疏场修复算法，同时区分信息论可识别性与凸优化所需的更强零空间条件。
Result: 摘要报告 γ_k(D,A) 为正当且仅当每个 k 节点损坏可识别；稳定界与 1/γ_k 成正比，且存在匹配的两点极小极大下界。受控定理测试和黑盒数学/代码实验验证了四个理论后果：一致性-真理分离、锚点相变、冗余饱和以及跨模型/跨任务的修复难度预测。
Conclusion: 作者认为 γ_k(D,A) 是响应恢复实例的可测量属性，而非某个具体修复启发式的分数；同时强调一致性不是真理，纯关系方法对共享幻觉等零方向不敏感。

papers.title: EuroExec: Frontier Language Models Fall Short of Expert Judgment on European Executive Decision Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLMs are increasingly put to use on open-ended complex questions, different in nature from the ones they are typically evaluated on. We dedicate more than 4,000 human expert hours to evaluate a selection of six frontier LLMs on a member of this class of problems: EuroExec, our introduced human expert-based benchmark composed of 413 open-ended long-form European executive tasks authored by 47 vetted domain experts, each question drawn from experience in a real case. Every response is manually evaluated through a multi-attribute rubric, an item-specific checklist of requirements, and a preference rank ordering, extracting an aggregate metric "Solve Rate". The strongest model solves only 56.9% of tasks, while expert-written reference answers judged blindly are solved at near-ceiling levels and are preferred over every model response in 74% of direct rankings, placing frontier generative systems well below the professional standard of work they are already used for. We see that the best way to extract this kind of conclusion is by employing human evaluators, carefully checking their consistency through rigorous statistical analysis, and observe that automatic measurements also fall short when evaluating on this case of real-world open-ended problems with a subjective ground truth.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables, submitted to EACL 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EuroExec，一个基于人类专家的基准，包含 413 个开放式长格式欧洲高管决策任务，由 47 位经验证的领域专家根据真实案例撰写。研究者投入超过 4000 小时人工评估六种前沿 LLM，通过多属性评分、逐项要求检查表和偏好排序计算综合指标 Solve Rate。最强的模型仅解决 56.9% 的任务，而专家撰写的参考答案接近上限，并在 74% 的直接排名中被优先于所有模型回答。
Motivation: 前沿 LLM 越来越多地被用于开放式复杂问题，这类问题在本质上不同于它们通常被评估的任务；现有评估可能无法反映真实世界专业工作场景，因此需要基于人类专家判断的基准来检验模型是否达到专业工作标准。
Method: 由 47 位领域专家基于真实案例经验撰写 413 个开放式长文本任务；每个回答由人工评估者通过多属性评分量表、项目特定的要求检查表和偏好排序进行评分，并通过严格的统计分析检查评估者一致性；同时比较自动测量方法在这种具有主观 ground truth 的问题上的表现。
Result: 最强的模型只解决了 56.9% 的任务，而专家撰写的参考答案以盲评方式接近天花板水平；在 74% 的直接排名中，专家参考答案优先于每个模型回答。自动测量在评估这种主观 ground truth 的开放式问题上也表现不足。
Conclusion: 作者强调，要得出此类结论，最佳途径是采用人类评估者并仔细通过统计分析验证其一致性；自动测量在真实世界开放式问题上也不够可靠。这表明前沿生成系统目前仍低于它们已被用于的专业工作标准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Model Merging Approach for Continual MLLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) unlearning methods have been proposed to remove private, sensitive, or proprietary information from well-trained models. However, most existing MLLM unlearning methods are designed for one-shot requests and fail to adequately address continual scenarios, as repeatedly applying one-shot operations leads to cumulative utility degradation, unlearning rebound, and retention drift. We introduce Merging for Continual Unlearning (MCU), an approach that dynamically merges multiple one-shot unlearning adapters into a unified adapter upon receiving each new unlearning request.Through a leave-one-out merging analysis, we reveal that these unlearning adapters exhibit strong cross-task dependencies. Such dependencies have two contrasting effects: they can facilitate cross-task unlearning transferability, but they can also introduce severe interference that degrades unlearning effectiveness and compromises retained knowledge. To address this challenge, MCU projects the adapters into a shared representation space, preserves their dominant directions, suppresses over-concentrated coordinates, and reconfigures cross-task dependencies to mitigate interference while enhancing transferability. Experiments on ICU-Bench and MLLMU-Bench demonstrate that MCU achieves superior unlearning effectiveness while preserving both retained knowledge and general multimodal utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的持续遗忘 (continual unlearning) 问题提出 Merging for Continual Unlearning (MCU) 方法。MCU 在每个新的遗忘请求到来时，将多个一次性遗忘适配器动态合并为一个统一适配器，并通过留一法合并分析发现这些适配器之间存在强跨任务依赖。该方法在 ICU-Bench 和 MLLMU-Bench 上实现了更优的遗忘效果，同时保持已保留知识和通用多模态能力。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 遗忘方法大多面向一次性请求，难以应对持续场景；反复应用一次性遗忘操作会导致累积效用下降、遗忘反弹 (unlearning rebound) 以及保留知识漂移 (retention drift)。
Method: 提出 MCU：将多个一次性遗忘适配器动态合并为统一适配器；通过留一法合并分析揭示跨任务依赖，并将适配器投影到共享表示空间，保留其主导方向、抑制过度集中坐标，重新配置跨任务依赖以减轻干扰并增强迁移性。
Result: 在 ICU-Bench 和 MLLMU-Bench 上的实验表明，MCU 在保持保留知识和通用多模态效用的同时，取得了更优的遗忘有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调持续遗忘场景下跨任务依赖具有双重作用，既可能促进跨任务遗忘迁移，也可能引入干扰；MCU 通过显式重构这些依赖来平衡遗忘效果与知识保留。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning Compression Rules for Network Traffic
authors: 2) Louis-Adrien Dufrène (1) Guillaume Larue (1) Massih-Reza Amini (2) ((1) Orange Research (2) Université Grenoble Alpes)
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning compact rule-based compressors for structured network traffic. Each packet is a record of header fields that are highly redundant within a flow, and a compressor is a small set of rules matching such records and replacing predictable fields with short codes. We cast rule learning as a two-stage problem: (i) an unsupervised structure-discovery stage that recursively partitions training packets using a normalized entropy-ratio criterion robust to small samples, and (ii) a constrained selection stage that uses dynamic programming to pick the rule subset maximizing expected compression gain under a hard budget on the number of installable rules. We instantiate the framework on Static Context Header Compression (SCHC), the IETF standard for rule-based header compression in constrained networks, and evaluate it on four real-world Internet-of-Things and 5G core-network datasets. Our method, Robust Entropy Clustering for Adaptive comPression (RECAP), surpasses expert-engineered rule sets with a small number of learned rules and removes the need for manual rule design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究为结构化网络流量学习紧凑的基于规则（rule-based）的压缩器。作者将规则学习建模为两阶段问题：先使用归一化熵比（normalized entropy-ratio）准则做无监督结构发现，递归划分训练数据包；再用动态规划在可安装规则数预算约束下选取最大化期望压缩增益的规则子集。该方法在 IETF 标准 SCHC 上实例化，并在四个真实物联网与 5G 核心网数据集上超越专家手工规则集。
Motivation: 网络流量中每个数据包都是流内高度冗余的头部字段记录，手工设计压缩规则耗时费力且难以覆盖多样流量。现有方案依赖专家规则设计，缺少自动从数据中学习小型规则集的方法。
Method: 提出两阶段规则学习框架：阶段一为无监督结构发现，使用对小样本鲁棒的归一化熵比准则递归划分训练数据包；阶段二为受限选择，使用动态规划在规则数量硬预算约束下选择最大化期望压缩增益的规则子集。该方法被实例化为 RECAP，并应用于 SCHC 这一 IETF 基于规则的头部压缩标准。
Result: 摘要报告 RECAP 在四个真实物联网和 5G 核心网数据集上，用少量学习到的规则超越了专家手工设计的规则集，并消除了人工规则设计的需求。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对结构化网络流量的基于规则压缩可以从数据中自动学习，且少量规则即可达到优于专家规则集的效果，免去手动设计规则的负担。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EgoAfford: Task-Oriented Affordance Grounding via Egocentric Referring Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Part-level affordance grounding has advanced the localization of functional object regions associated with elemental actions. Extending this capability to complex tasks calls for connecting the semantic roles of participating objects with task-state-aligned visual observations and multi-step planning. We introduce EgoAfford, a benchmark designed to connect these three aspects. Given an egocentric observation and a high-level tabletop task, a model must generate the remaining plan and segment the functional regions of up to three components of the next action: the direct object, instrument, and destination. EgoAfford comprises approximately 15.5k human-verified images from 2,000 generated multi-step scenes, organized as semantically aligned, task-complete image series, together with EgoAfford-Real, 102 manually captured images spanning 26 tasks. We further present EgoLens, a 3B multimodal large language model with role-specific mask decoders, as an in-domain reference model for this joint task. Evaluations of recent referring-segmentation MLLMs, commercial-VLM--SAM2 pipelines, and EgoLens highlight the complementary challenges of next-step inference and action-role-conditioned part grounding. EgoLens establishes strong reference performance on both generated and manually captured observations. Together, EgoAfford and EgoLens provide a foundation for jointly studying perception and planning in multi-step tabletop tasks. Our project page is available at: https://egoafford.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoAfford，一个面向第一人称（egocentric）多步桌面任务的动作意图（affordance）定位基准：给定第一人称观测和高层任务描述，模型需生成剩余计划并分割下一动作中至多三个角色的功能区域（直接对象、工具、目的地）。基准包含来自 2,000 个生成多步场景的约 15.5k 张人工验证图像，以及 102 张人工拍摄的 EgoAfford-Real 图像；作者同时提出 EgoLens，一个带角色专用掩码解码器的 3B 多模态大语言模型作为参考模型。对现有 referring-segmentation MLLM、商业 VLM–SAM2 流水线和 EgoLens 的评测表明，下一步推理与动作角色条件化部件定位是互补的挑战。
Motivation: 部件级功能区域定位已能支持基本动作，但扩展到复杂任务需要把参与对象的语义角色、与任务状态对齐的视觉观测以及多步规划联系起来，目前缺少同时连接这三方面的基准。
Method: 构建 EgoAfford 基准，要求模型在给定第一人称图像和高层桌面任务时输出剩余规划，并分割下一动作中最多三个组件（直接对象、工具、目的地）的功能区域；配套提出 EgoLens，一个 3B 多模态大语言模型，搭配角色专用掩码解码器（role-specific mask decoders）来完成联合的规划与分割任务。
Result: 摘要报告 EgoLens 在生成图像和人工拍摄图像上都建立了强参考性能；而对近期 referring-segmentation MLLM、商业 VLM–SAM2 流水线以及 EgoLens 的评测揭示了下一步推理与动作角色条件化部件定位各自不同的难点。
Conclusion: EgoAfford 与 EgoLens 共同为多步桌面任务中感知与规划的联合研究提供了基础。

papers.title: Discretization and Statistical Consistency of Functional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Functional flow matching is posed on distributions of functions but implemented from finitely many coefficients or point values. Under scattered or adaptive refinement, the resulting conditioning sigma-algebras need not be nested, so martingale convergence does not justify the sensor limit. We prove strong $L^2$ convergence of finite conditional velocity targets for every strongly consistent sequence of finite-rank reconstructions, with quantitative bounds for orthogonal projections and a point-sensor extension through a regularity space. For learned flows, coupling directly to a population superposition path yields an end-to-end Wasserstein bound without assuming uniqueness of the population finite-dimensional ODE. We verify sensor-independent constants for a normalized quadrature neural operator, including globally Lipschitz activations through an explicit magnitude recurrence. A noncommuting trace-class Gaussian example gives boundary multiplier $0$ under projected restriction and $0.72$ under exact conditioning. A spatial regularity--cubature certificate closes the operator-realization term, a Bernstein argument gives a $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1})$ excess-risk term for fixed model dimension and envelopes, and an exactly realizable clipped Gaussian scaling specialization yields an explicit end-to-end rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究函数分布上的流匹配 (functional flow matching) 在有限系数或点值实现下的理论性质。作者证明对任意强一致的有限秩重构序列，有限条件速度目标具有强 L^2 收敛性，并给出正交投影的定量界及通过正则空间扩展到点传感器。对于学习到的流，直接耦合总体叠加路径可得到端到端 Wasserstein 界，无需假设有限维 ODE 解的唯一性。文中还通过非交换迹类高斯例子给出边界乘子的具体数值，并分析了归一化求积神经算子等实例。
Motivation: 函数流匹配在实际中只能基于有限个系数或点值实现，但在散乱或自适应剖分下产生的条件 sigma-代数不一定是嵌套的，因此通常依赖的鞅收敛无法证明传感器极限，需要建立不需要嵌套条件的统计一致性结论。
Method: 通过强一致有限秩重构序列来逼近条件速度目标，从理论上证明有限条件速度的 L^2 收敛；对学习流程引入与总体叠加路径的直接耦合以获得 Wasserstein 界；并用非交换迹类高斯例子、空间正则-求积证书、Bernstein 论证及裁剪高斯缩放特例来支撑各项理论环节。
Result: 摘要报告强 L^2 收敛性对所有强一致有限秩重构成立；非交换迹类高斯例子在投影限制下边界乘数为 0，在精确条件下为 0.72；固定模型维数与包络下 Bernstein 论证给出 tilde{O}(n^{-1}) 的过量风险项；精确可实现裁剪高斯缩放特例得到显式端到端速率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该理论框架避开了对有限维 ODE 唯一性的假设，并且通过点传感器扩展和具体例子说明泛函流匹配在非嵌套离散化下仍可保持统计一致性。

papers.title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents must remember both useful experience from earlier tasks and unfinished progress in the current interaction. Latent memory offers a compact solution by compressing multimodal trajectories into a few continuous tokens. Existing methods, however, usually map each trajectory to one fixed memory block and train it mainly through next-action supervision. This creates three practical problems: important details may be lost during compression, the same memory block must serve different decision stages, and irrelevant retrieved trajectories may still mislead the agent. We introduce FocusMem, which separates these responsibilities within a compact latent-memory interface. A role-aware content basis encourages episodic memory to retain reusable experience and working memory to retain task progress. A state-conditioned readout generates a decision-specific view of the same stored evidence, while a lightweight trust gate can suppress memory blocks that appear irrelevant to the current step. All components are trained while the GUI policy remains frozen. Across five GUI-agent benchmarks, FocusMem consistently outperforms a fully matched action-only fixed-memory baseline and prior latent memory adaptations. Further analysis shows that semantic and functional supervision preserve complementary information, state-conditioned readout is more robust as surrounding trajectory context grows, and the trust gate reduces the harm caused by injected irrelevant episodic evidence. These results show that effective latent memory depends not only on compressing past interaction, but also on what is retained, what is exposed, and what is allowed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FocusMem，一种针对 GUI 代理的隐式记忆（latent memory）接口，将记忆功能分解为内容保留、条件读取和信任门控三个职责。在 GUI 策略保持冻结的同时，角色感知内容基（role-aware content basis）区分情景记忆与工作记忆，状态条件读取（state-conditioned readout）生成决策特定视图，轻量信任门（trust gate）抑制与当前步骤无关的记忆块。作者在五个 GUI-agent 基准上报告该方法一致优于完全匹配的仅动作固定记忆基线以及既往隐式记忆适配方法。
Motivation: 现有隐式记忆方法通常把每条多模态轨迹压缩为一个固定记忆块，并主要通过下一步动作监督训练，导致三个实际问题：压缩时丢失重要细节、同一记忆块必须服务不同决策阶段、检索到的无关轨迹仍可能误导代理。
Method: FocusMem 在一个紧凑的隐式记忆接口中分离职责：角色感知内容基让情景记忆（episodic memory）保留可复用经验、工作记忆（working memory）保留任务进度；状态条件读取为同一存储证据生成决策特定的视图；轻量信任门可抑制与当前步骤无关的记忆块。所有组件都在 GUI 策略冻结（frozen）的情况下训练。
Result: 在五个 GUI-agent 基准上，FocusMem 一致优于完全匹配的仅动作固定记忆基线和既往隐式记忆适配方法。进一步分析显示，语义与功能监督保留互补信息，状态条件读取在周围轨迹上下文增长时更稳健，信任门减少了注入无关情景证据造成的损害。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，有效隐式记忆不仅取决于压缩过去的交互，还取决于保留什么、暴露什么以及允许什么，即内容、读取与信任三方面共同决定记忆效果。

papers.title: Coupled Continuous-Discrete Generation for Scene Text Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Scene text image super-resolution (STISR) aims to recover visually plausible appearance while preserving character semantics from degraded inputs. Existing STISR systems often rely on externally generated priors or separate image and text models, resulting in error propagation and costly multi-stage inference. We present DualTSR, a unified framework that formulates STISR as coupled continuous-discrete generation. Conditional flow matching restores continuous image latents, while absorbing-state discrete diffusion reconstructs text tokens. Both processes share a multimodal transformer backbone, allowing the evolving image and text states to interact throughout generation without an external OCR prior at inference. On CTR-TSR, DualTSR achieves the best FID, LPIPS, ACC, and NED among the compared methods at both X2 and X4. On an aligned RealCE subset, it obtains the best FID, ACC, and NED with competitive LPIPS. Compared with DiffTSR at X4, DualTSR improves ACC by 12.78 percentage points while reducing the parameter count from 1.23B to 203M and end-to-end latency from 13.3s to 132ms. These results establish DualTSR as an accurate and efficient method for STISR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualTSR，将场景文本图像超分辨率 (STISR) 建模为耦合的连续-离散生成：条件流匹配恢复连续图像潜变量，吸收态离散扩散重建文本 token，两者共享多模态 Transformer 骨干，推理时不需外部 OCR 先验。在 CTR-TSR 上 X2/X4 均取得最佳 FID、LPIPS、ACC、NED；在 RealCE 子集上取得最佳 FID、ACC、NED。相比 DiffTSR X4，ACC 提升 12.78 个百分点，参数量从 1.23B 降至 203M，端到端延迟从 13.3s 降至 132ms。
Motivation: 现有 STISR 系统常依赖外部生成的先验或分离的图像与文本模型，导致错误传播和多阶段推理成本高。
Method: 提出统一框架 DualTSR，将 STISR 形式化为耦合的连续-离散生成；条件流匹配恢复连续图像潜变量，吸收态离散扩散重建文本 token，二者共享多模态 Transformer 骨干并在生成过程中交互，推理无需外部 OCR 先验。
Result: 在 CTR-TSR 上 X2/X4 均取得最佳 FID、LPIPS、ACC、NED；在对齐 RealCE 子集上取得最佳 FID、ACC、NED，LPIPS 有竞争力。X4 下相比 DiffTSR，ACC 提升 12.78 个百分点，参数量由 1.23B 降至 203M，端到端延迟由 13.3s 降至 132ms。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 DualTSR 在 STISR 上兼具准确性和效率，并验证了耦合连续-离散生成可避免外部 OCR 先验带来的误差传播。

papers.title: ODRA: Synthesizing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Sessions with Structured Chain-Of-Thought and Dynamic Patient Resistance
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic generation of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) sessions is challenged by two competing demands: adhering to strict therapeutic structure while modeling the resistant, unpredictable behavior of real patients. Existing script-based methods fail to capture dynamic therapeutic interactions, while multi-agent approaches struggle to adhere to CBT's sequential structure; both suffer from sycophancy, producing overly compliant patients that misrepresent real clinical settings. In this work we introduce ODRA, a novel framework for synthesizing therapy dialogues through a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) strategy grounded in foundational CBT guidelines (Beck, 2020). ODRA further incorporates a resistance orchestrator to solve patient sycophancy, which employs steering techniques to elicit behaviors aligned with their resistance level. Automated and expert evaluations show that ODRA significantly outperforms existing methods across therapeutic skills, CBT alignment, and patient behavioral fidelity, with licensed psychologists preferring ODRA sessions across 12 of 13 clinical metrics. Furthermore, models fine-tuned on our dataset demonstrate superior therapeutic performance against both cooperative and resistant patients, validating that explicit resistance modeling in synthetic training data directly translates to downstream clinical robustness.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: ODRA 采用基于 Beck (2020) 基础 CBT 指南的思维链策略来生成结构化治疗对话，并加入阻力编排器，通过引导技术诱发与患者阻力水平一致的行为。
Result: 摘要报告 ODRA 在治疗技能、CBT 对齐和患者行为保真度上显著优于已有方法；持照心理学家在 13 项临床指标中有 12 项偏好 ODRA 会话；基于该数据集微调的模型对合作和抗拒患者均表现出更强的治疗性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为在合成训练数据中显式建模患者阻力可以直接转化为下游临床鲁棒性。

papers.title: Leak-Resistant Unlearning: A New Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Consistency and Recovery Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking machine unlearning methods is critical to understand whether sensitive knowledge is removed from large language models (LLMs) or not. Current unlearning benchmarks include mainly single-hop questions and a narrow set of multi-hop questions. Although effective, they still face two challenges. (1) Knowledge is not isolated, whereby diverse multi-hop reasoning paths can potentially induce knowledge leakage than normal queries. (2) Unlearning may be fragile: unlearned knowledge can be partially recovered through recovery attacks such as lightweight post-unlearning adaptation, making static evaluation insufficient. Therefore, in this paper, we introduce \unlearning as a novel benchmark to understand robust LLM knowledge removal across diverse reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We experiment with this benchmark on 3 models, 6 unlearning methods, and 2 carefully curated datasets. Results show that existing methods are vulnerable to multi-hop reasoning paths and recovery attacks. We further explore the trade-off among forget quality, robustness, and model utility for LLM unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有机器遗忘（machine unlearning）基准主要包含单跳问题和少量多跳问题、且忽略恢复攻击的不足，提出新基准 Leak-Resistant Unlearning，用于评测大语言模型（LLM）在多跳推理路径与恢复攻击下的知识移除鲁棒性。作者在 3 个模型、6 种遗忘方法和 2 个数据集上实验，结果显示现有方法对多跳推理路径和恢复攻击均较脆弱，并进一步分析了遗忘质量、鲁棒性与模型效用之间的权衡。
Motivation: 知识并非孤立存在，多样的多跳推理路径可能比普通查询更容易诱发知识泄漏；同时遗忘可能是脆弱的，轻量级遗忘后适应（post-unlearning adaptation）等恢复攻击可部分恢复已遗忘知识，使静态评估不足以检测真实风险。
Method: 提出 Leak-Resistant Unlearning 基准，包含两个精心构建的数据集，覆盖多样化推理路径与恢复攻击场景，并对 3 个模型和 6 种遗忘方法进行系统性评测。
Result: 实验表明现有遗忘方法在多跳推理路径和恢复攻击下是脆弱的；研究还揭示了遗忘质量、鲁棒性与模型效用之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要更鲁棒的 LLM 知识移除评测，静态单跳评估不足以反映真实风险，并为理解多跳推理一致性与恢复鲁棒性提供了基准。

papers.title: CARVE: Cross-Slice Anisotropic Reallocation of Visual Evidence for Efficient 3D Medical Volume Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Slice-based MLLMs leverage mature 2D encoders by representing 3D volumes as sequences of 2D slices. However, this slice-wise formulation produces thousands of visual tokens that burden the LLM backbone, many of which capture overlapping visual evidence across adjacent slices. To understand how effectively a growing visual token budget improves performance, we perform scaling analyses on two 3D medical VQA benchmarks and find diminishing returns: cost keeps rising while accuracy saturates, and improving in-plane resolution is more effective than adding slices at comparable budgets. The budget should therefore be allocated more selectively rather than simply enlarged, yet most token compression methods are designed for 2D images or videos, where redundancy arises from spatial layout or temporal motion rather than from near-duplicate content along the depth axis. We present CARVE, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens prior to LLM inference and casts token reduction as budget-constrained 2.5D allocation. CARVE partitions the depth axis into coherent windows and allocates tokens non-uniformly according to normalized cross-slice evidence. Under a shared budget, CARVE builds spatial anchors on representative slices and retrieves locally varying evidence from the full volume, then merges remaining eligible tokens into nearby anchors within each window. Removing roughly 80% of the visual tokens on Hulu-Med-7B, CARVE leads all compression baselines on every AMOS-MM report-generation metric, with 6.2 points higher retention of full-token quality than the strongest baseline, and preserves 98.1% of full-token performance across three VQA benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARVE，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的视觉 token 压缩框架，用于切片式 3D 医学影像多模态大模型。它把 token 缩减建模为受预算约束的 2.5D 分配：沿深度轴划分连贯窗口，根据归一化跨切片证据非均匀分配 token，构建空间锚点并检索局部变化证据后合并冗余 token。在 Hulu-Med-7B 上约移除 80% 视觉 token，并在三个 VQA 基准上保留 98.1% 的全 token 性能。
Motivation: 切片式 3D 医学 MLLM 把体积表示为大量 2D 切片，产生数千视觉 token，且相邻切片含有大量重叠证据，给 LLM 骨干带来沉重负担。作者在医学 VQA 基准上的扩展分析显示收益递减：token 预算增加时成本上升而准确率饱和，且同等预算下提升面内分辨率比增加切片更有效；而现有压缩方法针对 2D 图像或视频，其冗余来源是空间布局或时间运动，而非沿深度轴的近重复内容。
Method: CARVE 在 LLM 推理前压缩视觉 token，将缩减问题形式化为预算受限的 2.5D 分配 (budget-constrained 2.5D allocation)：将深度轴划分为连贯窗口，按归一化跨切片证据 (normalized cross-slice evidence) 非均匀分配 token；在代表性切片上构建空间锚点，从完整体积检索局部变化的证据，并在每个窗口内将剩余合格 token 合并到邻近锚点。
Result: 在共享预算下，CARVE 于 Hulu-Med-7B 上移除约 80% 视觉 token，并在 AMOS-MM 报告生成的每项指标上领先所有压缩基线；相比最强基线，全 token 质量保留率高 6.2 分；在三个 3D 医学 VQA 基准上保留 98.1% 的全 token 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将 token 预算按跨切片证据选择性分配，可以在高压缩率下近乎完整地保留全 token 性能，且无需训练；该方法专门针对深度轴上近重复内容导致的冗余，而非 2D 空间或视频时序冗余。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: GUARD: Grounding Uncertainty and Ablation-Based Risk Detection for Diffusion-Based VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies can generate plausible actions even when their predictions are weakly grounded in the visual and language evidence defining the task. We introduce GUARD, a test-time failure detection method that measures this grounding without modifying the pretrained policy. GUARD estimates the influence of token-indexed entries in the final vision-language model key-value (KV) cache, constructs counterfactual caches by ablating salient KV entries, and compares their denoising responses with the original conditioning. Based on the comparison, we derive GUARD diagnostic stream including sensitivity, attention entropy, modality bias, and grounding efficiency, which are calibrated online and processed by a lightweight temporal classifier. We evaluate GUARD under task-held-out splits across five policy-benchmark settings, using Pi0, SmolVLA, and Alpamayo-1.5 on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, MetaWorld, and PhysicalAI-AV. GUARD achieves the best ROC-AUC on four of five unseen-task settings and ranks second on the remaining setting, improving the average unseen-task ROC-AUC by 5.73 percentage points over the strongest competing runtime monitor while remaining within 0.19 points of the best seen-task average. These results show that directly probing action-head dependence on multimodal evidence provides a transferable failure signal across policies, tasks, embodiments, and domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUARD 是一种针对扩散式视觉-语言-动作策略 (Diffusion-based VLA) 的测试时失败检测方法，无需修改预训练策略即可度量动作预测对视觉与语言证据的 grounding 程度。它通过扰动最终视觉-语言模型 KV 缓存中的关键条目、构造反事实缓存并与原始条件作用的去噪响应做对比，生成敏感性、注意力熵、模态偏置和 grounding 效率等诊断信号，再经在线校准的轻量级时序分类器处理。在 Pi0、SmolVLA、Alpamayo-1.5 以及 LIBERO、SimplerEnv、MetaWorld、PhysicalAI-AV 等五个策略-基准组合的任务留出 (task-held-out) 划分下，GUARD 在四个未见任务设置中取得最佳 ROC-AUC，在剩余一个设置中排名第二，并在未见任务平均 ROC-AUC 上比最强竞争运行时监控器提升 5.73 个百分点。
Motivation: 扩散式 VLA 策略即便其预测与定义任务的视觉和语言证据关联很弱，仍可能生成看似合理的动作；现有方法缺少不修改预训练策略的测试时 grounding 度量手段。
Method: GUARD 估计最终视觉-语言模型 KV 缓存中按 token 索引的条目对动作输出的影响，通过消融关键 KV 条目构造反事实缓存，并比较其去噪响应与原始条件作用；由此得到敏感性、注意力熵、模态偏置、grounding 效率等诊断流，在线校准后交给轻量级时序分类器进行失败判定。
Result: 在五个策略-基准设置的任务留出评估下，GUARD 在四个未见任务设置上取得最佳 ROC-AUC，在剩余一个上排名第二；未见任务平均 ROC-AUC 比最强竞争运行时监控器高 5.73 个百分点，同时与最优的已见任务平均结果仅差 0.19 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，直接探测动作头对多模态证据的依赖性可以产生跨策略、任务、本体和域可迁移的失败信号，并强调 GUARD 不修改预训练策略。

papers.title: CARGO-VL: Counterfactual Arbitration with Risk-Constrained Group Optimization for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language systems combine images with retrieved text, but these sources can disagree or jointly fail to support an answer. Reliable models must identify the trustworthy source and abstain when neither is adequate. Existing post-training objectives score instances independently and therefore do not enforce coherent behavior under counterfactual evidence changes. We introduce CARGO-VL, a group-relative framework that optimizes matched variants covering aligned, image-correct, text-correct, and both-wrong (A/V/T/N) evidence states as one bundle. Its objective couples condition-wise correctness with transition rewards for answer invariance, source equivariance, and answer-to-abstention switching, while a primal-dual controller balances unsafe answers against excessive deferral. We also contribute XMC (eXtended Modal Conflict), a four-condition conflict training resource, and evaluate transfer on CMC-Bench and Modality-Bias. Across multiple seeds, CARGO-VL improves conflict handling, unsupported-answer avoidance, and modality balance over pointwise baselines. Ablations identify complementary benefits from relational transition signals and adaptive risk control, supporting counterfactual consistency as a practical objective for reliable multimodal evidence arbitration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARGO-VL，一个面向视觉-语言模型的分组相对优化框架，将图像-文本对齐、图像正确、文本正确、双错（A/V/T/N）四类反事实证据变体作为捆绑优化，目标耦合条件正确性与转移奖励（答案不变性、源等变性、答案到弃权切换），并用原始-对偶控制器在 unsafe 答案与过度弃权之间权衡。作者另外贡献 XMC 四条件冲突训练资源，并在 CMC-Bench 与 Modality-Bias 上评估。摘要称多随机种子实验显示 CARGO-VL 在冲突处理、不支持答案避免与模态平衡上优于逐点基线。
Motivation: 视觉-语言系统依赖图像与检索文本，但两类证据可能相互矛盾或共同无法支撑答案；可靠模型需识别可信来源并在证据不足时弃权。现有后训练目标对实例独立评分，未能在反事实证据变化下强制产生一致行为。
Method: 引入分组相对（group-relative）优化框架，将覆盖四类证据状态的匹配变体作为一个 bundle 优化；目标同时包含条件正确性、答案不变性、源等变性和答案到弃权切换的转移奖励，并用 primal-dual 控制器平衡不安全答案与过度延迟。还构建了 XMC（eXtended Modal Conflict）四条件冲突训练资源用于评估迁移。
Result: 在多随机种子的评估中，CARGO-VL 相比 pointwise 基线改善了冲突处理、unsupported-answer 避免和模态平衡；消融实验表明关系性转移信号与自适应风险控制具有互补收益。
Conclusion: 摘要主张反事实一致性（counterfactual consistency）可作为可靠多模态证据仲裁的实际优化目标，并在 CMC-Bench 与 Modality-Bias 上验证了其迁移性。

papers.title: GeoReward: Mitigating Contextual Variable Overestimation in Vision-Language Models for Cross-Market Preference Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models excel in many multimodal tasks but remain prone to a subtle yet impactful failure mode: they tend to overestimate dominant visual-textual cues while underestimating sparse but decision-critical contextual variables. This issue, which we term Contextual Variable Overestimation (CVE), becomes particularly evident in real-world applications such as predicting advertisement image preferences across diverse geographic markets. For instance, when a VLM is asked to choose between two product images tailored for different countries, it often defaults to a consistent output, ignoring ground-truth regional variations. This collapse occurs because pervasive high-volume signals, such as product attributes and dense image patches, overwhelm the few but critical tokens that encode market-specific context. To address CVE, we first collect a new multimodal dataset of real advertising creatives and their click-through performance across multiple countries. We then introduce GeoReward, a reward model designed to predict ad image preferences across diverse geographic markets. GeoReward integrates three purpose-built mechanisms: (1) Market-Aware Retrieval Augmentation, (2) Context-Guided Visual Modulation, (3) Selective Sensitivity Loss. Furthermore, we demonstrate how GeoReward can guide the fine-tuning of RL for a VLM to generate background designs for text-to-image models, producing market-aware advertising creatives. Experiments validate that our framework mitigates CVE and outperforms existing baselines. This work not only diagnoses a systematic bias in VLMs toward dominant perceptual features but also delivers a targeted solution for applications where sparse contextual variables govern decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态任务中会高估占主导的视觉-文本线索、低估稀疏但决策关键的情境变量，将该失效模式命名为 Contextual Variable Overestimation (CVE)，并用于解释跨市场广告图像偏好预测中的失效。作者构建了多国真实广告创意及其点击表现的数据集，提出名为 GeoReward 的奖励模型，集成 Market-Aware Retrieval Augmentation、Context-Guided Visual Modulation 与 Selective Sensitivity Loss 三种机制，并演示了其可引导 VLM 的 RL 微调以生成面向市场的文本到图像广告背景。实验表明该框架缓解了 CVE 并优于现有基线。
Motivation: VLM 在诸如跨地理市场广告偏好预测等现实任务中，容易被高频的产品属性或密集图像块等信号带偏，忽略编码市场特定上下文的少量关键 token，导致输出在各种地域条件下趋于一致，忽略了真实的地域差异。
Method: 作者首先收集了包含多个国家广告创意及其点击表现的多模态数据集；随后提出 GeoReward 奖励模型，包含 Market-Aware Retrieval Augmentation、Context-Guided Visual Modulation 和 Selective Sensitivity Loss 三个目标机制，并展示了如何用该奖励模型指导 VLM 的强化学习（RL）微调，以生成具备市场意识的文本到图像广告背景。
Result: 实验验证所提出框架能够缓解 CVE，并在广告图像偏好预测任务上优于现有基线。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文系统诊断了 VLM 偏向主导感知特征的偏差，并为那些稀疏情境变量决定决策的应用提供了针对性解决方案；作者强调该工作既有诊断意义也提供了实用工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AFD-Ledger: Deployment Provisioning for Attention--FFN Disaggregation
papers.abstract_en: Attention--Feed-Forward Network (FFN) Disaggregation (AFD) is emerging as a promising architecture for serving Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models. While existing AFD systems improve the efficiency of disaggregated execution, they leave a deployment question unanswered: under the same model, workload, time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO), hardware budget, hardware catalog, and runtime capabilities, does AFD provide higher throughput than the best collocated deployment? Answering this question requires jointly optimizing hardware assignment and deployment organization for both architectures, making exhaustive provisioning prohibitively expensive. We present AFD-Ledger, an offline analytical provisioning system that independently provisions AFD and collocated deployments using an analytical execution model and an evaluation-bounded hardware search. Across deployment spaces where exhaustive provisioning is feasible, AFD-Ledger reduces complete deployment evaluations by 68.8%--83.5% while still recovering the globally optimal deployment. On three physical LongCat 2.0 deployments, it preserves the correct architecture decision while predicting AFD-to-collocated throughput within 6.6%--9.6% of measurement. Using this validated framework, we show that homogeneous AFD improves fixed-budget throughput in only a minority of the studied settings, heterogeneous AFD requires deployment-level hardware complementarity rather than heuristic device selection, and role-specific hardware improvements matter primarily when they enable better deployment organizations by crossing deployment capability--price boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AFD-Ledger，一个用于 Attention-FFN 分离（AFD）与共置（collocated）部署的离线分析式资源供给系统。它通过解析执行模型和评估受限的硬件搜索，在可穷举部署空间中减少 68.8%--83.5% 的部署评估次数，同时仍能找到全局最优部署；在三个物理 LongCat 2.0 部署上，吞吐量预测与实测误差在 6.6%--9.6% 以内。基于该框架，作者发现同构 AFD 仅在少数设定下提升固定预算吞吐量，异构 AFD 需要部署级硬件互补性而非启发式设备选择。
Motivation: 现有 AFD 系统优化了分离执行的效率，但未回答部署问题：在相同模型、工作负载、TPOT SLO、硬件预算与目录下，AFD 是否比最优共置部署获得更高吞吐量；回答该问题需要联合优化硬件分配与部署组织，穷举供给代价过高。
Method: 提出 AFD-Ledger，一种离线分析式供给系统：使用解析执行模型刻画 AFD 与共置部署，并采用评估受限的硬件搜索（evaluation-bounded hardware search）来缩小搜索空间，分别对两种架构进行独立供给。
Result: 在可穷举的部署空间中，AFD-Ledger 将完整部署评估减少 68.8%--83.5%，且仍能恢复全局最优部署；在三个物理 LongCat 2.0 部署上，它保持正确的架构决策，AFD 与共置吞吐量预测与实测相差 6.6%--9.6%。
Conclusion: 同构 AFD 仅在少数研究设定下提高固定预算吞吐量；异构 AFD 需要部署级硬件互补性而非启发式选择；角色特定的硬件改进主要在其跨越部署能力-价格边界、从而促成更好部署组织时才有意义。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Action Recognition: Taxonomy, Methods, and Privacy-Utility Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Video surveillance in public safety, healthcare, and smart environments has made continuous human monitoring routine, raising real risks to personal identity and appearance. Privacy-preserving action recognition (PPAR) tackles the tension between the utility of video understanding and this exposure, and has drawn fast-growing interest. However, existing surveys remain narrow. Most catalog a single mechanism family, predate recent adversarial and hybrid work, or barely address evaluation. The result is a fragmented literature with incompatible threat models, inconsistent metrics, and no shared evaluation standard. We address this with a PRISMA-guided review of 32 peer-reviewed papers (2018--2026) drawn from 885 screened records. Methods sort into five families, namely adversarial learning (52%), skeleton-based (20%), cryptographic (12%), differential privacy (8%), and hybrid (8%), each with distinct privacy, utility, and efficiency trade-offs. Evaluation is the weak point. Only 10% of papers adopt a formal privacy definition, 65% rely on ad-hoc metrics, and 40% report an inconsistently defined cMAP. The trade-offs are steep. Skeleton methods reach about 85% accuracy but drop appearance, adversarial methods hold near 80% utility at moderate privacy (cMAP 0.9 to 0.3--0.5), and differential privacy often falls below 70%. Harder conditions stay under-tested, with fewer than 15% of papers checking cross-dataset generalization, under 10% testing adaptive attackers, and real-time edge deployment nearly untouched. We contribute a two-dimensional privacy-space taxonomy, a formal threat model, a comparative trade-off analysis, the PPAR Unified Evaluation Protocol, and a roadmap centered on benchmark standardization. With this grounding, we argue PPAR can move from prototypes toward deployment, with lessons extending to face recognition and medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇PRISMA指导的隐私保护动作识别（PPAR）系统综述，覆盖2018至2026年间从885篇筛选记录中纳入的32篇同行评审论文。作者将方法归为五类：对抗学习（52%）、基于骨架（20%）、密码学（12%）、差分隐私（8%）和混合（8%），并指出评估是文献的明显短板：仅10%采用正式隐私定义，65%依赖临时指标，40%报告了定义不一致的cMAP。文中提出二维隐私空间分类法、正式威胁模型、比较权衡分析、PPAR统一评估协议以及以基准标准化为核心的路线图。
Motivation: 现有PPAR综述范围狭窄，多数只编目单一机制家族，未覆盖近期的对抗与混合方法，且很少讨论评估问题。这导致文献碎片化，威胁模型不兼容、指标不一致、缺乏共享的评估标准，阻碍了该领域从原型走向部署。
Method: 采用PRISMA流程进行系统综述，从885条筛选记录中纳入32篇论文；提出二维隐私空间分类法、正式威胁模型、各类方法在隐私-效用-效率间的比较权衡分析，以及PPAR统一评估协议（PPAR Unified Evaluation Protocol）和基准标准化路线图。
Result: 方法分布为对抗学习52%、基于骨架20%、密码学12%、差分隐私8%、混合8%。权衡方面，骨架方法可达约85%准确率但丢弃外观信息；对抗方法在中等隐私下维持近80%效用（cMAP从0.9降至0.3–0.5）；差分隐私通常低于70%。困难条件测试不足：少于15%的论文检验跨数据集泛化，少于10%测试自适应攻击者，实时边缘部署几乎未被涉及。
Conclusion: 作者认为，借助所提出的统一威胁模型、评估协议和标准化路线图，PPAR可以从原型阶段向实际部署推进，且相关经验可推广至人脸识别和医学影像等领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DIVE: Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual inputs in vision-language models (VLMs) are often encoded into substantially longer token sequences than text, making visual tokens a major bottleneck for efficient inference. Abundant recent methods address this bottleneck by scoring token importance and pruning low-scoring tokens in a single pass. However, one-shot scoring is insufficient because a token's prompt-relevant usefulness depends on the evidence already retained. Motivated by this insight, we introduce DIVE (Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Construction), a training-free framework that recasts visual-token pruning as dynamic evidence construction. DIVE repeatedly selects the remaining token with the highest residual-conditioned score, updates the visual and prompt residuals to discount the evidence already explained, and re-evaluates the remaining tokens. This select-update-re-evaluate process builds a retained set of complementary, prompt-relevant evidence. Experiments across eight image-understanding benchmarks show that DIVE consistently preserves performance across token budgets. With an 88.9% reduction in visual tokens, DIVE retains 98.2% of the uncompressed model's average performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Zhong-Chenchen/DIVE.git.

Motivation: VLM 中视觉输入被编码成远长于文本的 token 序列，成为推理效率的主要瓶颈。现有方法通常单次打分并按重要性剪枝，但 token 与提示相关的有用性取决于已经保留的证据，单次评分不足以选出互补且有效的视觉证据。
Method: DIVE 将视觉 token 剪枝转化为动态证据构建：反复选择当前剩余 token 中残差条件分数（residual-conditioned score）最高的 token，更新视觉与提示残差以折扣已被解释的证据，再重新评估剩余 token，形成“选择-更新-再评估”的迭代过程。
Result: 实验覆盖八个图像理解基准，显示 DIVE 在多种 token 预算下均能保持性能；在剪除 88.9% 视觉 token 时，平均性能保持为未压缩模型的 98.2%。
Conclusion: DIVE 作为无需训练的方法，通过动态残差更新构建互补且与提示相关的视觉证据，为 VLM 视觉 token 压缩提供了有效方案。摘要未说明具体局限。

papers.title: Not All Redundant Tokens Are Alike: Analyzing Visual Token Pruning through Token Roles
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) process an image as a sequence of visual tokens, which creates a substantial computational bottleneck during inference. Recent visual token pruning methods address this issue by removing seemingly redundant tokens, yet it remains unclear how these pruning decisions relate to the functional roles of visual tokens. In this work, we analyze visual token pruning through the lens of token roles identified by EmbedLens. We first show that representative pruning methods exhibit distinct token-role biases, but these biases do not directly correlate with downstream performance. To better understand this behavior, we refine the token-role assignment procedure and evaluate role-protected pruning variants. Our results show that preserving non-alive tokens can sometimes maintain or improve performance, suggesting that tokens with weak direct semantic alignment may still affect model behavior under pruning. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jaykim9870/Not_All_Redundant_Tokens_Are_Alike.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 EmbedLens 识别出的 token 角色 (token roles) 视角分析视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中的视觉 token 剪枝。作者发现代表性剪枝方法表现出不同的 token-role 偏好，但这些偏好与下游性能并无直接相关；通过改进 token 角色分配并评测保护特定角色的剪枝变体，发现保留非存活 token (non-alive tokens) 有时能维持甚至提升性能。代码已公开。
Motivation: VLM 将图像视为视觉 token 序列，推理时形成显著计算瓶颈；现有视觉 token 剪枝方法虽然删除看似冗余的 token，但剪枝决策与 token 功能角色之间的关系仍不清楚。
Method: 借助 EmbedLens 的 token 角色标注来分析多种代表性剪枝方法的剪枝偏好；改进 token 角色分配流程，并构建 role-protected 剪枝变体，以考察强制保留某些角色（尤其非存活 token）对性能的影响。
Result: 代表性剪枝方法各自呈现不同的 token-role 偏差，但这些偏差与下游性能不直接相关；保留非存活 token 的 role-protected 剪枝有时可以维持或改善性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，与语义直接对齐较弱的 token (weak direct semantic alignment) 在剪枝条件下仍可能影响模型行为，因此 token 角色分析有助于理解并改进剪枝策略。

papers.title: REZE: Recognition-Based Zero-Shot Extraction for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding (VTG) refers to the task of identifying the time interval in a video that corresponds to a given natural-language query. A common zero-shot strategy asks a large vision-language model (VLM) to generate the start and end timestamps directly, so the result depends heavily on the design and training of the model, and grounding accuracy differs widely from one VLM to another. We therefore propose REcognition-based Zero-shot Extraction (REZE), a simple training-free method that splits the video into short clips, asks the model for a clip-level confidence score for the query, and uses a deterministic algorithm to convert the resulting score curve into the output required by the task. Because temporal aggregation is performed outside the model, REZE adapts to different task outputs, from single- and multi-interval moment retrieval to highlight detection. On QVHighlights, REZE improves the best reported training-free moment-retrieval mAP from 38.23 to 40.32, while on highlight detection it reaches 44.18 mAP and 73.41 HIT@1, establishing a new state of the art among training-free methods. Its HIT@1 also outperforms all fully supervised SoTAs on the QVHighlights test split. We evaluate REZE on seven backbones from three model families. On Charades-STA and QVHighlights, it outperforms direct timestamp generation in every available comparison. We further observe that with REZE an earlier-generation model can approach the native performance of a newer model in its family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REZE（Recognition-based Zero-shot Extraction），一种免训练的零样本视频时间定位方法：将视频切成短片段，让视觉语言模型输出片段级置信度分数，再用确定性算法把分数曲线转成任务输出。该设计把时序聚合移出模型，可适配单/多区间时刻检索和高亮检测等输出。在 QVHighlights 上，REZE 将免训练时刻检索 mAP 从 38.23 提升到 40.32，高亮检测达到 44.18 mAP 与 73.41 HIT@1，其 HIT@1 还超过了所有全监督 SOTA。
Motivation: 常见零样本视频时间定位策略是让大视觉语言模型直接生成起止时间戳，结果高度依赖模型设计与训练，不同 VLM 的定位精度差异大。REZE 通过片段级识别评分加模型外聚合，解耦模型能力与任务输出格式。
Method: REZE 将视频切分为短片段，让 VLM 对每个片段给出查询相关的置信度分数，再用确定性算法把分数曲线转换为任务所需输出；由于时序聚合在模型外完成，可统一支持单/多区间时刻检索和高亮检测。论文在三个模型族、七个骨干上评估了该方法。
Result: 在 QVHighlights 上，REZE 将最佳免训练时刻检索 mAP 从 38.23 提高到 40.32；高亮检测达到 44.18 mAP 和 73.41 HIT@1，成为免训练方法的新 SOTA，且 HIT@1 超过所有全监督 SOTA。在 Charades-STA 和 QVHighlights 上，REZE 在全部可比对比中都优于直接时间戳生成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，使用 REZE 后较早代际的模型可以接近其模型族内较新模型的原生性能，说明将时序聚合外置能缩小模型代际差距；论文未在摘要中展开其他局限。
