papers.title: AudioScape-TTA: A Structured Soundscape Benchmark for Fine-Grained Text-to-Audio Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-audio (TTA) generation has recently achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing realistic audio from natural language descriptions. However, determining whether generated audio faithfully satisfies complex textual instructions remains challenging. Existing benchmarks mainly rely on global similarity metrics, providing limited insight into fine-grained semantic failures. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{AudioScape-TTA}, a structured and complexity-aware benchmark for fine-grained TTA evaluation. AudioScape-TTA represents realistic soundscapes through modality-aware semantic structures and characterizes generation complexity using event density and structural complexity. Based on these annotations, we propose a rubric-based audio-grounded evaluation framework that verifies event realization, acoustic attributes, and speech content through fine-grained semantic criteria. The benchmark contains 2,258 audio-text pairs with 25,707 binary QA rubrics, enabling scalable and interpretable analysis of TTA systems. Experiments on 13 representative open-source TTA models reveal persistent limitations in fine-grained attribute control, speech-content preservation, and compositional soundscape generation. Human validation further demonstrates that our rubric-based evaluation achieves stronger alignment with human semantic judgments than conventional global similarity metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AudioScape-TTA，一个用于细粒度文生音频（text-to-audio, TTA）评估的结构化、复杂度感知基准。该基准通过模态感知语义结构表示真实声景，并用事件密度和结构复杂度刻画生成难度，同时提出基于 rubric 的音频接地评估框架。基准包含 2,258 对音频-文本样本和 25,707 条二元 QA rubric，实验显示现有 TTA 模型在细粒度属性控制、语音内容保持和组合声景生成上仍存在明显不足。
Motivation: 现有 TTA 评估主要依赖全局相似度指标，难以揭示生成音频是否忠实满足复杂文本指令，尤其无法定位细粒度的语义失败（semantic failures）。
Method: 构建 AudioScape-TTA 基准，通过模态感知语义结构组织声景，并以事件密度与结构复杂度表征生成复杂度；在此基础上提出 rubric 式、以音频为接地的评估框架，按事件实现、声学属性和语音内容等细粒度语义准则进行判定。
Result: 在 13 个开源 TTA 模型上的实验揭示了细粒度属性控制、语音内容保持和组合性声景生成方面的持续局限；人类验证表明，rubric 式评估比传统全局相似度指标更贴近人类语义判断。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准和 rubric 评估框架能够为 TTA 系统提供可扩展、可解释的细粒度分析，并指出当前模型在组合声景与内容保持上的普遍短板。

papers.title: DeepInvert: Semi-Supervised Embedding Inversion Against Obfuscated Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-based language model services routinely process prompts containing sensitive information. Obfuscation-based defenses---including ObfusLM, SentinelLMs, TextObfuscator, and DPNR---mitigate this risk by transforming prompt representations before transmission, offering a lightweight alternative to cryptographic solutions. We show these defenses provide far less protection than previously believed. We present DeepInvert, a semi-supervised embedding inversion attack that recovers original tokens from obfuscated representations with higher accuracy than prior methods. The key insight is that unlabeled obfuscated embeddings retain exploitable semantic structure despite perturbation. DeepInvert combines supervised training on labeled shadow data with a novel unsupervised consistency objective over unlabeled target embeddings, alternating between the two via a mixed training pipeline. Defense-aware adaptations further extend the attack to diverse obfuscation mechanisms across encoder-based and autoregressive architectures. Experiments on nine defenses, five tasks, and four model architectures show that DeepInvert outperforms prior attacks on most defenses. Against ObfusLM, DeepInvert achieves 73.5\% top-1 token recovery versus 26.2\% for the previous best. Our results reveal a task-dependent tension: obfuscation schemes preserving enough signal for utility also retain sufficient structure for inversion, while schemes resisting inversion collapse utility. On simpler classification tasks, some DP-based defenses can maintain both. We call for a re-evaluation of this defense class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepInvert，一种半监督嵌入反转攻击，可从混淆后的语言模型嵌入中恢复原始 token，且精度高于先前方法。作者在九种防御、五个任务和四种模型架构上的实验显示，混淆类防御提供的保护远低于此前认知；针对 ObfusLM，DeepInvert 达到 73.5% 的 top-1 token 恢复率，而先前最优方法为 26.2%。
Motivation: 云端语言模型服务会处理含敏感信息的提示，混淆防御（如 ObfusLM、SentinelLMs、TextObfuscator、DPNR）被提出作为加密方案的轻量替代，但本文表明这类防御提供的保护远比此前认为的弱。
Method: DeepInvert 结合在带标签影子数据上的监督训练与针对无标签目标嵌入的无监督一致性目标，通过混合训练流水线交替优化；防御感知的适应机制进一步将攻击扩展到编码器与自回归架构下的多种混淆机制。
Result: 在九种防御、五个任务和四种模型架构上，DeepInvert 在大多数防御上优于先前攻击；针对 ObfusLM 达到 73.5% top-1 token 恢复率（先前最好为 26.2%）。结果揭示任务相关的张力：保留足够效用信号的混淆方案也保留可供反转的结构，而抵抗反转的方案则效用崩溃；在较简单的分类任务上，部分基于 DP 的防御可同时兼顾两者。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁重新评估混淆防御这一类方法，认为其保护能力被高估。

papers.title: Local Violation Certification for Linear Predict-Then-Optimize Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven decision pipelines combining predictive machine learning models with downstream optimization software are increasingly used to make high-stakes operational decisions. Certifying the safety, fairness, and reliability of these decisions is essential, yet traditional scenario generation methods rely on repeated random testing, which becomes computationally prohibitive when failure events are rare and offers little insight into why failures occur. We present a framework for local violation certification designed specifically for linear decision pipelines under input uncertainty. We mathematically demonstrate that standard sampling methods fail efficiently for rare violations, motivating a direct structural approach. By analyzing the fixed decision boundary of a deployed pipeline, we show that the local risk of failure can be calculated directly in closed form using a single optimization solve. Furthermore, we introduce an exact sampling procedure and closed-form risk statistics that provide feature-level attributions (identifying which input characteristics contribute most to potential non-compliance) without requiring repetitive random trials or complex sampling algorithms. We demonstrate our approach on an economic power dispatch system subject to emissions regulations, delivering precise, auditable risk assessments at a fraction of the traditional computational cost.

Motivation: 数据驱动的预测模型与下游优化软件构成的决策管线需要认证安全性、公平性与可靠性，但传统场景生成方法依赖重复随机测试，在失效事件罕见时计算代价过高，且难以解释失效原因。
Method: 针对线性决策管线在输入不确定性下的局部违规认证，分析部署管线的固定决策边界，将局部失效风险转化为单次优化求解的闭式计算；同时提出精确采样过程和闭式风险统计量，提供特征级归因 (feature-level attributions)，无需重复随机试验或复杂采样算法。
Result: 摘要报告在受排放法规约束的经济电力调度系统上的演示，能以传统计算成本的一小部分提供精确、可审计的风险评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调直接的结构化方法相比标准采样方法在罕见违规认证上的效率优势，并为决策管线提供无需重复随机试验的特征归因能力。

papers.title: EndoVLM: An Endoscopy Vision-Language Pre-training Model via Anatomy-Guided Sparsity and Progressive Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The development of foundation models (FMs) is crucial for advancing endoscopic image analysis. However, existing endoscopy FMs mainly rely on self-supervised learning from uni-modal images or videos, overlooking the rich semantic knowledge contained in clinical reports. Furthermore, effectively leveraging these records is hindered by a fundamental modality gap: structured anatomical descriptions are not naturally mapped to specific frames within the high-redundancy, uncurated visual streams. In this paper, we present EndoVLM, a novel vision-language FM pre-trained on over 348K endoscopic examinations, each pairing a clinical report with its corresponding image collection. An Anatomy-Guided Sparse Pooling mechanism utilizes textual descriptions as queries to drive sparse attention, efficiently aggregating semantically salient frames into anatomy-specific visual representations across redundant image-sets. Next, a Progressive Semantic-Aware Alignment strategy models clinical taxonomy (anatomy and pathological status) via structured soft targets, bridging the gap from global patient-level matching to fine-grained localized alignment. Finally, a Semantic-Concentrated Masked Autoencoder is applied exclusively to these semantic-rich frames, integrating low-level visual precision with robust high-level semantic representation. Extensive experiments across various downstream tasks demonstrate that EndoVLM outperforms existing foundation models and remains competitive with task-specific methods. Remarkably, EndoVLM also exhibits robust zero-shot generalization capabilities, highlighting its potential for broader clinical application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoVLM，一个内窥镜视觉-语言基础模型，在超过 34.8 万次内窥镜检查（每次配对临床报告与对应图像集合）上预训练。通过解剖引导的稀疏池化、渐进语义感知对齐和语义集中的掩码自编码器，将临床报告语义与高冗余视觉帧结合。摘要称其在多种下游任务上优于现有基础模型、与任务专用方法相当，并展示出零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有内窥镜基础模型大多依赖单模态图像或视频的自监督学习，忽略了临床报告中丰富的语义知识；同时结构化解剖描述与高冗余、未整理的视觉流之间存在模态鸿沟，难以将文本自然映射到特定帧。
Method: 提出 EndoVLM，包含三个组件：Anatomy-Guided Sparse Pooling 以文本描述为查询驱动稀疏注意力，从冗余图像集中聚合语义显著帧为解剖特定的视觉表示；Progressive Semantic-Aware Alignment 用结构化软目标建模临床分类学（解剖与病理状态），从全局患者级匹配过渡到细粒度局部对齐；Semantic-Concentrated Masked Autoencoder 仅应用于语义丰富帧，整合低层视觉精度与高层语义表示。
Result: 摘要报告在多种下游任务上 EndoVLM 优于现有基础模型，并保持与任务专用方法的竞争力；同时表现出稳健的零样本泛化能力，显示其在更广泛临床应用中的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调利用临床报告-图像配对数据，并通过解剖引导的稀疏聚合与渐进式语义对齐，可以构建更强的内窥镜视觉-语言基础模型。

papers.title: Beyond Linear Dynamics: Neural Bilinear Dynamical Models for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series in real-world applications are often generated by nonlinear dynamical systems, making accurate forecasting challenging. Existing approaches that explicitly model system dynamics typically rely on linear assumptions or Koopman-based linearizations, which may inadequately capture complex nonlinear behaviors and lead to error accumulation in long-horizon prediction. To address this limitation, we propose the Neural Bilinear Dynamical Model (NBDM), which models nonlinear system dynamics through a bilinear latent dynamical formulation. Specifically, NBDM leverages Koopman theory to lift the original nonlinear dynamics into a higher-dimensional latent space, where a bilinear dynamical model is constructed to characterize state evolution. To mitigate the approximation error introduced by bilinear representations, we further incorporate a parameterized error compensation term. Within this formulation, control inputs are explicitly integrated into the dynamics, using auxiliary variables when available and learned feedback signals otherwise. To handle scenarios with missing control inputs, we design a memory-enhanced controller that infers latent controls through multiplicative interactions between historical states and control signals. Experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate that NBDM consistently outperforms competitive baselines in both given-control and missing-control settings, particularly for multi-step and long-horizon forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经双线性动力学模型 (Neural Bilinear Dynamical Model, NBDM)，用于时间序列预测。模型借助 Koopman 理论将原始非线性动力学提升到高维潜空间，在其中构造双线性动力学刻画状态演化，并加入参数化误差补偿项以缓解双线性表示的近似误差；控制输入被显式纳入动力学，缺失时由记忆增强控制器推断潜控制。摘要称在五个真实数据集上，NBDM 在给定控制与缺失控制两种设置下均一致优于竞争基线，尤其体现在多步与长程预测上。
Motivation: 现实时间序列常由非线性动力系统生成，而现有显式建模动力学的做法多依赖线性假设或 Koopman 线性化，难以充分捕捉复杂非线性行为，并会在长程预测中造成误差累积。
Method: NBDM 基于 Koopman 理论将非线性动力学提升到高维潜空间，用双线性潜动力学模型描述状态演化，并引入参数化误差补偿项降低双线性表示的近似误差；控制输入被显式整合进动力学，可用时使用辅助变量，不可用时通过记忆增强控制器利用历史状态与控制信号的乘法交互来推断潜控制。
Result: 摘要报告在五个真实世界数据集上，NBDM 在 given-control 和 missing-control 两种设定下均持续优于竞争基线，特别是在多步与长时程预测任务上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调双线性潜动力学、误差补偿以及显式控制输入建模的组合能有效改善长期时间序列预测；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Tropical Algebraic Geometry for Neuronal Representations: An Arakelov-Green Measure Based Descriptor for Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: The quantitative analysis of 3D neuronal morphologies requires capturing both graph topology and spatial geometry. Current message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are bounded by the 1-Weisfeiler-Lehman (1-WL) test, limiting their ability to capture cycles induced by spatial proximities. To address this, we propose a training-free geometric prior based on tropical algebraic geometry. We apply the recently established tropical Abel-Jacobi transform and polarization distances to machine learning on tree-structured data. We introduce a structural transformation pipeline, comprising cycle space augmentation and quotient space construction, to convert spatial trees into cyclic metric graphs suitable for embedding into the Tropical Jacobian. Computing exact tropical polarization distances requires solving the NP-Hard Closest Vector Problem (CVP) on integer lattices. Instead of relying on explicit approximations with quantization errors (e.g., Babai's rounding), we adopt a continuous relaxation on the universal cover of the Albanese torus. We show that the discrete Arakelov-Green measure, computed in closed form via the graph Laplacian's generalized inverse, decomposes exactly into the intrinsic path metric minus the unquantized polarization distance on this cover, avoiding integer lattice searches. This metric yields two descriptors: eigenvectors provide node-level structural coordinates, and the permutation-invariant eigenvalue spectrum provides a graph-level signature. On the BREC benchmark, the eigenvector formulation demonstrates expressivity beyond the 1-WL limit. On 3D morphology datasets (ACT-4, JML-4, BIL-6), the spectrum seamlessly integrates into standard architectures (VAEs, GNNs, Tree-LSTMs) without additional trainable parameters, outperforming explicit lattice approximations and improving classification accuracy over existing spatial models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于热带代数几何 (tropical algebraic geometry) 的无训练几何先验，用于图学习中对 3D 神经元形态的定量分析。作者应用热带 Abel-Jacobi 变换与极化距离 (polarization distances)，通过循环空间增广和商空间构造将空间树转换为可嵌入 Tropical Jacobian 的循环度量图；为避免求解 NP-hard 的整数格最近向量问题 (CVP)，在 Albanese 环面的万有覆盖上采用连续松弛，并用图拉普拉斯广义逆闭式计算离散 Arakelov-Green 度量。该度量给出两类描述子：节点级结构坐标的特征向量与图级置换不变的特征值谱。
Motivation: 现有消息传递 GNN 受 1-Weisfeiler-Lehman (1-WL) 测试限制，难以捕捉由空间邻近性诱导的环结构；而 3D 神经元形态的定量分析需要同时刻画图的拓扑与空间几何。
Method: 提出基于热带代数几何的训练无关几何先验，使用热带 Abel-Jacobi 变换与极化距离，并设计包含循环空间增广与商空间构造的结构变换流水线，将空间树转为循环度量图。计算精确热带极化距离需解整数格上的 NP-hard CVP，作者改为在 Albanese 环面的万有覆盖上做连续松弛，借助图拉普拉斯广义逆以闭式求离散 Arakelov-Green 度量，该度量精确分解为内在路径度量减去该覆盖上的未量化极化距离，从而避免整数格搜索。
Result: 在 BREC 基准上，特征向量形式展现出超越 1-WL 极限的表达能力；在 3D 形态数据集 ACT-4、JML-4、BIL-6 上，特征值谱可直接集成到 VAE、GNN、Tree-LSTM 等标准架构中且无需额外可训练参数，优于显式格近似方法，并在与现有空间模型的分类精度对比中取得提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过万有覆盖上的连续松弛避免了整数格搜索，给出的离散 Arakelov-Green 度量具有闭式精确分解，并作为无需训练的参数化先验提升图学习在下游形态分类任务上的效果。

papers.title: Architectural Implications of Agentic AI Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is emerging in datacenters, but its architectural implications remain unexplored. We organize agentic workflows in a taxonomy and present its first architectural characterization with a production study at Microsoft Azure and a controlled study of open-source frameworks. We show that agentic execution is fragmented and heterogeneous. Requests expand into a workflow of LLM inferences, tool invocations, and orchestration decisions that repeatedly cross the CPU-GPU boundary. Our taxonomy explains how this fragmentation turns into resource demand. As orchestration and tools run on the host, the CPU sits on the critical path. Execution structure sets the load over time, which stays low with sudden spikes. Model composition sets how evenly the workflow uses the GPUs. Diversity in tasks and tools widens this range even further. These characteristics expose architectural mismatches of conventional uniform servers. Fragmented execution strands CPU and GPU capacity despite bursty demand. Different software roles make homogeneous CPU provisioning inefficient. Finally, multiplexing many agents onto shared cores degrades microarchitectural locality. Guided by our findings, we derive implications for agentic servers and examine them through Agora, our prototype for commodity servers. Agora dynamically harvests idle CPU cores for co-located throughput work, while protecting agentic tail latency against tool spikes. It oversubscribes GPU memory by placing more agents on each GPU, prefetching the next agent's state to hide swap latency. To match the machine to the heterogeneous roles, Agora pools cores by role and applies affinity-aware scheduling to restore locality. It automatically tunes mechanisms to the workload. Agora improves utilization and server throughput while preserving agent tail latency. Our insights also identify key directions for future server architectures for agentic AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对数据中心中的 agentic AI 工作负载做架构层面的刻画，结合 Microsoft Azure 的生产研究与开源框架的受控实验提出分类法，并据此设计原型 Agora。研究发现 agentic 执行具有碎片化和异构性：请求会展开为反复跨越 CPU-GPU 边界的 LLM 推理、工具调用与编排决策，且 CPU 处于关键路径上。Agora 通过动态回收空闲 CPU 核、GPU 内存超卖与按角色分池调度，在保持 agent 尾延迟的同时提升利用率和吞吐。
Motivation: Agentic AI 正在进入数据中心，但其架构影响尚未被系统研究，传统均匀服务器（uniform servers）在这种新工作负载下存在资源错配。

papers.title: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigenius turns data provenance into a structural invariant rather than a property reconstructed across subsystem boundaries. The kernel rests on three pillars: a dependent type theory woven through the core, institutions acting as strongly typed integration boundaries, and a content-addressed immutable storage layer. On this foundation, epistemic status (declared/observed/derived/verified) is enforced as a strict commit-time invariant. Cross-system translations (comorphisms) are checked at commit and materialized directly into the graph as durable, first-class resources. To eliminate O(N^2) polystore bottlenecks, shared on-chain intermediate representations (IRs) collapse multi-system translations to identity. Crucially, this architecture unifies both domains of scientific epistemology: it relies on justification logic for empirical science, while embedding a fast, in-process term checker to safely evaluate formal mathematical proofs (via Lean 4) without IPC overhead. In an end-to-end recomputation of a published Nature study from fragile scripts to a materialized evidence graph, all 52 derived conclusions hold from pinned data, surfacing four machine-checked discrepancies in the original study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Eigenius，一个开源的类型化知识图谱 DBMS，面向通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 驱动研究的“AI 科学家”，目标是让数据溯源成为结构不变量而非跨子系统重建的属性。其内核由依赖类型理论、作为强类型集成边界的 institutions，以及内容寻址的不可变存储三根支柱构成，并在提交时强制检查 epistemic status 与跨系统翻译 (comorphisms)。作者用该体系对一篇已发表的 Nature 研究做端到端重计算，52 条派生结论全部在固定数据上成立，并暴露出原文的四处机器可查差异。
Motivation: 依赖临时脚本 (ephemeral scripts) 的 AI 研究系统无法支撑大规模、有状态且相互关联的证据链；回答审计问题（“你知道什么，以及你的保证是什么？”）需要把类型系统、存储引擎和集成协议紧耦合在一个统一内核中。
Method: Eigenius 将依赖类型理论贯穿核心，把 institutions 用作强类型集成边界，并采用内容寻址的不可变存储层；declared/observed/derived/verified 等 epistemic status 被作为提交时的不变量强制检查。跨系统翻译在提交时校验并物化为图中一等资源，共享的链上中间表示 (IR) 将多系统翻译折叠为恒等操作以消除 O(N^2) polystore 瓶颈；同时嵌入进程内 Lean 4 项检查器，无需 IPC 开销即可安全验证形式化数学证明。
Result: 在端到端重计算一篇已发表 Nature 研究的实验中，所有 52 条派生结论在固定数据 (pinned data) 上均成立，并发现了原文中四处机器可检查的不一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构统一了科学认识论的两个领域：用 justification logic 支撑经验科学，同时用进程内项检查器支撑形式化数学证明；数据溯源因此成为结构不变量，而不再是事后重构的性质。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Objective Ranking for Live-Streaming: Balancing Fresh and Delayed Signals with Segment-Aware Targeting
papers.abstract_en: One of the most challenging problems entertainment live-streaming services face in recommendation systems is that user behaviors are sparse and delayed, and interaction data exhibits bias for different user segments. Unlike e-commerce applications where user actions follow linear sequences, live-streaming viewers engage in multiple concurrent behaviors of watching, chatting, following, and spending, each occurring with varying delays. We address these challenges through three key contributions: 1) a delayed window approach that extends feedback collection beyond immediate responses, 2) a multi-model architecture that combines fresh and delayed signals, and a segment-aware targeting module that optimizes ranking scores differently across user lifecycle stages, and 3) Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) integration that jointly models correlated targets while reducing model parameters by 41.9% compared to independent models. Online A/B testing demonstrates significant improvements, including a +0.09% increase in Daily Active Viewers (DAV), generating millions more annual active viewer days, and +0.56% increase in highly engaged viewers' capped Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). Viewer-segment targeting achieved an additional +0.15% DAV improvement for newer and less engaged viewers, while MMoE enhancement added +0.08% overall DAV and +0.27% new follows. The proposed system processes ranking requests with low latency, providing a scalable approach for balancing multiple business objectives across diverse user populations. In addition, we tested the multi-model architecture on the Twitch mobile live feed and achieved a +1.12% increase in positive user-channel interactions (clicks, follows, and likes), demonstrating applicability beyond the primary use case.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the Industry Track of the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套面向娱乐直播推荐系统的多目标排序方案，核心是处理用户行为稀疏、延迟且有分段偏差的问题。作者引入延迟窗口扩展反馈收集，构建融合新鲜信号与延迟信号的多模型架构，并加入分段感知目标模块和MMoE集成。在线A/B测试显示DAV、高活跃用户ARPU等指标提升，并在Twitch移动直播流上验证了迁移性。
Motivation: 直播场景中用户行为（观看、聊天、关注、消费）并发发生且延迟各不相同，与传统电商的线性行为序列不同，导致推荐系统的反馈信号稀疏、延迟且对不同用户分段存在偏差。
Method: 提出三个关键部件：延迟窗口（delayed window）机制扩展反馈收集范围；多模型架构结合新鲜与延迟信号，并加入按用户生命周期分段的感知目标模块；以及用多门控混合专家（MMoE）联合建模相关目标，同时相对独立模型减少41.9%参数。
Result: 在线A/B测试显示DAV提升+0.09%，高活跃用户封顶ARPU提升+0.56%；对新用户和低活跃用户的分段定向额外提升DAV +0.15%；MMoE增强带来DAV +0.08%和新关注+0.27%。在Twitch移动直播流上，正向用户-频道互动（点击、关注、点赞）提升+1.12%。
Conclusion: 系统在低延迟下处理排序请求，提供一种在多样用户群体间平衡多个业务目标的可扩展方案，并展示了超越主用例的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Global Routing Aggregation: Phase-Aware Expert Merging for MoE Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts vision-language models (MoE-VLMs) increase model capacity with sparse expert activation, yet deployment requires storing the full expert pool. Training-free expert merging reduces this burden, and many routing-based methods aggregate routing statistics across all tokens to determine merge compatibility. However, MoE-VLM inference is phase-structured: image-context tokens carry visual content, question tokens specify the query, and answer tokens produce the output, with different counts and routing distributions. Because image-context tokens are far more numerous, global aggregation can overemphasize image-context processing and obscure phase-conditioned expert roles, making experts serving different phases appear interchangeable and degrading model performance. We therefore argue that MoE-VLM expert merging should preserve phase-conditioned expert roles, judging compatibility by how experts serve different phases rather than globally aggregated routing statistics. Based on this view, we propose RoleMerge, a training-free method that constructs each expert's Routing Role Profile (RRP) from phase-normalized routing statistics, capturing its relative phase preference. Guided by expert-phase information loss, RoleMerge merges experts with compatible profiles and their corresponding router entries while preserving answer-decoding expert distinctions. Experiments on three models and multiple benchmarks show that RoleMerge preserves more of the full model's performance than alternative expert-merging methods at matched expert-retention ratios, with relative improvements of up to 9.6 percent in six-task macro-average performance. These results validate phase-conditioned expert roles as a more effective basis than global routing aggregation for MoE-VLM expert merging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 MoE 视觉-语言模型 (MoE-VLM) 的无训练专家合并中，全局路由统计聚合会因图像上下文 token 数量远多于问答/输出 token 而过度强调图像处理，掩盖不同推理阶段 (phase) 对应的专家角色，导致合并后性能下降。作者据此提出 RoleMerge，一种无训练专家合并方法，基于阶段归一化的路由统计构建每个专家的 Routing Role Profile (RRP)，并按专家-阶段信息损失合并兼容的专家及其路由条目。在三个模型和多个基准上的实验表明，在相同专家保留比例下，RoleMerge 比现有专家合并方法保留更多完整模型性能，六任务宏平均性能相对提升最高达 9.6%。
Motivation: 现有很多基于路由的专家合并方法对所有 token 的路由统计做全局聚合来决定合并兼容性，但 MoE-VLM 推理具有明显的阶段结构：图像上下文 token 数量远多于提问和回答 token，全局聚合会掩盖阶段相关的专家角色，使服务于不同阶段的专家看起来可互换，从而降低模型性能。
Method: 提出训练自由的 RoleMerge 方法：先从阶段归一化的路由统计中为每个专家构建 Routing Role Profile (RRP)，刻画其相对阶段偏好；再以专家-阶段信息损失 (expert-phase information loss) 为准则，合并 profile 兼容的专家及其对应的 router 条目，同时保留负责答案解码的专家区分度。
Result: 在三个 MoE-VLM 模型和多个基准上，以匹配的专家保留比例与替代专家合并方法对比，RoleMerge 保留了更多完整模型性能，六任务宏平均性能的相对提升最高达 9.6%。
Conclusion: 作者认为阶段条件化的专家角色比全局路由聚合更适合作为 MoE-VLM 专家合并的依据，验证了保留阶段相关专家角色的有效性；方法无需训练，适合部署时缩减专家池。

papers.title: TwinIR: Coordinated Invisible Dual-Point Attacks on Online HD Map Construction
papers.abstract_en: Online HD map construction is critical to prediction and planning in autonomous driving. We find that existing physical attacks against online map construction are limited by a cross-boundary compensation effect: after the target boundary is perturbed, another visible boundary may retain sufficient geometric cues for the model to recover the original road geometry. Based on this observation, we propose TwinIR, a new mechanism-guided physical attack methodology for online map construction. TwinIR jointly optimizes attack effectiveness and point sparsity, seeking the minimum number of attack points needed to suppress compensating geometric cues from surrounding boundaries. To reduce the perceptibility of multi-point attacks, TwinIR models camera responses to near-infrared illumination and maps optimized attack points to feasible physical placements, producing camera-visible interference with minimal visible-spectrum changes. Experiments on nuScenes across state-of-the-art online map construction models show that TwinIR reduces mAP by 8.18-8.96 percentage points under RSA and 2.84-5.62 points under ETA, while increasing the unreachable-goal rate by 25-28 points and the unsafe-planned-trajectory rate by 19-20 points over clean inputs. These attacks are also validated on a real-world testbed AV, where TwinIR successfully induces both road straightening and early-turn deformations while remaining inconspicuous in full-color views.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线高清地图 (HD map) 构建的物理攻击问题，提出 TwinIR 攻击方法。作者观察到现有攻击受到跨边界补偿效应 (cross-boundary compensation effect) 的限制：目标边界被扰动后，其他可见边界仍可能提供足够几何线索使模型恢复原始道路几何。TwinIR 联合优化攻击有效性与攻击点稀疏性，并利用近红外光照降低攻击在可见光谱下的感知度。实验在 nuScenes 和真实测试车平台上验证了攻击效果与隐蔽性。
Motivation: 现有针对在线地图构建的物理攻击因跨边界补偿效应而受限，扰动目标边界后模型仍可借助其他可见边界恢复道路几何。这使得攻击不够有效，需要一种能同时压制补偿线索并降低可感知性的攻击方法。
Method: TwinIR 是一种机制引导的物理攻击方法，它联合优化攻击效果和点稀疏性，寻找抑制周围边界补偿几何线索所需的最少攻击点；同时建模相机对近红外照明的响应，将优化后的攻击点映射到可行的物理位置，从而产生相机可见的干扰而在可见光谱内几乎无变化。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上对多种最新在线地图构建模型的实验中，该方法在 RSA 下使 mAP 降低 8.18-8.96 个百分点，在 ETA 下降低 2.84-5.62 个百分点；与干净输入相比，不可达目标率增加 25-28 个百分点，不安全规划轨迹率增加 19-20 个百分点。真实测试车上成功诱导道路拉直和早转变形，且在全彩视图下难以察觉。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 TwinIR 能有效利用跨边界补偿效应的机理，以稀疏且隐蔽的方式攻击在线地图构建，并在真实世界测试车上得到验证。

papers.title: Q-CueGraph: Query-Conditioned Visual Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution pixels and crop or zoom tools give multimodal large language models the ability to inspect an image, but they do not provide a reliable task-conditioned policy for deciding where to inspect. Q-CueGraph makes this decision explicit. It maps a question and an image representation to budgeted, coordinate-level observations for a frozen reader. Text-rich images use a reusable OCR/layout graph; natural-image search instantiates query-conditioned visual nodes behind the same selection, composition, and budgeting interface. Optional utility refinement learns which candidate crops the frozen reader can use from training-answer correctness, without region-box supervision. With a frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B reader, Q-CueGraph reaches 0.833 accuracy on V*Bench versus 0.696 for full-image inference from a 19% image-area budget, and reaches 92% of full-image ANLS on InfographicVQA from about half the image area. Across six benchmarks, explicit observation is most valuable when evidence is localizable, the question discriminates its location, and resolution limits full-image reading.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-CueGraph，一种为多模态大语言模型显式选择图像观察位置的方法。它将问题与图像表示映射为带预算的坐标级观察，供冻结的 reader 使用：文本密集图像复用 OCR/布局图，自然图像检索则实例化查询条件化的视觉节点；可选的工具精炼阶段无需区域框监督即可学习哪些候选裁剪对冻结 reader 有用。在冻结 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，该方法以 19% 图像面积预算在 V*Bench 达到 0.833 准确率（全图推理为 0.696），在 InfographicVQA 上以约一半图像面积达到全图 ANLS 的 92%。
Motivation: 高分辨率像素与裁剪/缩放工具虽使多模态大模型能够检查图像，但缺乏可靠的任务条件化策略来决定检查哪里，导致观察选择不明确。
Method: Q-CueGraph 将问题与图像表示映射到预算化的坐标级观察，统一了文本密集图像的 OCR/布局图与自然图像的查询条件化视觉节点，并支持选择、组合与预算接口；可选工具精炼利用训练答案正确性学习哪些候选裁剪对 frozen reader 可用，且不需要区域框监督。
Result: 使用冻结 Qwen2.5-VL-7B reader，Q-CueGraph 在 V*Bench 上以 19% 图像面积预算达到 0.833 准确率，而全图推理为 0.696；在 InfographicVQA 上以约一半图像面积达到全图 ANLS 的 92%。跨六个基准，显式观察在证据可定位、问题能区分位置且分辨率限制全图阅读时最有价值。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式的任务条件化观察决策能显著提升受限面积下的多模态推理性能，且无需区域框监督即可学习裁剪效用；其价值取决于证据局部化程度与提问判别力等条件。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Counterexample to Fourier Alignment in Single-Neuron Modular Addition
papers.abstract_en: We give a negative solution to MAIS-O60. We first construct an example in which an initially active ReLU neuron becomes completely inactive in finite time and thereafter remains frozen at a limit whose Fourier energy is equally distributed among all nonzero real frequency classes. The counterexample holds on an open set of initial conditions and therefore occurs with positive probability under Gaussian initialization. An appendix prepared by GPT-5.6 Sol strengthens the counterexample by showing that the same failure can occur for every Clarke trajectory from an open set of initial conditions, under the convention $\mathrm{ReLU}'(0)=0$, for smooth dead-zone approximations of ReLU, and for fixed-step full-batch gradient descent. Thus, single-frequency alignment is not a general consequence of training a single neuron on modular addition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出 MAIS-O60 的否定解，构造了一个单 ReLU 神经元在模加法训练中的反例：一个初始活跃的神经元在有限时间内完全失活，此后冻结在一个傅里叶能量在所有非零实频率类别间均匀分布的极限上。该反例在初始条件的开集上成立，因此高斯初始化下以正概率出现。这否定了单频对齐（single-frequency alignment）作为单神经元模加法训练的一般结果。
Motivation: 该工作针对模加法上训练单神经元时是否普遍出现特定频率对齐的问题，即 MAIS-O60；通过构造反例，表明这种对齐并非必然发生的机制。
Method: 构造一个具体的反例，其中初始活跃的 ReLU 神经元在有限时间内完全失活并冻结在傅里叶能量均匀分布的极限。附录还表明，在 ReLU'(0)=0、光滑死区近似以及固定步长全批量梯度下降的设置下，该失败可以从开集初始条件的每条 Clarke 轨迹发生。
Result: 反例在初始条件的开集上成立，因而在高斯初始化下具有正概率；摘要明确说明单频对齐并不是训练单个神经元于模加法的普遍结果。
Conclusion: 单频对齐不能作为单神经元模加法训练的一般性质，存在可重复发生的反例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When does training on downscaled images yield the same gradients?
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers deliver strong image generation, but their training cost grows superlinearly with resolution. Recent work justifies training or sampling at reduced resolution on a spectral premise: at high noise, a downscaled latent preserves almost the full surviving signal. Whether a downscaled step also preserves the native training gradient signal, however, has remained unresolved. We reduce how that signal changes under downscaling to two terms: a noise-dependent term governed by the downscale ratio, which decays at high noise as the spectral premise predicts, and a σ-independent floor governed by the target grid's absolute token count, carried by the compute graph itself and removed by no noise level. The measured (route, σ) map corroborates the account and uncovers structure the spectral picture cannot express: on the 1024->768 route, a window (0.65 < σ< 0.95), predicted by no spectral criterion at any tolerance, where the downscaled gradient stays within a small margin of the native one. Training LoRA adapters with downscaled steps restricted to the routes and noise windows the map validates reduces training time by 14.6% at a fixed step budget while remaining near-native in weight space. Code is available at https://github.com/sorryhyun/anima_lora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散 Transformer (diffusion transformer) 在降采样图像上训练时梯度信号是否保持，将降采样带来的梯度变化分解为噪声依赖项与 σ-independent floor 两项。作者通过实测 (route, σ) 映射验证该解释，并在 1024→768 路线发现 σ∈(0.65,0.95) 的窗口，其中降采样梯度与原生梯度差距很小。利用该映射约束降采样步骤训练 LoRA 适配器，在固定步数预算下训练时间减少 14.6%，且权重空间接近原生训练。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的训练成本随分辨率超线性增长，现有工作以谱前提 (spectral premise) 说明高噪声下降采样潜变量仍保留大部分信号，但降采样步骤能否保留原生训练梯度信号这一问题尚未解决。
Method: 将降采样下梯度信号的变化归约为两项：由降采样比例控制的噪声依赖项（在高噪声下衰减），以及由目标网格绝对 token 数决定、不受 σ 影响的 floor；通过实测 (route, σ) 映射验证该解释，并据此确定安全的降采样训练路线与噪声窗口。
Result: 摘要报告在 1024→768 路线上存在 σ∈(0.65,0.95) 的窗口，该窗口内降采样梯度与原生梯度保持小差距；在这些路线和噪声窗口上采用降采样步骤训练 LoRA 适配器，固定步数预算下训练时间减少 14.6%，且权重空间接近原生训练。
Conclusion: 作者认为谱前提不足以刻画降采样梯度行为，存在谱准则无法预测的可用噪声窗口；该 (route, σ) 映射可为降采样训练策略提供依据，代码已在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: D$^2$F-ReAG: Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often generate inaccurate answers due to their reliance on static internal knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by integrating external knowledge and excelling at single-hop queries. However, it struggles with multi-hop questions that require cross-document reasoning. Existing methods, such as graph structured RAG or question decomposition, often lack dynamic decomposition and effective filtering, which leads to lower efficiency and accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we propose Dynamic Decomposition and Filtering for Multi-Hop Reasoning-Augmented Generation (D2F-ReAG), a novel paradigm that adaptively controls reasoning depth by judging the reliability of the root-level reasoning. If the root reasoning is reliable, the model directly generates the answer. Otherwise, the question is logically decomposed into sub-questions, and the verified reasoning derived from these sub-questions is used to refine the root reasoning. Experiments on three multi-hop benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in handling complex multi-hop questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D2F-ReAG，一种面向多跳推理的检索增强生成 (RAG) 范式，通过动态判断根级推理的可靠性来控制推理深度。若根推理可靠则直接生成答案，否则将问题逻辑分解为子问题，并用子问题验证后的推理来修正根推理。在三个多跳基准上的实验表明该方法能有效处理复杂多跳问题。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 擅长单跳查询，但在需要跨文档推理的多跳问题上表现不佳；已有的图结构 RAG 或问题分解方法缺乏动态分解和有效过滤，导致效率和准确性不足。
Method: 提出动态分解与过滤机制，自适应控制推理深度：先判断根级推理的可靠性；可靠则直接回答，否则将问题分解为子问题，并利用子问题得到的经验证推理来精炼根推理。
Result: 摘要在三个多跳基准上的实验验证了该方法处理复杂多跳问题的有效性，但未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态控制推理深度能弥补现有方法在效率和准确性上的不足，未提及明显的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robustness Emerges Early in Training Dynamics, but Is Not Preserved
papers.abstract_en: Robustness to natural corruptions remains a fundamental challenge for deep neural networks. In this paper, we identify a robustness fading phenomenon where shallow layers spontaneously develop robust representations and flat loss landscapes in early training, yet these properties are not preserved during standard convergence. To address this, we propose a framework that performs strategic interventions on training dynamics to stabilize the empirically identified early-emergent robust priors. Our approach includes two parameter-free strategies: Early-Phase Stabilization~(EPS) and Asymmetric Weight Reversion~(AWR), which stabilize or recover robust shallow configurations without modifying the model architecture or introducing learnable parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our framework across various benchmarks and architectures, yielding significant gains in downstream transfer, dynamic adaptation, and diverse computer vision applications.

papers.title: Season: Spectrum-Aware Orthogonal Gradient Refinement for Transfer-Based Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Transfer-based adversarial attacks often transfer poorly across heterogeneous architectures because CNNs favor local textures while Vision Transformers (ViTs) rely on global shapes. We propose Season, a spectrum-aware orthogonal gradient refinement framework for L-infinity transfer attacks against black-box target models on ImageNet, using a white-box surrogate. Season decomposes each update into a low-frequency branch capturing structural cues and a high-frequency branch capturing textures. A low-saliency guidance scheme reallocates high-frequency energy to background regions, preserving foreground structures that ViTs depend on. An orthogonal projection then forces the textural update to lie in the orthogonal complement of the structural direction, mitigating feature interference. As a training-free plug-and-play wrapper, Season enhances eight gradient-stabilization and input-enhancement attacks without modifying their cores. Across eight CNN, ViT, and MLP targets, Season improves transfer success rate by 6.6 percentage points on average and up to 16.0 points over strong baselines under a unified protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Season，一种频谱感知的正交梯度细化框架，用于基于迁移的 L-infinity 对抗攻击。它把每次更新分解为捕捉结构线索的低频分支和捕捉纹理的高频分支，通过低显著性引导将高频能量重新分配到背景区域，并用正交投影迫使纹理更新位于结构方向的互补空间，以减少特征干扰。作为训练无关的即插即用包装器，Season 在统一协议下增强八种梯度稳定与输入增强攻击，在 ImageNet 的八个 CNN、ViT 和 MLP 目标上平均提升迁移成功率 6.6 个百分点，最高提升 16.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 基于迁移的对抗攻击在异构架构间迁移性较差，因为 CNN 偏向局部纹理而 ViT 依赖全局形状，现有方法未显式解耦这两类信息。
Method: 提出频谱感知分解，将每次梯度更新拆成低频结构分支与高频纹理分支；低显著性引导把高频能量重分配到背景区域以保留 ViT 依赖的前景结构；正交投影迫使纹理更新位于结构方向的正交补空间中，缓解特征干扰。
Result: 在统一协议下，该训练无关包装器可增强八种现有攻击；在八个 CNN/ViT/MLP 目标上平均提升迁移成功率 6.6 个百分点，相对强基线最高提升 16.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Season 无需训练即可即插即用，通过频谱分解与正交化能有效提升跨架构的迁移攻击成功率。

papers.title: ExeCRE: Execution-Consistency Guided Reliability Estimation for Self-Correcting Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made notable progress in code generation, but they still struggle on challenging tasks that require sophisticated algorithms or complex implementations. Recent methods increasingly use code execution as feedback, especially in self-correction pipelines that construct verification signals from generated code. However, these pipelines often depend on supervision signals whose reliability is unknown, which can introduce misleading feedback, unnecessary revisions, and incorrect final answers. To address this issue, we propose ExeCRE, an Execution-Consistency guided code Reliability Estimation framework. Instead of judging candidate code by tests or LLM feedback, ExeCRE estimates code reliability by statistically analyzing consistency patterns in execution outputs over a large number of randomly generated inputs. It collects execution outputs over generated inputs, projects them into consistency signals, and applies the Dawid-Skene model to infer latent code reliability. We integrate ExeCRE into self-correction for code generation. Experiments show that ExeCRE consistently improves both effectiveness and stability, while substantially reducing misleading correction signals. Under GPT-5.2 on LiveCodeBench, the average number of misleading feedback cases on already correct code drops from 113.2 with a representative self-correction baseline to 14.0 with ExeCRE. As an additional study, we apply the same reliability estimation strategy to code-based mathematical reasoning and observe similar benefits. These results suggest that ExeCRE enables more reliable use of generated code in execution-based pipelines.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExeCRE，一种基于执行一致性指导的代码可靠性估计框架，用于改善大语言模型在代码生成自校正流水线中的反馈质量。ExeCRE 不依赖测试或 LLM 评判，而是通过统计大量随机输入上执行输出的一致性模式，并借助 Dawid-Skene 模型推断潜在代码可靠性，再将该可靠性估计集成进自校正过程。实验表明该方法能提升有效性与稳定性，并显著减少误导性校正信号。
Motivation: 现有代码生成自校正流水线常将代码执行作为反馈，但这些监督信号的可靠性未知，可能引入误导性反馈、带来不必要的修订并导致最终答案错误。
Method: ExeCRE 在随机生成的输入上收集代码执行输出，将输出投影为一致性信号，并用 Dawid-Skene 模型统计推断潜在的代码可靠性，随后将估计出的可靠性集成到代码生成的自校正流程中。
Result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上配合 GPT-5.2，ExeCRE 将本已正确代码上的平均误导性反馈案例数从代表性自校正基线的 113.2 降至 14.0；将同一可靠性估计策略用于基于代码的数学推理也观察到类似收益。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 ExeCRE 能够在基于执行的下游流水线中更可靠地使用生成代码，提升自校正的有效性和稳定性。

papers.title: ToolArtist: Tool-Using Unified Multimodal Models for Agentic Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models can produce visually compelling images, yet they remain limited on open-world tasks that require complex semantic understanding, multi-step reasoning, and the integration of external world knowledge. Existing efforts introduce agent capabilities into image generation, but they either prescribe a fixed workflow or place only a subset of the open-world image generation process under agent control. Consequently, reasoning, tool invocation, and image generation are not coordinated by a single policy. We propose ToolArtist, a fully agentic image generation model obtained by post-training a Unified Multimodal Model (UMM). ToolArtist dynamically orchestrates reasoning, external tool use, and native image generation within one unified policy. During Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), we equip a teacher agent with search tools alongside an image-generation tool. We then convert the collected trajectories into a UMM compatible format, where the image-generation tool is concealed while the resulting generated images are retained. During Reinforcement Learning (RL), we develop an agentic RL infrastructure for UMMs and introduce Reason-Act-Draw GRPO (RAD-GRPO), which uses complementary intent and quality rewards to jointly optimize the model. Experiments show that placing the entire open-world image-generation process under an agent policy consistently outperforms approaches with fixed pipelines or only partially agent-controlled components. We release the training data and the complete post-training infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToolArtist，一个通过对统一多模态模型 (UMM) 进行后训练得到的全智能体图像生成模型。它将推理、外部工具调用和原生图像生成统一到单一策略中，并结合监督微调与强化学习（RAD-GRPO）进行训练。实验表明，将整个开放世界图像生成过程置于智能体策略下，持续优于固定流水线或仅部分智能体控制的方案，作者还开源了训练数据与后训练基础设施。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像 (T2I) 模型在需要复杂语义理解、多步推理和外部世界知识集成的开放世界任务上表现受限；已有工作要么规定固定工作流，要么只将开放世界图像生成的部分过程置于智能体控制下，导致推理、工具调用和图像生成无法由单一策略协调。
Method: 在监督微调阶段，为教师智能体配备搜索工具和图像生成工具，并将轨迹转换为 UMM 兼容格式，隐藏图像生成工具但保留其生成的图像；在强化学习阶段，构建面向 UMM 的智能体 RL 基础设施，并提出 Reason-Act-Draw GRPO (RAD-GRPO)，利用互补的意图奖励与质量奖励联合优化模型。
Result: 实验显示，将整个开放世界图像生成过程纳入智能体策略，始终优于固定流水线或仅部分组件被智能体控制的方案；作者公开了训练数据及完整的后训练基础设施。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用一个统一策略动态编排推理、外部工具使用和原生图像生成，是提升开放世界智能体图像生成效果的有效方式，并提供了可复现的训练数据和基础设施。

papers.title: OmniRouting: A Semantic-Coupled Multimodal Benchmark for Constraint-Aware Spatial Reasoning in PCB Routing
papers.abstract_en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in constraint-aware navigation, maze reasoning, and graph reasoning. However, their ability to reason about complex routing problems under strict geometric, topological, and electrical constraints remains largely unexplored, despite routing being one of the most challenging and critical stages of electronic design automation (EDA). To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniRouting, the first large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on printed-circuit-board (PCB) routing reasoning under real-world industrial design-rule, manufacturability, and connectivity constraints. OmniRouting contains 1,681 industrial-grade schematic-coupled PCB designs, including board geometries, routable component placements by human engineers, footprints, pad locations, netlists, stackup information, and routing constraints. The benchmark comprises four tasks: (1) geometric routing reasoning, generating physically valid copper traces, vias, and layer assignments to connect circuit nets within constrained board regions; (2) design-rule-aware routing reasoning, producing routable layouts that satisfy clearance, trace-width, via, obstacle-avoidance, and board-boundary constraints; (3) electrical functionality reasoning, preserving schematic-specified connectivity while reasoning over net names and functional roles to produce electrically correct routing; and (4) tool-augmented agentic routing, leveraging external tools for tasks (1)-(3). Our results reveal substantial limitations of current LMMs in PCB routing, including weak path-planning capabilities, poor adherence to design-rule constraints, and inconsistent preservation of electrical functionality. We will open-source all benchmark data, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniRouting，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在印刷电路板（PCB）布线推理中能力的首个大规模基准。基准包含 1,681 个工业级原理图耦合的 PCB 设计，涵盖板级几何、可布线元件布局、焊盘、网络表、叠层与布线约束，并设计四类任务。实验表明当前多模态大模型（LMM）在 PCB 布线上的路径规划、设计规则遵循和电气功能保持方面存在显著不足。
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 在约束感知导航、迷宫推理和图推理上已有进展，但在严格的几何、拓扑与电气约束下对复杂布线问题的推理能力仍缺乏研究，而布线是电子设计自动化（EDA）中最关键且最具挑战性的环节之一。
Method: 构建包含 1,681 个工业级原理图耦合 PCB 设计的基准，提供板级几何、工程师标注的可布线元件布局、封装、焊盘位置、网络表、叠层与布线约束等数据；并设计四项任务：几何布线推理、设计规则感知布线推理、电气功能推理，以及利用外部工具的工具增强智能体布线。
Result: 评测结果显示当前 LMM 在 PCB 布线中表现明显不足，具体包括路径规划能力薄弱、对设计规则约束的遵循度差，以及电气功能保持不一致。
Conclusion: 作者将开源全部基准数据、评测代码和工具接口，以促进该方向的后续研究。

summary_sections.motivation: 尽管 LLM 在约束感知导航、迷宫推理和图推理上已有进展，但在严格的几何、拓扑与电气约束下对复杂布线问题的推理能力仍缺乏研究，而布线是电子设计自动化（EDA）中最关键且最具挑战性的环节之一。
summary_sections.method: 构建包含 1,681 个工业级原理图耦合 PCB 设计的基准，提供板级几何、工程师标注的可布线元件布局、封装、焊盘位置、网络表、叠层与布线约束等数据；并设计四项任务：几何布线推理、设计规则感知布线推理、电气功能推理，以及利用外部工具的工具增强智能体布线。
summary_sections.result: 评测结果显示当前 LMM 在 PCB 布线中表现明显不足，具体包括路径规划能力薄弱、对设计规则约束的遵循度差，以及电气功能保持不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将开源全部基准数据、评测代码和工具接口，以促进该方向的后续研究。

papers.title: MERaLiON-GR: Speech Gender Recognition Model for English and SEA Languages
papers.abstract_en: We present MERaLiON-GR, a speech gender recognition system that performs binary classification (female / male) on English and Southeast Asian (SEA) languages. The model finetunes MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2, a large conformer based transformer pre-trained on a broad speech corpus, and applies parameter efficient fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to adapt the encoder to the gender recognition task, and appends a multi-scale ECAPA-TDNN down stream network with attention pooling and a lightweight linear classifier. Extensive evaluations across multilingual Singaporean and Southeast Asian languages (English, Chinese, Malay, Tamil, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Khmer) show that MERaLiON-GR consistently surpasses the state-of-the-art gender recognition model Vox-Profile and a large Audio-LLM, in both full-utterance and segment level evaluation modes. The results underscore the value of dedicated speech models in achieving accurate paralinguistic understanding and strong cross-lingual generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MERaLiON-GR，一个对英语和东南亚语言进行二分类（女性/男性）语音性别识别（speech gender recognition）的系统。系统微调 MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2（基于 conformer 的大规模预训练语音 Transformer），使用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 做参数高效微调，并后接带注意力池化（attention pooling）的多尺度 ECAPA-TDNN 下游网络与轻量线性分类器。在多种东南亚语言上的评估显示，该系统在整句和分段两种评估模式下均超过现有 SOTA 模型 Vox-Profile 和大型 Audio-LLM。
Motivation: 英语和东南亚语言的语音性别识别缺少专用模型，现有大型通用音频模型在该副语言理解任务上的准确性不足，需要针对性别识别进行专门适配的下游模型。
Method: 基于 MERaLiON-SpeechEncoder-2 预训练语音编码器，采用 LoRA 进行参数高效微调以适应性别识别任务；其后接入带注意力池化的多尺度 ECAPA-TDNN 网络，再通过轻量线性分类器输出二分类结果。
Result: 在包含英语、中文、马来语、泰米尔语、泰语、越南语、印尼语和高棉语的多语言新加坡与东南亚语料上，MERaLiON-GR 在整句（full-utterance）和分段（segment level）两种评估模式下均一致优于 SOTA 性别识别模型 Vox-Profile 和大型 Audio-LLM。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，专用语音模型能更准确地完成副语言理解（paralinguistic understanding），并在多语言场景下表现出更强的跨语言泛化能力。

papers.title: The Price of Isolation: Estimating the Ecosystem Cost of Symmetric Two-Sided A/B Testing
papers.abstract_en: On two-sided content platforms, symmetric two-sided isolation (assigning matched fractions of creators and viewers to isolated treatment and control submarkets) is widely used for creator-side and cold-start experiments because it removes cross-arm marketplace interference. Isolation, however, thins each viewer's candidate catalog, and intuition suggests the resulting engagement cost should fade as the platform grows: a small fraction of a vast catalog is still vast. We show that, in an order-statistics model of engagement, whether this intuition holds depends on the upper tail of match quality. Extreme-value theory yields tail-class loss laws with a sharp dichotomy: for light or bounded tails the loss vanishes as the candidate pool grows, whereas under heavy tails it converges to a size-independent constant, so expanding the candidate pool, even by orders of magnitude, does not asymptotically eliminate the cost. Evidence from two production experiments on a platform with millions of active creators is consistent with this picture: a pure A/A traffic sweep reveals a measurable, depth-graded engagement cost; a one-sided catalog ablation independently shows that per-viewer thinning contributes to the loss; and a tail index calibrated on the small exploration pool predicts an effect consistent with the one observed in the far larger full-catalog ablation. Isolation thus carries a price that experimenters should budget for, like any other cost. We give practitioners a preflight procedure that estimates it before launch, sizes traffic accordingly, and recommends a fallback design when the predicted cost exceeds a chosen tolerance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双面内容平台中对称双面隔离（symmetric two-sided isolation）实验的生态成本。作者在订单统计参与模型中证明，随着候选池增大，参与损失是否消失完全取决于匹配质量分布的尾部：轻尾或有界尾下损失趋于零，重尾下损失收敛到与规模无关的常数。两个生产实验（A/A流量扫描与单侧目录消融）与这一理论预测一致，并据此给出实验前估算成本的预飞行程序。
Motivation: 双面平台用隔离实验消除跨臂市场干扰，但隔离会稀释每个观看者的候选目录，直觉认为这种参与成本会随平台规模增长而消失。论文要检验这一直觉在什么条件下成立，因为如果成本不消失，实验设计就需要为其预留预算。
Method: 建立订单统计参与模型，利用极值理论（extreme-value theory）按匹配质量上尾类型推导参与损失的标度律；随后用两个生产实验验证：纯 A/A 流量扫描测量深度分级的参与成本，单侧目录消融分离每观看者稀释的贡献，并用小探索池标定尾部指数预测全目录消融的效果。
Result: 理论给出清晰二分法：轻尾或有界尾下损失随候选池增长而消失，重尾下损失收敛到与规模无关的常数，即使候选池扩大几个数量级也无法渐近消除。两个生产实验与这一图景一致：可测量的参与成本存在且随深度分级，单侧目录消融确认稀释贡献，小池标定的尾部指数对更大全目录消融的预测与观测一致。
Conclusion: 论文结论是隔离实验具有可量化的生态成本，实验者应当像管理其他成本一样为其做预算；并给出预飞行程序，在实验启动前估计成本、相应调整流量，并在预测成本超过容忍阈值时推荐回退设计。

papers.title: An adaptive split-combine Gaussian mixture filter for nonlinear and multimodal state estimation
authors: Dae Wook Kim (1 and 6) ((1) Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
(3) The Institute for Data Innovation in Science
(5) Department of Computational Medicine and Bioinformatics
papers.abstract_en: Filtering combines model predictions with measurements to estimate the probability density function (PDF) of a system state over time. The PDF often becomes highly asymmetric and even multimodal in nonlinear systems with oscillatory or chaotic dynamics. Such non-Gaussian features violate the single-Gaussian assumption underlying Kalman-type filters. To address this problem, Gaussian mixture filtering has been proposed. However, accurately propagating mixture components and adaptively adjusting their number and weights over time remain open challenges. Here, we develop an adaptive split-combine Gaussian mixture filter (AMF) that estimates the time evolution of asymmetric and multimodal PDFs by adaptively splitting and combining Gaussian particles without auxiliary online numerical optimization. Notably, the proposed splitting method guarantees a reduction in variance along a target level-set-point direction of a Gaussian particle. This enables accurate and efficient propagation of particles. We show that AMF consistently outperforms various baseline filters across diverse benchmarks, including single and coupled slow-fast Van der Pol oscillators and the Lorenz attractor. We also propose a parallel implementation of AMF, allowing high-fidelity PDF estimation with practical computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应分裂-合并高斯混合滤波器 (adaptive split-combine Gaussian mixture filter, AMF)，用于估计非线性振荡与混沌系统中高度不对称甚至多模态的状态概率密度函数 (PDF)。该方法通过自适应地分裂和合并高斯粒子来避免 Kalman 型滤波器的单高斯假设，且不需要额外的在线数值优化；摘要称其分裂方式保证沿目标水平集点方向 (level-set-point direction) 的方差减少。作者在 Van der Pol 振荡器与 Lorenz 吸引子等基准上报告 AMF 一致优于多种基线滤波器，并给出并行实现以降低计算成本。
Motivation: Kalman 型滤波器依赖单高斯假设，而在振荡或混沌非线性系统中状态 PDF 常呈现高度不对称甚至多模态，导致滤波失效。高斯混合滤波虽已被提出用于解决该问题，但如何精确传播混合分量并随时间自适应调整其数量和权重仍是开放挑战。
Method: 提出 AMF，通过自适应分裂与合并高斯粒子来追踪非高斯 PDF 的演化，不需要辅助的在线数值优化。其分裂方法被证明能保证沿目标水平集点方向减少方差，从而准确高效地传播粒子；研究者还设计了并行实现以降低计算成本。
Result: 摘要报告 AMF 在多个基准上一致优于各种基线滤波器，包括单个和耦合同慢速 Van der Pol 振荡器以及 Lorenz 吸引子；并行实现能以实际可行的计算成本获得高保真 PDF 估计。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为非线性多模态状态估计提供了一种无需在线数值优化的准确高效方案，并可通过并行化平衡精度与计算成本。摘要未明确讨论局限性或具体适用范围。

papers.title: UBLLIE: Unified Backlight and Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Backlit and low-light images often suffer from severe exposure imbalance or global underexposure, presenting significant challenges for both visual perception and downstream computer vision tasks. In this paper, we propose a unified, unsupervised enhancement framework that addresses both types of degradation without relying on paired ground-truth data. Our approach builds on CLIP-guided prompt learning to semantically supervise enhancement using learned positive and negative textual prompts. To improve the quality of our improvements over prior work, we design a symmetric residual U-Net backbone augmented with an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling module. This architecture captures multi-scale contextual information, enabling adaptive correction under spatially heterogeneous illumination. During training, the enhancement network is guided by CLIP-based semantic similarity losses and refined via an iterative prompt optimization mechanism. Extensive experiments on both paired and unpaired datasets, including BAID, Backlit300, LOL, and VE-LOL-L, demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised methods in terms of fidelity, perceptual quality, and generalization. Furthermore, our work emphasizes the need for stronger benchmarking protocols for backlit enhancement, a relatively underexplored area. The proposed framework provides a robust, scalable solution for real-world illumination enhancement across diverse lighting conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的、无监督的低光和背光图像增强框架 UBLLIE，不依赖成对真值数据。方法基于 CLIP 引导的提示学习（prompt learning），用学习的正负文本提示做语义监督，并设计带 Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling 的对称残差 U-Net 来捕获多尺度上下文信息。实验在 BAID、Backlit300、LOL、VE-LOL-L 等成对与非成对数据集上验证，声称在保真度、感知质量和泛化性上优于现有监督与无监督方法。
Motivation: 背光和低光图像分别存在曝光失衡和全局欠曝问题，严重影响视觉感知与下游任务；现有方法往往依赖成对真值数据，且背光增强这一方向缺乏统一的、可应对空间异质光照的无监督框架。
Method: 提出无监督统一增强框架：用 CLIP 引导的提示学习，通过学习的正负文本提示提供语义监督；增强网络采用带 Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling 的对称残差 U-Net，以捕获多尺度上下文信息；训练时结合 CLIP 语义相似度损失，并通过迭代提示优化（prompt optimization）机制逐步细化。
Result: 在 BAID、Backlit300、LOL 和 VE-LOL-L 等成对与非成对数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架在保真度、感知质量和泛化性方面持续优于现有的监督与无监督方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调背光增强是相对未被充分探索的领域，需要更强的基准测试协议；提出的框架为不同光照条件下的真实世界增强提供了鲁棒、可扩展的解决方案。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调背光增强是相对未被充分探索的领域，需要更强的基准测试协议；提出的框架为不同光照条件下的真实世界增强提供了鲁棒、可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Deltoris: Enabling Real-time VLA Inference in Embodied AI via Bit-level Sparsity and Speculative Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a key component in embodied AI. Among existing approaches, diffusion-based VLA models achieve superior motion quality and generalization. However, diffusion-based VLA models are compute-intensive and must run at high control frequency, e.g., 50-200 Hz. Thus, it imposes strict latency and energy constraints on edge devices. In this work, we present Deltoris, an algorithm-hardware co-design framework for efficient diffusion-based VLA inference. First, we exploit the temporal similarity of consecutive inputs and propose a \textit{temporal-aware bit-sparsity} algorithm that computes only the differences between consecutive inputs, eliminating redundant bit-level operations. To further address the extra off-chip traffic introduced by our algorithm, we propose a \textit{speculative inference} technique, which amortizes data loading across multiple control steps. Lastly, to support these techniques, we co-design a dedicated accelerator with customized 1D systolic bit-serial PE arrays that eliminate PE workload imbalance. Our evaluation shows that Deltoris achieves up to 34.2$\times$ speedup over mobile GPUs and 6.1$\times$ over prior accelerators, while maintaining comparable accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Deltoris，一个面向扩散式视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的算法-硬件协同设计框架，旨在满足具身智能中 50-200 Hz 高频控制所要求的实时推理与低能耗。方法上利用连续输入的时间相似性提出 temporal-aware bit-sparsity 算法，只计算相邻输入的差分以消除冗余位级操作，并用 speculative inference 摊销跨控制步的数据加载开销，同时设计专用 1D 脉动位串行 (bit-serial) PE 阵列加速器。评估显示 Deltoris 相比移动 GPU 最高获得 34.2 倍加速，相比先前加速器获得 6.1 倍加速，同时保持相当的精度。
Motivation: 扩散式 VLA 模型是具身智能的关键组件，但计算密集且需在高控制频率下运行，给边缘设备带来严格的延迟和能耗约束，现有方案难以满足实时性要求。
Method: 提出算法-硬件协同设计：利用相邻输入的时间相似性，提出 temporal-aware bit-sparsity 算法仅计算差分以减少冗余位操作；引入 speculative inference 技术将数据加载开销摊销到多个控制步；并协同设计包含定制 1D 位串行 PE 阵列的专用加速器以消除 PE 负载不均衡。
Result: 评估表明 Deltoris 在保持可比较精度的前提下，相比移动 GPU 达到最高 34.2 倍加速，相比先前加速器达到 6.1 倍加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的位级稀疏和推测推理技术能够有效支撑扩散式 VLA 模型在边缘设备上的实时推理，但该结论主要基于所描述加速框架的评估结果。

papers.title: Predict, Then Retrieve: Cross-Instance Future-State Retrieval from Video Prefixes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Predictive State Retrieval (PSR), a task in which a model observes a short video prefix and a temporal question about an object's future state, then retrieves instances from other videos or images that depict that state. Unlike action anticipation, which predicts a label, moment retrieval, which localizes an observed event within a video, or video generation, which synthesizes pixels, PSR combines anticipation with cross-instance retrieval across multiple temporal horizons. We construct a benchmark from four datasets with graded, human-validated ground truth, difficulty tiers, and an oracle ceiling. We also propose LFTR, a lightweight retriever with frozen encoders that predicts a question- and horizon-conditioned future latent and matches it in complementary semantic and visual spaces. A ceiling decomposition reveals a clear bottleneck: the true future state is highly retrievable once specified, whereas every predictor we evaluate, including a large multimodal language model with access to the prefix frames, remains far below the oracle. Thus, forecasting rather than perception is the central learnable challenge. LFTR narrows this gap at substantially lower inference cost, and ablations attribute its gains to cross-space fusion and hard-negative training rather than latent rollout. We release the benchmark, code, and evaluation scripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Predictive State Retrieval (PSR) 任务：模型观察短视频前缀和关于物体未来状态的时序问题，从其他视频或图像中检索描绘该状态的实例。作者构建了基于四个数据集、含人工验证分级标注和 oracle 上限的基准，并提出 LFTR——一种使用冻结编码器的轻量检索器，预测问题与时间视界条件化的未来潜变量，并在互补的语义和视觉空间中匹配。天花板分解表明真正的未来状态一旦给定就高度可检索，而所有预测器（包括可访问前缀帧的大规模多模态语言模型）都远低于 oracle，因此预测而非感知是核心可学习挑战。
Motivation: 现有工作分别处理动作预测、时刻检索和视频生成，缺乏将跨视频前缀的未来状态预测与跨实例检索结合的任务定义，本文填补这一空白并量化预测环节的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 LFTR，使用冻结编码器，预测与问题和时间视界条件化的未来潜在表示，并在语义与视觉两个互补空间中进行匹配；同时构建含难度分层和 oracle 上限的基准，并进行天花板分解。
Result: 天花板分解显示真实未来状态在被指定时高度可检索，而所有被测预测器包括大型多模态语言模型都远低于 oracle；LFTR 以显著更低的推理成本缩小了这一差距，消融实验将增益归因于跨空间融合和难负样本训练而非潜变量展开。
Conclusion: 作者认为预测而非感知是 PSR 的核心可学习挑战，并发布基准、代码和评估脚本；摘要未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Thinking with Anchors: Grounded and Efficient Document Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Existing document understanding benchmarks have largely focused on locating page elements, yet real-world document intelligence requires models to reason jointly about region semantics, spatial relations, and visual structure. We present ADOPD 2026, a reasoning-oriented extension of ADOPD that turns page decomposition into spatially grounded document understanding. ADOPD 2026 enriches page anchors inherited from ADOPD 2024 dataset with human-cleaned captions, semantic tags, and generated chain-of-thought (CoT) traces grounded to document regions. Instead of treating boxes, masks, and tags as independent supervision signals, we cast text blocks, visual entities, semantic labels, bounding boxes, and polygon masks as a shared vocabulary of visual anchors. This representation supports three connected capabilities. First, region-level semantic tagging asks models to identify document element types from both page context and local appearance, revealing long-tail semantic failures that standard layout benchmarks often hide. Second, unified vision-language grounding generates text regions and visual entities together with coordinates or polygonal outlines, transforming detection and segmentation outputs into structured anchors that can be reused by downstream reasoning systems. Third, current state-of-the-art models still struggle with dense counting tasks evaluated on DocCount, a benchmark derived from ADOPD 2026, highlighting the need for the Thinking-with-Anchors pipeline in document semantic understanding. By connecting page decomposition to verifiable visual-anchor reasoning, ADOPD 2026 provides a task framework that moves document understanding beyond localization toward anchor-grounded document intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADOPD 2026，一个面向推理的文档理解数据集扩展，将页面分解任务转化为空间锚定 (spatially grounded) 的文档理解。它在 ADOPD 2024 的页面锚点基础上补充人工清洗的标题、语义标签和锚定到文档区域的思维链 (chain-of-thought, CoT) 轨迹，并把文本块、视觉实体、语义标签、边界框和多边形掩码统一为共享的视觉锚点词汇表。该框架支持区域级语义标注、统一视觉语言接地 (grounding) 以及密集计数基准 DocCount。摘要还指出当前最优模型在 DocCount 上仍表现不佳，凸显了 Thinking-with-Anchors 流水线的必要性。
Motivation: 现有文档理解基准大多只关注定位页面元素，而真实文档智能要求模型联合推理区域语义、空间关系和视觉结构，这一能力缺口是本文要解决的核心问题。
Method: 在 ADOPD 2026 中，作者将文本块、视觉实体、语义标签、边界框和多边形掩码统一为视觉锚点共享词汇表，并由此构建三个能力：基于页面上下文和局部外观的区域级语义标注、同时生成文本区域与视觉实体及其坐标或多边形轮廓的统一视觉语言接地，以及密集计数基准 DocCount。
Result: 摘要报告当前最优模型在 DocCount 密集计数任务上仍存在明显困难，并指出区域级语义标注能暴露标准布局基准常掩盖的长尾语义失败；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: ADOPD 2026 通过把页面分解与可验证的视觉锚点推理连接起来，提供了一套将文档理解从定位推向锚定文档智能的任务框架；当前模型在计数上的不足说明需要 Thinking-with-Anchors 这样的流水线来支撑文档语义理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Foreseeing the Invisible: Amodal Reconstruction of Leaf Fossil Images
papers.abstract_en: Fossil leaves are rarely preserved whole -- sedimentary rock hides, breaks, and erodes the lamina, yet paleobotany depends on the complete shape and outline of the leaf. We cast the recovery of the missing tissue as amodal reconstruction and present AmodalDINO, a multi-head dense-prediction model that predicts four masks from a single RGB image: visible leaf, amodal complete leaf, amodal main vein, and fine veins. Unlike essentially all prior amodal work, AmodalDINO is given no visible mask. It predicts the visible and amodal regions jointly, so it needs no upstream instance segmenter at runtime. Two simple but effective changes adapt the model to the amodal segmentation task: fully fine-tune a DINOv3 ViT-L/16 at a small learning rate instead of freezing it, and attach auxiliary venation heads alongside the leaf heads. These two changes enable the model to learn the structural shape prior of leaves. Trained only on synthetic leaf fossil images, AmodalDINO reaches 95.0% Dice / 90.5% IoU on the validation set and transfers well to real fossil specimens. Stripped to two heads, the same recipe can run on two benchmark datasets, reaching 85.05 full mIoU / 66.65 occluded mIoU on KINS and 80.90 / 38.15 on COCOA-cls. The model is also practical: by quantizing to 4-bit weights, it runs entirely offline in a browser, matching the original model with an IoU of 0.910. We also add ruler-based calibration to estimate surface area, and a generative visualization of living leaves on local devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AmodalDINO，一个多任务密集预测模型，用于从单个 RGB 图像重建化石叶片的缺失组织，将问题建模为 amodal 重建。模型同时预测可见叶片、完整叶片、主脉和细脉四个掩码，且不依赖任何上游实例分割器。仅在合成化石图像上训练即可达到 95.0% Dice / 90.5% IoU，并能迁移到真实化石标本。
Motivation: 化石叶片极少完整保存，岩石会隐藏、折断或侵蚀叶肉，而古植物学依赖叶片的完整形状和轮廓。现有 amodal 方法几乎都需要可见掩码作为输入，且很少针对化石图像这种高度残缺的场景。
Method: AmodalDINO 使用多头密集预测架构，基于 DINOv3 ViT-L/16 进行全量微调（小学习率）而非冻结，并附加叶脉预测头。训练时联合预测可见区域和 amodal 区域，无需运行时实例分割器；此外引入基于尺子的标定来估计叶片表面积，并支持量化到 4-bit 权重后在浏览器中离线运行。
Result: 仅在合成叶化石图像上训练的 AmodalDINO 在验证集上达到 95.0% Dice / 90.5% IoU，并能很好地迁移到真实化石标本。缩减到两个预测头后，同一配方在 KINS 上取得 85.05 全 mIoU / 66.65 遮挡 mIoU，在 COCOA-cls 上取得 80.90 / 38.15。量化到 4-bit 后 IoU 为 0.910，与原模型基本一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，完全微调 DINOv3 并附加叶脉头是让模型学习叶片结构形状先验的关键，且该方案从合成数据出发即可泛化到真实场景，并通过量化实现本地设备上的实用部署。
Relevance: 7

papers.title: Generative Optimization for Incentivized Advertising with Global Level Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Incentivized advertising allocates monetary or virtual rewards to drive user engagement, where a key challenge is optimizing continuous incentive magnitudes under strict global constraints. This problem is complicated by high-frequency interactions, delayed feedback, and non-Markovian user dynamics such as fatigue, which limit the effectiveness of existing uplift modeling and constrained reinforcement learning approaches. To address these challenges, we propose GOAL, a constraint-aware generative framework that formulates incentive allocation as a conditional sequence generation problem. GOAL directly generates incentive magnitudes conditioned on user histories and system-level global pressure, and integrates a hierarchical causal state encoder to capture both local behavioral dynamics and long-range dependencies. To enable flexible constraint control, we introduce \textbf{S}afe \textbf{C}onstrained \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (SCPO), which learns a single generative policy that generalizes across a spectrum of ROI constraints without retraining. papers.title: SPOT: Sparse Probing and Outcome Calibration for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but standard reverse-KL training can assign insufficient probability to other plausible continuations. Teacher entropy alone does not reveal whether uncertainty is concentrated among a few plausible next tokens or dispersed over a long probability tail, nor whether the student already represents those candidates well. Moreover, local teacher probabilities may not predict downstream success. We introduce Sparse Probing and Outcome-calibrated Targets OPD (SPOT), which addresses two coupled decisions, where to probe and what to distill, through an acquisition--exploration--exploitation procedure. During acquisition, a position-level score combines normalized teacher entropy, the probability mass captured by a small top-$k$ candidate set, and student--teacher mismatch to allocate a limited probing budget. During exploration, SPOT evaluates teacher-proposed candidates through verifier-scored student continuations. During exploitation, these outcomes produce a closed-form, KL-regularized target that favors candidates with better downstream outcomes while remaining anchored to the teacher distribution. Extensive experiments across multiple student models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of SPOT in improving reasoning performance while balancing solution quality and coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPOT（Sparse Probing and Outcome-calibrated Targets OPD），一种用于在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 的训练方法。方法针对标准反向 KL 训练对除教师首选外的其他合理续写概率分配不足的问题，通过采集-探索-利用三阶段过程同时决定在何处探测（where to probe）和蒸馏什么（what to distill）。实验在多个学生模型和推理基准上验证了 SPOT 能提升推理性能并平衡解质量与覆盖率。
Motivation: 标准 on-policy distillation 使用反向 KL 训练，可能给其他合理续写分配过低的概率；教师熵本身无法区分不确定性是集中在少数候选标记还是分散在长概率尾部，也无法反映学生是否已覆盖这些候选。此外，局部教师概率并不能预测下游任务的成功程度，因此需要更精细的目标构造。
Method: SPOT 采用 acquisition-exploration-exploitation 流程：在采集阶段，用结合归一化教师熵、top-k 候选集合覆盖的概率质量以及学生-教师不匹配度的位置级得分来分配有限的探测预算；在探索阶段，通过验证器评分的学生续写结果评估教师提出的候选；在利用阶段，利用这些结果构造闭式 KL 正则化目标，在保持锚定教师分布的同时偏向具有更好下游结果的候选。
Result: 摘要报告在多个学生模型和多种推理基准上的广泛实验表明，SPOT 能有效改善推理性能，并在解质量和覆盖率之间取得平衡。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时处理探测位置与蒸馏目标是提升 on-policy distillation 推理性能的关键，SPOT 通过结果校准的目标分布实现了更好的性能-覆盖权衡。摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: muSync-GS: Physics-Synchronized Driving Video Synthesis for Weather and Geometric Road Hazards
papers.abstract_en: High-quality driving data are essential for autonomous-driving systems and generative world models. However, rare and safety-critical scenarios involving adverse weather, braking under low tire--road friction, and uneven road geometry are costly and risky to collect at scale. Existing video-generation and 3D Gaussian editing methods can modify weather appearance or road geometry, but typically do not couple these edits with tire--road interaction and vehicle dynamics. As a result, an edited video may retain its original trajectory even when the modified road condition should alter braking, wheel slip, load transfer, and ego-camera motion. We present muSync-GS, a physics-synchronized framework for driving video synthesis under adverse-weather and road-elevation hazards. A precipitation-derived road-surface condition jointly controls road appearance and tire friction, while a shared road-elevation profile drives both visible road-geometry editing and axle excitation. A calibrated vehicle model predicts speed, slip ratio, normal loads, and pitch for constructing the ego-camera trajectory and synchronized physical annotations. On 12 held-out CarSim cases spanning precipitation levels, brake inputs, and road-profile parameters, the model achieves mean case-wise RMSEs of 0.0273 m/s for speed, 0.0590 degrees for pitch, 0.0101 for slip ratio, and 26.61 N for per-wheel normal load. Together with the reconstructed-scene experiments, these results show that muSync-GS accurately reproduces vehicle responses under held-out controls while synchronizing them with controllable scene edits and ego-camera motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 muSync-GS，一个面向恶劣天气与道路高程危险场景的物理同步驾驶视频合成框架。该方法将降水导出的路面条件同时用于控制道路外观与轮胎摩擦，并由共享的道路高程剖面驱动可见路面几何编辑与车轴激励；一个标定过的车辆模型预测速度、滑移率、垂向载荷与俯仰角，用于构建自车相机轨迹和同步物理标注。在 12 个留出 CarSim 用例上，速度、俯仰角、滑移率和单轮垂向载荷的均方根误差分别达到 0.0273 m/s、0.0590 度、0.0101 和 26.61 N。
Motivation: 现有视频生成与 3D Gaussian 编辑方法可以修改天气外观或道路几何，但通常不把这些编辑与轮胎-路面相互作用及车辆动力学耦合，导致编辑后的视频在路面条件应改变制动、轮滑、载荷转移和自车相机运动时仍保留原始轨迹。
Method: 提出一个物理同步框架：由降水导出的路面条件联合控制道路外观与轮胎摩擦，共享的道路高程剖面同时驱动可见几何编辑与车轴激励；并用标定的车辆模型预测速度、滑移率、垂向载荷和俯仰角，以构造自车相机轨迹及同步物理标注。
Result: 在 12 个涵盖降水水平、制动输入和道路剖面参数的留出 CarSim 用例上，方法取得平均逐例 RMSE：速度 0.0273 m/s、俯仰角 0.0590 度、滑移率 0.0101、单轮垂向载荷 26.61 N；结合重建场景实验，说明其在留出控制下能准确复现车辆响应。
Conclusion: 作者认为 muSync-GS 能够在可控场景编辑与自车相机运动同步的前提下，准确复现留出控制下的车辆响应。

papers.title: Not Every Divergence Should Be Suppressed: Counterfactual Recoverability in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-visited trajectories, yet divergence-based rules cannot determine whether an erroneous prefix remains correctable. We formulate this decision as counterfactual recoverability and replay each error state through budget-matched teacher-continuation and rollback branches. Based on their relative success, states are categorized as recoverable, irreversible-but-avoidable, or ambiguous, and these labels guide whether training retains, rolls back, or conventionally supervises the corresponding trajectory. On AIME branch diagnostics, the mean continuation-minus-rollback effect is 0.185 for recoverable states and -1.000 for irreversible-but-avoidable states, demonstrating opposite intervention preferences. A branch-derived recoverability proxy achieves an AUC of 1.000, substantially outperforming divergence alone at 0.392. Across frozen evaluations, recoverability-aware control achieves the strongest recorded performance, reaching 0.578 success on held-out AIME2025 compared with 0.517 for the best baseline. It also improves AIME2024-2025 average@32 from 0.2656 to 0.3125 and GPQA-Diamond average@32 from 0.2702 to 0.3070. Component ablations further show that retaining teacher-correctable prefixes provides the largest individual contribution. These findings establish recoverability as an outcome-grounded decision variable for selective supervision in OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation, OPD) 中仅靠散度规则无法判断学生轨迹中错误前缀是否可纠正的问题，提出反事实可恢复性 (counterfactual recoverability) 决策框架：对每个错误状态用预算匹配 (budget-matched) 的 teacher-continuation 与 rollback 分支回放，根据相对成败将状态分类为可恢复、不可逆但可避免 (irreversible-but-avoidable) 或模糊，并据此对轨迹进行保留、回滚或常规监督。实验表明该方法在 AIME2025、AIME2024-2025 与 GPQA-Diamond 上均超过基线，且分支导出的可恢复性代理 AUC 远超单纯散度。
Motivation: OPD 用发散度 (divergence) 规则监督学生访问的轨迹，但这类规则无法判定一个带错误前缀的状态是否仍可被纠正；这种可判定性缺失会导致监督信号选择不当。
Method: 将监督决策形式化为反事实可恢复性，对每个错误状态并行执行预算匹配的 teacher-continuation 分支和 rollback 分支，依据两个分支的相对成功程度把状态标为可恢复、不可逆但可避免或模糊，并让这些标签决定对应轨迹是被保留、回滚还是按常规方式监督。
Result: 在 AIME 分支诊断中，可恢复状态的 continuation 减 rollback 效应为 0.185，不可逆但可避免状态为 -1.000，呈现相反干预偏好；分支导出的可恢复性代理 AUC 为 1.000，远超仅用散度的 0.392。可恢复性感知控制在冻结评估中取得最强记录：held-out AIME2025 成功率 0.578（最佳基线 0.517），AIME2024-2025 average@32 从 0.2656 升至 0.3125，GPQA-Diamond average@32 从 0.2702 升至 0.3070；组件消融表明保留教师可纠正前缀贡献最大。
Conclusion: 作者把可恢复性确立为 OPD 选择性监督中基于结果 (outcome-grounded) 的决策变量，并认为它比散度规则更能指导轨迹层级的保留、回滚或常规监督。

papers.title: MESH: Memory-Efficient Sinkhorn Optimization for Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.abstract_en: Memory-efficient matrix optimizers such as Sinkhorn gradient descent remove most AdamW optimizer state for dense Transformer matrices, but direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is unreliable. We study this failure in a controlled 110M-parameter nanowhale DeepSeek-style MoE pretraining setting. A SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid reduces optimizer state from 0.883GB to 0.331GB but degrades evaluation loss to 3.8265, far above the AdamW baselines observed in the same setup (3.58--3.64 across the seeds we study). We show that routed MoE expert matrices are the dominant failure point: their gradients are conditional, temporally varying, and poorly served by stateless Sinkhorn normalization. We propose MESH, a hidden-momentum Sinkhorn update for MoE experts. MESH restores a temporal first-moment signal through the gradient-buffer lifecycle, without storing the expert first moment as optimizer state. MESH is an optional block-preconditioned variant that adds a coarse neuron/block inverse-RMS multiplier. Across ablations, temporal smoothing before matrix normalization is the primary causal ingredient; block/neuron preconditioning can improve the memory-quality frontier, but is not established as universally necessary. In two additional seeds, MESH and MESH-B reduce optimizer-state memory by 62.5\% and peak PyTorch CUDA allocation by about 12.6\% relative to AdamW, with a modest evaluation-loss gap. Full-state diagnostic variants recover AdamW-like performance in ablations, supporting the conclusion that MoE experts need temporal smoothing, but not necessarily full coordinate-wise AdamW state.

TL;DR: 本文研究内存高效优化器（如 Sinkhorn 梯度下降）直接用于 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 训练时失效的问题。作者在 110M 参数的 DeepSeek 风格 MoE 预训练设置中发现，SAGE/Sinkhorn 混合方法将优化器状态从 0.883GB 降至 0.331GB，但评估损失退化到 3.8265，远高于 AdamW 基线的 3.58–3.64。作者定位 routed MoE 专家矩阵为主要失效点，并提出 MESH（隐藏动量 Sinkhorn 更新）来恢复时间一阶矩信号而不存储专家一阶矩作为优化器状态。
Motivation: 内存高效的 Sinkhorn 类优化器能移除稠密 Transformer 矩阵的大部分 AdamW 优化器状态，但直接应用于 MoE 训练不可靠；作者希望理解失效原因并设计适用于 MoE 的替代更新规则。

papers.title: Incremental Aggregation on the Grassmannian for Asynchronous Eigenspace Computation
papers.abstract_en: We study asynchronous optimization for finite-sum eigenspace computation in heterogeneous distributed systems. The theoretical foundations for asynchronous eigenspace computation remain scarce, with existing approaches offering limited coverage of dynamics directly on the Grassmannian under stale information. In this paper, we propose a Grassmannian incremental aggregation method that refreshes only arriving components and reuses cached gradients, retaining low per-update cost without global synchronization. The method employs an extrinsic polar update that preserves the intrinsic subspace geometry without requiring parallel transport of stale tangent vectors. Our analysis establishes a tight angle-dependent gradient-dominance characterization of the objective and a basin-invariance property for stale aggregated updates. These yield two-phase linear convergence, comprising an explicit broad-basin regime and a sharper local regime, with constants controlled by component spectral spreads. Experiments on serial and distributed PCA demonstrate improved sample efficiency and wall-clock convergence over representative baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异构分布式系统中的有限和特征子空间计算（finite-sum eigenspace computation），提出一种格拉斯曼流形上的增量聚合方法：只刷新到达的组件并复用缓存的梯度，从而在不做全局同步的情况下保持低单步更新代价。方法采用外在极分解更新（extrinsic polar update），保留内在子空间几何，无需对过期切向量进行并行传输。作者建立了目标函数的紧致角度相关梯度主导刻画和过期聚合更新的盆不变性，并据此证明两阶段线性收敛，实验在串行与分布式 PCA 上相较基线改善样本效率与墙钟收敛。
Motivation: 异步特征子空间计算的理论基础仍然稀缺，现有方法对过期信息（stale information）下直接在格拉斯曼流形上演化的动力学覆盖有限，难以适应异构分布式系统的需求。
Method: 提出格拉斯曼增量聚合方法，仅刷新到达的组件并复用缓存梯度；通过外在极分解更新保持内在子空间几何，避免对过期切向量做并行传输。理论分析给出角度依赖的梯度主导刻画与过期聚合更新的盆不变性。
Result: 摘要报告两阶段线性收敛结果：包含显式的宽盆（broad-basin）阶段和更尖锐的局部阶段，常数由分量谱展（component spectral spreads）控制；串行与分布式 PCA 实验显示样本效率和墙钟收敛优于代表性基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提方法在保持低每步更新代价的同时，为异步格拉斯曼流形优化提供了可证明的收敛保证，并强调收敛常数受谱展控制。

papers.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
papers.abstract_en: Long-context large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet self-attention remains a major efficiency bottleneck -- especially during decoding -- due to the necessity of repeatedly processing ever-growing key-value (KV) caches. Existing sparse attention reduce computation by attending to fewer KV pairs, but often suffer from substantial accuracy degradation, require additional training, or rely on expensive hashing. In this work, we present BinaryPC, a training-free, data-aware hashing-based sparse attention for long-context LLMs. BinaryPC constructs compact binary hash codes and corresponding hash function by computing binary principal components of data. Unlike Locality-Sensitive Hashing (LSH) with data-independent random projections or learned non-linear hashing methods, BinaryPC constructs binary codes that explicitly preserve the structural information of data without requiring gradient-based training. Comprehensive experiments across multiple model families and long-context benchmarks show that BinaryPC preserves accuracy relative to full attention while achieving superior performance among sparse and hashing-based baselines. On modern GPUs, BinaryPC improves end-to-end decoding throughput by 3.56$\times$ over the FlashAttention kernel. Our code is available at https://github.com/yudaohai666/BPC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BinaryPC，一种无需训练、数据感知的哈希类稀疏注意力机制，用于长上下文大语言模型。它通过计算数据的二元主成分（binary principal components）构造紧凑的二元哈希码与哈希函数，不依赖 LSH 的随机投影或需要梯度的非线性哈希方法。实验显示，BinaryPC 在多个模型家族和长上下文基准上保持与全注意力相当的精度，并优于现有稀疏与哈希基线；在现代 GPU 上，相对 FlashAttention 将端到端解码吞吐量提升 3.56 倍。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 的自注意力是效率瓶颈，尤其在解码阶段需要反复处理不断增长的 KV 缓存。现有稀疏注意力方法常带来明显精度损失、需要额外训练或依赖昂贵的哈希计算。
Method: 提出 BinaryPC，通过计算数据矩阵的二元主成分来生成紧凑的二元哈希码和对应哈希函数，从而在无需梯度训练的情况下显式保留数据的结构信息，并用于稀疏注意力中的 KV 对选择。
Result: 在多个模型家族与长上下文基准上，BinaryPC 相对全注意力保持精度，同时优于其他稀疏与哈希基线；在现代 GPU 上，端到端解码吞吐量较 FlashAttention 提升 3.56 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BinaryPC 是一种无需训练、数据感知的哈希稀疏注意力方案，在精度与解码效率之间取得良好平衡，并已开源代码。
