papers.title: Faster-WAM: Efficient Inference-Time Future Conditioning for Robust World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot manipulation by learning how the environment evolves beyond the current observation. However, existing approaches face a fundamental dilemma: Joint-WAMs preserve future-aware representations during inference but incur prohibitive computation costs, while efficient alternatives remove future modeling at inference time and may lose the robustness benefits of temporal reasoning. In this work, we revisit the role of future representations in WAMs and show that inference-time future conditioning is critical for generalization under distribution shifts. This observation motivates Faster-WAM, an efficient future-conditioning WAM that preserves future representations while avoiding expensive video-action interaction. Faster-WAM introduces a sparse future-conditioning framework that computes future representations once and selectively reuses them throughout action denoising. Specifically, we propose SparseMoT to replace ubiquitous layer-wise fusion with selective video-action interaction at a compact subset of network stages, and Interval KV-Fusion to aggregate multi-depth future representations without increasing attention complexity. Experiments demonstrate that Faster-WAM achieves a substantially better performance-efficiency trade-off than existing WAMs. On the out-of-distribution LIBERO-Plus benchmark, Faster-WAM improves success rate from 49.14% to 73.57% compared with Fast-WAM, while running 2.21$\times$ faster than Joint-WAM. It further achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong robustness in real-world manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Faster-WAM，一种高效的推理时未来条件（inference-time future conditioning）世界动作模型（World Action Model）。它通过稀疏未来条件框架，将未来表示只计算一次并在动作去噪过程中选择性复用，用 SparseMoT 替代逐层融合、用 Interval KV-Fusion 聚合多深度未来表示。实验显示在分布外 LIBERO-Plus 基准上成功率从 Fast-WAM 的 49.14% 提升到 73.57%，且比 Joint-WAM 快 2.21 倍，并在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 面临两难：Joint-WAM 在推理时保留未来感知表示但计算代价高昂，而高效替代方案去掉推理时的未来建模，可能损失时间推理带来的鲁棒性。作者希望在不引入昂贵视频-动作交互的前提下保留推理时未来条件，以提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。
Method: 提出稀疏未来条件框架：未来表示仅计算一次，并在动作去噪过程中选择性复用。具体包含 SparseMoT，用紧凑的网络阶段子集进行选择性视频-动作交互以取代逐层融合；以及 Interval KV-Fusion，聚合多深度未来表示而不增加注意力复杂度。
Result: 在 out-of-distribution 的 LIBERO-Plus 基准上，相比 Fast-WAM，成功率从 49.14% 提升到 73.57%，同时比 Joint-WAM 快 2.21 倍；在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 上取得最先进性能，并在真实世界操纵中表现出强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调推理时未来条件对分布偏移下的泛化至关重要，Faster-WAM 通过稀疏复用未来表示实现了比现有 WAM 更好的性能-效率权衡。

papers.title: Elbow-Based MoE Routing: A Training-Free Inference Time Plugin for Expert Selection
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable model scaling while maintaining low inference-time compute by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, conventional routing relies on a fixed top-k selection, forcing the model to spend the same compute regardless of how many experts are relevant. We introduce elbow-based routing, a training-free inference-time modification that dynamically adjusts the number of experts on a per-token basis. Our method examines the sorted router probability distribution and identifies an elbow point that separates high- and low-probability experts. We find that most router distributions exhibit clear inflection points suitable for this strategy, and we show both theoretically and empirically that elbow-based routing preserves expert load balance. Experiments on a state-of-the-art MoE model demonstrate an average latency reduction of 5.3% while maintaining accuracy across six benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 elbow-based routing，一种无需训练的推理时插件，用于 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 模型的专家选择。该方法检查每个 token 排序后的路由器概率分布，识别出区分高概率与低概率专家的肘点，从而按 token 动态调整激活专家数量，而非固定 top-k。实验显示在 SOTA MoE 模型上平均延迟降低 5.3%，同时保持六个基准的准确率。
Motivation: 传统 MoE 路由固定使用 top-k 专家选择，无论每个 token 实际需要多少专家都消耗相同计算量，导致推理计算浪费。
Method: 提出训练无关的推理时修改：分析每个 token 排序后的路由器概率分布，寻找肘点将高概率与低概率专家分开，据此动态决定该 token 激活的专家数量；并从理论和实证两方面论证该方法能保持专家负载平衡 (load balance)。
Result: 在 state-of-the-art MoE 模型上的实验显示平均推理延迟降低 5.3%，且在六个基准上保持准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 elbow-based routing 可作为 MoE 推理时的即插即用修改，通过动态调整每 token 专家数减少计算开销而不损失准确率。

papers.title: Approximate Multi-Objective Search Under Rulebooks
papers.abstract_en: Robotic planning often involves multiple objectives with complex priority relationships, such as safety, efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Rulebooks formalize these relationships, allowing partial ordering of objectives that generalizes both Pareto and lexicographic dominance. Computing the full set of rulebook-optimal solutions, however, is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce the concept of epsilon-rule-dominance, a principled notion of approximate dominance under rulebooks, and propose RA*pex, a best-first search algorithm that efficiently computes a compact set of epsilon-approximate rulebook-optimal solutions. RA*pex leverages dimensionality reduction, a technique used to speed up existing multi-objective search algorithms, while respecting rule hierarchies by maintaining separate closed sets and performing dominance checks over truncated and residual rule sets. We provide a formal analysis of RA*pex, proving that every rulebook-optimal solution is epsilon-rule-dominated (a generalization of approximate dominance we introduce) by at least one solution in the returned set. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach achieves computation times over two orders of magnitude faster than existing methods.

papers.title: CofactVLA: Deconfounding Vision-Language-Action Models via Counterfactual Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have driven significant progress in robotic manipulation, yet they fundamentally struggle with the vision-override phenomenon. Driven by the severe modality imbalance between dense visual streams and sparse linguistic instructions, VLAs frequently fall prey to causal confusion. Instead of treating language as the primary causal driver, the policy entirely bypasses the original instruction by overfitting to spurious visual confounders, such as prominent objects or familiar layouts. To systematically alleviate this bias, we formalize the process of action generation as a Dual-path Deconfounding Graph (DDG) and propose CofactVLA, a novel causal intervention framework. By dynamically constructing a language-masked counterfactual branch within a single forward pass, CofactVLA isolates and neutralizes visual confounders through two synergistic mechanisms. First, Action-Level Orthogonal Projection Guidance (OPG) geometrically projects the factual velocity field away from the counterfactual visual bias during continuous flow matching, extracting the pure semantic intent. Second, Feature-Level Counterfactual Covariance Reduction (CCR) mathematically deconfounds latent representations by penalizing the positive eigenspace of the covariance difference, explicitly suppressing dominant visual shortcuts while preserving the causal language intent. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CofactVLA establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse simulation benchmarks. Beyond simulation, real-world robot experiments demonstrate the causal efficacy of our method in bridging the generalization gap, yielding a 52.3\% absolute success rate gain under out-of-distribution scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型中的视觉主导(vision-override)现象提出因果干预框架 CofactVLA。作者将动作生成过程形式化为双路径去混淆图(DDG)，通过单次前向传播动态构建语言掩码的反事实分支，并借助动作级正交投影引导(OPG)与特征级反事实协方差缩减(CCR)两种机制消除视觉混淆因素。实验表明该方法在多个仿真基准上达到新最优，并在真实机器人分布外场景下取得52.3%的绝对成功率提升。
Motivation: VLA 模型因密集视觉流与稀疏语言指令之间存在严重的模态不平衡，常发生因果混淆(causal confusion)：策略不把语言当作主要因果驱动力，而是过拟合显著物体或熟悉布局等虚假视觉混淆因素，导致忽略原始指令。
Method: 提出 CofactVLA 因果干预框架，将动作生成建模为 Dual-path Deconfounding Graph (DDG)，并在单次前向中构建语言掩码的反事实分支。其一，Action-Level Orthogonal Projection Guidance (OPG) 在连续流匹配(flow matching)中将事实速度场几何投影到远离反事实视觉偏差的方向，提取纯语义意图；其二，Feature-Level Counterfactual Covariance Reduction (CCR) 通过惩罚协方差差的正特征空间，从特征层面抑制主导视觉捷径并保留因果语言意图。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个仿真基准上刷新了最先进水平；真实机器人实验进一步显示，在分布外(out-of-distribution)场景下取得52.3%的绝对成功率提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法通过反事实干预有效桥接泛化差距，验证了消除视觉混淆因素对提升 VLA 模型因果效力的作用。

papers.title: Free-Lunch Augmentation by Revisiting Diffusion-Based Data Generation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CDFSOD) aims to transfer knowledge from data-rich upstream generic domains to downstream expert domains using scarce training data, where the significant domain gap and data scarcity make it an unsolved challenge. To address this problem, we revisit a natural yet underexplored approach in CDFSOD: data augmentation, by directly synthesizing data through diffusion models to supplement limited training samples. However, due to large domain gaps, we find that current diffusion methods cannot produce good results, leading to performance even lower than using the original images. To address these limitations, we divide the domain gaps into visual gaps and semantic gaps for separate analysis. For the visual gap, we find that the diffusion model cannot distinguish noise from useful information on expert domains, which can be mitigated by adding weakened noise. For the semantic gap, we find that the background semantics shows much smaller gaps between domains than foreground semantics, and we can bridge this gap by background inpainting. Based on the above analysis, we propose a method (Selective Inpainting with Tailored Noise, SITN) to dynamically take different strategies for downstream data synthesis based on their different gaps from the general domain, including a Generation Module for adding tailored noise and a Selection Module to dynamically select the inpainting regions. Extensive experiments on 6 datasets of CDFSOD and 4 datasets of cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CDFSS) validate that we can synthesize helpful data, achieving new state-of-the-art performance. Our codes is available at https://github.com/zzzzj311-droid/Free-Lunch-SITN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨域少样本目标检测 (Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection, CDFSOD)，重新审视用扩散模型直接合成数据来补充少量训练样本的思路。作者把域间差距拆分为视觉差距和语义差距：视觉上扩散模型在专家域难以区分噪声与有用信息，可用减弱噪声缓解；语义上背景语义的跨域差异远小于前景语义，可用背景补全 (inpainting) 弥合。据此提出 SITN (Selective Inpainting with Tailored Noise)，包含添加定制噪声的生成模块和动态选择补全区域的选择模块，并在多个 CDFSOD 和跨域少样本分割数据集上达到新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: CDFSOD 面临显著域差距与训练数据稀缺叠加的挑战，而扩散模型数据增强这一直接手段在大域差距下效果差，甚至低于直接用原始图像，因此需要针对性地分析扩散数据生成失败的原因。
Method: 将域差距分为视觉差距与语义差距分别处理：针对视觉差距，采用减弱噪声 (weakened noise) 使扩散模型在专家域上区分噪声与有用信息；针对语义差距，利用背景语义跨域差异小于前景语义的特点，通过背景补全 (background inpainting) 弥合差距。整体提出 SITN 框架，由 Generation Module 生成带定制噪声的数据、Selection Module 动态选择补全区域。
Result: 摘要报告在 6 个 CDFSOD 数据集和 4 个跨域少样本分割 (CDFSS) 数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能合成有用的训练数据，并取得新的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分别缓解视觉差距和语义差距可以使扩散模型成为 CDFSOD 的一种有效数据增强手段，并将代码开源。

papers.title: When Proxy Prediction Becomes Equation Reconstruction: Diagnostics and Residual Learning for Factor-Derived Proxy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning often relies on proxy targets computed from known domain factors when direct observations are limited. When those same factors are used as model inputs, however, high predictive accuracy may reflect reconstruction of the proxy-generating equation rather than robustness to degraded factor information. We study this problem in RUSLE-derived soil-loss proxy prediction under controlled degradation of the soil-erodibility factor $K$. We introduce a diagnostic framework that combines degraded-formula references, classical tree-based baselines, matched direct and formula-feature predictors, contextual ablations, tail-error analysis, and degradation robustness scoring. We then propose RASPL, a formula-preserving residual framework that retains the degraded formula estimate as the prediction anchor and learns an adaptively gated contextual correction. RASPL substantially outperforms matched direct prediction and provides stronger degradation and tail robustness than treating the formula estimate as an ordinary input feature. Within RASPL, a compact statistical encoder achieves the highest macro-averaged $R^2$ and lowest computational cost, whereas a convolutional encoder achieves the strongest degradation robustness and lowest Tail95 mean absolute error (MAE). These results establish formula preservation as the central design principle for robust learning from factor-derived proxy targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究科学机器学习中由已知领域因子计算出的代理目标（proxy targets）作为监督时的问题：当这些因子同时作为模型输入，高预测精度可能只是重构了代理生成方程，而非对退化因子信息的鲁棒性。作者在 RUSLE 派生的土壤流失代理预测中，针对土壤可蚀性因子 K 的受控退化设计了诊断框架，并提出公式保留式残差学习框架 RASPL。RASPL 以退化公式估计为预测锚点、学习自适应门控的上下文修正，在匹配的直接预测上显著更优，且比把公式估计当作普通输入特征具有更强的退化与尾部鲁棒性。
Motivation: 直接观测有限时，科学机器学习常依赖由已知领域因子计算的代理目标；但当这些因子同时作为模型输入时，高精度可能只是重构代理生成方程，掩盖模型对因子信息退化的脆弱性。作者在 RUSLE 土壤流失预测中研究该问题。
Method: 引入由退化公式参考、经典树基线、匹配的直接与公式特征预测器、上下文消融、尾部误差分析和退化鲁棒性评分组成的诊断框架；随后提出 RASPL，保留退化公式估计作为预测锚点，学习自适应门控的上下文修正。其中紧凑统计编码器宏平均 R^2 最高且计算成本最低，卷积编码器退化鲁棒性最强且 Tail95 MAE 最低。
Result: RASPL 大幅优于匹配的直接预测方法，并在退化鲁棒性和尾部鲁棒性上强于将公式估计作为普通输入特征的方法；紧凑统计编码器取得最高宏平均 R^2 和最低计算成本，卷积编码器取得最强退化鲁棒性和最低 Tail95 MAE。
Conclusion: 结果表明，公式保留（formula preservation）是从因子派生代理目标进行鲁棒学习的核心设计原则。本文为 8 页预印本，尚未有期刊发表信息。

papers.title: NeuroPB: Scaling Neural Decoding with Pretrained Behavioral Representations
papers.abstract_en: Decoding continuous motor trajectories from neural activity is essential for developing practical brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, current neural decoders are constrained by the limited scale and heterogeneity of neural recordings. In contrast, behavioral data can be collected more readily and at substantially larger scale from humans, animals, simulations, and robotic systems. Here, we introduce NeuroPB, a framework that scales neural decoding by transferring knowledge from pretrained behavioral representations. NeuroPB first pretrains a motor encoder on large-scale motor behavior data and then aligns neural activity with the resulting behavioral representation space using a limited set of paired neural-behavioral recordings. A neural encoder and lightweight motor decoder are subsequently optimized to reconstruct continuous movement from the aligned neural representations. Across multiple macaque motor datasets, behavioral pretraining improves trajectory decoding, including an 11% $R^2$ increase on center-out and 8% on random-target compared with training the motor encoder from scratch. Notably, pretraining on robotic trajectories achieves performance comparable to pretraining on macaque trajectories, demonstrating that transferable kinematic structure is shared across biological and artificial models. Moreover, decoding performance improves as the scale and diversity of robotic pretraining data increase, when the amount of neural data is fixed. Pretraining also enhances generalization across recording sessions, subjects, and motor tasks, with only 10% calibration needed to match training from scratch. Overall, these results establish behavioral pretraining as a scalable source for neural decoding and provide a promising route toward high-performance and calibration-efficient BCIs under limited neural data.

TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroPB 框架，通过在大规模运动行为数据上预训练运动编码器 (motor encoder)，再用少量配对神经-行为记录将神经活动对齐到行为表征空间，最后联合优化神经编码器与轻量级运动解码器来重建连续运动。在多个猕猴运动数据集上，行为预训练相比从零训练带来轨迹解码提升，中心外出任务 R² 提高 11%、随机目标任务提高 8%；机器人轨迹预训练效果与猕猴轨迹预训练相当，且预训练增强跨 session、跨被试和跨任务的泛化，仅需 10% 校准数据即可匹配从零训练。

Method: NeuroPB 首先在大规模运动行为数据上预训练一个运动编码器，然后利用有限的配对神经-行为记录，将神经活动对齐到行为表征空间；随后优化神经编码器和轻量级运动解码器，从对齐后的神经表征重建连续运动。
Result: 在多个猕猴运动数据集上，行为预训练相比从头训练运动编码器带来轨迹解码提升，中心外出任务 R² 提高 11%，随机目标任务提高 8%。机器人轨迹预训练可达到与猕猴轨迹预训练相当的性能，且在神经数据量固定时，解码性能随机器人预训练数据的规模与多样性增加而提升；预训练还改善了跨记录 session、跨被试和跨运动任务的泛化，仅需 10% 校准数据即可匹配从零训练。

papers.title: ReGround: Restoring Visual Grounding in Multi-Step Reasoning through Self-Diagnosis and Visual Re-Examination
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often lose visual grounding during multi-step reasoning: as reasoning chains grow longer, later inference steps rely increasingly on language priors rather than image evidence. We identify a consistent benchmark-level signature associated with this degradation: across 2,510 re-examined samples from four benchmarks, attention entropy over image tokens typically decreases during Round 1 and rises again after image re-injection. However, we find that effective visual re-examination requires two complementary ingredients: image re-injection and targeted self-diagnosis. Without targeted diagnosis, re-examination can even hurt performance, whereas accurate self-diagnosis yields substantial gains -- a swing of several points on key benchmarks, indicating that diagnostic quality is a key factor in whether re-examination helps or hurts in our setting. We present ReGround, a two-stage framework that teaches VLMs to self-diagnose grounding failures and selectively re-examine visual evidence, without architectural modifications or external tools. Through capability bootstrapping, a stronger variant from the same model family provides diagnostic scaffolding only during data construction, while the policy model learns to diagnose autonomously at inference time and retains most of the assisted gains. Experiments on eight benchmarks across two VLM backbones demonstrate consistent gains, especially on visually intensive multi-step reasoning tasks, while incurring only modest inference overhead relative to tool-augmented baselines. Project page: https://sespoir.github.io/reground-page/ . Code: https://github.com/sespoir/ReGround .
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 8 pages main text, 4 figures, plus appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGround，一个两阶段框架，用于恢复视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在多步推理中丢失的视觉定位 (visual grounding)。作者指出推理链变长时后续步骤越来越依赖语言先验而非图像证据，并发现仅靠图像重注入 (image re-injection) 不够，还必须配合针对性自我诊断 (self-diagnosis)；在八个基准、两个 VLM 主干上报告了稳定增益，尤其在视觉密集型多步推理任务上，且推理开销相对工具增强基线仅为适度增加。
Motivation: VLM 在多步推理中会逐渐失去对图像证据的关注，长推理链导致视觉定位退化；作者在四个基准的 2510 个再检查样本中识别出一致的基准级信号：图像 token 的注意力熵在第一轮下降、图像重注入后回升。无针对性诊断的视觉重检查甚至可能损害性能，因此诊断质量是重检查有效性的关键因素。
Method: ReGround 采用两阶段框架：通过能力启动 (capability bootstrapping)，由同一模型家族的更强变体仅在数据构造阶段提供诊断脚手架，策略模型 (policy model) 在推理时自主诊断定位失败并选择性地重新检查视觉证据；该方法不需要架构修改或外部工具。
Result: 摘要报告在八个基准和两个 VLM 主干上的一致提升，尤其在视觉密集型多步推理任务上；准确自我诊断可带来关键基准上几个百分点的增益，而缺少针对性诊断时重检查甚至可能有害。推理开销相对工具增强基线仅为适度增加。
Conclusion: 有效的视觉再检查需要两个互补要素：图像重注入与针对性自我诊断；通过能力启动，策略模型可以在推理时自主诊断并保留大部分辅助增益，同时避免架构修改和外部工具依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Improving Auto-Design of Neural PDE Solvers with a Domain-Specific Language
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE solver auto-design is fundamentally a search-space representation problem. In the space of unrestricted Python programs, valid solvers form an extremely sparse subset: most candidate programs are syntactically incorrect, semantically incompatible, or numerically unstable. Direct code generation therefore forces an LLM to spend most of its search capacity navigating implementation failures rather than reasoning about solver quality. ADSL-PDE addresses this challenge by introducing a structured search state between solver concepts and executable code. It represents the functional decisions that determine a neural PDE solver (architecture, physical constraints, objectives, sampling, and optimization) while abstracting away low-level implementation details. A deterministic compiler maps each valid search state to an executable solver. In effect, ADSL-PDE reshapes the search space: it removes large regions of invalid programs, increases the density of meaningful candidates, and preserves the compositional freedom needed to discover previously unseen designs. Solver evolution can thus operate over design decisions rather than code artifacts. Built on this representation, our evolutionary agent iteratively proposes, evaluates, and refines solver search states using empirical feedback. Across multiple PDE benchmarks, ADSL-PDE improves both search efficiency and optimization stability, achieving an improvement of more than 52% within the first ten evolution iterations. These results suggest a broader principle for LLM-driven auto-design: effective agents do not merely require stronger reasoning, but rather a search representation that concentrates exploration on valid and consequential decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADSL-PDE，一种用于神经 PDE 求解器自动设计的领域特定语言 (DSL) 与结构化搜索状态表示。该方法将决定求解器行为的设计决策（架构、物理约束、目标、采样、优化）与底层实现细节分离，并通过确定性编译器把合法搜索状态映射为可执行求解器，从而重塑搜索空间并提高有效候选的密度。基于该表示的演化智能体迭代提出、评估和细化搜索状态，在多个 PDE 基准上提升了搜索效率与优化稳定性。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器自动设计本质上是一个搜索空间表示问题；在无限制 Python 程序空间中，合法求解器只占极稀疏子集，多数候选程序存在语法、语义或数值不稳定问题。直接代码生成迫使 LLM 把大部分搜索能力消耗在处理实现失败上，而非关注求解器质量。
Method: 在求解器概念与可执行代码之间引入结构化搜索状态，抽象掉低级实现细节，只保留决定神经 PDE 求解器的功能性决策；用确定性编译器将每个合法搜索状态转换为可执行求解器。演化智能体在此基础上对设计决策而非代码工件进行迭代提议、评估与细化。
Result: 在多个 PDE 基准上，ADSL-PDE 在搜索效率和优化稳定性两方面均有提升，前十个演化迭代内实现超过 52% 的改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明，LLM 驱动的自动设计需要的不只是更强的推理能力，更需要一种能把探索集中在有效且关键决策上的搜索表示。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Non-asymptotic implicit bias of logistic regression at early-stage gradient descent dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Gradient descent has been of particular interest in modern machine learning beyond sole focus on optimization. Implicit bias emerging from optimization, though not being encoded by the learning objective, often prevents from overfitting to spurious patterns. A typical instance is the max-margin implicit bias of a linear classifier, widely established for exponentially tailed loss functions. Even after having a given dataset separated, the parameter vector continues to evolve towards the max-margin direction asymptotically along the gradient descent dynamics. This phenomenon corroborates a frequent empirical observation of "train longer, generalize better." However, the max-margin convergence is an asymptotic phenomenon, and what is worse, this asymptotic convergence rate is significantly slower than pure convex optimization. Even so, the parameter vector along gradient descent dynamics commonly correlates with the max-margin direction positively (though not exactly) within considerably fewer iterations than the asymptotic rate. By shedding another light on this classical problem, this work aims to understand the mechanism of this early-stage alignment phenomenon. Our theoretical results demonstrate that the parameter vector weakly aligns with the max-margin direction within $O(\exp(\exp(-δ)))$ iterations, where $δ>0$ is the permissible alignment error, which is shown to be tight. By tracking the radial and tangential flows, our proof operates on the alignment dynamics directly with dataset geometry and gets rid of the asymptotic expansion, which is a key insight to establishing faster weak alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究逻辑回归在梯度下降早期阶段的非渐近隐式偏置 (implicit bias)。作者证明参数向量会在 O(exp(exp(-δ))) 次迭代内与最大间隔方向 (max-margin direction) 形成弱对齐 (weak alignment)，其中 δ>0 为允许的对齐误差，并指出该界是紧的。证明通过追踪径向流与切向流直接分析对齐动力学，绕开了渐近展开。
Motivation: 最大间隔收敛是渐近现象，且渐近收敛速度远慢于纯凸优化，但经验上参数向量在远少于渐近速率的迭代内就与最大间隔方向呈正相关。本文旨在理解这一早期对齐现象背后的机制。
Method: 提出直接作用于对齐动力学 (alignment dynamics) 的分析方法，结合数据集几何追踪径向 (radial) 与切向 (tangential) 流动，避免使用渐近展开，从而建立更快的弱对齐结果。
Result: 理论结果表明，参数向量在 O(exp(exp(-δ))) 次迭代内即与最大间隔方向弱对齐，其中 δ 为允许的对齐误差，且该迭代复杂度界被证明是紧的。
Conclusion: 本文认为关键洞见是直接分析对齐动力学而非依赖渐近展开，从而能在远早于渐近速率的时间尺度上刻画弱对齐现象。

papers.title: NodeJEPA: Structure-Conditioned Latent Prediction for Node-Level Graph Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning on graphs is largely shaped by contrastive methods that depend on carefully designed augmentations, and by generative methods that reconstruct node attributes in the input space. Both paradigms can entangle representations with low-level input statistics rather than with relational structure. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) instead learn by predicting latent targets rather than reconstructing inputs. Recent work has explored this idea for graph-level representation learning, but how to design JEPA-style objectives for node-level tasks, and which structural signals the predictor should condition on, remains less clear. We present NodeJEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for node-level graph self-supervised learning. NodeJEPA masks structure-aware k-hop ego-subgraphs and trains a context encoder to predict the latent representations of the masked nodes. These targets come from an EMA-updated target encoder with stop-gradient. A structure-conditioned predictor integrates spectral and centrality descriptors through cross-attention. Variance, covariance, and Laplacian spectral regularizers help stabilize the embedding geometry, and an optional curriculum gradually increases masking difficulty during training. Because prediction occurs in latent space, NodeJEPA does not rely on input reconstruction or hand-crafted graph augmentations. We evaluate NodeJEPA on standard node classification benchmarks under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols, and conduct ablations on masking, prediction, and regularization design choices. Our study offers a practical recipe for node-level JEPA-style latent prediction on graphs, and clarifies when structural conditioning helps representation learning. Code, configurations, and evaluation scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/OliverZ-dot/Node-Jepa.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NodeJEPA，一种用于节点级图自监督学习的联合嵌入预测架构 (joint-embedding predictive architecture)。它掩蔽结构感知的 k-hop ego-subgraph，让上下文编码器在潜在空间预测被掩蔽节点的表征，目标来自带 stop-gradient 的 EMA 更新目标编码器；预测器通过交叉注意力整合谱与中心性描述符。作者在标准节点分类基准上以线性探测和微调协议评估，并做了掩蔽、预测和正则化设计的消融，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有图自监督方法主要依赖对比学习（依赖精心设计的增广）或生成式方法（在输入空间重建节点属性），两者都可能让表征纠缠于低层输入统计而非关系结构。JEPA 思想在图表征学习已有探索，但面向节点级任务如何设计 JEPA 式目标、预测器应条件于哪些结构信号仍不清楚。
Method: NodeJEPA 掩蔽结构感知的 k-hop ego-subgraphs，并用上下文编码器预测被掩蔽节点的潜在表征；目标来自 EMA 更新的 target encoder 并配合 stop-gradient。结构条件预测器通过 cross-attention 整合谱描述符 (spectral descriptors) 与中心性描述符 (centrality descriptors)；方差、协方差和 Laplacian 谱正则化稳定嵌入几何，可选课程学习逐步增加掩蔽难度。预测发生在潜在空间，不依赖输入重建或手工图增广。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在标准节点分类基准上以线性探测 (linear probing) 和微调 (fine-tuning) 协议进行评估，并对掩蔽、预测和正则化设计选择进行了消融，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为节点级 JEPA 式潜在预测提供了一份实用配方，并厘清了结构条件化在何时有助于表征学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Image Classification Using CNN-QNN Hybrid Model with Optimized Correlated Features
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method to optimize the correlation among convolutional neural network (CNN) features that are used as inputs to quantum neural network (QNN) to enhance image classification accuracy. Unlike prior approaches that employ orthogonal decomposition as preprocessing, we intentionally introduce correlated features that are more physically compatible with QNN. This design leverages the QNN's inherent ability to exploit quantum entanglement for representing correlated states-an advantage unavailable to classical neural networks. We hypothesize that aligning feature correlations with the entanglement structure of QNN improves binary classification performance. Based on a mathematical derivation of QNN outputs, Monte Carlo simulations indicate that an average correlation between features of 0.5 yields optimal classification accuracy. To validate this finding, we evaluate a quantum-classical hybrid model on three tasks: CIFAR-10 (automobile vs. truck), Fashion-MNIST (shirt vs. coat), and radar micro-Doppler signatures (robotic dogs vs. non-robots). To regulate feature correlations, we introduce a correlation-regularization term on the outputs of the CNN, driving the off-diagonal entries of the feature correlation matrix toward a target constant. Across all datasets, inducing intermediate correlation consistently improved accuracy compared to low, high, or unregulated correlations, while also reducing classification accuracy variance. These results demonstrate that imposing moderate feature correlations-without modifying the quantum circuit-enhances classification accuracy and stability by aligning feature statistics with the QNN's entanglement structure. This study highlights the potential of QNN to surpass the performance of classical classifiers as more qubits become available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在 CNN 与量子神经网络（QNN）的混合模型中，通过引入受控的相关特征来提升图像二分类精度。与以往用正交分解做预处理的思路相反，作者有意保留并调节特征相关性，使其与 QNN 的纠缠结构对齐；在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST 与雷达微多普勒（micro-Doppler）三组二分类任务上，中间水平的特征相关性一致优于低相关、高相关或未调节的相关性，并降低准确率方差。
Motivation: 以往研究将 CNN 特征做正交分解后输入 QNN，但作者认为正交特征与 QNN 依赖量子纠缠表达相关态的能力不匹配，限制了混合模型性能。
Method: 提出在 CNN 输出上加入相关性正则项（correlation-regularization term），将特征相关矩阵的非对角项推向目标常数，从而在不修改量子电路的前提下调节特征之间的平均相关性；并用数学推导和 Monte Carlo 模拟确定最优相关性水平。
Result: Monte Carlo 模拟显示特征平均相关性约为 0.5 时分类精度最优；在 CIFAR-10（automobile vs. truck）、Fashion-MNIST（shirt vs. coat）和雷达微多普勒（robotic dogs vs. non-robots）三个二分类任务上，中间相关相比低、高或未调节的相关都提升准确率，同时降低准确率方差。
Conclusion: 作者认为，使特征统计与 QNN 纠缠结构对齐可在不改动量子电路的情况下提高分类精度与稳定性；随着可用量子比特增多，QNN 有潜力超越经典分类器。

papers.title: Helping Music Co-Creation Agents 'Listen' Well: Hierarchical Self-Supervised World Models for Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative music agents need internal representations rich enough to support both understanding and generation, yet flexible enough for a workflow where the human retains agency. We present a hierarchical self-supervised ``world model'' for symbolic music: a 2.55M-parameter Swin V2 encoder trained on MIDI piano-roll images with JEPA-style objectives (pitch- and time-shift equivariance, masked embedding prediction, and a distributional regularizer), using no labels and no music-theory vocabulary. Probing the frozen embeddings shows that the level at which a musical property becomes decodable tracks its musical time scale: phrase boundaries are read off the coarsest levels, note density and harmonic detail off the finest. Temporal and phrase structure emerge from the self-supervised objectives alone, while harmonic content must be asked for; a small chord-supervision head raises joint chord recovery from .18 to .54, and key detection, which is never supervised, from .16 to .70. Following the Representation AutoEncoder paradigm, a conditional flow-matching model stands in for a trained decoder, flowing in pixel space from PCA-reduced conditioning: it reproduces a target window at pixel F1 $0.996$, and the same per-level conditioning dropout that controls how far variations stray also enables graphical prompting for masked inpainting with no inpainting-specific sampler. The pipeline runs on CPU producing a suggestion in $2.8$ s, or $0.6$ s on Apple MPS, which we demonstrate in a live interactive demo. In concert with an LLM-based brain, these capabilities supply the core of a collaborative music creation agent in service of, rather than in place of, human agency.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 14 figures. A 6-page version was submitted to the NeurIPS 2026 Creative AI Track. Supplemental website with listening examples: https://drscotthawley.github.io/midi-rae-jepa-son/. Live demo: https://drscotthawley-midi-rae-jepa-son.hf.space/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向人机协同的音乐共创场景，提出一个用于符号音乐的分层自监督世界模型：一个 2.55M 参数的 Swin V2 编码器，在 MIDI piano-roll 图像上用 JEPA 风格目标（音高/时间平移等变性、掩码嵌入预测、分布正则化）训练，不使用标签或音乐理论词汇。冻结嵌入的探测显示，音乐属性可在哪一层被解码与其时间尺度相关：乐句边界在最粗层可读，音符密度与和声细节在最细层可读。条件 flow-matching 模型作为解码器，可在像素空间重构目标窗口（像素 F1 0.996），并支持无专门采样器的掩码修复；CPU 上 2.8 秒、Apple MPS 上 0.6 秒生成一个建议。
Motivation: 协作式音乐智能体需要足够丰富的内部表示来同时支持理解与生成，同时又要足够灵活以适应人类保留主导权的创作流程；作者认为现有模型缺乏这种兼顾理解与生成的表示。
Method: 提出分层自监督世界模型：用 JEPA 风格目标训练 Swin V2 编码器（2.55M 参数）处理 MIDI piano-roll 图像；遵循 Representation AutoEncoder 范式，用条件 flow-matching 模型替代训练好的解码器，在像素空间从 PCA 降维条件中生成；并利用逐层条件 dropout 控制变体偏离程度，同时实现图形化提示的掩码修复。
Result: 探测实验表明乐句边界在最粗层、音符密度与和声细节在最细层可解码；加入小型和弦监督头后，联合和弦恢复从 .18 提升到 .54，从未被监督的调性检测从 .16 提升到 .70；目标窗口重构像素 F1 为 0.996；CPU 上 2.8 秒、Apple MPS 上 0.6 秒生成一个建议，并已提供实时交互演示。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间与乐句结构可以仅从自监督目标中涌现，而和声内容需要额外监督；该流水线结合 LLM 大脑，为以服务而非取代人类主导权的协同音乐创作智能体提供了核心能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Hypergraph Neural Networks under Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraph neural networks (HGNNs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in processing complex higher-order relationships. However, their performance is highly dependent on labeled data, making them vulnerable to label noise. Despite advances in learning with label noise (LLN) and graph learning with label noise (GLN), noisy-label learning on hypergraphs remains underexplored. In this paper, we present a systematic study of hypergraph node classification under label noise. First, we adapt representative LLN and GLN methods to hypergraphs and evaluate them under a unified benchmark, revealing the limitations of existing robust learning strategies for hypergraphs. Building on this, we propose a new hypergraph robust framework, HyperTrust, which first estimates hyperedge trustworthiness through a pretraining-based, entropy-aware strategy, and then incorporates the HyperedgeBoost module to enhance reliable supervision by connecting unlabeled nodes to trustworthy hyperedges, as well as the HyperedgePrune module to suppress noisy propagation by removing untrustworthy node-hyperedge incidences. Finally, two modules work collaboratively to adjust the hypergraph structure and generate final predictions. Extensive experiments and theoretical analysis demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of HyperTrust on multiple hypergraph datasets under various noisy settings. Our work provides a unified benchmark and an effective solution for hypergraph learning with label noise and lays a foundation for future research in this direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究超图神经网络（HGNN）在标签噪声下的节点分类问题，提出鲁棒框架 HyperTrust。该框架先通过预训练、熵感知策略估计超边可信度，再以 HyperedgeBoost 模块将未标注节点连接到可信超边以增强监督，并用 HyperedgePrune 模块移除不可信的节点-超边关联以抑制噪声传播；两个模块协同调整超图结构并生成最终预测。作者还适配了代表性 LLN 与 GLN 方法到超图场景并建立统一基准，实验与理论分析表明 HyperTrust 在多种噪声设置下具有有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 超图神经网络依赖标签数据，对标签噪声敏感；尽管学习含噪标签（LLN）和图学习含噪标签（GLN）已有进展，超图上的含噪标签学习仍缺乏系统研究，且现有鲁棒学习策略在超图上的表现未被统一评估。
Method: 首先将代表性 LLN 与 GLN 方法适配到超图并构建统一评测基准，揭示现有策略的局限；随后提出 HyperTrust，包含基于预训练的熵感知超边可信度估计，以及 HyperedgeBoost（连接未标注节点到可信超边）和 HyperedgePrune（移除不可信节点-超边关联）两个模块，二者协同调整超图结构并生成预测。
Result: 在多个超图数据集和多种噪声设置下，HyperTrust 相对现有方法表现出更优的有效性和鲁棒性；论文还提供了理论分析，并指出已有鲁棒学习策略在超图上的不足。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为超图含噪标签学习提供了统一基准和有效解决方案，并为该方向的后续研究奠定基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinReportBench: Measuring and Improving Institution-Grade Financial Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce fluent financial analysis, but fluency alone does not establish whether a report is suitable for institutional delivery. We introduce FinReportBench, an expert-grounded benchmark for measuring and improving institution-grade financial report generation. Expert review reveals recurring gaps in report identity, institutional components, source discipline, and visual delivery. We derive a 35-item rubric through expert partial orders, multimodal evidence, and audits of decision boundaries, covering deliverability, report identity, and institutional completeness. Starting from 10,000 balanced Chinese and English financial-research source records, we curate 244 bilingual tasks across three research objects and two input tiers. Each task separates the public query, reconstructed research trajectory, and hidden source packet. Three independent judge families reproduce the expert partial order at near-ceiling rates, showing that bounded, observable criteria support reliable evaluation. Across nine model families, basic deliverability is nearly saturated, while report identity and institutional completeness remain the primary bottlenecks. The largest cross-model gaps concern generation-trace control, information density, and data discipline rather than basic report framing. We then use benchmark-guided skill distillation to turn recurrent failures into reusable generation and self-review constraints. Across five model families, the evolved skill improves mean G1 by 33.85 points and mean G2 by 13.83 points over paired no-skill runs while preserving G0 for every pair. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/MisterBrookT/finreportbench.

TL;DR: 本文提出 FinReportBench，一个面向机构级金融报告生成的专家校准基准。作者通过专家评审归纳出 35 项评分细则，从 10,000 条中英金融研究源记录中整理出 244 个双语任务，每个任务分离公开查询、重构研究轨迹与隐藏源包。三类独立评判器以接近上限的比例复现专家偏序；在九个模型家族上，基本可交付性接近饱和，而报告身份与机构完整性仍是主要瓶颈。作者进一步用基准引导的技能蒸馏将反复出现的失败转化为可复用的生成与自审约束，在五个模型家族上将平均 G1 提升 33.85 分、G2 提升 13.83 分，同时保持 G0 不变。
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成流畅的金融分析，但流畅性本身不足以证明报告适合机构交付；现有评估缺乏针对机构级报告质量的可信、可复现测度。
Method: 通过专家偏序、多模态证据与决策边界审计推导出 35 项评分细则，覆盖可交付性、报告身份与机构完整性；构建双语任务集，并用三个独立评判器家族验证评估可靠性。随后使用基准引导的技能蒸馏，将反复失败转化可复用的生成与自审约束。
Result: 三个评判器家族以近天花板水平复现专家偏序；九个模型家族中基本可交付性几乎饱和，报告身份与机构完整性成为主要瓶颈，最大的跨模型差距出现在生成轨迹控制、信息密度与数据纪律上。在五个模型家族上，演化技能使平均 G1 提高 33.85 分、G2 提高 13.83 分，且每对实验的 G0 均保持不变。
Conclusion: 作者认为有界、可观察的准则能够支持可靠的机构级金融报告评估，且技能蒸馏可在不损失基础 G0 的前提下显著改善高阶报告质量。

papers.title: EvtGraph: Event-Adaptive Compression for Sparse Temporal Graph Learning in Multimodal Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal temporal data are inherently irregular and uneven in information density, yet most models rely on uniform discretization, leading to inefficient representations. We propose \textbf{EvtGraph}, a unified framework that aligns computation with temporal salience under explicit budget constraints. EvtGraph reparameterizes sequences into event-level tokens via event-adaptive compression (EAMC), selects a compact subset with a node budget (NBC), and performs temporally constrained sparse graph reasoning (T2SG). This transforms dense sequences into structured computation over salient events, reducing complexity while preserving critical transitions. We show that this design provides a practical mechanism for allocating representational capacity under a fixed budget, yielding a consistent performance--efficiency trade-off, where a small budget is often sufficient in practice. Experiments on multimodal clinical (MIMIC-IV + CXR) and cross-domain benchmarks demonstrate that EvtGraph outperforms both Transformer-based and recurrent baselines while significantly improving efficiency. These results suggest that budget-constrained event-centric representation provides a general paradigm for learning from high-redundancy temporal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvtGraph，一个在显式预算约束下将计算与时间显著性对齐的统一框架，用于多模态时序数据学习。它通过事件自适应压缩 (EAMC) 将序列重参数化为事件级 token，用节点预算 (NBC) 选择紧凑子集，并执行时间约束稀疏图推理 (T2SG)，把密集序列转化为对显著事件的结构化计算。在 MIMIC-IV + CXR 临床多模态和跨域基准上，EvtGraph 优于 Transformer 与循环基线，同时显著提升效率。
Motivation: 多模态时间数据天然不规则、信息密度不均匀，但大多数模型依赖均匀离散化，导致表示效率低下。作者希望为高冗余时序数据提供一种在固定预算下分配表征能力的实际机制，并验证小预算往往足以取得良好效果。
Method: EvtGraph 包含三个组件：事件自适应压缩 (EAMC) 将序列重参数化为事件级 token；节点预算 (NBC) 选择紧凑子集；时间约束稀疏图推理 (T2SG) 在显著事件上进行稀疏图计算，从而在降低复杂度的同时保留关键转变。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV + CXR 等临床多模态基准和跨域基准上，EvtGraph 在性能上超过基于 Transformer 和循环结构 (recurrent) 的基线，同时显著提升效率，并展现出固定预算下一致的性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要认为预算约束的事件中心表示 (event-centric representation) 为从高冗余时间数据中学习提供了一种通用范式，且实践中较小预算往往足够。论文未涉及降水、临近预报或天气数据，与个人关键词的直接联系有限，但方法可能迁移到高冗余气象时序任务。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Combating Knowledge Corruption in Agent Systems: A Byzantine-Tolerant Secure Collaborative RAG Framework
papers.abstract_en: While retrieval-augmented generation systems partially address the hallucination issues in large language models, it also introduces new vulnerabilities to knowledge corruption attacks. Adversaries exploit these vulnerabilities by poisoning documents provided by RAG system to manipulate LLM outputs. To counter this threat, we propose SecureCollaRAG, a Byzantine-tolerant collaborative RAG framework leveraging Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism. Our approach enables agent system to securely verify document provenance through dynamic GNN-based credibility scoring, effectively preventing stealthy knowledge corruption attacks while preserving essential domain knowledge integrity. Through extensive evaluations and formal analysis, we demonstrate that SecureCollaRAG maintains robustness against attackers under non-IID data distributions.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026, pages 2661-2672, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SecureCollaRAG，一个面向智能体系统的拜占庭容错协作式 RAG 框架，用于抵御知识污染攻击（knowledge corruption attacks）。方法引入多源知识验证机制（Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism），通过基于动态 GNN 的可信度评分来验证文档来源，从而在不破坏领域知识完整性的前提下阻断隐蔽的知识污染。摘要报告，通过大量实验与形式化分析，SecureCollaRAG 在非 IID 数据分布下对攻击者保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）虽能部分缓解大语言模型的幻觉问题，但也引入了新的知识污染攻击面：攻击者通过投毒 RAG 系统提供的文档来操纵 LLM 输出。
Method: 提出 SecureCollaRAG，一种拜占庭容错的协作式 RAG 框架，核心是 Multi-source Knowledge Validation Mechanism，利用动态 GNN 的可信度评分对文档来源（provenance）进行安全验证，以识别并抑制隐蔽知识污染。
Result: 摘要声称通过大量评估与形式化分析，该方法在非 IID 数据分布下仍能保持对攻击者的鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过动态 GNN 可信度评分安全验证文档来源，可以在保留领域知识完整性的同时有效防御隐蔽的知识污染攻击。

papers.title: Manipulation-Proof Oblivious Audits against Deceptive Model Providers
papers.abstract_en: Audits have emerged as a critical instrument for algorithmic governance, providing a mechanism for external scrutiny and governance of machine learning models. However, ensuring the integrity of such assessments remains a challenging issue. For instance in regulatory contexts, audits are typically declared or easily detected, thus enabling model providers to manipulate the process, whether intentionally or inadvertently. This vulnerability is particularly acute in the context of fairness evaluations, in which providers can often infer sensitive attributes and strategically equalize allocation rates between groups to satisfy fairness metrics. In this paper, we introduce a novel audit protocol designed to significantly increase the post-audit detectability of such manipulations by enabling the auditor to query the model in an oblivious manner. Our approach leverages a Private Information Retrieval mechanism to require the provider to label a large set of instances, while preventing it from knowing which subset will ultimately be used for the audit. The protocol is efficient, imposes minimal overhead on the auditor, and requires no modification to the audited model, its training procedure, or its inference pipeline. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, under this protocol, a provider attempting to hide unfairness must falsify a significantly larger number of responses, thereby increasing both the difficulty and the likelihood of detection of manipulation. Experimental results across representative audit scenarios confirm the effectiveness and practicality of our approach.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication at the 2026 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对外部审计中模型提供者可能操纵评估过程的问题，提出一种防操纵的 oblivious 审计协议。该协议利用私有信息检索（Private Information Retrieval, PIR）机制，让审计员以不可见方式查询模型，使提供者必须标注大量实例但不知晓哪些子集真正用于审计。作者给出理论保证，说明该协议能迫使试图隐藏不公平性的提供者伪造更多响应，从而显著提高操纵的事后可检测性，并在代表性审计场景中通过实验验证了其有效性与实用性。
Motivation: 现有审计通常是声明式或容易被提供者察觉，模型提供者可能有意或无意地操纵审计过程；尤其在公平性评估中，提供者可推断敏感属性并策略性均衡不同组别的分配率以满足公平性指标，使审计结果失真。
Method: 提出一种新的审计协议，使审计员能对模型进行 oblivious 查询；核心是借助 Private Information Retrieval 机制，要求提供者为大量实例提供标注，同时阻止其得知哪些子集最终被用于审计。该协议对审计员额外开销极小，且无需修改被审计模型、其训练过程或推理管线。
Result: 理论分析表明，在该协议下试图隐藏不公平性的提供者必须伪造显著更大数量的响应，从而同时增加操纵难度与被检测概率；实验在多个代表性审计场景中证实了方法的有效性、效率与实用性。
Conclusion: 作者总结该 oblivious 审计协议能在不改变模型本身的前提下显著提升对操纵行为的检测能力，并通过理论保证和实验结果为人工智能系统外部审计提供了一种低成本、可部署的增强方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuMoSync: End-to-End Neuromodulatory Control for Plasticity and Adaptability in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) requires models to learn tasks sequentially, yet deep neural networks often suffer from plasticity loss and poor knowledge transfer, which can impede their long-term adaptability. Drawing high-level inspiration from global neuromodulatory mechanisms in the brain, we introduce Neuromodulation and Synchronization (NeuMoSync), a novel architecture that integrates dynamic, neuron-specific modulation into deep neural networks to enhance their adaptability and plasticity. NeuMoSync extends standard neural network architectures with learnable feature vectors for each neuron that track network-wide historical context and with a module operating at a higher level of abstraction. This module synthesizes neuron-specific signals, conditioned on both current inputs and the network's evolving state, to adaptively regulate activation dynamics and synaptic plasticity. Evaluated on diverse CL benchmarks, including memorization (Random Label CIFAR-10 and Random Label MNIST), concept drift (Shuffle CIFAR-10 and Shuffle Mini-ImageNet), class-incremental learning (Class Split ImageNet and Class Split CIFAR-100), and domain-incremental learning (Permuted MNIST), NeuMoSync demonstrates strong performance in retaining plasticity and achieves improvements in both forward and backward adaptation compared with existing methods. Ablation studies validate the necessity of each component, while analysis of the learned modulatory signals reveals interpretable coordination patterns across tasks. Our work underscores the potential of integrating global coordination mechanisms into deep learning systems to advance robust, adaptive continual learning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/RoozbehRazavi/NeuMoSync.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuMoSync（Neuromodulation and Synchronization），一种端到端的神经调制架构，用于增强持续学习（continual learning）中深度神经网络的可塑性与适应性。架构为每个神经元引入可学习特征向量以追踪网络级历史上下文，并由一个更高抽象层的模块基于当前输入和网络演化状态合成神经元特异信号，动态调节激活动力学与突触可塑性。在随机标签、概念漂移、类别增量与域增量等基准上的实验显示其能保持可塑性并改善前向与后向适应，消融实验验证各组件必要性，学习到的调制信号呈现跨任务的可解释协调模式。
Motivation: 持续学习要求模型顺序学习多个任务，但深度神经网络常遭受可塑性损失（plasticity loss）和知识迁移不佳，进而限制长期适应性；论文从大脑全局神经调制机制获取高层灵感来缓解这一问题。
Method: NeuMoSync 扩展标准神经网络，为每个神经元添加可学习的特征向量以跟踪全网络历史上下文，并加入一个在更高抽象层级运作的模块；该模块以当前输入和网络演化状态为条件，合成神经元特异调制信号，自适应调节激活动力学与突触可塑性。
Result: 在 Random Label CIFAR-10/MNIST（记忆）、Shuffle CIFAR-10/Shuffle Mini-ImageNet（概念漂移）、Class Split ImageNet/Class Split CIFAR-100（类增量）及 Permuted MNIST（域增量）等基准上，NeuMoSync 相比现有方法在保持可塑性和前向/后向适应上均有提升；消融研究确认每个组件的必要性，调制信号分析揭示跨任务的可解释协调模式。

papers.title: HyPASE: Hyperbolic Geometry for Parameter-Efficient Speech Emotion Fine-Tuning Framework for Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) excel at general speech understanding; however, adapting them to fine-grained tasks like Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) remains a significant bottleneck. Current Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods typically operate in flat Euclidean space, and this geometry fails to capture the multi-granularity nature of emotion cues, which range from low-level prosody to high-level semantics. To address this, we propose HyPASE, a hyperbolic PEFT framework for LALM-based SER. HyPASE leverages the Poincare ball model, using the hyperbolic radius as an explicit proxy for representational granularity. The framework consists of two core components: a Hyperbolic Geometric Adapter (HGA) for layer-adaptive weight modulation, and an Emotion-aware Multi-capacity Cross-modal Aggregator (EMCA) that compresses multi-scale features into compact audio prefixes. Empirical results on standard benchmarks show that HyPASE outperforms Euclidean PEFT baselines across all metrics on MELD and achieves a notable Unweighted Accuracy gain on IEMOCAP, particularly in class-imbalanced emotion recognition, with the accompanying slight Weighted Accuracy trade-off reflecting hyperbolic space's geometric prioritization of minority-class representations; furthermore, HyPASE achieves robust zero-shot cross-dataset generalization within a constrained parameter budget. By grounding the adaptation process in hyperbolic geometry, HyPASE offers a highly efficient path for LALM fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyPASE，一个基于双曲几何 (hyperbolic geometry) 的参数高效微调 (PEFT) 框架，用于大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 的语音情感识别 (SER)。它利用 Poincaré ball 模型，将双曲半径作为表示粒度 (representational granularity) 的显式代理，并包含 Hyperbolic Geometric Adapter (HGA) 与 Emotion-aware Multi-capacity Cross-modal Aggregator (EMCA) 两个核心组件。在 MELD 上全面优于欧几里得 PEFT 基线，在 IEMOCAP 上获得显著的 Unweighted Accuracy 提升，并能在受限参数预算下实现稳健的零样本跨数据集泛化。
Motivation: 现有 LALM 在通用语音理解上表现良好，但适应语音情感识别等细粒度任务仍是瓶颈；当前 PEFT 方法在平坦欧几里得空间中操作，难以捕捉从低级韵律到高级语义的多粒度情绪线索。
Method: 提出 HyPASE，采用 Poincaré ball 模型，用双曲半径显式建模表征粒度；框架包含 HGA 进行层自适应权重调制，以及 EMCA 将多尺度特征压缩为紧凑音频前缀。
Result: 标准基准上的实验显示，HyPASE 在 MELD 上所有指标均优于欧几里得 PEFT 基线；在 IEMOCAP 上获得显著的 Unweighted Accuracy 提升，尤其在类不平衡情感识别中，同时伴随轻微的 Weighted Accuracy 权衡；此外在受限参数预算下实现了稳健的零样本跨数据集泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将适应过程建立在双曲几何中，是 LALM 微调的一条高效路径，双曲空间对少数类表征的几何优先级解释了类不平衡场景下的收益与 WA 权衡。

papers.title: Poly-OPD: Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability-Selectable Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Leading open text-to-image models often carry complementary strengths: one may lead on preference-aligned aesthetics while another follows compositional instructions more faithfully. However, differences in their autoencoders and noise schedules make it difficult to transfer these strengths across models. In this paper, we present Poly-OPD, a framework that can consolidate complementary strengths of heterogeneous teachers into a single compact flow-matching student. To bridge the incompatible latent spaces of different teachers, Poly-OPD performs on-policy distillation through a pixel bridge. Each student-generated image is re-encoded by a selected teacher's encoder and refined from a noise level matched by magnitude under the teacher's noise schedule. The resulting target is further matched to the student in frozen DINOv2 space, enabling supervision across incompatible latent spaces. To retain complementary capabilities without cross-teacher interference, Poly-OPD uses a gradient compatibility diagnostic to organize its adapters: attention LoRA modules are shared across teachers, whereas feed-forward adapters remain teacher-specific. During distillation, a gap-aware curriculum devotes more training to compositional categories where the student still falls short of the teacher. As each gap narrows, training shifts toward categories with larger remaining gaps. By distilling FLUX.1-dev and Z-Image into a 2.5B SD3.5-Medium student, Poly-OPD improves GenEval from 67.3 to 73.3, surpassing both larger teachers, and raises DrawBench HPSv3 from 9.34 to 11.35, consolidating both strengths within a switchable model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Poly-OPD，一个面向异构多教师的知识蒸馏框架，用于将多个互补的文本到图像模型能力整合进单个紧凑的流匹配学生模型。通过像素桥在教师噪声调度下进行在线策略蒸馏，并在冻结 DINOv2 空间中匹配目标，以解决不同教师潜在空间和噪声调度的不兼容问题。实验中，将 FLUX.1-dev 和 Z-Image 蒸馏进 2.5B SD3.5-Medium 学生，GenEval 从 67.3 提升到 73.3，DrawBench HPSv3 从 9.34 提升到 11.35，均超过两个更大的教师模型。
Motivation: 领先的开源文本到图像模型各有互补优势，例如一个在偏好对齐的美学上领先，另一个在组合指令跟随上更忠实；但由于自动编码器和噪声调度不同，直接迁移这些能力很困难，且已有方法难以在单一模型中整合多个异构教师。
Method: Poly-OPD 使用像素桥执行在线策略蒸馏：学生生成的图像经所选教师编码器重编码，并在教师噪声调度下按幅度匹配的噪声级别细化；目标再在冻结的 DINOv2 空间中与学生匹配，从而跨越不兼容潜在空间进行监督。为保留互补能力并避免教师间干扰，方法使用梯度兼容性诊断来组织适配器——注意力 LoRA 模块共享，前馈适配器保持教师特定；同时采用差距感知课程，把更多训练分配到学生仍落后于教师的组合类别，并随差距缩小动态转移训练重心。
Result: 在将 FLUX.1-dev 和 Z-Image 蒸馏进 2.5B SD3.5-Medium 学生的实验中，GenEval 从 67.3 提升到 73.3，DrawBench HPSv3 从 9.34 提升到 11.35，学生超过两个更大的教师，并同时保留两种优势于一个可切换模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 Poly-OPD 能够在可切换的单一模型中整合异构教师的互补能力，绕过了潜在空间与噪声调度不兼容的障碍，为能力可选择的流模型蒸馏提供了一种可行方案。

papers.title: iStructTab: Structured Feature Sequencing for Multimodal Learning of Image and Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning of images and tabular data is often impaired by ineffective representations, resulting in redundancy, dispersion, and generalization problems. To tackle this challenge, we introduce Graph-Enhanced Descriptor Sequencing (GEDS), a structured feature sequencing algorithm grounded in principles from the Column Permutation Problem (CPP). GEDS refines statistical descriptors of the features through similarity graph-based computations, systematically determining an effective feature sequencing. We incorporate GEDS within an order-aware efficient transformer framework, utilizing order-aware memory tokens that explicitly adhere to the derived feature sequencing via a dedicated loss function. Experimental results across multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that iStructTab effectively minimizes feature dispersion, improving predictive performance and robustness, and highlighting the significance of structured feature sequencing in multimodal learning.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026) in Lyon, France Code: https://github.com/zadid6pretam/iStructTab PyPI: pip install istructtab
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iStructTab，面向图像与表格数据多模态学习的结构化特征排序方法。核心是 Graph-Enhanced Descriptor Sequencing (GEDS)，基于列排列问题 (Column Permutation Problem) 原理，通过相似度图计算优化统计描述子并确定特征顺序，再结合顺序感知的 Transformer 与显式遵循该顺序的 order-aware memory tokens 实现多模态融合。实验显示该方法能降低特征分散度，提升预测性能与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 图像与表格数据的多模态学习常因表示不佳而产生特征冗余、分散和泛化问题，作者尝试通过结构化的特征排序来缓解这些缺陷。
Method: 提出 GEDS 特征排序算法，以列排列问题为理论依据，利用相似度图对特征的统计描述子进行精炼并系统决定有效排序；排序结果通过专门的损失函数约束 Transformer 中的 order-aware memory tokens，构成 iStructTab 框架。
Result: 在多个多模态基准上，iStructTab 有效减小特征分散度，并提升预测性能与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化特征排序在多模态学习中的重要性，但未给出具体数据集上的量化结果或局限说明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Looking in the Mirror: Introspecting Side-Effect Misalignments Induced by Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning enables a source model to acquire desired capabilities and behaviors in a target domain while retaining much of its general-purpose competence. However, this adaptation process can also degrade alignment properties that were present in the source model. Recent work has shown that large language models can be trained using LoRA-based modules known as introspection adapters (IAs) to describe behavioral changes induced by fine-tuning. However, existing studies primarily consider settings in which the model is fine-tuned on datasets explicitly designed to implant a specific behavior and is then asked to explain the implanted behavior. This differs from practical deployment scenarios, where the central concern is often side-effect misalignment: unintended degradation of alignment caused by fine-tuning on tasks that are not obviously related to safety or alignment. To bridge this gap, we formulate a novel problem setting called \emph{side-effect introspection}, in which the target of introspection is not a behavior explicitly implanted through fine-tuning, but rather alignment shifts that emerge as unintended side effects, and we construct a dataset for this setting. Furthermore, to enhance sensitivity to internal model changes, we propose the Delta-Aware Introspection Adapter (DAIA), a novel mechanism designed to explicitly process both base-model activations and activation differences induced by fine-tuning. Our empirical evaluation shows that introspection learning generalizes to unseen fine-tuned models and safety categories, and that DAIA consistently outperforms existing introspection adapters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究微调引发的对齐副作用（side-effect misalignment）：模型在无关安全的任务上微调后，对齐属性出现非刻意退化。作者将这种场景形式化为 side-effect introspection 问题，构建相应数据集，并提出 Delta-Aware Introspection Adapter (DAIA)，显式同时处理基座模型激活与微调引起的激活差异。实验显示内省学习可泛化到未见过的微调模型与安全类别，且 DAIA 一致优于现有 introspection adapter。
Motivation: 现有基于 introspection adapter (IA) 的研究都假设模型是在刻意植入特定行为的数据集上微调，再要求模型解释该植入行为；而实际部署中更关键的是微调在不明显涉及安全或对齐的任务上时引发的非预期对齐退化，现有设定无法覆盖这一场景。
Method: 作者提出 side-effect introspection 这一新问题设定，并构建对应数据集；同时提出 DAIA 机制，通过显式处理基座模型激活与微调前后激活差异（activation differences）来提高对模型内部变化的敏感度。
Result: 经验评估表明，内省学习能够泛化到未见过的微调模型与安全类别，且 DAIA 在性能上一致优于现有 introspection adapter。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将内省目标从显式植入行为扩展到副作用式对齐偏移是可行的，DAIA 提供了一种更敏感的建模方式；其适用范围与数据规模等限制在摘要中未展开说明。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为，将内省目标从显式植入行为扩展到副作用式对齐偏移是可行的，DAIA 提供了一种更敏感的建模方式；其适用范围与数据规模等限制在摘要中未展开说明。

papers.title: Equitable System-Prompt Selection via Constrained Mixed-Strategy GroupDRO
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used for information seeking, yet semantically equivalent questions phrased in different ways can receive answers of considerably different quality. System prompts are widely employed to steer response behavior, but they are typically optimized for average-case quality, so some question phrasings may still receive incomplete or low-quality answers. To address this, we formulate a constrained mixed-strategy GroupDRO framework for system-prompt selection. Instead of optimizing the system-prompt text, the framework assigns weights to system prompts in an existing pool to minimize the worst-case information-quality loss across evaluation metrics and groups, while constraining the mean loss to stay close to that of average-based selection. Because pool generation and selection are decoupled, the method applies to any system-prompt pool and can leverage an ensemble of complementary system prompts rather than a single one. Across five LLMs on two bilingual medical and consumer-finance benchmarks, the constrained method reduces the Overall Mean, Worst 25% Mean, and Worst by 13.1%, 13.2%, and 13.7% on average relative to no mitigation while keeping overall quality close to Average selection. Its multi-prompt weights reveal complementarity across metric-group pairs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Rainxu09/equitable-system-prompt-selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个有约束的混合策略 GroupDRO 框架，用于从既有系统提示词池中选择权重，以最小化不同问题表述和评测指标下的最差信息质量损失，同时约束平均损失接近平均化选择。在双语医学与消费金融基准上、跨五个 LLM 的实验中，该方法相对无缓解方案将 Overall Mean、Worst 25% Mean 和 Worst 分别平均降低 13.1%、13.2% 和 13.7%，并保持整体质量接近 Average 选择。代码与数据已公开。
Motivation: 大语言模型用于信息检索时，语义等价但措辞不同的问题可能得到质量差异很大的回答；系统提示词通常针对平均质量优化，导致部分问题表述仍得到不完整或低质量答案。
Method: 将系统提示词选择建模为带约束的混合策略 GroupDRO 问题：不修改提示词文本，而是为既有提示词池中的每个提示词分配权重，最小化跨评测指标和分组的 worst-case 信息质量损失，并约束平均损失接近基于平均质量的选择；池的生成与选择解耦，因此可适用于任意提示词池并用多个互补提示词集成。
Result: 在五个 LLM、两个双语医学与消费金融基准上，相对无缓解基线，Overall Mean、Worst 25% Mean 和 Worst 平均分别下降 13.1%、13.2% 和 13.7%，整体质量与 Average 选择接近；多提示词权重揭示出指标-分组对之间的互补性。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法因池生成与选择解耦而具有通用性，并可通过互补系统提示词的集成实现更公平的系统提示词选择。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: COMPAS: Difficulty-Aware Joint Search for Optimizing Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Code generation systems make each LLM call with a model, a prompt, and decoding settings. However, existing optimization methods usually tune only part of these choices or use one fixed configuration for all tasks: global optimizers search one configuration for all tasks, routers choose only a model, and prompt optimizers keep the model and decoding settings fixed. This leaves their joint, group-specific interactions unclear. We therefore examine how these choices interact and observe that prompts and decoding settings interact, tuning effects vary by model, and the best configuration varies by task difficulty. Guided by these observations, we introduce COMPAS (Code-generation Optimization over Models, Prompts, And Decoding Settings), a difficulty-aware method that learns group-specific quality-cost fronts through low-cost model selection and joint prompt-decoding search, then routes each test task to its matching front online without further search. Under a matched search budget on LiveCodeBench, COMPAS improves pass@1 from 45.9% for the best baseline to 52.8% while reducing cost from $36.57 to $4.92. This also transfers to repository-level code generation on SWE-bench, resolving 76.0% of tasks versus 70.0% for the best baseline. Code and the reproducibility artifact are available at https://github.com/gjz78910/COMPAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码生成系统中模型、提示词 (prompt) 与解码设置 (decoding settings) 三类 LLM 调用配置的联合优化问题。作者通过实验观察发现提示词与解码设置之间存在交互、调优效果因模型而异、最佳配置随任务难度变化，据此提出 COMPAS：一种难度感知 (difficulty-aware) 方法，先以低成本模型选择和联合提示-解码搜索学习按任务难度分组的质量-成本前沿 (quality-cost fronts)，再在测试时无需额外搜索地将每个任务路由到匹配的前沿。在 LiveCodeBench 上，COMPAS 将 pass@1 从最佳基线的 45.9% 提升到 52.8%，并将成本从 $36.57 降至 $4.92；在 SWE-bench 上解决了 76.0% 的任务，优于最佳基线的 70.0%。
Motivation: 现有代码生成优化方法通常只调整模型、提示词或解码设置中的一部分，或者对所有任务使用单一固定配置：全局优化器为所有任务搜索一种配置，路由器只选模型，提示词优化器保持模型和解码设置不变。这导致这些选择的联合、按任务分组 (group-specific) 的交互关系未被充分理解。
Method: 提出 COMPAS (Code-generation Optimization over Models, Prompts, And Decoding Settings)。该方法通过三方面的观察作为指导：提示词与解码设置相互作用、调优效果因模型而异、最佳配置随任务难度变化；然后以低成本模型选择加联合提示-解码搜索来学习按难度分组的质量-成本前沿，并在测试时在线将任务路由到匹配的前沿，无需再次搜索。
Result: 在匹配的搜索预算下，COMPAS 在 LiveCodeBench 上将 pass@1 从最佳基线的 45.9% 提升到 52.8%，并将成本从 $36.57 降低到 $4.92。该方法也能迁移到仓库级代码生成任务 SWE-bench，解决 76.0% 的任务，优于最佳基线的 70.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调对模型、提示词和解码设置进行联合、难度感知的优化可以同时提升代码生成质量并大幅降低成本，且该方法可迁移至仓库级代码生成场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ATLAS: Adaptive Topological Learning with Abstract Successors for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary model-free reinforcement learning algorithms can achieve very high performance, but have low sample efficiency and are not robust to changes in the environment. Model-based algorithms have much higher sample efficiency, but still fail when the environment shifts. This paper introduces Adaptive Topological Learning with Abstract Successors (ATLAS) to combat these challenges. ATLAS uses a Grow When Required network with Successor Features in order to achieve high sample efficiency while also robustly tackling catastrophic forgetting. We evaluate ATLAS in spatial navigation tasks, benchmarking its performance against common on-policy and off-policy algorithms. Our empirical results demonstrate that by structurally decoupling transition dynamics from the reward signal, ATLAS achieves near-instantaneous adaptation to new goals and can exhibit positive backward transfer, significantly outperforming baseline methods in non-stationary environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATLAS（Adaptive Topological Learning with Abstract Successors），一种结合 Grow When Required 网络与 Successor Features 的强化学习算法，旨在同时提升样本效率和对环境变化的鲁棒性。在空间导航任务中，ATLAS 通过结构上解耦转移动态与奖励信号，实现对新目标的近即时适应，并在非平稳环境中显著优于常见 on-policy 与 off-policy 基线，表现出正向后迁移 (positive backward transfer)。
Motivation: 无模型强化学习算法性能高但样本效率低且对环境变化不鲁棒，基于模型的算法样本效率更高但环境发生偏移时仍会失败，论文针对这一样本效率与鲁棒性难以兼顾的问题。
Method: ATLAS 使用 Grow When Required 网络结合 Successor Features，并从结构上将转移动态与奖励信号解耦，以高效学习环境拓扑并缓解灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在空间导航任务中，ATLAS 能够近即时地适应新目标，展现出正向后迁移，并在非平稳环境中显著超越常见的 on-policy 与 off-policy 基线算法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，结构上解耦转移动态与奖励信号是 ATLAS 在新目标适应和非平稳环境鲁棒性上取得优势的关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cost-Aware Multi-Objective Bandits: Theory and Application to Budgeted LLM Configuration Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) configuration evaluation is challenging due to limited evaluation budgets, varying costs, and multiple competing objectives. In this paper, we formulate LLM configuration evaluation as a cost-aware multi-objective bandit problem, where each configuration evaluation incurs a configuration-dependent cost and yields a noisy vector-valued outcome. Under this framework, we study two fundamental problems: online configuration selection and Pareto configuration identification. For online configuration selection, we propose a hypervolume-based UCB algorithm that optimizes an optimistic hypervolume-per-cost index. We establish a budgeted regret bound of order $O\bigl(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log B}{Δ_i}\bigr)$, where $B$ is the evaluation budget, $i^\star$ is the optimal configuration in terms of hypervolume efficiency, and $Δ_i$ is the corresponding efficiency gap of configuration $i$. This bound retains the logarithmic budget dependence of classical single-objective budgeted bandits. For fixed-budget Pareto identification, we develop a cost-aware empirical gap elimination algorithm and prove that its error probability is of order $O\bigl(\exp(-\frac{B}{H_{μ,c}})\bigr)$, where $H_{μ,c}$ is a cost-aware Pareto identification complexity depending on configuration costs and Pareto classification gaps. This error probability decays exponentially with the evaluation budget and recovers the standard Pareto set identification guarantee when all configuration costs are identical. Experiments on LLM configuration evaluation tasks demonstrate that the proposed framework enables efficient online decision-making and accurate cost-aware Pareto identification under limited budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将大语言模型（LLM）配置评估建模为成本感知多目标bandit问题，其中每次评估产生与配置相关的成本并返回带噪声的向量化结果。作者针对在线配置选择提出基于超体积（hypervolume）的UCB算法，针对固定预算Pareto识别提出成本感知的经验间隙消除算法，并在理论上给出预算遗憾界和指数衰减的误差概率界。实验在LLM配置评估任务上验证了框架在有限预算下的有效性和准确识别能力。
Motivation: LLM配置评估面临评估预算有限、各配置成本不同以及多个目标相互竞争的现实困难，现有方法难以同时处理成本与多目标权衡。
Method: 提出成本感知多目标bandit框架：在线选择采用超体积UCB算法，优化一个乐观的超体积-成本指标；Pareto识别采用成本感知的经验间隙消除算法。
Result: 在线选择得到阶为O(∑_{i≠i*} log B / Δ_i)的预算遗憾界，保留经典单目标预算bandit的对数预算依赖性；固定预算Pareto识别的误差概率阶为O(exp(-B/H_{μ,c}))，随预算指数衰减，且当各配置成本相同时退化为标准Pareto集合识别保证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在有限预算下实现高效的在线决策和准确的成本感知Pareto识别，实验支持其在实际LLM配置评估中的有效性。

papers.title: Right Reset: Chunking by Prefix Removal
papers.abstract_en: Removing the left context from a causal language model reveals a useful kind of boundary: an edge where the model processes the same right-hand tokens with little change. We turn this observation into prefix-removal probing and introduce Right Reset (RR), which measures preservation of the right-hand hidden-state trajectory. A dynamic program converts RR edge scores into variable-length chunks. On flattened text formed by concatenating topically similar records after deleting their separators and layout, RR recovers 47.7% of the original records as clean units, versus 25.9% for a BGE embedding boundary, the strongest tested conventional baseline without task-specific model training. The gain persists after rendering and OCR. Passive scores from the same Qwen3-4B layer and direct prompting of a same-scale instruction model perform substantially worse on flattened records. Across six language models, RR-selected cuts also undergo consistently less local output disruption than unselected candidate edges. An observed-token likelihood-ratio readout is competitive in some architectures, indicating that the central contribution is the intervention: context dependence itself can provide a boundary signal when surface structure is weak.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, data, and reproduction materials: https://github.com/ZECTBynmo/right-reset-paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Right Reset (RR)，一种基于前缀移除 (prefix removal) 的探测方法，通过测量因果语言模型处理相同右侧 token 时隐藏状态轨迹的保持程度来识别文本边界，并用动态规划把边分数转换成可变长度分块。在由主题相似记录拼接成的扁平文本上，RR 恢复 47.7% 的原始记录为干净单元，明显高于最强的常规基线 BGE embedding boundary（25.9%），且该优势在渲染和 OCR 后依然存在。跨六个语言模型，RR 选中的切分点比未选中的候选边产生更少的局部输出扰动。
Motivation: 在分隔符和布局被删除的扁平文本中，表面结构很弱，常规的基于嵌入或提示的边界检测效果有限；论文试图利用因果语言模型对左上下文移除的响应本身作为边界信号，而不依赖任务特定的模型训练。
Method: 删除左上下文并比较模型处理相同右侧 token 时的隐藏状态轨迹，得到 RR 边分数；随后用动态规划 (dynamic programming) 将边分数转换为可变长度块。论文还对比了被动分数、同规模指令模型的直接提示，以及基于观测 token 的似然比 (likelihood-ratio) 读出方式。
Result: 摘要报告 RR 在扁平记录上恢复 47.7% 的原始记录为干净单元，而最强的常规基线 BGE embedding boundary 为 25.9%；渲染和 OCR 后该优势仍然保持。跨六个语言模型，RR 选中的切分点比未选中的候选边产生更小的局部输出扰动；似然比读出在某些架构上具有竞争力，被动分数和直接提示的表现则显著更差。
Conclusion: 作者认为核心贡献在于干预本身：当表面结构较弱时，上下文依赖本身可以提供边界信号；被动分数和同规模指令模型的直接提示都不如该干预有效。

papers.title: An Analysis and Implementation of Seam Carving for Content-Aware Image Resizing
papers.abstract_en: Seam carving is a classical content-aware image resizing operator that modifies the width or height of an image by repeatedly removing (or inserting) seams, i.e., 8-connected monotonic paths of pixels of locally minimal importance. Because seams bend around salient content rather than uniformly scaling or cropping it, the operator preserves vital image structures while discarding (or duplicating) low-energy regions. This article describes a C++ implementation of the operator that follows the original formulation of Avidan and Shamir (2007), including the optional forward-energy criterion subsequently introduced by Rubinstein, Shamir and Avidan (2008). The implementation supports image reduction, image enlargement via ordered seam insertion, multi-pass enlargement for large scale factors, a user-supplied weight mask for object protection and removal, along with dumping of energy maps and visualisation of seams. We detail the algorithm, its parameters and its computational complexity, discuss design choices with respect to the original descriptions, and illustrate the behaviour of the operator on natural images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个遵循 Avidan 和 Shamir (2007) 原始公式的 C++ 实现，用于内容感知图像缩放（seam carving），并包含 Rubinstein、Shamir 和 Avidan (2008) 提出的可选前向能量准则。实现支持图像缩小、通过有序接缝插入的放大、多遍放大、用户提供的权重掩膜以进行对象保护与移除，以及能量图导出和接缝可视化。作者详细说明算法、参数和计算复杂度，并讨论与原始描述相关的设计选择，在自然图像上展示操作行为。
Motivation: 经典的接缝裁剪算子虽然广泛应用，但其原始描述中仍存在实现细节上的选择空间；本文旨在给出一个忠实于原始公式、可直接复现的完整实现，并澄清这些设计取舍。
Method: 采用 C++ 实现 seam carving 算子，核心是以动态规划寻找并反复移除（或插入）8 连通、单调且局部重要性最小的接缝；同时集成前向能量准则、有序接缝插入放大、面向大尺度因子的多遍放大，以及用户权重掩膜机制，并支持能量图与接缝的可视化输出。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标，仅在自然图像上演示了算子的行为，并给出算法及其计算复杂度的描述性分析。
Conclusion: 该工作提供一个接近原始公式的参考实现，并通过讨论设计选择帮助使用者理解 seam carving 在不同设置下的表现，可支撑对象保护与移除等实际应用。

papers.title: Real-time probabilistic tsunami forecasting via generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Explicit onshore tsunami inundation forecasting can improve public risk awareness, but deterministically predicted inundation boundaries under highly uncertain conditions, such as near-field tsunamis generated by megathrust earthquakes, may falsely imply safety outside the boundaries. Consequently, current warnings primarily target coastal tsunami height, not onshore inundation. Although machine learning enables instant inundation predictions, they remain deterministic, lacking uncertainty quantification. Here, we develop a probabilistic ensemble model based on a conditional diffusion model (a type of generative AI) that reconciles accuracy with calibration. Validated with the 2011 Tohoku-oki earthquake data, our model faithfully tracks the postearthquake uncertainty decreasing over time while accurately predicting inundation depth and extent. Our framework shows that generative AI can shift tsunami forecasting from determinism to probabilism, providing a foundation for next-generation early warning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于条件扩散模型（conditional diffusion model）的概率集成模型，用于显式预报近海海啸的陆上淹没，并量化预报不确定性。使用2011年东北地方太平洋近海地震（Tohoku-oki）数据验证，模型能随地震后时间的推移忠实跟踪不确定性的下降，同时准确预测淹没深度与范围。作者认为生成式AI可将海啸预报从确定性转向概率性，为下一代早期预警奠定基础。
Motivation: 当前确定性海啸淹没边界预测在近场巨型逆冲地震等高度不确定条件下可能传递虚假的安全感，而现有机器学习即时预测也缺乏不确定性量化，因此需要兼具精度与校准性的概率预报框架。
Method: 构建基于条件扩散模型（生成式AI的一种）的概率集成模型，将精确预测与概率校准相结合，对陆上淹没深度和范围进行显式概率预报，并随时间演化更新不确定性。
Result: 以2011年东北地方太平洋近海地震数据为验证，模型在准确预测淹没深度和范围的同时，能够刻画地震后随时间递减的预报不确定性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架展示了生成式AI可将海啸预报从确定性范式推向概率性范式，为下一代早期预警系统提供基础。

papers.title: Efficient Online Lexicographic Generalized Low-Rank Matrix Bandits
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies generalized low-rank matrix bandits with multiple prioritized objectives. At each round, the learner selects a matrix-valued arm and observes a vector-valued reward, whose components correspond to multiple objectives with different priority levels. Each objective is governed by an objective-specific generalized low-rank matrix model, and the learner evaluates arms according to a lexicographic preference order, prioritizing higher-level objectives before lower-level ones. We propose \textsc{Lexi-LowGLM}, an efficient online algorithm that first estimates objective-specific low-rank subspaces and then performs lexicographic learning in the reduced feature spaces. Unlike existing single-objective algorithms that repeatedly solve a batch generalized linear estimator using all historical observations, \textsc{Lexi-LowGLM} updates each objective-specific estimator via an online Newton step, reducing the estimator-update complexity over $T$ rounds from $O(T^2)$ to $O(T)$. We establish a regret bound of $\widetilde O\left(W_i^{\rm lex}\sqrt{m}\,(d_1+d_2)r\sqrt{T}\right)$ for each objective $i\in[m]$, where $r$ is an upper bound on the ranks of the objective-specific parameter matrices and $W_i^{\rm lex}$ characterizes the lexicographic trade-off effect. This bound depends on the effective low-rank dimension $(d_1+d_2)r$ rather than the ambient dimension $d_1d_2$. Numerical experiments further validate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有多个优先级目标的一般化低秩矩阵老虎机 (generalized low-rank matrix bandits) 问题，提出在线算法 Lexi-LowGLM。该算法先估计每个目标对应的低秩子空间，再在降维后的特征空间中进行字典序学习，并用在线牛顿步更新估计器，将 T 轮内的估计器更新复杂度从 O(T^2) 降到 O(T)。每个目标 i 的遗憾界为 ~O(W_i^lex sqrt(m)(d1+d2)r sqrt(T))，只依赖有效低秩维度而非环境维度。
Motivation: 现有低秩矩阵老虎机研究大多只考虑单一目标，而实际应用中常存在多个优先级不同的目标，并要求按字典序偏好 (lexicographic preference) 进行决策；同时已有单目标算法反复求解批处理广义线性估计器，计算开销随轮次增加。
Method: 提出 Lexi-LowGLM：先针对每个目标估计其专属的一般化低秩矩阵模型的低秩子空间，再在约简特征空间中按字典序偏好学习；每个目标的估计器通过在线牛顿步更新，避免反复使用全部历史数据求解批处理估计器。
Result: 摘要给出每个目标 i 的遗憾界 ~O(W_i^lex sqrt(m)(d1+d2)r sqrt(T))，其中 r 为目标参数矩阵秩的上界，W_i^lex 刻画字典序权衡效应；该界依赖有效低秩维度 (d1+d2)r 而非环境维度 d1d2，且估计器更新复杂度从 O(T^2) 降为 O(T)。数值实验验证了有效性和计算效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用目标特定的低秩结构结合在线牛顿步更新，可以在多优先级目标的低秩矩阵老虎机问题中同时获得更低的计算复杂度和依赖低秩维度的遗憾界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trident，一个基于智能体 LLM 的红队（red teaming）框架，用于攻击深度强化学习（DRL）驱动的自主网络防御系统。框架包含三个部分：覆盖 CybORG CAGE 4 和 CyberWheel 的动态隔离沙箱基准、包含超过 13,000 条高保真红蓝交互轨迹的 RLVR 数据集，以及将红队智能体训练重构为上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）的 "Code-as-Policy" RLVR 架构。实验表明，仅使用一个可训练的 7B Planner，Trident 相比静态红队基线平均将蓝队防御性能降低 522%，并自主发现诱饵规避和自适应状态优先级排序等涌现行为。
Motivation: 现有 DRL 网络防御系统几乎只面对静态、启发式红队进行评估，其对抗自适应威胁的鲁棒性严重缺乏研究。同时，带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽已提升 LLM 推理能力，但由于缺少合适的基准环境和交互数据集，尚未有效应用于网络安全。
Method: Trident 由三部分组成：包含 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 隔离沙箱服务器的动态基准；由超过 13,000 条红蓝交互轨迹构成、面向 RLVR 的数据集；以及 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 三段式 "Code-as-Policy" 智能体架构，其中可训练的 Planner 从压缩执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的 Coder 将这些策略转化为可执行的 Python 代码并部署攻击实时 DRL 防御者。
Result: 摘要报告，仅使用一个可训练的 7B Planner，Trident 相比静态红队基线平均将蓝队防御性能降低 522%，并自主发现诱饵规避、自适应状态优先级排序等静态启发式完全无法揭示的涌现行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有 DRL 网络防御存在根本性脆弱性，并指出 Trident 所构建的基准与数据集可为 RLVR 在网络安全领域的应用提供基础。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: Trident 由三部分组成：包含 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 隔离沙箱服务器的动态基准；由超过 13,000 条红蓝交互轨迹构成、面向 RLVR 的数据集；以及 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 三段式 "Code-as-Policy" 智能体架构，其中可训练的 Planner 从压缩执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的 Coder 将这些策略转化为可执行的 Python 代码并部署攻击实时 DRL 防御者。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告，仅使用一个可训练的 7B Planner，Trident 相比静态红队基线平均将蓝队防御性能降低 522%，并自主发现诱饵规避、自适应状态优先级排序等静态启发式完全无法揭示的涌现行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为现有 DRL 网络防御存在根本性脆弱性，并指出 Trident 所构建的基准与数据集可为 RLVR 在网络安全领域的应用提供基础。

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks for Good: A Survey of Proactive Protection across the Visual Content Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Once visual content enters an AI pipeline, its owner often retains little technical control over how it is used. Legal and regulatory remedies can address misuse, but many technical interventions must be applied earlier, when content is released or accessed. This survey examines the protective paradigm that has grown around this intervention point, which we call \emph{adversarial attacks for good}. Perturbations and structured signals long studied as attacks on learned models are instead applied by data owners, creators, platforms, or auditors to disrupt unauthorized automation or support later accountability. Five research communities have arrived at this inversion largely independently, each addressing a different stage of a visual asset's lifecycle: privacy filters against unwanted recognition at sharing time, unlearnable examples against unauthorized training, generative safeguards against malicious editing or imitation, adversarial CAPTCHAs for access control against automated agents, and provenance mechanisms for post-circulation attribution. Although developed in separate venues with incompatible success criteria, many of these methods exploit persistent gaps between human perception, semantic interpretation, and machine inference, suggesting that the paradigm remains relevant as visual pipelines evolve toward multimodal models and autonomous agents. To make their claims comparable, we evaluate all five families along shared axes of transferability, adaptability, and deployment readiness. Across the lifecycle, we find that most protections are still validated mainly against static or weakly adaptive adversaries, while evidence beyond controlled benchmarks remains scarce. We close by consolidating cross-stage countermeasures and open problems for robust, composable, and deployable owner-side protection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，将“对抗攻击用于善意目的”这一保护视觉内容所有者控制权的范式作为研究对象，系统梳理了五个独立发展的研究社区及其对应的视觉资产生命周期阶段：分享时的隐私过滤、阻止未授权训练的不可学习样本、针对恶意编辑或模仿的生成式防护、面向自动化代理的对抗CAPTCHA，以及发布后的溯源机制。作者沿迁移性、适应性和部署就绪性三个共享轴对这五类方法进行比较，发现多数防护仍主要针对静态或弱自适应攻击者验证，受控基准之外的证据稀缺。
Motivation: 视觉内容一旦进入AI流水线，所有者对其后续使用几乎失去技术控制，而法律和监管补救往往滞后，因此许多技术干预必须在内容发布或访问时提前进行。该综述旨在把五个彼此独立、成功标准不一致的研究社区统一到“对抗攻击用于善意”的保护范式下，使它们的主张可以比较。
Method: 采用调查与统一评估框架：将五类防护家族按视觉资产生命周期阶段的干预点组织起来，并沿transferability、adaptability和deployment readiness三个共享轴进行评估，最后汇总跨阶段的对抗措施与开放问题。
Result: 调查发现，大多数保护方法目前主要针对静态或弱自适应（weakly adaptive）的对抗者进行验证，受控基准之外的部署证据仍然稀缺；同时，许多方法利用了人类感知、语义解释与机器推理之间的持久差距，这一差距被认为在流水线演进中仍然存在。
Conclusion: 作者认为该范式在视觉流水线向多模态模型和自主智能体演进时依然相关，但需要更鲁棒、可组合且可部署的所有者侧保护，并为此整理了跨阶段反制措施与开放问题。
Relevance: 2
