papers.title: Achieving First-Order Statistical Improvements in Data-Driven Optimization: From No-Free-Lunch to Amplified Decision Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Recent proliferation of data-optimization integration has led to a range of methods that aim to improve the statistical performance of data-driven optimization decisions. However, while many of these methods are motivated intuitively from a robustness or regularization perspective, their resulting statistical benefits are often unclear and, even if available, are established on a case-by-case basis. We provide a systematic dissection of data-driven optimization formulations using the view of "directionally perturbed" empirical optimization (EO). Specifically, this umbrella of formulations, which we call "EO+", covers many existing data-driven optimization methods, including regularization, distributionally robust optimization, transfer learning, and analogous methods for contextual optimization. On the one hand, we argue that without additional, correctly specified, side information, any EO+ method can result in at most second-order improvements. This provides a negative conclusion, namely ``no free lunch is possible", on the statistical power of EO+. On the other hand, we show that when leveraging side information that is geometrically effective, achieving first-order improvements is possible by choosing hyperparameters that are significantly larger than what is typically suggested in the literature. Moreover, we construct a principled methodology based on excess risk estimation, via either system knowledge or bootstrap resampling, to maximize the first-order gain. We demonstrate how this gain connects to the control-variate principle, a variance reduction technique in the Monte Carlo simulation literature, which helps explain why geometrically effective side information is necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统剖析数据驱动优化（data-driven optimization）中的统计改进问题，提出一个统一的视角——方向扰动经验优化（directionally perturbed empirical optimization, EO+），把正则化、分布鲁棒优化、迁移学习和上下文优化等方法纳入同一框架。作者证明：在没有额外且正确指定的边信息（side information）时，任何 EO+ 方法至多只能带来二阶改进，即"没有免费午餐"；而当利用几何上有效的边信息并把超参数选得比文献常规取值大得多时，可以实现一阶改进。文章进一步给出基于超额风险估计（excess risk estimation）的原则性方法来最大化一阶增益，并将该增益与蒙特卡洛模拟中的控制变量（control-variate）原则联系起来。
Motivation: 数据优化结合的诸多方法虽从鲁棒性或正则化角度提出，但其统计收益常常不清楚，且即使有收益也往往只能逐例分析。缺少一个统一的框架来回答这类方法到底能在多大程度上改进数据驱动决策的统计性能。
Method: 提出"EO+"这一统一框架，涵盖正则化、分布鲁棒优化（distributionally robust optimization）、迁移学习和上下文优化等方法。在理论上刻画无正确边信息时的一阶改进不可能性；在利用几何有效的边信息时，通过系统知识或自助重采样（bootstrap resampling）进行超额风险估计，并选择显著大于文献常规取值的超参数来最大化一阶增益。
Result: 摘要报告：没有额外且正确指定的边信息时，任何 EO+ 方法最多只能获得二阶改进；借助几何有效的边信息并放大超参数，可以实现一阶改进。该一阶增益与控制变量（control-variate）原则相连，解释了几何有效边信息为何必要。
Conclusion: 文章的要点是：数据驱动优化若要获得一阶统计改进，必须依赖几何有效的边信息，且超参数需要比通常建议的取值更大；文中给出的超额风险估计方法可用于最大化这一增益。结论限于 EO+ 这一表述框架，不涉及该框架之外的优化方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ArborEnum: Decision Tree Rashomon Sets over Continuous Features
papers.abstract_en: The Rashomon effect describes the phenomenon that many models can achieve nearly equivalent performance on the same learning task, with significant ramifications for robustness, feature importance, and customizability. These use cases motivate the computation of Rashomon sets: the set of all models whose regularized loss is near-optimal. Decision trees are one of the few model classes for which Rashomon sets can be fully enumerated, but this computation has always been conditional on a binarization of the original data, either restricting which splits each tree is allowed to make or substantially increasing the complexity of an already difficult combinatorial problem. We introduce the first algorithm that exactly enumerates decision-tree Rashomon sets while exploiting the ordered structure of continuous features. We further develop a relaxation for approximate enumeration and an anytime algorithm that progressively refines the set of candidate thresholds, producing increasingly detailed approximations that converge to the continuous-feature Rashomon set. Experiments show that coarse binarization can miss many trees, important features, and predictive multiplicity; our algorithms achieve orders-of-magnitude speedups over existing enumeration methods, with approximations providing further speedups while maintaining near-perfect recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArborEnum，声称是第一个在利用连续特征有序结构的同时、精确枚举决策树 Rashomon 集（即正则化损失接近最优的所有模型集合）的算法。除精确枚举外，还给出近似枚举的松弛版本，以及逐步细化候选阈值的 anytime 算法，使近似结果收敛到连续特征 Rashomon 集。实验表明，粗粒度二值化会遗漏大量树、重要特征与预测多重性（predictive multiplicity），而 ArborEnum 相比现有枚举方法可取得数量级加速。
Motivation: Rashomon 效应对鲁棒性、特征重要性和可定制性有重要影响，因此需要计算 Rashomon 集；决策树是少数可完全枚举 Rashomon 集的模型类，但此前计算都依赖对原始数据的二值化，要么限制允许的划分，要么显著增加本已困难的组合问题的复杂度。
Method: 提出 ArborEnum，通过利用连续特征的有序结构实现决策树 Rashomon 集的精确枚举；同时开发用于近似枚举的松弛（relaxation），以及一种 anytime 算法，它逐步细化候选阈值集合，产生越来越精细且收敛到连续特征 Rashomon 集的近似。
Result: 实验显示粗二值化会遗漏许多树、重要特征和预测多重性；ArborEnum 相对现有枚举方法实现数量级加速，近似版本在保持接近完美召回（near-perfect recall）的同时进一步加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ArborEnum 使得决策树 Rashomon 集的计算不再受限于预先二值化，并为大规模场景提供近似与 anytime 变体来权衡效率与覆盖度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MIDAS: Multi-LLM Iterative Data-Adaptive Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Text summarization is deceptively difficult. While condensing information seems straightforward, real-world enterprise summarization of support tickets, legal documents, incident reports, and more, demands strict adherence to domain-specific guidelines, output formats, and organizational conventions. Crafting prompts that reliably satisfy these constraints is labor-intensive, requiring significant human expertise and continuous maintenance as requirements evolve. Existing automated prompt optimization methods reduce this burden through Large Language Model (LLM) critique-driven refinement, yet remain limited by static prompts that cannot adapt to the diversity of summary applications. We propose Multi-LLM Iterative Data-Adaptive Summarization (MIDAS), a multi-LLM framework that extends this paradigm with data-driven pattern learning and use-case-specific personalization, enabling automatic adaptation to different summarization requirements without manual prompt engineering. Applied to enterprise customer ticket summarization across five output formats, MIDAS achieves the strongest overall performance against state-of-the-art critique-driven optimization frameworks such as CriSPO and ZERA, improving ROUGE-1 by up to 11.0%, ROUGE-2 by up to 18.2%, and ROUGE-L by up to 8.0%, while consistently improving BERTScore F1 across all formats and output types. We additionally demonstrate cross-model and cross-domain generalization through multi-LLM configurations and finance-domain summarization benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 20th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR 2026). 17 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIDAS（Multi-LLM Iterative Data-Adaptive Summarization），一个多 LLM 驱动的文本摘要框架，通过数据驱动的模式学习和用例级个性化，在无需人工提示工程的情况下自动适配不同的摘要需求。在五种输出格式的企业客户工单摘要任务上，MIDAS 相比 CriSPO 和 ZERA 等基于 critique 的优化框架取得整体最佳性能，ROUGE-1 最高提升 11.0%、ROUGE-2 最高提升 18.2%、ROUGE-L 最高提升 8.0%，并在所有格式和输出类型上持续提升 BERTScore F1。作者还通过多 LLM 配置和金融领域摘要基准展示了跨模型与跨领域的泛化能力。
Motivation: 真实企业场景中的工单、法律文档和事件报告等摘要任务要求严格遵循领域规范、输出格式和组织惯例，而人工编写并持续维护满足这些约束的提示词成本很高；现有基于 LLM critique 的自动提示优化方法受限于静态提示，难以适应多样的摘要应用。
Method: 提出 MIDAS，一个多 LLM 迭代式数据自适应摘要框架，在 critique 驱动的提示优化范式上引入数据驱动的模式学习和面向具体用例的个性化，使系统能够自动适配不同的摘要要求，避免人工提示工程。
Result: 在五种输出格式的企业客户工单摘要上，MIDAS 相对 CriSPO 和 ZERA 实现最强整体性能：ROUGE-1 最高提升 11.0%，ROUGE-2 最高提升 18.2%，ROUGE-L 最高提升 8.0%，并在所有格式和输出类型上一致提升 BERTScore F1；多 LLM 配置和金融领域摘要基准进一步验证了跨模型和跨领域泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MIDAS 能够在不进行手工提示工程的前提下，通过数据驱动的迭代优化自动适配不同摘要需求，并具有跨模型、跨领域的泛化能力。

papers.title: Adaptive Finite-Budget Training for CVaR Risk-Aware Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Risk-aware Q-learning (RaQL) provides a model-free, two-timescale estimator for dynamic risk objectives, but its finite-budget behavior remains fragile: fixed inner-loop hyperparameters can produce unstable value estimates, persistent Bellman residuals, and inefficient sample reuse. This paper proposes an adaptive training controller for Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) RaQL and evaluates it on a daily Bitcoin trading task. The controller preserves the original CVaR estimator and Bellman fixed point; instead, it redesigns the training procedure through six coordinated mechanisms: per-cell inner-step sizing, outer-rate-matched decay synchronization, a short early correction for the VaR-like inner variable, a coverage-first-then-greedy sample allocation rule, progressive suffix aggregation of mature inner estimates, and data-driven calibration of key scales from online-observable quantities. Across 20 random seeds and 856,000 inner-transition samples, the controller reduces the mean empirical CVaR Bellman residual by approximately 85% relative to the fixed-parameter baseline (MeanBEQ: 1.2202 to 0.1854; MeanBEV: 1.1624 to 0.0535) and maintains stability across CVaR levels, discount factors, and training budgets. On the chronological out-of-sample test set, the learned policy attains a Sharpe ratio of 0.9281 with a maximum drawdown of 6.46% after transaction costs. Although buy-and-hold yields a higher cumulative return (35.43% vs. 23.61%), the adaptive policy achieves far lower volatility (9.57% vs. 47.93%), drawdown, and CVaR loss. These results demonstrate that adaptive finite-budget training design, applied solely to the training procedure without altering the risk objective, can materially improve the reliability and risk-adjusted performance of risk-aware Q-learning in financial applications.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, submit to ACM International Conference on AI in Finance: ICAIF '26 Milan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对风险感知Q学习（Risk-aware Q-learning, RaQL）在有限训练预算下的不稳定性问题，提出一种自适应训练控制器，专门用于CVaR风险目标。控制器不改动原始CVaR估计器和Bellman不动点，而是通过六种协调机制重新设计训练过程。在日频比特币交易任务上，该控制器将经验CVaR Bellman残差相对固定参数基线降低约85%，并在样本外测试集上取得Sharpe 0.9281、最大回撤6.46%的结果。
Motivation: RaQL的双时间尺度估计器在有限预算下行为脆弱：固定内循环超参数会导致值估计不稳定、Bellman残差持续存在以及样本复用低效。
Method: 提出自适应训练控制器，包含六个协调机制：逐单元内步长调整、与外层速率匹配的衰减同步、针对VaR-like内变量的早期短修正、先覆盖后贪婪的样本分配规则、成熟内层估计的渐进后缀聚合，以及从在线可观测量进行关键尺度的数据驱动标定。
Result: 在20个随机种子和856,000个内转换样本上，控制器将平均经验CVaR Bellman残差从基线MeanBEQ 1.2202降至0.1854、MeanBEV从1.1624降至0.0535（约85%下降），并在不同CVaR水平、折扣因子和训练预算下保持稳定。样本外测试中策略Sharpe比为0.9281，扣除交易成本后最大回撤6.46%；相比买入持有，累计收益较低（23.61% vs 35.43%），但波动率（9.57% vs 47.93%）、回撤和CVaR损失显著更低。
Conclusion: 仅改动训练过程而不改变风险目标，就能实质性地提升风险感知Q学习在金融应用中的可靠性与风险调整后表现。

papers.title: CLIP-CC-Bench: Evaluating Paragraph-Level Video Descriptions in Video-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking video-language models has largely focused on short clips and single-sentence metrics, leaving open whether current systems can generate accurate long-form, paragraph-level descriptions. We introduce CLIP-CC-Bench, an evaluation suite for long-form video description built from 5 hours of movie content segmented into 90-second clips, each paired with an expert-written paragraph-style reference. The evaluation suite employs an ensemble of five state-of-the-art LLM-based embedding models to increase reliability and mitigate single-model bias, and applies two complementary methodologies: (i) coarse-grained semantic matching and (ii) fine-grained semantic matching to compare model-generated descriptions against CLIP-CC-Bench references. Using this framework, we evaluate 17 state-of-the-art video-language models and report both their Borda-aggregated rankings and their average scores on CLIP-CC-Bench. We further quantify the protocol's internal reliability through inter-judge agreement and bootstrap ranking stability. We release standardized evaluation scripts, model outputs, and aggregation tools at https://github.com/Multimodal-Intelligence-Lab/CLIP-CC-Bench to support reproducibility. CLIP-CC-Bench provides a practical evaluation framework for long-form video description, filling a gap left by existing short-clip and QA-only benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at EvalMG 2026, the Second Workshop on Evaluation for Multimodal Generation, co-located with ACM SIGIR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP-CC-Bench，一个面向长视频描述生成的评测基准，基于 5 小时电影内容切分为 90 秒片段，并为每段配专家撰写的段落级参考描述。评测采用五个 SOTA LLM 嵌入模型的集成以减少单模型偏差，并通过粗粒度与细粒度两种语义匹配方法对比模型输出。作者用该框架评测了 17 个视频语言模型，报告其 Borda 聚合排名与平均分数，并量化了协议内部可靠性。
Motivation: 现有视频语言模型评测多集中在短视频片段和单句级指标上，缺少对长段落级视频描述生成能力的系统评估。
Method: 构建 CLIP-CC-Bench 数据集，使用五个 LLM 嵌入模型集成提升评测可靠性，并采用粗粒度语义匹配与细粒度语义匹配两种互补方法；同时用 Borda 聚合排名、评判者间一致性和 bootstrap 排名稳定性量化协议可靠性。
Result: 在 CLIP-CC-Bench 上评测了 17 个视频语言模型，报告了 Borda 聚合排名与平均得分，并验证了评测协议的内部可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CLIP-CC-Bench 填补了现有短片段和仅问答型基准的空白，为长段落视频描述提供实用评测框架，并发布了标准化评测脚本、模型输出与聚合工具以支持复现。

papers.title: Long-term Measurements: Towards a Longitudinal Understanding of Human-AI Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Language models have taken on the role of a very new type of technology, by virtue of their "human-ness" and rapid integration into users' daily lives. This combination of features can introduce longitudinal risks---cognitive, developmental and socio-affective changes in humans---that might not surface during a short-term interaction, but can have lasting long-term effects on users. This forms the basis of a critical new mission for NLP: to pivot from static, short-term evaluations of text generations to long-term measurements of behavioral changes, towards a diachronic understanding of human-model interactions. In this work, we draw from measurements used in social science fields that are crucial to understand emergent phenomena in longitudinal data. We discuss how computational methods in the field of NLP need to be combined with such measurements, not only to understand long-term safety risks of human-model interactions, but to help steer model development towards positive rather than negative outcomes for users. This ability to model human behavioral shifts as a function of model interactions can facilitate online rather than post-hoc detection of problematic behaviors, and should be leveraged in alignment frameworks to mitigate long-term risks in users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场性/议程性论文，主张 NLP 研究应从静态、短期的文本生成评估，转向对人类行为变化的长期测量，以建立对人与模型交互的历时性 (diachronic) 理解。作者借鉴社会科学中用于分析纵向数据 (longitudinal data) 的测量方法，讨论其如何与 NLP 计算方法结合，以识别长期安全风险并引导模型朝积极方向发展。摘要未报告实证实验结果。
Motivation: 语言模型兼具“类人性”并快速融入用户日常生活，可能引入认知、发育和社会情感层面的纵向风险 (longitudinal risks)；这类风险在短期交互中不会显现，却会对用户产生持久影响，而现有静态短期评估无法捕获这些变化。
Method: 借鉴社会科学中用于理解纵向数据中涌现现象的测量方法，提出将 NLP 计算方法与这些测量相结合；核心设想是对人类行为偏移 (behavioral shifts) 随模型交互的变化进行建模，从而支持在线 (online) 而非事后 (post-hoc) 的问题行为检测，并将该能力纳入对齐 (alignment) 框架。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验、数据集或数值结果；本文以研究议程和概念框架为主，强调通过长期行为测量弥补短期评估的不足。
Conclusion: 作者主张将长期测量融入对齐框架以缓解用户端的长期风险，并借此将模型开发引向积极结果；内容属于展望性论述，尚无实证验证。

papers.title: GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience
papers.abstract_en: A wearable assistant should both answer questions about its visual history and recognize when that history is useful to the present situation. Existing video-memory systems primarily support question-conditioned recall, whereas proactive assistants typically use separate memory and control mechanisms. We introduce GROVE, a training-free framework that supports both behaviors with one memory grown causally from a continuous video stream. GROVE retains fine-grained perceptual evidence and incrementally consolidates it into time-stamped moments, coherent episodes, and recurring cross-day patterns. Each stratum is paired with a scale-native retrieval skill for locating an observation, replaying an activity, or traversing long-range regularities. Reactive QA and proactive assistance share this memory and access interface, differing in whether retrieval is initiated by a user query or the current situation. Across multiple benchmarks including the challenging MM-lifelong and EgoServe, GROVE achieves the best results among the compared methods. Controlled ablations show that the temporal strata and their access skills are complementary, with patterns providing the largest benefit when evidence spans multiple days. Code will be available at https://github.com/SitongGong/GROVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GROVE 是一个无需训练的框架，从连续视频流中因果式地构建时间分层记忆，同时支持反应式问答（reactive QA）和主动式辅助（proactive assistance）。记忆被增量整合为带时间戳的时刻、连贯的情节和跨天重复出现的模式，每一层都配有对应尺度的检索技能。在 MM-lifelong 和 EgoServe 等多个基准上，GROVE 取得了对比方法中的最佳结果。
Motivation: 现有视频记忆系统主要支持由问题触发的回忆，而主动式助手通常使用分离的记忆与控制机制；作者希望用单一记忆同时支持查询驱动的回忆和当前情境驱动的主动辅助。
Method: 提出训练无关（training-free）框架，从连续视频流中因果式生长记忆：保留细粒度感知证据，并增量整合为时间戳时刻、连贯情节和跨天重复模式；每个时间层配有一种尺度原生的检索技能，反应式问答与主动辅助共享同一记忆和访问接口，区别仅在于检索由用户查询还是当前情境触发。
Result: 在 MM-lifelong 与 EgoServe 等基准上与对比方法相比取得最佳结果；受控消融显示各时间层及其访问技能互补，其中跨天模式在证据跨越多天时带来最大收益。
Conclusion: 作者强调单一分层记忆和共享访问接口足以同时支撑反应式与主动式行为，且该方法无需训练；代码已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Mamba with Hierarchical Memory: Solving Representation Bottleneck in Long Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent linear attention models (RLAs) such as Mamba offer efficient linear-time sequence modeling as an alternative to Transformers, yet their fixed-capacity recurrent states limit long-sequence modeling. Drawing inspiration from hierarchical human memory, we propose Hierarchical Memory Mamba (HMM) to address this limitation. Building upon a pre-trained Mamba backbone, HMM integrates a lightweight working memory that extracts slow paragraph-level semantics (PLS) from the fast sensory memory embedded in the backbone's hidden states. The PLS is subsequently compressed into persistent long-term memory for task-relevant retrieval. The hierarchical processing of semantic information overcomes the representation bottleneck of RLAs and endows HMM cross-task generalization through parametric learning, which is not observed in other long-context enhanced Mamba variants. Evaluations on Passkey Retrieval and LongBench-E tasks demonstrate that HMM improves retrieval success by 34.3--37.1% and reasoning accuracy by 1.6--14.2% over strong Mamba-based models, while adding only 2% extra parameters and with minimal training overhead.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 受人类分层记忆启发，HMM 在预训练 Mamba 骨架上集成轻量工作记忆，从骨干隐藏状态中提取慢速的段落级语义（PLS），并将其压缩为持久的长期记忆用于任务相关检索，通过参数化学习实现跨任务泛化。
Result: 在 Passkey Retrieval 上检索成功率相比强 Mamba 基线提升 34.3–37.1%，在 LongBench-E 上推理准确率提升 1.6–14.2%，额外参数仅约 2% 且训练开销很小。
Conclusion: 分层语义信息处理可以克服 RLA 的表示瓶颈，并使模型具备其他长上下文增强 Mamba 变体未展现的跨任务泛化能力。

papers.title: PhyCheck: Fine-Grained Evidence-Grounded Dataset for Physical Law Understanding in Video-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence and world models require video understanding systems to go beyond recognizing objects and actions and develop an understanding of physical regularities. However, despite their strong performance on general video understanding tasks, current video-language models still struggle to reliably determine whether an observed event conforms to specific physical laws. Existing benchmarks primarily assess the physical quality of generated videos, providing limited support for systematically evaluating and improving the physical-law understanding of Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs). To address this gap, we introduce PhyCheck, a video question answering dataset organized at two complementary levels of granularity. The coarse-grained subset asks models to determine whether the phenomenon shown in a video conforms to or violates physical laws, while the fine-grained subset further examines whether models can capture physical details responsible for the violation or compliance. We use these subsets as structured supervision to improve physical understanding. In addition, the dataset contains a diagnostic subset with external causal context that reveal hidden factors affecting physical plausibility, assessing whether models can recalibrate their judgments accordingly. Experiments with Fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL show that training with the proposed data substantially improves the understanding of physical-consistency, while evaluations in the diagnostic subset reveal that current models still have difficulty incorporating additional causal conditions into their decisions. These findings highlight the gap between recognizing surface-level inconsistencies and understanding underlying physical mechanisms, and provide a foundation for evaluating and improving physical understanding in Video-LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyCheck，一个面向视频大语言模型 (Video-LLM) 的物理规律理解问答数据集，包含粗粒度（判断视频现象是否符合物理规律）、细粒度（指出违反或符合规律的具体物理细节）以及带外部因果上下文的诊断性子集。作者用该数据对 Qwen2.5-VL 进行微调，称其物理一致性理解能力显著提升，但诊断子集显示模型仍难以把额外因果条件纳入判断。
Motivation: 现有视频语言模型在通用视频理解上表现强，但难以可靠判断事件是否符合具体物理规律；已有基准主要评估生成视频的物理质量，缺少对 Video-LLM 物理规律理解进行系统评估和提升的数据。
Method: 构建 PhyCheck 数据集，按互补的两个粒度组织：粗粒度子集判断视频现象符合或违反物理规律，细粒度子集要求捕捉导致违反或符合的物理细节；另含带外部因果上下文的诊断子集，用于检验模型是否据此重新校准判断。将各子集作为结构化监督用于微调模型。
Result: 摘要报告用 PhyCheck 数据微调 Qwen2.5-VL 能大幅提升物理一致性理解；在诊断子集上的评估表明，现有模型仍难以将额外因果条件融入决策。
Conclusion: 作者指出该结果凸显了识别表面不一致性与理解底层物理机制之间的差距，PhyCheck 可作为评估和提升 Video-LLM 物理理解的基准。

papers.title: HiResNets: Native Full-HD Video Recognition with Foveal Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Much of the recent progress in image and video recognition has come at the cost of memory: larger models, increased resolution, and longer temporal contexts. An inevitable component is the quadratic (or larger) growth of memory and compute based on image resolution, which is a property of the grid sampling used in convolutional networks and vision transformers. In this work we study residual networks whose convolutional blocks have logarithmic-square growth instead, enabling them to process very high-resolution video quickly. The key insight is to use a residual architecture's residual stream as a high-resolution buffer, to which convolutional blocks only read and write via log-polar image warp operations. Layers adaptively focus on different parts of each frame, with very high resolution only near the focus point. A complete high-resolution representation is built up in the residual stream, analogous to eye saccades creating a complete picture in biological vision, and a theoretical construction is presented that eliminates the quadratic dependency of the residual stream resolution. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed HiResNets learn to foveate around scenes similarly to human vision, and have superior performance in difficult egocentric video recognition tasks, especially egocentric video with small objects and fine-grained recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiResNets，一种面向原生全高清视频识别的残差网络，其卷积块的内存和计算量随分辨率呈对数平方增长而非二次增长。核心思想是利用残差网络的 residual stream 作为高分辨率缓冲，卷积块通过 log-polar 图像变换读写该缓冲，使各层自适应聚焦视频帧的不同区域；作者还给出了消除 residual stream 分辨率二次依赖的理论构造。实验表明 HiResNets 能学习到类似人类视觉的注视（foveate）行为，并在困难的 egocentric 视频识别任务上表现更好，尤其是小物体和细粒度识别场景。
Motivation: 图像和视频识别领域的进展往往以内存为代价，例如更大模型、更高分辨率与更长时序，而基于卷积网络和视觉 Transformer 的网格采样会导致内存和计算量随分辨率二次（甚至更高次）增长，成为处理高分辨率视频的瓶颈。
Method: 设计一种残差网络架构，将残差流用作高分辨率缓冲，卷积块通过 log-polar 图像 warp 操作只读取和写入该缓冲中的局部区域；层可以自适应地聚焦每帧的不同部位，仅在焦点附近使用很高分辨率，并逐步在残差流中构建完整的高分辨率表示，类比生物视觉中的眼跳（saccades）机制。
Result: 实验显示 HiResNets 学会类似人类视觉的注视行为，并在困难的 egocentric 视频识别任务中取得更优性能，尤其是在含小物体和需要细粒度识别的第一人称视频上。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构可以消除残差流分辨率上的二次依赖，从而高效处理非常高的视频分辨率，并展示了与生物视觉相似的注意力行为；摘要未提及在通用基准上的横向比较或潜在局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instruction-Conditioned Exploration for Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation to an Unconditioned Policy
papers.abstract_en: Post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become an important tool for improving model capabilities, but the LLM action-space structure introduces challenges distinct from classical RL, with implications for inducing exploration. New methods are required that leverage the broad knowledge and flexibility of pre-trained LLMs to deliberately generate diverse experience at training time. We propose Instruction-Conditioned Exploration (ICE), which appends one of a small fixed set of instructions to task prompts during training, using the same set for every problem, increasing the coverage of behaviours attempted. To facilitate ICE, we combine RL on the instruction-conditioned policy with self-distillation of its correct rollouts into the unconditioned test-time policy. ICE with this objective improves Qwen3-1.7B held-out pass@1 performance at 4K response length on mathematical reasoning tasks by $5.0\%$ relative to training with DAPO, with improvement persisting at a longer 8K context. The improvement does not appear for Qwen3-4B at 4K, where the instructions do not expand base-model coverage.
papers.comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR) May 2026 cycle. OpenReview submission record at https://openreview.net/forum?id=PV945lekMa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM后训练RL中动作空间结构带来的探索难题，提出指令条件探索（Instruction-Conditioned Exploration, ICE）：在训练时给任务提示附加一个小型固定指令集，并将指令条件策略的正确rollouts自蒸馏到无条件的测试时策略。实验显示，在数学推理任务上，该方法相对DAPO训练将Qwen3-1.7B在4K响应长度下的hold-out pass@1提升5.0%，且8K下改善持续；但在Qwen3-4B上未见提升。
Motivation: LLM与经典RL环境不同，其动作空间结构使传统探索方法难以直接适用，需要利用预训练LLM的广泛知识在训练时主动生成多样化经验。
Method: 提出ICE：在训练时向每个任务提示附加一个来自小型固定集合的指令（同一集合用于所有问题），以扩大尝试行为的覆盖范围；同时将指令条件策略的RL训练与自我蒸馏相结合，把其中正确的rollouts蒸馏到无条件测试策略。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，与DAPO训练相比，该方法使Qwen3-1.7B在4K响应长度下的hold-out pass@1相对提升5.0%，并在更长的8K上下文下仍保持改善；但Qwen3-4B在4K下没有出现提升，因为指令没有扩展该基础模型的覆盖范围。
Conclusion: 摘要表明ICE能在特定模型规模上提升探索覆盖与下游性能，但其收益依赖于基础模型本身的覆盖情况，对已覆盖较好的较大模型可能无效。

papers.title: STEAM: A Spatio-TEmporal Alignment Mixture-of-Experts Model with Hierarchical Pre-training for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have been widely used in motor rehabilitation, disease diagnosis, and other neural engineering scenarios. However, conventional neural signal decoding algorithms often suffer from limited generalizability and high adaptation costs, motivating recent interest in BCI foundation models. Existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve general transferability, accurate decoding, and efficient downstream adaptation. We present STEAM, a hierarchical transfer framework that reconciles general-purpose representation learning with paradigm-specific specialization in EEG foundation models. The framework is instantiated as a dual-branch spatio-temporal encoder in which a shared soft mixture-of-experts (SSMoE) module aligns the spatial and temporal branches, allowing complementary representations to exchange information through a compact set of soft slots. Across seven downstream datasets and fourteen evaluation settings, STEAM attains the best average rank among the compared methods at a competitive inference cost measured in FLOPs. Building upon the Stage-I general initialization, the hierarchical pre-training strategy further specializes the model to a target paradigm without retraining from scratch, yielding consistent gains in paradigm-specific decoding accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEAM 是一个面向 EEG 解码的分层迁移框架，旨在统一 BCI 基础模型中的通用表示学习与范式特定专化。其核心是双分支时空编码器，通过共享软混合专家 (shared soft mixture-of-experts, SSMoE) 模块对齐空间与时间分支，并借助紧凑的软槽 (soft slots) 交换互补信息。摘要报告在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中取得最佳平均排名，且推理成本 (FLOPs) 具有竞争力。
Motivation: 传统神经信号解码算法泛化能力有限且适应成本高，而现有 BCI 基础模型难以同时实现通用迁移性、准确解码和高效下游适配。
Method: 提出 STEAM 分层迁移框架，采用双分支时空编码器，其中共享软混合专家 (SSMoE) 模块对齐空间与时间分支，使互补表示通过紧凑软槽交换信息；分层预训练策略在 Stage-I 通用初始化基础上进一步将模型专化到目标范式，而无需从头重训。
Result: 在七个下游数据集和十四个评估设置中，STEAM 获得对比方法中的最佳平均排名，推理成本 (FLOPs) 具有竞争力；基于 Stage-I 初始化的分层预训练在范式特定解码准确率上带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层迁移框架能够调和通用表示学习与范式特定专化，在不从头重训的情况下提升 EEG 解码性能。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调分层迁移框架能够调和通用表示学习与范式特定专化，在不从头重训的情况下提升 EEG 解码性能。

papers.title: CompanionBench: A Theory-Anchored, Real-World-Grounded Benchmark for AI Emotional Companionship
papers.abstract_en: LLM companions are deployed at scale in personally consequential settings, yet poorly evaluated. Existing benchmarks use hand-authored scenarios and prompted simulators, aggregate empathy into one score, and overlook judge biases such as same-family favoritism and scale drift. We introduce CompanionBench, an interactive bilingual benchmark. To our knowledge, it is the first companion benchmark to ground both its scenarios and a trained user simulator in de-identified real-world data. A hidden disclosure gate branches each persona's trajectory on the agent's own behavior, controlling the interaction state space without scripting dialogue. We operationalize ten capabilities derived from 25 theories across psychology and counseling, four of them not graded explicitly by prior work: holding ambiguity, selfobject responsiveness, positive resonance and calibrated challenge. Agents are assessed on two complementary axes: a subjective ten-capability rubric and a deterministic measure of whether deeper disclosure was earned. A cross-family panel dilutes same-family favoritism; an Item Response Theory model separates agent quality from judge severity. Theory fixes what to measure and how personas are structured; real data supply events, history, and profiles -- coverage from theory, authenticity from data. Rankings are reproducible in both languages (rho = 0.996 ZH / 0.953 EN). Evaluating 28 agents reveals capability-level differences obscured by aggregate scores. Emotion regulation and calibrated challenge remain common weaknesses; holding ambiguity discriminates most. Role-play agents rank near the bottom: immersion does not imply relational competence. Across agents, the dominant failure mode is substituting surface warmth for substantive relational support. We will release 500 Chinese-English parallel pairs and the evaluation code.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 19 tables, 13 appendices. Bilingual (Chinese/English) interactive benchmark; 28 evaluated agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompanionBench 是一个面向 LLM 情感陪伴能力的交互式中英双语基准，据作者称是首个将场景与训练好的用户模拟器都建立在脱敏真实世界数据上的陪伴基准。它通过隐藏的披露门控 (hidden disclosure gate) 依据智能体自身行为分支各人设轨迹，并用来自心理学与咨询领域 25 种理论的十个能力维度评估智能体，其中四个维度（holding ambiguity、selfobject responsiveness、positive resonance、calibrated challenge）是此前工作未明确打分的。评估 28 个智能体后，作者发现聚合分数掩盖了能力层面的差异，且排名在两种语言下均可复现。
Motivation: LLM 陪伴产品已在个人后果严重的场景中大规模部署，但现有评估用手写场景与提示模拟器，把共情聚合为单一分数，并忽视同族偏好和尺度漂移等评判偏差。作者认为需要更有理论依据且更真实的数据支撑的评测方法。
Method: 作者提出 CompanionBench，用真实数据提供事件、历史与用户画像，用理论决定测什么以及人设如何结构化；设计隐藏披露门控控制交互状态空间而不依赖脚本对话；用跨家族评审团稀释同族偏好，并用项目反应理论 (Item Response Theory) 模型把智能体质量与评审严格程度分离；同时采用主观的十能力评分表和判断是否赢得更深层自我披露的确定性度量两个互补维度。
Result: 28 个智能体的评估显示排名在中文 (rho=0.996) 与英文 (rho=0.953) 下可复现；情绪调节与 calibrated challenge 是普遍弱点，holding ambiguity 区分度最高；角色扮演类智能体排名接近垫底，说明沉浸感不等于关系能力；最主要的失败模式是用表面温情替代实质性的关系支持。作者将发布 500 对中英平行样本和评估代码。
Conclusion: 作者强调评测需要理论锚定与真实数据支撑的结合，并指出沉浸式角色扮演并不等同于关系能力，未来工作可基于发布的平行样本与代码进一步研究情感陪伴能力的细粒度评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on states visited by the student, reducing the distribution gap between training and inference. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student deviations may accumulate over time, gradually moving the trajectory away from states where teacher guidance remains effective. Our quantitative analysis further shows that high-disagreement states offer promising opportunities for teacher guidance, but determining whether such guidance is beneficial requires examining its effect on subsequent student trajectories. We propose FutureBridge-OPD (FTB), which executes a short teacher bridge at a high disagreement state and uses the resulting student continuation to assess whether the bridge increases the density of positive distillation signals relative to the teacher. On ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, under the main Qwen3-32B teacher to Qwen3-1.7B student setting, FTB outperforms vanilla OPD and TCOD by an average of 16.6 and 7.6 points, respectively, and remains effective across student scales and teacher settings. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ChenChiShui/FutureBridge-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FutureBridge-OPD (FTB)，一种针对多轮智能体任务中在线策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 的教师指导验证方法。作者观察到学生轨迹偏差会累积，使轨迹偏离教师指导仍然有效的状态；FTB 在高分歧状态下执行一段短教师桥接，并通过学生后续轨迹判断该桥接是否提升正向蒸馏信号密度。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上，以 Qwen3-32B 教师蒸馏 Qwen3-1.7B 学生，FTB 平均超过 vanilla OPD 16.6 点、超过 TCOD 7.6 点，且在不同学生规模和教师设置下保持有效。
Motivation: 多轮智能体任务中，学生偏差随时间累积会把轨迹推向教师指导不再有效的区域，而量化分析表明高分歧状态虽然蕴含指导机会，但需要考察指导对后续轨迹的影响才能判断其是否有益。
Method: 提出 FutureBridge-OPD (FTB)，在高分歧状态执行一段短暂的教师桥接，然后利用学生的后续轨迹来评估该桥接是否相对教师增加了正向蒸馏信号密度，以此决定是否采用该指导。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 基准上，使用 Qwen3-32B 教师到 Qwen3-1.7B 学生的主设置，FTB 比 vanilla OPD 平均提升 16.6 点，比 TCOD 平均提升 7.6 点，并在不同学生规模和教师设置下表现稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调验证教师指导时应向前看未来轨迹，而非仅看当前状态；FTB 通过这种前瞻性验证改善了多轮智能体蒸馏效果，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PICopilot: An LLM-based Agentic Framework for Assisting Photonic Integrated Circuit Design via Script Generation
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) is shifting the design flow from traditional graphical user interface (GUI)-based methods to script-based methods for higher flexibility, portability, and maintainability. However, script-based design introduces new challenges, requiring designers to possess additional proficiency in tool application programming interfaces (APIs) and programming. It also demands greater effort and time because it is inherently less intuitive and more complex than GUI-based methods. As PICs grow in scale and complexity, the productivity gap between design needs and manual scripting capabilities continues to widen. To address this gap, we introduce PICopilot, the first large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that assists in PIC design via automated design script generation from natural language instructions. PICopilot leverages a multi-agent architecture with a feedback mechanism and a specifically designed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline, achieving a high success rate and reliability. Experimental results on a benchmark of diverse PIC scripting tasks demonstrate that PICopilot successfully completes all 48 tasks and outperforms other LLM-based approaches without incurring substantial extra latency or cost, even solving 21 more tasks than the advanced GPT-5 model with a general RAG pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PICopilot，据称是首个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的智能体框架，用于通过自然语言指令自动生成光子集成电路 (PIC) 设计脚本。框架采用多智能体架构、反馈机制和专门设计的检索增强生成 (RAG) 管道。在包含 48 个任务的 PIC 脚本生成基准上，PICopilot 全部完成，且优于其他 LLM 方法，并比采用通用 RAG 管道的 GPT-5 多解决 21 个任务。
Motivation: PIC 设计正从 GUI 方式转向脚本方式，但脚本化设计要求设计师额外掌握工具 API 和编程技能，且比 GUI 更不直观、更复杂。随着 PIC 规模和复杂度增长，设计需求与手工脚本编写能力之间的生产力差距日益扩大。
Method: 提出 PICopilot，一个基于 LLM 的智能体框架，利用多智能体架构和反馈机制，并配有专门设计的检索增强生成 (RAG) 管道，从自然语言指令自动生成设计脚本。
Result: 在多样化的 PIC 脚本任务基准上，PICopilot 成功完成全部 48 个任务，胜过其他基于 LLM 的方法，比使用通用 RAG 管道的 GPT-5 多完成 21 个任务，且未引入显著的额外延迟或成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在 PIC 脚本生成任务上取得了高成功率和可靠性，说明 LLM 智能体方法可以缩小 PIC 设计中脚本化生产率差距。

papers.title: MemSIF: From Structured Interactions to Dual-Track Fact Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is critical for LLM agents operating over long-horizon interactions. However, several persistent limitations of existing memory systems can be traced to two recurring misalignment patterns in long-term interaction settings: Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) and Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM). TSM arises when temporal proximity does not reliably align with topical or event-level relatedness, whereas DUM arises when write-time salience does not reliably predict future query utility. To mitigate these misalignment patterns, we propose MemSIF (Memory with Structured Interactions and Facts), a structured interaction-to-fact memory framework. Structured Interaction Memory organizes raw interactions into Topical Segments that preserve local topical coherence and Event Trajectories that maintain cross-time event continuity. Dual-Track Fact Memory uses two complementary tracks: CoreFact memory consolidates stable, schema-guided information at write time, whereas ActiveFact memory forms facts on demand and promotes those supported by multiple historical sources and recurring query demand for reuse. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across five backbone LLMs show that MemSIF achieves the highest Total ACC in all settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.29%-8.79% on LoCoMo and 2.87%-6.15% on LongMemEval-S. These results support the effectiveness of combining Structured Interaction Memory with Dual-Track Fact Memory to mitigate TSM and DUM. Code is available at https://github.com/luoyufeihaha/MemSIF.
papers.comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027. 19 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemSIF，一个面向 LLM 智能体长期交互的结构化交互到事实记忆框架，用于缓解长期记忆系统中出现的 Temporal-Structural Misalignment (TSM) 与 Delayed Utility Manifestation (DUM) 两类不对齐问题。MemSIF 将原始交互组织为 Topical Segments 和 Event Trajectories，并通过 CoreFact 与 ActiveFact 双轨事实记忆分别处理稳定信息与按需形成的事实。在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上基于五个 backbone LLM 的实验显示，MemSIF 在所有设置中取得最高 Total ACC。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统在长时程交互场景中持续存在两类缺陷：时间邻近性不能可靠对应主题或事件相关性（TSM），以及写入时的显著性不能可靠预测未来查询效用（DUM），这限制了 LLM 智能体的长期记忆能力。
Method: 提出 MemSIF 框架：Structured Interaction Memory 将原始交互组织为保持局部主题连贯性的 Topical Segments 与维持跨时间事件连续性的 Event Trajectories；Dual-Track Fact Memory 通过 CoreFact 在写入时整合稳定的 schema 引导信息，ActiveFact 按需形成事实并依据多源历史支持与重复查询需求提升重用。
Result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 两个基准上跨越五个 backbone LLM 的实验中，MemSIF 在所有设置中均取得最高 Total ACC，相对最强基线在 LoCoMo 上提升 2.29%-8.79%，在 LongMemEval-S 上提升 2.87%-6.15%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将 Structured Interaction Memory 与 Dual-Track Fact Memory 相结合能有效缓解 TSM 与 DUM，并公开了代码；实验范围限于摘要列出的两个基准与五个 backbone。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StreamSplat: Streaming Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel-view synthesis without per-scene optimization, but most existing methods assume a fixed set of context views and process them jointly. This limits their applicability to online scenarios where calibrated views arrive sequentially and the scene must be updated causally. We present \emph{StreamSplat}, a streaming feed-forward 3DGS framework that incrementally maintains a persistent geometry-grounded scene state and decodes it into renderable 3D Gaussians after each input chunk. StreamSplat centers on a \textbf{Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)}, which stores historical 3D tokens in a memory-bounded voxel structure so that memory grows with explored scene geometry rather than stream length. To better reuse history during causal prediction, we introduce \textbf{History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA)} to project cached geometry as depth guidance for current cost-volume estimation, and \textbf{Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI)} to inject cached latent evidence into Gaussian-token regression. Experiments on DL3DV, RealEstate10K, and ScanNet show that StreamSplat remains competitive with state-of-the-art feed-forward 3DGS methods under sparse causal inputs, despite not using future views or full-scene context. More importantly, it scales to long input streams with 256, 512, and 1024 views where fixed-view baselines run out of memory, yielding sustained improvements in novel-view synthesis quality as more observations arrive. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamSplat，一种流式前馈 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）框架，面向在线场景中按顺序到达的校准视图，因果地增量更新场景状态并解码为可渲染的 3D 高斯。核心组件是 Voxel-Aligned Causal Cache (VACC)，配合 History-Projected Depth Anchoring (HPDA) 与 Cache-Guided Feature Injection (CGFI) 来复用历史信息。实验在 DL3DV、RealEstate10K 和 ScanNet 上显示，稀疏因果输入下其性能与现有前馈 3DGS 方法相当，并能扩展到 256、512、1024 视图的长输入流，而固定视图基线在此类场景会内存不足。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法大多假设固定的一组上下文视图并联合处理，这限制了其在在线场景中的应用——在线场景中校准视图顺序到达，且场景必须因果地更新。
Method: StreamSplat 增量维护一个持续的几何锚定场景状态（persistent geometry-grounded scene state），在每个输入块后将其解码为可渲染的 3D 高斯。具体包括：VACC 用内存有界的体素结构存储历史 3D token，使内存随已探索的几何而非流长度增长；HPDA 将缓存几何投影为当前代价体（cost-volume）估计的深度引导；CGFI 将缓存的潜在证据注入高斯 token 回归。
Result: 在 DL3DV、RealEstate10K 和 ScanNet 上，StreamSplat 在稀疏因果输入下与 SOTA 前馈 3DGS 方法保持竞争力，即便不使用未来视图或全场景上下文；在 256、512、1024 视图的长输入流上，固定视图基线会耗尽内存，而 StreamSplat 可扩展并随着更多观测到达持续提升新视角合成质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过内存有界的几何缓存，流式因果设置下的前馈 3DGS 可以在长输入流上保持可扩展性，并随观测增加获得持续的质量改进；代码将在论文接收后公开。

papers.title: GenTrack: Physical Alignment for Robot-Native Motion Generation and Zero-Shot Humanoid Tracking
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose humanoid trackers can execute diverse references, but their zero-shot coverage depends on large embodied corpora that are costly to extend. Text-to-motion generators offer scalable supervision, yet models trained on human motion or retargeted data inherit a gap between kinematic plausibility and robot executability. Existing one-way pipelines fix either the generated corpus or the reward tracker. We introduce GenTrack, an online generator--tracker framework that alternates execution-grounded, group-relative generator alignment with tracker training on newly generated references; anchoring and rehearsal constrain drift. On Unitree G1, we evaluate GenTrack with ProtoMotions and SONIC backbones across three zero-shot tracking splits including public AMASS and LAFAN benchmarks, and a private out-of-distribution test set of 1,024 prompt-motion pairs in the wild. The online co-training strategy consistently produces generators that output more robot-executable motions with strong semantic alignment, and trackers with markedly broader zero-shot coverage and improved tracking accuracy, especially on out-of-distribution references. These results demonstrate that joint online post-training effectively narrows the executability gap between retargeted references and robot-native motion, advancing zero-shot humanoid control without additional data collection and beyond the limitations of a static reference pool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenTrack，一个面向人形机器人运动生成的在线生成器-跟踪器 (generator-tracker) 联合训练框架。该框架交替进行基于执行接地 (execution-grounded) 的组相对生成器对齐，并在新生成的运动参考上训练跟踪器，同时用锚定 (anchoring) 和回放 (rehearsal) 约束漂移。在 Unitree G1 上结合 ProtoMotions 和 SONIC 骨干，跨 AMASS、LAFAN 及含 1,024 对提示-运动的私有分布外测试集评估，结果表明在线协同训练能缩小重定向参考与机器人原生运动之间的可执行性差距，提升零样本跟踪覆盖率和精度。
Motivation: 通用人形跟踪器可执行多样参考，但零样本覆盖依赖成本高昂的大规模具身语料；文本到运动生成器虽提供可扩展监督，但基于人类运动或重定向数据训练的模型在运动学合理性与机器人可执行性之间存在固有鸿沟，而现有单方向流程只固定生成语料或奖励跟踪器之一。
Method: 引入在线生成器-跟踪器框架 GenTrack，交替执行基于执行接地的组相对生成器对齐与在新生成参考上的跟踪器训练，并借助锚定和回放机制约束训练过程中的漂移。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 上以 ProtoMotions 和 SONIC 为骨干，GenTrack 在 AMASS、LAFAN 及私有分布外测试集（含 1,024 对提示-运动）上始终生成更具机器人可执行性且语义对齐良好的运动，并显著提升跟踪器的零样本覆盖范围和跟踪精度，尤其在分布外参考上提升明显。
Conclusion: 联合在线后训练能有效缩小重定向参考与机器人原生运动之间的可执行性差距，无需额外数据采集即可推进零样本人形控制，突破了静态参考池的局限。

papers.title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be computed without the image. We study Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs), a label-free, training-free rule that scores each candidate by whether the model re-derives it under label-preserving perturbations of the input (cropping, background masking, mild photometric or geometric jitter); Pgs recovers majority voting when the perturbation set is empty. The decisive question is not whether Pgs beats chain-of-thought only majority voting, but whether the perturbation term adds anything once decoding format and budget are controlled. We therefore introduce a format-matched control (MatchedCtrl): the same short, no-CoT draws spent on the original image. Across TextVQA, MATH-Vision, MMMU, and ViLP, with a Qwen headline (three-seed means) and LLaVA-OneVision coverage in matched-budget selector tables, Pgs appears to beat plain majority voting by up to +31.8 points on TextVQA (Qwen), but MatchedCtrl tracks or exceeds Pgs within noise on every benchmark, including the vision-required ViLP; no Qwen category shows a significant gain over this control. The stability gap is real and image-dependent (up to +0.48), yet does not predict per-instance wins. The result is negative and diagnostic: perturbation consistency is at best a partial diagnostic of visual dependence and, on its own, not a usable selection signal once format is controlled; gains reported against CoT-only majority voting overstate such methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的测试时缩放 (test-time scaling) 中候选答案选择信号不可靠的问题，系统审计了扰动一致性类选择方法。作者研究 Perturbation Grounded Selection (Pgs)，即通过标签保持的图像扰动下模型能否重新推导出候选答案来打分，并引入格式匹配的控制组 (MatchedCtrl) 来剥离解码格式与预算的影响。在 TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU、ViLP 上，Pgs 相对纯多数投票最高提升 +31.8 分 (Qwen/TextVQA)，但 MatchedCtrl 在所有基准上都能在噪声范围内追平或超过 Pgs，结论是负面的。
Motivation: 测试时缩放将大量采样与选择机制迁移到 VLM 时效果不佳，因为选择层上图像支撑的答案与仅凭语言先验的自信猜测难以区分；一个自然方案是让选择信号无法脱离图像计算，本文即为验证这类信号是否真正有效。
Method: 研究 Pgs：一种无标签、无训练的选择规则，通过模型在标签保持扰动 (裁剪、背景遮蔽、轻微光度或几何抖动) 下能否重新推导出该候选来打分，扰动集为空时退化为多数投票；并引入格式匹配控制 MatchedCtrl，即在原始图像上使用同样短的、无 CoT (no-CoT) 的采样预算，以控制解码格式与预算。
Result: 在 TextVQA、MATH-Vision、MMMU 和 ViLP 上，Pgs 相对纯多数投票最高超过 +31.8 分 (Qwen, TextVQA)，但 MatchedCtrl 在每个基准 (包括需要视觉信息的 ViLP) 上都在噪声范围内追平或超过 Pgs；没有任何 Qwen 类别相对该控制组有显著增益。扰动一致性导致的稳定性差距真实存在且与图像相关 (最高 +0.48)，但不能预测逐样本的胜出。
Conclusion: 这是一个负面的诊断性结论：扰动一致性至多是对视觉依赖的部分诊断信号，在控制解码格式后本身不能作为可用的选择信号；针对仅用 CoT 多数投票基线报告的增益会高估这类方法的实际价值。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: UniHEAR: Unified Heterogeneous-Source Attentive Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires retrieving entity knowledge from external sources to answer visually grounded questions. Existing retrieval-augmented systems suffer from two critical limitations. First, relying on a single retrieval modality creates a Single-Source Retrieval Bottleneck, missing ground-truth entities that are only accessible through complementary sources. Second, dual-tower pointwise rerankers suffer from Retrieval-Source-Blind Reranking, as they overlook retrieval origins and candidate-level retrieval priors, leading to redundant modality reliance. To address these challenges, we propose UniHEAR, a unified lightweight framework for heterogeneous-source entity retrieval and reranking. UniHEAR constructs a Coarse Retrieval Descriptor for each candidate entity, and introduces Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating to condition modality attention weights on this descriptor, complemented by Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion of coarse retrieval priors. A hybrid training strategy combining contrastive learning with an auxiliary modality-preserving loss unifies entity-level and section-level retrieval within a single model. Extensive experiments on E-VQA and InfoSeek demonstrate that UniHEAR achieves state-of-the-art retrieval and VQA performance, improving Recall@1 by 6.7 and 1.2 points over the strongest baselines while maintaining a lightweight reranking architecture. Code and model are available at https://github.com/iven-luo/UniHEAR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniHEAR，一个统一的轻量级异构来源实体检索与重排框架，用于知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）。它针对单源检索瓶颈和检索源盲重排两个问题，为每个候选实体构建粗检索描述符，并引入检索引导的注意力模态门控与熵加权源融合；通过结合对比学习和辅助模态保持损失的混合训练，在同一模型内统一实体级与章节级检索。在 E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上取得检索与 VQA 的最优性能，Recall@1 较最强基线分别提高 6.7 和 1.2 个点。
Motivation: 现有检索增强的 KB-VQA 系统存在两个关键缺陷：依赖单一检索模态会造成单源检索瓶颈，漏掉只有互补来源才能访问的真实实体；双塔 pointwise 重排器忽视检索来源和候选级检索先验，导致冗余的模态依赖。
Method: UniHEAR 为每个候选实体构造 Coarse Retrieval Descriptor，并引入 Retrieval-Guided Attentive Modality Gating，以该描述符为条件调节模态注意力权重；同时用 Entropy-Weighted Source Fusion 融合粗检索先验。混合训练策略将对比学习与辅助模态保持损失结合，在单一模型中统一实体级和章节级检索。
Result: 在 E-VQA 和 InfoSeek 上的大量实验显示，UniHEAR 达到检索与 VQA 性能的最优水平，Recall@1 比最强基线分别提升 6.7 和 1.2 个点，同时保持轻量级重排架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一异构来源的检索与重排可以缓解单源检索瓶颈和检索源盲重排问题，并公开了代码与模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Measurement Without Validity: The Compounding Reliability Problem in Agentic AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI evaluation pipelines produce benchmark scores that justify deployment decisions, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance claims. No formal framework has yet characterized how validity degrades across the stages of these pipelines. We present a three-layer compounding validity model, V_total <= V_1 x V_2 x V_3, that captures multiplicative degradation across task generation (V_1), human-simulator calibration (V_2), and automated judgment (V_3). Under empirically grounded estimates, a pipeline retaining 70% validity at each stage is at most 34% valid against the intended construct (range 0.22--0.54). We validate the model against a structured survey of 55 published agentic evaluation papers, finding that approximately 82% apply structurally mismatched, incomplete, or absent inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics---a pattern consistent with systematic V_3 collapse. We further identify empirical evidence of V_1 failures (task validity flaws in 7 of 10 popular benchmarks) and V_2 miscalibration (up to 9 percentage points inter-simulator variance, with systematic demographic disparities for non-Standard American English speakers). We derive eight prescriptions grounded in psychometric science and domain-stratified reliability thresholds (ICC>=0.70; alpha >= 0.67/0.70/0.80 by consequence level) that practitioners and benchmark authors can apply immediately. The framework provides a tractable knowledge-based tool for diagnosing and correcting evaluation pipeline validity before deployment decisions are made.

papers.title: ExtractBench: A Benchmark for Schema-Guided Enterprise Document Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise workflows increasingly rely on agents for \emph{schema-guided extraction}: given a document and a user-defined schema, the agent faithfully follows the schema to produce the correct output with source evidence as grounding metadata. We present ExtractBench, a benchmark for schema-guided extraction and, to our knowledge, the first to score value accuracy, record completeness at scale, grounding, and measured cost together. The evaluation system contains 4,869 pages across 370 enterprise documents, 8 business domains, and 67 document types, with clear tags differentiating their challenge scenarios. The scalable schema and ground-truth curation pipeline combines independent-system agreement for real documents, known values for synthetic lists, and human verification for forms. We report order-insensitive value F1 for value accuracy, plus two grounding metrics for source traceability: word- and page-level F1. Commercial VLMs perform well on short documents but often truncate record lists on long ones, while coding agents retain higher accuracy at much higher cost. LlamaExtract Agentic Plus ranks first on all three metrics, with accuracy comparable to coding agents at a fraction of the cost. Dataset and evaluation code are available on \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/ExtractBench}{HuggingFace} and \href{https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExtractBench，一个面向模式引导文档抽取（schema-guided extraction）的基准，据作者称是首个同时评估值准确性、记录完整性（record completeness）、grounding 和成本的工作。基准包含 370 份企业文档、4869 页、8 个业务领域和 67 种文档类型，并通过独立系统一致性、合成列表已知值和人工验证等形式构建可扩展的真值。摘要报告了商业 VLM 与编码 agent 的比较，并称 LlamaExtract Agentic Plus 在三个指标上均排名第一。
Motivation: 企业工作流日益依赖 agent 按用户定义的模式从文档中抽取结构化输出，但现有基准未能在大规模上同时考核值准确性、记录完整性、grounding 证据与实测成本，缺乏系统衡量这些维度的标准。
Method: 构建了包含 4869 页、370 份企业文档的评估集，覆盖 8 个业务领域、67 种文档类型，并用标签区分不同挑战场景。真值生成采用三类可扩展流程：真实文档用独立系统一致性、合成列表用已知数值、表格类用人工验证。评估指标包括顺序不敏感的值 F1，以及词级和页级 grounding F1。
Result: 摘要报告商业 VLM 在短文档上表现良好，但长文档上常截断记录列表；编码 agent（coding agents）准确率更高但成本显著更高。LlamaExtract Agentic Plus 在值准确性、词级和页级 grounding 三个指标上均排名第一，准确率接近编码 agent 而成本远低于后者。
Conclusion: 作者将 ExtractBench 作为开源基准发布（数据集在 HuggingFace、代码在 GitHub），以支持同时考虑准确率、记录完整性、grounding 与成本的模式引导抽取评估；摘要未明确讨论该工作的局限性。

papers.title: Evaluation-Verification Reward for Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: While recent image editing models have made rapid progress, multi-reference editing remains challenging, particularly in maintaining visual consistency across references and ensuring overall visual harmony. Reinforcement learning has proven highly effective for text-to-image generation and single-image editing, but its extension to multi-reference editing is hindered by the absence of suitable reward models that capture multi-image relational constraints. Moreover, naively using multimodal large language models(MLLMs) as zero-shot evaluators faces a key tension between hallucination-prone long-form reasoning and the limited deductive power of short-form judgments. We address these issues with a Multi-dimensional Evaluation-Verification Reward(EVR). EVR decomposes evaluation into distinct visual criteria; for each criterion, an MLLM Evaluator generates multiple candidate hypotheses, and a Verifier grounds each claim in concrete visual evidence to accept or reject it, producing reliable and fine-grained reward signals. Together with a scalable data pipeline, our method enables RL fine-tuning of off-the-shelf editors without architectural changes. Extensive experiments show substantial gains over the base Qwen-Image-Edit, improving consistency and harmony to match or surpass NanoBanana.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多参考图像编辑中跨参考一致性与整体视觉和谐性难以保持的问题，提出多维评估-验证奖励（Multi-dimensional Evaluation-Verification Reward, EVR）。EVR 将评估分解为多个视觉标准，由 MLLM 评估器为每个标准生成多个候选假设，再用验证器依据具体视觉证据接受或拒绝假设，从而产生可靠且细粒度的奖励信号。结合可扩展的数据管道，该方法无需改动架构即可对现成编辑器进行强化学习微调，实验表明相对 Qwen-Image-Edit 有显著提升，并在一致性与和谐性上达到或超过 NanoBanana。
Motivation: 强化学习在文生图与单图编辑中有效，但难以扩展到多参考编辑，因为缺少能捕捉多图关系约束的合适奖励模型。同时，直接使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为零样本评估器面临长程推理易幻觉与短判断推理能力有限的矛盾。
Method: 提出 EVR 奖励模型，将评估分解为多个明确的视觉标准；对每个标准，MLLM 评估器生成多个候选假设，验证器将每个主张锚定到具体视觉证据并接受或拒绝，从而输出可靠、细粒度的奖励信号。配合可扩展的数据管道，该方法支持对现成编辑器进行强化学习微调，无需架构改动。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法相对基线 Qwen-Image-Edit 取得显著提升，使一致性与和谐性匹配或超越 NanoBanana。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EVR 能为多参考图像编辑提供可靠且细粒度的奖励信号，使现成编辑器无需架构变化即可通过强化学习微调获得性能提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
papers.abstract_en: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures Added acknowledgement of funding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个对齐问题的形式化模型：智能体先经过理想化的对齐训练，使其价值函数满足某个代理条件，再对世界进行优化。主要结果给出在人价值函数与代理条件准确性满足某些条件时，一个具有 η-灾难性价值函数（即在优化能力极限下保证把人类价值期望压到 η 以下的智能体）会被部署的条件。结论强调过度优化（overoptimization）的危险，并支持限制优化压力的设计，如分位数智能体（quantilizer），而非仅依赖部署前训练。
Motivation: 随着 AI 系统承担越来越多的责任，保证其与人类对齐变得越来越重要；AI 安全中常见的担忧是人类价值是脆弱的，即对不完美代理目标过度优化可能导致灾难性后果。
Method: 论文建立了一个对齐问题模型，其中智能体在接受理想化的对齐训练后满足代理条件，然后才优化世界；作者在人类价值函数和若干代理条件准确性的假设下，分析何种情况下会部署具有 η-灾难性价值函数的智能体。
Result: 主要结果识别出人类价值函数形式与代理条件准确性的一组条件，在这些条件下，一个保证在优化能力极限下把人类价值期望降至 η 以下的智能体会被部署。
Conclusion: 研究强调过度优化的危险性，并认为应采用限制优化压力的 AI 设计（如 quantilizer），而不是仅依赖部署前的对齐训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DragonCrawl: A Generative, Intent-Based Framework for Scalable Mobile End-to-End Testing
papers.abstract_en: As mobile applications grow in complexity, traditional End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks struggle with UI volatility, maintenance overhead, and cross-platform scalability. This paper presents DragonCrawl, an AI-driven mobile testing system for continuous regression testing that has evolved from embedding-based similarity matching to generative intent-based reasoning using large language models. Unlike prior LLM-based testing research focused on exploratory testing and crash detection, DragonCrawl validates specific user flows on every code change, blocking commits that break critical functionality. By leveraging GPT-4o's multimodal capabilities, DragonCrawl achieves 91.6% pass rate on iOS and 92.2% on Android across 1,013 automated tests running continuously in CI/CD pipelines. The system reduces test onboarding time from 96-120 hours to under 4 hours and has saved an estimated 27 developer years in test maintenance effort. We present the architectural evolution from V1 (semantic embedding matching) to V2 (generative intent-based reasoning), discuss implementation challenges including token explosion and memory constraints, and report operational experience from production deployment. The integration of multimodal vision for end-state detection and tool calling for backend state transitions enables comprehensive regression testing that bridges UI interactions with system state. Our results demonstrate that AI-driven testing can maintain stability while eliminating the brittleness of traditional automated tests, enabling continuous quality assurance at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DragonCrawl 是一个面向移动应用持续回归测试的 AI 驱动测试系统，其架构从 V1 的语义嵌入匹配（semantic embedding matching）演进到 V2 的基于大语言模型的生成式意图推理（generative intent-based reasoning）。系统在每次代码变更时验证特定用户流程，并在 CI/CD 流水线中持续运行 1,013 个自动化测试，在 iOS 上达到 91.6% 的通过率、Android 上达到 92.2%。摘要还报告测试接入时间从 96-120 小时降至 4 小时以内，并估计节省了约 27 人年的测试维护工作量。
Motivation: 传统端到端（E2E）测试框架在移动应用复杂度增长下面临 UI 易变（UI volatility）、维护开销大和跨平台扩展性差的问题；而先前基于 LLM 的测试研究主要聚焦探索性测试和崩溃检测，并未针对每次代码变更验证特定用户流程以进行回归拦截。
Method: 提出 DragonCrawl，利用 GPT-4o 的多模态能力实现生成式意图推理，并整合多模态视觉用于端状态检测（end-state detection）、工具调用（tool calling）用于后端状态迁移，从而将 UI 交互与系统状态关联起来；论文还描述了从 V1（语义嵌入匹配）到 V2（生成式意图推理）的架构演进。
Result: 在 IOS 和 Android 上分别取得 91.6% 与 92.2% 的自动化测试通过率（1,013 个测试，运行于 CI/CD 流水线），测试接入时间从 96-120 小时缩短到 4 小时以下，并估计节省约 27 人年的测试维护工作量。
Conclusion: 论文报告了生产部署中的运维经验，并讨论 token 爆炸（token explosion）与内存约束等工程挑战；作者认为 AI 驱动的测试能在保持稳定性的同时消除传统自动化测试的脆弱性，从而实现规模化持续质量保障。

papers.title: ORCA-bench: How Ready Are Language Model Agents for Oncall?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can write, patch, and search code, but oncall root cause analysis (RCA) demands something different: reasoning over noisy metrics, logs, traces, and source code, starting from ambiguous user-facing reports, often hours after the incident began. We introduce ORCA-bench, a benchmark that puts general-purpose coding agents in a production-fidelity oncall setting. ORCA-bench pairs a live OpenTelemetry-instrumented microservice system--exposing six days of metrics, logs, and traces through real telemetry interfaces (Prometheus, Jaeger, and OpenSearch via Grafana) and full source-code access--with 1,079 RCA tasks that systematically vary report specificity, time-to-detection, and co-occurring fault scenarios. Ground-truth symptoms are curated and signed off by expert SREs, and our LLM-as-judge is independently re-scored by humans (Cohen's $κ_w=0.90$). Across five frontier agents, the best RCA Accuracy is 25.3% on Medium-difficulty tasks (the realistic-input setting) and 10.0% on Hard--a gap that remains even with Claude Fable 5. The weakest model hallucinates an implausible root cause in 40% of incident reports, and removing source-code access degrades every metric. Crucially, these are performances on a curated 50 GB / six-day testbed with tasks investigated in isolation on a system whose code and instrumentation are public. Since real production systems are order of magnitudes larger, more dynamic, and more idiosyncratic, the gap we report is a lower bound on the engineering investment required before frontier coding agents can be safely entrusted with production reliability. We release the public set at https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/orca-bench/orca-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ORCA-bench，一个将通用编码智能体置于生产级 oncall 场景的基准，用于评估大语言模型在根因分析 (RCA) 上的能力。基准将一个带 OpenTelemetry 插桩的微服务系统与 1,079 个 RCA 任务配对，任务系统性地变化报告模糊度、检测延迟和共现故障场景。在五个前沿智能体上，最佳 RCA Accuracy 在 Medium 难度为 25.3%、Hard 难度为 10.0%，最弱模型在 40% 的报告中产生不合理的根因幻觉。
Motivation: 大语言模型能够编写、修补和搜索代码，但 oncall 根因分析需要在嘈杂的指标、日志、追踪和源代码上进行推理，并从模糊的用户报告出发，现有编码基准没有覆盖这种生产保真度下的任务。
Method: ORCA-bench 将实时 OpenTelemetry 仪器化的微服务系统（通过 Prometheus、Jaeger、OpenSearch/Grafana 暴露六天的指标、日志和追踪，并提供完整源代码访问）与系统化变化的 RCA 任务配对。真值症状由专家 SRE 策划签署，LLM-as-judge 由人工独立复评（Cohen's κ_w=0.90）。
Result: 五个前沿智能体中最佳 RCA Accuracy 在 Medium 难度任务为 25.3%，Hard 难度为 10.0%，且 Claude Fable 5 仍有差距；最弱模型在 40% 的 incident 报告中幻觉出不合理的根因，移除源代码访问会降低所有指标。
Conclusion: 这些结果是在公开、规模约 50 GB / 六天且任务孤立调查的测试台上取得的，真实生产系统更大、更动态且更特质化，因此该差距是安全地将前沿编码智能体用于生产可靠性前所需工程投入的下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Endo-NeRF++: Uncertainty-Aware Neural Rendering with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding for Dynamic Surgical Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic surgical scenes is crucial for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery; however, it continues to be difficult because of tissue deformation, occlusions, specular reflections, and restricted viewpoints. In this study, we introduce Endo-NeRF++, a neural rendering framework that accounts for uncertainty in the reconstruction of dynamic surgical scenes. Expanding on EndoNeRF, the suggested approach incorporates multi-resolution hash-grid encoding, temporal feature merging, and uncertainty-informed adaptive sampling to enhance reconstruction accuracy and temporal coherence in deformable endoscopic scenes.The multi-resolution hash-grid representation within the framework effectively captures both coarse and fine anatomical details, while temporal feature blending ensures stable reconstruction during tissue deformation and surgical tool occlusions. Additionally, uncertainty-driven adaptive sampling assigns more samples to uncertain areas to enhance rendering quality and geometric coherence. Experiments on robotic surgical video sequences demonstrate that the proposed uncertainty-guided adaptive sampling improves PSNR by up to 1.22dB (4.3%), increases SSIM by up to 5.3%, and reduces LPIPS by up to 55.1% compared with the EndoNeRF baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Endo-NeRF++，一个面向动态手术场景重建的神经渲染框架，在 EndoNeRF 基础上引入多分辨率哈希网格编码、时间特征融合和不确定性引导的自适应采样。实验在机器人手术视频序列上进行，与 EndoNeRF 基线相比，PSNR 最高提升 1.22dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Motivation: 机器人辅助微创手术中的动态场景重建因组织变形、遮挡、镜面反射和受限视角而困难，现有方法难以兼顾高精度重建与时间一致性。
Method: 框架扩展 EndoNeRF，采用多分辨率哈希网格编码同时捕捉粗粒度和细粒度的解剖细节，通过时间特征融合在组织变形和手术工具遮挡下维持稳定重建，并利用不确定性驱动的自适应采样在不确定区域分配更多采样点以提升渲染和几何质量。
Result: 摘要报告在机器人手术视频序列上，所提出的不确定性引导自适应采样相比 EndoNeRF 基线的 PSNR 最高提升 1.22dB（4.3%），SSIM 最高提升 5.3%，LPIPS 最高降低 55.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架改善了可变形内镜场景中的重建精度和时间一致性，不确定性引导的自适应采样是提升渲染质量与几何一致性的关键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CORF-GS: Real-Time Wireless Radiance Field Reconstruction via Coupled Optical-RF Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based wireless radiance field (WRF) reconstruction provide an efficient solution for wireless channel modeling. However, existing WRF reconstruction methods rely on pre-collected observations and offline optimization, and thus struggle to provide real-time channel knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose CORF-GS, a real-time WRF reconstruction framework that processes sequential optical and radio frequency (RF) keyframes. Specifically, CORF-GS constructs a unified Gaussian representation for optical and RF with shared geometry and modality-specific appearance, allowing high-resolution optical images to provide structural priors for WRF reconstruction. When a new keyframe arrives, CORF-GS first employs optical-guided Gaussian sampling to densify the WRF in under-represented regions. Since light and radio waves may respond differently to the same object surfaces due to wavelength mismatch, relying solely on optical guidance may neglect RF-informative areas. Therefore, CORF-GS performs coupled optical-RF optimization to jointly refine the shared Gaussians. Compared with the existing two-stage training pipelines, this prevents WRF from passively adapting to a frozen optical geometry and encourages the shared Gaussians to adapt to both optical structures and RF power distributions. Simulations show that CORF-GS achieves state-of-the-art RF spectrum synthesis quality and reduces the reconstruction time by $6.4\times$ compared with existing WRF methods.
papers.comment: A collection of paper on 3DGS for Wireless Communications can be found at https://github.com/AI4Wireless/3DGS4Wireless
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CORF-GS，一个基于 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 的实时无线辐射场 (WRF) 重建框架，用于顺序处理光学与射频 (RF) 关键帧。它用共享几何和模态特定的外观构建光学与 RF 的统一高斯表示，并采用光学引导的高斯采样和耦合光学-RF 优化来联合细化共享高斯。仿真表明，相比现有 WRF 方法，CORF-GS 在 RF 频谱合成质量上达到最先进水平，并将重建时间缩短 6.4 倍。
Motivation: 现有 WRF 重建方法依赖预先收集的观测和离线优化，难以提供实时信道知识。作者希望打破这种离线训练的限制，实现实时无线信道建模。
Method: CORF-GS 使用共享几何和模态特定外观的统一高斯表示。新关键帧到达时，先通过光学引导的高斯采样在欠表示区域稠密化 WRF；随后进行耦合光学-RF 优化，共同细化共享高斯，避免 WRF 被动适应冻结的光学几何。
Result: 仿真结果显示 CORF-GS 实现了最先进的 RF 频谱合成质量，并将重建时间相比现有 WRF 方法缩短 6.4 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调耦合光学-RF 优化能让共享高斯同时适应光学结构和 RF 功率分布，为实时无线信道建模提供了可行的新路径。

papers.title: Breaking the Periodicity Assumption: Robust Tensorial Multi-View Clustering via Graph-Spectral Low-Rank Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tensorial multi-view clustering (TMC) has achieved strong performance due to its ability to capture high-order correlations across multiple views. Most existing t-SVD-based TMC frameworks apply the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) along the sample mode to impose frequency-domain low-rank constraints. However, we reveal that this widely adopted design critically relies on an implicit ``periodicity assumption'' induced by the sample arrangement. When samples are ordered by class, neighboring indices tend to be semantically similar, creating artificial local continuity along the sample mode and a favorable spectral structure for FFT-based low-rank regularization. Once this ordering is removed by random permutation, existing t-SVD-based TMC methods suffer severe performance degradation. This strong sensitivity to class ordering conflicts with the permutation-invariant nature of clustering and indicates that part of the reported performance may be attributed to a privileged sample arrangement rather than genuine high-order structure modeling. In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and its underlying algebraic and spectral mechanisms. To address this fundamental flaw, we further propose a graph-spectral low-rank tensor learning framework based on the Graph Fourier Transform (GFT), which replaces the fixed Fourier basis along the sample mode with a data-driven graph spectral basis, thereby capturing the intrinsic manifold structure without relying on a particular sample ordering. Moreover, we develop an anchor-based variant to address large-scale datasets efficiently. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks validate our findings and demonstrate the competitive or superior performance of the proposed methods compared with state-of-the-art TMC approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有基于 t-SVD 的张量多视图聚类 (TMC) 对样本排列存在隐含的“周期性假设”：FFT 沿样本模施加频域低秩约束的效果依赖样本按类别排序造成的人为局部连续性，随机打乱顺序后性能显著退化。作者提出基于图傅里叶变换 (GFT) 的图谱低秩张量学习框架，用数据驱动的图谱基替换固定傅里叶基，并给出面向大规模数据的锚点 (anchor-based) 变体。实验表明该方法在多个基准上与现有 SOTA TMC 方法相当或更优。
Motivation: 现有 t-SVD 类 TMC 方法通过 FFT 在样本模上施加频域低秩约束，但其有效性隐式依赖样本按类别排序产生的“周期性假设”；随机置换样本顺序后方法性能严重下降，这与聚类的置换不变性相矛盾，说明部分报告的性能可能来自有利的样本排列而非真实的高阶结构建模。
Method: 提出基于图傅里叶变换 (GFT) 的图谱低秩张量学习框架，将样本模上的固定傅里叶基替换为数据驱动的图谱基，以捕获内在流形结构而不依赖特定样本排序；另开发锚点变体以高效处理大规模数据集。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上的大量实验验证了周期性假设现象，并表明所提方法相对现有 SOTA TMC 方法在聚类性能上相当或更优。
Conclusion: 作者系统研究了周期性假设及其背后的代数与谱机制，强调张量多视图聚类不应依赖样本类别排序所带来的人为谱结构，并指出所提 GFT 框架及锚点变体为样本排列无关的聚类提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SpecBox: Speculative Sandbox Scheduling for Efficient LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly rely on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to invoke isolated external sandboxes, disaggregated sandbox deployment introduces a fundamental tension between resource utilization and interactive tail latency. Persistent long-lived sandbox reservations incur excessive memory overhead at scale, while lazy on-demand instantiation generates severe cold-start penalties that degrade response performance under multi-tenant, multi-turn agent workloads. To resolve this dilemma, we present SpecBox, a runtime built around speculative sandbox preallocation tailored for dynamic LLM agent execution pipelines. At its core, SpecBox implements keyword matching and streaming semantic embedding to enable intent-driven sandbox prewarming, which identifies pending tool execution demands mid-LLM token generation and fully overlaps sandbox bootstrapping with model inference. To extend prewarming windows across sequential agent steps, the framework leverages context-aware stochastic prefetching atop a sandbox dependency graph to probabilistically forecast future sandbox switches ahead of execution. We complement these speculative mechanisms with two orthogonal optimizations: a semantic result cache that prunes redundant repeated sandbox invocations, and a dedicated out-of-band shared-memory transport plane that bypasses conventional network serialization to deliver zero-copy artifact transfers. Evaluated on high-concurrency multi-turn agent traces, our prototype demonstrates that SpecBox cuts P99 end-to-end latency by up to $2.9\times$ relative to the on-demand sandbox baseline, while slashing peak memory consumption by $45.9\%$ compared to permanently reserved sandbox deployments.

Motivation: LLM agent 日益依赖 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 调用隔离的外部沙箱，分离式沙箱部署在资源利用率和交互尾延迟之间存在根本性矛盾：长期保留沙箱内存开销过大，而按需实例化会引入严重冷启动惩罚，影响多租户、多轮 agent 负载下的响应性能。

Result: 在高并发多租户多轮 agent 轨迹评估中，原型相对按需沙箱基线将 P99 端到端延迟最高降低 2.9 倍，同时相对永久保留沙箱部署削减峰值内存占用 45.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调推测性沙箱预分配并叠加结果缓存与共享内存传输优化，可以在保持资源效率的同时显著改善交互延迟，适用于动态 LLM agent 执行流水线。

papers.title: Wrong Design Intent Can Be Worse Than None: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned code LLMs are often conditioned on a design-intent header to steer parametric CAD generation, but whether the model reads that header's content has been tested neither under execution-level scoring nor with a causal control. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, re-scored by executable geometric assertions on the produced B-rep solid. Across three seeds and a pre-registered {0%, 40%}-prefix $\times$ {correct, wrong, masked}-header matrix -- with inference duplicate-aware over the 38 unique-program clusters a submission-stage audit found held out -- we report: (i) in conditional completion (40% prefix), a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the no-header baseline (0.43 $\to$ 0.30/0.21 text/token) on the intents the model can render unconditioned, namely polygonal and thin. The drop is significant on 3/3 token-header seeds but 1/3 text-header seeds, so the pre-registered combined rule, which required the text side, does not pass; (ii) a derangement control -- retrained with shuffled headers: identical marginal, greatly reduced content correlation -- stays competent yet shows no detectable correct-to-wrong drop while M does (text headers; interaction significant on 3/3 seeds, p $\le$ 0.024, one seed below the frozen non-zero-count guardrail), so the harm requires the learned header$\to$program mapping, not the header marginal; (iii) requiring a generated program to execute removes almost all of a correct header's apparent benefit (token: +0.22 ungated regex $\to$ +0.03 gated regex $\to$ +0.02 gated geometry), so the deflation is execution blindness, not detector disagreement; (iv) the harm is regime-specific: at 0% prefix the baseline generates no valid CAD at all. Wrong intent is not noise: where it is detectable, it actively misdirects generation.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. v2: corrects the analysis unit -- the held-out sample contained each program twice, so inference is now over 38 unique-program clusters. Arm means unchanged; the pre-registered text-header rule no longer passes (1/3 seeds), token and the causal control hold on 3/3. Deflation of the correct-header benefit re-attributed to execution gating, not detector choice. Title hedged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用因果对照和可执行几何评分检验 CAD 程序生成中设计意图头 (design-intent header) 是否真正被模型读取。作者在 CADCON 数据集上对 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 做 LoRA 微调，把五特征意图头拼接到 CadQuery 风格草绘-拉伸程序前，并用生成 B-rep 实体的可执行几何断言重新评分。结果显示，在 40% 前缀的条件补全下，语义错误的意图头会把模型对原本可渲染意图（多边形和薄壁）的 adherence 从 0.43 降到 0.30/0.21（text/token），但预注册的 text 侧规则未通过；错排对照 (derangement control) 显示伤害需要学到的 header→program 映射而非 header 边际；要求程序可执行后正确头的表观收益几乎全部消失。
Motivation: 微调后的代码 LLM 常以设计意图头为条件来引导参数化 CAD 生成，但模型是否真的读取该头的内容，从未在执行级评分或因果对照下被检验过。
Method: 在 LoRA 微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 时，将 CADCON 的五特征设计意图头 prepend 到 CadQuery 风格程序前，并用可执行几何断言对生成的 B-rep 实体重新打分；使用预注册的 {0%, 40%} 前缀 × {correct, wrong, masked} 意图头矩阵，三颗种子，并在提交审计发现的 38 个唯一程序簇上做重复感知 (duplicate-aware) 推断；另用 shuffled headers 重训一个错排对照模型。
Result: 在 40% 前缀下，错误意图头使 adherence 低于无意图头基线（0.43 降至 0.30/0.21，text/token），token 侧 3/3 种子显著而 text 侧仅 1/3，预注册的组合规则未通过；错排对照模型边际相同但内容相关性大幅降低，仍保持能力却无正确到错误的可检测下降，而主模型 (M) 有（交互 3/3 种子显著，p ≤ 0.024）；要求程序可执行后，正确头的表观收益从 token 的 +0.22（未门控 regex）降至 +0.03（门控 regex）再到 +0.02（门控几何）；在 0% 前缀下，基线完全不产生有效 CAD。
Conclusion: 作者认为错误意图不是噪声：在可检测的情形下，它会主动误导生成；正确头收益的缩水被重新归因于执行门控 (execution gating) 而非检测器选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Subject-Level Heterogeneity in EEG Motor Imagery Decoding: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Portfolio-Based Reduction of the Search Space
papers.abstract_en: Robust EEG motor imagery decoding remains limited by strong inter-individual variability, making it difficult to identify pipelines that generalize across users. We present a large-scale, standardized within-session benchmark of decoding pipelines across three public datasets: Cho2017 (52 subjects), PhysionetMI (109 subjects), and Zhou2016 (4 subjects). Using a common MOABB LeftRightImagery setting, two frequency bands (8-15 Hz and 8-30 Hz), and a broad combination of feature extraction, preprocessing, and classification steps, we analyzed 216,714 raw evaluation rows, which after structured aggregation yielded 44,928, 109,000, and 4,192 subject-level observations respectively. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) consistently defined the strongest methodological families, though their relative ordering was dataset-dependent. On Cho2017, the best family-level mean accuracy came from cov-tgsp in 8-30 Hz (0.712 +/- 0.140), whereas Zhou2016 favored CSP (0.832 +/- 0.121 in 8-15 Hz). These aggregate rankings concealed substantial subject-level heterogeneity: 42 distinct winning pipelines across 52 Cho2017 subjects, and 93 across 109 PhysionetMI subjects. We then used the benchmark as an empirical performance landscape for building compact portfolios of pipelines of size K. Several construction procedures were compared, including a ranking-based Top-K Mean heuristic and search-based strategies. Results were broadly consistent, with Top-K Mean giving the best trade-off. A single best global pipeline already retained 94.2% of the oracle in Cho2017 and 81.8% in PhysionetMI; at K = 12, oracle retention rose to 96.5% and 90.0%. The landscape is therefore subject-dependent, and this heterogeneity can be exploited through compact portfolios that make personalization more feasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 EEG 运动想象解码中强烈的个体间差异，构建了大规模标准化基准，比较多个解码流水线在 Cho2017、PhysionetMI 和 Zhou2016 三个公共数据集上的表现。结果显示协方差切空间投影 (cov-tgsp) 与 Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) 是最强的方法族，但排名随数据集变化；个体层面存在显著异质性，并可通过构建小型流水线组合 (portfolio) 来接近 oracle 性能。
Motivation: EEG 运动想象解码受个体间差异影响严重，难以找到跨用户泛化的通用流水线，这是制约实际应用的主要问题。
Method: 使用统一的 MOABB LeftRightImagery 设定、8-15 Hz 与 8-30 Hz 两个频段，以及特征提取、预处理和分类步骤的广泛组合进行大规模基准分析；随后将该基准作为经验性能景观，比较 Top-K Mean 启发式与基于搜索的策略来构建大小为 K 的紧凑流水线组合。
Result: 分析 216,714 条原始评估记录，聚合后得到 44,928、109,000 和 4,192 条个体级观测。Cho2017 上最佳方法族为 8-30 Hz 的 cov-tgsp（0.712 ± 0.140），Zhou2016 上为 8-15 Hz 的 CSP（0.832 ± 0.121）；Cho2017 的 52 个受试者中出现 42 种不同获胜流水线，PhysionetMI 的 109 个受试者中出现 93 种。单个最佳全局流水线在 Cho2017 保留 94.2% 的 oracle 性能，PhysionetMI 为 81.8%；K=12 时分别升至 96.5% 和 90.0%，Top-K Mean 策略表现出最佳权衡。
Conclusion: 基准表明解码性能景观高度依赖受试者，但这种异质性可利用紧凑流水线组合加以利用，使个性化解码更可行。

papers.title: Cautious optimism for deep parameterized quantum circuits
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in quantum machine learning is understanding the scaling behavior of parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs). In particular, it remains unclear how their performance on unseen data changes as the number of trainable parameters increases. Prior works have derived formal generalization guarantees for quantum models, but it is well-known that many such results do not fully characterize generalization behavior in practice. In this work, we show that gradient-based PQCs can exhibit improved performance on unseen data as model size increases, displaying the phenomenon of double descent. This contrasts with the traditional view that larger models lead to degraded generalization. We provide analytical results rigorously underpinning this behavior by leveraging add-one-in perturbation techniques and spectral properties of random matrices. We support these results with numerical experiments on re-uploading PQCs across several data sets and training set sizes, consistently observing the predicted double descent behavior. While other obstacles on the path toward practical quantum machine learning remain, our finding that deeper parameterized quantum circuits do not necessarily exhibit degraded performance provides reasons for cautious optimism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究参数化量子电路（PQC）的泛化行为，发现基于梯度的PQC在模型规模增大时可在未见数据上表现更好，出现双下降（double descent）现象，这与传统“更大模型导致泛化下降”的观点相反。作者利用加一摄动（add-one-in perturbation）技术和随机矩阵谱性质给出解析结果，并在重上传PQC（re-uploading PQC）上进行了数值实验验证。
Motivation: 量子机器学习中的一个核心挑战是理解PQC的规模扩展行为，尤其是不清楚训练参数数量增加时模型在未见数据上的性能如何变化。先前的泛化保证在实践中往往不能完全刻画真实的泛化行为。
Method: 作者利用加一摄动技术和随机矩阵的谱性质，为双下降行为提供严格的解析结果；并在重上传PQC上开展数值实验，覆盖多个数据集和不同的训练集规模。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集和多种训练集规模下均一致观察到预测的双下降行为，表明更深（参数更多）的PQC并不必然导致泛化性能退化。
Conclusion: 这一发现为实用量子机器学习提供了谨慎乐观的理由；但作者也指出，通往实用量子机器学习的道路上仍存在其他障碍，本工作仅针对性能退化这一个方面。

papers.title: HalluScope: Fine-grained Hallucination Diagnosis for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of vision-language tasks, they still suffer from hallucinations, where model outputs become inconsistent with the visual content, textual context, or commonsense knowledge. Existing studies primarily address this problem through coarse-grained detection. However, these approaches often provide insufficient diagnostic information for understanding hallucination types and supporting downstream hallucination mitigation. To bridge this gap, we propose fine-grained hallucination diagnosis for MLLMs, a new unified task that jointly performs hallucination detection, classification, and interpretable explanation generation. We develop an automated data generation pipeline and construct HalluScope-30K, a large-scale diagnostic dataset covering eight sources and five task categories. Based on this dataset, we design a multi-granular joint reward function and train two diagnosis models, HalluScope-4B and HalluScope-8B, which achieve state-of-the-art performance on both the MHALO benchmark and our fine-grained hallucination classification benchmark. Notably, detection and classification are mutually beneficial under joint optimization. Furthermore, diagnosis-driven feedback experiments show that the fine-grained diagnostic explanations produced by our model effectively guide target models to correct their hallucinations, with full diagnosis substantially outperforming all baselines on both Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and LLaVA-1.5-7B. Our code, data, and models are available at https://github.com/wkinglin/HalluScope.
