papers.title: IConFace: Fine-Grained Identity Conditioning for Reference-Aware Face Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Severe face degradation can remove person-specific evidence, making restoration underdetermined. A generative prior may recover a sharp, plausible face yet miss localized traits that persist across images of the same person. Same-identity references supply this missing evidence, while the degraded observation anchors target structure. We propose \textbf{IConFace}, a fine-grained identity-conditioned framework that optionally conditions restoration on up to three same-identity references. Its hybrid concat backbone retains degraded and reference observations as dense visual tokens, preserving localized reference evidence. An identity pathway provides compact multi-reference guidance, while a degraded-structure pathway injects full-field and local-residual memories to reinforce target-aligned structure. We also introduce a human-audited benchmark that measures whether persistent localized identity details survive restoration. IConFace achieves leading reference compatibility, especially under severe degradation, and the highest observed preservation rate on this benchmark. Without references, it achieves leading learned perceptual quality across five blind-restoration benchmarks. Joint reference-based and paired-target evaluations show that reference-supported identity recovery and exact target agreement are complementary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IConFace，一种细粒度身份条件化的人脸复原框架，可选用最多三张同身份参考图来补充退化图像缺失的个体特征。其混合拼接主干将退化图和参考图保留为密集视觉 token，身份通路提供紧凑的多参考引导，退化结构通路注入全图与局部残差记忆以保持目标对齐结构。作者还引入一个人工审核基准，衡量跨图像持续存在的局部身份细节是否在复原后存活。
Motivation: 严重的人脸退化会抹去人特有的证据，使复原问题欠定；生成先验能恢复清晰且看似合理的人脸，却容易丢失同一人物跨图像持续存在的局部特征。同身份参考图可补充这一缺失证据，而退化观测用于锚定目标结构。
Method: 提出细粒度身份条件化框架 IConFace，利用混合拼接主干把退化与参考观测保留为密集视觉 token；身份通路提供紧凑的多参考引导，退化结构通路注入全图与局部残差记忆；同时构建人工审核基准来评估持久局部身份细节的保留情况。
Result: IConFace 在参考兼容性上表现领先，尤其在严重退化下最优，并在该基准上取得最高观测保留率；无参考时在五个盲复原基准上取得领先的学习感知质量。参考型与配对目标型评估显示，参考支撑的身份恢复与精确目标一致是互补的。
Conclusion: 作者强调参考支撑的身份恢复与精确目标一致可以互补，并提出以人工审核基准衡量持久局部身份细节是否在复原后存活。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stable GFlowNets with TV Monitoring and Probabilistic Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn to sample states proportional to an unnormalized reward. Despite their theoretical promise, practical training is often unstable, exhibiting severe loss spikes and mode collapse. To tackle this, we first assess the sensitivity of GFlowNet objectives, demonstrating that a small Total Variation (TV) distance between the learned and target distributions does not preclude unbounded training loss. Motivated by this mismatch, we establish converse guarantees by deriving loss-to-TV bounds that certify global fidelity from bounded trajectory balance losses. Lastly, we propose Stable GFlowNets, an algorithm that leverages our theoretical results to stabilize training, and empirically demonstrate improved training behavior and superior distributional fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成流网络 (GFlowNets) 的训练不稳定问题，指出小 TV 距离并不排除无界训练损失，并基于此推导 loss-to-TV 界来建立全局保真度保证。作者提出 Stable GFlowNets 算法，利用这些理论结果稳定训练，实验显示训练行为和分布保真度均有改善。
Motivation: GFlowNets 虽有理论前景，但实际训练常不稳定，出现严重损失尖峰和模式坍缩 (mode collapse)，需要从理论上解释并解决这一不稳定现象。
Method: 先评估 GFlowNet 目标函数的敏感性，证明学习分布与目标分布之间较小的 Total Variation (TV) 距离仍可能伴随无界训练损失；随后推导 loss-to-TV 界，从有界的 trajectory balance loss 出发认证全局保真度，并据此设计 Stable GFlowNets 训练算法。
Result: 摘要报告 Stable GFlowNets 在实验中表现出更稳定的训练行为，并获得更优的分布保真度 (distributional fidelity)。
Conclusion: 作者强调其贡献在于弥合训练损失与分布距离之间的理论缺口，并利用该理论结果实现更稳定的 GFlowNet 训练。

papers.title: Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory
papers.abstract_en: Current agentic memory systems (vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation, scratchpads, and context-window management) do not implement memory: they implement lookup. We argue that treating lookup as memory is a category error with provable consequences for agent capability, long-term learning, and security. Retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases; weight-based memory generalizes by applying abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Conflating the two produces agents that accumulate notes indefinitely without developing expertise, face a provable generalization ceiling on compositionally novel tasks that no increase in context size or retrieval quality can overcome, and are structurally vulnerable to persistent memory poisoning as injected content propagates across all future sessions. Drawing on Complementary Learning Systems theory from neuroscience, we show that biological intelligence solved this problem by pairing fast hippocampal exemplar storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, and that current AI agents implement only the first half. We formalize these limitations, address four alternative views, and close with a co-existence proposal and a call to action for system builders, benchmark designers, and the memory community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为当前的智能体记忆系统（向量存储、retrieval-augmented generation、scratchpad 与上下文窗口管理）实现的只是查表 (lookup) 而非真正的记忆，并将这种混淆视为范畴错误。作者借助神经科学的互补学习系统 (Complementary Learning Systems) 理论指出，生物智能通过快速的海马体样例存储与缓慢的皮层权重巩固相结合来解决该问题，而当前 AI 智能体只实现了前半部分。文章形式化了这些局限、回应了四种替代观点，并提出查表与权重巩固共存的方案。
Motivation: 论文瞄准将检索即查表误当作记忆这一范畴错误，认为它会对智能体能力、长期学习与安全性产生可论证的后果：智能体会无限积累笔记却不发展专长，在组合性新颖任务上遭遇无法通过增大上下文或改进检索质量来突破的泛化上限，并结构性易受持久记忆投毒 (persistent memory poisoning) 攻击。
Method: 采用形式化与概念论证的方式：区分查表式记忆（按相似性泛化到已存案例）与基于权重的记忆（将抽象规则应用到未见输入），并借鉴互补学习系统理论，提出将快速海马式样例存储与慢速皮层式权重巩固相互配合的共存方案。
Result: 摘要不包含实验数据，核心结论是概念性的：混淆查表与记忆会带来可证明的泛化上限与安全脆弱性，即注入内容能在所有未来会话中传播；文章同时回应了四种替代观点。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁系统构建者、基准设计者与记忆社区采取行动，推动查表式记忆与权重巩固式记忆共存，而不是继续把上下文查询当作真正的记忆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assessing and Explaining the Persuadability of Large Language Models as Legal Decision Tools
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as legal decision assistants, and even first-instance decision-makers, across a range of judicial and administrative contexts, it becomes essential to explore how they answer legal questions, and in particular the factors that lead them to decide difficult questions. A specific feature of legal decisions is the need to respond to arguments advanced by contending parties. A legal decision-maker must be able to engage with, and respond to, including through being potentially persuaded by, these arguments. Conversely, they should not be unduly persuadable, deciding cases based on the skills of the advocates rather than the merits of the case. In this paper we explore how frontier open- and closed-weights LLMs respond to legal arguments. We propose a metric to measure persuadability in the trilateral setting in which competing advocates seek to persuade a judge of opposite conclusions. We report original experimental results measuring how far the quality of the advocate making arguments affects the likelihood that a given model will agree with a particular legal point of view. We further examine how far models are capable of distinguishing between stronger and weaker arguments and how far model judgments in this domain are affected by positional bias. Through parallel bilateral trials we show how the trilateral setting changes the demands on judge models, and in turn their apparent persuadability. Finally we examine the specific features of arguments that affect persuasion, including the relative contribution of legal content and rhetorical form, the extent to which model persuasion tracks human expert judgments of argument quality, and the extent to which argument quantity, diversity and type affect persuasive outcomes. Our results have implications for the feasibility of adopting LLMs across legal and administrative settings.
papers.comment: v2 is the conference version, accepted for the Proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), (DOI: 10.1145/3836937.3837003). v3 is a substantially extended version for journal submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿开源与闭源大语言模型 (LLM) 在作为法律决策工具时如何回应对抗双方的法律论证。作者提出一个在三方对抗场景（两方辩护律师试图说服法官采纳相反结论）下衡量模型可说服性 (persuadability) 的指标，并报告实验：论证方质量如何影响模型同意某法律观点的概率、模型区分强论证与弱论证的能力、位置偏差 (positional bias) 的影响，以及平行双边试验与三方试验对法官模型要求的不同。
Motivation: LLM 正被提议用于司法和行政场景中的法律决策辅助甚至一审裁决，因此需要理解它们如何回答法律问题以及哪些因素导致它们裁决疑难案件。法律决策者必须能够回应并可能被当事人论证说服，但又不应该被过度说服、仅凭律师技巧而非案情裁判，这构成需要量化的核心风险。
Method: 提出一个在三方对抗设置中衡量可说服性的指标；通过平行双边试验 (parallel bilateral trials) 对比三方设置对法官模型的额外要求；并分析影响说服的具体论证特征，包括法律内容与修辞形式的相对贡献、模型判断与人类专家对论证质量判断的吻合程度，以及论证数量、多样性和类型的作用。
Result: 摘要报告了原创实验结果：论证方质量显著影响模型同意特定法律观点的可能性；模型区分强弱论证的能力有限；模型判断受位置偏差影响；三方设置改变了法官模型面临的需求并改变其表观可说服性。摘要未给出量化数据。
Conclusion: 结果表明，在司法和行政场景中采用 LLM 的可行性需要谨慎评估，因为模型的裁决可能受倡导技能、论证修辞与位置偏差影响，而非纯粹基于案件实质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Risk Is Not the Target: A Monotonic Framework for Evaluating Wildfire Operational Risk Signals
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating wildfire risk systems using standard machine-learning metrics such as F1-score or IoU is fundamentally flawed: these metrics assess event prediction accuracy, not the operational coherence of a continuous risk signal. This work proposes a novel monotonic evaluation framework that measures whether increases in a predicted risk score consistently correspond to increases in observed operational load, such as number of fires, intervention time, and deployed resources. Moreover, we compare three structurally different approaches on the French Alpes-Maritimes department: the expert-based DFE index, GRU- based predictive models, and FARS, a hybrid multi-agent system combining predictive AI with LLM-based reasoning. Experimental results reveal that the DFE, despite poor classification metrics, exhibits the most balanced monotonic behavior across the full risk scale. GRU models achieve strong local monotonicity but fail to produce well-distributed risk levels. FARS inherits and reveals the structural limitations of upstream signals rather than correcting them. The central finding is a paradigm shift: a good risk model does not predict fires accurately, but one whose ordinal scale meaningfully explains operational dynamics, as proved in this paper. Code of the monotonic framework is available on github.
papers.comment: Accepted in 2026 IEEE 50th Annual Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于评估野火运行风险信号的单调性评价框架，取代 F1-score 或 IoU 等标准机器学习指标。作者在法国滨海阿尔卑斯省比较了基于专家的 DFE 指数、基于 GRU 的预测模型以及融合 AI 与大语言模型推理的混合多智能体系统 FARS。结果显示 DFE 尽管分类指标较差，但在整个风险尺度上表现出最均衡的单调行为；GRU 局部单调性强但风险等级分布不均；FARS 则继承了上游信号的结构性局限。核心结论是好的风险模型不在于准确预测火灾，而在于其序数尺度能有意义地解释运行动态。
Motivation: 标准机器学习指标如 F1-score 和 IoU 评估的是事件预测准确性，而非连续风险信号的运行一致性，因此不适合评价野火风险系统；需要一种能反映预测风险分数与观测运行负荷对应关系的评价方式。
Method: 提出新的单调性评价框架，检验预测风险分数的上升是否持续对应观测运行负荷（如火警数量、干预时间、部署资源）的上升；并用该框架对三种结构不同的方法进行对比。
Result: 实验发现 DFE 尽管分类指标不佳，却在完整风险尺度上呈现最均衡的单调行为；GRU 模型局部单调性强但无法产生分布良好的风险等级；FARS 暴露并继承了上游信号的结构性局限而非修正它们。
Conclusion: 论文主张一种范式转变：好的风险模型不是能准确预测火灾的模型，而是其序数尺度能有意义地解释运行动态的模型；该单调框架代码已公开在 GitHub 上。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种用于评估野火运行风险信号的单调性评价框架，取代 F1-score 或 IoU 等标准机器学习指标。作者在法国滨海阿尔卑斯省比较了基于专家的 DFE 指数、基于 GRU 的预测模型以及融合 AI 与大语言模型推理的混合多智能体系统 FARS。结果显示 DFE 尽管分类指标较差，但在整个风险尺度上表现出最均衡的单调行为；GRU 局部单调性强但风险等级分布不均；FARS 则继承了上游信号的结构性局限。核心结论是好的风险模型不在于准确预测火灾，而在于其序数尺度能有意义地解释运行动态。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准机器学习指标如 F1-score 和 IoU 评估的是事件预测准确性，而非连续风险信号的运行一致性，因此不适合评价野火风险系统；需要一种能反映预测风险分数与观测运行负荷对应关系的评价方式。
summary_sections.method: 提出新的单调性评价框架，检验预测风险分数的上升是否持续对应观测运行负荷（如火警数量、干预时间、部署资源）的上升；并用该框架对三种结构不同的方法进行对比。
summary_sections.result: 实验发现 DFE 尽管分类指标不佳，却在完整风险尺度上呈现最均衡的单调行为；GRU 模型局部单调性强但无法产生分布良好的风险等级；FARS 暴露并继承了上游信号的结构性局限而非修正它们。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文主张一种范式转变：好的风险模型不是能准确预测火灾的模型，而是其序数尺度能有意义地解释运行动态的模型；该单调框架代码已公开在 GitHub 上。

papers.title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Unlike text- or image-driven video generation, an interactive world model is driven by actions: the user acts, and the world responds. Two obstacles stand in the way of fair and comprehensive evaluation. First, models take actions in incompatible formats---captions, camera trajectories, action functions---so no shared protocol has been established. Second, while existing benchmarks have advanced world memory and visual quality, action following is reduced to trajectory or direction error, which collapses a whole path into one number: not how quickly the world reacts to a command switch, nor how cleanly it moves along the commanded axis. WorldMark removes both obstacles. Per-model adapters translate a shared WASD-style vocabulary into each model's native control format, so ten heterogeneous models receive semantically identical instructions across 500 standardized cases spanning styles, viewpoints, and difficulty tiers; a new model costs one adapter. On this common ground we characterize action dynamics through a control-systems lens---direction accuracy, direction purity, response latency, and motion stability, each resolved per axis---alongside suites for world memory and visual quality. Together they expose differences existing protocols cannot see: the fastest responders are often the least stable, a trade-off no single action metric captures; per-axis resolution reveals models that follow translation almost perfectly while barely responding to rotation; the model with the best perceptual and aesthetic quality ranks last in translational direction accuracy and latency; and stylized scenes cost every model global consistency while leaving action dynamics largely intact. We will release all data, evaluation code, and model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldMark，一个面向交互式视频世界模型 (interactive video world models) 的统一评测基准。它通过 per-model adapters 将共享的 WASD 风格词汇翻译成各模型的原生控制格式，使 10 个异构模型在 500 个覆盖风格、视角和难度层级的标准用例上收到语义相同的指令。评测从控制论视角刻画动作动力学，包括方向准确度、方向纯度、响应延迟和运动稳定性，并逐轴解析，同时配套世界记忆与视觉质量评测。
Motivation: 现有交互式世界模型评测缺少统一协议，因为不同模型接受格式不兼容的动作指令（如字幕、相机轨迹、动作函数）；同时，已有基准把动作跟随简化为轨迹或方向误差，将整条路径压缩成单一数字，无法反映世界对指令切换的响应速度，也难以衡量沿指定轴运动的干净程度。
Method: 为每个模型构建一个 adapter，将共享的 WASD 风格词汇映射到该模型的原生控制格式，新增模型只需写一个 adapter；随后在 500 个标准化用例上对 10 个异构模型进行评测。动作动力学通过方向准确度、方向纯度、响应延迟和运动稳定性等控制论指标逐轴刻画，并辅以世界记忆和视觉质量评测套件。
Result: 摘要报告了现有协议无法观察到的现象：响应最快的模型往往最不稳定，这种权衡无法被单一动作指标捕捉；逐轴解析显示某些模型几乎完美跟随平移却几乎不响应旋转；感知与美学质量最佳的模型在平移方向准确度和延迟上排名最后；风格化场景会使所有模型的全局一致性受损，但动作动力学基本不受影响。
Conclusion: 作者主张统一的评测协议与逐轴动作动力学指标能够暴露单一动作指标掩盖的权衡，并计划发布全部数据、评测代码和模型输出。

papers.title: Leakage-Audited Benchmarking Reveals Limited Evidence for Cross-Subject Auditory-Evoked EEG Vowel Perception Decoding
papers.abstract_en: We tested whether auditory-evoked EEG supports subject-independent five-vowel perception decoding when trial identity, model identity, prediction provenance, and participant-level inference are controlled within a single benchmark. We reconstructed Study 2 event tables from OpenNeuro ds006104 version 1.0.1 and analyzed the consonant-vowel pair task. One-to-one marker-stimulus pairing yielded 3,840 independent trials; control-condition selection and artifact rejection retained 1,094 epochs from 16 participants and 61 EEG channels. Thirteen unique implementations were evaluated using leave-one-subject-out testing, with participant metrics reconstructed from 36,102 trial predictions across 33 complete prediction replicas. Random Forest was numerically highest at 21.474% balanced accuracy (95% participant-bootstrap interval, 19.526-23.482%; chance, 20%), but neither its participant-level tests nor any implementation survived correction across the 13-model family. Deep-model performance was close to chance, and several architectures showed substantial seed-dependent variation and low trial-label agreement. In a separate descriptive sensor-space representation, participant-associated effects accounted for 72.24% of the balanced standardized centroid sum of squares, compared with 2.04% for vowel-associated effects; between-participant same-vowel distances exceeded within-participant across-vowel distances for all 16 participants. An exploratory MDM analysis comprising 9,616 genuine refits across training cohorts of 3-15 participants showed no monotonic performance gain. Within this dataset and protocol, evidence for reliable cross-subject five-vowel decoding is limited. The benchmark provides a reproducible chain from source rows to retained epochs, predictions, participant-level metrics, multiplicity-adjusted inference, and bounded diagnostic analyses.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures; includes 11-page supplementary material. Associated code, prediction records, source data, and reproducibility materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21805983
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个泄漏审计基准（leakage-audited benchmark），在控制试验身份、模型身份、预测来源与参与者层级推断的条件下，检验听觉诱发 EEG 是否支持跨被试的五元音感知解码。作者从 OpenNeuro ds006104 重建事件表，评估 13 种实现，发现随机森林在平衡准确率上最高（21.474%，机会水平为 20%），但没有任何模型在多重比较校正后显著优于机会水平，深层模型接近机会水平。参与者相关效应解释了大部分表征方差，提示该数据集与协议下跨被试五元音解码的证据有限。
Motivation: 已有的跨被试语音感知 EEG 解码研究可能因数据泄漏或推断设计不严谨而高估了可解码性，本文的目标是在单一受控基准中系统检验五元音解码是否真实存在。
Method: 作者从 OpenNeuro ds006104 版本 1.0.1 重建 Study 2 事件表，采用一对一标记-刺激配对获得 3,840 个独立试验，经条件筛选与伪迹剔除保留 16 名被试、61 通道的 1,094 个 epoch。评估 13 种唯一实现，使用留一被试交叉验证，从 33 个完整预测副本中的 36,102 条试验预测重建被试级指标，并进行参与者 bootstrap 区间、多重性校正、传感器空间表示分析以及探索性 MDM 分析。
Result: 随机森林取得最高的 21.474% 平衡准确率（95% bootstrap 区间 19.526-23.482%，机会水平 20%），但其被试级检验以及所有实现均未在校正后通过 13 模型族检验；深度模型性能接近机会水平且随随机种子波动较大。描述性分析中，参与者相关效应占平衡标准化质心平方和的 72.24%，而元音相关效应仅占 2.04%；探索性 MDM 分析（9,616 次真实重拟合）未显示单调的性能增益。
Conclusion: 在该数据集和协议范围内，可靠的跨被试五元音解码证据有限；作者提供了从源数据行到保留 epoch、预测、被试级指标、多重性调整推断和边界诊断分析的完整可复现链条。

papers.title: A Systematic Review and Taxonomy of Reinforcement Learning-Model Predictive Control Integration for Linear Systems
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for constrained decision-making and adaptive control. MPC offers structured optimization, explicit constraint handling, and established stability tools, whereas RL provides data-driven adaptation and performance improvement in the presence of uncertainty and model mismatch. Despite the rapid growth of research on RL--MPC integration, the literature remains fragmented, particularly for control architectures built on linear or linearized predictive models. This paper presents a comprehensive Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of RL--MPC integrations for linear and linearized systems, covering peer-reviewed and formally indexed studies published until 2025. The reviewed studies are organized through a multi-dimensional taxonomy covering RL functional roles, RL algorithm classes, MPC formulations, cost-function structures, and application domains. In addition, a cross-dimensional synthesis is conducted to identify recurring design patterns and reported associations among these dimensions within the reviewed corpus. The review highlights methodological trends, commonly adopted integration strategies, and recurring practical challenges, including computational burden, sample efficiency, robustness, and closed-loop guarantees. The resulting synthesis provides a structured reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to design or analyze RL--MPC architectures based on linear or linearized predictive control formulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是针对线性与线性化系统中模型预测控制（MPC）与强化学习（RL）集成研究的系统性文献综述（SLR），覆盖截至2025年的同行评审文献。作者提出包含RL功能角色、RL算法类别、MPC公式、代价函数结构和应用领域的多维分类法，并进行跨维度综合以识别反复出现的设计模式、方法趋势与实际挑战。
Motivation: RL-MPC集成研究快速增长的背景下，相关文献仍然碎片化，尤其是基于线性或线性化预测模型构建的控制架构缺乏系统性的整理与参考框架。
Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，检索并整理截至2025年的正式索引文献，通过多维分类法组织研究对象，并做跨维度综合分析以归纳设计模式与维度间的关联。
Result: 综述识别出方法学趋势、常用集成策略以及反复出现的工程挑战，包括计算负担、样本效率、鲁棒性和闭环保证，并报告了各分类维度之间的关联模式。
Conclusion: 该综合为基于线性或线性化预测控制公式设计和分析RL-MPC架构的研究者与实践者提供结构化参考；摘要未给出具体量化结果或详细局限性说明。

papers.title: MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: 6D object pose estimation in cluttered scenes remains challenging due to severe occlusion and sensor noise. We propose MAPRPose, a two-stage framework that leverages mask-aware correspondences for pose proposal and amodal-driven Region-of-Interest (ROI) prediction for robust refinement. In the Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) stage, we lift 2D correspondences into 3D space to establish reliable keypoint matches and generate geometrically consistent pose hypotheses based on correspondence-level scoring, from which the top-$K$ candidates are selected. In the refinement stage, we introduce a tensorized render-and-compare pipeline integrated with an Amodal Mask Prediction and ROI Re-Alignment (AMPR) module. By reconstructing complete object geometry and dynamically adjusting the ROI, AMPR mitigates localization errors and spatial misalignment under heavy occlusion. Furthermore, our GPU-accelerated RGB-XYZ reprojection enables simultaneous refinement of all $N \times B$ pose hypotheses in a single forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAPRPose，一种用于杂乱场景下多目标 6D 姿态估计 (6D pose estimation) 的两阶段框架，针对严重遮挡与传感器噪声问题。第一阶段 Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) 将 2D 对应点提升到 3D 空间建立关键点匹配，并按对应关系打分生成几何一致的姿态假设，选出 top-K 候选；第二阶段引入张量化 render-and-compare 管线，配合 Amodal Mask Prediction and ROI Re-Alignment (AMPR) 模块重建完整物体几何并动态调整 ROI，通过 GPU 加速的 RGB-XYZ 重投影在单次前向中同时精修所有 N × B 个姿态假设。
Motivation: 杂乱场景中的严重遮挡和传感器噪声使 6D 物体姿态估计仍具挑战性，现有方法难以在这些条件下保持定位与空间对齐的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：MAPP 阶段利用 mask-aware 对应关系生成姿态假设并基于对应关系打分筛选 top-K；精修阶段采用张量化 render-and-compare 管线，结合 AMPR 模块进行 amodal 掩码预测和 ROI 重新对齐，并用 GPU 加速的 RGB-XYZ 重投影实现所有假设的并行精修。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化数值，主要宣称该方法在严重遮挡下缓解定位误差与空间错位，并能通过单次前向同时精修全部姿态假设。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合 mask-aware 姿态提议与 amodal 驱动的 ROI 精修可以有效应对遮挡和噪声，同时利用 GPU 加速重投影提升多假设精修效率。

summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出具体量化数值，主要宣称该方法在严重遮挡下缓解定位误差与空间错位，并能通过单次前向同时精修全部姿态假设。

papers.title: Localized Tornado Outbreak at the Upstream of a Tropical Easterly Wave in Camarines Norte, Philippines (13 September 2025)
papers.abstract_en: (Abridge) On 13 September 2025 around 22 UTC, a localized tornado outbreak affected eastern Philippines, causing significant damage in Camarines Norte. The event developed within an atypical easterly severe weather regime characterized by warm, moist southeasterly flow and strong low-level wind shear associated with an easterly wave trough. A vorticity convergence zone along the inverted trough enhanced low-level rotation, while highly curved streamwise hodographs indicated a favorable environment for supercells and tornadogenesis. At least five vortices were identified, including three tornadic supercells. The Magang tornado was rated IF2.5 (EF3-equivalent) with $\sim$2 km damage path, while the Cahabaan and Napilihan tornadoes were rated IF1 (EF1-equivalent), with Cahabaan producing $\sim$3 km damage path. The remaining vortices were rated IF0 (EF0-equivalent). These tornadoes occurred simultaneously, indicating multiple discrete supercells within the same mesoscale environment and possible inflow-outflow interactions. Dual-polarization radar observations revealed Z$_\text{DR}$ and K$_\text{DP}$ columns, a debris signature in the Magang tornado, and a bounded weak echo region (BWER) in the Cahabaan supercell. This study documents the first known tornado outbreak and simultaneous tornadic supercells in the Philippines within an easterly severe weather regime.

TL;DR: 本文是对2025年9月13日菲律宾Camarines Norte地区一次局地龙卷爆发的个例研究。事件发生在与东风波槽相关联的异常东风强天气背景下，暖湿东南气流与强低层风切变共同作用，弯度很大的顺风切变矢端图 (streamwise hodographs) 表明环境有利于超级单体与龙卷生成。作者结合环境分析与双偏振雷达观测，识别出至少五个涡旋，其中包括三个龙卷超级单体。这是菲律宾首次记录到的发生在东风强天气背景下的龙卷爆发事件，也是首次记录到同时出现的龙卷超级单体。
Motivation: 菲律宾热带地区此前缺乏对东风波背景下龙卷爆发和同时出现的超级单体的系统观测与记录，该事件提供了一个罕见且典型的个例，有助于理解热带东风强天气环境中龙卷生成的物理机制。
Method: 采用个例天气分析的方法，利用探空与再分析资料刻画环境垂直风切变、流函数和涡度辐合带，并结合双偏振雷达观测识别Z_DR与K_DP柱、碎片特征 (debris signature) 以及有界弱回波区 (BWER) 等超级单体与龙卷的雷达回波特征，同时依据破坏路径对龙卷定级。
Result: 摘要报告至少识别出五个涡旋，包括三个龙卷超级单体；Magang龙卷定级为IF2.5（相当于EF3），破坏路径约2 km；Cahabaan和Napilihan龙卷定级为IF1（相当于EF1），其中Cahabaan破坏路径约3 km；其余涡旋为IF0（相当于EF0）。这些龙卷同时发生，表明同一中尺度环境中存在多个离散超级单体及可能的流入-流出相互作用。
Conclusion: 该研究首次记录并分析了菲律宾在东风强天气背景下发生的龙卷爆发和同时出现的龙卷超级单体事件，强调异常环境与雷达特征之间的联系，为热带地区类似的强对流天气识别提供了观测依据。

papers.title: UniCSG: Unified High-Fidelity Content-Constrained Style-Driven Generation via Staged Semantic and Frequency Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Style transfer must match a target style while preserving content semantics. DiT-based diffusion models often suffer from content-style entanglement, leading to reference-content leakage and unstable generation. We present UniCSG, a unified framework for content-constrained, style-driven generation in both text-guided and reference-guided settings. UniCSG employs staged training: (i) a latent-space semantic disentanglement stage that combines low-frequency preprocessing with conditioning corruption to encourage content-style separation, and (ii) a latent-space frequency-aware detail reconstruction stage that refines details via multi-scale frequency supervision. We further incorporate pixel-space reward learning to align latent objectives with perceptual quality after decoding. Experiments demonstrate improved content faithfulness, style alignment, and robustness in both settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCSG，一个用于内容约束、风格驱动生成的统一框架，同时支持文本引导和参考引导两种设置。针对 DiT 扩散模型在风格迁移中常见的内容-风格纠缠问题，UniCSG 采用分阶段训练：先在潜空间进行语义解耦，再进行频率感知的细节重建，并结合像素空间奖励学习。实验表明该方法在两种设置下均提升了内容保真度、风格对齐性和生成鲁棒性。
Motivation: DiT 扩散模型在风格迁移中常因内容与风格的纠缠导致参考内容泄漏（reference-content leakage）和生成不稳定，难以在匹配目标风格的同时保持内容语义。
Method: UniCSG 采用分阶段训练：第一阶段为潜空间语义解耦，结合低频预处理与条件损坏（conditioning corruption）促进内容-风格分离；第二阶段为潜空间频率感知细节重建，通过多尺度频率监督细化细节；此外引入像素空间奖励学习，使潜空间目标与解码后的感知质量对齐。
Result: 实验在文本引导和参考引导两种设置下均展示了内容保真度、风格对齐性和鲁棒性的改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一框架结合分阶段语义与频率解耦以及像素空间奖励，可有效缓解扩散模型风格迁移中的内容-风格纠缠问题。

papers.title: Just Repair: A Minimal Denoising Network for Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detectors have grown steadily more complex, incorporating attention mechanisms, adversarial training, and stochastic latent variables. Yet, it is unclear how much of this machinery detection actually requires. We test this question with JuRe (Just Repair), a deliberately minimal detector: a single depthwise-separable convolutional residual block trained to repair Gaussian-corrupted, channel-masked windows, scored at inference by a fixed structural discrepancy function with no learned parameters. JuRe ranks second on the TSB-AD multivariate benchmark (AUC-PR 0.404 over 180 series) and second on the UCR univariate archive (AUC-PR 0.201 over 250 series), where it leads all neural baselines. On TSB-AD, JuRe runs roughly $20\times$ faster than AxonAD, one of the top-ranked methods on that benchmark. Full-benchmark ablations show that removing Gaussian corruption reduces AUC-PR by 0.046, whereas AUC-PR across the evaluated architecture variants spans at most 0.017. A synthetic linear-manifold experiment provides partial evidence for this geometric interpretation: anomaly scores correlate with true off-manifold distance (Pearson $r=0.725$), and repair directions align increasingly with the true projection as anomaly magnitude grows. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction find significant differences against 20 of 25 baselines, although dependence among series limits dataset-level interpretation. Code is available at https://github.com/iis-esslingen/JuRe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JuRe (Just Repair)，一个刻意最小化的时间序列异常检测器：仅用一个深度可分离卷积残差块，将高斯噪声破坏且通道掩码后的窗口修复为原始形状，推理时用不含可学习参数的固定结构差异函数打分。在 TSB-AD 多元基准（180 个序列，AUC-PR 0.404）和 UCR 一元基准（250 个序列，AUC-PR 0.201）上均排名第二，并领先所有神经基线；在 TSB-AD 上比 AxonAD 快约 20 倍。全基准消融显示去掉高斯噪声破坏会降低 AUC-PR 0.046，而架构变体之间的 AUC-PR 差异最多 0.017。
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测器不断引入注意力机制、对抗训练和随机隐变量等复杂组件，但检测任务实际上需要多少此类机制尚不清楚；作者想检验最小化模型能否达到相当的性能。
Method: JuRe 由单个 depthwise-separable 卷积残差块组成，训练目标是修复被高斯噪声破坏并施加通道掩码的窗口；推理阶段用无学习参数的固定结构差异函数 (structural discrepancy function) 对修复残差打分，从而判定异常。
Result: 在 TSB-AD 多变量基准上 AUC-PR 为 0.404（180 个序列），在 UCR 单变量基准上 AUC-PR 为 0.201（250 个序列），均排名第二且领先所有神经基线；在 TSB-AD 上约比 AxonAD 快 20 倍。消融表明去掉高斯噪声破坏使 AUC-PR 下降 0.046，而架构变体间差异至多 0.017；合成线性流形实验中异常分数与真实离流形距离的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.725。
Conclusion: 作者认为简单的修复目标与固定打分函数足以支撑强异常检测性能，几何上异常分数与离流形距离相关；不过序列之间的依赖性限制了数据集层面的统计解释，且 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Holm 校正）仅对 25 个基线中的 20 个发现显著差异。

papers.title: TSM-Pose: Topology-Aware Learning with Semantic Mamba for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Category-level object pose estimation is fundamental for embodied intelligence, yet achieving robust generalization to unseen instances remains challenging. However, existing methods mainly rely on simple feature extraction and aggregation, which struggle to capture category-shared topological structures and conduct semantic keypoint modeling, limiting their generalization. To address these, we propose a \textbf{T}opology-Aware Learning with \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{M}amba for Category-Level \textbf{P}ose Estimation framework (TSM-Pose). Specifically, we introduce a Topology Extractor to capture the global topological representation of the point cloud, which is integrated into local geometry features and enables robust category-level structural representation. Simultaneously, we propose a Mamba-based Global Semantic Aggregator that injects semantics priors into keypoints to enhance their expressiveness and leverages multiple TwinMamba blocks to model long-range dependencies for more effective global feature aggregation. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (REAL275, CAMERA25, and HouseCat6D) demonstrate that TSM-Pose outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TSM-Pose，一个用于类别级物体姿态估计 (category-level object pose estimation) 的框架，针对未见实例的泛化问题。该框架通过 Topology Extractor 捕获点云的全局拓扑表示并融入局部几何特征，同时提出基于 Mamba 的 Global Semantic Aggregator，用多个 TwinMamba 块建模长程依赖并注入语义先验到关键点。摘要报告在 REAL275、CAMERA25 和 HouseCat6D 三个基准上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有类别级姿态估计方法多依赖简单的特征提取与聚合，难以捕获类别共享的拓扑结构，也缺乏语义关键点建模，从而限制了模型对未见实例的泛化能力。
Method: 提出 TSM-Pose 框架，包含 Topology Extractor 以学习点云全局拓扑表示并与局部几何特征融合；以及基于 Mamba 的全局语义聚合器，将语义先验注入关键点，并通过多个 TwinMamba 块建模长程依赖以增强全局特征聚合。
Result: 在 REAL275、CAMERA25 和 HouseCat6D 三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TSM-Pose 的性能优于现有最先进方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文主张拓扑感知学习与语义 Mamba 聚合可增强类别级物体姿态估计的结构表示和关键点表达能力，从而提升泛化性能。摘要未说明局限性。

papers.title: Reasoning Dynamics and the Limits of Monitoring Modality Reliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) offer reasoning capabilities, yet how these unfold and integrate visual and textual information remains unclear. We analyze reasoning dynamics in 18 VLMs covering instruction-tuned and reasoning-trained models from two different model families. We track confidence over Chain-of-Thought (CoT), measure the corrective effect of reasoning, and evaluate the contribution of intermediate reasoning steps. We find that models are prone to answer inertia, in which early commitments to a prediction are reinforced, rather than revised during reasoning steps. While reasoning-trained models show stronger corrective behavior, their gains depend on modality conditions, from text-dominant to vision-only settings. Using controlled interventions with misleading textual cues, we show that models are consistently influenced by these cues even when visual evidence is sufficient, and assess whether this influence is recoverable from CoT. Although this influence can appear in the CoT, its detectability varies across models and depends on what is being monitored. Reasoning-trained models are more likely to explicitly refer to the cues, but their longer and fluent CoTs can still appear visually grounded while actually following textual cues, obscuring modality reliance. In contrast, instruction-tuned models refer to the cues less explicitly, but their shorter traces reveal inconsistencies with the visual input. Taken together, these findings indicate that CoT provides only a partial view of how different modalities drive VLM decisions, with important implications for the transparency and safety of multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析18个视觉语言模型（VLM）在思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理中的动态，发现模型普遍存在“答案惯性”（answer inertia），即早期预测被强化而非修正。推理训练模型虽然表现出更强的纠错行为，但其收益依赖从文本主导到纯视觉等模态条件；通过误导性文本线索的受控干预，作者发现这种模态依赖难以从CoT中可靠监测，CoT只能部分反映视觉与文本信息如何驱动VLM决策。
Motivation: 现有VLM具备推理能力，但推理如何展开以及视觉与文本信息如何被整合仍不清楚；基于CoT的透明度监测能否可靠揭示模态依赖缺乏系统评估，而这关系到多模态系统的透明度与安全性。
Method: 对18个VLM（涵盖指令微调模型和推理训练模型，来自两个模型家族）跟踪CoT过程中的置信度变化，测量推理的纠错效果，评估中间推理步骤的贡献；并用带误导性文本线索的受控干预测试模型是否受线索影响，以及该影响能否从CoT中恢复。
Result: 模型普遍表现出对早期预测的强化而非修正；推理训练模型纠错更强但依赖模态条件。即使视觉证据充分，误导性文本线索仍持续影响模型；这种影响有时出现在CoT中，但其可检测性因模型而异，并取决于监测的具体对象。
Conclusion: CoT只能提供模态如何驱动VLM决策的部分视图：推理训练模型更可能显式提及误导线索，但其更长更流畅的CoT可能看似视觉接地实则跟随文本线索；指令微调模型较少显式提及线索，但较短轨迹会暴露与视觉输入的不一致。作者强调这对多模态系统的透明度和安全性有重要影响。

papers.title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.
papers.comment: Published at COLM 2026. 50 pages, 20 figures. Code and data at https://technion-cs-nlp.github.io/vibe-testing-llms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用户对 LLM 的“vibe-testing”（非正式、基于使用体验的评估）实践，并试图将其形式化以支持系统分析。作者先分析用户评估实践问卷和来自博客与社交媒体的真实模型对比报告两类资源，将 vibe-testing 概括为“用户个性化测什么”和“用户个性化怎么评判”的两段式过程，再提出一个遵循该形式的 proof-of-concept 评估流水线，用个性化提示与用户感知的主观标准比较模型输出。在编码基准上的实验表明，结合个性化提示和用户感知评估可能改变被偏好的模型。
Motivation: 基准分数常常无法反映模型在真实场景中的实用性，而用户普遍依赖 vibe-testing 这类非正式评估；但这种做法过于临时和缺乏结构，难以在大规模上进行分析和复现。
Method: 首先分析两项经验资源：用户评估实践的问卷，以及从博客和社交媒体收集的真实模型对比报告；据此将 vibe-testing 形式化为两段式过程，即用户个性化测试内容与个性化评判方式；随后实现一个 proof-of-concept 流水线，生成个性化提示，并用用户感知的主观标准来比较模型输出。
Result: 在编码基准上的实验发现，将个性化提示与用户感知评估相结合，可能改变最终被偏好的模型，从而体现 vibe-testing 在实际使用中的作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为形式化的 vibe-testing 可以作为连接基准分数与真实世界使用体验的有用途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Any3DAvatar: Fast and High-Quality Full-Head 3D Avatar Reconstruction from Single Portrait Image
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing a complete 3D head from a single portrait remains challenging because existing methods still face a sharp quality-speed trade-off: high-fidelity pipelines often rely on multi-stage processing and per-subject optimization, while fast feed-forward models struggle with complete geometry and fine appearance details. To bridge this gap, we propose Any3DAvatar, a fast and high-quality method for single-image 3D Gaussian head avatar generation, whose fastest setting reconstructs a full head in under one second while preserving high-fidelity geometry and texture. First, we build AnyHead, a unified data suite that combines identity diversity, dense multi-view supervision, and realistic accessories, filling the main gaps of existing head data in coverage, full-head geometry, and complex appearance. Second, rather than sampling unstructured noise, we initialize from a Plücker-aware structured 3D Gaussian scaffold and perform one-step conditional denoising, formulating full-head reconstruction into a single forward pass while retaining high fidelity. Third, we introduce auxiliary view-conditioned appearance supervision on the same latent tokens alongside 3D Gaussian reconstruction, improving novel-view texture details at zero extra inference cost. Experiments show that Any3DAvatar outperforms prior single-image full-head reconstruction methods in rendering fidelity while remaining substantially faster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Any3DAvatar，一种从单张肖像图像生成完整 3D 头部高斯头像的方法，最快设置可在 1 秒内完成重建并保持高保真几何与纹理。作者构建了统一数据套件 AnyHead，采用 Plücker-aware 结构化 3D Gaussian 初始化与单步条件去噪，将全头重建化为单次前向传播，并引入辅助视图条件外观监督提升新视角纹理。实验表明该方法在渲染保真度上优于先前的单图全头重建方法，同时速度显著更快。
Motivation: 现有单图全头重建方法在质量与速度之间存在尖锐权衡：高保真管线依赖多阶段处理和逐主体优化，而快速前馈模型难以恢复完整几何和精细外观细节。
Method: 首先构建 AnyHead 统一数据套件，整合身份多样性、密集多视角监督和真实配件，弥补现有头部数据在覆盖度、全头几何和复杂外观上的缺口；然后从 Plücker-aware 结构化 3D Gaussian scaffold 初始化，通过单步条件去噪将重建整合为一次前向传播；最后在相同潜 token 上增加视图条件外观监督，提升新视角纹理细节且不增加推理成本。
Result: 实验显示 Any3DAvatar 在渲染保真度上超越先前的单图全头重建方法，同时保持明显更快的速度；其最快设置可在 1 秒内重建完整头部。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过统一数据套件、结构化初始化与单步去噪以及辅助外观监督，可以在无需逐主体优化的情况下同时实现快速和高质量的全头重建。

papers.title: AffectAgent: Collaborative Multi-Agent Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multimodal emotion recognition relies on static parametric memory and often hallucinates when interpreting nuanced affective states. In this paper, given that single-round retrieval-augmented generation is highly susceptible to modal ambiguity and therefore struggles to capture complex affective dependencies across modalities, we introduce AffectAgent, an affect-oriented multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that leverages collaborative decision-making among agents for fine-grained affective understanding. Specifically, AffectAgent comprises three jointly optimized specialized agents, namely a query planner, an evidence filter, and an emotion generator, which collaboratively perform analytical reasoning to retrieve cross-modal samples, assess evidence, and generate predictions. These agents are optimized end-to-end using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) with a shared affective reward to ensure consistent emotion understanding. Furthermore, we introduce Modality-Balancing Mixture of Experts (MB-MoE) and Retrieval-Augmented Adaptive Fusion (RAAF), where MB-MoE dynamically regulates the contributions of different modalities to mitigate representation mismatch caused by cross-modal heterogeneity, while RAAF enhances semantic completion under missing-modality conditions by incorporating retrieved audiovisual embeddings. Extensive experiments on MER-UniBench demonstrate that AffectAgent achieves superior performance across complex scenarios. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/Wz1h1NG/AffectAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AffectAgent 是一个面向情感的多智能体检索增强生成框架，用于多模态情感识别。它由查询规划器、证据过滤器和情感生成器三个协作智能体组成，并通过多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）与共享情感奖励进行端到端联合优化。框架还引入模态平衡混合专家（MB-MoE）和检索增强自适应融合（RAAF），以缓解跨模态异质性和缺失模态问题。在 MER-UniBench 上的大量实验表明其取得了优越性能。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的多模态情感识别依赖静态参数记忆，在解读细微情感状态时容易产生幻觉；而单轮检索增强生成易受模态歧义影响，难以捕捉跨模态之间的复杂情感依赖。
Method: 提出 AffectAgent，包含三个联合优化的专用智能体：查询规划器（query planner）负责检索跨模态样本，证据过滤器（evidence filter）评估证据，情感生成器（emotion generator）生成预测；三者协作完成分析式推理。智能体使用 MAPPO 和共享情感奖励端到端优化；同时提出 MB-MoE 动态调节各模态贡献，并用 RAAF 通过检索到的视听嵌入增强缺失模态条件下的语义补全。
Result: 在 MER-UniBench 基准上的大量实验表明，AffectAgent 在复杂场景下取得了优越的情感识别性能；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 摘要认为通过智能体间的协作决策与检索增强，可以有效提升跨模态复杂情感理解能力；代码将在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Modal Learning meets Genetic Programming: Analyzing Alignment in Latent Space Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover mathematical expressions from data, a task traditionally tackled using Genetic Programming (GP) through combinatorial search over symbolic structures. Latent Space Optimization (LSO) methods use neural encoders to map symbolic expressions into continuous spaces, transforming the combinatorial search into continuous optimization. SNIP (Meidani et al., 2024), a contrastive pre-training model inspired by CLIP, advances LSO by introducing a multi-modal approach: aligning symbolic and numeric encoders in a shared latent space to learn the phenotype-genotype mapping, enabling optimization in the numeric space to implicitly guide symbolic search. However, this relies on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, whereas literature on similar models like CLIP reveals that such an alignment is typically coarse-grained. In this paper, we investigate whether SNIP delivers on its promise of effective bi-modal optimization for SR. Our experiments show that: (1) cross-modal alignment does not improve during optimization, even as fitness increases, and (2) the alignment learned by SNIP is too coarse to efficiently conduct principled search in the symbolic space. These findings reveal that while multi-modal LSO holds significant potential for SR, effective alignment-guided optimization remains unrealized in practice, highlighting fine-grained alignment as a critical direction for future work.
papers.comment: Accepted at PPSN 2026 (Trento, Italy). To appear in Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究潜在空间优化 (LSO) 框架 SNIP 在符号回归 (SR) 中的应用，SNIP 采用类 CLIP 的对比预训练，对齐符号编码器与数值编码器以在共享潜在空间中实现双模态优化。实验发现跨模态对齐在优化过程中并未随适应度提高而改善，且 SNIP 学习的对齐过于粗糙，无法有效指导符号空间中的原则性搜索。作者据此认为多模态 LSO 有潜力但有效的对齐引导优化尚未实现，细粒度对齐是未来关键方向。
Motivation: SNIP 声称通过多模态对齐学习表型-基因型映射，可在数值空间优化以隐式指导符号搜索，但现有文献（如 CLIP）表明此类跨模态对齐通常是粗粒度的，因此需要检验 SNIP 是否真正实现了有效的双模态优化。
Method: 对 SNIP 在符号回归任务上的多模态潜在空间优化进行实证分析，重点考察优化过程中跨模态对齐的动态变化，以及学习到的对齐粒度是否足以支撑符号空间中的搜索。
Result: 实验表明：(1) 即使适应度提升，跨模态对齐质量在优化过程中并未改善；(2) SNIP 习得的对齐过于粗糙，不足以进行高效的符号空间原则性搜索。
Conclusion: 多模态 LSO 对符号回归具有显著潜力，但当前 SNIP 架构下的对齐引导优化在实践中尚未实现，作者将细粒度对齐列为未来研究的关键方向。

papers.title: SHIELD: A Segmented Hierarchical Memory Architecture for Energy-Efficient LLM Inference on Edge NPUs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) inference on edge Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is fundamentally constrained by limited on-chip memory capacity. Although high-density embedded DRAM (eDRAM) is attractive for storing activation workspaces, its periodic refresh consumes substantial energy. Prior work has primarily focused on reducing off-chip traffic or optimizing refresh for persistent Key-Value (KV) caches, while transient and error-resilient Query and Attention Output (QO) activations are largely overlooked. We propose SHIELD, a lifecycle-aware segmented eDRAM architecture that jointly exploits temporal residency and bit-level sensitivity in bfloat16 (BF16) activations. SHIELD isolates the sign and exponent fields from the mantissa, disables refresh for transient QO mantissas, and applies relaxed refresh to persistent KV mantissas. Across multiple LLMs and inference scenarios, SHIELD reduces eDRAM refresh energy by 35% relative to a standard-refresh baseline while preserving accuracy on WikiText-2, PIQA, and ARC-Easy.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SHIELD，一种面向边缘 NPU 上 LLM 推理的分段层次化 eDRAM 架构，旨在降低片上存储的刷新能耗。SHIELD 利用 bfloat16 激活的时间驻留性与位级敏感性，将符号位和指数位与尾数分离，对短暂存活的 Query/Attention Output 尾数禁用刷新，并对持久存活的 KV 缓存尾数采用宽松刷新。摘要报告在多个 LLM 和推理场景下，eDRAM 刷新能耗较标准刷新基线降低 35%，同时在 WikiText-2、PIQA 和 ARC-Easy 上保持准确率。
Motivation: 边缘 NPU 上的 LLM 推理受限于片上存储容量，高密度 eDRAM 虽适合存储激活工作区，但其周期性刷新消耗大量能量；先前工作主要关注减少片外流量或优化 KV 缓存的刷新，而忽视了短暂存在且具有错误鲁棒性的 Query 和 Attention Output 激活。
Method: 提出生命周期感知的分段 eDRAM 架构，联合利用 BF16 激活的时间驻留性和位级敏感性：将符号位与指数位从尾数中隔离，对短暂存活的 QO 尾数禁用刷新，对持久存活的 KV 尾数应用放宽的刷新策略。
Result: 在多个 LLM 和推理场景下，与标准刷新基线相比，eDRAM 刷新能耗降低 35%，并在 WikiText-2、PIQA 和 ARC-Easy 基准上保持准确率。
Conclusion: 通过同时利用激活的时间驻留性和位级敏感性，可以显著降低 eDRAM 刷新能耗而不损失推理精度；该方法针对边缘 NPU 上的 LLM 推理场景设计。

papers.title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs. We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs and 4 PL pairs. Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCodeAgent，一种面向仓库级代码翻译与验证的自主多智能体 (multi-agent) 工作流，用户只需提供源语言项目和目标语言即可自动完成整个仓库的翻译与验证。作者在 118 个真实项目、平均每个项目 1,975 行代码和 43 个翻译单元、覆盖 6 种编程语言和 4 个语言对的基准上与四种神经符号及智能体方法比较，报告测试通过率提升 60.8%，平均成本约 15.3 美元。论文还通过过程分析对比多智能体与单智能体架构，发现单智能体使测试通过率平均下降 40.4% 且轨迹变长。
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码翻译与验证技术大多只在单一源-目标编程语言对上评估，适配新语言对需要大量工程工作，缺乏真正语言无关的自动化方案。
Method: ReCodeAgent 采用自主多智能体工作流，利用编程智能体跨多种语言生成代码，并自动调用各语言特有的分析工具，实现无需人工干预的仓库级翻译与验证。
Result: 在 118 个真实项目上，ReCodeAgent 在翻译正确性上持续优于四种基线方法，ground-truth 测试的测试通过率提升 60.8%，平均成本为 15.3 美元；将多智能体替换为单智能体后，测试通过率平均下降 40.4%，轨迹平均变长 28% 且效率持续低下。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ReCodeAgent 是首个在多种编程语言间实现高翻译成功率的仓库级方法，并强调多智能体架构选择对性能与过程效率有显著影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Model Predictive Control of a Turbofan Engine
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for multivariable control of a two-spool turbofan engine. A physics-based component-level model is developed to generate training data and validate the controllers. A meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition is adapted, with a cost function designed to accurately capture both spool-speed dynamics and the engine pressure ratio (EPR), enabling the construction of a single Koopman model that can be reused across multiple control strategies. Using the identified time-varying Koopman model, an adaptive Koopman-based model predictive controller (AKMPC) with a disturbance observer is developed and compared with a Koopman-based feedback linearization controller (K-FBLC) and its integrator-augmented version (K-FBLC-I). The Koopman representation further enables nonlinear GTE output limiters, such as rotor-acceleration and turbine-inlet-temperature limits, to be expressed as linear constraints in the AKMPC. The controllers are evaluated for two control configurations of spool speeds and EPR, under both sea-level and varying flight conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed identification approach enables accurate predictions of both spool speeds and EPR, allowing the Koopman model to be reused flexibly across different control formulations. While all strategies achieve comparable performance in sea-level conditions, the AKMPC demonstrates improved performance under varying flight conditions due to its ability to capture nonlinear dynamics, handle constraints, and compensate for model mismatch. Moreover, the EPR control strategy improves the thrust response. The study highlights the applicability of Koopman-based control and the advantages of the AKMPC framework for robust turbofan engine control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 Koopman 算子的双转子涡扇发动机多变量控制。作者构建物理部件级模型生成训练数据，提出一种元启发式扩展动态模态分解，以同时刻画转子转速与发动机压比 (EPR)，得到可复用于多种控制策略的单个 Koopman 模型。基于该时变 Koopman 模型，开发了带扰动观测器的自适应 Koopman 模型预测控制器 (AKMPC)，并与 Koopman 反馈线性化控制器 (K-FBLC) 及其积分增广版本 (K-FBLC-I) 对比，并在海平面和变化飞行条件下评估。
Motivation: 涡扇发动机控制需要同时处理非线性动态、多变量耦合与安全约束，传统线性化方法难以在宽飞行包线内保持精度，且不同控制策略往往需要各自重新辨识模型，缺乏可复用的统一表示。
Method: 提出一种元启发式扩展动态模式分解 (meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition)，其代价函数同时拟合转子转速动态和 EPR；利用辨识得到的时变 Koopman 模型构建自适应模型预测控制器 (AKMPC)，并加入扰动观测器补偿模型失配。Koopman 表示将转子加速度限制和涡轮进口温度限制等非线性约束表达为 AKMPC 中的线性约束。
Result: 摘要报告该辨识方法能准确预测转速与 EPR，使 Koopman 模型可灵活复用于不同控制公式；在海平面条件下各策略性能相当，而在变化飞行条件下 AKMPC 因能捕捉非线性动态、处理约束并补偿模型失配而表现更优；EPR 控制策略改善了推力响应。
Conclusion: 研究强调 Koopman 控制在鲁棒涡扇发动机控制中的适用性，并指出 AKMPC 框架在变化工况下相比反馈线性化方案的优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: From Understanding to Erasing: Towards Complete and Stable Video Object Removal
papers.abstract_en: Video object removal aims to erase target objects while reconstructing visually plausible and temporally coherent content. However, target objects often induce shadows, reflections, illumination changes and other effects that extend beyond the provided mask, making conventional mask-conditioned completion prone to visible residuals. We therefore formulate side-effect-aware object removal as an understanding-guided process that integrates object--effect relations, affected-region localization, and context-aware reconstruction. Specifically, we introduce Object-Induced Relation Distillation to transfer token-level object--effect relations from a pretrained vision foundation model to the video diffusion model. We then design Object-aware Framewise Context Cross-Attention to combine target-object semantics with per-frame background context for removal and reconstruction, and propose Attention-guided Region Localization to derive a soft spatial prior over the target object and its affected regions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves more complete object-and-effect removal and outperforms existing approaches in removal quality, side-effect suppression, and temporal consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向视频物体移除 (video object removal) 的理解引导式方法，把目标物体引发的阴影、反射、光照变化等超出掩码范围的影响纳入建模。方法包含 Object-Induced Relation Distillation、Object-aware Framewise Context Cross-Attention 和 Attention-guided Region Localization 三个组件，并在多个基准上取得更完整的物体与影响区域移除效果。
Motivation: 目标物体常带来阴影、反射、光照变化等超出给定掩码范围的副作用，传统基于掩码条件的补全方法会留下可见残差，因此需要显式建模物体与其影响区域之间的关系。
Method: 将副作用感知的物体移除建模为理解引导的过程：用 Object-Induced Relation Distillation 把预训练视觉基础模型的 token 级物体-影响关系迁移到视频扩散模型；用 Object-aware Framewise Context Cross-Attention 结合目标物体语义与逐帧背景上下文；用 Attention-guided Region Localization 生成覆盖目标物体及其影响区域的软空间先验。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法能实现更完整的物体与影响放大区域的移除，并在移除质量、副作用抑制和时间一致性上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调理解物体与其诱导影响之间的关系是实现完整且稳定的视频物体移除的关键。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 将副作用感知的物体移除建模为理解引导的过程：用 Object-Induced Relation Distillation 把预训练视觉基础模型的 token 级物体-影响关系迁移到视频扩散模型；用 Object-aware Framewise Context Cross-Attention 结合目标物体语义与逐帧背景上下文；用 Attention-guided Region Localization 生成覆盖目标物体及其影响区域的软空间先验。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法能实现更完整的物体与影响放大区域的移除，并在移除质量、副作用抑制和时间一致性上优于现有方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调理解物体与其诱导影响之间的关系是实现完整且稳定的视频物体移除的关键。

papers.title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid growth of e-commerce, exploring general representations rather than task-specific ones has attracted increasing attention. Although recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have driven significant progress in product understanding, they are typically employed as feature extractors that implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. Therefore, we argue that leveraging the reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to explicitly model fine-grained product attributes holds significant potential. Nevertheless, achieving this goal remains non-trivial due to several key challenges: (i) long-context reasoning tends to dilute the model's attention to salient information in the raw input; (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) primarily encourages rigid imitation, limiting the exploration of effective reasoning strategies; and (iii) fine-grained details are progressively attenuated during forward propagation. To address these issues, we propose MOON3.0, the first reasoning-aware MLLM-based model for product representation learning. Our method (1) employs a multi-head modality fusion module to adaptively integrate raw signals; (2) incorporates a joint contrastive and reinforcement learning framework to autonomously explore more effective reasoning strategies; and (3) introduces a fine-grained residual enhancement module to progressively preserve local details throughout the network. Additionally, we release a large-scale multimodal e-commerce benchmark MBE3.0. Experimentally, our model demonstrates state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across various downstream tasks on both our benchmark and public datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM), 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOON3.0，一个面向电商商品表示学习的推理感知多模态大模型（MLLM）方法，旨在显式建模细粒度商品属性而非仅依赖全局嵌入。方法包括多头模态融合模块、联合对比与强化学习框架，以及细粒度残差增强模块，并发布了多模态电商基准 MBE3.0。实验表明模型在自建及公开基准的多个下游任务上取得零样本最优性能。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型常被当作特征提取器，将商品信息隐式编码为全局嵌入，难以捕捉细粒度属性；作者认为利用 MLLM 的推理能力显式建模细粒度属性具有潜力，但面临长上下文注意力稀释、SFT 导致机械模仿、前向传播中细节逐渐衰减等挑战。
Method: 提出 MOON3.0，包含三部分：(1) 多头模态融合模块自适应整合原始信号；(2) 联合对比学习（contrastive learning）与强化学习框架以自主探索有效推理策略；(3) 细粒度残差增强模块在网络中逐步保留局部细节。同时构建并发布大规模多模态电商基准 MBE3.0。
Result: 摘要报告在自建基准 MBE3.0 和公开数据集上的多个下游任务中，MOON3.0 取得了零样本（zero-shot）性能的最优结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为推理感知的 MLLM 表示学习可有效改善电商商品细粒度理解，并强调其方法与基准的可用性；摘要未提及方法在非电商领域或推理成本方面的局限。

papers.title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
papers.abstract_en: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures at a fraction of the cost. Our findings suggest that simple, flexible programmatic interfaces combined with strong foundation models should be the backbone of enterprise automation.
papers.comment: Pre-print. Under review. 51 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战企业自动化中复杂智能体架构的必要性，提出仅配备终端 (terminal) 和文件系统 (filesystem) 的编码智能体 (coding agent) 可直接调用平台 API 完成企业任务。作者在多个真实系统上评估该假设，发现这种低层终端智能体以低得多的成本达到或超过更复杂的智能体架构（如基于 Model Context Protocol 的工具增强智能体和图形界面网页智能体）。结论主张以简单灵活的程序化接口配合强基础模型作为企业自动化的主干。
Motivation: 现有企业自动化方向包含基于 MCP 等抽象的工具增强智能体和通过图形界面操作的网页智能体，但这类复杂系统带来成本与运维开销，其必要性尚不明确。
Method: 提出使用仅具备终端和文件系统的编码智能体，直接与平台 API 交互来执行企业任务，并将其与更复杂的智能体架构进行对比评估。
Result: 在多样化真实系统上的评估显示，低层终端智能体匹配或超越更复杂的智能体架构，且成本仅为后者的一小部分。
Conclusion: 作者认为简单、灵活的程序化接口与强基础模型的组合应成为企业自动化的核心基础；摘要未报告具体数字或局限性。

papers.title: SleepVLM: A Rule-Grounded Vision-Language Model for Auditable Sleep Staging
papers.abstract_en: Sleep staging is essential for sleep assessment and disorder diagnosis. In recent years, automatic sleep staging systems have achieved accuracy approaching that of human experts, but the black-box nature of their predictions hinders clinical adoption. Existing interpretability methods offer partial insight into model behavior, but their outputs still require expert reinterpretation and do not provide a direct basis for auditing individual predictions. To improve trustworthiness, we propose the task of auditable sleep staging. To solve this task, we present SleepVLM, a vision-language model that casts sleep staging as visual reasoning over rendered polysomnography (PSG) waveform images. For each epoch, SleepVLM outputs a stage together with the applicable American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) rules and an auditable rationale. The model is trained using a two-stage framework: Waveform-Perceptual Pre-training followed by Rule-Grounded Supervised Fine-tuning over a mixture of fine-grained and coarse annotations. Experiments on four datasets show that SleepVLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on average. An automated AASM-feature audit shows broad coverage of stage-defining evidence in the rationales, and independent experts validate their reasoning quality. To facilitate further research, we construct and release MASS-EX, an expert-annotated dataset for rule-grounded sleep staging with AASM rule annotations and expert-written rationales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SleepVLM，一个将睡眠分期建模为对渲染后的多导睡眠图（PSG）波形图像进行视觉推理的视觉-语言模型（vision-language model）。对每个 epoch，模型输出分期结果、适用的美国睡眠医学学会（AASM）规则以及可审计的理由。训练采用两阶段框架：波形感知预训练（Waveform-Perceptual Pre-training）和规则接地监督微调（Rule-Grounded Supervised Fine-tuning）。在四个数据集上平均优于现有方法，并构建发布了专家标注数据集 MASS-EX。
Motivation: 自动睡眠分期系统的准确率已接近人类专家，但其黑箱预测阻碍临床采用；现有可解释性方法只能提供部分模型行为洞察，仍需专家重新解读，无法直接审计单个预测。作者因此提出可审计睡眠分期（auditable sleep staging）这一任务。
Method: SleepVLM 将睡眠分期视为对 PSG 波形图像的视觉推理，为每个 epoch 输出分期、适用的 AASM 规则和可审计理由。模型采用两阶段训练：波形感知预训练之后，在细粒度和粗粒度混合标注上进行规则接地监督微调。
Result: 在四个数据集上的实验显示，SleepVLM 平均优于现有最先进方法。自动 AASM 特征审计表明理由对阶段定义证据覆盖广泛，独立专家也验证了推理质量；作者还构建并发布了带 AASM 规则标注和专家理由的 MASS-EX 数据集。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基于规则的可审计理由能为单个预测提供直接审计依据，从而提升临床信任度；发布 MASS-EX 数据集以促进规则接地睡眠分期研究。

papers.title: Is Monitoring Enough? Strategic Agent Selection For Stealthy Attack in Multi-Agent Discussions
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent discussions have been widely adopted, motivating growing efforts to develop attacks that expose their vulnerabilities. In this work, we study a practical yet largely unexplored attack scenario, the discussion-monitored scenario, where anomaly detectors continuously monitor inter-agent communications and block detected adversarial messages. Although existing attacks are effective without discussion monitoring, we show that they exhibit detectable patterns and largely fail under such monitoring constraints. But does this imply that monitoring alone is sufficient to secure multi-agent discussions? To answer this question, we develop a novel attack method explicitly tailored to the discussion-monitored scenario. Extensive experiments demonstrate that effective attacks remain possible even under continuous monitoring, indicating that monitoring alone does not eliminate adversarial risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体讨论在受监控场景下的对抗攻击问题。作者指出，现有攻击在异常检测器持续监控并拦截对抗消息的约束下会表现出可检测模式并大多失效；但作者据此提出一种专门针对该讨论监控场景的新型攻击方法，实验显示即使在持续监控下有效攻击仍然可行，说明仅靠监控不足以保障多智能体讨论的安全。
Motivation: 多智能体讨论被广泛采用，但其安全漏洞研究尚不充分；此前攻击未考虑讨论监控场景，而实际部署中异常检测器会持续监控并阻断对抗消息。作者希望回答“仅监控是否足以保证安全”这一关键问题。
Method: 提出一种专门针对讨论监控（discussion-monitored）场景的对抗攻击方法，旨在绕过持续通信监控而保持隐蔽性；摘要未给出该方法的内部机制细节，但明确其以监控场景为设计目标，区别于现有在无监控假设下工作的攻击。
Result: 实验表明，现有攻击在持续监控下大多失败并呈现可检测模式；而新提出的攻击方法在持续监控条件下仍能实现有效攻击，表明监控无法完全消除对抗风险。
Conclusion: 作者强调监测本身不足以保障多智能体讨论的安全，对抗风险在监控下依然存在，需要进一步防御措施；摘要未给出具体局限或扩展方向。

papers.title: RiboSphere: Learning Unified and Efficient Representations of RNA Structures
papers.abstract_en: Accurate RNA structure modeling remains difficult because RNA backbones are highly flexible, non-canonical interactions are prevalent, and experimentally determined 3D structures are comparatively scarce. We introduce RiboSphere, a framework that learns discrete geometric representations of RNA by combining vector quantization with flow matching. Our design is motivated by the modular organization of RNA architecture: complex folds are composed from recurring structural motifs. RiboSphere uses a geometric transformer encoder trained using mean-centered coordinates and random rotation augmentation to produce geometry-aware features, which are discretized with finite scalar quantization (FSQ) into a finite vocabulary of latent codes. Conditioned on these discrete codes, a flow-matching decoder reconstructs atomic coordinates, enabling high-fidelity structure generation. We find that the learned code indices are enriched for specific RNA motifs, suggesting that the model captures motif-level compositional structure rather than acting as a purely compressive bottleneck. Across benchmarks, RiboSphere achieves strong performance in structure reconstruction (RMSD 1.25,Å, TM-score 0.84), and its pretrained discrete representations transfer effectively to inverse folding and RNA--ligand binding prediction, with robust generalization in data-scarce regimes. Code is available at https://github.com/Zhangz312/RiboSphere.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RiboSphere，一种结合向量量化 (vector quantization) 与流匹配 (flow matching) 的 RNA 结构离散几何表示学习框架。模型用几何 transformer 编码器（均值中心化坐标与随机旋转增强）提取特征，经有限标量量化 (FSQ) 离散成语码，再由流匹配解码器重建原子坐标。摘要报告结构重建 RMSD 1.25 Å、TM-score 0.84，且预训练离散表示可迁移到逆折叠与 RNA-配体结合预测。
Motivation: RNA 骨架柔性高、非规范相互作用普遍且实验测定的 3D 结构稀缺，导致准确建模困难；作者利用 RNA 由重复结构基序组成的模块化组织，提出以离散几何码为中间表示的建模思路。
Method: RiboSphere 使用几何 transformer 编码器，配合均值中心化坐标和随机旋转增强生成几何感知特征，再用有限标量量化 (FSQ) 将特征离散化到有限的潜在码本；以这些离散码为条件，流匹配解码器重建原子坐标，实现高保真结构生成。
Result: 摘要报告结构重建取得 RMSD 1.25 Å、TM-score 0.84；学到的码索引富集于特定 RNA 基序，表明模型捕捉到基序级组合结构。预训练离散表示在逆折叠和 RNA-配体结合预测上迁移良好，并在数据稀缺场景下表现稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法不是纯压缩瓶颈，而是学到基序级组合结构，并在重建与多种下游任务上取得强性能；代码已开源。

papers.title: SEAR: Simple and Efficient Adaptation of Visual Geometric Transformers for Unpaired RGB+Thermal 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Foundational feed-forward visual geometry models enable accurate and efficient camera pose estimation and scene reconstruction by learning strong scene priors from massive RGB datasets. However, their effectiveness drops when applied to mixed sensing modalities, such as RGB-thermal (RGB-T) images. We observe that while a visual geometry grounded transformer pretrained on RGB data generalizes well to thermal-only reconstruction, it struggles to align RGB and thermal modalities when processed jointly. To address this, we propose SEAR, a simple yet efficient fine-tuning strategy that adapts a pretrained geometry transformer to multimodal RGB-T inputs. Despite being trained on a relatively small RGB-T dataset, our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for 3D reconstruction and camera pose estimation, achieving significant improvements over all metrics and delivering higher detail and consistency between modalities with negligible overhead in inference time compared to the original pretrained model. Notably, SEAR enables reliable multimodal pose estimation and reconstruction even under challenging conditions, such as low lighting and dense smoke. We validate our architecture through extensive ablation studies and demonstrate how the model aligns both modalities. Additionally, we introduce a new dataset featuring RGB and thermal sequences captured at different times, viewpoints, and illumination conditions, providing a robust benchmark for future work in multimodal 3D scene reconstruction. Code and models are publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/ZENODO.21077295.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEAR，一种简单高效的微调策略，将预训练的视觉几何 Transformer（visual geometry transformer）适配到未配对的 RGB+Thermal 多模态 3D 重建任务。作者观察到，RGB 预训练的几何模型在纯热成像重建上泛化良好，但在联合处理 RGB 与热成像时难以对齐两种模态。SEAR 在较小的 RGB-T 数据集上训练，显著提升相机位姿估计与 3D 重建精度，并能在低光照和浓烟等挑战性条件下保持可靠性能；作者还发布了新的多时间、多视角、多光照 RGB-T 数据集。
Motivation: 基于大规模 RGB 数据预训练的前馈视觉几何模型在混合传感模态（如 RGB-热成像）下效果显著下降，尤其是当 RGB 与热成像被联合处理时模态对齐困难。
Method: 提出一种简单高效的微调策略 SEAR，将预训练几何 Transformer 适配到多模态 RGB-T 输入；模型在相对较小的 RGB-T 数据集上训练，并配合作者新引入的 RGB-T 序列数据集进行验证。
Result: 摘要报告在 3D 重建和相机位姿估计上全面超越现有方法（所有指标均有显著提升），重建细节和模态间一致性更高，推理时间相比原始预训练模型几乎无额外开销；在低光照和浓烟条件下仍能可靠工作。
Conclusion: SEAR 以极小的推理代价实现了可靠的 RGB-T 多模态位姿估计与重建，并提供了公开的代码、模型和新的多模态重建基准数据集。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Investigating How the Fractions Skill Score and Brier Divergence Skill Score Reflect Forecast Error
papers.abstract_en: Meaningful scores for forecast verification are essential for developing reliable forecasts, and there has been much effort to develop scores that align well with human perceptions of forecast quality. Whilst many of these scores have intuitive interpretations, relatively little is known about how these scores rank different forecasts, and how scores reflect forecast error. We theoretically explore the behaviour of two scores that fall within the `neighbourhood' paradigm of spatial verification; the Fractions Skill Score (FSS) and Brier Divergence Skill Score (BDnSS). We investigate how each score ranks forecasts with two types of error; errors in the mean frequency (corresponding to intensity or shape errors) and errors in the standard deviation (corresponding to errors in spatial structure, such as blurring or excess noise). We find that under many situations the FSS assigns higher scores to forecasts that over-predict mean frequency, thus theoretically confirming the need to use the FSS with percentile thresholds. Both scores generally assign higher scores to forecasts with lower neighbourhood standard deviation, a reflection of the `double penalty' problem; however, we observe that size of this effect is larger for the BDnSS than the FSS, showing that the FSS under some situations is less susceptible to the double penalty problem than the BDnSS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上探讨空间验证中邻域类 (neighbourhood) 评分 Fractions Skill Score (FSS) 与 Brier Divergence Skill Score (BDnSS) 如何对两类预报误差进行排序：平均频率误差（对应强度或形状误差）和标准差误差（对应空间结构误差，如模糊或过度噪声）。摘要发现 FSS 在许多情景下会给高估平均频率的预报更高分数，从而理论证实 FSS 需要配合百分位阈值使用；两种评分通常都会给邻域标准差更低的预报更高分，反映 double penalty 问题，但该效应在 BDnSS 上比 FSS 更明显。
Motivation: 许多验证评分虽然具有直观解释，但关于这些评分如何对不同预报排序、如何反映预报误差的研究较少，这会影响评分选择与预报开发。
Method: 采用理论分析方法，考察 FSS 与 BDnSS 这两类空间验证评分在两类误差设定（平均频率误差与标准差误差）下的排序行为。
Result: 摘要报告 FSS 在多数情形下偏好过度预测平均频率的预报；两种评分均偏好较低邻域标准差的预报，且该偏好效应在 BDnSS 上更大，说明 FSS 在某些情况下对 double penalty 问题不如 BDnSS 敏感。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需将 FSS 与百分位阈值结合使用，并揭示了 FSS 与 BDnSS 在 double penalty 问题上的敏感性差异。
Relevance: 86

papers.title: Seeking Physics in Diffusion Noise
papers.abstract_en: Do video diffusion models encode signals predictive of physical plausibility? We probe intermediate denoising representations of pretrained Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) and find that physically plausible and implausible videos are partially separable in mid-layer feature space, even at high noise levels. Within-source and perceptual-quality controls suggest that this signal is not fully explained by generator identity or generic visual quality. We distill the signal into a lightweight, backbone-specific physics verifier trained on frozen features and use it in two complementary inference-time mechanisms under a fixed multi-trajectory budget: progressive trajectory selection, which scores trajectories at intermediate checkpoints and prunes weak candidates early, and reward-gradient guidance, which steers surviving trajectories by backpropagating through only the first few DiT blocks. Experiments on PhyGenBench and Physics-IQ across CogVideoX-2B/5B and Wan 2.1-14B show that progressive selection matches verifier-based Best-of-4 on CogVideoX-2B while reducing wall-clock inference time by 37%, whereas reward-gradient guidance substantially improves physical consistency on CogVideoX-5B, all without fine-tuning the video generator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究预训练视频扩散模型（Diffusion Transformers, DiTs）的中间去噪表示是否编码与物理合理性相关的信号。作者发现物理合理与不合理的视频在中层特征空间中部分可分，即使在较高噪声水平下也存在此信号，并通过控制实验排除其完全来自生成器身份或通用视觉质量。作者将该信号蒸馏为轻量级、骨干网络特定的物理验证器，并用于两种互补的推理时机制：渐进式轨迹选择（progressive trajectory selection）和奖励梯度引导（reward-gradient guidance）。在 PhyGenBench 和 Physics-IQ 基准及 CogVideoX-2B/5B、Wan 2.1-14B 上的实验表明，这些机制无需微调视频生成器即可改善物理一致性或推理效率。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型生成的内容常缺乏物理合理性，但人们不清楚预训练模型内部是否已经隐含了足以判别物理合理性的信号。若该信号存在，就可以在不重新训练生成器的情况下加以利用，提升生成视频的物理一致性。
Method: 作者探测预训练 DiTs 的中间去噪表示，训练一个基于冻结特征的轻量级、骨干网络特定的物理验证器；然后在固定多轨迹预算下使用两种推理时机制：在中间检查点对轨迹打分并提前剪枝的渐进式轨迹选择，以及仅通过前几个 DiT 块反向传播来引导幸存轨迹的奖励梯度引导。
Result: 摘要报告在 PhyGenBench 和 Physics-IQ 上，对 CogVideoX-2B/5B 和 Wan 2.1-14B 的实验显示：渐进式选择在 CogVideoX-2B 上达到基于验证器的 Best-of-4 效果，同时减少 37% 的端到端推理时间；奖励梯度引导在 CogVideoX-5B 上显著提升物理一致性，且全程无需微调视频生成器。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预训练视频扩散模型的中层特征已经携带部分可用的物理合理性信号，可以通过冻结特征的验证器与推理时机制来利用，从而在固定计算预算内提升物理一致性或降低推理开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Imitation Learning from Human Motion Alone Does Not Guarantee Biomechanically Plausible Gait Kinetics
papers.abstract_en: Motion imitation learning (IL) is increasingly used in robotics and human gait modeling, yet its ability to recover biomechanically consistent joint moments without explicit kinetic information remains unclear. In this study, we examined whether motion imitation alone can estimate reasonable biological joint moments. We compare motion-only IL (MOIL) against a kinetics-aware IL (KAIL) framework that incorporates ground reaction forces (GRF) and center of pressure (CoP) in imitation rewards, with an ablation study to examine the contribution of each kinetic term. Experiments were conducted using walking data from a non-disabled participant at three speeds (0.9, 1.2, and 1.5 m/s). While both MOIL and KAIL achieved comparable kinematic tracking accuracy, MOIL exhibited substantially larger errors in GRF, CoP, and joint moment estimates relative to inverse dynamics references. In contrast, KAIL produced kinetics more consistent with biomechanical values. These findings highlight a fundamental limitation of MOIL approaches, which may lead to erroneous interpretations of gait biomechanics and downstream applications by failing to estimate consistent human-like gait kinetics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅靠运动模仿学习 (motion imitation learning, IL) 是否能在没有显式动力学信息的情况下恢复生物力学上合理的关节力矩。作者比较了仅运动 IL (MOIL) 与在模仿奖励中加入地面反作用力 (GRF) 和压力中心 (CoP) 的动力学感知 IL (KAIL)，并使用一名非残障受试者在 0.9、1.2 和 1.5 m/s 三种速度下的行走数据进行实验。结果显示两者运动学跟踪精度相近，但 MOIL 在 GRF、CoP 和关节力矩估计上相对逆动力学参考值有显著更大误差，而 KAIL 得到的动力学更符合生物力学数值。
Motivation: 运动模仿学习在机器人和人体步态建模中应用日益增多，但仅凭运动数据能否恢复生物力学一致的关节力矩尚不清楚；若无法做到，将导致对步态生物力学和下游应用的错误解读。
Method: 对比仅运动 IL (MOIL) 与动力学感知 IL (KAIL)，后者将 GRF 和 CoP 纳入模仿奖励，并通过消融实验分别考察每个动力学项的贡献；实验采用非残障受试者在三种行走速度下的数据。
Result: MOIL 与 KAIL 的运动学跟踪精度相当，但 MOIL 在 GRF、CoP 和关节力矩估计上相对逆动力学参考值表现出明显更大的误差，KAIL 则产生与生物力学数值更一致的动力学结果。
Conclusion: 仅依赖人类运动数据进行模仿学习并不能保证生成生物力学合理的步态动力学，作者强调这一局限性可能导致对步态生物力学及其下游应用的错误解释。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Simultaneous estimation of multiple discrete unimodal distributions under stochastic order constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of estimating multiple discrete unimodal distributions, motivated by search behavior analysis on a real-world platform. To incorporate prior knowledge of precedence relations among distributions, we impose stochastic order constraints and formulate the estimation task as a mixed-integer convex quadratic optimization problem. Experiments on both synthetic and real datasets show that the proposed method reduces the Jensen-Shannon divergence by 2.2% on average (up to 6.3%) when the sample size is small, while performing comparably to existing methods when sufficient data are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在随机序约束下同时估计多个离散单峰分布的问题，动机来自真实平台上的搜索行为分析。作者将估计任务建模为混合整数凸二次优化问题（mixed-integer convex quadratic optimization），并在合成与真实数据上验证。摘要报告在小样本情形下该方法平均将 Jensen-Shannon 散度降低 2.2%（最高 6.3%），而数据充足时与现有方法表现相当。
Motivation: 在搜索行为分析等场景中，需要同时估计多个离散单峰分布，且这些分布之间存在先验的先后次序关系；利用这种随机序约束可以提高估计质量，尤其在小样本情形下。
Method: 作者将分布间的随机序约束（stochastic order constraints）显式加入估计问题，并把任务形式化为一个混合整数凸二次优化问题来求解。
Result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，样本量较小时，所提方法平均降低 Jensen-Shannon 散度 2.2%，最高达 6.3%；当数据量充足时，性能与现有方法相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调随机序约束能够帮助改善小样本下多个离散单峰分布的联合估计，并在数据充裕时保持与已有方法相当的效果。

papers.title: Place-it-R1: Unlocking Environment-aware Reasoning Potential of MLLM for Video Object Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Video object insertion is fundamental to video editing, yet existing diffusion methods often produce visually plausible but physically inconsistent results. We present Place-it-R1, an end-to-end framework for physically plausible video object insertion driven by environment-aware MLLM reasoning. Rather than treating reasoning as a generic text prompt, Place-it-R1 uses the MLLM to analyze the target environment, infer object-scene interactions, and determine where an insertion is physically valid. The resulting reasoning is translated into two complementary forms of guidance for video diffusion: semantic guidance that describes the intended physical interaction and spatial guidance that provides a valid insertion region in each frame. To further align generation with local physical realism, we introduce Spatial Direct Preference Optimization, which leverages an MLLM to rank generated candidates, and introduces a region-aware preference objective that explicitly localizes physical-violation penalties to the inserted-object region. Place-it-R1 further offers flexible and standard modes to trade off environment adaptation and scene preservation. Extensive experiments show that Place-it-R1 produces more physically coherent and visually natural insertions than state-of-the-art methods and achieves competitive results against commercial systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Place-it-R1，一个由环境感知 MLLM 推理驱动的端到端视频物体插入框架。与以往将推理当作通用文本提示的做法不同，它让 MLLM 分析目标环境、推断物体-场景交互并判断物理上有效的插入位置，再把推理结果转化为语义引导和空间引导两种互补的扩散模型条件。作者还引入 Spatial Direct Preference Optimization，用 MLLM 对生成候选排序并施加区域感知偏好目标，把物理违反惩罚定位到插入物体区域；实验表明该方法比现有 SOTA 更物理连贯、视觉自然，并与商业系统竞争相当。
Motivation: 现有视频物体插入的扩散方法往往给出视觉上貌似合理但物理不一致的结果，缺少对环境感知和物理有效插入位置的显式建模。
Method: 端到端框架包含三点：用 MLLM 对目标环境做物理有效的插入分析，生成语义引导（描述预期物理交互）和空间引导（逐帧有效插入区域）；通过 Spatial Direct Preference Optimization 用 MLLM 排序生成候选并引入区域感知偏好目标；提供 flexible 和 standard 两种模式以权衡环境适应与场景保持。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 Place-it-R1 的插入在物理连贯性和视觉自然性上优于 state-of-the-art 方法，并且与商业系统的结果具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 本文表明将环境感知 MLLM 推理显式编码为语义与空间引导，并结合区域感知偏好优化，可以提升视频物体插入的物理一致性；两种模式提供了环境适应与场景保持的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: stratum: A System Infrastructure for Massive Agent-Centric ML Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) transform how machine learning (ML) pipelines are developed and evaluated. LLMs enable a new type of workload, agentic pipeline search, in which autonomous or semi-autonomous agents generate, validate, and optimize complete ML pipelines. These agents predominantly operate over popular Python ML libraries and exhibit highly exploratory behavior. This results in thousands of executions for data profiling, pipeline generation, and iterative refinement of pipeline stages. However, the existing Python-based ML ecosystem is built around libraries such as Pandas and scikit-learn, which are designed for human-centric, interactive, sequential workflows and remain constrained by Python's interpretive execution model, library-level isolation, and limited runtime support for executing large numbers of pipelines. Meanwhile, many high-performance ML systems proposed by the systems community either target narrow workload classes or require specialized programming models, which limits their integration with the Python ML ecosystem and makes them largely ill-suited for LLM-based agents. This growing mismatch exposes a fundamental systems challenge in supporting agentic pipeline search at scale. We therefore propose stratum, a unified system infrastructure that decouples pipeline execution from planning and reasoning during agentic pipeline search. Stratum integrates seamlessly with existing Python libraries, compiles batches of pipelines into optimized execution graphs, and efficiently executes them across heterogeneous backends, including a novel Rust-based runtime. We present stratum's architectural vision along with an early prototype, discuss key design decisions, and outline open challenges and research directions. Finally, preliminary experiments show that stratum can significantly speed up large-scale agentic pipeline search up to 16.6x.
papers.comment: Accepted at PVLDB 2026 (Vol. 19, No. 11). Artifact available on GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 stratum，一个面向大规模 agent-centric ML 工作负载（尤其是 agentic pipeline search）的统一系统基础设施。它将 pipeline 执行与规划/推理解耦，兼容现有 Python 库，把批量 pipeline 编译为优化执行图，并在异构后端（含新的 Rust 运行时）上执行。初步实验表明，该方法可将大规模 agentic pipeline search 加速最高 16.6 倍。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的 agent 会以高度探索性的方式反复执行数据剖析、pipeline 生成与迭代优化，产生数千次执行；而 Pandas、scikit-learn 等 Python 生态为人机交互式顺序工作流设计，受解释执行和库级隔离限制，难以规模化支撑此类负载。系统社区的高性能 ML 系统又往往只覆盖窄负载或要求特殊编程模型，难以与 Python 生态集成。
Method: 提出 stratum 这一系统架构，核心是解耦 pipeline 执行与 agent 的规划/推理过程；它无缝集成现有 Python 库，将成批 pipeline 编译成优化执行图，并通过异构后端（包括新设计的 Rust 运行时）高效执行。论文呈现架构愿景、早期原型、关键设计决策，并讨论开放挑战。
Result: 初步实验显示，stratum 在大规模 agentic pipeline search 上最高可实现 16.6 倍加速。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为架构愿景与早期原型，强调其设计能显著加速大规模 agentic pipeline search，同时指出仍需应对的开放挑战和后续研究方向。

papers.title: Aligning Fetal Anatomy with Kinematic Tree Log-Euclidean PolyRigid Transforms
papers.abstract_en: Automated analysis of articulated bodies is crucial in medical imaging. Existing surface-based models often ignore internal volumetric structures and rely on deformation methods that lack anatomical consistency guarantees. To address this problem, we introduce a differentiable volumetric body model based on the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) formulation, driven by a new Kinematic Tree-based Log-Euclidean PolyRigid (KTPolyRigid) transform. KTPolyRigid resolves Lie algebra ambiguities associated with large, non-local articulated motions, and encourages smooth, bijective volumetric mappings. Evaluated on 53 fetal MRI volumes, KTPolyRigid yields deformation fields with significantly fewer folding artifacts. Furthermore, our framework enables robust groupwise image registration and a label-efficient, template-based segmentation of fetal organs. It provides a robust foundation for standardized volumetric analysis of articulated bodies in medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学影像中关节式身体（articulated bodies）的自动化分析问题，提出一种基于 SMPL (Skinned Multi-Person Linear) 公式的可微分体积身体模型，并使用新的 Kinematic Tree-based Log-Euclidean PolyRigid (KTPolyRigid) 变换来驱动。KTPolyRigid 通过解决大范围非局部关节运动相关的李代数歧义，鼓励平滑且双射的体积映射。在 53 个胎儿 MRI 体数据上的评估显示其变形场折叠伪影显著减少，并支持鲁棒的群组图像配准和基于模板的高标签效率胎儿器官分割。
Motivation: 现有基于表面的身体模型常忽略内部体积结构，且依赖缺乏解剖一致性保证的变形方法，难以满足医学成像中对关节式身体自动化分析的鲁棒性和解剖合理性需求。
Method: 提出一个基于 SMPL 公式的可微分体积身体模型，引入 Kinematic Tree-based Log-Euclidean PolyRigid (KTPolyRigid) 变换，通过运动学树与 Log-Euclidean PolyRigid 构造来解决大范围、非局部关节运动的李代数歧义，并促进平滑、双射的体积映射。
Result: 在 53 个胎儿 MRI 体数据上，KTPolyRigid 生成的变形场折叠伪影显著少于对比方法；该框架还实现了鲁棒的组群图像配准（groupwise image registration）和标签高效的基于模板的胎儿器官分割。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为医学影像中关节式身体的标准体积分析提供了鲁棒基础。
Relevance: 0
