papers.title: Formal Analysis and Supply Chain Security for Agentic AI Skills
papers.abstract_en: 32 pages, 5 theorems with full proofs, 68 references, open-source tool: https://github.com/qualixar/skillfortify. v2: corrects the bibliography (22 entries had author lists that did not match the papers at the cited arXiv identifiers; all verified against the arXiv API and corrected, and affected authors notified) and three external claims against primary sources: MalTool reports 1,300 standalone and 5,727 embedded malicious tools, not 6,487; CVE-2026-25253 is authentication-token exfiltration via an unvalidated gatewayUrl, credited to depthfirst and fixed in 2026.1.29, not remote code execution through a crafted skill package; ClawHavoc counts are 341, later 824, and 1,184 by source and date, not "over 1,200". All experiments re-measured against the released v0.6.0 implementation using harnesses now committed to the repository. E1/E2 unchanged (F1 96.15%). E3 reverses to a negative result: information flow analysis adds no detections over pattern matching on this corpus. The soundness theorem's scope is stated explicitly and no longer conflated with the zero false-positive rate.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 5 theorems with full proofs, 68 references, open-source tool: https://github.com/qualixar/skillfortify
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对智能体 AI 技能（agentic AI skills）的供应链安全进行形式化分析，并发布开源工具 skillfortify。摘要描述了 v2 版本的重要修正：更正 22 条参考文献、订正 MalTool/CVE-2026-25253/ClawHavoc 三处外部数据主张，并基于 v0.6.0 实现重新测量实验。E1/E2 结果不变，F1 为 96.15%；E3 转为负结果，即信息流分析在该语料上相对模式匹配没有新增检测。作者同时明确可靠性定理的适用范围，不再将其与零误报率混为一谈。
Motivation: 智能体 AI 技能的分发与供应链存在安全风险，而现有外部工具统计、漏洞描述和检测方法的效果缺乏可信、可复现的评估基础。本文通过形式化证明与可复现实验来支撑对这类技能的安全分析。
Method: 提出包含 5 个带完整证明定理的形式化分析框架，并开发开源工具 skillfortify；结合模式匹配（pattern matching）与信息流分析（information flow analysis）进行检测，公开实验 harness 和 v0.6.0 实现，并通过 arXiv API 核对参考文献与外部主张。
Result: 摘要报告实验 E1/E2 的 F1 为 96.15% 且保持不变；E3 为负结果，信息流分析在该语料上没有比模式匹配增加检测数量。外部数据被订正为：MalTool 为 1,300 个独立和 5,727 个嵌入式恶意工具，CVE-2026-25253 是经未验证的 gatewayUrl 进行认证令牌外泄而非远程代码执行，ClawHavoc 数量按来源和日期分别为 341、824、1,184。
Conclusion: 作者强调可靠性定理的适用范围应与形式化声明严格对应，不能等同于零误报率；同时指出外部数据源核验和可复现实验对供应链安全研究的重要性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调可靠性定理的适用范围应与形式化声明严格对应，不能等同于零误报率；同时指出外部数据源核验和可复现实验对供应链安全研究的重要性。

papers.title: Flash-VAED: Plug-and-Play VAE Decoders for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models have enabled high-quality video synthesis, yet their inference remains costly and time-consuming. As diffusion transformers become increasingly efficient, the latency bottleneck inevitably shifts to VAE decoders. To reduce their latency while maintaining quality, we propose a universal acceleration framework for VAE decoders that preserves full alignment with the original latent distribution. Specifically, we propose (1) an independence-aware channel pruning method to effectively mitigate severe channel redundancy, and (2) a stage-wise dominant operator optimization strategy to address the high inference cost of the widely used causal 3D convolutions in VAE decoders. Based on these innovations, we construct a Flash-VAED family. Moreover, we design a three-phase dynamic distillation framework that efficiently transfers the capabilities of the original VAE decoder to Flash-VAED. Extensive experiments on Wan and LTX-Video VAE decoders demonstrate that our method outperforms baselines in both quality and speed, achieving approximately a 6$\times$ speedup while maintaining the reconstruction performance up to 96.9%. Notably, Flash-VAED accelerates the end-to-end generation pipeline by up to 36% with negligible quality drops on VBench-2.0. Our code is available at https://github.com/Aoko955/Flash-VAED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对潜在扩散模型视频生成中 VAE 解码器成为推理延迟瓶颈的问题，提出一个通用的即插即用加速框架 Flash-VAED，在保持与原始潜在分布对齐的前提下降低解码器延迟。方法包含基于独立性的通道剪枝 (independence-aware channel pruning) 和针对因果 3D 卷积的分阶段主导算子优化，并设计了三阶段动态蒸馏来迁移原解码器能力。在 Wan 和 LTX-Video VAE 解码器上，该方法在重建性能保持最高 96.9% 的同时实现约 6 倍加速，并使端到端生成管线在 VBench-2.0 上加速最高 36% 且质量损失可忽略。
Motivation: 随着扩散 Transformer 越来越高效，视频生成的推理延迟瓶颈转移到 VAE 解码器，而现有 VAE 解码器存在严重的通道冗余和高昂的因果 3D 卷积计算成本，导致推理耗时且昂贵。
Method: 提出一种 VAE 解码器通用加速框架：一是独立性感知的通道剪枝方法以缓解通道冗余，二是分阶段主导算子优化策略以降低因果 3D 卷积的推理成本；基于这两点构建 Flash-VAED 系列，并设计三阶段动态蒸馏框架来高效迁移原 VAE 解码器的能力。
Result: 在 Wan 和 LTX-Video VAE 解码器上的实验显示，该方法在质量和速度上均优于基线，实现约 6 倍加速，同时重建性能保持最高 96.9%；Flash-VAED 可使端到端视频生成管线在 VBench-2.0 上加速最高 36%，且质量下降可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Flash-VAED 是一个保持原始潜在分布对齐的通用即插即用加速框架，能够在不明显损失重建质量的前提下显著降低 VAE 解码器延迟，并公开了代码。

papers.title: AdaCorrection: Adaptive Offset Cache Correction for Accurate Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art performance in high-fidelity image and video generation but suffer from expensive inference due to their iterative denoising structure. While prior methods accelerate sampling by caching intermediate features, they rely on static reuse schedules or coarse-grained heuristics, which often lead to temporal drift and cache misalignment that significantly degrade generation quality. We introduce \textbf{AdaCorrection}, an adaptive offset cache correction framework that maintains high generation fidelity while enabling efficient cache reuse across Transformer layers during diffusion inference. At each timestep, AdaCorrection estimates cache validity with lightweight spatio-temporal signals and adaptively blends cached and fresh activations. This correction is computed on-the-fly without additional supervision or retraining. Our approach achieves strong generation quality with minimal computational overhead, maintaining near-original FID while providing moderate acceleration. Experiments on image and video diffusion benchmarks show that AdaCorrection consistently improves generation performance. Our code has been integrated into FastCache-xDiT at https://github.com/NoakLiu/FastCache-xDiT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) 在迭代去噪推理中的缓存复用问题，提出自适应偏移缓存校正框架 AdaCorrection。该方法在每个时间步用轻量级时空信号估计缓存有效性，并自适应混合缓存激活与新鲜激活，无需额外监督或重训练。摘要报告其在保持接近原始 FID 的前提下提供中等程度的推理加速，并在图像和视频扩散基准上一致提升生成质量。
Motivation: 现有加速方法通过缓存中间特征来减少计算，但依赖静态复用调度或粗粒度启发式，容易造成时间漂移 (temporal drift) 和缓存错位 (cache misalignment)，显著降低生成质量。论文目标是在高效缓存复用下保持高保真生成。
Method: AdaCorrection 在每个去噪时间步利用轻量级时空信号估计缓存有效性，自适应地将缓存激活与新计算的激活进行混合，实现 Transformer 层间的缓存校正；该校正完全在线计算，不需要额外监督或重训练。
Result: 在图像和视频扩散基准上，AdaCorrection 一致改善生成性能，保持接近原始 FID 的同时带来中等程度的推理加速，且计算开销很小。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能以极小的额外开销实现高效的缓存复用，并将代码集成到 FastCache-xDiT。摘要未报告与天气或降水建模相关的应用。

papers.title: Text2GraphQuery-Bench: A Text to Graph Query Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Graph models are fundamental to data analysis in domains rich with complex relationships. Unlike SQL, which benefits from a rel- atively unified standard and widespread familiarity, graph query languages are diverse (e.g., Cypher, GQL, SQL/PGQ) and far less fa- miliar to most users, making them significantly harder to learn and use. Text-to-Graph-Query systems address this barrier by trans- lating natural language into executable graph queries, enabling LLMs to serve as interfaces for Graph Database Management Systems (GDBMS). Existing benchmarks are limited in language coverage, rely on rigid synthesis, and lack comprehensive evaluation. We present Text2GraphQuery-Bench, the first benchmark covering all mainstream declarative property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL, and SQL/PGQ). It contains 267,276 (Question, Graph Query) pairs across 34 databases and 13 domains. Its construction supports adaptation from heterogeneous resources and domain-aware synthesis, while its Graph-IR-based design enables rapid extension to new languages. The evaluation protocol reports Grammar, GLEU, Similarity, and EX under graph-native difficulty, question abstraction, and schema aliasing. Experiments on 8 LLMs reveal: (i) a significant language gap exists - zero-shot GQL and SQL/PGQ Grammar is far below Cypher, yet few-shot prompting largely recovers it; (ii) fine-tuning an 8B model reaches or exceeds zero-shot large models, indicating unfamiliarity - rather than model capacity - is the primary barrier; (iii) as supervision increases, syntax errors recede, shifting bottlenecks to aggregation logic in GQL and schema linking in SQL/PGQ; (iv) higher question abstraction degrades EX due to intent-to-schema grounding issues, while schema aliasing has minimal impact; (v) EX consistently degrades from Easy to Extra Hard, with Extra Hard remaining a persistent bottleneck. *(Due to arXiv constraints, this abstract is shortened. See PDF for the full version.)*
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text2GraphQuery-Bench，据称是覆盖 Cypher、GQL 与 SQL/PGQ 三种主流声明式属性图查询语言的第一个文本到图查询基准，包含 34 个数据库、13 个领域共 267,276 对 (问题, 图查询) 数据。基准采用 Graph-IR 的设计以支持快速扩展到新语言，并引入 Grammar、GLEU、Similarity 与 EX 指标，在图表原生难度、问题抽象与 schema 别名三种设置下评测。基于 8 个 LLM 的实验揭示出语言不熟悉而非模型能力是主要障碍，并刻画了不同瓶颈随监督量增加而转移的现象。
Motivation: 图查询语言（如 Cypher、GQL、SQL/PGQ）缺乏如 SQL 那样统一的标准与广泛熟悉度，学习使用门槛高；而现有 Text-to-Graph-Query 基准在语言覆盖上有限、依赖僵化的合成方式，并且缺乏全面的评测协议。
Method: 构建了一个跨三种图查询语言的基准 Text2GraphQuery-Bench，其数据构建支持从异构资源适配和领域感知合成 (domain-aware synthesis)，并采用基于 Graph-IR 的设计使新语言扩展变得快速；评测协议在 graph-native difficulty、question abstraction 和 schema aliasing 条件下报告 Grammar、GLEU、Similarity 与 EX 指标。
Result: 在 8 个 LLM 上的实验显示：零样本下 GQL 与 SQL/PGQ 的 Grammar 远低于 Cypher，但 few-shot prompting 基本能弥补该差距；微调 8B 模型可达到或超过零样本大模型；随着监督增加，语法错误减少，瓶颈转向 GQL 中的聚合逻辑与 SQL/PGQ 中的 schema linking；更高的问题抽象程度因意图到 schema 的对齐问题降低 EX，而 schema aliasing 影响很小；EX 从 Easy 到 Extra Hard 持续下降，Extra Hard 仍是持续性瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要认为图查询语言的不熟悉性而非模型容量是主要障碍，并指出不同语言与难度等级下瓶颈有所差异；该基准旨在为图数据库管理系统上的文本到图查询研究提供更全面的评估基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RooflineBench: A Benchmarking Framework for On-Device LLMs via Roofline Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The transition toward localized intelligence through Small Language Models (SLMs) has intensified the need for rigorous performance characterization on resource-constrained edge hardware. However, objectively measuring the theoretical performance ceilings of diverse architectures across heterogeneous platforms remains a formidable challenge. In this work, we propose a systematic framework based on the Roofline model that unifies architectural primitives and hardware constraints through the lens of operational intensity (OI). By defining an inference-potential region, we introduce the Relative Inference Potential as a novel metric to compare efficiency differences between Large Language Models (LLMs) on the same hardware substrate. Extensive empirical analysis across diverse compute tiers reveals that variations in performance and OI are significantly influenced by sequence length. We further identify a critical regression in OI as model depth increases. Additionally, our findings highlight an efficiency trap induced by hardware heterogeneity and demonstrate how structural refinements, such as Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), can effectively unlock latent inference potential across various hardware substrates. These insights provide actionable directions for hardware-software co-design to align neural structures with physical constraints in on-device intelligence. The released code is available in the Appendix C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Roofline 模型的系统化基准框架 RooflineBench，用于在资源受限的边缘硬件上评估小型语言模型（SLM）与大型语言模型（LLM）的理论性能上限。作者通过操作强度（OI）统一架构原语与硬件约束，定义推理潜力区域，并引入相对推理潜力（Relative Inference Potential）作为同一硬件上不同模型效率对比的新指标。实证分析显示序列长度显著影响性能与 OI，模型深度增加会导致 OI 关键回归，并指出硬件异构性带来的效率陷阱以及 MLA 等结构改进的潜力。
Motivation: 随着本地化智能转向小型语言模型，资源受限边缘硬件上的严格性能表征需求增加，但客观衡量异构平台上不同架构的理论性能天花板仍具挑战。
Method: 提出基于 Roofline 模型的框架，通过操作强度（OI）统一考虑架构原语与硬件约束；定义推理潜力区域，并引入相对推理潜力（Relative Inference Potential）指标用于对比同硬件上不同 LLM 的效率差异。
Result: 跨不同计算层级的实证分析表明，性能与 OI 的变化显著受序列长度影响；模型深度增加时 OI 出现关键回归；硬件异构性导致效率陷阱；结构改进如 Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) 能有效解锁不同硬件上的潜在推理能力。
Conclusion: 这些发现为硬件-软件协同设计提供可操作方向，使神经结构更好地对齐物理约束；发布的代码位于附录 C。

papers.title: MemFly: On-the-Fly Memory Optimization via Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory enables large language model agents to tackle complex tasks through historical interactions. However, existing frameworks encounter a fundamental dilemma between compressing redundant information efficiently and maintaining precise retrieval for downstream tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose MemFly, a framework grounded in information bottleneck principles that facilitates on-the-fly memory evolution for LLMs. Our approach minimizes compression entropy while maximizing relevance entropy via a gradient-free optimizer, constructing a stratified memory structure for efficient storage. To fully leverage MemFly, we develop a hybrid retrieval mechanism that seamlessly integrates semantic, symbolic, and topological pathways, incorporating iterative refinement to handle complex multi-hop queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MemFly substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in memory coherence, response fidelity, and accuracy.

papers.title: Data-Aware and Scalable Sensitivity Analysis for Decision Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Decision tree ensembles are widely used in critical domains, making robustness and sensitivity analysis essential to their trustworthiness. We study the feature sensitivity problem, which asks whether an ensemble is sensitive to a specified subset of features -- such as protected attributes -- whose manipulation can alter model predictions. Existing approaches often yield examples of sensitivity that lie far from the training distribution, limiting their interpretability and practical value. We propose a data-aware sensitivity framework that constrains the sensitive examples to remain close to the dataset, thereby producing realistic and interpretable evidence of model weaknesses. To this end, we develop novel techniques for data-aware search using a combination of mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) and satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) encodings. Our contributions are fourfold. First, we strengthen the NP-hardness result for sensitivity verification, showing it holds even for trees of depth 1. Second, we develop MILP-optimizations that significantly speed up sensitivity verification for single ensembles and for the first time can also handle multiclass tree ensembles. Third, we introduce a data-aware framework generating realistic examples close to the training distribution. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental evaluation on large tree ensembles, demonstrating scalability to ensembles with up to 800 trees of depth 8, achieving substantial improvements over the state of the art. This framework provides a practical foundation for analyzing the reliability and fairness of tree-based models in high-stakes applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对决策树集成(decision tree ensembles)的特征敏感性验证问题,提出数据感知(data-aware)的敏感性分析框架,要求搜索到的敏感示例贴近训练分布,以生成可解释的模型弱点证据。作者将问题编码为混合整数线性规划(MILP)与可满足性模理论(SMT)的组合,并给出更紧的 NP-hard 结果、针对多类别集成的优化以及可扩展的求解方法。实验表明该方法可处理多达 800 棵深度为 8 的树集成,并在敏感性验证速度上显著超过现有技术。
Motivation: 现有敏感性分析常产生远离训练分布的示例,难以解释且实用价值有限;而决策树集成在关键领域广泛使用,需要可靠且贴近数据的敏感性证据来评估鲁棒性和公平性。
Method: 提出数据感知敏感性框架,将敏感示例约束在数据集附近;使用 MILP 与 SMT 编码进行搜索,并通过对深度为1的树也成立的 NP-hard 证明、针对单一集成与多类别集成的 MILP 优化来加速验证。
Result: 摘要报告在最多 800 棵树、深度为 8 的大型集成上可扩展,并较现有技术(state of the art)取得显著改进;同时首次支持多类别树集成的敏感性验证。
Conclusion: 该框架为高利害应用中树模型(fairness 和 robustness)分析提供了实用基础;摘要未提及具体实验数据集或数值指标。

papers.title: Can Post-Training Transform LLMs into Causal Reasoners?
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference is essential for decision-making but remains challenging for non-experts. While large language models (LLMs) show promise in this domain, their precise causal estimation capabilities are still limited, and the impact of post-training on these abilities is insufficiently explored. This paper examines the extent to which post-training can enhance LLMs' capacity for causal inference. We introduce CauGym, a comprehensive dataset comprising seven core causal tasks for training and five diverse test sets. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate five post-training approaches: SFT, DPO, KTO, PPO, and GRPO. Across five in-domain and four existing benchmarks, our experiments demonstrate that appropriate post-training enables smaller LLMs to perform causal inference competitively, often surpassing much larger models. Our 14B parameter model achieves 93.5% accuracy on the CaLM benchmark, compared to 55.4% by OpenAI o3. Furthermore, the post-trained LLMs exhibit strong generalization and robustness under real-world conditions such as distribution shifts and noisy data. Collectively, these findings provide the first systematic evidence that targeted post-training can produce reliable and robust LLM-based causal reasoners. Our data and GRPO-model are available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/CauGym.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练 (post-training) 能在多大程度上提升大语言模型 (LLM) 的因果推断能力，并为此引入包含七类核心因果任务和五个测试集的 CauGym 数据集。作者系统评估了 SFT、DPO、KTO、PPO 和 GRPO 五种后训练方法，发现适当的后训练可以让较小的 LLM 在因果推断上具有竞争力，甚至超过更大的模型。14B 参数模型在 CaLM 基准上达到 93.5% 准确率，而 OpenAI o3 为 55.4%；模型在分布偏移和噪声数据等真实条件下也表现出较强的泛化与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 因果推断对决策至关重要，但非专家难以掌握；LLM 在此领域虽有潜力，但精确的因果估计能力仍有限，且后训练对这些能力的影响尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建 CauGym 数据集，包含七个核心因果任务用于训练和五个多样化测试集；在此基础上系统比较五种后训练方法：SFT、DPO、KTO、PPO 与 GRPO。
Result: 实验表明，适当的后训练能使较小的 LLM 以有竞争力的水平完成因果推断，常优于更大模型；14B 模型在 CaLM 基准上取得 93.5% 准确率，对比 OpenAI o3 的 55.4%，并在分布偏移和噪声数据下展现出较强的泛化与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 这是首个系统性证据，表明有针对性的后训练可以产生可靠且鲁棒的基于 LLM 的因果推理器；作者公开了 CauGym 数据与 GRPO 模型。

papers.title: Non-Stationary Inventory Control with Lead Times
papers.abstract_en: We study non-stationary single-item, periodic-review inventory control problems in which the demand distribution is unknown and may change over time. We analyze how demand non-stationarity affects learning performance across inventory models, including systems with demand backlogging or lost-sales, both with and without lead times. For each setting, we propose an adaptive online algorithm that optimizes over the class of base-stock policies and establish performance guarantees in terms of dynamic regret relative to the optimal base-stock policy at each time step. The algorithms leverage the convexity and one-sided feedback structure of inventory costs to enable counterfactual policy evaluation despite demand censoring. In backlogging systems and lost-sales models with zero lead time, our algorithms adapt to unknown demand changes while matching, up to logarithmic factors, the rates known for the corresponding stationary learning problems. In lost-sales systems with positive lead times, the combination of demand censoring and delayed replenishment restricts counterfactual policy evaluation and leads to weaker regret guarantees. We complement the theoretical analysis with simulation results showing that our methods significantly outperform existing non-oracle benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究需求分布未知且随时间变化的非平稳单品类、周期性盘点库存控制问题，分析需求非平稳性对学习性能的影响，覆盖可延期交货与失销、有无提前期（lead time）的模型。作者提出自适应在线算法，在最优点位库存策略（base-stock policy）类上优化，并以动态遗憾（dynamic regret）形式给出相对于每步最优策略的性能保证。仿真表明方法显著优于现有非oracle基准。
Motivation: 现有库存控制学习理论大多假设需求平稳，而实际中需求分布可能随时间变化；非平稳性如何影响学习性能，尤其是在存在提前期和需求审查（demand censoring）时的表现，尚缺乏系统分析。
Method: 针对每种设置提出自适应在线算法，利用库存成本函数的凸性和单侧反馈结构，在需求审查条件下实现反事实策略评估；算法在最优基点库存策略类上优化，并给出动态遗憾上界。
Result: 在可延期交货系统与零提前期的失销模型中，算法适配未知需求变化，且遗憾界（除对数因子外）匹配相应平稳学习问题的已知速率；在正提前期的失销系统中，需求审查与延迟补货共同限制反事实策略评估，导致较弱的遗憾保证。仿真显示方法显著优于现有非oracle基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调非平稳需求下的学习性能取决于需求审查与提前期的交互：零提前期或可延期交货时可达到接近平稳问题的速率，而正提前期失销系统本质上更难。

papers.title: Multi-Task GRPO: Reliable LLM Reasoning Across Tasks
papers.abstract_en: RL-based post-training with GRPO is widely used to improve large language models on individual reasoning tasks. However, real-world deployment requires reliable performance across diverse tasks. A straightforward multi-task adaptation of GRPO often leads to imbalanced outcomes, with some tasks dominating optimization while others stagnate. Moreover, tasks can vary widely in how frequently prompts yield zero advantages (and thus zero gradients), which further distorts their effective contribution to the optimization signal. To address these issues, we propose a novel Multi-Task GRPO (MT-GRPO) algorithm that (i) dynamically adapts task weights to explicitly optimize worst-task performance and promote balanced progress across tasks, and (ii) introduces a ratio-preserving sampler to ensure task-wise policy gradients reflect the adapted weights. Experiments on both 3-task and 9-task settings show that MT-GRPO consistently outperforms baselines in worst-task accuracy. In particular, MT-GRPO achieves 16-28% and 6% absolute improvement on worst-task performance over standard GRPO and DAPO, respectively, while maintaining competitive average accuracy. Moreover, MT-GRPO requires 50% fewer training steps to reach 50% worst-task accuracy in the 3-task setting, demonstrating substantially improved efficiency in achieving reliable performance across tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GRPO 在多任务推理中的不均衡问题，提出 Multi-Task GRPO (MT-GRPO)，动态调整任务权重以优化最差任务表现，并引入 ratio-preserving sampler。在 3 任务和 9 任务设置中，MT-GRPO 相比标准 GRPO 和 DAPO 在最差任务准确率上分别提升 16-28% 和 6%，且平均准确率保持竞争力；3 任务设置下达到 50% 最差任务准确率所需训练步数减少 50%。
Motivation: 现实部署需要 LLM 在多种任务上表现可靠，但 GRPO 直接多任务化会导致任务间不平衡，部分任务支配优化而其他停滞；此外，不同任务生成零 advantage（从而零梯度）的 prompt 频率差异会进一步扭曲优化信号。
Method: 提出 MT-GRPO 算法：(i) 动态调整任务权重以显式优化最差任务性能、促进跨任务均衡进展；(ii) 引入 ratio-preserving sampler，使任务级策略梯度反映调整后的权重。
Result: 在 3 任务和 9 任务设置中，MT-GRPO 在最差任务准确率上持续优于基线；相对标准 GRPO 和 DAPO 分别带来 16-28% 和 6% 的绝对提升，同时保持具有竞争力的平均准确率；3 任务设置中达到 50% 最差任务准确率所需训练步数减少 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MT-GRPO 能显著提高多任务场景下可靠性能的训练效率，说明任务权重自适应与梯度采样校正是提升多任务 RL 后训练均衡性的有效手段。

papers.title: Efficient Training of Boltzmann Generators Using Off-Policy Log-Dispersion Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from unnormalized probability densities is a central challenge in computational science. Boltzmann generators are generative models that enable independent sampling from the Boltzmann distribution of physical systems at a given temperature. However, their practical success depends on data-efficient training, as both simulation data and target energy evaluations are costly. To this end, we propose off-policy log-dispersion regularization (LDR), a novel regularization framework that builds on a generalization of the log-variance objective. We apply LDR in the off-policy setting in combination with standard data-based training objectives, without requiring additional on-policy samples. LDR acts as a shape regularizer of the energy landscape by leveraging additional information in the form of target energy labels. The proposed regularization framework is broadly applicable, supporting unbiased or biased simulation datasets as well as purely variational training without access to target samples. Across all benchmarks, LDR improves both final performance and data efficiency, with sample efficiency gains of up to one order of magnitude.

papers.title: Distributional Active Inference
papers.abstract_en: Optimal control of complex environments with robotic systems faces two complementary and intertwined challenges: efficient organization of sensory state information and far-sighted action planning. Because the reinforcement learning framework addresses only the latter, it tends to deliver sample-inefficient solutions. Active inference is the state-of-the-art process theory that explains how biological brains handle this dual problem. However, its applications to artificial intelligence have thus far been limited to extensions of existing model-based approaches. We present a formal abstraction of reinforcement learning algorithms that spans model-based, distributional, and model-free approaches. This abstraction seamlessly integrates active inference into the distributional reinforcement learning framework, making its performance advantages accessible without transition dynamics modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种对强化学习算法的形式化抽象，统一涵盖基于模型 (model-based)、分布 (distributional) 与无模型 (model-free) 三类方法，并将主动推理 (active inference) 无缝嵌入分布强化学习框架。作者认为，这一抽象使主动推理的性能优势无需显式建模转移动力学即可获得，从而弥补了强化学习框架只处理规划、忽视感知状态组织的不足。
Motivation: 机器人最优控制需要同时解决感官状态信息的有效组织与远视行动规划，而强化学习只覆盖后者，常导致样本效率低下。主动推理虽是解释生物大脑处理这一双重问题的先进过程理论，但其在人工智能中的应用迄今仅限于对现有基于模型方法的扩展。
Method: 给出一个统一的强化学习算法形式化抽象，横跨基于模型、分布强化学习和无模型方法，并由此在分布强化学习框架内整合主动推理，避免了显式的转移动力学建模。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，主要贡献是概念性结果：证明主动推理可被无缝整合进分布强化学习框架，使其性能优势无需转移动力学建模即可被利用。
Conclusion: 该工作为主动推理应用于人工智能提供了一个超越现有基于模型扩展的通用框架，但其实际效果和局限性仍需进一步的实证研究来验证。

papers.title: Beyond the Dirac Delta: Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Versatile Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for fine-tuning large-scale generative models, such as diffusion and flow models, to align with complex human preferences and user-specified tasks. A fundamental limitation remains \textit{the curse of diversity collapse}, where the objective formulation and optimization landscape inherently collapse the policy to a Dirac delta distribution. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{DRIFT} (\textbf{D}ive\textbf{R}sity-\textbf{I}ncentivized Reinforcement \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning for Versatile Image Generation), an innovative framework that systematically incentivizes output diversity throughout the on-policy fine-tuning process, reconciling strong task alignment with high generation diversity to enhance versatility essential for applications that demand diverse candidate generations. We approach the problem across three representative perspectives: i) \textbf{sampling} a reward-concentrated subset that filters out reward outliers to prevent premature collapse; ii) \textbf{prompting} with stochastic variations to expand the conditioning space, and iii) \textbf{optimization} of the intra-group diversity with a potential-based reward shaping mechanism. Experimental results show that DRIFT achieves superior Pareto dominance regarding task alignment and generation diversity, yielding a $ 9.08\%\!\sim\! 43.46\%$ increase in diversity at equivalent alignment levels and a $ 59.65\% \!\sim\! 65.86\%$ increase in alignment at equivalent levels of diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRIFT 框架，用于在强化学习微调扩散/流模型时缓解“多样性崩溃”（diversity collapse），即目标函数与优化过程把策略推向 Dirac delta 分布的问题。DRIFT 从采样、提示词和优化三个角度显式激励输出多样性，并在图像生成任务上声称实现任务对齐与生成多样性的 Pareto 改进。
Motivation: 强化学习微调虽能对齐扩散模型与流模型到复杂人类偏好，但目标公式与优化景观本质上会将策略收敛到 Dirac delta 分布，导致多样性崩溃，限制了需要多种候选生成的应用。
Method: DRIFT 从三个视角设计：i) 采样方面，筛选奖励集中的子集以剔除奖励离群点、防止过早崩溃；ii) 提示方面，引入随机变化以扩展条件空间；iii) 优化方面，利用基于势能的奖励塑形（potential-based reward shaping）机制优化组内多样性。
Result: 实验显示 DRIFT 在任务对齐与生成多样性上取得更优的 Pareto 支配，在同等对齐水平下多样性提升 9.08%~43.46%，在同等多样性水平下对齐提升 59.65%~65.86%。
Conclusion: 作者强调在 on-policy 微调过程中系统性地激励输出多样性可以同时保持强任务对齐与高生成多样性，适用于需要多样候选生成的场景。

papers.title: XGrammar-2: Dynamic and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Agentic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on dynamic structured generation, such as tool calling and response protocols. Unlike traditional structured generation with static structures, these workloads vary both across requests and within a request, posing new challenges to existing engines. We present XGrammar-2, a structured generation engine for dynamic agentic workloads. Our design is based on two key ideas: first-class support for tag-triggered structure switching, and fine-grained reuse across requests with different output structures. Concretely, XGrammar-2 introduces TagDispatch for dynamic structural dispatching and Cross-Grammar Cache for substructure-level cache reuse across grammars. It further improves efficiency with an Earley-based adaptive token mask cache, just-in-time compilation, and repetition state compression. Experiments show that XGrammar-2 achieves over 6x faster compilation than prior structured generation engines, and incurs near-zero end-to-end overhead in modern LLM serving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XGrammar-2，一个面向智能体 LLM 动态结构化生成任务的高效引擎，核心是支持标签触发的结构切换（TagDispatch）与跨语法子结构级缓存复用（Cross-Grammar Cache），并辅以基于 Earley 的自适应 token 掩码缓存、即时编译和重复状态压缩。实验报告称其编译速度比先前引擎快 6 倍以上，在现代 LLM 服务系统中端到端开销接近零。
Motivation: 现有结构化生成引擎主要面向静态结构，而智能体工作负载（如工具调用、响应协议）的结构既随请求变化也在单个请求内动态变化，给引擎带来新的挑战。
Method: 设计上以两个关键思想为基础：对标签触发结构切换的一等支持（TagDispatch），以及跨请求、跨不同输出语法结构的细粒度复用（Cross-Grammar Cache）；同时引入 Earley 式自适应 token 掩码缓存、即时编译（JIT）与重复状态压缩来进一步提升效率。
Result: 实验表明 XGrammar-2 的编译速度比先前结构化生成引擎快 6 倍以上，在现代 LLM 服务系统中端到端开销接近零。
Conclusion: 作者认为面向动态智能体工作负载的结构化生成需要结构切换的一等支持和跨语法缓存复用，这两点可以显著降低编译开销并几乎消除端到端性能损失。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CLIP-Joint-Detect: End-to-End Joint Training of Object Detectors with Contrastive Vision-Language Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Conventional object detectors rely on cross-entropy classification, which can be vulnerable to class imbalance and label noise. We propose CLIP-Joint-Detect, a simple and detector-agnostic framework that integrates CLIP-style contrastive vision-language supervision through end-to-end joint training. A lightweight parallel head projects region or grid features into the CLIP embedding space and aligns them with learnable class-specific text embeddings via InfoNCE contrastive loss and an auxiliary cross-entropy term, while all standard detection losses are optimized simultaneously. The approach applies seamlessly to both two-stage and one-stage architectures. We validate it on Pascal VOC 2007+2012 using Faster R-CNN and on the large-scale MS COCO 2017 benchmark using modern YOLO detectors (YOLOv11), achieving consistent and substantial improvements while preserving real-time inference speed. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that joint optimization with learnable text embeddings markedly enhances closed-set detection performance across diverse architectures and datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIP-Joint-Detect，一个探测器无关的框架，通过端到端联合训练将 CLIP 风格的对比视觉-语言监督引入目标检测。它用轻量级并行头把区域或网格特征投影到 CLIP 嵌入空间，并通过 InfoNCE 对比损失和辅助交叉熵项与可学习的类别文本嵌入对齐，同时优化所有标准检测损失。作者在 Pascal VOC 2007+2012（Faster R-CNN）和 MS COCO 2017（YOLOv11）上验证，称取得一致且显著的闭集检测提升，同时保持实时推理速度。
Motivation: 传统目标检测器依赖交叉熵分类，容易受到类别不均衡和标签噪声的影响，作者希望用对比视觉-语言监督来缓解这一问题。
Method: 提出一个简单且与检测架构无关的框架：在 CLIP 嵌入空间中对齐区域或网格特征与可学习的类别特定文本嵌入，使用 InfoNCE 对比损失加辅助交叉熵项，并与标准检测损失一起联合优化；该方法可无缝应用于两阶段和单阶段检测器。
Result: 在 Pascal VOC 2007+2012 上使用 Faster R-CNN、在 MS COCO 2017 上使用 YOLOv11 进行验证，摘要报告在不同架构和数据集上均获得一致且显著的闭集检测性能提升，同时保持实时推理速度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，联合优化可学习文本嵌入能明显提升跨架构、跨数据集的闭集目标检测性能；论文为 6 页预印本，正处于审稿中。

papers.title: A Mechanistic Analysis of Transformers for Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Transformers are increasingly adopted for modeling and forecasting time-series, yet their internal mechanisms remain poorly understood from a dynamical systems perspective. In contrast to classical autoregressive and state-space models, which benefit from well-established theoretical foundations, Transformer architectures are typically treated as black boxes. This gap becomes particularly relevant as attention-based models are considered for general-purpose or zero-shot forecasting across diverse dynamical regimes. In this work, we do not propose a new forecasting model, but instead investigate the representational capabilities and limitations of single-layer Transformers when applied to dynamical data. Building on a dynamical systems perspective, we interpret causal self-attention as a linear, history-dependent recurrence and analyze how it processes temporal information. Through a series of linear and nonlinear case studies, we identify distinct operational regimes. For linear systems, we show that in the single-head attention-only setting, the convexity constraint imposed by softmax attention restricts the class of autoregressive operators that can be represented, leading to oversmoothing when the target dynamics require mixed-sign lag coefficients. For nonlinear systems under partial observability, attention instead acts as an adaptive delay-embedding mechanism, enabling effective state reconstruction when sufficient temporal context and latent dimensionality are available. These results help bridge empirical observations with classical dynamical systems theory, providing insight into when and why Transformers succeed or fail as models of dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文不提出新的预测模型，而是从动力系统视角分析单层 Transformer 的内部机制。作者将因果自注意力解释为线性、依赖历史的递推（recurrence），并通过线性与非线性算例识别出其不同的运行机制：在单头纯注意力设置下，softmax 的凸性约束限制了可表示的自回归算子类别，导致目标动力学需要混合符号滞后系数时出现过度平滑；在非线性部分可观测系统中，注意力则表现为自适应的延迟嵌入（delay embedding）机制。结果有助于从经典动力系统理论角度解释 Transformer 作为动力学模型何时成功或失败。
Motivation: Transformer 在时间序列建模与预测中被广泛采用，但相较于自回归模型和状态空间模型缺乏成熟的理论基础，常被视为黑箱；这一问题在注意力模型被用于通用或零样本预测时尤为突出。
Method: 采用机理分析方法，不提出新预测模型，而是从动力系统视角研究单层 Transformer 的表征能力与局限；将因果自注意力建模为线性、依赖历史的递推，并通过一系列线性与非线性案例研究识别不同运行机制。
Result: 对线性系统，单头 attention-only 设置下 softmax 注意力带来的凸性约束限制了可表示的线性自回归算符类，当目标动力学需要混合符号滞后系数时会导致过度平滑（oversmoothing）；对非线性部分可观测系统，注意力充当自适应延迟嵌入机制，在时序上下文和潜在维度足够时实现有效的状态重构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些分析将经验观察与经典动力系统理论联系起来，增进了对 Transformer 在动力系统建模中成功或失败原因的理解；摘要未给出具体数值基准或实验数据。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Attention Fusion for Bridge Deck Delamination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Subsurface delaminations in reinforced concrete bridge decks escape conventional visual inspection, and the two principal sensing techniques used to find them are individually incomplete: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) penetrates deeply but degrades near the surface, while Infrared Thermography (IRT) resolves shallow defects but cannot reach deeper structure. This paper presents a framework for fusing the two modalities through hierarchical attention: temporal self-attention over GPR A-scans, channel-spatial attention over IRT patches, and cross-modal multi-head attention with learnable modality embeddings, coupled with decomposed aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty estimation. Beyond the architecture itself, which is lightweight at approximately 0.53M parameters with a closed-form accounting of where capacity resides, we contribute an elementary formal analysis. Two-token cross-modal attention is shown to be exactly a bank of per-sample learned gates; a gradient-allocation proposition quantifies how class imbalance starves attention parameters of minority-class signal and how loss reweighting trades that starvation for gradient variance; and closed-form metric floors under majority-class collapse anchor a diagnostic divergence between ranking metrics (AUC) and thresholded metrics (F1). The analysis suggests that adaptively weighted fusion, precisely because its feature-selection policy is learned, may be distinctively vulnerable to the severe class imbalance typical of operational bridge decks; establishing whether and when this occurs is deferred to empirical evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于钢筋混凝土桥面板脱粘 (delamination) 检测的框架，融合探地雷达 (GPR) 与红外热成像 (IRT) 两种模态。方法采用层次化注意力：对 GPR A-scan 做时间自注意力，对 IRT 块做通道-空间注意力，并通过带可学习模态嵌入的跨模态多头注意力融合，同时估计aleatoric/epistemic不确定性。模型轻量，约0.53M参数；论文还给出形式化分析，指出两token跨模态注意力等价于逐样本学习的门控，并刻画类别不平衡对注意力参数梯度的负面影响。
Motivation: 桥面板内部脱粘无法通过常规视觉检查发现，而GPR与IRT各自不完整：GPR能深入但近表面退化，IRT能分辨浅层缺陷但无法到达深层。此外，运营桥面板通常存在严重类别不平衡，而自适应权重融合的特征选择策略是学习得到的，可能对此格外脆弱。
Method: 提出层次化注意力融合框架，包括GPR A-scan上的时间自注意力、IRT patch上的通道-空间注意力、带可学习模态嵌入的跨模态多头注意力，以及分解的aleatoric/epistemic不确定性估计。除轻量架构外，还给出形式化分析：将两token跨模态注意力证明为逐样本门控的集合，提出梯度分配命题，给出多数类坍缩下排序指标(AUC)与阈值指标(F1)的闭合形式下界。
Result: 摘要报告的结果主要是理论性的：两token跨模态注意力恰好是一组逐样本学习门控；梯度分配命题量化了类别不平衡如何使少数类信号饥饿化注意力参数，以及损失重加权如何在梯度方差上做权衡；多数类坍缩下的闭合形式指标下界揭示了AUC与F1之间的诊断分歧。没有报告经验实验结果。
Conclusion: 分析表明，自适应加权融合因其特征选择策略是学习得到的，可能对运营桥面板中典型的严重类别不平衡格外敏感；这种情况是否发生以及何时发生被留待经验评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fundamentals of quantum Boltzmann machine learning with visible and hidden units
papers.abstract_en: One of the primary applications of classical Boltzmann machines is generative modeling, wherein the goal is to tune the parameters of a model distribution so that it closely approximates a target distribution. Training relies on estimating the gradient of the relative entropy between the target and model distributions, a task that is well understood when the classical Boltzmann machine has both visible and hidden units. For some years now, it has been an obstacle to generalize this finding to quantum state learning with quantum Boltzmann machines that have both visible and hidden units. In this paper, I derive an analytical expression for the gradient of the quantum relative entropy between a target quantum state and the reduced state of the visible units of a quantum Boltzmann machine. Crucially, this expression is amenable to estimation on a quantum computer, as it involves modular-flow-generated unitary rotations reminiscent of those appearing in my prior work on rotated Petz recovery maps. This leads to a quantum algorithm for gradient estimation in this setting. I then specialize the setting to quantum visible units and classical hidden units, and vice versa; I also provide analytical expressions for the gradients, along with quantum algorithms for estimating them. Finally, I replace the quantum relative entropy objective function with the Petz-Tsallis relative entropy; here I develop an analytical expression for the gradient and sketch a quantum algorithm for estimating it, as an application of an independent derivation of a formula for the derivative of the matrix power function, which also involves modular-flow-generated unitary rotations. Ultimately, this paper demarcates progress in training quantum Boltzmann machines with visible and hidden units for generative modeling and quantum state learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推导了同时含可见单元与隐藏单元的量子玻尔兹曼机（quantum Boltzmann machine）中，目标量子态与可见单元约化态之间量子相对熵的梯度解析表达式。该表达式涉及 modular-flow 生成的酉旋转，可在量子计算机上估计，从而得到梯度估计的量子算法。作者还特化为量子可见单元+经典隐藏单元及其相反情形，并进一步将目标函数替换为 Petz-Tsallis 相对熵，给出相应梯度表达式与量子算法草图。摘要称这标志着在含可见与隐藏单元的量子玻尔兹曼机训练方面取得进展。
Motivation: 经典玻尔兹曼机同时含可见与隐藏单元时，相对熵梯度的估计已被很好理解；但将此推广到同时含可见与隐藏单元的量子玻尔兹曼机的量子态学习，长期以来是一个未解决的障碍。
Method: 作者推导量子相对熵梯度的解析表达式，该表达式包含 modular-flow 生成的酉旋转，适合在量子计算机上估计；随后将该设置分别特化为量子可见单元/经典隐藏单元和经典可见单元/量子隐藏单元，给出对应梯度表达式与量子算法；最后用 Petz-Tsallis 相对熵替代量子相对熵，并借助独立推导的矩阵幂函数导数公式，给出梯度表达式并勾勒量子估计算法。
Result: 摘要报告了梯度解析表达式的推导以及相应量子梯度估计算法的提出，未给出具体数值实验或数据集结果。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该工作推进了同时含可见与隐藏单元的量子玻尔兹曼机在生成建模和量子态学习中的训练；关于实际性能与局限，摘要未展开说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrating Transformer Attention via Task-Space Sensitivity Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based pre-trained language models (PLMs) excel in text classification but suffer from attention dilution and attention sink effects, forcing models to over-focus on task-irrelevant tokens. Existing attention supervision methods rely on costly token-level human annotations or static heuristics, which fail to scale or capture context-dependent token importance. To address this, we propose AttCal, a self-supervised, annotation-free attention calibration framework via task-space sensitivity feedback. AttCal treats attention distributions as stochastic policies to guide token deletion perturbations, infers context-dependent token importance from semantic shifts, and optimizes attention parameters via policy gradient. Critically, AttCal freezes the PLM backbone and updates only attention projection layers to ensure training efficiency. Benchmarks across five datasets demonstrate that AttCal significantly outperforms vanilla PLMs-yielding up to a 15.8% accuracy lift for Llama3-8B-and surpasses SOTA supervised baselines in both classification and interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AttCal，一种无需标注的自监督注意力校准框架，用于缓解 Transformer 预训练语言模型（PLM）中的注意力稀释（attention dilution）与注意力汇聚（attention sink）效应。AttCal 将注意力分布视为随机策略来指导 token 删除扰动，从语义偏移中推断上下文相关的 token 重要性，并通过策略梯度优化注意力参数；关键地，它冻结 PLM 主干、仅更新注意力投影层。在五个数据集上，AttCal 显著优于原始 PLM，Llama3-8B 上准确率最高提升 15.8%，并在分类与可解释性上超过 SOTA 监督基线。
Motivation: Transformer 预训练语言模型在文本分类中常过度关注与任务无关的 token，现有注意力监督方法依赖昂贵的 token 级人工标注或静态启发式规则，无法扩展且难以捕捉上下文相关的 token 重要性。
Method: 提出 AttCal 自监督框架：将注意力分布当作随机策略以指导 token 删除扰动，根据语义位移推断 token 重要性，并用策略梯度（policy gradient）优化注意力参数；同时冻结 PLM 主干，只更新注意力投影层以保证训练效率。
Result: 在五个数据集上的实验显示，AttCal 相比 vanilla PLM 最高带来 15.8% 的准确率提升（Llama3-8B），并在分类性能和可解释性上均超过 SOTA 监督基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需人工标注、仅更新注意力投影层的自监督校准既高效又有效，但其验证范围限于文本分类的五个基准数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Galaxy Phase-Space and Field-Level Cosmology: The Strength of Semi-Analytic Models
papers.abstract_en: Semi-analytic models are a widely used approach to simulate galaxy properties within a cosmological framework, relying on simplified yet physically motivated prescriptions. They have also proven to be an efficient alternative for generating accurate galaxy catalogs, offering a faster and less computationally expensive option compared to full hydrodynamical simulations. In this paper, we demonstrate that using only galaxy $3$D positions and radial velocities, we can train a graph neural network coupled to a moment neural network to obtain a robust machine learning based model capable of estimating the matter density parameters, $Ω_{\rm m}$, with a precision of approximately 10%. The network is trained on ($25 h^{-1}$Mpc)$^3$ volumes of galaxy catalogs from L-Galaxies and can successfully extrapolate its predictions to other semi-analytic models (GAEA, SC-SAM, and Shark) and, more remarkably, to hydrodynamical simulations (Astrid, SIMBA, IllustrisTNG, and SWIFT-EAGLE). Our results show that the network is robust to variations in astrophysical and subgrid physics, cosmological and astrophysical parameters, and the different halo-profile treatments used across simulations. This suggests that the physical relationships encoded in the phase-space of semi-analytic models are largely independent of their specific physical prescriptions, reinforcing their potential as tools for the generation of realistic mock catalogs for cosmological parameter inference.
papers.journal_ref: Volume 1007, Number 1, Year 2026, Pages 34
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用半解析模型 (semi-analytic models) 生成的星系目录，仅以星系的三维位置和径向速度作为输入，训练一个耦合了矩神经网络 (moment neural network) 的图神经网络，来估计物质密度参数 Ωm，精度约为 10%。模型在 L-Galaxies 的 (25 h⁻¹ Mpc)³ 体元上训练，并能外推到其他半解析模型及流体动力学模拟，表明半解析模型相空间中的物理关系与其具体物理处方大体无关。
Motivation: 半解析模型是星系形成模拟中计算成本较低的替代方案，但需要验证其生成的星系目录能否用于稳健的宇宙学参数推断，以及其所编码的相空间信息是否具有跨模型普适性。
Method: 提出用图神经网络与矩神经网络联合处理星系三维位置与径向速度，从星系目录的相空间信息回归物质密度参数 Ωm；训练数据来自 L-Galaxies 半解析模型的 (25 h⁻¹ Mpc)³ 星系目录体积。
Result: 摘要报告 Ωm 估计精度约为 10%；模型可成功外推到 GAEA、SC-SAM、Shark 等半解析模型以及 Astrid、SIMBA、IllustrisTNG、SWIFT-EAGLE 等流体动力学模拟，并对天体物理/次网格物理、宇宙学参数及暗物质晕轮廓处理的变化具有稳健性。
Conclusion: 作者认为半解析模型相空间中编码的物理关系在很大程度上独立于具体物理处方，这加强了其作为生成真实星系模拟目录并用于宇宙学参数推断的工具的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Boundary Frames: Talking-Head Inbetweening via Context-Aware Motion Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Existing talking-head generation methods primarily target open-ended generation rather than bridging two existing video segments. In this paper, we study talking-head inbetweening, a practical editing task that aims to generate realistic intermediate frames under fixed endpoint constraints. Unlike generic video inbetweening, this task requires recovering subtle speech-driven facial dynamics over long temporal gaps, where the boundary frames alone provide insufficient guidance for realistic motion recovery. To address this problem, we propose BBF (Beyond Boundary Frames), a unified context-aware framework for talking-head inbetweening. BBF consists of three complementary components: Endpoint Anchoring for preserving endpoint consistency, Motion Evolution Modeling for capturing plausible temporal transitions from surrounding visual context, and Speech Dynamics Refinement for injecting fine-grained speech-driven facial dynamics from speech audio. A progressive optimization strategy further balances structural consistency and motion refinement during denoising. Extensive experiments on the talking-head benchmarks HDTF and Hallo3 demonstrate that BBF consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, BBF surpasses the strongest baseline on Hallo3 by 23.3% in FID and 36.5% in FVD. Moreover, BBF demonstrates strong generalization on generic video inbetweening benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 talking-head inbetweening 任务，即在固定端点约束下为两段视频之间生成真实中间帧。作者提出 BBF (Beyond Boundary Frames) 统一框架，结合 Endpoint Anchoring、Motion Evolution Modeling 与 Speech Dynamics Refinement 三个组件，并用渐进式优化策略平衡结构一致性与运动细化。在 HDTF 和 Hallo3 基准上达到最先进水平，并在通用视频 inbetweening 基准上表现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 talking-head 生成方法主要面向开放式生成，而非桥接两段已有视频片段；talking-head inbetweening 需要恢复长时间间隔中由语音驱动的细微面部动态，而仅靠边界帧不足以提供现实运动恢复的指导。
Method: 提出 BBF 框架，包含三个互补组件：Endpoint Anchoring 保持端点一致性，Motion Evolution Modeling 从周围视觉上下文捕获合理解释的时间过渡，Speech Dynamics Refinement 从语音音频注入细粒度的语音驱动面部动态；另外采用渐进式优化策略在去噪过程中平衡结构一致性与运动细化。
Result: 在 HDTF 和 Hallo3 两个 talking-head 基准上持续取得最先进性能；在 Hallo3 上比最强基线在 FID 上提升 23.3%、在 FVD 上提升 36.5%，并在通用视频 inbetweening 基准上展现出强泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用周围上下文与语音信息可以解决长间隔 talking-head inbetweening 中边界帧信息不足的问题，并验证了所提框架在同类与泛化任务上的有效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Feedback Loops and Code Perturbations in LLM-based Software Engineering: A Case Study on a C-to-Rust Translation System
papers.abstract_en: The advent of strong generative AI has a considerable impact on various software engineering tasks such as code repair, test generation, or language translation. While tools like GitHub Copilot are already in widespread use in interactive settings, automated approaches require a higher level of reliability before being usable in industrial practice. In this paper, we focus on three aspects that directly influence the quality of the results: a) the effect of automated feedback loops, b) the choice of Large Language Model (LLM), and c) the influence of behavior-preserving code changes. We study the effect of these three variables on an automated C-to-Rust translation system. Code translation from C to Rust is an attractive use case in industry due to Rust's safety guarantees. The translation system is based on a generate-and-check pattern, in which Rust code generated by the LLM is automatically checked for compilability and behavioral equivalence with the original C code. For negative checking results, the LLM is re-prompted in a feedback loop to repair its output. These checks also allow us to evaluate and compare the respective success rates of the translation system when varying the three variables. Our results show that without feedback loops LLM selection has a large effect on translation success. However, when the translation system uses feedback loops the differences across models diminish. We observe this for the average performance of the system as well as its robustness under code perturbations. Finally, we also identify that diversity provided by code perturbations can even result in improved system performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 LLM 的自动化 C-to-Rust 翻译系统中影响结果质量的三个变量：自动反馈回路、LLM 选择以及保持行为不变的代码扰动。系统采用生成-检查模式，对 LLM 生成的 Rust 代码自动检查可编译性和与原始 C 代码的行为等价性，检查失败时通过反馈回路重新提示 LLM 修复。结果表明反馈回路会削弱不同 LLM 之间的性能差异，且代码扰动带来的多样性还能提升系统性能。
Motivation: 自动化软件工程方法在工业实践中需要更高可靠性，而当前对反馈回路、模型选择和代码扰动如何影响生成结果质量的理解不足。C-to-Rust 翻译因 Rust 的安全保证是工业界有吸引力的用例，适合作为研究这些变量的场景。
Method: 实现一个基于生成-检查范式的自动化 C-to-Rust 翻译系统，LLM 生成的 Rust 代码会自动接受可编译性与行为等价性检查；检查失败时通过反馈回路重新提示 LLM 修复。通过变化三个变量（反馈回路、LLM 选择、行为保持的代码扰动）来评估和比较翻译成功率。
Result: 在没有反馈回路时，LLM 选择对翻译成功率影响很大；加入反馈回路后各模型间的差异显著缩小，这一现象在系统平均性能和对代码扰动的鲁棒性上均成立。此外，代码扰动提供的多样性甚至能带来系统性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调反馈回路能缩小不同 LLM 之间的性能差距，并指出代码扰动可作为提升系统性能的手段；研究聚焦于 C-to-Rust 翻译这一具体场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MODEST: Multi-Optics Depth-of-Field Stereo Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Training and evaluation of state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms for reliable shallow depth of field (DoF) rendering and defocus deblurring remain constrained by a persistent lack of large-scale, full-frame, high fidelity, real-image datasets. Optical effects of shallow DoF and defocus blur depend intimately on camera optical configuration set with focal length and aperture; requiring rigorous evaluation of the models when these parameters systematically change. Further, modern applications such as AR, VR, smartphones, industrial robots, etc. deploy stereo or multi-camera systems. We present MODEST - the first ultra-high-resolution(5472x3648px, 20MP), multi-optics depth of field stereo DSLR dataset that methodically varies focal length and aperture for a series of complex, real-world scenes, capturing the optical realism and complexity of professional camera systems. With 20,000 images across 50 distinct optical configurations, focal length in 28-70mm, aperture in f/22-f/2.8 for multiple stereo viewpoints for 10 scenes; this ultra-high-resolution, full-range optics coverage enables controlled analysis of geometric and optical effects for shallow DoF rendering and defocus deblurring. Each scene is curated to have challenging visual elements: reflective surfaces, transparent glass walls, fine-grained details, point lights, and multi-scale depth illusions. In addition, we provide intrinsics and extrinsics calibration images to support ever-evolving calibration methods. We evaluate several SOTA DoF and defocus deblurring methods and demonstrate failure cases and limitations. Our comprehensive tuning analysis demonstrates how MODEST evaluates sensitivity of the SOTA DoF models for the actual focal configuration of input images. This work attempts to bridge the realism gap between synthetic, low-resolution training data and inference generalization on high-resolution real-camera optics.
papers.comment: Website, dataset and software tools now available for purely non-commercial, academic research purposes. Significant new contributions. Project page: https://modest-dataset.netlify.app/ Huggingface: https://huggingface.co/datasets/independent-vision-lab/MODEST
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MODEST，一个超高分辨率（5472×3648px，20MP）的多光学配置景深（depth of field）立体 DSLR 数据集，包含 50 种光学配置、10 个场景、20000 张图像，焦距范围 28-70mm、光圈 f/22-f/2.8，并配有内参和外参标定影像。作者还评估了若干 SOTA 浅景深渲染与散焦去模糊（defocus deblurring）方法，展示了这些方法在不同光学配置下的失败案例和局限性。
Motivation: 可靠的浅景深渲染与散焦去模糊算法训练和评估长期缺乏大规模、全画幅、高保真的真实图像数据集；浅景深和散焦模糊效果高度依赖焦距、光圈等相机光学配置，且 AR/VR、智能手机、工业机器人等现代应用普遍采用立体或多相机系统。
Method: 通过 DSLR 在 10 个复杂真实场景中系统地改变焦距和光圈，采集多个立体视角下的 20MP 超高清图像，形成覆盖全范围光学配置的数据集；同时提供标定影像以支持标定方法研究，并使用该数据集对 SOTA DoF 与散焦去模糊模型进行敏感性分析和失败案例展示。
Result: 摘要报告数据集包含 20000 张图像、50 种光学配置、10 个场景，并通过全面的调参分析展示 SOTA DoF 模型对输入图像实际焦段配置（focal configuration）的敏感性及其局限性。
Conclusion: 作者试图弥合合成低分辨率训练数据与真实高分辨率相机光学系统之间在推理泛化上的现实差距，为浅景深渲染和散焦去模糊研究提供一个包含真实光学复杂性的评测基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Chain-of-Visual-Thought: Teaching VLMs to See and Think Better with Continuous Visual Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at reasoning in linguistic space but struggle with perceptual understanding that requires dense visual perception, e.g., spatial reasoning and geometric awareness. This limitation stems from the fact that current VLMs have limited mechanisms to capture dense visual information across spatial dimensions. We introduce Chain-of-Visual-Thought (COVT), a framework that enables VLMs to reason not only in words but also through continuous visual tokens-compact latent representations that encode rich perceptual cues. Within a small budget of roughly 20 tokens, COVT distills knowledge from lightweight vision experts, capturing complementary properties such as 2D appearance, 3D geometry, spatial layout, and edge structure. During training, the VLM with COVT autoregressively predicts these visual tokens to reconstruct dense supervision signals (e.g., depth, segmentation, edges, and DINO features). At inference, the model reasons directly in the continuous visual token space, preserving efficiency while optionally decoding dense predictions for interpretability. Evaluated across more than ten diverse perception benchmarks, including CV-Bench, MMVP, RealWorldQA, MMStar, WorldMedQA, and HRBench, integrating COVT into strong VLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA consistently improves performance by 3% to 16% and demonstrates that compact continuous visual thinking enables more precise, grounded, and interpretable multimodal intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chain-of-Visual-Thought (COVT)，让视觉语言模型 (VLM) 不仅用语言、还通过约 20 个连续视觉 token 进行推理。训练时模型自回归预测这些 token 以重建深度、分割、边缘和 DINO 特征等密集监督信号；推理时直接在连续视觉 token 空间中推理，并可选择解码出密集预测用于可解释性。在 CV-Bench、MMVP、RealWorldQA、MMStar 等十余个感知基准上，将该框架集成到 Qwen2.5-VL 和 LLaVA 中，性能稳定提升 3% 到 16%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 擅长语言空间中的推理，但在需要密集视觉感知的任务（如空间推理和几何感知）上表现不佳，原因是它们缺乏跨空间维度捕获密集视觉信息的机制。
Method: COVT 从轻量视觉专家中蒸馏知识，将 2D 外观、3D 几何、空间布局和边缘结构等互补属性编码为少量连续的潜在视觉 token；训练时 VLM 自回归预测这些 token，推理时直接在连续 token 空间中进行推理。
Result: 在超过十个多样化感知基准（包括 CV-Bench、MMVP、RealWorldQA、MMStar、WorldMedQA 和 HRBench）上，将 COVT 集成进 Qwen2.5-VL 和 LLaVA 等强 VLM 后，性能一致提升 3% 到 16%，表明紧凑的连续视觉思维能带来更精确、更 grounded 且可解释的多模态智能。
Conclusion: 作者认为紧凑的连续视觉 token 使 VLM 能够在保持效率的同时进行更精细的视觉感知推理，并可通过可选的稠密预测解码增强可解释性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 VLM 擅长语言空间中的推理，但在需要密集视觉感知的任务（如空间推理和几何感知）上表现不佳，原因是它们缺乏跨空间维度捕获密集视觉信息的机制。
summary_sections.method: COVT 从轻量视觉专家中蒸馏知识，将 2D 外观、3D 几何、空间布局和边缘结构等互补属性编码为少量连续的潜在视觉 token；训练时 VLM 自回归预测这些 token，推理时直接在连续 token 空间中进行推理。
summary_sections.result: 在超过十个多样化感知基准（包括 CV-Bench、MMVP、RealWorldQA、MMStar、WorldMedQA 和 HRBench）上，将 COVT 集成进 Qwen2.5-VL 和 LLaVA 等强 VLM 后，性能一致提升 3% 到 16%，表明紧凑的连续视觉思维能带来更精确、更 grounded 且可解释的多模态智能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为紧凑的连续视觉 token 使 VLM 能够在保持效率的同时进行更精细的视觉感知推理，并可通过可选的稠密预测解码增强可解释性。

papers.title: Interpreting GFlowNets for Drug Discovery: What probes can and cannot show
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) construct molecules through sequential decisions, but their internal policies remain opaque, limiting adoption in drug discovery, where chemists need interpretable rationales for proposed structures. We present a control-validated interpretability study of SynFlowNet, a synthesis-aware GFlowNet trained with a drug-likeness (QED) reward. Our framework combines gradient saliency and counterfactual edits, an undercomplete factor analysis, and an overcomplete BatchTopK sparse autoencoder, evaluated with shuffled-label controls, RDKit-descriptor baselines, a scaffold-disjoint split, cross-seed stability, and an architecture-matched untrained network. These controls materially change the interpretation. Physicochemical properties and functional groups are highly decodable from SynFlowNet embeddings, but an untrained network with the same architecture performs essentially as well as the trained policy (drug-likeness within 0.005 and marginally better molecular-size decoding). Thus, this decodability reflects graph architecture and atom featurization rather than representations acquired through policy training. The surviving conclusions are narrower: the overcomplete autoencoder reconstructs embeddings better than a matched undercomplete baseline at comparable sparsity; chemically enriched substructure detectors, including per-halogen and boron features, emerge in individual runs, although only a small subset of dictionary directions is stable across seeds; and zeroing individual features produces property-specific effects on probe decoding. Beyond SynFlowNet, this study provides a reusable control protocol for molecular-model interpretability, separating learned structure from signals supplied by architecture and input representation. High probe scores alone should not be treated as evidence of learned chemistry.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对合成感知 GFlowNet（SynFlowNet，以类药性 QED 作为奖励）的可解释性研究。作者结合梯度显著性 (gradient saliency)、反事实编辑、欠完备因子分析与过完备 BatchTopK 稀疏自编码器，并引入打乱标签对照组、RDKit 描述符基线、脚手架不重叠划分、跨种子稳定性以及同架构未训练网络等多个控制实验。核心发现是：物理化学性质与官能团能从 SynFlowNet 嵌入中高度解码，但未训练的同架构网络表现几乎一样好（类药性差异在 0.005 以内，分子大小解码甚至略优），因此这种可解码性来自图架构与原子特征化，而非策略训练习得的表示。作者提出，单独的高探针分数不应被视为模型学到了化学知识的证据。
Motivation: GFlowNets 通过序列决策构建分子，但其内部策略不透明，限制了在药物发现中的采用，因为化学家需要对所提结构给出可解释的依据。
Method: 提出一套控制验证的可解释性框架，组合梯度显著性与反事实编辑、欠完备因子分析和过完备 BatchTopK 稀疏自编码器，并配以打乱标签对照、RDKit 描述符基线、脚手架不重叠划分、跨种子稳定性以及与架构匹配的未训练网络等控制手段。
Result: 训练策略与未训练同架构网络在物化性质和官能团解码上几乎相当（类药性误差在 0.005 以内，未训练网络在分子大小解码上略优）；过完备自编码器在相近稀疏度下重建嵌入优于匹配的欠完备基线；个别运行中出现含卤素和含硼等化学富集的子结构检测器，但只有少量字典方向跨种子稳定；清零单个特征对探针解码产生性质特异的影响。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，高探针分数本身不足以证明模型习得了化学知识；该研究提供了一个可复用的分子模型可解释性控制协议，用以区分学习到的结构信号与来自架构和输入表示的本征信号。

papers.title: Stabilizing Multi-Attack Adversarial Training via Bandit Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) remain vulnerable to diverse adversarial perturbations, motivating multi-attack adversarial training (AT) for improved robustness. However, existing methods either incur prohibitive overhead by computing all attacks at each iteration, or rely on stochastic sampling over adversarial examples, which may cause excessive parameter drift. To address these issues, we propose Calibrated Adversarial Sampling (CAS), an efficient and stable framework that reformulates multi-attack AT as a multi-armed bandit optimization problem. By sampling a single attack per iteration that dynamically balances exploration and exploitation, CAS significantly reduces training cost while mitigating optimization conflicts across attacks and controlling excessive parameter drifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAS achieves superior overall robustness at low computational cost, offering a scalable and principled approach to robust generalization against multi-attack settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/CAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Calibrated Adversarial Sampling (CAS)，将多攻击对抗训练 (multi-attack AT) 重构为多臂老虎机 (multi-armed bandit) 优化问题，每次迭代只采样一种攻击并在探索与利用之间动态平衡，以降低训练成本并缓解参数漂移。实验表明 CAS 在较低计算开销下达到较好的整体鲁棒性，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有 DNN 面对多种对抗扰动仍脆弱，因此需要多攻击对抗训练来提升鲁棒性。但已有方法要么每轮计算所有攻击导致开销过高，要么对对抗样本做随机采样从而引起过度的参数漂移。
Method: 将多攻击 AT 建模为多臂老虎机优化，提出 CAS 框架：每次迭代采样单个攻击，并动态平衡探索与利用，从而减少训练成本、缓解不同攻击间的优化冲突，并控制参数漂移。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明，CAS 在较低计算成本下取得了更优的整体鲁棒性，可作为多攻击场景下鲁棒泛化的可扩展方案。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CAS 为多攻击对抗训练提供了可扩展且原则性的框架，并公开了代码仓库；摘要本身未给出具体数据集或数值指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multicalibration Yields Better Matchings
papers.abstract_en: Consider the problem of finding the best matching in a weighted graph where we only have access to predictions of the actual stochastic weights, based on an underlying context. If the predictor is the Bayes optimal one, then computing the best matching based on the predicted weights is optimal. However, in practice, this perfect information scenario is not realistic. Given an imperfect predictor, a suboptimal decision rule may compensate for the induced error and thus outperform the standard optimal rule. In this paper, we propose multicalibration as a way to address this problem. This fairness notion requires a predictor to be unbiased on each element of a family of protected sets of contexts. Given a class of matching algorithms $\mathcal C$ and any predictor $γ$ of the edge-weights, we show how to construct a specific multicalibrated predictor $\hat γ$, with the following property. Picking the best matching based on the output of $\hat γ$ is competitive with the best decision rule in $\mathcal C$ applied onto the original predictor $γ$. We complement this result by providing sample complexity bounds, and by performing numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在带权图中基于上下文预测随机边权重来寻找最优匹配的问题。作者提出用多校准 (multicalibration) 构造校准后的预测器 γ̂，使得基于 γ̂ 输出选择的最优匹配，与在原始预测器 γ 上应用给定匹配算法类 C 中的最优决策规则相比具有竞争性。摘要还给出了样本复杂度界并进行了数值实验。
Motivation: 当预测器非最优时，基于预测权重直接计算最优匹配的标准决策规则可能不是最优的，因为一个次优的决策规则可以补偿预测误差。论文针对这一现实场景，希望用多校准来缩小预测误差对下游匹配决策的影响。
Method: 采用多校准这一公平性概念，要求预测器在受保护上下文集合族中的每个集合上均无偏。给定匹配算法类 C 与任意边权重预测器 γ，作者构造一个特定的多校准预测器 γ̂，并证明基于 γ̂ 的输出选择最优匹配能与基于 γ 应用 C 中最优决策规则相竞争。
Result: 摘要报告了理论上的竞争性保证 (competitive guarantee) 和样本复杂度界，并进行了数值实验验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为多校准可以作为在预测不完备时改进匹配决策的一种有效手段；摘要未提及明显的局限性。

papers.title: Convergence and Stability Analysis of Self-Consuming Generative Models with Heterogeneous Human Curation
papers.abstract_en: Self-consuming generative models have received significant attention over the last few years. In this paper, we study a self-consuming generative model with heterogeneous preferences that is a generalization of the model in Ferbach et al. (2024). The model is retrained round by round using real data and its previous-round synthetic outputs. The asymptotic behavior of the retraining dynamics is investigated across four regimes using different techniques including the nonlinear Perron--Frobenius theory. Our analyses improve upon that of Ferbach et al. (2024) and provide convergence results in settings where the well-known Banach contraction mapping arguments do not apply. Stability and non-stability results regarding the retraining dynamics are also given.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究一类具有异构偏好（heterogeneous preferences）的自消耗生成模型（self-consuming generative model），该模型是 Ferbach et al. (2024) 模型的推广，每轮用真实数据和上一轮合成输出重新训练。作者利用非线性 Perron–Frobenius 理论分析四个不同场景下再训练动力学的渐近行为，在 Banach 压缩映射论证不适用的情形下给出收敛性结果，并补充了稳定性与非稳定性结论。文章共 42 页，属于 cs.LG 与 stat.ML 领域的理论分析工作。
Motivation: 已有自消耗生成模型的分析依赖 Banach 压缩映射论证，但该工具在异构偏好等更一般设定下并不适用，导致收敛性结论缺失。本文针对 Ferbach et al. (2024) 模型的推广形式，补上这些设定下的理论空白。
Method: 论文将带异构偏好的自消耗再训练过程建模为逐轮动力学，借助非线性 Perron–Frobenius 理论，在四个不同的 regime 下研究其渐近行为，并与 Ferbach et al. (2024) 的分析相对照。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 Banach 压缩映射论证不适用的场景中取得了收敛性结果，改进并推广了 Ferbach et al. (2024) 的分析，同时给出关于再训练动力学的稳定性与非稳定性结论。
Conclusion: 作者指出，非线性 Perron–Frobenius 理论能够处理异构偏好下自消耗生成模型的收敛分析，为不满足标准压缩条件的再训练动力学提供了理论保证。

papers.title: FinRpt: Dataset, Evaluation System and LLM-based Multi-agent Framework for Equity Research Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: While LLMs have shown great success in financial tasks like stock prediction and question answering, their application in fully automating Equity Research Report generation remains uncharted territory. In this paper, we formulate the Equity Research Report (ERR) Generation task for the first time. To address the data scarcity and the evaluation metrics absence, we present an open-source evaluation benchmark for ERR generation - FinRpt. We frame a Dataset Construction Pipeline that integrates 7 financial data types and produces a high-quality ERR dataset automatically, which could be used for model training and evaluation. We also introduce a comprehensive evaluation system including 11 metrics to assess the generated ERRs. Moreover, we propose a multi-agent framework specifically tailored to address this task, named FinRpt-Gen, and train several LLM-based agents on the proposed datasets using Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning. Experimental results indicate the data quality and metrics effectiveness of the benchmark FinRpt and the strong performance of FinRpt-Gen, showcasing their potential to drive innovation in the ERR generation field. All code and datasets are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将股权研究报告（Equity Research Report, ERR）生成建模为独立任务，并发布开源基准 FinRpt，包含一个整合 7 类金融数据的自动数据集构建流水线，以及涵盖 11 项指标的评估体系。作者还提出面向该任务的多智能体框架 FinRpt-Gen，用监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning）和强化学习（Reinforcement Learning）训练多个基于 LLM 的智能体。实验表明 FinRpt 的数据质量和指标有效性良好，FinRpt-Gen 性能较强，代码和数据集均已公开。
Motivation: LLM 已在股票预测、问答等金融任务上表现良好，但完全自动化的股权研究报告生成仍是未探索领域，且存在数据稀缺和缺乏评估指标的问题。
Method: 提出 FinRpt 基准，包括整合 7 类金融数据的数据集构建流水线，自动生成可用于训练与评估的高质量 ERR 数据集；构建含 11 项指标的评估系统；提出多智能体框架 FinRpt-Gen，并基于监督微调和强化学习训练多个 LLM 智能体。
Result: 实验结果表明 FinRpt 的数据质量和评估指标有效，FinRpt-Gen 在 ERR 生成任务上表现强劲。
Conclusion: 该基准与多智能体框架有望推动股权研究报告生成领域的发展，且所有代码和数据集均公开可用。

papers.title: DeepThinkVLA: Enhancing Reasoning Capability of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Does Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning genuinely improve Vision Language Action (VLA) models, or does it merely add overhead? Existing CoT-VLA systems report limited and inconsistent gains, yet no prior work has rigorously diagnosed when and why CoT helps robots act. Through systematic experiments, we identify two necessary conditions that must be jointly satisfied for CoT to be effective in VLA: (1) Decoding Alignment: CoT and actions must be generated with modality-appropriate mechanisms; forcing both through a single autoregressive decoder is not merely suboptimal but actively harmful, degrading performance by 4.2 percentage points; (2) Causal Alignment: CoT must be causally linked to task success via outcome-based optimization; without it, supervised CoT is indistinguishable from no reasoning at all under action-execution-sensitive dynamics shift, exhibiting a 32.0 pp performance drop nearly identical to the 31.6 pp drop of a reasoning-free baseline. Guided by these findings, we build DeepThinkVLA: a hybrid-attention decoder satisfies Condition 1 by pairing causal attention for language with bidirectional attention for parallel action decoding, while a two-stage SFT-then-RL pipeline satisfies Condition 2 by aligning the full reasoning: action chain with sparse task-success rewards. DeepThinkVLA achieves 97.0\% success on LIBERO, 79.0\% robustness on LIBERO-Plus (vs. 61.6\% for $π_0$-FAST), and 59.3\% success on RoboTwin 2.0, exceeding the strongest baseline by 21.7 points. Furthermore, real-robot experiments provide preliminary evidence for the physical applicability of our CoT data construction and hybrid architecture. Our codes are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/DeepThinkVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统实验诊断 CoT（Chain-of-Thought）推理在 VLA（Vision-Language-Action）模型中的有效条件，识别出必须同时满足的两个必要条件：解码对齐（Decoding Alignment）与因果对齐（Causal Alignment）。基于这些发现提出 DeepThinkVLA，采用混合注意力解码器与两阶段 SFT-then-RL 流程，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得明显提升，并通过真实机器人实验提供初步验证。
Motivation: 现有 CoT-VLA 系统报告的效果增益有限且不一致，尚无工作严格诊断 CoT 在何时以及为何能帮助机器人行动，作者希望厘清 CoT 对 VLA 的贡献是真实提升还是仅仅增加开销。
Method: 先通过系统实验确立两个充分必要条件：解码对齐要求 CoT 与动作采用模态适配的生成机制，混合注意力解码器以因果注意力处理语言、以双向注意力并行解码动作；因果对齐要求 CoT 通过基于结果的优化与任务成功因果关联，两阶段 SFT-then-RL 流程用稀疏任务成功奖励对齐完整的推理-动作链。
Result: 摘要报告，强制 CoT 与动作共用单一自回归解码器会主动损害性能，下降 4.2 个百分点；缺乏因果对齐时，监督式 CoT 在动作执行敏感的动态变化下性能下降 32.0 pp，与无推理基线的 31.6 pp 几乎相同。DeepThinkVLA 在 LIBERO 上达到 97.0% 成功率，LIBERO-Plus 上 79.0% 鲁棒性（对比 π0-FAST 的 61.6%），RoboTwin 2.0 上 59.3% 成功率，超过最强基线 21.7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者强调解码对齐与因果对齐须联合满足 CoT 才能在 VLA 中发挥作用，并指出真实机器人实验为 CoT 数据构造与混合架构的物理适用性提供了初步证据，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Group-Equivariant Diffusion Models for Lattice Field Theory
papers.abstract_en: Near the critical point, Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) simulations of lattice quantum field theories (LQFT) become increasingly inefficient due to critical slowing down. In this work, we investigate score-based symmetry-preserving diffusion models as an alternative strategy to sample two-dimensional $φ^4$ and ${\rm U}(1)$ lattice field theories. We develop score networks that are equivariant to a range of group transformations, including global $\mathbb{Z}_2$ reflections, local ${\rm U}(1)$ rotations, and periodic translations $\mathbb{T}$. The score networks are trained using an augmented training scheme, which significantly improves sample quality in the simulated field theories. We also demonstrate empirically that our symmetry-aware models outperform generic score networks in sample quality, expressivity, and effective sample size.
papers.comment: Updated to match published version in JHEP. 45 pages, 12 figures. Code available at https://gitlab.com/ovega141/diffusion_for_lqft
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于分数的保持对称性的扩散模型（score-based symmetry-preserving diffusion models）作为采样二维格点场论的新策略，目标是缓解临界点附近MCMC的临界减慢问题。作者构造对全局Z2反射、局部U(1)旋转和周期平移T等群变换等变的score network，并采用增强训练方案进行训练。摘要报告该对称感知模型在样本质量、表达力和有效样本量上均优于通用score network。
Motivation: 格点量子场论在临界点附近因临界减慢（critical slowing down）导致MCMC模拟效率急剧下降，需要替代的采样方案。
Method: 提出群等变score network，覆盖全局Z2反射、局部U(1)旋转和周期平移T等对称群，并使用增强训练方案（augmented training scheme）训练。
Result: 摘要称增强训练方案显著提升模拟场论的样本质量，且对称感知模型在样本质量、表达力（expressivity）和有效样本量（effective sample size）上均优于通用score network。
Conclusion: 作者认为群等变扩散模型有潜力成为格点场论中MCMC之外的替代采样方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Model Inversion meets Cryptographic Fuzzy Extractors
papers.abstract_en: Model inversion attacks pose an open challenge to privacy-sensitive applications that use machine learning (ML) models. For example, face authentication systems use modern ML models to compute embedding vectors from face images of the enrolled users and store them. If leaked, inversion attacks can accurately reconstruct user faces from the leaked vectors. A fuzzy extractor (FE) is a cryptographic primitive with properties that can help defend against model inversion, offering attack-agnostic security without requiring any re-training of the ML model it protects. To date, no systematic cryptanalysis of existing FE schemes that tolerate $\ell_2$ noise, as needed in modern ML-based face recognition systems, has been conducted. We perform the first in-depth security analysis of existing $\ell_2$-FE schemes showing that they offer weak security. We also show end-to-end inversion attacks that achieve high success rates in recovering original faces that are meant to be protected by FE schemes. We then offer a simple but new candidate scheme and prove its security formally. Our construction offers the first design point that offers practical runtime, stronger security, and usable accuracy for use in commodity ML-based face authentication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对现有容忍 $\ell_2$ 噪声的模糊提取器（fuzzy extractor, FE）方案进行系统密码分析，指出其在模型逆向攻击（model inversion）下安全性薄弱，并展示能够高成功率恢复受 FE 保护的人脸图像端到端攻击。作者随后提出一个新的候选 FE 构造，给出形式化安全证明，并声称该构造在运行时、安全性和可用精度上首次同时适合商品级 ML 人脸认证系统。
Motivation: 人脸认证系统将用户人脸经 ML 模型映射为嵌入向量并存储，向量泄露后可被模型逆向攻击重建人脸；模糊提取器提供与攻击无关且无需重训练 ML 模型的防护，但现有容忍 $\ell_2$ 噪声的 FE 方案从未被系统性地进行密码分析，其实际安全性未知。
Method: 作者对现有 $\ell_2$-FE 方案进行深入安全性分析，并构造端到端的模型逆向攻击来验证其弱点；随后提出一个新的 FE 候选方案，并对其安全性给出形式化证明。
Result: 安全性分析表明现有 $\ell_2$-FE 方案仅提供弱安全性；端到端逆向攻击能以高成功率恢复本应受 FE 保护的人脸图像。
Conclusion: 作者提出的新构造是首个在实用运行时、更强安全性和可用精度三个维度上同时适用于商品化 ML 人脸认证的 FE 设计点；摘要未提及该方法在真实系统部署中的局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MediRec: Enhancing Chinese Medication Recommendation with Explainable Clinical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for clinical decision support through their advanced language understanding and reasoning capabilities. However, their application to Chinese clinical medication recommendation remains largely unexplored. Existing approaches are primarily developed on English electronic health record datasets and focus on coarse-grained medication code prediction, offering limited support for interpretable clinical decision-making. In this work, we propose MediRec, an explainable LLM-based framework for Chinese medication recommendation from electronic health records. MediRec combines clinically grounded reasoning-chain distillation with reinforcement learning to improve both recommendation accuracy and interpretability. Comprehensive experiments on a Chinese medication recommendation benchmark show that MediRec achieves strong performance, with an F1 score of 0.5813 and a Jaccard score of 0.4626. Further analyses indicate that MediRec generates clinically plausible recommendations with transparent reasoning, demonstrating its effectiveness for explainable medication decision support in Chinese healthcare settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MediRec，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的可解释中文药物推荐框架，将临床推理链蒸馏与强化学习结合，用于从电子健康记录（EHR）中生成推荐。在一个中文药物推荐基准上，该方法取得F1分数0.5813、Jaccard分数0.4626，并产生临床合理且透明的推理。
Motivation: LLM在临床决策支持中展现潜力，但应用于中文临床药物推荐仍未被充分探索。现有方法多在英文EHR数据集上开发，仅做粗粒度的药物编码预测，缺乏对可解释临床决策的支持。
Method: 提出MediRec框架，结合临床基础推理链蒸馏（reasoning-chain distillation）与强化学习（reinforcement learning），以提升推荐准确性和可解释性。
Result: 在中文药物推荐基准上取得F1分数0.5813和Jaccard分数0.4626；进一步分析表明MediRec能生成临床合理且带透明推理的推荐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MediRec在中文医疗场景下实现了有效的可解释药物推荐决策支持，验证了该框架的实用性。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning and Consumption-Savings Behavior
papers.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates how reinforcement learning can explain two puzzling empirical patterns in household consumption behavior during economic downturns. I develop a model where agents use Q-learning with neural network approximation to make consumption-savings decisions under income uncertainty, departing from standard rational expectations assumptions. The model replicates two key findings from recent literature: (1) unemployed households with previously low liquid assets exhibit substantially higher marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) out of stimulus transfers compared to high-asset households (0.50 vs 0.34), even when neither group faces borrowing constraints, consistent with Ganong et al. (2024); and (2) households with more past unemployment experiences maintain persistently lower consumption levels after controlling for current economic conditions, a "scarring" effect documented by Malmendier and Shen (2024). Unlike existing explanations based on belief updating about income risk or ex-ante heterogeneity, the reinforcement learning mechanism generates both higher MPCs and lower consumption levels simultaneously through value function approximation errors that evolve with experience. Simulation results closely match the empirical estimates, suggesting that adaptive learning through reinforcement learning provides a unifying framework for understanding how past experiences shape current consumption behavior beyond what current economic conditions would predict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用强化学习 (reinforcement learning, RL) 解释经济衰退期间家庭消费行为的两个经验谜团：低流动资产失业家庭对刺激转移支付有更高的边际消费倾向 (MPC)，以及过去失业经历对当前消费水平的持久“疤痕”效应。作者构建了使用 Q-learning 与神经网络近似的消费-储蓄决策模型，替代标准理性预期假设，并称模拟结果与 Ganong et al. (2024) 和 Malmendier and Shen (2024) 的实证估计高度吻合。
Motivation: 现有解释依赖收入风险的信念更新或事前异质性，无法同时产生更高的 MPC 与更低的消费水平；作者试图用经验驱动的自适应学习机制统一解释这两类现象。
Method: 建立消费-储蓄模型，智能体在收入不确定性下用带神经网络近似的 Q-learning 做决策，不采用理性预期假设；通过价值函数近似误差随经验演化，产生行为特征。

papers.title: Neural Diversity Regularizes Hallucinations in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models continue to hallucinate despite increases in parameters, compute, and data. We propose neural diversity -- decorrelated parallel representations -- as a principled mechanism that reduces hallucination rates at fixed parameter and data budgets. While existing mitigation strategies largely target accuracy, we provide the first formal tail bounds for hallucination probability in ensembled language models, reframing it as a second-moment reliability problem and explaining 94.3% of empirical reliability variation seen across parallel configurations. We introduce ND-LoRA (Neural Diversity Low-Rank Adaptation), combining parallel LoRA adapters with Barlow Twins regularization, and reduce hallucinations by up to 25.6% (and 14.6% on average) while preserving general accuracy. Ablations show LoRA adapters and regularization act synergistically, causal interventions prove neurodiversity as the mediating factor and correlational studies indicate scale: a 0.1% neural correlation increase is associated with a 3.8% hallucination increase. Finally, task-dependent optimality emerges: different tasks require different optimal amounts of neurodiversity. Together, our results highlight neural diversity as a third axis of scaling -- orthogonal to parameters and data -- to improve the reliability of language models at fixed budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将神经多样性（neural diversity，即去相关的并行表示）作为降低语言模型幻觉率的原理性机制，并给出集成语言模型中幻觉概率的首个形式化尾界，将其重构为二阶矩可靠性问题。作者提出的 ND-LoRA 结合并行 LoRA 适配器与 Barlow Twins 正则化，在保持通用精度的同时将幻觉率最多降低 25.6%（平均降低 14.6%），并将神经多样性视为与参数和数据正交的第三条扩展（scaling）轴。
Motivation: 语言模型即使增加参数、算力和数据仍持续产生幻觉，现有缓解策略主要针对准确性而非可靠性，缺少对幻觉概率的形式化保证。
Method: 提出神经多样性作为去相关的并行表示，给出集成语言模型幻觉概率的首个形式化尾界；在此基础上提出 ND-LoRA，将并行 LoRA 适配器与 Barlow Twins 正则化结合，并配合消融、因果干预和相关分析来验证机制。
Result: 该机制解释了跨并行配置中 94.3% 的经验可靠性变化；ND-LoRA 使幻觉率最多降低 25.6%、平均降低 14.6% 且不损失通用精度。消融显示 LoRA 适配器与正则化具有协同作用，因果干预表明神经多样性是中介因素，相关研究显示神经相关度每增加 0.1% 与幻觉率增加 3.8% 相关联。
Conclusion: 神经多样性可作为与参数和数据正交的第三条扩展轴来提升固定预算下语言模型的可靠性，且不同任务存在任务相关的最优神经多样性水平。

papers.title: When Large Language Models Know the Table: A Framework for Assessing Data Contamination in Tabular Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly exposed to data contamination, i.e., performance gains driven by prior exposure of test datasets rather than generalization. However, in the context of tabular data, this problem is largely unexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on memorization tests, which are too coarse to detect contamination. In contrast, we propose a framework for assessing contamination in tabular datasets by generating controlled queries and performing comparative evaluation. Given a dataset, we craft multiple-choice aligned queries that preserve task structure while allowing systematic transformations of the underlying data. These transformations are designed to selectively disrupt dataset information while preserving partial knowledge, enabling us to isolate performance attributable to contamination. We complement this setup with non-neural baselines that provide reference performance, and we introduce a statistical testing procedure to formally detect significant deviations indicative of contamination. Empirical results on eight widely used tabular datasets reveal clear evidence of contamination in four cases. These findings suggest that performance on downstream tasks involving such datasets may be substantially inflated, raising concerns about the reliability of current evaluation practices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估表格数据集数据污染（data contamination）的框架，通过构造保持任务结构的多项选择查询并对底层数据施加系统变换，配合非神经基线与统计检验来识别污染。在八个常用表格数据集上的实验显示其中四个存在明显污染证据，作者认为这可能导致下游任务性能被大幅高估。
Motivation: 表格数据场景下的数据污染问题此前几乎没有被系统研究，现有方法主要依赖记忆测试（memorization tests），粒度太粗而难以可靠检测污染。
Method: 给定数据集后，框架先生成多项选择对齐查询以保留任务结构，再对数据施加多种系统变换，选择性破坏数据集信息而保留部分知识，从而隔离出可归因于污染的模型表现；同时引入非神经基线作为参考，并使用统计检验正式检测显著偏差。
Result: 在八个广泛使用的表格数据集上，框架发现四个数据集存在清晰的数据污染证据，提示在这些数据集上的下游任务性能可能被显著抬高。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前基于这类数据集的评估实践可靠性存疑，并强调该框架可用于正式识别表格数据中的污染证据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bi-Level Reinforcement Learning Pathway for Sim-to-Real Optimality
papers.abstract_en: Training Reinforcement Learning (RL) policies using simulation models before deployment in real-world environments is a common strategy when real-world interaction is expensive. This approach is used in sim-to-real RL and in dyna-style model-based RL. A key limitation of this approach is that the policies trained in simulation often perform poorly in the real world due to discrepancies between the simulation model and the real-world environment, referred to as the sim-to-real gap. This gap reflects the objective mismatch: simulation models are typically constructed for predictive accuracy, whereas policies are trained to maximize task performance. Since the policy learned in simulation is implicitly defined by the simulation parameters, understanding the sensitivity of the learned policy to these parameters enables gradient-based adaptation of the simulation model to improve real-world policy performance. Motivated by this, we derive the sensitivity of locally converged policies trained with Stochastic Policy Gradient (SPG) methods in an actor-critic setting, which is the most widely used approach in RL. Based on this sensitivity analysis, we formulate a bi-level RL approach that can address the objective mismatch problem by learning simulation parameters using gradients of real-world policy performance, thereby directly coupling simulation model adaptation with policy performance. We provide a thorough convergence analysis of the proposed bi-level RL approach and illustrate the concept through a proof-of-concept bi-level PPO algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对仿真到真实环境迁移中策略性能下降的 sim-to-real gap 问题，提出一种双层强化学习 (bi-level RL) 方法。作者在 actor-critic 设置下推导了用随机策略梯度 (SPG) 训练得到的局部收敛策略对仿真参数的敏感性，并据此用真实世界策略性能的梯度来学习仿真参数，从而直接耦合仿真模型适配与策略性能。摘要报告了该方法的收敛性分析，并以双层 PPO 算法作为概念验证。
Motivation: 在 sim-to-real RL 和 dyna-style 模型型 RL 中，仿真模型通常按预测精度构建，而策略按任务性能训练，导致目标不匹配 (objective mismatch)；这使仿真中训练的策略在真实世界中表现差。
Method: 推导 actor-critic 设置下 SPG 训练的局部收敛策略关于仿真参数的敏感性，基于该敏感性分析提出双层 RL 框架，用真实世界策略性能的梯度学习仿真参数。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验，提供了所提出双层 RL 方法的收敛性分析，并通过概念验证性质的双层 PPO 算法展示该方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过梯度将仿真模型参数学习与策略性能直接耦合可以缓解目标不匹配问题，但该方法目前仅以 PPO 概念验证形式呈现，尚需更多实证支持。
