papers.title: Binding Biometrics with AI Agent Identifiers for Delegation of Authority
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems has raised serious questions about the accountability for tasks performed by AI agents. Ideally, an AI agent must not be allowed to perform critical tasks without explicit authorization by a human operator. Since biometric recognition is one of the most reliable approaches for authenticating individuals, it has the potential to enable authenticated delegation of authority to AI agents. In this work, we present a framework called BIND, which leverages ideas from the field of biometric cryptosystems, to securely bind biometric data of the human user to the AI agent identity (ID) and authority scope (task-specific constraints) at the time of agent authorization. This token/identifier can be presented by the AI agent to an Identity Auditor, who simultaneously performs biometric authentication and recovers the agent ID and scope, thereby enabling real-time user authentication and establishing a non-repudiable proof of human control and delegation of authority. We also provide a practical implementation of the proposed BIND framework based on face features extracted using standard deep neural network models. To facilitate this implementation, we propose a feature adaptation module that transforms real-valued feature embeddings into fixed-length binary representations suitable for a fuzzy commitment construct based on turbo error correcting codes. Experiments demonstrate the practical feasibility of the proposed face cryptosystem, achieving a True Match Rate of $96\%$ at zero False Match Rate and supporting $1024$-bit agent tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 BIND 的框架，用于在授权时刻将人类用户的生物特征数据与 AI 智能体的身份（agent ID）及权限范围（authority scope）安全绑定，从而实现对智能体行为的可认证委托。该框架借鉴生物特征加密系统（biometric cryptosystems）的思想，并基于深度神经网络提取的人脸特征给出实用实现，实验表明其技术可行性。
Motivation: 随着智能体式 AI（agentic AI）系统的普及，AI 智能体执行任务时的问责问题日益突出；理想情况下，智能体未经人类操作者明确授权不应执行关键任务。生物特征识别是最可靠的身份认证手段之一，因此有望用于实现对人类授权的可认证委托。
Method: 提出 BIND 框架，利用生物特征加密系统将人类用户的生物特征数据与智能体 ID 和任务约束在授权时绑定，生成可供智能体出示给身份审计器（Identity Auditor）的令牌。身份审计器同时完成生物特征认证并恢复 agent ID 与权限范围，从而提供不可否认的人类控制与委托证明。作者还提出一个特征适配模块，将实值人脸嵌入转换为定长二值表示，以适配基于 turbo 纠错码的模糊承诺（fuzzy commitment）结构。
Result: 实验基于标准深度神经网络提取的人脸特征验证了该人脸密码系统的实用性：在零误匹配率（False Match Rate）下实现 96% 的真匹配率（True Match Rate），并支持 1024 位的智能体令牌。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 BIND 能够建立不可否认的人类控制与委托证明，并给出了基于人脸特征的可行实现方案。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SafeCommit: Certifying When Memory-Grounded Agents May Safely Act
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents increasingly use persistent memory and tools to take actions with external side effects. A central failure mode is premature commitment: an agent acts before resolving whether its memory grounding is stale, conflicting, incomplete, or corrupted. We formalize this problem as safe commitment under memory uncertainty and introduce SafeCommit, a risk controlled layer between agent reasoning and external execution. The layer constructs a calibrated set of plausible latent worlds from memory, observations, tool outputs, provenance, and policy constraints. It permits a side effectful action only when a conformal action certificate shows that the action is safe in every retained world. Otherwise, it selects a low-side-effect probe that targets the worlds blocking certification, or returns a conservative fallback. Under calibrated world coverage, the probability of an unsafe certified commit is at most the target level α; with imperfect world proposal, the bound separates calibration and representation error. A dependency-free controlled simulator illustrates the safety-utility tradeoff and reproduces all reported results with one command. The goal is to offer a concrete approach for deciding not only what an agent should do, but when the available evidence is sufficient to safely do it.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 tables, and 1 figure, target NeurIPS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有持久记忆与外部工具的长程智能体，形式化了记忆不确定性下的安全承诺问题，并提出 SafeCommit 这一位于智能体推理与外部执行之间的风险控制层。该层基于记忆、观测、工具输出、来源信息与策略约束构造一组校准的可行潜在世界，仅当符合规定 (conformal) 的动作证书表明动作在所有保留世界中均安全时才允许执行有副作用动作，否则选择低副作用探针或保守回退。摘要通过一个无依赖的受控模拟器展示了安全性-效用权衡，目标是回答智能体不仅应该做什么，还应何时有足够证据可以安全地做。
Motivation: 长程智能体常因过早承诺而失败，即在记忆基础过时、冲突、不完整或损坏时仍执行有外部副作用的动作；现有方法缺少对这一失败模式的系统化形式化与保障。
Method: 提出 SafeCommit 风险控制层：从记忆、观测、工具输出、来源信息和策略约束构造校准的潜在世界集合，仅当 conformal action certificate 证明动作在所有保留世界安全时放行；否则选择针对阻塞认证世界的低副作用探针，或返回保守回退。
Result: 在校准的世界覆盖下，不安全认证提交的概率至多为目标水平 α；在非完美世界提议下，界限将校准误差与表示误差分离。无依赖的受控模拟器说明了安全性-效用权衡，并可用一条命令重现所述结果。
Conclusion: 作者的目标是提供一种具体方法，不仅决定智能体应该做什么，还决定何时可用证据已充分、足以安全地执行动作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sample Complexity of Multicalibration for Multilevel Properties
papers.abstract_en: Calibration requires a predictor to be unbiased after conditioning on its own predictions. Multicalibration asks for this guarantee simultaneously across a collection of groups. Many prediction tasks ask for several related features of the same conditional outcome distribution: variance is defined relative to the mean, skewness relative to both mean and variance, and conditional value at risk relative to a quantile. We study multicalibration for a sequence of $k$ properties in which each property is identifiable once the preceding properties are fixed. This framework includes Bayes pairs but does not require the properties to arise from a single loss. For every fixed $k\ge2$, we establish matching upper and lower sample-complexity bounds up to logarithmic factors under regularity conditions. Even with only polylogarithmically many binary groups, achieving multicalibration error $\varepsilon$ requires $\widetildeΩ(\varepsilon^{-(k+2)})$ samples. Conversely, for any finite group family $\mathcal G$, we give a randomized learner using $O(\varepsilon^{-(k+2)}+\varepsilon^{-2}\log|\mathcal G|)$ samples. Thus the sample complexity is $\widetildeΘ(\varepsilon^{-(k+2)})$ for polynomial-size group families. We instantiate the theory for three canonical examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多层级属性 (multilevel properties) 上的多校准 (multicalibration) 样本复杂度。作者考虑一串 k 个属性，其中每个属性在前序属性固定后可被识别，该框架涵盖 Bayes 对但不要求属性来自单一损失。在正则条件下，他们为每个固定 k≥2 建立了匹配到对数因子的上下界，并给出三个典型例子的具体结果。
Motivation: 许多预测任务需要同一条件结果分布的多项关联特征，如方差依赖均值、偏度依赖均值和方差、条件风险价值依赖分位数；现有校准与多校准理论缺少对这类多级属性序列样本复杂度的刻画。
Method: 定义基于逐级可识别属性的多校准框架；构造下界证明即使只有 polylog 个二值组，达到 ε 多校准误差也需 Ω~(ε^{-(k+2)}) 样本；同时为任意有限组族 G 给出随机化学习器，样本复杂度为 O(ε^{-(k+2)} + ε^{-2} log|G|)。
Result: 对固定 k≥2，下界为 Ω~(ε^{-(k+2)})；对多项式大小的组族，上界与之匹配，因此样本复杂度为 Θ~(ε^{-(k+2)})。
Conclusion: 摘要表明多级属性多校准的样本复杂度随属性数 k 呈 ε^{-(k+2)} 量级，并给出三个规范例子的具体化；结论依赖正则性条件。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.motivation: 许多预测任务需要同一条件结果分布的多项关联特征，如方差依赖均值、偏度依赖均值和方差、条件风险价值依赖分位数；现有校准与多校准理论缺少对这类多级属性序列样本复杂度的刻画。

papers.title: Eliciting Intrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs via Semantically Equivalent Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often used in conjunction with external knowledge sources to improve their factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations, through methods such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, these systems remain susceptible to intrinsic hallucinations, where the model generates unfaithful or fabricated information that is not supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose a novel framework to assess model robustness against this phenomenon by stress-testing using natural, semantically equivalent variations of a user query found via adversarial optimization methods. We apply our framework, which enforces strict semantic equivalence constraints and an intrinsic hallucination objective, to a range of adversarial attack techniques across white-box, gray-box, and black-box adversarial settings. Evaluating these attacks on 5 open-source and 5 closed-source generator models across 3 datasets, we demonstrate that even state-of-the-art models are highly susceptible to meaning-preserving perturbations, which significantly degrade contextual faithfulness (by up to 50% for GPT-5-mini). Our findings indicate that faithful use of in-context evidence remains fragile even in state-of-the-art LLMs, motivating architectures and training objectives that enforce robust grounding independent of surface query form. Code is available at: https://github.com/atriviveksharma/intrinsic_hall
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种评估大语言模型（LLM）对内在幻觉（intrinsic hallucination）鲁棒性的框架：通过对抗优化生成用户查询的自然语义等价变体来给模型施压。作者在 white-box、gray-box 和 black-box 三种对抗设置下评估多种攻击技术，覆盖 5 个开源与 5 个闭源生成模型、3 个数据集，发现即使最先进的模型也极易受保持语义的扰动影响，其中 GPT-5-mini 的上下文忠实度（contextual faithfulness）下降最高达 50%。代码已开源。
Motivation: 即使借助检索增强生成（RAG）等外部知识源，LLM 仍会出现生成内容与检索证据不一致的内在幻觉；现有鲁棒性评估缺少针对这种自然、语义等价查询变体的压力测试。
Method: 提出一个攻击框架，严格施加语义等价约束并定义内在幻觉目标函数，在此基础上将多种对抗攻击技术分别应用于 white-box、gray-box 与 black-box 设置，以自动搜索用户查询的语义等价变体。
Result: 在 5 个开源和 5 个闭源生成模型、3 个数据集上的实验表明，最先进的模型对意义保持的扰动高度敏感；上下文忠实度最多下降 50%（GPT-5-mini）。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，即便在最先进的 LLM 中，对上下文证据的忠实利用仍然脆弱，这促使未来需要设计不依赖表面查询形式（surface query form）、强制稳健接地（robust grounding）的架构与训练目标。

papers.title: The RAIL Principles for Neurosymbolic AI: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neurosymbolic AI systems that integrate machine learning and symbolic reasoning are rapidly gaining attention. They complement the data-intensive statistical approaches of neural networks and language models with symbolic reasoning algorithms to function in high-stakes domains or in low-data regimes that characterize many real-world applications. We argue that the neurosymbolic combination of machine learning and formal reasoning is not a niche approach within AI, but rather includes many already successful techniques that are of crucial importance to the development of reliable, efficient and, ultimately, trustworthy systems. This perspective prompts a re-examination of the design of current AI systems. We show that many leading AI systems, including some that are not traditionally considered as neurosymbolic, can be analysed from the perspective of four principles of neurosymbolic AI design: Reasoning, Assurances, Interfacing and Learning (RAIL). Applying the RAIL framework offers a unified view of seemingly disparate AI systems, ranging from physics-aware machine learning to neuro-guided search (such as Google DeepMind's Alpha-* suite), causal learning and tool-augmented Large Language Models. Importantly, the RAIL principles will enable engineers to make better-informed and more principled decisions about the design and deployment of production-level AI systems. In this article, we introduce the RAIL principles, examine how they can be applied across major areas of AI, and illustrate how they may guide practitioners to integrate neurosymbolic methods into next-generation AI technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经符号 AI（neurosymbolic AI）设计的四条原则 RAIL——推理（Reasoning）、保证（Assurances）、接口（Interfacing）与学习（Learning），主张机器学习与形式推理的结合并非 AI 中的小众路线，而是构建可靠、高效、可信系统的关键。作者以此框架重新审视当前 AI 系统设计，并论证许多主流系统（包括通常不被视为神经符号的系统）都可以从 RAIL 视角统一分析。文章面向工程师，旨在为生产级 AI 系统的设计与部署提供更有依据的决策框架。
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统设计常把神经网络/语言模型的数据驱动统计方法与符号推理算法割裂看待，而神经符号组合在高风险领域和低数据场景下至关重要。作者认为应重新审视当前 AI 系统的设计方式，并给出统一的规范性视角。
Method: 提出 RAIL 四条设计原则作为分析框架，将其应用于物理感知机器学习（physics-aware machine learning）、神经引导搜索（如 Alpha-* 系列）、因果学习（causal learning）和工具增强的大语言模型等看似迥异的 AI 系统，并展示实践者如何据此整合神经符号方法。
Result: 该文是立场性/视角类文章，未报告量化实验结果。其核心主张是：许多主流 AI 系统都能从 RAIL 四原则的角度得到统一解释，从而为系统比较与设计提供结构化视角。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RAIL 原则能让工程师对生产级 AI 系统的设计和部署做出更明智、更原则化的决策，并可能引导下一代 AI 技术整合神经符号方法；其适用范围被表述为面向广泛 AI 领域的设计指导，而非特定任务的实证方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: EA-Graph: Artifact-Anchored Verification Memory for Coding Agents under Upstream Drift
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly work across sessions, but prose notes can preserve a conclusion without the program state that supported it. After an upstream change, a repository may still build even though earlier verification claims are no longer valid. EA-Graph is an artifact-anchored memory for verification claims. It represents artifacts at sub-path granularity, resolves aliases to leaf definitions, anchors each claim to the content used to establish it, and keeps evidence strength separate from freshness. When replacement content is unavailable, the claim becomes unprovable rather than guessed. EA-Graph is evaluated on generated repositories whose behavior-to-artifact ground truth is known by construction. The task is to classify prior claims as unaffected, affected, or unprovable after value drift, logic drift, and deliberately withheld upstream content. The analysis covers 42 sessions across seven clean worlds, 14 model-world instances, three memory conditions, and two model tiers. In the Haiku round, artifact-anchored memory outscored prose notes and no persistent memory in all seven worlds; each exact paired Wilcoxon comparison yielded p = 0.0156. In the Sonnet round, the anchored condition was perfect, but frequent control ceilings left the preregistered contrasts non-significant. No session fabricated withheld content. These results support a bounded claim: artifact-anchored memory improved the smaller model's provability judgments in this testbed. An exploratory comparison further suggests that structured claim memory may narrow a capability gap by externalizing in-session re-derivation, but it does not establish cross- model equivalence. The study makes no claim about efficiency or repair quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EA-Graph，一种面向编程智能体验证主张 (verification claims) 的工件锚定记忆 (artifact-anchored memory)。它以子路径粒度表示工件，将别名解析到叶定义，把每条主张锚定到用于建立它的内容，并将证据强度与 freshness 分开处理；当替换内容不可用时，主张被判定为不可证明而不是猜测。评估使用行为到工件 ground truth 已知的生成仓库，在值漂移、逻辑漂移和故意 withheld 上游内容后分类主张为不受影响、受影响或不可证明。
Motivation: 编程智能体跨会话工作时，散文式笔记能保留结论，却丢失了支撑该结论的程序状态；上游变更后仓库可能仍能构建，但此前的验证主张已失效。作者针对这一 gap 提出需要一种将验证主张与具体工件内容绑定的持久记忆机制。
Method: EA-Graph 将工件表示到子路径粒度，解析别名到叶定义，并把每条验证主张锚定到其建立时所依赖的内容；证据强度与 freshness 在数据结构上分离。当替换内容不可用时，主张被标记为 unprovable，而非进行猜测。
Result: 分析覆盖 42 个会话、七个 clean worlds、14 个 model-world 实例、三种记忆条件和两个模型层级。在 Haiku 轮中，工件锚定记忆在全部七个 worlds 上超过散文笔记和无持久记忆，逐对精确 Wilcoxon 比较 p=0.0156；在 Sonnet 轮中锚定条件表现完美，但控制组频繁达到上限使预先登记的对比不显著。没有会话编造 withheld 内容。
Conclusion: 作者给出有界结论：在该测试台上，工件锚定记忆改善了较小模型的 provability 判断。探索性比较提示结构化主张记忆可能通过外化会话内重推导来缩小能力差距，但不能证明跨模型等价；研究未对效率或修复质量作任何声明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Compass: Continuously Aligning Social Media Feeds via In-Situ Reflections
papers.abstract_en: Social media recommendation feeds often optimize for users' immediate impulses rather than preferences they would hold after deeper reflection. Some systems address this misalignment by incorporating users' explicit preferences via a configuration page or in-feed controls instead of just behavioral signals. However, users typically have evolving preferences, and their stated preferences and behavior naturally diverge, necessitating continuous reflection and feed realignment. But existing strategies require the user to take initiative and are often effortful; as a result, in practice they are rarely invoked. We present Compass, a system that aligns a user's feed with their reflective preferences by helping users reflect on and articulate their preferences given their behavior. To enable continuous reflection during everyday browsing, Compass surfaces in-situ reflections via lightweight notifications, while feed alignment is achieved by periodically simulating behavioral signals and directly manipulating feed content. We embedded Compass within YouTube Shorts and compared it against a baseline without continuous support through a 10-day field study (N=15). We found that Compass promoted more reflective and purposeful feed consumption, iterative preference adjustment, and stronger feed alignment, without sacrificing the casual nature of feed browsing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Compass，一个通过轻量通知在浏览过程中触发“原位反思”（in-situ reflections）来持续对齐社交媒体推荐流与用户反思性偏好的系统。系统通过周期性模拟行为信号并直接操纵 feed 内容实现 feed 对齐。作者将 Compass 嵌入 YouTube Shorts，进行了 10 天、N=15 的现场研究（field study），发现它促进更有反思性和目的性的 feed 消费、迭代式偏好调整以及更强的 feed 对齐，且未牺牲浏览的随意性。
Motivation: 社交媒体推荐流往往优化用户的即时冲动，而非用户深度反思后持有的偏好；现有配置页或 feed 内控制需要用户主动发起且费力，实际中很少被调用，而用户偏好本身在演化且陈述偏好与行为自然存在分歧，因此需要持续的反思与 feed 重新对齐。
Method: Compass 通过轻量通知在用户日常浏览中即时呈现反思提示，帮助用户结合自身行为反思并表达偏好；feed 对齐则依靠周期性模拟行为信号和对 feed 内容的直接操纵来实现。
Result: 在一个嵌入 YouTube Shorts 的 10 天现场研究（N=15）中，与无持续支持的基线相比，Compass 促进了更具反思性和目的性的 feed 消费、迭代式偏好调整以及更强的 feed 对齐，同时保持浏览的随意性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，持续且低负担的原位反思机制可以在不牺牲休闲浏览体验的前提下，使社交媒体 feed 更贴近用户的反思性偏好；摘要未报告明确的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Strategic Evaluation of Planning Strategies for LLM Agents in Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of LLM planning agents largely ask whether a task succeeds or a declared plan is followed. In strategic cyber-physical systems, a stronger question is whether the planning architecture remains appropriate after autonomous participants respond and physics constrains the outcome. We introduce a controlled, physics-grounded benchmark built around planning-induced control trajectories: the ordered planning operations and directives through which an execution architecture acts on other agents and the physical process. It implements predefined, sequential, hierarchical, and search executors in a smart-grid demand-response system with 40 heterogeneous prosumers and an independently simulated radial feeder. The LLM is bounded to typed policy declaration and short operator messages, while schedule construction, prosumer dynamics, and power flow remain explicit code. The protocol uses paired forced-mode counterfactuals, common random response draws, and event-level deadline feasibility. Three properties follow. Architecture materially changes outcomes: forced search is the oracle in all five baseline seeds. Execution fidelity needs more than mode agreement: objective substitution holds agreement at 1.0 while increasing voltage shortfall by 2.68x. A 144-scenario, 576-episode bank has feasible oracles from three of the four architectures. A prespecified stress-held-out ridge has mean regret 90.7 (95% interval [73.8, 108.6]) and no detectable value over fixed sequential; applying known deadline feasibility before quality prediction cuts regret to 29.0 and improves over fixed sequential by 61.1. An all-feasible ablation does not beat fixed search, localising the remaining challenge to within-feasible quality selection. A five-model extension separates stress-conditioned, state-blind, and invariant declarers; latency tails show that live feasibility should be treated probabilistically.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 引入受控的、基于物理的基准，通过强制模式反事实 (paired forced-mode counterfactuals)、公共随机响应抽样和事件级截止可行性 (event-level deadline feasibility) 协议，比较 predefined、sequential、hierarchical 和 search 四类执行器在智能电网需求响应系统中的表现。

papers.title: Geometry-Informed Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pre-trained Molecular GNNs for Blood-Brain Barrier Permeability Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Blood-brain barrier permeability (BBBP) prediction is a critical screening task in central nervous system drug discovery, where candidate molecules must be assessed for whether they can cross, or should be prevented from crossing, the blood-brain barrier. However, this task remains challenging because of limited, class-imbalanced datasets and sensitivity to molecular structure. Recent advances in deep learning have established graph neural networks (GNNs) as a powerful approach for molecular representation learning, while pre-trained molecular GNNs provide transferable knowledge for downstream tasks. However, full fine-tuning is often parameter-inefficient and prone to overfitting, whereas existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods mainly adapt node features or the two-dimensional covalent graph, limiting their ability to capture three-dimensional geometry and second-order interactions. To address these limitations, we propose BBBP-GeoPEFT, a geometry-informed PEFT framework for pre-trained molecular GNNs. BBBP-GeoPEFT constructs distance-based graphs at multiple cutoffs and their corresponding line graphs from molecular conformers to capture spatial atom and second-order edge interactions. Lightweight auxiliary geometric graph encoders generate cutoff-specific representations, which are incorporated into each pre-trained layer through node-wise cutoff attention and gated residual connections. This design preserves pre-trained knowledge while incorporating permeability-relevant geometric information with a small trainable-parameter budget. Experiments on a curated BBBP dataset show that BBBP-GeoPEFT achieves competitive performance compared with full fine-tuning and representative PEFT baselines. Under both random and scaffold splitting, BBBP-GeoPEFT achieves competitive or improved ROC-AUC and accuracy in most experiments while updating only 10.1% of the model parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BBBP-GeoPEFT，一个面向预训练分子 GNN 的几何感知参数高效微调 (PEFT) 框架，用于血脑屏障渗透性预测。该方法从分子构象构建多截断距离图及对应 line graph，通过轻量辅助几何编码器生成截断特定表示，并以节点级截断注意力和门控残差连接注入每个预训练层。在 curated BBBP 数据集上，该方法仅更新 10.1% 的参数即可在随机和 scaffold 划分下取得与全量微调及代表性 PEFT 基线相当或更优的 ROC-AUC 和准确率。
Motivation: BBBP 预测因数据集有限、类别不平衡且对分子结构敏感而具有挑战性；全量微调预训练分子 GNN 参数效率低且易过拟合，而现有 PEFT 方法主要适配节点特征或二维共价图，难以捕获三维几何与二阶相互作用。
Method: 提出 BBBP-GeoPEFT，从分子构象构造多截断距离图和相应 line graph 以捕捉空间原子与二阶边相互作用；轻量辅助几何图编码器生成截断特定表示，通过节点级截断注意力与门控残差连接融入每个预训练层，以较小可训练参数预算保留预训练知识。
Result: 在 curated BBBP 数据集上的实验显示，BBBP-GeoPEFT 与全量微调及代表性 PEFT 基线相比性能相当；在随机和 scaffold 划分下，大多数实验中取得相当或改进的 ROC-AUC 与准确率，且仅更新 10.1% 的模型参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调几何信息可通过参数高效方式注入预训练 GNN，从而在保留预训练知识的同时捕获与渗透性相关的三维几何和二阶相互作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PriDyG: Privacy-preserving Dynamic Graph Inference with LLM-GNN Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Graph inference over relational data can expose sensitive edge information, and this risk becomes more severe in dynamic graphs, where repeated model updates cause privacy loss to accumulate. We formulate Edge-level Differentially Private Dynamic Graph Inference (EDG) and propose PriDyG, a private inference framework that combines GNN-based structural learning with LLM-based semantic reasoning. PriDyG introduces incremental private multi-hop aggregation, which buffers newly arrived edges and processes each edge exactly once. By parallel composition, the total privacy cost equals that of a single static release, independent of the number or schedule of model updates. Compared with geometrically decaying budget allocation, incremental aggregation avoids exponentially increasing noise while preserving exact one-hop signals and at least half of two-hop information transfers. PriDyG further complements privatized GNN outputs with LLM predictions derived solely from node text, incurring no additional edge-level privacy cost. Experiments on four benchmarks for node classification and link prediction show that PriDyG consistently outperforms geometrically decaying baselines under the same privacy budget and matches the utility of naive per-update retraining while reducing cumulative privacy cost by up to three orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态图中图推理的边级隐私泄露问题，提出 Edge-level Differentially Private Dynamic Graph Inference (EDG) 形式化定义，并给出 PriDyG 私有推理框架，将 GNN 结构学习与 LLM 语义推理结合。PriDyG 采用增量式私有多跳聚合，对新到达的边缓冲并恰好处理一次，通过并行组合 (parallel composition) 使总隐私代价等同于单次静态发布，与模型更新次数和调度无关。实验表明在相同隐私预算下稳定优于几何衰减预算分配基线，并匹配朴素逐更新重训练的效用，同时将累计隐私代价降低至多三个数量级。
Motivation: 关系数据上的图推理可能暴露敏感边信息，而动态图中反复的模型更新会让隐私损失不断累积，现有几何衰减的预算分配方式会导致噪声指数增长，需要一种不随更新次数增长隐私成本的私密推理方案。
Method: PriDyG 由 GNN 结构学习与 LLM 语义推理协作组成：增量式私有多-hop 聚合先缓冲新到达的边并保证每条边只处理一次，利用并行组合使总隐私成本与单次静态发布相同；LLM 仅基于节点文本生成预测，与私有化后的 GNN 输出互补，不增加额外边级隐私代价。
Result: 在四个节点分类与链接预测基准上，PriDyG 在同一隐私预算下一致优于几何衰减基线，并在效用上与朴素逐更新重训练相当，同时累计隐私成本降低最多三个数量级；增量聚合还保持了精确的一跳信号和至少一半的两跳信息传递。
Conclusion: 作者强调增量聚合避免了指数增长的噪声，同时保留了一跳与部分两跳的图结构信息，且 LLM 语义预测不产生额外边级隐私成本；该工作为动态图私密推理提供了不依赖更新调度的新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Is a Conformal Guarantee Fair? Auditing Silent Subgroup Under-Coverage in Alzheimer's Disease Longitudinal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal prediction of Alzheimer's disease biomarkers increasingly informs clinical decisions, and a forecast is only useful if it also reports how much to trust it. Conformal prediction supplies this by wrapping any forecaster in a prediction band with a finite-sample coverage guarantee under exchangeability. However, standard population-level conformal prediction guarantees only marginal coverage and may mask substantial under-coverage within clinically important subgroups. We introduce a general mechanism-driven framework for auditing and repairing such subgroup under-coverage. Across two cohorts (ADNI, OASIS-3), two base forecasters, and nine attributes spanning genetic risk, demographics, and clinical severity, we find that population-level bands under-cover high-risk subgroups in 57 of 68 audited combinations, despite achieving nominal marginal coverage. We trace these failures to two mechanisms: (A) \emph{rarity}, where a group-conditional band calibrated on only $n$ patients covers at most $k/(n+1)$; and (B) \emph{tail-heaviness}, where a population-wide band is too narrow for a heavy-tailed subgroup and additional data cannot close the gap. Under-coverage falls disproportionately on patients with high genetic risk and disease severity (6.1 pp mean deficit, 95\% CI [3.3, 8.9]), while demographic groups remain at the target level on average (0.0 pp, CI [$-1.9$, 1.7]). We pair each mechanism with a corresponding conformal correction: cross-conformal pooling for rarity, per-subgroup calibration for tail-heaviness, and a coverage-safe marginal floor when both arise. Together, these corrections restore target coverage for nearly every high-risk subgroup across both cohorts and forecasters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究阿尔茨海默病纵向预测中，标准共形预测 (conformal prediction) 的总体边际覆盖保证可能掩盖高风险亚组内的严重欠覆盖问题。作者提出一个机制驱动的审计与修复框架，在 ADNI 和 OASIS-3 两个队列、两个基础预测器和九个属性上进行验证，发现 68 个审计组合中有 57 个存在高风险亚组欠覆盖。作者将失败归因于稀有性 (rarity) 与重尾性 (tail-heaviness) 两种机制，并分别提出对应的共形修正方法以恢复目标覆盖率。
Motivation: 标准总体水平的共形预测只保证边际覆盖率，可能对临床重要亚组（如高遗传风险、高疾病严重度患者）系统性欠覆盖，而这类亚组恰恰是临床决策中需要可靠预测区间的群体。
Method: 提出一个通用机制驱动的审计与修复框架：审计部分用组条件覆盖率识别欠覆盖；机制分析区分稀有性（组条件校准样本 n 导致覆盖率上界 k/(n+1)）与重尾性（总体宽度的区间对重尾亚组过窄且数据无法弥补）；修复部分分别采用交叉共形池化 (cross-conformal pooling)、逐亚组校准 (per-subgroup calibration)，以及两种机制同时出现时的覆盖安全边际下限 (coverage-safe marginal floor)。
Result: 在 ADNI 与 OASIS-3 两个队列、两个基础预测器和九个属性上，总体边际覆盖率达标的同时，68 个审计组合中有 57 个高风险亚组欠覆盖；高遗传风险和高疾病严重度患者的平均覆盖缺口为 6.1 个百分点（95% CI [3.3, 8.9]），而人口统计学亚组平均缺口为 0.0 个百分点（CI [-1.9, 1.7]）。所提修正组合几乎恢复了两个队列和所有预测器中每个高风险亚组的目标覆盖率。
Conclusion: 作者强调仅依赖总体边际覆盖的共形预测可能掩盖临床重要亚组的系统性风险，并表明通过将审计与面向具体机制的共形修正相结合，可以在保持总体保证的同时修复亚组欠覆盖。

summary_sections.motivation: 标准总体水平的共形预测只保证边际覆盖率，可能对临床重要亚组（如高遗传风险、高疾病严重度患者）系统性欠覆盖，而这类亚组恰恰是临床决策中需要可靠预测区间的群体。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个通用机制驱动的审计与修复框架：审计部分用组条件覆盖率识别欠覆盖；机制分析区分稀有性（组条件校准样本 n 导致覆盖率上界 k/(n+1)）与重尾性（总体宽度的区间对重尾亚组过窄且数据无法弥补）；修复部分分别采用交叉共形池化 (cross-conformal pooling)、逐亚组校准 (per-subgroup calibration)，以及两种机制同时出现时的覆盖安全边际下限 (coverage-safe marginal floor)。
summary_sections.result: 在 ADNI 与 OASIS-3 两个队列、两个基础预测器和九个属性上，总体边际覆盖率达标的同时，68 个审计组合中有 57 个高风险亚组欠覆盖；高遗传风险和高疾病严重度患者的平均覆盖缺口为 6.1 个百分点（95% CI [3.3, 8.9]），而人口统计学亚组平均缺口为 0.0 个百分点（CI [-1.9, 1.7]）。所提修正组合几乎恢复了两个队列和所有预测器中每个高风险亚组的目标覆盖率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调仅依赖总体边际覆盖的共形预测可能掩盖临床重要亚组的系统性风险，并表明通过将审计与面向具体机制的共形修正相结合，可以在保持总体保证的同时修复亚组欠覆盖。

papers.title: Dynamical Lie Algebras Cannot Describe Shallow QAOA: Cragged Terrains, Barren Plateaus, and Empirical Hardness Models
papers.abstract_en: The dynamical Lie algebraic (DLA) theory of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) predicts commonplace exponentially vanishing loss and gradient variances for sufficiently deep parametrized circuits. In this work, we show that these predictions fail dramatically in the shallow-circuit (and particularly constant-depth) regime for the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) applied to the maximum independent set (MIS) problem. In a large-scale numerical study across $\sim$23,000 problem instances, we find that barren plateaus are rare, while landscapes whose variances polynomially increase with system size---which we term "cragged terrains"---are common across graph families. This aggregate polynomial growth persists both for generic, low-symmetry random graphs and for highly symmetric vertex-transitive graphs, indicating that DLA-based variance predictions do not describe landscape scaling in this regime. As a stopgap alternative to the theory, we train empirical hardness models to predict instance-wise hardness metrics for QAOA-MIS. While these models generalize poorly, they nonetheless recover the correct landscape scaling class (barren plateau vs. cragged terrain) with high fidelity. Taken together, our results identify shallow QAOA for MIS as a prototypical setting in which asymptotic, unitary-design-centric predictions may be fundamentally insufficient to describe shallow variational quantum algorithms more broadly, emphasizing the need for more empirically-informed models of VQA loss landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过约 23,000 个问题实例的大规模数值实验，研究浅层（尤其常数深度）QAOA 求解最大独立集 (MIS) 时的损失景观。结果显示，DLA (dynamical Lie algebra) 理论预言的贫瘠高原 (barren plateaus) 在此区间罕见，相反，方差随系统大小多项式增长的“cragged terrains”普遍存在。作者训练经验硬度模型预测实例级硬度，模型泛化性差但能高保真地恢复景观缩放类别；该结果提示渐进式、unitary-design 类预测可能不足以描述浅层变分量子算法。
Motivation: DLA 理论预测足够深的变分量子电路会出现指数级消失的损失与梯度方差，但该预测在浅层 QAOA 区间是否成立缺乏检验。作者以 QAOA-MIS 为原型，考察浅层常数深度下的景观缩放。
Method: 采用大规模数值研究，覆盖约 23,000 个图实例，包含低对称随机图与高度对称的顶点传递图；并训练经验硬度模型来预测实例级硬度指标。
Result: 数值结果表明贫瘠高原罕见，而方差随系统尺寸多项式增长的 cragged terrains 在各类图族中普遍存在；该多项式增长在两种图族中均成立。经验硬度模型虽泛化差，但能以高保真度恢复正确的景观缩放类别（贫瘠高原 vs cragged terrain）。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DLA 的方差预测无法描述浅层 QAOA 的景观缩放，浅层 QAOA-MIS 是渐进式 unitary-design 预测失效的代表性场景，并强调需要更多基于经验的 VQA 损失景观模型。

papers.title: SAFECAST: Robust Failure Detection for VLA Policies with Contrast-Set Training and Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action policies often fail under deployment-time distribution shifts such as clutter, distractor objects, lighting changes, novel objects, altered initial states, and reworded instructions. Hidden-state-based risk probes combined with functional conformal prediction can detect rollout failures, but their reliability depends on calibration data matching deployment conditions. We introduce SAFECAST, which leverages contrast set perturbations to improve hidden-state probe training and calibration for deployment time shift. SAFECAST statistically significantly improves failure detection ROC-AUC scores over a state of the art baseline in both real-world DROID and LIBERO simulation experiments across multiple VLM backbones. We further find that SAFECAST benefits most when both visual and language contrast set perturbations are used to augment data, and that with contrast set perturbations, sim-to-real calibration leads to better probes than using real rollout data only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFECAST，一种面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略的失败检测方法，利用对比集扰动 (contrast set perturbations) 改进隐状态风险探针 (hidden-state risk probe) 的训练与校准，以应对部署时的分布偏移。在真实 DROID 与 LIBERO 模拟实验中，SAFECAST 在多个 VLM 骨干上显著提升失败检测的 ROC-AUC。
Motivation: VLA 策略在部署时易受杂乱、干扰物、光照变化、新物体、初始状态改变及指令改写等分布偏移影响；现有基于隐状态的风险探针结合函数化共形预测 (functional conformal prediction) 的可靠性依赖校准数据与部署条件的一致性。
Method: SAFECAST 通过引入视觉与语言层面的对比集扰动来增强隐状态探针的训练数据和校准过程，使探针在部署时分布偏移下仍能有效检测 rollout 失败。
Result: 在真实 DROID 和 LIBERO 模拟实验中，相比现有最先进基线，SAFECAST 在多个 VLM 骨干上统计显著地提升失败检测 ROC-AUC；同时发现同时使用视觉和语言对比集扰动时收益最大，且使用对比集扰动时 sim-to-real 校准优于仅使用真实 rollout 数据。
Conclusion: 作者强调对比集扰动能同时改进探针训练与校准，且视觉和语言两种扰动都重要；该工作聚焦于 VLA 策略失败检测，未涉及其他任务。

papers.title: SIGNPOST-Bench: Benchmarking Text-Vision Conflict Resolution in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) make grounded predictions in real-world scenes by combining visual and textual cues, yet existing benchmarks rarely reveal how they arbitrate between these evidence sources when they conflict. We introduce SIGNPOST-Bench, a controlled counterfactual benchmark for evaluating text-vision conflict resolution. Each source image is transformed into a counterfactual quintuplet of Original, Blank, Similar, Random, and Adversarial variants. Synthetic, localized scene-text interventions are designed to preserve non-textual content, enabling paired measurements of changes in localization performance and directed shifts toward geographic targets introduced by conflicting text. SIGNPOST-Bench contains 5,111 counterfactual groups and 25,555 image variants from four datasets. We evaluate 20 MLLMs from seven providers. Compared with Original images, Adversarial variants raise median localization error from 282 km to 1,347 km, a 4.8-fold increase. Among geocodable adversarial samples, 6.5-20.1% of predictions lie less than 50 km from the injected target across models, and every evaluated model exhibits a positive mean paired reduction in target distance from Blank to Adversarial. Compatible, unrelated, and conflicting text replacements produce distinct effects on model predictions, while clean-input localization performance does not fully predict robustness to conflicting text. These results establish visual geolocation as a continuous diagnostic of scene-text arbitration and provide a controlled framework for evaluating how MLLMs resolve conflicting multimodal evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIGNPOST-Bench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在文本与视觉证据冲突时如何裁决的受控反事实基准。每个源图像被转换为 Original、Blank、Similar、Random、Adversarial 五种变体，共包含 5,111 个反事实组和 25,555 张图像，并评估了来自七家提供方的 20 个 MLLM。结果表明，对抗性文本变体将中位地理定位误差从 282 km 提升到 1,347 km（约 4.8 倍），且不同模型均表现出对注入目标的系统性偏向。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 基准很少揭示模型在视觉与文本线索冲突时如何权衡两种证据来源，缺乏对文本-视觉冲突仲裁 (text-vision conflict resolution) 的受控评估工具。
Method: 通过合成、局部的场景文本干预构造反事实五元组，在保留非文本视觉内容的同时注入与地理目标相关或冲突的文本，从而成对测量定位性能变化以及预测向目标方向的偏移。
Result: 摘要报告，Adversarial 变体将中位定位误差从 282 km 提高到 1,347 km（4.8 倍）；在可地理编码的对抗样本中，各模型有 6.5%-20.1% 的预测落在注入目标 50 km 以内；所有模型在 Blank 到 Adversarial 之间均表现出目标距离的平均成对下降；兼容、无关与冲突文本替换产生不同影响，且干净输入下的定位性能不能完全预测对冲突文本的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉地理定位可作为场景文本仲裁的连续诊断指标，并为评估 MLLM 如何解决冲突的多模态证据提供了一个受控框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Attention-based representations for multi-task computation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head attention layers produce vector representations that support multiple downstream tasks. We establish bounds on the number of heads required in two simple and concrete multi-task scenarios. In the first scenario, a vector representation is sought so that linear predictors can compute both the smallest and largest numbers in a given list. In this case, it is known two attention heads with small embedding dimension and bit precision level suffice. We prove that a single attention head requires exponentially higher embedding dimension or precision level. In the second scenario, a vector representation is sought so that a polynomial threshold function can compute the XOR of a given string of $n$ bits. This scenario is analogous to the first one for $n=2$, since XOR is readily computed by a linear function using a vector representation that encodes both the AND and the OR of the two bits. We observe that $n$-bit XOR requires the product of the number of heads and the polynomial degree to be at least $n$, and we construct multi-head attention layers that match this lower bound. These results generalize to arbitrary (symmetric) Boolean functions, where the bound is given in terms of the threshold degree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多头注意力层为多任务计算构造向量表示所需的最少注意力头数。作者在两种具体场景中给出紧的界限：最小/最大值线性预测需要两个头、单头需要指数级更大的嵌入维数或精度；n 位 XOR 要求头数与多项式度数之积至少为 n，并构造达到下界的多头注意力层。结果还推广到任意对称布尔函数，界限由阈值度数 (threshold degree) 给出。
Motivation: 多头注意力产生的表示要同时支持多个下游任务，但关于表示能力所需的注意力头数缺乏精确刻画。本文用简单具体的多任务场景来量化单头与多头表示之间的复杂度差距。
Method: 建立两个场景的上下界：场景一考察线性预测器同时计算列表最小值和最大值所需的头数；场景二考察多项式阈值函数计算 n 位 XOR 所需的头数与多项式度数。构造与下界匹配的多头注意力层，并将界限推广到对称布尔函数。
Result: 摘要报告：两个头配合小嵌入维数和位精度即可计算最小值和最大值，而单头需要指数级更高的嵌入维数或精度；n 位 XOR 需要头数乘以多项式度数至少为 n，且存在达到该下界的构造。对于任意对称布尔函数，界限以阈值度数表示。
Conclusion: 这些结果刻画了多头注意力在表示紧凑性与计算复杂度之间的权衡：增加头数可以指数级降低嵌入维数或精度要求，头数与多项式度数之间存在乘法下界。结论局限于理论构造场景。

papers.title: Hallucinations on the Board: Tool-Augmented Evaluation of LLM Chess Commentary
papers.abstract_en: Superhuman game engines in domains like chess have made expert-level evaluations easily accessible, yet they communicate what is true without the natural-language explanations that make such expertise educationally useful to experts and non-experts alike. Large language models could, in principle, bridge this gap, but they frequently hallucinate due to limited domain-specific knowledge, and standard reference-based or LLM-as-a-judge frameworks cannot reliably detect these errors. In this work, we present ACT-Eval, an evaluation framework that decomposes chess commentary into atomic claims and routes them to engine-supported tools and expert-annotated gold references to assess factual correctness, conceptual coverage, and move-quality judgment. We release a benchmark of 325 position--move pairs spanning pedagogical, tournament, and critical positions, including 125 positions with expert-verified gold atoms and a five-class error taxonomy. Evaluating leading proprietary and open-weight models, we find that factual hallucinations remain pervasive in chess commentary: GPT-5.4 without tools produces incorrect sub-claims 22.0% of the time, while smaller open-weight models exceed 40%. Although tool augmentation substantially improves factual correctness and move-quality assessment, coverage of expert strategic and tactical ideas remains limited across all models. Human calibration shows that ACT-Eval's factual judgments fall within the observed range of inter-human agreement, while its coverage scores correlate strongly with human assessments of strategic completeness.

TL;DR: 本文提出 ACT-Eval，一个用于评估大语言模型国际象棋解说（chess commentary）事实正确性的框架，将解说分解为原子声明（atomic claims），并路由到引擎支持的工具与专家标注的 gold references 进行核查。作者发布包含 325 个 position-move 对的基准，其中 125 个位置带专家验证的 gold atoms，并给出五类错误分类法。评测显示，无工具时 GPT-5.4 的错误子声明比例为 22.0%，较小的开源模型超过 40%；工具增强能显著改善事实正确性和走法质量判断，但专家级战略与战术思想的覆盖仍然有限。
Motivation: 国际象棋引擎能给出专家级判断，但缺乏自然语言解释；LLM 可以生成解说，却因领域知识不足而频繁幻觉，而标准基于参考（reference-based）或 LLM-as-a-judge 的评估框架无法可靠检测这些错误。
Method: 提出 ACT-Eval 评估框架：将棋评解说分解为原子声明，路由到引擎支持的工具（engine-supported tools）和专家标注的 gold references，从事实正确性（factual correctness）、概念覆盖（conceptual coverage）和走法质量判断（move-quality judgment）三个维度评估，并配套发布包含五类错误分类法的基准。
Result: 摘要报告无工具时 GPT-5.4 的 incorrect sub-claims 比例为 22.0%，较小的开源权重模型超过 40%；工具增强大幅改善事实正确性与走法质量评估。人工校准显示，ACT-Eval 的事实判断落在人类间一致性观察范围内，覆盖分数与人类对战略完整性的评估强相关。
Conclusion: 事实幻觉在国际象棋解说中仍然普遍，工具增强虽然能显著提升事实正确性和走法质量判断，但所有模型对专家战略战术思想的覆盖仍有限；ACT-Eval 的判断与人类评估一致，可用于可靠检测此类错误。

papers.title: Physics-informed reduced-order modelling with equivariant spectral submanifolds
papers.abstract_en: Spectral submanifold (SSM) reduction has emerged as a mathematically principled route to reliable nonlinear reduced-order models, capturing dynamics beyond the reach of linear techniques such as Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD). The computation of SSMs, however, remains computationally expensive, particularly for high-dimensional systems. In this work, we introduce equivariant spectral submanifold (eSSM) reduction, a novel extension of the SSM framework that explicitly incorporates symmetries of the full-order model into the reduction process. We establish the mathematical foundations of this approach by showing that SSMs are naturally equivariant submanifolds and that the associated charts and reduced dynamics inherit the appropriate induced group actions. Building on this framework, we develop a novel equivariant SSM reduction algorithm that exploits these symmetries to achieve substantially faster computations while also improving model robustness. We demonstrate the advantages of this approach on several benchmark problems including a test from the Common Task Framework for Science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出等变谱子流形（equivariant spectral submanifold, eSSM）降阶方法，将全阶模型的对称性显式纳入谱子流形（SSM）降阶框架，并证明 SSM 是自然的等变子流形，相关坐标卡与降阶动力学继承诱导群作用。基于该数学基础，作者开发了利用对称性的等变 SSM 降阶算法，在多个基准问题（包括 Common Task Framework for Science 的测试）上报告了更快的计算和更好的模型鲁棒性。
Motivation: SSM 降阶虽能可靠地构建非线性降阶模型、捕捉 DMD 等线性方法之外的动力学，但对高维系统而言计算代价仍然很高。本文针对这一计算瓶颈，尝试通过显式利用全阶模型的对称性来加速降阶过程。
Method: 建立了 eSSM 的数学基础，证明 SSM 是等变子流形，且相关坐标卡与降阶动力学继承适当的诱导群作用；并基于该框架提出一种等变 SSM 降阶算法，利用对称性实现更快的计算和更强的鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准问题（包括 Common Task Framework for Science 中的测试）上，该方法相比现有途径实现了显著更快的计算，并提升了模型鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调将对称性显式纳入 SSM 框架可以实质性加速计算并改善鲁棒性；摘要未涉及该方法在降水、天气等具体应用场景中的表现或局限。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Multimodal Alignment Through Joint Kernel Entropic Gromov--Wasserstein Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of aligning data from multiple modalities into a shared representation space, focusing on settings where strong pretrained unimodal encoders are available but cross-modal paired data are scarce. We propose a structure-preserving alignment framework, joint kernel entropic Gromov--Wasserstein Optimal Transport (JK-EGW), which maps multiple modalities into a common latent space by minimizing a quadratic optimal transport objective. JK-EGW leverages fine-grained similarity relationships within and across modalities to construct a global affinity kernel instead of relying on raw feature-space distances. Our framework naturally provides explicit control over the geometry and distribution of the latent embedding. On the theory side, we establish parametric sample complexity rate of $n^{-1/2}$, matching the corresponding rates for standard, entropic and Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. On the algorithmic side, we derive a scalable alternating procedure to solve JK-EGW with entropic optimal transport (EOT) updates through a low-rank kernel approximation and a variational lifting. This lifting scheme effectively relieves the burden of a quadratic objective, and allowing us to take the advantage of existing EOT solvers. Empirically, we focus on post-hoc alignment of embeddings from pretrained encoders in data-scarce regimes, and show that our proposed method achieves improved multimodal retrieval performance compared to existing alignment baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联合核熵化 Gromov--Wasserstein 最优传输 (JK-EGW) 框架，用于在跨模态配对数据稀缺时，将多个模态的预训练嵌入对齐到公共潜空间。该方法通过构造全局亲和核 (affinity kernel) 捕获模态内外的细粒度相似关系，而非依赖原始特征距离，并提供对潜空间几何与分布的显式控制。理论上建立 n^{-1/2} 的参数样本复杂度率，算法上利用低秩核近似与变分提升设计可扩展的交替求解过程。实验表明在数据稀缺场景下，多模态检索性能优于现有对齐基线。
Motivation: 问题在于已有强预训练单模态编码器但跨模态配对数据稀缺，需要将多模态数据对齐到共享表示空间。现有方法依赖原始特征距离或配对数据，缺乏结构保持与样本效率保证，因此需要一种利用模态内外相似性关系且可扩展的对齐框架。
Method: 提出 JK-EGW，通过最小化二次最优传输目标将多模态映射到公共潜空间，用模态内外的细粒度相似关系构造全局亲和核。算法上采用低秩核近似与变分提升将二次目标转化为可利用熵正则最优传输 (EOT) 求解器的交替过程。
Result: 理论部分建立参数样本复杂度率 n^{-1/2}，与标准、熵正则及 Gromov--Wasserstein 最优传输的相应速率一致。实验在预训练编码器的后验对齐 (post-hoc alignment) 数据稀缺场景下，显示多模态检索性能优于现有对齐基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 JK-EGW 提供对潜嵌入几何与分布的显式控制，并在数据稀缺的后验对齐设置中有效提升多模态检索。更广泛的适用性或局限未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Interoceptive Attention as Dynamic Homeostatic Prioritization in a Foraging Agent
papers.abstract_en: Biological systems must regulate competing needs under limited perceptual bandwidth, where sharpening one estimate costs the capacity to sharpen the others. Any fixed-budget system therefore has to decide where to allocate its perceptual precision. We study this in a foraging agent that must keep several bodily needs satisfied to survive, modelled with active inference. At each step it reads its own body-state beliefs, identifies the most-needed channel, and reallocates a fixed budget of interoceptive precision toward it, so that the same precision-shaped likelihood feeds both belief update and planning. In AffectWorld, a four-channel foraging gridworld, this selective allocation more than doubles learning-phase survival at matched budget against a uniform-precision agent ($0.414$ vs $0.199$ across 11 layouts, $n{=}32$ seeds each, paired cluster-bootstrap $p \leq 10^{-4}$). Two further results sharpen the mechanism. The benefit runs through planning as well as perception, since denying the shaped likelihood to the planner alone removes about half of it. It is also need-aligned, since aiming precision at the least-needed channel does worse than spreading it evenly. The attended channel additionally learns its own dynamics about twice as fast, and stays ahead even at matched observation count, a behavioural trace of the same precision routing, visible in learning speed, not survival.
papers.comment: Accepted at SAB 2026 (From Animals to Animats 18), forthcoming in the Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence proceedings. 20 pages, 11 numbered figures (12 graphics), 5 tables. The 12-page camera-ready paper is reproduced without alteration and followed by supplementary analyses that were not part of the proceedings paper. Code: https://github.com/sgrimbly/attention-aif-sab2026-snapshot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生物系统在有限感知带宽下如何动态分配内感受精度（interoceptive precision），以协调多个相互竞争的生理需求。作者在主动推理（active inference）框架下构建一个觅食智能体，每一步读取自身身体状态信念，识别最需要的通道，并将固定预算的精度重新分配给它，使同一精度形状的似然同时用于信念更新与规划。在 AffectWorld 四通道觅食网格世界中，该选择性分配在匹配预算下将学习阶段生存率从 0.199 提升到 0.414，且收益同时来自感知与规划层面。
Motivation: 生物系统必须在有限感知带宽下调节相互竞争的需求，锐化某个估计会牺牲其他估计的精度，因此系统需要决定如何分配感知精度。现有模型缺乏对这种动态稳态优先级排序机制的研究。
Method: 提出一种内感受注意机制：智能体在每一步读取自身身体状态的信念，识别最需要的通道，并将固定预算的内感受精度重新分配给它，使得同一精度形状的似然同时驱动信念更新（perception）和规划（planning）。在 AffectWorld 四通道觅食网格世界中，与均匀精度 agent 进行对照实验。
Result: 在 AffectWorld 中，选择性分配在匹配预算下使学习阶段生存率超过均匀精度 agent 的两倍（0.414 vs 0.199，11 种布局，各 32 个种子，配对 cluster-bootstrap p ≤ 1e-4）。若仅剥夺规划器使用该精度形状似然，约一半收益消失；将精度对准最不需要的通道则比均匀分配更差。被注意通道学习自身动态的速度约快两倍，且在匹配观测数量下仍保持领先。
Conclusion: 摘要表明内感受注意可被理解为动态稳态优先级排序（dynamic homeostatic prioritization），其收益通过感知和规划两条路径产生，并在学习速度而非生存率上留下行为痕迹。该结论基于模拟的主动推理觅食环境，属于行为建模层面的机制研究。

papers.title: Transferable Dual-Stream Representations for Mesoscale-Preserving Sea Surface Temperature Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for scientific spatio-temporal downscaling often minimize reconstruction error while failing to preserve physically meaningful multi-scale structure. For sea surface temperature prediction, this can yield outputs that are numerically plausible yet overly smooth, missing mesoscale variability critical to regional ocean dynamics. Existing methods often focus on pixel-wise objectives or single-context conditioning, which limits their ability to preserve spectral fidelity and generalize across regions. To address this, we propose EddyFlow, a representation learning framework for kilometer-scale sea surface temperature downscaling that balances predictive accuracy, scale-dependent structure, and regional generalization. EddyFlow is trained on the Gulf of St.~Lawrence and evaluated in zero-shot and few-shot settings on the Bay of Fundy and the Gulf of Mexico. EddyFlow demonstrates that physics-informed representation learning reduces zero-shot RMSE by 21%, achieves up to 85.6% skill relative to persistence on unseen domains, and maintains near-ideal spectral fidelity with a PSD ratio of $\approx 1.00$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EddyFlow，一个用于公里尺度海表温度降尺度的表示学习框架，目标是同时兼顾预测精度、尺度依赖结构与跨区域泛化。模型在圣劳伦斯湾训练，并在芬迪湾与墨西哥湾上进行零样本和少样本评估；摘要报告零样本 RMSE 降低 21%，在未见区域上达到相对持续性预报 85.6% 的技能，且 PSD 比值接近 1.00，即保持近理想的谱保真度。
Motivation: 现有科学时空降尺度深度学习模型常只最小化重建误差，未能保留物理上有意义的多尺度结构，导致海表温度预测数值上合理但过度平滑，缺失对区域海洋动力学重要的中尺度变率。逐像素损失或单一上下文条件也限制了谱保真度和跨区域泛化能力。
Method: 提出 EddyFlow 双流表示学习框架，利用物理信息表示学习（physics-informed representation learning）在降尺度过程中平衡预测精度、尺度依赖结构和区域性可迁移性，并支持零样本与少样本迁移评估。
Result: 在圣劳伦斯湾训练、对芬迪湾与墨西哥湾零样本评估时，EddyFlow 将 RMSE 降低 21%，在未见区域上取得最高 85.6% 的相对持续性预报技能，并将 PSD 比值维持在约 1.00，接近理想谱保真。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是物理信息表示学习能够同时兼顾降尺度精度、尺度结构保持与区域泛化，为公里尺度海表温度降尺度提供了一种可迁移方案；具体局限未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 46

papers.title: Random features for Grassmannian kernel approximation with bounded rank-one projections
papers.abstract_en: We propose a family of random feature maps for scalable kernel machines on low-dimensional subspaces, ie on the Grassmannian manifold. Such representations are useful when data classes or clusters are well described by the span of a few samples. Classical Grassmannian kernels, including the projection and Binet-Cauchy kernels, require full Gram matrices, which leads to prohibitive computational and memory costs for large high-dimensional subspace datasets. We address this limitation using random features based on rank-one projections of subspace projection matrices followed by bounded non-linear transforms, either periodic or binary, to control the resulting distributions. We show that inner products in the random feature space approximate well-defined rotation-invariant Grassmannian kernels that depend only on the principal angles between subspaces. When the number of features is sufficiently large relative to the intrinsic subspace dimension, the approximation holds uniformly over all fixed-dimensional subspaces with high probability. For periodic transforms, the approximated kernel has a closed-form expression with tunable behaviour between inverse Binet-Cauchy and Gaussian-type regimes. Binary transforms yield compact one-bit subspace features, although no closed-form kernel is known. Structured rank-one projections based on randomised fast Fourier transforms further reduce computation without sacrificing practical accuracy. Experiments on synthetic data and ETH-80 classification tasks show that these features accurately preserve Grassmannian geometry while reducing computation, memory, and storage. Rank-one embeddings therefore provide a practical and scalable alternative to classical Grassmannian kernels.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, July 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一族基于秩一投影 (rank-one projections) 的随机特征映射，用于在 Grassmannian 流形上逼近旋转不变的核函数，从而为低维子空间数据提供可扩展的核方法。作者证明当特征数相对于子空间本征维数足够大时，近似以高概率在固定维子空间上一致成立；周期型非线性变换对应有闭式表达的核，行为介于逆 Binet-Cauchy 与高斯型之间，二值变换则给出紧凑的一位子空间特征。实验在合成数据与 ETH-80 分类任务上显示，该方法在保持 Grassmannian 几何的同时降低计算、内存与存储开销。
Motivation: 经典 Grassmannian 核（包括 projection 核与 Binet-Cauchy 核）需要完整 Gram 矩阵，面对大规模高维子空间数据集时计算和内存成本过高。本文针对这一可扩展性限制提出随机特征近似。
Method: 提出随机特征映射族：对子空间投影矩阵施加秩一投影，再经过有界非线性变换（周期型或二值型）来控制输出分布；并引入基于随机化快速傅里叶变换的结构化秩一投影以进一步降低计算量。
Result: 摘要报告理论结果表明随机特征空间中的内积可近似良好定义的旋转不变 Grassmannian 核，该核仅取决于子空间间的主角度；当特征数足够大时近似对固定维子空间一致成立。周期变换对应的核有闭式表达，行为可在逆 Binet-Cauchy 与高斯型之间调节；合成数据和 ETH-80 分类实验表明该方法准确保持 Grassmannian 几何并减少计算、内存和存储。
Conclusion: 作者认为秩一嵌入是经典 Grassmannian 核的实用且可扩展的替代方案；二值变换可产生紧凑的一位子空间特征，但尚无已知闭式核。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: OmniVR: Joint Video-Audio Conditional Generation for Restoring Degraded Historical Films
papers.abstract_en: Historical films suffer from co-occurring visual and audio degradations---blur, noise, flicker, hiss, clipping, and dropout---yet existing methods restore each modality independently, leaving quality gaps and cross-modal inconsistency. We present OmniVR, the first joint audio-video generative restoration model. Built upon a 22B-parameter audio-video generation backbone, OmniVR formulates restoration as conditional generation within a unified multimodal DiT: the low-quality video and audio are encoded as latent conditions, combined with a fixed restoration prompt, and jointly denoised to recover visual structure, temporal motion, and acoustic detail under one coordinated objective. Three key designs enable this adaptation: (1) a joint audio-video degradation pipeline that simulates real old-film characteristics from Internet-collected data; (2) an architecture-preserving text-to-audio-video (T2AV) to audio-video-to-audio-video (AV2AV) transition with prompt annealing that maximally retains the generative prior; and (3) first-frame image-to-video (I2V) anchoring with loss reweighting and waveform supervision for long-video extrapolation and audio fidelity. We also propose OmniVRBench, the first benchmark that evaluates audio-video restoration across visual quality, audio quality, temporal consistency, and audio-visual synchrony on 200 real historical clips. OmniVR surpasses all prior methods on all six visual metrics, achieves the best audio quality, and produces natural colorization---the first method to jointly address all three aspects. Code and weights will be publicly released. Project Page: https://xin1u.github.io/OminiVR_PAGE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniVR，据称是首个联合音视频生成式修复模型，用于恢复历史影片中同时出现的视觉与音频退化（模糊、噪声、闪烁、嘶声、削波、丢帧）。模型基于 22B 参数的音视频生成主干，将修复视为统一多模态 DiT 下的条件生成，并配套提出基于 200 个真实历史片段的首个音视频修复基准 OmniVRBench。摘要报告 OmniVR 在所有六项视觉指标上超过既有方法，同时取得最佳音频质量并实现自然着色。
Motivation: 历史影片的视觉与音频退化往往同时发生，但现有方法分别独立修复两种模态，导致质量缺口和跨模态不一致。
Method: 将低质量视频和音频编码为潜在条件，结合固定修复提示在统一多模态 DiT 中联合去噪；关键设计包括联合音视频退化管线、保留生成先验的 T2AV 到 AV2AV 迁移与提示退火 (prompt annealing)，以及用于长视频外推和音频保真的首帧 I2V 锚定 (I2V anchoring) 与损失重加权、波形监督。
Result: 在 OmniVRBench 的 200 个真实历史片段上，OmniVR 超过所有既有方法的六项视觉指标，取得最佳音频质量，并首次同时实现视觉质量、音频质量和自然着色三类改进。
Conclusion: 作者强调联合条件生成可以同时处理视觉与音频退化，并发布代码、权重和基准以推动后续研究；摘要未说明具体局限性。

papers.title: TIDE: A Physically Diverse 3D Turbulence Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Scientific Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Turbulence is a central testbed for machine learning on physical dynamics because its governing laws are known exactly. However, most existing studies remain in 2D, while 3D turbulence has fundamentally different physics and is far more costly to simulate. Existing 3D resources also typically provide only one realization per configuration, making it difficult to distinguish learning the dynamics from fitting the statistics of a single flow. In this paper, we introduce TIDE (Turbulent Incompressible DNS Ensembles), a 256^3 DNS corpus and benchmark for 3D incompressible turbulence, with 15 configurations on eight controlled axes, independent ensembles, pressure fields, and equation-level verification. The benchmark includes five tasks, standardized learned baselines, controlled generalization splits, and physical-fidelity metrics alongside pointwise error. Across the main forecasting configurations, current learned models barely outperform persistence and still make about twice the error of a spectral solver given the true equations. Moreover, lower pointwise error can coincide with severely distorted small-scale dynamics, showing that accuracy alone does not ensure physical fidelity. Generalization results further show that most regime shifts reflect limited training coverage, whereas forced-to-decay transfer exposes a missing conditioning variable: operators trained under forcing continue to predict driven evolution when the external drive is removed. Closing these accuracy, fidelity, and conditioning gaps is the central open problem made measurable by TIDE.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 28 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ydai17/TIDE ; Code: https://github.com/Dyloong1/TIDE-dataset-benchmark ; DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21589489
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIDE（Turbulent Incompressible DNS Ensembles），一个 256^3 分辨率的 3D 不可压缩湍流 DNS 语料库与基准，包含 15 种配置、独立系综、压力场和方程级验证。基准提供五个任务、标准化学习基线、受控泛化划分以及同时包含逐点误差和物理保真度的指标。摘要报告，在主要预测配置下当前学习模型仅勉强超过持续性预测，误差约为给定真实方程的谱求解器的两倍，且逐点误差更低并不保证小尺度动力学保真。
Motivation: 湍流是机器学习物理动力学的核心测试平台，但现有研究大多停留在 2D，而 3D 湍流物理本质不同且模拟成本高得多；现有 3D 资源通常每个配置只提供一个实现，难以区分模型是在学习动力学还是拟合单个流动的统计特性。
Method: 构建 TIDE 数据集与基准：包含 15 种配置、八个受控轴、独立系综与压力场，并提供五个任务、标准化学习基线、受控泛化划分，以及结合逐点误差与物理保真度的评估指标。
Result: 在主要预测配置中，当前学习模型仅略优于持续性预测，误差约为使用真实方程的谱求解器的两倍；降低逐点误差可能伴随小尺度动力学的严重失真。泛化实验还显示，多数状态转移反映训练覆盖不足，而受迫到衰减的迁移暴露了缺失的条件变量：在强迫下训练的算子在外力移除后仍预测驱动演化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，缩小准确性、保真度和条件化方面的差距是 TIDE 使之可测量的核心开放问题。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: A Unified Model for Cross-Domain Clone Detection via Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: The growing diversity of code clone types, from syntactic copies to cross-language semantic clones to AI-generated duplicates, has created a fragmentation crisis in clone detection. Current deep learning detectors are domain specialists that degrade significantly outside their training distribution, with F1 drops exceeding 70% across domains. Deploying multiple specialized models is impractical, yet training a single cross-domain detector requires simultaneous access to all training data. To address this, we investigate model merging, a family of post-hoc techniques that operate solely on trained checkpoints. We evaluate parameter merging with five task-vector methods, architecture merging via greedy layer stitching, and cross-tokenizer alignment across four code models, three benchmarks, and twelve configurations. Same-base TIES merging creates effective cross-domain detectors, validated across two model families and three random seeds, reaching 0.865 combined F1 on UniXcoder, 93% of multi-task performance without any training data at the merging step. WUDI achieves the highest in-distribution combined F1 at 0.899, but TIES generalizes better to unseen AI-generated clones, making it our recommended method. Cross-base merging yields only marginal and high-variance gains across all five methods, indicating that task vector compatibility through a shared pre-trained base is the binding factor for effective merging. Merged detectors also outperform zero-shot code LLMs on GPTCloneBench at lower inference cost and generalize up to 4x better than multi-task training to unseen AI-generated clones, suggesting a trade-off between in-domain performance and OOD robustness. This work provides one of the first systematic empirical studies of model merging for software engineering and a practical recipe for building cross-domain clone detectors.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12--16, 2026, Munich, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对克隆检测中的领域碎片化问题，系统研究模型合并 (model merging) 能否仅凭已训练检查点构建跨领域克隆检测器。作者在四个代码模型、三个基准和十二种配置上评估了五种任务向量 (task-vector) 参数合并、贪心层拼接的架构合并以及跨 tokenizer 对齐；发现同基座 TIES 合并能在 UniXcoder 上达到 0.865 的综合 F1，相当于多任务训练性能的 93%，且无需在合并阶段使用训练数据。跨基座合并仅带来微小且高方差的收益，说明共享预训练基座的任务向量兼容性是有效合并的关键。
Motivation: 代码克隆类型日益多样（从语法拷贝到跨语言语义克隆再到 AI 生成重复），导致当前深度学习检测器成为领域专家，超出训练分布时 F1 降幅可超过 70%；同时部署多个专用模型不现实，而训练单一跨领域检测器又需要同时访问全部训练数据。
Method: 采用模型合并这一仅作用于已训练检查点的后处理技术路线，具体评估五种任务向量方法、基于贪心层拼接的架构合并，以及跨 tokenizer 对齐，覆盖同基座和跨基座两类合并场景。
Result: 同基座 TIES 合并取得 0.865 的 UniXcoder 综合 F1，达到多任务训练性能的 93%；WUDI 的分布内综合 F1 最高（0.899），但 TIES 对未见过的 AI 生成克隆泛化更好，因此被推荐。合并检测器在 GPTCloneBench 上以更低推理成本超越零样本代码 LLM，对未见 AI 生成克隆的泛化能力比多任务训练最高好 4 倍，呈现出分布内性能与分布外鲁棒性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 这是软件工程领域最早针对模型合并的系统实证研究之一；摘要强调共享预训练基座带来的任务向量兼容性才是有效合并的决定性因素，并给出构建跨领域克隆检测器的实用配方。

papers.title: Attention-Only White-Box Transformer via LeJEPA-Based Self-Supervised Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Existing studies on self-supervised learning for white-box networks typically decouple the derivation of white-box networks via optimization algorithms from self-supervised learning paradigms. In this work, we instead revisit the two components from a joint perspective. The LeJEPA-based self-supervised framework assumes an isotropic Gaussian distribution as the optimal embedding distribution for downstream tasks, which is conceptually equivalent to the expansion term $R(Z)$ in the sparse rate reduction objective guiding white-box Transformer optimization. Building on this observation, we use the LeJEPA self-supervised paradigm to optimize $R(Z)$, and derive the remaining terms $R^{c}(Z\mid U_{[K]})+λ\lVert Z\rVert_{0}$ via the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) into an attention-only Transformer that dispenses with the ISTA structure or MLP layers of the original design. Experimental results demonstrate that our attention-only white-box Transformer achieves classification accuracies of $88.88\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $63.54\%$ on CIFAR-100 at the Base scale under the LeJEPA self-supervised paradigm, while the original white-box Transformer CRATE achieves classification accuracies of $89.18\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $63.56\%$ on CIFAR-100. Our model achieves competitive performance while reducing the parameter count by roughly $31\%$. Beyond the white-box setting, we further investigate standard ViTs and find that replacing all MLP blocks with ReLU activations under knowledge distillation removes approximately 66\% of the parameters while preserving competitive accuracy, motivating further investigation into the potential redundancy of MLP modules in standard ViT architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把白盒 Transformer 的推导与自监督学习范式联合起来处理，指出 LeJEPA 假设各向同性高斯分布为最优嵌入分布，与稀疏率降低目标 (sparse rate reduction) 中的展开项 R(Z) 概念等价。作者用 LeJEPA 范式优化 R(Z)，并通过交替方向乘子法 (ADMM) 推导剩余项，得到一个无需 ISTA 结构或 MLP 层的纯注意力白盒 Transformer。在 Base 规模下，该模型在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上分别取得 88.88% 和 63.54% 的分类准确率，与原 CRATE 的 89.18% 和 63.56% 相当，同时参数量减少约 31%。
Motivation: 现有白盒网络的自监督学习研究通常把通过优化算法推导白盒网络与自监督学习范式分开处理，本文希望从联合视角重新审视这两个组成部分。
Method: 利用 LeJEPA 自监督范式优化目标中的展开项 R(Z)，并用 ADMM 推导剩余项 R^c(Z|U_[K])+λ‖Z‖_0，从而得到去掉 ISTA 结构或 MLP 层的纯注意力白盒 Transformer；此外还考察了标准 ViT 中用 ReLU 激活替换全部 MLP block 并配合知识蒸馏的做法。
Result: Base 规模下，LeJEPA 训练的纯注意力白盒 Transformer 在 CIFAR-10 上准确率 88.88%、CIFAR-100 上 63.54%，而原 CRATE 分别为 89.18% 和 63.56%；新模型以约 31% 的参数量缩减取得竞争性表现。对标准 ViT，将全部 MLP 替换为 ReLU 并结合知识蒸馏可去除约 66% 参数并保持竞争性准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调纯注意力白盒 Transformer 能在大幅减少参数的同时保持与 CRATE 相当的性能，并指出 MLP 模块在标准 ViT 架构中的潜在冗余值得进一步研究。

papers.title: PADFormer: Pose-agnostic Anomaly Detection from Sparse View Images
papers.abstract_en: Pose-agnostic Anomaly Detection (PAD) remains challenging as anomalies can appear under arbitrary viewpoints, requiring methods to handle significant pose variations. Existing approaches rely on complex 3D reconstruction, which are computationally expensive and require extensive multi-view data. We propose PADFormer, a novel image-space approach that leverages Vision Transformer (ViT) to directly reconstruct anomaly-free versions of query images while preserving pose information. Our key insight is to adapt cross-view masked reconstruction for anomaly detection through training exclusively on normal data, combined with dynamic patch selection and spatial alignment mechanisms that enable effective learning from sparse reference views under significant pose variations. During inference, we perform multiple forward passes with different masking patterns to generate an ensemble of anomaly-free reconstructions, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the query image. Anomalies are detected by comparing these reconstructions with the query image. PADFormer achieves state-of-the-art results on the PAD benchmark while maintaining comparable performance on classic few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) tasks, demonstrating superior efficiency and generalization without requiring 3D reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PADFormer，一种面向姿态无关异常检测 (pose-agnostic anomaly detection) 的纯图像空间方法。它利用 Vision Transformer (ViT) 直接在图像空间重建查询图像的无异常版本，同时保留姿态信息，避免了现有的复杂三维重建流程。方法仅用正常数据训练，结合跨视图掩码重建、动态补丁选择和空间对齐机制，并在推理时通过多种掩码模式的多次前向传播形成集成重建，再与查询图像比较来检测异常。摘要报告其在 PAD 基准上达到最新最优，在经典 few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) 任务上保持可比性能，且无需三维重建。
Motivation: 姿态无关异常检测中异常可能出现在任意视角下，现有方法依赖复杂的三维重建，计算成本高且需要大量多视角数据。
Method: 提出仅用正常数据训练的跨视图掩码重建方法，通过动态补丁选择与空间对齐机制从稀疏参考视图中学习；推理时对查询图像采用不同掩码模式多次前向传播，集成多个无异常重建结果用于异常判定。
Result: 在 PAD 基准上取得最新最优结果，并在经典 few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) 任务上保持可比性能，同时展现出更高的效率和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是一个避免三维重建的图像空间方案，能在显著姿态变化下有效工作，兼顾效率与泛化。

papers.title: From Non-Convex Self-Concordant Regularization to Scalable Quasi-Newton Training of PINNs
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often require high-accuracy quasi-Newton refinement to obtain reliable partial differential equation solutions, but their residual objectives can exhibit indefinite, nearly singular, and poorly scaled local curvature. Regularized quasi-Newton methods provide established mechanisms for stabilizing secant models, while self-concordant methods provide local-metric rules for curvature-dependent step selection. Building on these two lines of work, we propose SCORE, a self-concordance-inspired quasi-Newton method with decrement-coupled shifted secant geometry for PINN training. Its distinguishing mechanism is that a single quasi-Newton decrement computed from the learned inverse metric jointly determines a strong-Wolfe-tested candidate step and an adaptive shift used to define the next secant geometry. The shifted displacement represents the action of an averaged shifted metric along the accepted step, while requiring neither Hessian construction nor Hessian-vector products. Under a local spectral-equivalence condition, we show that the quasi-Newton decrement and candidate step remain comparable to their counterparts in a positive shifted metric, and recover the normalized self-concordant rule in the matched-metric case. Strong Wolfe acceptance, fallback line search, and standard curvature safeguards provide globalization without modifying the underlying PINN objective. Experiments on the viscous Burgers, Kuramoto--Sivashinsky, Korteweg--de Vries, and complex Ginzburg--Landau equations show that SCORE attains lower final errors than the tested BFGS and self-scaled Broyden baselines. The Burgers ablation further indicates that shifted curvature stabilization and decrement-based step selection make complementary contributions to high-accuracy refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCORE，一种受自和谐 (self-concordance) 启发的拟牛顿方法，用于 PINN 的高精度精修训练。其核心机制是用从学习到的逆度量计算出的单一拟牛顿减量 (quasi-Newton decrement) 同时决定经强 Wolfe 检验的候选步长和用于定义下一步割线几何的自适应移位 (adaptive shift)，且无需构造 Hessian 或计算 Hessian-向量乘积。在粘性 Burgers、Kuramoto–Sivashinsky、Korteweg–de Vries 和复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程上，该方法比测试的 BFGS 和自尺度 Broyden 基线取得更低的最终误差。
Motivation: PINN 的残差目标常呈现不定、近奇异且尺度不良的局部曲率，而高精度拟牛顿精修又对这类条件敏感，现有正则化拟牛顿与自和谐方法各有侧重但未很好结合，导致稳定步长选择与割线模型保真之间存在缺口。
Method: SCORE 将自和谐思想引入拟牛顿训练：由逆度量算出一个拟牛顿减量，该减量同时用于生成候选步长并计算自适应移位，以定义下一个割线几何；移位位移视为沿接受步长的平均移位度量作用，配合强 Wolfe 接受准则、回退线搜索和曲率保护实现全局化，且不修改原 PINN 目标。
Result: 在四个非线性 PDE（粘性 Burgers、Kuramoto–Sivashinsky、Korteweg–de Vries、复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程）上，SCORE 达到比 BFGS 和自尺度 Broyden 基线更低的最终误差；Burgers 消融表明移位曲率稳定与基于减量的步长选择对高精度精修有互补贡献。
Conclusion: 作者表明在局部谱等价条件下，SCORE 的拟牛顿减量和候选步长可与正移位度量下的对应量保持可比，且在匹配度量情形下恢复归一化自和谐规则；该方法无需 Hessian 构造或 Hessian-向量乘积，提供了一种面向 PINN 的可扩展高精度精修训练路线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
papers.abstract_en: Human evaluation of AI systems and digital products is costly, slow, and difficult to scale. Offline evaluations are more scalable but often abstract away human diversity and interactive behavior. We therefore introduce MatrAIx, a population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure for testing AI systems and digital products with heterogeneous users. MatrAIx has three core components: First, Persona 8B contains 8.3 billion persona records represented by 1,290 categorical dimensions. Records are either sampled from a dependency graph that preserves correlated attributes or derived from human-authored profiles. We release a quality-filtered coreset of approximately 1 million personas, comprising 599,847 human-grounded and 400,000 synthetic records. Second, the MatrAIx Playground provides four environments in which diverse users evaluate and interact with digital products: Survey, AI Chatbot, Web, and App. Third, MatrAIx provides 1,010 application tasks spanning more than 25 domains, including Commerce, Software, Finance, and Healthcare. We conducted 18,189 evaluation trials across eight representative tasks. Persona agents were powered by three LLMs: Claude Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5. The resulting feedback captures how decisions and preferences vary across persona backgrounds, including hesitation after a price increase, willingness to continue after an AI assistant fails, and latency tolerance. We conducted two main validation studies: First, a 400-trial controlled study evaluated persona adherence across ten behavioral attributes and all four environments. The declared behavior was expressed or correctly suppressed in 366 trials (91.5%). Second, human and LLM judges evaluated the extraction quality of human-grounded personas. Overall, MatrAIx provides an end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating AI systems and digital products with diverse simulated human users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MatrAIx，一个人口规模的模拟用户评估基础设施，用于测试 AI 系统和数字产品。它包含 Persona 8B（83 亿人物记录、1290 个类别维度）及约 100 万条质量过滤后的核心集；MatrAIx Playground 提供 Survey、AI Chatbot、Web、App 四种环境；并提供 1,010 个跨 25 个以上领域（如电商、软件、金融、医疗）的应用任务。作者用三个 LLM 驱动人物代理完成 18,189 次评估试验，并通过两项验证研究（人设遵循率 91.5% 等）表明该基础设施能捕捉不同人物背景下的决策与偏好差异。
Motivation: 人类评估 AI 系统和数字产品成本高、速度慢、难以扩展，而离线评估虽然可扩展但往往忽略了人类多样性和交互行为。因此需要一种大规模、包含异质用户的模拟用户评估方法。
Method: MatrAIx 包含三个核心组件：一是 Persona 8B 人物数据集，记录来自依赖图采样或人工撰写，并发布约 100 万条质量过滤核心集（599,847 条人类来源、400,000 条合成）；二是提供四种交互环境的 MatrAIx Playground；三是覆盖多个领域的 1,010 个应用任务。人物代理由 Claude Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 驱动。
Result: 作者进行了 18,189 次评估试验，覆盖八个代表性任务，反馈显示决策和偏好随人物背景变化，例如价格提高后的犹豫、AI 助手失败后是否继续使用以及延迟容忍度。400 次受控试验中，人物声明的行为在 366 次试验中被正确表达或抑制（91.5%）；同时人类和 LLM 法官评估了人物提取质量。
Conclusion: MatrAIx 为使用多样化模拟人类用户评估 AI 系统和数字产品提供了端到端基础设施，强调可扩展性、人物多样性和交互环境覆盖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unscented KalmanNet: a hybrid deep learning filter with calibrated posterior covariance for nonlinear state estimation
papers.abstract_en: State estimation for nonlinear dynamical systems is commonly performed with the Unscented Kalman filter (UKF), which propagates the state moments through deterministic sigma points and reports a posterior covariance at every step. In practice, however, unknown and time-varying noise statistics and model mismatch degrade both estimation accuracy and covariance calibration. Existing learned filters improve accuracy but are largely built on the extended Kalman filter and either forgo an explicit covariance or learn uncertainty without correcting mismatch-induced gain bias. This paper introduces the Unscented KalmanNet (UKN), a hybrid recursive estimator that augments the UKF with two structurally distinct learned components while preserving its explicit sigma-point covariance recursion. NoiseNet predicts time-varying process and measurement covariances as bounded multiplicative corrections to fixed baselines, guaranteeing positive definiteness, while GainNet applies a bounded residual correction to the analytical gain. A calibration-aware training objective combines state error with covariance- and innovation-consistency terms through adaptive weights, jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration. UKN is benchmarked against UKF, KalmanNet, and Bayesian KalmanNet on three synthetic systems and UZH-FPV real-flight data. It achieves the lowest aggregate state-estimation error in all four examples and reduces RMSE by $26.4$-$49.7\%$ compared to UKF in the synthetic cases. Leave-one-sequence-out cross-validation over 11 flights shows $22.4\%$ and $34.3\%$ reductions in mean position and velocity RMSE, respectively. UKN also yields the lowest fold-to-fold variability, with normalized NEES and empirical coverage closest to nominal values among the other filters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unscented KalmanNet (UKN)，一种混合递归估计器，在无迹卡尔曼滤波 (UKF) 基础上加入两个结构不同的可学习组件：NoiseNet 以有界乘法校正预测时变过程与测量协方差，保证正定性；GainNet 对解析增益施加有界残差校正，同时保留 UKF 的显式 sigma 点协方差递推。校准感知的训练目标通过自适应权重联合优化状态误差、协方差一致性与创新一致性。在三个合成系统和 UZH-FPV 真实飞行数据上，UKN 相对 UKF、KalmanNet 和 Bayesian KalmanNet 取得最低聚合状态估计误差。
Motivation: 实际中未知且时变的噪声统计和模型失配会同时损害 UKF 的估计精度与协方差校准；现有学习型滤波器大多基于扩展卡尔曼滤波，要么不输出显式协方差，要么只学习不确定性而没有纠正失配引起的增益偏差。
Method: 提出 UKN，在保留 UKF 显式 sigma 点协方差递推的同时，用 NoiseNet 将时变过程与测量协方差预测为对固定基线的有界乘法校正（保证正定），用 GainNet 对解析增益做有界残差校正；训练目标结合状态误差项与协方差/创新一致性项，并通过自适应权重联合优化精度与校准。
Result: 在三个合成系统和 UZH-FPV 真实飞行数据上，UKN 在全部四个例子中取得最低聚合状态估计误差；合成案例中相比 UKF 的 RMSE 降低 26.4%-49.7%，11 次飞行的留一序列交叉验证显示平均位置和速度 RMSE 分别降低 22.4% 和 34.3%；UKN 还取得最低的折间变异性，归一化 NEES 和经验覆盖率最接近标称值。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将 UKF 的解析协方差递推与两类有界学习校正相结合，可以在非线性状态估计中同时改善精度与协方差校准；摘要未报告明显的局限。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: From Financial Sentiment Classification to Return Predictability: A QLoRA Benchmark of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Financial sentiment classifiers are commonly evaluated against human labels, but strong linguistic performance does not necessarily imply economically useful return predictability. This study separates these questions through two experiments. First, we construct a unified three-class benchmark from five financial text datasets and compare TF--IDF Naive Bayes, off-the-shelf FinBERT and Financial-RoBERTa encoders, zero-shot Qwen2.5-7B, and QLoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and Mistral-7B models. Mistral-7B achieves the best test accuracy (0.8840) and macro-F1 (0.8771), while QLoRA raises Qwen2.5's macro-F1 from 0.7274 to 0.8615. An inverse-frequency class-weighted loss does not improve Qwen2.5. Second, we evaluate economic validity on a temporally separate 2019 Benzinga sample containing 10,637 unique headlines and 13,115 headline--stock observations for a fixed S\&P~100 universe. Model probabilities are converted into continuous sentiment scores, aggregated by stock and signal date, and aligned with next-session returns over one-, two-, three-, and five-day horizons. All seven downstream models produce positive but small mean rank information coefficients at the one-day horizon; the largest is 0.0143 for FinBERT. None of the 28 model--horizon tests remains significant after Newey--West inference and false-discovery-rate correction. Portfolio results likewise fail to establish a robust advantage for the best-performing classifiers. The findings show that QLoRA is effective for financial sentiment adaptation, while also documenting a clear gap between classification accuracy and tradable cross-sectional signals.
papers.comment: Waiting to submit to a conference (ICAIF)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个实验区分金融情感分类的语言学表现与经济回报可预测性。作者在五个金融文本数据集上构建统一的三分类基准，比较 TF-IDF 朴素贝叶斯、FinBERT、Financial-RoBERTa、零样本 Qwen2.5-7B 以及 QLoRA 微调的多个大模型；随后在 2019 年 Benzinga 样本上评估这些模型概率转化后的情感分数对下一交易日收益的预测能力。结果显示 Mistral-7B 取得最佳测试准确率 0.8840 和宏 F1 0.8771，QLoRA 将 Qwen2.5 的宏 F1 从 0.7274 提升至 0.8615，但所有模型在一天时间窗口的收益预测信息系数都很小，且经 Newey-West 推断和 FDR 校正后均不显著。
Motivation: 现有金融情感分类器通常以人类标注为评估标准，但较强的语言分类表现不一定意味着经济上有用的收益可预测性，作者希望分别考察这两个问题。
Method: 采用两个实验：在五个金融文本数据集上构建统一三分类基准并比较多种模型，包括传统 TF-IDF 朴素贝叶斯、现成 FinBERT 与 Financial-RoBERTa、零样本 Qwen2.5-7B、以及 QLoRA 适配的 Qwen2.5-7B、LLaMA3-8B 和 Mistral-7B；随后在时间分离的 2019 Benzinga 样本上，将模型概率转为连续情感分数，按股票和信号日期聚合，并与未来 1、2、3、5 个交易日的收益对齐进行经济有效性检验。
Result: Mistral-7B 获得最佳测试准确率 0.8840 和宏 F1 0.8771；QLoRA 将 Qwen2.5 的宏 F1 从 0.7274 提升到 0.8615，而逆频率类别加权损失未改善 Qwen2.5。七个模型在一天时间窗口均产生为正但很小的平均秩信息系数，最大为 FinBERT 的 0.0143；28 个模型-时间窗口组合在 Newey-West 推断和 FDR 校正后均不显著，组合结果也未显示最佳分类器具有稳健优势。
Conclusion: QLoRA 对金融情感适应是有效的，但研究同时记录了分类准确率与可交易横截面信号之间的明显差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SiMDex: Mining Similar Egocentric Videos for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed an explosive trend of scaling ego-centric human videos for robot manipulation, yet it remains unclear which data actually benefits dexterous manipulation. We present SiMDex, a similarity-based data mining framework that casts human data selection for VLA post-training in dexterous manipulation as a recommendation problem. For each robot demonstration, SiMDex employs a three-layer recall-ranking-re-ranking pipeline to extract task-relevant subsets from a pool of ~32M egocentric human samples, operating in a morphology-agnostic action space that requires no changes to VLA architecture or training. Against a strong baseline trained with an equal amount of randomly sampled human data, SiMDex uses only ~1.49M mined samples (<5% of the pool) yet improves the overall success rate from 47.7% to 61.1%, showing that selective curation outperforms indiscriminate data mixing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SiMDex，一个基于相似度的数据挖掘框架，将灵巧操作中用于 VLA 后训练的人类数据选择建模为推荐问题。该方法采用三层召回-排序-重排序 (recall-ranking-re-ranking) 流程，在形态无关的动作空间中，从约 3200 万条第一视角 (egocentric) 人类样本池中筛选任务相关子集，无需改动 VLA 架构或训练方式。摘要报告称，在等量随机采样人类数据训练的强基线上，仅用约 149 万条筛选样本（不到数据池的 5%）即可将总体成功率从 47.7% 提升到 61.1%。
Motivation: 近年利用大规模第一视角人类视频进行机器人操作训练的趋势显著，但哪些人类数据真正有利于灵巧操作仍不清楚；随机混合数据效果有限，需要更有效的选择性数据筛选方法。
Method: SiMDex 将人类数据选择问题转化为推荐问题，采用三层 recall-ranking-re-ranking 流程，从约 3200 万条 egocentric 人类样本中提取任务相关子集；全程在形态无关 (morphology-agnostic) 动作空间中运行，因此不需要改动 VLA 架构或训练流程。
Result: 与使用等量随机采样人类数据训练的强基线相比，SiMDex 仅使用约 149 万条挖掘样本（<5% 数据池）便将总体成功率从 47.7% 提升至 61.1%，说明选择性数据策展优于不加区分的数据混合。
Conclusion: 摘要强调选择性数据筛选比无差别数据混合更有效，SiMDex 能够在极小数据子集上显著提升 VLA 在灵巧操作任务中的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Patients-like-me: A Variational LM--GNN Framework for Explainable Clinical Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) offer strong textual representations for electronic health records (EHRs), but they encode patient sequences in isolation and provide limited explainability. Graph neural networks (GNNs) complement LMs by incorporating inter-patient relationships and enabling reference-patient attribution, yet they rely on high-quality patient representations. We propose Patients-like-me (PLM), a unified LM--GNN framework that integrates local patient semantics with global cohort structure. To train PLM efficiently, we introduce a Variational Expectation-Maximization algorithm that alternates LM and GNN updates under a supervised variational objective. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that PLM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with improvements generalizing across encoder-only and decoder-only LM backbones. These gains are achieved with only modest additional computational overhead. PLM also provides reference-patient explanations by retrieving influential similar patients, while edge-masking experiments confirm that the highest-ranked references have the greatest impact on model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Patients-like-me (PLM)，一个将语言模型与图神经网络统一的框架，用于可解释的临床预测。PLM 把局部患者语义与全局队列结构结合，并引入变分期望最大化 (Variational Expectation-Maximization) 算法交替更新 LM 与 GNN。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，PLM 持续优于现有方法，且改进在 encoder-only 与 decoder-only 的 LM 骨干上都成立。
Motivation: 语言模型对电子健康记录 (EHR) 能提供强文本表征，但独立编码患者序列且可解释性有限；GNN 可以引入患者间关系并提供参考患者归因，却依赖高质量的患者表征。作者希望同时利用局部患者语义与全局队列结构来弥补这一缺口。
Method: 提出统一 LM-GNN 框架 PLM，将患者文本语义与患者间关系结构整合进同一模型；训练上设计了变分期望最大化算法，在监督变分目标下交替更新 LM 与 GNN 参数。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上，PLM 一致超过现有最先进方法，并验证改进可推广到 encoder-only 与 decoder-only 两种 LM 骨干，且只需适度的额外计算开销。边掩码实验表明，排序最高的参考患者对模型预测影响最大。
Conclusion: PLM 通过检索有影响力的相似患者提供参考患者式解释，实验确认高排名参考患者对预测贡献最大，说明结合全局队列信息能同时提升预测性能与可解释性。
