papers.title: Behavioral Skill Reconstruction: Reconstructing Hidden Functionality from LLM Agent Skills
papers.abstract_en: Closed source agent skills may encode proprietary instructions, scripts, constants, and data. Providers may offer their capabilities as services while keeping the underlying packages hidden. Prior work focuses on prompt injection attacks that directly disclose these artifacts, and existing defenses accordingly aim to prevent such leakage. However, preventing file disclosure does not prevent users from recovering the functionality those files implement. This raises a fundamental question: can a user reconstruct a skill's functionality through ordinary use while its files remain hidden? We study behavioral skill reconstruction (BSR), in which an attacker uses valid task requests and observed responses to build a functional clone of a hidden skill. We introduce SkillClone, a black-box attack that clones a target skill by forming an interface hypothesis from its public advertisement, issuing structured benign probes, synthesizing an executable replica, and iteratively repairing it through differential validation against the victim skill. Across 30 skills spanning rules, tables, procedures, and algorithms, SkillClone achieves exact or partial recovery on held-out inputs for several targets. Iterative requerying closes gaps missed by single-round reconstruction. Because SkillClone uses only legitimate interactions, disclosure-focused defenses provide limited coverage, and less detailed skill descriptions offer limited protection. These results show that file secrecy alone does not ensure functional secrecy. Defenses must also limit cumulative information leakage from ordinary use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究闭源 LLM agent skill（技能）的功能恢复问题，提出行为技能重建（behavioral skill reconstruction, BSR）的黑盒攻击框架 SkillClone。攻击者仅通过合法的任务请求与观察到的响应，对隐藏的 skill 文件进行功能克隆，并在 30 个覆盖规则、表格、流程和算法的 skill 上实现对部分目标测试输入的精确或部分恢复。作者指出，仅靠文件保密无法保证功能保密，防御需要限制正常使用中的累积信息泄漏。
Motivation: 现有攻击聚焦于提示注入（prompt injection）直接泄露 skill 中的专有指令、脚本或数据，防御也因此只关注阻止文件内容泄露；但阻止文件泄露并不能阻止用户从正常交互中恢复其实现的功能，这是一个被忽视的缺口。
Method: SkillClone 是一种黑盒攻击，流程包括：依据 skill 的公开宣传形成接口假设（interface hypothesis）、发出结构化的良性探针、合成可执行副本，并通过与受害者 skill 的差分验证（differential validation）迭代修复该副本。
Result: 在 30 个涵盖规则、表格、流程和算法的 skill 上，SkillClone 对若干目标的留出输入实现了精确或部分恢复；迭代重查询（iterative requerying）能够弥合单轮重建遗漏的差距。
Conclusion: 作者认为文件保密并不等于功能保密，仅靠防止文件披露的防御覆盖有限，而更简略的 skill 描述也仅能提供有限保护；防御必须同时限制正常使用过程中产生的累积信息泄漏。

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Abductive Fusion of Pre-trained Transformer-based Perception Models
papers.abstract_en: Deploying pre-trained perception models in novel environments degrades their accuracy under distributional shift, and assembling them alone does not recover it: combiners such as majority voting trade recall for precision and are brittle to coordinated failures. Prior metacognitive methods learn logical rules that flag a model's errors, but rely on hand-authored domain-knowledge cues (object-size priors, segmentation masks) that do not transfer to genuinely novel scenes. We show that this metacognitive layer can be learned without any domain knowledge by exploiting vector-space geometry: per-model Label Vector Pools (LVP), built from each model's own training embeddings, yield error-detection rules from the geometry of detections relative to training-determined prototypes, reaching parity with domain-knowledge rules to within $0.002$ every F1 on test set. Because the approach remains neurosymbolic, these geometric rules share a single logical framework and can still be complemented by domain knowledge when available. We frame the fusion of multiple imperfect ViT-based detectors as a consistency-based abduction problem solved at test time by an exact Integer Program (IP) and a polynomial-time heuristic. On an aerial-imagery benchmark of 15 weather-shifted test sets and six ViT detectors, our domain-knowledge-free layer matches the strongest majority-vote variant on clean data (within $0.005$ F1) and, unlike every majority-vote baseline, retains its performance under a coordinated label-flipping attack: at a $90\%$ flip rate it averages $0.42$ F1 versus $0.35$ for MV-Plurality (a $22\%$ relative gain) and attains the highest F1 on \emph{every} test set once the flip rate exceeds $0.4$
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在分布偏移下融合多个预训练 ViT 感知模型的问题，提出无需领域知识的元认知层：利用每个模型自身训练嵌入构建 Label Vector Pools，从检测结果相对训练原型的几何关系学习错误检测规则，与手工领域知识规则的 F1 差距在 0.002 内。融合被建模为测试时的基于一致性的溯因 (abduction) 问题，用精确整数规划 (IP) 和多项式时间启发式求解。在 15 个天气偏移航拍测试集和 6 个 ViT 检测器上，该无领域知识层在干净数据上与多数投票最优变体相当，并在协调标签翻转攻击下保持性能。
Motivation: 预训练感知模型在新环境部署时因分布偏移精度下降，简单组合器如多数投票以召回换精度且对协同失败脆弱；先验元认知方法依赖手工领域知识线索，无法迁移到真正的新场景。
Method: 提出从每个检测器自身训练嵌入构建 Label Vector Pools，利用检测结果相对训练确定原型的几何性质生成错误检测规则；将多个不完美 ViT 检测器的融合建模为测试时一致性溯因问题，用精确整数规划和多项式时间启发式求解，并保持神经符号框架以便与可用领域知识互补。
Result: 在航拍图像基准（15 个天气偏移测试集、6 个 ViT 检测器）上，无领域知识层与最强多数投票变体在干净数据上 F1 相差 0.005 内；在 90% 标签翻转率下平均 F1 为 0.42，优于 MV-Plurality 的 0.35（相对提升 22%），且翻转率超过 0.4 时在每个测试集上取得最高 F1。
Conclusion: 摘要强调元认知错误检测层可以完全从向量空间几何中学习而不需要领域知识，性能与手工领域知识规则相当，并显著提升对协调标签翻转攻击的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Feature Selection Methods for EHR Diagnosis Codes in Opioid Use Disorder Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is a critical step in electronic health record (EHR)-based predictive modeling, where input variables are often high-dimensional, sparse, noisy, and redundant. Large feature sets not only increase computational burden and overfitting risk, but also make model interpretation difficult, leading to limited usefulness in clinical settings. In this study, we focus on diagnosis-related features and compare five feature selection paradigms for opioid use disorder (OUD) prediction: recurrence enrichment, NTK-motivated early gradient sensitivity, LightGBM-SHAP, Elastic Net, and large language model (LLM)-guided semantic selection. We use a unified preprocessing and evaluation framework and assess each method by downstream predictive performance, resampling stability, and representation of infrequent diagnosis codes. Our results demonstrate that performance improves with larger feature budgets with diminishing returns beyond a moderate size. NTK sensitivity provides the best overall balance of accuracy and stability, and LLM-guided selection contributes complementary clinically meaningful signals despite lower standalone performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AMIA 2026 Annual Symposium
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是面向阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）预测的特征选择方法比较研究，针对EHR诊断码特征的高维、稀疏、嘈杂和冗余问题，统一预处理与评估框架下比较复发富集、NTK启发的早期梯度敏感性、LightGBM-SHAP、Elastic Net和LLM引导的语义选择五种范式。结果表明更大特征预算带来性能提升但中等规模后收益递减，NTK敏感性在准确性和稳定性上综合最优，LLM引导选择提供互补的临床有意义信号。
Motivation: EHR预测建模中特征集高维、稀疏、嘈杂且冗余，大特征集增加计算负担和过拟合风险，同时降低模型可解释性，限制临床实用性。
Method: 聚焦诊断相关特征，比较复发富集、NTK启发的早期梯度敏感性、LightGBM-SHAP、Elastic Net和LLM引导语义选择五种特征选择范式，使用统一预处理与评估框架，按下游预测性能、重采样稳定性和罕见诊断码代表性评估。
Result: 性能随特征预算增大而提升，但超过中等规模后收益递减；NTK敏感性在准确性和稳定性间综合平衡最佳；LLM引导选择独立性能较低但贡献互补的临床有意义信号。
Conclusion: 研究强调特征预算规模与收益的权衡，并指出NTK敏感性为OUD预测中较稳健的选择，LLM引导特征可作为补充信号来源。

papers.title: TriCLE: Tri-Modal Vision-Language Reasoning for Edge-Deployed Fine-Grained Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Edge platforms used for aerial observation must interpret aircraft imagery under limited memory, limited compute, and intermittent connectivity. This setting is difficult for standard RGB-only recognition models and general-purpose vision-language models, especially when calibrated thermal and LiDAR aircraft data are unavailable. We present TriCLE, an application-oriented tri-modal vision-language system for aircraft taxonomic grouping under edge constraints. From a single RGB aircraft image, TriCLE generates a structure-preserving FLIR-style thermal view and a pseudo-LiDAR depth projection, then fuses the aligned views with task instructions in a compact Qwen3-VL backbone. The model is aligned to an expert aircraft taxonomy based on propulsion, airframe family, size, design era, and configuration, so its outputs reflect engineering-relevant similarity rather than only surface appearance. We evaluate supervised fine-tuning, rotation-preserving SFT, and three policy-alignment strategies: GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO. Sequence-level GSPO gives the strongest validation performance, reaching 88.33\% validation accuracy and 0.91 weighted F1 on valid aircraft outputs. On a held-out aircraft test partition, GSPO achieves 78.00\% accuracy and 0.793 weighted F1 while preserving 94.00\% parseable output formatting. After 4-bit quantization and attention-memory optimization, the aligned 4B model fits an 8GB deployment target and processes each tri-modal triplet in 1.48 seconds. These results support TriCLE as a practical prototype for interpretable, edge-feasible aircraft grouping, while emphasizing the need for further validation on real aligned thermal and LiDAR sensor streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TriCLE，一个面向边缘部署的三模态视觉-语言系统，用于飞机分类学分组（taxonomic grouping）。系统从单张 RGB 飞机图像生成结构保持的 FLIR 风格热视图和伪 LiDAR 深度投影，并在紧凑的 Qwen3-VL 骨干中与任务指令融合，输出对齐到基于动力、机身家族、尺寸、设计年代和配置的专家分类法。摘要报告在策略对齐中序列级 GSPO 表现最佳，并在量化后满足 8GB 边缘部署目标。
Motivation: 边缘航空观测平台在有限内存、有限算力和间歇连接下需要解读飞机图像，而标准 RGB 识别模型和通用视觉-语言模型在此场景下表现不佳，尤其在缺乏校准热成像和 LiDAR 数据时。
Method: TriCLE 从单张 RGB 图像生成 FLIR 风格热视图和伪 LiDAR 深度投影，将三个对齐视图与任务指令融合进紧凑的 Qwen3-VL 骨干，并对齐到反映工程相关相似性的专家飞机分类法。作者评估了监督微调、旋转保持 SFT 以及 GRPO、GSPO、DAPO 三种策略对齐方法。
Result: 序列级 GSPO 在验证集上达到 88.33% 准确率和 0.91 加权 F1；在留出测试分区上达到 78.00% 准确率和 0.793 加权 F1，同时保持 94.00% 的可解析输出格式。经 4-bit 量化和注意力内存优化后，对齐后的 4B 模型适配 8GB 部署目标，每个三模态三元组处理耗时 1.48 秒。
Conclusion: 结果表明 TriCLE 是面向可解释、边缘可行的飞机分组任务的实际原型，同时作者强调仍需在真实对齐的热成像和 LiDAR 传感器流上进行进一步验证。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TriCLE，一个面向边缘部署的三模态视觉-语言系统，用于飞机分类学分组（taxonomic grouping）。系统从单张 RGB 飞机图像生成结构保持的 FLIR 风格热视图和伪 LiDAR 深度投影，并在紧凑的 Qwen3-VL 骨干中与任务指令融合，输出对齐到基于动力、机身家族、尺寸、设计年代和配置的专家分类法。摘要报告在策略对齐中序列级 GSPO 表现最佳，并在量化后满足 8GB 边缘部署目标。

papers.title: TS2TabPFN: Time Series Classification and Extrinsic Regression through Feature Extraction and a Tabular Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Time series data are ubiquitous in practical applications, where classification (TSC) and extrinsic regression (TSER) have emerged as essential tasks for obtaining value from temporal sequences. While the literature has seen significant progress through feature-based and deep learning models, existing methods often focus either on the quality of feature extraction or on the intrinsic predictive power of complex architectures applied to raw data. This division creates a gap between the control offered by feature engineering and the automated performance of end-to-end models. This paper proposes TS2TabPFN, a framework that bridges this gap by integrating explicit feature extraction with TabPFN 2.5, a cutting-edge foundation model for tabular data, to leverage its predictive capabilities. Our extensive experimental evaluation demonstrates that TS2TabPFN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models in TSER tasks with statistical significance, providing a robust and efficient alternative for TSC and surpassing most of the currently best-performing algorithms. These results suggest that combining foundation models with structured features overcomes single-paradigm limitations, establishing a new time series state-of-the-art.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026. To appear in Springer LNCS. 18 pages; 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TS2TabPFN，将显式特征提取与表格数据基础模型 TabPFN 2.5 结合，用于时间序列分类（TSC）和外部回归（TSER）。实验表明该方法在 TSER 任务上显著优于现有最优模型，并在 TSC 上超过大多数当前最佳算法，作者据此认为结合基础模型与结构化特征可突破单一范式的局限。
Motivation: 现有时间序列方法要么侧重特征提取质量，要么依赖对原始数据建模的复杂端到端架构，导致特征工程的可控性与端到端模型的自动化性能之间存在割裂。
Method: 提出 TS2TabPFN 框架，先对时间序列进行显式特征提取，再将结构化特征输入 TabPFN 2.5 这一表格数据基础模型进行预测，以同时利用特征工程的控制力和基础模型的预测能力。
Result: 摘要报告 TS2TabPFN 在 TSER 任务上以统计显著性优于现有最优模型，在 TSC 上是稳健且高效的替代方案，性能超过大多数当前最佳算法。
Conclusion: 作者认为基础模型与结构化特征的组合能够克服单一范式的局限，并称之为新的时间序列 state-of-the-art；论文已被 ECML PKDD 2026 接收。

papers.title: Understanding Fault Tolerance of Adversarially Robust Pruned Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on resource-constrained neuromorphic hardware face three concurrent challenges: the need for model compression through pruning, vulnerability to adversarial input perturbations, and susceptibility to hardware-induced weight faults such as stuck-at-zero errors. While each of these factors has been studied in isolation, their combined effects on model reliability have received little attention. This paper presents an empirical investigation of how pruning, adversarial training, and hardware fault injection interact to affect the robustness of convolutional neural networks. Using a compact three-layer CNN trained on MNIST, we conduct three experiments: (1) comparing the fault tolerance of naturally and adversarially trained models under simultaneous hardware faults and adversarial attacks, (2) evaluating how pruning affects adversarial robustness, and (3) characterizing the joint accuracy surface across fault rates, adversarial perturbation magnitudes, and pruning levels. Our results show that adversarial training improves robustness against input perturbations but increases sensitivity to stuck-at-zero weight faults. Contrary to intuition, pruning did not significantly increase fault sensitivity, and varying the pruning level had little effect across fault rates and attack strengths. These results highlight the need to jointly consider adversarial robustness and hardware reliability.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE National Aerospace and Electronics Conference (NAECON 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 MNIST 上用一个紧凑的三层 CNN 实证研究剪枝、对抗训练和硬件故障注入（stuck-at-zero 权重故障）三者之间的交互。通过三个实验比较自然训练与对抗训练模型在同时发生硬件故障和对抗攻击时的容错性、评估剪枝对对抗鲁棒性的影响，并刻画故障率、对抗扰动幅度与剪枝水平共同作用下的联合精度面。结果表明对抗训练提高了对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但增加了对 stuck-at-zero 权重故障的敏感性。
Motivation: 部署在资源受限神经形态硬件上的 DNN 同时面临模型压缩、对抗扰动和硬件诱导权重故障等挑战，此前这些因素通常被孤立研究，它们对模型可靠性的联合影响很少被关注。
Method: 使用一个紧凑的三层 CNN 在 MNIST 上开展三项实验：对比自然训练与对抗训练模型在同时遭受硬件故障与对抗攻击时的故障容错性；评估剪枝如何影响对抗鲁棒性；刻画故障率、对抗扰动幅度和剪枝水平构成的联合精度面 (joint accuracy surface)。
Result: 摘要报告对抗训练提升了对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但增加对 stuck-at-zero 权重故障的敏感性；与直觉相反，剪枝未显著增加故障敏感性，且改变剪枝水平在不同故障率和攻击强度下影响很小。
Conclusion: 结果表明需要同时考虑对抗鲁棒性与硬件可靠性，而不能只单独优化其中一方面。

papers.title: Visualizing Graph-to-Answer Mechanism Recovery in Materials-Science Hypothesis Generation
papers.abstract_en: AI co-scientists can generate fluent materials-science hypotheses, but fluency does not show that an answer preserves a scientifically meaningful mechanism. We present a graph-to-answer mechanism-tracing case study for Graph-PRefLexOR-8B, a Qwen3-8B model adapted to expose distinct stages for brainstorming, graph construction, pattern extraction, and synthesis. We organize semantic backtracking, graph corruption, activation-based recovery measurements, and layer-by-token-region grids into a visual diagnostic workflow for inspecting this pathway. Across 100 open-ended materials-science questions, final answers remain closest to the model's own structured stages, especially synthesis. Under graph corruption, a full sweep over 37 residual-stream checkpoints, the embedding output and 36 transformer blocks, shows little mechanism recovery in the earlier transition region at layers 7--10, recovery instead concentrates in late synthesis and answer-start regions around layers 30 and 36. The workflow is intended to help scientists and model developers identify where a generated hypothesis loses or regains mechanism support before it is passed to downstream experimental planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 共科学家在材料科学假设生成中“流利但不保证机制正确”的问题，提出一个图到答案的机制追踪 (mechanism tracing) 案例研究。作者使用 Graph-PRefLexOR-8B（基于 Qwen3-8B 调整的模型），将其构建为头脑风暴、图构建、模式提取和综合几个阶段，并用语义回溯、图破坏、基于激活的恢复测量以及按层-按 token 区域的网格组成可视化诊断工作流。在 100 个开放式材料科学问题上的实验表明，最终答案始终最接近模型自身的结构化阶段（尤其是综合阶段），并且机制恢复主要集中在后期综合和答案起始区域。
Motivation: 现有 AI 共科学家生成的假设虽然流畅，但流畅性并不能证明答案保留了科学上有意义的机制；研究人员需要能看清机制在何处丢失或恢复的可视化诊断方法。
Method: 提出一种可视化诊断工作流，整合语义回溯、图破坏、基于激活的恢复测量，以及逐层-逐 token 区域的网格；在 37 个残差流检查点（嵌入输出加 36 个 Transformer 块）上对图破坏进行全扫描，以检查机制恢复路径。
Result: 在 100 个开放式材料科学问题上，最终答案与模型自身结构化阶段（尤其是综合阶段）最接近；图破坏下，层 7–10 的早期过渡区域几乎没有机制恢复，恢复集中在约层 30 和 36 的后期综合与答案起始区域。
Conclusion: 该工作流旨在帮助科学家和模型开发者确定生成的假设在交给下游实验规划前，机制支持在何处丢失或重新获得。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mind the Cap: Output-Budget Regimes Change the Measured Multilingual Reasoning Gap
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual evaluations report accuracy at a single output-token cap, but languages need different numbers of tokens to express the same content, so the cap is a hidden experimental variable. We test whether the native-vs-translate gap on MGSM (German, Thai, Swahili) is a token-budget artifact for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four prompting strategies. The measured gap swings by up to 57 points across budgets, length normalization moves it by up to 38.9 points where the cap binds, and at tight caps normalization can reverse which strategy scores higher. We prospectively froze the sweep's three Qwen peaks and its near-zero value at 1024 and evaluated them on 540,000 independently hard-capped decodes: a second frozen family of six Holm-corrected tests rejects every null. The frozen test at $B^*=1024$ still fails to reject because native accuracy has already saturated there; above saturation, the residual difference is a strategy-performance gap, not an identified reasoning deficit. The same truncation channel prices a cost-ordered adaptation ladder: a cross-fitted Thai vocabulary extension closes 0.0 points of the gap at the frozen budget and 4.9 points where 19% of traces still truncate. A third frozen family varies only the announced budget at a fixed enforced cap; announcing 128 rather than 2048 tokens moves Thai native accuracy by 5.1 points, so accuracy is not a function of the enforced cap alone. A correct-emission timing identity computed from one long-cap run matches the three pre-specified MGSM peaks to 0.65 points and, in an exploratory Qwen-only analysis of three further benchmarks, tracks held-out items to 0.92 points, locating the peak exactly in five of seven cells. Treat the output cap as an independent variable and report accuracy across the budget regime, not at a single budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验多语言评测中 native-vs-translate 差距是否是输出 token 预算（output-token cap）带来的实验伪影。作者在 MGSM（德语、泰语、斯瓦希里语）上用 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 及四种提示策略，发现测量到的差距随预算最多摆动 57 个点，长度归一化在预算受限时最多移动 38.9 个点，且在紧预算下归一化可能反转策略之间的高低排序。作者通过前瞻性冻结检验和 540,000 次硬截断解码验证了部分峰值，并指出在饱和点以上剩余差异是策略性能差距而非推理缺陷。
Motivation: 多语言评测通常在单一输出 token 上限下报告准确率，但不同语言表达同一内容所需 token 数不同，因此该上限是一个隐藏的实验变量，可能导致 native 与 translate 之间的推理差距被误读。
Method: 采用四种提示策略扫描多个输出预算，结合长度归一化，并对三个预指定的 Qwen 峰值及 1024 处的近零值做前瞻性冻结检验，在 540,000 次独立硬截断解码上用 Holm 校正的六重检验验证；随后构建成本排序的适应阶梯（泰语词汇扩展），并设计第三个冻结实验族，在固定强制预算下仅改变公布的预算。还引入正确发射时间恒等式（correct-emission timing identity）来定位峰值。
Result: 测量差距随预算最多摆动 57 点；长度归一化在预算受限处最多移动 38.9 点并可反转策略排序。冻结检验在 B*=1024 处无法拒绝原假设，因为 native 准确率已饱和；泰语词汇扩展在冻结预算处闭合 0.0 点差距，在 19% 轨迹仍截断处闭合 4.9 点；将公布预算从 2048 改为 128 使泰语 native 准确率移动 5.1 点。时序恒等式与三个预指定 MGSM 峰值吻合到 0.65 点，在探索性 Qwen-only 分析中与留出项吻合到 0.92 点，并在七个单元格中的五个精确定位峰值。
Conclusion: 作者主张应将输出预算视为独立变量，并在整个预算区间上报告准确率，而不是在单一预算点报告；饱和后残余差异是策略性能差距，不应解释为跨语言推理缺陷。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 测量差距随预算最多摆动 57 点；长度归一化在预算受限处最多移动 38.9 点并可反转策略排序。冻结检验在 B*=1024 处无法拒绝原假设，因为 native 准确率已饱和；泰语词汇扩展在冻结预算处闭合 0.0 点差距，在 19% 轨迹仍截断处闭合 4.9 点；将公布预算从 2048 改为 128 使泰语 native 准确率移动 5.1 点。时序恒等式与三个预指定 MGSM 峰值吻合到 0.65 点，在探索性 Qwen-only 分析中与留出项吻合到 0.92 点，并在七个单元格中的五个精确定位峰值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张应将输出预算视为独立变量，并在整个预算区间上报告准确率，而不是在单一预算点报告；饱和后残余差异是策略性能差距，不应解释为跨语言推理缺陷。

papers.title: MINT: Tensor Decomposition on Stacked Recurrence Matrices for Time Series Data Mining
papers.abstract_en: Recurrence plots are a time series data mining primitive applied to a variety of domains (e.g. star light curves, sound waveforms, CCT telemetry). This work proposes tensorized self-similarity matrices as a primitive for univariate time series datasets ($N\times n$) of $N$ time series of length $n$ with a subsequence window of length $m$, and whose tensor-based nature is naturally extensible to multivariate datasets. The proposed method to compute this primitive computes dot plots of size $N \times (n-m+1) \times (n-m+ 1)$ from these datasets, where the subsequent tensor is mined using tensor decomposition methods to mine for co-clustered patterns. We demonstrate our results in mass rapid transit, electricity demand, wind turbine, and car traffic data, finding the MINT pipeline effectively co-clusters cross-sensor patterns in highly regular datasets containing motifs at regular intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MINT，一种针对单变量时间序列数据集（N 条长度为 n 的序列）的张量化自相似矩阵（tensorized self-similarity matrices）原语，将每个时间序列的子序列窗口（长度 m）计算为点积图，堆叠形成大小为 N × (n-m+1) × (n-m+1) 的张量，再用张量分解（tensor decomposition）挖掘协同聚类（co-clustered）模式。作者在公共交通、电力需求、风力涡轮机和汽车交通数据上验证了 MINT 流程，称其能有效在具有规则间隔模式的规律数据中发现跨传感器协同聚类模式。该方法天然可扩展到多变量数据集。
Motivation: 复发图（recurrence plots）是多种领域（如恒星光变曲线、声音波形、CCT 遥测）的时间序列数据挖掘原语，但现有形式未充分利用多序列数据集中的张量结构。作者希望提出一种统一的张量化原语，使大规模时间序列数据集上的协同聚类模式挖掘更加高效。
Method: 提出将多个单变量时间序列的子序列点积图堆叠为三阶张量，并采用张量分解方法对该张量进行挖掘，以识别跨传感器的协同聚类模式；该张量表示自然支持向多变量数据集的扩展。
Result: 在公共交通、电力需求、风力涡轮机和汽车交通数据上的实验表明，MINT 流程能有效对包含规则间隔动机（motifs）的高规律数据集进行跨传感器协同聚类。
Conclusion: 作者认为张量化自相似矩阵是时间序列数据挖掘的有效新原语，特别适用于具有规律性重复模式的数据集；摘要未提及对非规律数据或极端规模数据的适用范围限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BrainBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Comprehensive EEG Understanding
papers.abstract_en:
Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis extends beyond assigning predefined labels to recordings; it requires workflows connecting natural-language instructions, signal processing, quantitative evidence, and scientific interpretation. We term this capability \emph{comprehensive EEG understanding}. Existing evaluations, however, primarily target isolated decoding tasks or system-specific demonstrations, leaving the competence of large language models (LLMs) insufficiently quantified. We introduce  enchmarkname{}, a unified benchmark for comprehensive, instruction-conditioned EEG understanding. It comprises four subsets---Foundational Analysis, Sleep Assessment, Neurocognitive Assessment, and Physiological Integration---covering 17 datasets, 
umcases{} tasks, and over 
uminstances{} real-data instances. Given an instruction and EEG recordings with optional physiological signals, a system must perform the analysis and produce a scientifically grounded report and, when required, artifacts. Outputs are assessed through numerical, categorical, set, sequence, semantic, and artifact validation. We evaluate 
ummodels{} representative LLMs across more than 100K executions under two paradigms: autonomous code execution with CodeAct and structured agentic analysis with BrainAgent. Results vary substantially across models, subsets, difficulty levels, and execution paradigms, showing that EEG competence depends on the model and its operationalization.  enchmarkname{} provides a reproducible testbed for advancing LLM-based EEG understanding. The code and benchmark will be released soon, with evaluation results continuously updated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一、指令条件下的 EEG 理解基准 BrainBench，包含 Foundational Analysis、Sleep Assessment、Neurocognitive Assessment、Physiological Integration 四个子集，覆盖 17 个数据集和大量真实数据实例；系统需根据自然语言指令与可选生理信号完成分析并输出科学报告和必要的人工产物。作者在自主代码执行（CodeAct）与结构化智能体分析（BrainAgent）两种范式下对代表性 LLM 进行 10 万次以上执行评测，发现 EEG 能力随模型、子集、难度与执行范式显著变化。
Motivation: 现有 EEG 评测主要针对孤立解码任务或系统特定演示，缺乏对 LLM 在连接自然语言指令、信号处理、定量证据与科学解释的完整工作流（comprehensive EEG understanding）上的统一量化。
Method: 构建 BrainBench 基准，设计四个任务子集并集成 17 个数据集与多种真实数据任务；输出通过数值、类别、集合、序列、语义和 artifact 验证，并在自主代码执行（CodeAct）与结构化智能体分析（BrainAgent）两种执行范式下评测多个代表性 LLM。
Result: 摘要报告在超过 10 万次执行中，不同模型、子集、难度级别和执行范式下的结果差异显著，说明 EEG 能力既取决于模型本身，也取决于其操作化方式（operationalization）。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BrainBench 为推进基于 LLM 的 EEG 理解提供了可复现的测试平台，代码与基准即将发布，评测结果将持续更新。

papers.title: TRNet: Topography-Guided Frequency Rectification and Structure-Aware Decoding for Multimodal Paddy Rice Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Mapping paddy rice from very-high-resolution imagery in mountainous and hilly regions is difficult because terrain alters optical appearance and increases confusion with visually similar vegetation. We present TRNet for 0.5-m GaoJing-1 red--green--blue (RGB) imagery, a 5-m TanDEM-X digital elevation model (DEM), and derived slope. Separate visual and terrain encoders preserve modality-specific features. At an early encoder stage, Topographic Energy-Spectral Rectification applies terrain-conditioned low-frequency modulation and asymmetric high-frequency regulation to suppress steep-slope clutter and conditionally enhance compatible low-slope rice cues. The Topography-guided Paddy Structure Decoder combines semantic, rice--background boundary, and interior cues, using coarse terrain as context. Experiments used an Area A internal test set and held-out Area B, which had steeper terrain and lower rice prevalence. TRNet achieved rice intersection-over-union (IoU) values of 85.10\% and 80.68\%, exceeding the original Dual-Encoder U-Net by 9.15 and 18.83 percentage points, respectively. Ablation and slope-stratified results linked these gains to frequency rectification, structure learning, and fewer steep-terrain false positives. The results support coarse topography as a contextual prior for very-high-resolution paddy rice mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRNet，面向 0.5-m 高分一号（GaoJing-1）RGB 影像、5-m TanDEM-X DEM 及其坡度派生数据，用于山地丘陵地区的水稻（paddy rice）分割。网络采用独立视觉/地形双编码器，提出 Topographic Energy-Spectral Rectification 进行地形条件化频率修正，并用 Topography-guided Paddy Structure Decoder 融合语义、边界与内部线索。在内部测试集 Area A 和更陡峭、水稻占比更低的泛化集 Area B 上，水稻 IoU 分别达 85.10% 和 80.68%，显著超过 Dual-Encoder U-Net 基线。
Motivation: 在山区和丘陵地区，地形会改变光学成像外观，并增加水稻与视觉相似植被之间的混淆，使高分辨率水稻制图困难。
Method: TRNet 使用分离的视觉编码器和地形编码器保留各模态特征；在早期编码器阶段，Topographic Energy-Spectral Rectification 以地形条件执行低频调制和非对称高频调节，抑制陡坡杂波并增强低坡水稻线索；解码器利用粗粒度地形作为上下文，结合语义、水稻—背景边界和内部线索进行结构感知解码。
Result: 在 Area A 和 Area B 上，TRNet 的水稻 IoU 分别达到 85.10% 和 80.68%，较原始 Dual-Encoder U-Net 分别提升 9.15 和 18.83 个百分点。消融与按坡度分层的结果表明，提升来自频率修正、结构学习以及陡坡假阳性的减少。
Conclusion: 结果表明，粗粒度地形可作为高分辨率水稻制图的有效上下文先验；论文同时暗示该方法的适用性与地形复杂度相关。

papers.title: Sublogarithmic Swap Regret in Multiplayer General-Sum Games via Hybrid Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Swap regret governs the rate at which uncoupled learning dynamics converge to correlated equilibria in multiplayer general-sum games. Under full-information feedback, the best previous guarantee when every player follows the same dynamics grows logarithmically in the horizon $T$. We construct uncoupled dynamics under which every player incurs only $O(nm^2\sqrt{\log m\log T})$ swap regret, where $n$ is the number of players and $m$ bounds the number of actions per player. To our knowledge, this is the first sublogarithmic individual guarantee in this setting, and it implies that the time-averaged product distribution of play is an $O(nm^2\sqrt{\log m\log T}/T)$-approximate correlated equilibrium. The key algorithmic choice is to combine the Blum--Mansour reduction with optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader using a hybrid regularizer that separately weights negative Shannon entropy and the log-barrier: the entropy controls the optimistic prediction error, whereas the log-barrier controls the transition-matrix movement through its Bregman divergence. A new sensitivity theorem for stationary distributions of Markov chains, which involves neither mixing parameters nor the smallest transition probability, transfers this control to the played strategies and yields a simpler analysis without local-norm or self-concordance arguments. The guarantee is preserved by an adversarially robust variant that additionally ensures $O(nm^2\sqrt{\log m\log T}+\sqrt{mT\log m})$ swap regret against arbitrary utility sequences, and by a horizon-free variant that requires no prior knowledge of $T$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多人一般和博弈中无耦合学习动力学 (uncoupled dynamics) 的交换遗憾 (swap regret)，其收敛速率决定相关均衡 (correlated equilibrium) 的逼近程度。作者构造一种动力学，使每个玩家在完整信息反馈下仅承受 O(nm^2√(log m log T)) 的交换遗憾，据称是该设定下首个亚对数 (sublogarithmic) 个体保证，并由此推出时间平均乘积分布是 O(nm^2√(log m log T)/T)-近似相关均衡。核心算法是将 Blum–Mansour 归约与乐观 FTRL 结合，并采用混合正则项分别加权负香农熵与对数障碍函数。
Motivation: 在全信息反馈且所有玩家遵循相同动力学时，此前最好的交换遗憾保证随时间水平 T 呈对数增长；交换遗憾决定了动力学收敛到相关均衡的速率，因此亚对数界是该设定下悬而未决的问题。
Method: 提出将 Blum–Mansour 归约与乐观 follow-the-regularized-leader 结合，使用混合正则项：负香农熵控制乐观预测误差，对数障碍函数 (log-barrier) 通过其 Bregman 散度控制转移矩阵的移动。另给出一个关于马尔可夫链平稳分布的新敏感性定理，不涉及混合参数或最小转移概率，可将上述控制转移到实际策略上，从而避开局部范数与自和谐 (self-concordance) 论证。
Result: 摘要报告每位玩家的交换遗憾为 O(nm^2√(log m log T))，其中 n 为玩家数、m 为每人动作数上界；时间平均乘积分布为 O(nm^2√(log m log T)/T)-近似相关均衡。对抗鲁棒变体在任意效用序列下保证 O(nm^2√(log m log T)+√(mT log m))，另有无需知晓 T 的无水平 (horizon-free) 变体。
Conclusion: 作者声称这是该设定下首个亚对数个体交换遗憾保证，且新敏感性定理带来更简洁的分析，无需局部范数或自和谐工具；对抗鲁棒与无水平变体均保持该保证。

papers.title: AgentForge: An Immersive Role-Playing Platform for Learning Agentic Software Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is increasingly used to coordinate planning, implementation, review, and testing in software development, yet it often offers limited transparency into its decisions and interactions. Many such systems also assume that users can effectively guide the AI's decisions and validate its outputs. This assumption poses a particular challenge for novices, who must simultaneously learn how agentic AI works, how to collaborate with it effectively, and how to evaluate its outputs critically. To address this challenge, we present \textit{AgentForge}, an immersive learning system in which novices take on one of four software-engineering roles: Task Planner, Patch Author, Code Reviewer, or Test Runner, within a multi-agent code-repair workflow. In each practice session, the novices perform their chosen role while AI agents perform the remaining three. Through role-based scaffolding and metacognitive support, AgentForge clarifies role-specific responsibilities, makes agent coordination and intermediate artifacts visible, and encourages novices to monitor and evaluate their decisions. In a study with 37 novice developers, participants achieved high task-completion rates with AI-agent support. However, interaction demands differed significantly across practices: the Code Reviewer practice required more interaction turns, reroutes, and completion time ($p_{\mathrm{adj}} = .004$) and was perceived as the most challenging. Participants nevertheless reported significant gains in their understanding of software repair and agent collaboration ($p_{\mathrm{adj}} < .001$). These findings suggest that AgentForge can help novices develop practical software-engineering skills while learning to collaborate with agentic AI more critically and effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentForge，一个面向新手开发者的沉浸式学习平台，其核心场景是多智能体代码修复工作流：新手扮演 Task Planner、Patch Author、Code Reviewer 或 Test Runner 四种软件工程角色之一，而由 AI 智能体完成其余三种角色。平台通过角色脚手架 (role-based scaffolding) 和元认知支持，使智能体协调过程和中间产物可见，并鼓励学习者监控与评估自身决策。一项包含 37 名新手开发者的研究发现，参与者在 AI 智能体支持下取得高任务完成率，但不同角色实践的交互需求差异显著，且参与者自报对软件修复和智能体协作的理解有明显提升。
Motivation: 智能体 AI 正被用于软件开发的规划、实现、审查和测试，但其决策与交互过程透明度有限，且系统常假设用户能有效引导 AI 决策并验证输出；对新手而言，他们需要同时学会智能体 AI 的工作原理、协作方式和批判性评估，现有系统缺少针对这一挑战的学习支持。
Method: 作者构建 AgentForge，一个多智能体代码修复工作流中的角色扮演学习系统；每次练习中，新手执行所选角色，AI 智能体承担其余三种角色，并借助角色专用脚手架和元认知提示来澄清职责、暴露智能体协调与中间产物，引导学习者监控和评估自身判断。
Result: 在 37 名新手开发者参与的实验中，参与者在 AI 智能体协助下获得较高的任务完成率；不同角色实践差异显著，Code Reviewer 实践需要更多交互轮次、路线重定向和完成时间 (p_adj = .004)，并被感知为最具挑战性；同时参与者报告对软件修复和智能体协作的理解获得显著提升 (p_adj < .001)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 AgentForge 有助于新手在培养实际软件工程技能的同时，学会更批判、更有效地与智能体 AI 协作；该结论基于一个中等规模的单次用户研究。

papers.title: LiNC: Lightweight Noise Correction via Per-Sample Trust and Gaussian Mixture Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Label noise is common in medical imaging datasets due to factors such as inter-rater variability, annotation errors, and ambiguous cases. This can severely undermine the reliability and clinical effectiveness of machine learning models trained using those datasets. To address this challenge, we introduce Lightweight Noise Correction (LiNC), which adds a single trainable trust parameter per training sample and learns when to use the observed label and when to defer to the model during a standard training loop. The key idea is to train using a convex combination of the observed label and the model's own predictive distribution, controlled by a per-sample trust parameter. We show that the gradient of this objective drives trust values in opposite directions for clean versus noisy samples in the early training phase, yielding separable trust distributions. We use a 3-component Gaussian Mixture Model over the trust values to separate them into clean, ambiguous, and noisy cases and then execute a short soft-correction phase on the noisy cases and a final hard correction phase. Experiments on ten 2D datasets from MedMNISTv2 under label noise of up to 50% show consistent gains in accuracy and strong mislabel detection. LiNC adds negligible asymptotic overhead: the training-time complexity remains dominated by the base network, with additional memory growing linearly with the size of the training set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiNC（Lightweight Noise Correction），一种针对医学影像数据集标签噪声的轻量校正方法。方法为每个训练样本引入一个可训练的信任参数（trust parameter），在标准训练循环中用观测标签与模型自身预测分布的凸组合来决定何时采信观测标签、何时交由模型判断。作者用 3 分量高斯混合模型（Gaussian Mixture Model）将信任值分为干净、模糊和噪声三类，并对噪声样本执行短期软校正和最终硬校正。在 MedMNISTv2 的十个 2D 数据集上、标签噪声高达 50% 时，报告了持续的准确率提升和较强的误标签检测能力。
Motivation: 医学影像数据集常因标注者间差异、标注错误和模糊病例而包含标签噪声，这会严重损害基于这些数据训练的机器学习模型的可靠性和临床有效性。
Method: 每个训练样本增加一个可训练的信任参数，用该参数控制观测标签与模型自身预测分布的凸组合；利用该目标的梯度在训练早期对干净与噪声样本的信任值产生相反方向的驱动，从而形成可分离的信任分布。随后用 3 分量高斯混合模型将信任值划分为干净、模糊和噪声三类，对噪声样本先执行短期的软校正阶段，再执行最终硬校正阶段。
Result: 在 MedMNISTv2 的十组 2D 数据集上、标签噪声比例最高达 50% 时，方法带来一致的准确率提升和较强的误标签检测；渐近开销可忽略，训练时间复杂度仍由基础网络主导，额外内存随训练集大小线性增长。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LiNC 能以极小的额外代价在标签噪声场景下改善医学影像分类并有效检测错标样本；其实验范围限于 MedMNISTv2 的 2D 数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Neighborhood-Aware Dual Biomedical Entity Linking
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical entity linking grounds mentions in clinical and scientific text to entities in a curated knowledge base (KB) with ontological structure, which supports downstream applications such as literature-scale information extraction and patient-record normalization. The task has several challenges at once: the KB contains large numbers of entities, mentions are often ambiguous, and gold labels follow annotation conventions specific to each corpus. To address these challenges, we propose PILOT, a three-stage framework made up of neighborhood-aware retrieval, dual reranking, and score fusion. The retriever injects ontological structure from both the query and KB side, by reformulating mentions and pooling entity embeddings. The retrieved pool is then scored from two complementary views, one over surface forms and one over context, and fused together. PILOT achieves the state of the art on average across five widely-used benchmarks and remains efficient at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PILOT，一个三阶段生物医学实体链接框架，由 neighborhood-aware retrieval、dual reranking 与 score fusion 组成。检索器从查询侧和知识库侧注入本体结构，通过重构 mention 和池化实体嵌入来获取候选池；随后从表面形式 (surface forms) 与上下文两个互补视角对候选进行重排序并融合分数。摘要报告该方法在五个广泛使用的基准上平均达到最新技术水平，同时保持推理高效。
Motivation: 生物医学实体链接面临多个叠加挑战：知识库实体数量庞大、mention 歧义高、不同语料库的标注约定各不相同，这些因素使现有方法难以同时兼顾检索精度与跨语料泛化。
Method: 提出三阶段框架 PILOT：第一阶段是 neighborhood-aware retrieval，利用查询和知识库两侧的本体结构，通过重构 mention 和池化实体嵌入注入结构信息；第二阶段是 dual reranking，分别从表面形式和上下文两个互补视图对检索池打分；第三阶段是 score fusion，将两路分数融合得到最终排序。
Result: 摘要称 PILOT 在五个广泛使用的基准上平均取得 state-of-the-art 结果，并且在推理时保持高效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将本体结构感知的检索与双视角重排序融合，可以有效改善生物医学实体链接的性能与效率。

papers.title: InvFlowFD: Reference-Free and Background-Set-Free Perceptual Music Quality Metric with Flow Matching Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Existing reference-free methods for evaluating music perceptual quality alleviate the need for paired noisy-clean data, but they still rely on a background set, which is used to compute aggregated statistics of clean audio samples. In this work, we propose a novel approach that eliminates this requirement, achieving background-set-free and reference-free quality estimation using only a pre-trained Flow Matching backbone. We demonstrate that unconditional Flow Matching inversion via simple Euler integration is sufficient to detect various artificial distortions and accurately rank music generation models against human perceptual judgments. We introduce InvFlowFD, which performs flow inversion and compares a group of inverted samples to the prior distribution. We evaluate our method against prior work, quantitatively and with a thorough human study. Results suggest that InvFlowFD is highly correlated with human perception of sound distortions, as well as generative models' quality, while being more flexible and less restrictive than existing metrics.
papers.journal_ref: ISMIR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InvFlowFD，一种无需参考样本 (reference-free) 且无需背景集 (background-set-free) 的音乐感知质量评估指标，仅依赖预训练的 Flow Matching 主干。作者证明通过简单 Euler 积分的无条件 Flow Matching 反转足以检测多种人工失真，并能据此对音乐生成模型质量进行排序。定量实验与人类研究显示，InvFlowFD 与人类对声音失真的感知以及生成模型质量高度相关，且比现有指标更灵活、限制更少。
Motivation: 现有无参考音乐质量评估方法虽然避免了对配对噪声-干净数据的需求，但仍依赖背景集来计算干净音频的聚合统计；本文旨在消除这一依赖，实现完全无参考且无背景集的质量估计。
Method: 利用预训练的 Flow Matching 主干，对音频样本执行无条件 Flow Matching 反转（通过简单 Euler 积分），并将一组反转样本与先验分布进行比较，据此判断失真程度和生成质量。
Result: 摘要报告 InvFlowFD 与人类对声音失真的感知以及生成模型质量高度相关，同时比先前指标更灵活、限制更少；具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Flow Matching 反转可以作为感知音乐质量评估的有效基础，消除了对参考样本和背景集的依赖，为质量评估提供了更通用的方案。

papers.title: RUTA: Principled Visual Token Allocation via Rate-Utility Optimization
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution images and long videos provide vision-language models with rich context for multimodal reasoning and fine-grained perception, but the resulting long visual token sequences make large language model-side computation and memory costly. Existing visual token reducers often operate at prescribed rates, while recent methods adapt token counts across inputs using method-specific learned thresholds or importance predictors. We introduce RUTA, a principled Rate-Utility Token Allocation method that performs pre-LLM reduction by jointly learning which tokens to retain and how many to allocate to each image-query pair. RUTA constructs query-conditioned candidate tokens and predicts a retention probability for each candidate. During training, these probabilities parameterize independent Bernoulli gates, while their sum provides a differentiable training-time estimate of the token count for each pair. Retained tokens serve as anchors that aggregate information from non-retained tokens according to semantic affinity and spatial proximity. RUTA is optimized with a penalized rate-utility objective that balances downstream task loss against expected token usage. Averaged across five benchmarks and measured relative to each backbone's full-token baseline, RUTA uses only $2.0\%$ and $4.2\%$ of visual tokens while preserving $88.2\%$ and $94.4\%$ of task performance on LLaVA-NeXT-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUTA，一种基于率-效用优化的视觉 token 分配方法，在视觉语言模型（VLM）进入大语言模型之前压缩视觉 token。它联合学习保留哪些 token 以及每个图像-查询对分配多少 token，用可微的 Bernoulli 门估计 token 数量，并以带惩罚的率-效用目标优化。在五个基准上平均，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 分别只用 2.0% 和 4.2% 的视觉 token 就保留了 88.2% 和 94.4% 的任务性能。
Motivation: 高分辨率图像和长视频产生长视觉 token 序列，导致大语言模型端的计算和内存成本高昂；现有视觉 token 缩减器多使用固定比率或方法特定的阈值，缺乏统一的原则性分配机制。
Method: RUTA 在进入 LLM 前进行 token 缩减：构造查询条件化的候选 token，并为每个候选预测保留概率；训练时这些概率参数化独立的 Bernoulli 门，其总和作为每对图像-查询 token 数的可微估计。保留的 token 作为锚点，根据语义亲和度与空间邻近性聚合未保留 token 的信息，并用惩罚的率-效用目标在任务损失和期望 token 使用之间取得平衡。
Result: 在五个基准上相对于各骨干网络的完整 token 基线，RUTA 在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上仅使用 2.0% 的视觉 token 即保留 88.2% 的任务性能，在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上仅使用 4.2% 的视觉 token 即保留 94.4% 的任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，RUTA 以原则化的方式联合决定保留哪些 token 以及为每个图像-查询对分配多少 token，在极低的视觉 token 预算下仍能保持大部分下游任务性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 RUTA，一种基于率-效用优化的视觉 token 分配方法，在视觉语言模型（VLM）进入大语言模型之前压缩视觉 token。它联合学习保留哪些 token 以及每个图像-查询对分配多少 token，用可微的 Bernoulli 门估计 token 数量，并以带惩罚的率-效用目标优化。在五个基准上平均，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 分别只用 2.0% 和 4.2% 的视觉 token 就保留了 88.2% 和 94.4% 的任务性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 高分辨率图像和长视频产生长视觉 token 序列，导致大语言模型端的计算和内存成本高昂；现有视觉 token 缩减器多使用固定比率或方法特定的阈值，缺乏统一的原则性分配机制。
summary_sections.method: RUTA 在进入 LLM 前进行 token 缩减：构造查询条件化的候选 token，并为每个候选预测保留概率；训练时这些概率参数化独立的 Bernoulli 门，其总和作为每对图像-查询 token 数的可微估计。保留的 token 作为锚点，根据语义亲和度与空间邻近性聚合未保留 token 的信息，并用惩罚的率-效用目标在任务损失和期望 token 使用之间取得平衡。
summary_sections.result: 在五个基准上相对于各骨干网络的完整 token 基线，RUTA 在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上仅使用 2.0% 的视觉 token 即保留 88.2% 的任务性能，在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上仅使用 4.2% 的视觉 token 即保留 94.4% 的任务性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，RUTA 以原则化的方式联合决定保留哪些 token 以及为每个图像-查询对分配多少 token，在极低的视觉 token 预算下仍能保持大部分下游任务性能。

papers.title: Radar4D-VLM: Proposal-Grounded Temporal 4D Radar Reasoning Across Frozen Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models for autonomous driving primarily rely on cameras and LiDAR, leaving 4D radar largely unexplored as a standalone perceptual modality despite its robustness to adverse visibility and direct measurement of radial velocity. We introduce Radar4D-VLM, a radar-only temporal vision-language model that reasons from ten consecutive 4D-radar point-cloud sweeps without camera or LiDAR input. Radar4D-VLM extracts geometrically grounded object proposals and organizes radar evidence into a compact hierarchy of object, scene, and kinematic tokens. A parameter-efficient projector maps these tokens into frozen language backbones, while auditable prediction heads jointly model object count, spatial distribution, motion state, collision risk, semantic category, and radial velocity. Radar4D-VLM combines proposal-grounded temporal object tokenization, global scene context, and explicit kinematic tokens within a unified frozen-backbone interface. On sequence-isolated K-Radar development validation, its Top-64 proposal recall reaches 98.13% at 4 m, exceeding fixed-lattice and uniform-random controls by 6.40 and 22.83 percentage points, respectively. We further evaluate 24 matched runs spanning eight frozen Qwen, Phi, Mistral, Llama, and Gemma backbones under an identical adaptation budget. The radar-token interface remains compatible across all five language-model families, while matched aligned, permuted, and no-language controls show sensor dependence but no stable direct-head gain from aligned language supervision. These results establish a reproducible foundation for radar-only multimodal scene and motion reasoning while separating interface compatibility from the benefit of language supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Radar4D-VLM，一个仅使用 4D 雷达点云的时序视觉语言模型，输入十次连续扫描，提取几何锚定的目标提议并组织成对象、场景与运动学 token 的紧凑层次，再通过参数高效投影器映射到冻结语言模型。在 K-Radar 序列隔离验证集上，Top-64 提议召回率达 98.13%（4m 阈值），并跨五个冻结语言模型家族（Qwen、Phi、Mistral、Llama、Gemma）验证了接口兼容性。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶视觉语言模型主要依赖相机和 LiDAR，4D 雷达作为独立感知模态几乎未被探索，尽管它对恶劣可见条件稳健且能直接测量径向速度。
Method: 构建 proposal-grounded 的时序对象 token 化，将雷达证据组织为对象、场景与运动学 token 的层次结构；使用参数高效投影器将这些 token 映射进冻结语言骨干，并设置可审计的预测头联合建模对象数量、空间分布、运动状态、碰撞风险、语义类别与径向速度。
Result: 在序列隔离的 K-Radar 开发验证集上，Top-64 提议召回率达到 98.13%（4m），分别超过固定格子（fixed-lattice）和均匀随机（uniform-random）控制 6.40 与 22.83 个百分点；在 24 组匹配实验中，雷达 token 接口与全部五个语言模型家族兼容，但对齐、置换和无语言控制表明存在传感器依赖，对齐的语言监督未带来稳定的直接头端增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果建立了仅雷达多模态场景与运动推理的可复现基础，并将接口兼容性与语言监督的实际收益区分开。

papers.title: Teaching Foundation Models to Read mmWave: Pose-Guided Kinematic Representation for Human Behavior Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents need to perceive human behavior in physical environments. Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides a privacy-friendly and contactless sensing modality, but radar observations are difficult to align with language. Existing radar-language methods often rely on synthetic data or lack explicit supervision for human body structure and motion. We present mmMind, a radar-language model that uses synchronized 3D pose as training-only supervision. A spatio-temporal radar encoder is pretrained to capture body configuration and motion dynamics, after which the pose head is removed so that inference requires radar alone. The learned radar representations are then aligned with an LLM for behavior captioning and spatio-temporal question answering. We also introduce mmMind-Bench, a real-world mmWave-language benchmark containing 17.9 hours of recordings from 23 participants across seven indoor environments. Experiments on captioning, question answering, and unseen-action generalization show that mmMind consistently outperforms existing radar-language baselines, while ablations confirm the importance of pose-guided pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mmMind，一种毫米波 (mmWave) 雷达-语言模型，以同步 3D 姿态作为仅训练期的监督信号。系统先预训练时空雷达编码器使其捕获人体姿态结构与运动动态，训练结束后移除姿态头，推理时只需雷达输入；随后将雷达表示与 LLM 对齐，用于行为描述与时空问答。作者同时发布真实世界基准 mmMind-Bench（23 名参与者、7 个室内环境、17.9 小时记录），实验显示 mmMind 在描述、问答与未见动作泛化上均优于现有雷达-语言基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体需要在物理环境中感知人类行为，毫米波雷达是一种隐私友好且非接触的感知模态，但雷达观测难以与语言对齐；现有雷达-语言方法常依赖合成数据，或缺少对人体结构和运动的显式监督。
Method: 提出 mmMind：先利用同步 3D 姿态作为训练期监督，预训练一个时空雷达编码器以捕捉身体配置 (body configuration) 和运动动态；预训练后移除姿态头，使推理阶段仅依赖雷达数据；随后将学习到的雷达表示与 LLM 对齐，以支持行为描述 (behavior captioning) 和时空问答 (spatio-temporal question answering)。
Result: 在行为描述、问答和未见动作泛化任务上，mmMind 一致优于现有雷达-语言基线；消融实验确认了姿态引导预训练 (pose-guided pretraining) 的重要性。所引入的 mmMind-Bench 包含 17.9 小时、23 名参与者、7 个室内环境的真实记录。
Conclusion: 摘要强调姿态引导预训练是雷达-语言对齐的关键，并说明 mmMind 在推理阶段无需姿态标注即可工作；验证范围限于室内真实场景的基准设置。

papers.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Video question answering requires models to ground language queries in visual evidence and, when necessary, reason over that evidence across time. Existing methods typically rely on long textual chain-of-thought rationales, even though many questions can be answered as soon as the relevant object, action, or frame is localized. We propose Dynamic Latent Reasoning (DyLaR), which first grounds a question in a short block of perception latents (continuous hidden states that encode query-relevant visual evidence), and then adaptively decides whether to append reasoning latents (continuous thoughts that reason over this evidence in latent space) before answering. DyLaR learns this behavior by grounding perception latents in verified visual evidence and distilling verified rationales into reasoning latents, followed by reinforcement learning that further refines when to reason. Across nine video benchmarks and four multimodal language model backbones, DyLaR improves average accuracy over same-backbone baselines while generating fewer than 20 tokens per query. On Qwen3-VL-4B, for example, DyLaR improves average accuracy over Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking from 54.0 to 58.2 while reducing response length from 1,220.7 to 18.5 tokens per query. Ablations further show that grounded perception latents, rationale-supervised reasoning latents, and adaptive routing each improve accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态潜在推理 (Dynamic Latent Reasoning, DyLaR)，用于视频问答与视频理解。DyLaR 先将问题 grounding 为一段较短的感知潜在表示 (perception latents)，再自适应决定是否在潜在空间中追加推理潜在表示 (reasoning latents)，之后才作答。在九个视频基准和四个多模态大模型底座上，DyLaR 相比同底座基线提升平均准确率，同时每个问题仅生成不到 20 个 token。
Motivation: 现有视频问答方法通常依赖冗长的文本思维链 (chain-of-thought) 推理，但许多问题在定位到相关物体、动作或帧之后即可回答。作者认为这种默认的长文本推理是低效的，需要一种按需推理的机制。
Method: DyLaR 先通过感知潜在表示编码与问题相关的视觉证据，再自适应路由来决定是否追加推理潜在表示；训练上结合三部分：将感知潜在表示 grounding 到已验证的视觉证据、将已验证的推理依据蒸馏进推理潜在表示，以及用强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 进一步优化何时触发推理。
Result: 在九个视频基准与四个多模态语言模型底座上，DyLaR 平均准确率优于同底座基线，且每个查询生成少于 20 个 token。以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为例，平均准确率从 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking 的 54.0 提升到 58.2，响应长度从每查询 1,220.7 token 降至 18.5 token。消融实验表明，grounding 的感知潜在表示、基于推理依据监督的推理潜在表示以及自适应路由均各自带来准确率提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将感知与推理分离并只在必要时进行潜在空间推理，可以在保持甚至提升视频问答准确率的同时大幅缩短输出长度；这种按需推理范式是有效的。

papers.title: Interpretable Fuzzy Inference for UAV Target Tracking Using Bounding-Box Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based guidance of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) toward unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) supports cooperative aerial--ground robotics, but reliable continuous yaw estimation from onboard vision remains challenging because of sensing uncertainty, limited computation, and the need for interpretable control. Existing deep-learning and geometric-reconstruction approaches often require large datasets, external localization, or complex modeling assumptions, reducing transparency and deployment suitability on resource-constrained platforms. We present an interpretable fuzzy-inference framework that generates continuous yaw commands from low-dimensional features extracted from YOLO boxes: target centroid location, area, and aspect ratio. No explicit geometric modeling is required. A Mamdani fuzzy system serves as an interpretable baseline using a shoulder--triangle--shoulder input partition. It is followed by a first-order Takagi--Sugeno model with three antecedent membership terms per input, whose parameters are derived from training-set quantiles, yielding a compact 27-rule structure. Evaluation uses 6{,}169 labeled samples from a VICON motion-capture environment. Across five randomized train--test splits, the Takagi--Sugeno model achieves a test-set mean absolute error of $0.140^\circ \pm 0.003^\circ$, a root mean squared error of $0.200^\circ \pm 0.008^\circ$, and a maximum absolute error of $1.254^\circ \pm 0.121^\circ$. Within-threshold accuracies are $99.676% \pm 0.270%$ for $\pm1^\circ$ and $100.000% \pm 0.000%$ for both $\pm3^\circ$ and $\pm5^\circ$. Directional consistency between image-plane horizontal displacement and predicted yaw sign reaches $90.254% \pm 0.612%$. These results show that the framework is transparent, data-efficient, computationally lightweight, and suitable for real-time vision-based UAV guidance toward mobile ground targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的模糊推理框架，用于无人机（UAV）基于视觉引导追踪无人地面车辆（UGV）。系统从 YOLO 检测框提取低维特征（目标中心位置、面积、长宽比），无需显式几何建模，即可生成连续偏航（yaw）指令。作者先以 Mamdani 模糊系统作为可解释基线，再提出参数由训练集分位数推导的一阶 Takagi–Sugeno 模型（27 条规则），在 VICON 动捕环境下 6,169 个标注样本上达到亚度级误差，并强调其透明性、数据高效性与轻量计算特性。
Motivation: 基于视觉的 UAV 对 UGV 引导中，可靠的连续偏航估计面临感知不确定性、有限计算资源和可解释性需求；现有深度学习与几何重建方法往往依赖大数据集、外部定位或复杂建模假设，透明性不足且难以部署到资源受限平台。
Method: 提出可解释的模糊推理框架：从 YOLO 框提取目标质心位置、面积和长宽比作为输入特征，不进行显式几何建模；以 Mamdani 模糊系统（肩-三角-肩输入划分）为基线，随后建立带三个前提隶属度项的一阶 Takagi–Sugeno 模型，参数由训练集分位数导出，形成紧凑的 27 条规则结构。
Result: 在 VICON 动捕环境采集的 6,169 个标注样本上，经 5 次随机训练/测试划分，Takagi–Sugeno 模型的测试集平均绝对误差为 0.140°±0.003°，均方根误差 0.200°±0.008°，最大绝对误差 1.254°±0.121°；±1° 阈值内精度 99.676%±0.270%，±3° 与 ±5° 阈值内精度均为 100.000%；图像平面水平位移与预测偏航符号的方向一致性为 90.254%±0.612%。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架透明、数据高效、计算量小，适合用于实时视觉引导 UAV 追踪移动地面目标。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释的模糊推理框架，用于无人机（UAV）基于视觉引导追踪无人地面车辆（UGV）。系统从 YOLO 检测框提取低维特征（目标中心位置、面积、长宽比），无需显式几何建模，即可生成连续偏航（yaw）指令。作者先以 Mamdani 模糊系统作为可解释基线，再提出参数由训练集分位数推导的一阶 Takagi–Sugeno 模型（27 条规则），在 VICON 动捕环境下 6,169 个标注样本上达到亚度级误差，并强调其透明性、数据高效性与轻量计算特性。
summary_sections.motivation: 基于视觉的 UAV 对 UGV 引导中，可靠的连续偏航估计面临感知不确定性、有限计算资源和可解释性需求；现有深度学习与几何重建方法往往依赖大数据集、外部定位或复杂建模假设，透明性不足且难以部署到资源受限平台。
summary_sections.method: 提出可解释的模糊推理框架：从 YOLO 框提取目标质心位置、面积和长宽比作为输入特征，不进行显式几何建模；以 Mamdani 模糊系统（肩-三角-肩输入划分）为基线，随后建立带三个前提隶属度项的一阶 Takagi–Sugeno 模型，参数由训练集分位数导出，形成紧凑的 27 条规则结构。
summary_sections.result: 在 VICON 动捕环境采集的 6,169 个标注样本上，经 5 次随机训练/测试划分，Takagi–Sugeno 模型的测试集平均绝对误差为 0.140°±0.003°，均方根误差 0.200°±0.008°，最大绝对误差 1.254°±0.121°；±1° 阈值内精度 99.676%±0.270%，±3° 与 ±5° 阈值内精度均为 100.000%；图像平面水平位移与预测偏航符号的方向一致性为 90.254%±0.612%。

papers.title: Out-Of-The-Loop Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization is a ubiquitous problem in science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions with cheaper lower-fidelity proxies available. Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MF-BO) is a principled approach to this problem, leveraging correlations across different fidelities when querying the objective. However, for many important MF-BO tasks, the true highest-fidelity function is prohibitively expensive to be part of the optimization loop. Nevertheless, practitioners often have gold standard data (observations of the highest-fidelity function) obtained from previous experiments that might provide information for the current task. For instance, in molecular optimization, chemists often pick the top-$k$ candidate molecules using various computer simulations, and later reveal their true objective function values. In this work, we demonstrate the suboptimality of standard MF-BO algorithms in the real-world scenarios above, even under ideal assumptions. Next, we mitigate this problem by incorporating historical high-fidelity data accompanied by task descriptors---which can be explicitly given or extracted from unstructured metadata. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods on synthetic functions, as well as real-world problems in chemistry and hyperparameter optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一种多保真贝叶斯优化 (multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization, MF-BO) 变体：真实最高保真函数因成本过高而不进入优化循环，但存在来自历史实验的金标准 (gold standard) 数据。作者先证明标准 MF-BO 算法在这种循环外场景下即使在理想假设下也是次优的，再提出将历史高保真数据与任务描述符 (task descriptors) 结合的方法，并在合成函数、化学分子优化和超参数优化任务上验证有效性。
Motivation: 许多 MF-BO 实际任务中最高保真目标函数过于昂贵，无法在优化循环内查询，但从业者往往握有既往实验得到的最高保真观测数据；作者指出标准 MF-BO 算法在这种现实场景下表现次优，因此需要新方法利用这类历史数据。
Method: 在标准 MF-BO 框架之外引入历史高保真数据及其对应的任务描述符；任务描述符可以显式给出，也可以从非结构化元数据中提取，用于对齐历史数据与当前任务，从而缓解最高保真函数不可查询造成的次优性。
Result: 摘要报告标准 MF-BO 在理想假设下仍会在该场景下次优；所提方法在合成函数、化学问题以及超参数优化等真实任务上均验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为将历史金标准数据与任务描述符纳入建模可以改善无法在循环内查询最高保真函数的 MF-BO 场景；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: GEB-Bench: Abstract Structures Told in Many Voices
papers.abstract_en: Can a model look at a river delta and a lightning bolt and see that they share a structure? We introduce GEB-Bench, a benchmark whose unit is an abstract structural motif--self-reference, a strange loop, a Mobius twist--in the spirit of Godel, Escher, Bach. Each motif is told in several voices: a natural scene whose composition is the structure, a folk story whose telling enacts it through a mechanically checkable form device, a mathematical theorem, and a programmatic skeleton; surface parameters are declared nuisance variables and never scored. Motifs, voices, and the structural changes between them form a small cross-modal category, and GEB-Bench's tasks are its questions. Evaluating twelve open and proprietary models, we find that abstraction failure is lawful. The central finding is a gap between recognition and cross-voice mapping: models identify a structure within one voice far better than they carry it across voices; every model pays this tax, and mapping strong enough to narrow it appears only at the frontier tier. Two patterns support it. Errors align more strongly with the designed formal geometry than with measured perceptual geometries, and frontier models from different vendors converge on the same wrong answers; and surface complexity taxes every model that reads structure, with capacity buying headroom rather than immunity. GEB-Bench is fully generative and released with its pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEB-Bench，一个以抽象结构主题（如自引用、奇怪循环、莫比乌斯扭曲）为单元的基准测试，每个主题以自然场景、民间故事、数学定理和程序骨架等多种“声音”呈现。评估十二个开放与专有模型后发现抽象失败具有规律性：模型在单声音内识别结构明显优于跨声音映射，且所有模型都承担这一代价。基准完全生成式，管道已发布。
Motivation: 现有模型对抽象结构的跨模态泛化能力缺乏系统性评测框架，该基准旨在探究模型能否在不同“声音”中识别并传递同一抽象结构，并揭示这种能力的失败模式。
Method: 构建 GEB-Bench，将表面参数声明为 nuisance variables 且不计分，通过结构变化在多种声音形式之间形成小规模跨模态类别，并据此设计任务。
Result: 摘要报告了识别与跨声音映射之间的差距：模型在单一声音内识别结构远好于跨声音携带结构；错误与设计的正式几何而非感知几何对齐，前沿模型趋于相同的错误答案，表面复杂度对所有模型造成负担。
Conclusion: 摘要强调抽象失败是有规律的，跨声音映射只有在前沿模型层级才能出现足够缩小差距的能力，容量带来余量而非免疫；基准完全生成式并发布。

papers.title: LoRetta: A Foundation Model and Extensive Dataset for Global-Scale Remote Sensing Dense Image Matching
papers.abstract_en: Dense image matching establishes pixel-wise correspondences and underpins broad applications in computer vision and photogrammetry. However, extending dense matching to global-scale remote sensing remains challenging because image pairs may differ in acquisition time, season, viewpoint, spatial resolution, and land-cover state. The resulting large geometric offsets, partial overlap, and intrinsically unmatchable regions make direct dense correspondence prediction unreliable and inefficient. We thus reformulate dense matching as localization-and-registration: first localizing the matchable overlap and affine geometry, then refining dense residuals within the aligned frame. Based on this formulation, we propose LoRetta, a foundation model coupling matchability-aware affine localization with guided dense registration. We also introduce LEVIR-GM, a global-scale multi-temporal optical matching benchmark with dataset-native matchability labels (103K aligned, 827K augmented pairs, six continents, five years, 0.5-1024 m resolution). We further establish a unified evaluation protocol for sparse, semi-dense, and dense matchers. On LEVIR-GM, LoRetta achieves an area under the curve (AUC) of 83.3%, outperforming the strongest baseline RoMa v2 by 1.6 points, with larger percentage of correct keypoints (PCK) gains of 6.5 and 8.2 points at 1 and 2 pixels, while reducing inference latency by 47.8%. Astronaut-to-satellite and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-to-satellite geolocalization experiments further demonstrate its transferability as a reusable geometric aligner.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 12 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence. Project page: https://siweiyu.com/work/loretta/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRetta，一个面向全球尺度遥感密集图像匹配 (dense image matching) 的基础模型，并将密集匹配重新表述为定位-配准 (localization-and-registration) 问题：先定位可匹配重叠区域与仿射几何，再在配准后的框架内细化密集残差。作者还引入了带原生可匹配性标签的全球多时相光学匹配基准 LEVIR-GM（103K 对齐对、827K 增强对，覆盖六大洲、五年、0.5–1024 m 分辨率），并建立统一的稀疏/半密集/密集匹配评估协议。在 LEVIR-GM 上 LoRetta 的 AUC 达 83.3%，超过最强基线 RoMa v2 1.6 点，1 像素和 2 像素的 PCK 分别提升 6.5 和 8.2 点，推理延迟降低 47.8%；宇航员-卫星和无人机-卫星地理定位实验显示其作为可复用几何对齐器的迁移能力。
Motivation: 将密集匹配推广到全球尺度遥感具有挑战性，因为图像对可能在采集时间、季节、视角、空间分辨率和地表覆盖状态上存在差异，导致大几何偏移、部分重叠和本质不可匹配区域，直接预测密集对应关系不可靠且低效。
Method: 将密集匹配重新表述为定位与配准两步：先定位可匹配的重叠区域和仿射几何，再在对齐的框架内细化密集残差；据此提出 LoRetta，将可匹配性感知的仿射定位 (matchability-aware affine localization) 与引导式密集配准 (guided dense registration) 耦合。同时构建 LEVIR-GM 基准并提出统一的稀疏、半密集、密集匹配评估协议。
Result: 在 LEVIR-GM 上，LoRetta 的 AUC 为 83.3%，比最强基线 RoMa v2 高 1.6 点；在 1 像素和 2 像素阈值下 PCK 分别提升 6.5 和 8.2 点，推理延迟降低 47.8%。宇航员-卫星与无人机-卫星地理定位实验进一步验证了其作为可复用几何对齐器的迁移能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将密集匹配重构为定位-配准并结合可匹配性标签的基准，可以可靠且高效地处理全球尺度、多时相遥感图像中的大几何偏移与不可匹配区域。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: FinPerMA: A Theory-Informed, Event-Grounded Personalized-Memory Benchmark for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as personalized assistants in high-stakes domains such as financial advising, yet it remains unclear whether they can maintain and update an individualized user model over long horizons. Existing personalized-memory benchmarks primarily test factual retention or rely on weakly constrained model-generated trajectories, leaving event-driven preference adaptation underexplored. We introduce FinPerMA, an event-grounded benchmark that evaluates personalized memory against frozen longitudinal investor trajectories. Its generation pipeline combines deterministic, theory-informed impact rules, controlled LLM narration, and automated quality screening; a Post-Shock checkpoint isolates whether an agent has integrated a material event into its persistent user model. On 2,994 questions from 276 personas, seven frontier LLMs and up to seven memory configurations remain far from saturated: no full-context configuration exceeds approximately 0.47 overall accuracy or approximately 39% on multiple-choice questions. Attribution analysis shows that summary-based memory often preserves factual details while losing the preference signals needed for personalization; simple retrieval can therefore outperform purpose-built memory systems, with the gap widening after shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinPerMA，一个基于事件驱动（event-grounded）的个性化记忆基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体在金融咨询等高风险场景中长期维护并更新用户模型的能力。基准生成流程结合确定性的理论驱动影响规则、受控的 LLM 叙述和自动化质量筛查，并设置 Post-Shock 检查点以判断智能体是否将重大事件整合进持久用户模型。在 2,994 个问题、276 个 persona 上，七个前沿 LLM 与最多七种记忆配置均远未饱和：全上下文配置的总体准确率不超过约 0.47，多项选择题约 39%。
Motivation: 现有个性化记忆基准主要测试事实保留或依赖约束较弱的模型生成轨迹，事件驱动的偏好适应仍未得到充分探索；而 LLM 智能体需要在长时间跨度内维护和更新个性化用户模型，这一能力在高风险金融咨询场景中尚无系统评估。
Method: 构建 FinPerMA 基准，生成流程由三部分组成：确定性的、基于理论的影响规则，受控的 LLM 叙述，以及自动化质量筛查；并通过 Post-Shock 检查点将重大事件是否被整合进持久用户模型这一能力单独隔离出来进行评测。
Result: 在 2,994 个问题和 276 个 persona 上，七个前沿 LLM 与最多七种记忆配置均未饱和，任何全上下文配置的总体准确率不超过约 0.47，多项选择题准确率约 39%。归因分析显示，基于摘要的记忆常保留事实细节但丢失个性化所需的偏好信号，简单检索反而能优于专门构建的记忆系统，且这一差距在事件冲击后进一步扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前 LLM 智能体在事件驱动的偏好适应上明显不足，专门设计的摘要式记忆可能在个性化信号上存在损失，简单检索可作为更强的基线，为后续个性化记忆机制设计提供方向。

summary_sections.method: 构建 FinPerMA 基准，生成流程由三部分组成：确定性的、基于理论的影响规则，受控的 LLM 叙述，以及自动化质量筛查；并通过 Post-Shock 检查点将重大事件是否被整合进持久用户模型这一能力单独隔离出来进行评测。
summary_sections.result: 在 2,994 个问题和 276 个 persona 上，七个前沿 LLM 与最多七种记忆配置均未饱和，任何全上下文配置的总体准确率不超过约 0.47，多项选择题准确率约 39%。归因分析显示，基于摘要的记忆常保留事实细节但丢失个性化所需的偏好信号，简单检索反而能优于专门构建的记忆系统，且这一差距在事件冲击后进一步扩大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调当前 LLM 智能体在事件驱动的偏好适应上明显不足，专门设计的摘要式记忆可能在个性化信号上存在损失，简单检索可作为更强的基线，为后续个性化记忆机制设计提供方向。

papers.title: SpecDrop: Parameter-Free Category-Conditioned Routing for Modular Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks pursue specialization through learned routers, gates, and load-balancing losses, yet at matched total-parameter budgets learned routers can underperform equal-weight No-Routing baselines. Is the bottleneck the routing algorithm, or the alignment between training-signal granularity and the target categories? We probe the question with SpecDrop, a fixed parameter-free routing scheme: each of $K$ branches receives weight $p_a$ for its assigned category and a small leakage $p_i > 0$ otherwise, merged through a category-independent fixed denominator, with no learned routing parameters and no auxiliary losses; the category label is required at inference. On vision tasks where each image has one superclass label (CIFAR-100 on ResNet-110; ImageNet-1K on ViT-S/16), SpecDrop reaches 79.23% on CIFAR-100 and 79.89% on ImageNet-1K, exceeding parameter-matched baselines that do not use the label (+4.75 over dense on CIFAR-100; +6.53 over the No-Routing+SE control on ImageNet-1K). These gains quantify what category supervision buys when deployed through routing -- not an advantage over label-aware deployments of the baselines: given the same label, masking a dense model's outputs is stronger for accuracy alone (85.2 / 83.7). SpecDrop's contribution is converting the label into trained-in modular structure: 58%/100% branch-category alignment, and masking gains of 0.00 (CIFAR) / +1.06 (ImageNet) -- the output-space restriction is largely internalized during training. On fuzzy partitions, where training units span multiple categories (SlimPajama-6B language modeling with a 30M Transformer; SuperNI instruction tuning over Llama-3.2-1B with LoRA), the routing mechanism reduces to the matched No-Routing controls within seed noise, the null our thesis predicts. Granularity alignment, not algorithm choice, localizes when routing helps. Code: https://github.com/Beryex/SpecDrop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecDrop，一种参数无关的类别条件固定路由方案：每个分支对其指定类别获得权重 p_a，对其他类别保留小泄漏 p_i，通过与类别无关的固定分母合并，无学习路由参数、无辅助损失，推理时要求提供类别标签。在 CIFAR-100/ResNet-110 与 ImageNet-1K/ViT-S/16 上，它超过参数匹配但不使用标签的基线；而在模糊划分的语言任务上，其表现与 No-Routing 对照在种子噪声内持平。作者把收益归因于训练信号粒度与目标类别的对齐，而非路由算法本身。
Motivation: 在总参数预算相同时，带学习路由的 MoE 可能不如等权 No-Routing 基线，作者想判断瓶颈究竟是路由算法，还是训练信号粒度与目标类别之间的对齐。
Method: SpecDrop 是一种固定、参数无关的路由机制：K 个分支中各分支对其指定类别接收 p_a 权重、对其余类别接收小泄漏 p_i，经类别无关的固定分母合并；不使用学习路由参数或辅助损失，但推理时需要类别标签。
Result: SpecDrop 在 CIFAR-100 上达到 79.23%，在 ImageNet-1K 上达到 79.89%，相对不使用标签的参数匹配基线分别提升 +4.75（对比 dense）和 +6.53（对比 No-Routing+SE）；分支-类别对齐为 58%/100%，掩码增益为 0.00（CIFAR）与 +1.06（ImageNet）。在模糊划分的 SlimPajama 语言建模和 SuperNI 指令微调中，路由退化为与 No-Routing 对照在种子噪声内无异。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是粒度对齐而非算法选择决定了路由何时有效；给定相同标签时，直接掩码 dense 模型输出在纯准确率上更强（85.2/83.7），SpecDrop 的贡献在于把标签转化为训练进模块结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinProBench: Evaluating Financial AI Agents with Role-Grounded Rubrics Derived from Professional Deliverables
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating financial AI agents requires criteria aligned with real professional work. Existing rubric methods typically derive criteria from task prompts or model outputs, overlooking tacit standards visible only in practitioner deliverables. We introduce FinProBench, a benchmark for professional financial tasks, and Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC), a reusable pipeline that derives rubrics from deliverables produced by practitioners in the same role. RGRC comprises four stages: Deliverable Collection, Competency Extraction, Rubric Synthesis, and Validation. Its rubrics capture tacit standards, distinguish quality levels, and transfer across tasks within a role. Before analysis, we classified 57 occupations by deliverable genre into 30 prior-rich conventional roles and 27 prior-sparse role-specialized roles. Across all roles, Prompt-only nearly matches RGRC for conventional roles (89.2% vs. 90.7%), but RGRC substantially outperforms it for role-specialized roles (99.1% vs. 78.0%). This split indicates that prompt engineering can approximate rubrics when conventions are well represented in model priors, while professional grounding is essential for standards beyond those priors. FinProBench is built from 1,723 curated deliverables spanning 57 occupations, 8 financial sub-industries, and 161 deliverable types, and releases an initial evaluation set of 20 complete tasks covering 20 roles in 7 sub-industries. With heterogeneous LLM judges and role-level rubrics, human deliverables rank first on average (73.7 vs. 70.3, 70.2, and 69.6 out of 100), while all four systems show overlapping 95% confidence intervals and complementary strengths. Reusing rubrics at the role level reduces estimated per-task construction effort by 6.7 times relative to authoring each rubric from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinProBench，一个面向专业金融任务的基准，并提出 Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC) 可复用流程，从相同岗位从业者制作的交付物中派生评分标准。RGRC 的评分能捕捉隐性标准并区分质量水平，在角色专门任务上显著优于仅用提示工程的方法，同时通过角色级复用将每个任务的建设成本降低约 6.7 倍。
Motivation: 现有评分方法通常从任务提示或模型输出中派生标准，忽略了从业者交付物中才可见的隐性专业标准，难以与真实金融专业工作对齐。
Method: RGRC 包含交付物收集、能力提取、评分合成和验证四个阶段。作者将 57 个职业按交付物类型划分为 30 个先验丰富的常规角色和 27 个先验稀疏的角色专门角色，并构建了覆盖 57 个职业、8 个金融子行业、161 种交付物类型的 FinProBench，初始评估集含 20 个完整任务。
Result: 在常规角色上，Prompt-only 与 RGRC 几乎持平（89.2% 对 90.7%），但在角色专门角色上 RGRC 显著更优（99.1% 对 78.0%）。使用异构 LLM 裁判和角色级评分时，人类交付物平均排名第一（73.7 对 70.3、70.2、69.6，满分 100），但四个系统的 95% 置信区间相互重叠且各具优势。
Conclusion: 当专业惯例已充分体现在模型先验中时，提示工程可以近似评分；但对于超出先验的标准，基于专业交付物的评分构建至关重要。角色级评分复用可将单任务的构建工作量估算降低约 6.7 倍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Transformer for Traffic Intelligence in Edge Computing
papers.abstract_en: Accurate traffic forecasting is essential for proactive resource management in edge computing, where service demand evolves dynamically across both space and time. In practical cellular edge systems, traffic exhibits strong spatial correlations among neighboring service regions and long-range temporal dependencies driven by user mobility and application behavior. Existing recurrent forecasting approaches can capture short-term dynamics but often struggle to model long-horizon traffic evolution under non-stationary conditions. To address this challenge, we propose a spatiotemporal graph Transformer framework that jointly models spatial interactions and temporal dependencies for traffic forecasting in edge computing. The framework employs graph neural networks to capture spatial correlations among service regions and leverages Transformer-based self-attention to learn long-range temporal patterns from historical traffic observations. By decoupling spatial representation learning from temporal reasoning, the proposed approach provides an effective mechanism for large-scale spatiotemporal traffic modeling. Extensive experiments on a real-world cellular network dataset demonstrate that the proposed graph Transformer consistently outperforms recurrent graph-based baselines, including GCN-RNN, GCN-LSTM, and GCN-GRU models, across multiple forecasting horizons. The resulting forecasts enable more effective proactive resource provisioning and reduce overload risk compared with reactive management strategies. These results highlight the potential of graph-enhanced attention mechanisms for building intelligent and adaptive edge computing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向边缘计算中的流量预测问题，提出一种时空图 Transformer 框架，将图神经网络用于空间相关性建模、Transformer 自注意力用于长程时间依赖学习，并显式解耦空间表示与时间推理。在真实蜂窝网络数据集上的实验表明，该模型在多个预测时域上 consistently 优于 GCN-RNN、GCN-LSTM 和 GCN-GRU 等循环图基线，其预测可支持更主动的资源预留并降低过载风险。
Motivation: 边缘计算中服务需求在空间和时间上动态演化，现有循环预测方法能捕捉短期动态，但在非平稳条件下难以建模长时域流量演化。
Method: 提出时空图 Transformer 框架：用图神经网络建模服务区域间的空间相关，用基于 Transformer 的自注意力从历史观测中学习长程时间模式，并将空间表示学习与时间推理解耦以支持大规模建模。
Result: 在真实蜂窝网络数据集上，所提图 Transformer 在多个预测时域上一致优于 GCN-RNN、GCN-LSTM 和 GCN-GRU 基线；相比反应式管理，生成的预测支持更有效的主动资源预留并降低过载风险。
Conclusion: 摘要强调图增强注意力机制在构建智能自适应边缘计算系统中的潜力，并指出解耦式时空建模是提升长时域流量预测的有效机制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Spend Bits Where Queries Look: KV Cache Vector Quantization with Attention-Preserving Transforms
papers.abstract_en: Long-context LLM decoding reads the key-value (KV) cache at every step. Loading it takes longer than computing attention over it, so throughput is bandwidth-bound. Hence, reducing the cache size can raise both decoding speed and serving capacity. The challenge is to reduce cache size while preserving the attention products, keeping reconstruction cheap, and using a fixed per-token bit count. At two bits per element, the most competitive methods rely on orthogonal transforms. However, existing techniques are either data-oblivious or use the query statistics without deriving the transform from a distortion criterion. Moreover, they rely on transforms built on top of random or Hadamard rotations, which equalize variances across entries rather than compacting energy, and fixed-width scalar quantizers, which are suboptimal at low rates. In this paper, we formulate KV cache quantization as a transform coding problem in which distortion is the error in the attention products. We derive closed-form optimal transforms for keys and values from calibration statistics, under a high-resolution model. We show that the optimal key transform is not orthogonal and satisfies a generalized Parseval relation: the attention-aware distortion becomes mean-squared error (MSE) in the transform domain. Thus, we can use MSE-optimal vector quantizers applied directly to the transformed key coefficients. To meet the fixed-width layout requirement, we show that grouping coefficients into equal-volume partitions makes equal-size codebooks attain the variable-rate optimum under the same high-resolution model. At two bits per element, our method, termed NOVA-KV, recovers most of the long-context retrieval accuracy lost by scalar quantization methods at comparable throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把长上下文 LLM 解码中的 KV cache 量化建模为以注意力乘积误差为失真的变换编码问题，并从校准统计量出发在高分辨率模型下推导出键和值的闭式最优变换。作者证明最优键变换是非正交的且满足广义 Parseval 关系，使注意力感知失真等价于变换域的均方误差，从而可直接使用 MSE 最优的向量量化器；将系数按等体积分区分组后，定宽码本可以达到变速率最优。所提方法 NOVA-KV 在每元素 2 bit 下恢复了标量量化方法在相近吞吐量下损失的大部分长上下文检索准确率。
Motivation: 长上下文解码每一步都要读取 KV cache，加载缓存的时间超过计算注意力的时间，因而吞吐量受带宽限制；缩小缓存尺寸能同时提升解码速度和 serving 容量，难点在于保持注意力乘积、降低重建成本并保持固定的每 token 比特数。
Method: 将 KV cache 量化表述为以注意力乘积误差为失真的变换编码问题，基于校准统计量在高分辨率模型下推导键和值的闭式最优变换；该非正交键变换满足广义 Parseval 关系，使失真等价于变换域 MSE，进而对变换后的键系数直接应用 MSE 最优向量量化器。为满足定宽布局，将系数划分为等体积分区，使得等大小码本在相同高分辨率模型下达到变速率最优。
Result: 在每元素 2 bit 下，NOVA-KV 以相近吞吐量恢复了标量量化方法所损失的大部分长上下文检索准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从失真准则出发推导变换可得到注意力感知的 KV cache 量化方案，并能在固定比特数下保持检索性能；摘要未明确讨论局限性或更广泛的任务表现。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 将 KV cache 量化表述为以注意力乘积误差为失真的变换编码问题，基于校准统计量在高分辨率模型下推导键和值的闭式最优变换；该非正交键变换满足广义 Parseval 关系，使失真等价于变换域 MSE，进而对变换后的键系数直接应用 MSE 最优向量量化器。为满足定宽布局，将系数划分为等体积分区，使得等大小码本在相同高分辨率模型下达到变速率最优。
summary_sections.result: 在每元素 2 bit 下，NOVA-KV 以相近吞吐量恢复了标量量化方法所损失的大部分长上下文检索准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调从失真准则出发推导变换可得到注意力感知的 KV cache 量化方案，并能在固定比特数下保持检索性能；摘要未明确讨论局限性或更广泛的任务表现。

papers.title: FBID: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Robust Out-of-Distribution Attack Detection in IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) has emerged as a promising solution for intrusion detection in heterogeneous IoT environments, as it can improve local adaptation under highly Non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) data distributions. However, existing PFL methods often rely on client-side self-adjustment, which may lead to over-personalization and substantial degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) attack detection. In this paper, we propose Federated Bandit Intrusion Detection (FBID), a novel adaptive PFL framework to address this limitation through server-side personalization control. In particular, FBID employs a contextual multi-armed bandit at the server to dynamically regulate each client's local training intensity according to its observed behavior and update quality. Moreover, FBID introduces a trust-based blending mechanism to derive client-specific interpolation coefficients between the global and local models, thereby preserving global attack-detection knowledge while still allowing beneficial local specialization. Through extensive experiments on the CICIoT2023 dataset under heterogeneous client distributions and OOD stress-test settings, we show that FBID improves individual client OOD Detection Rate (DR) by up to 7.66% and F1-Score (F1) by up to 5.08% (relative) over the strongest stable baseline, while also improving robustness to previously unseen attack classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向异构IoT入侵检测的自适应个性化联邦学习框架FBID，针对现有PFL方法因客户端自我调整导致过个性化、OOD攻击检测性能下降的问题，在服务端引入contextual multi-armed bandit动态调节每个客户端的本地训练强度，并采用基于信任的混合机制生成客户端特定的全局/本地模型插值系数。在CICIoT2023数据集上的实验表明，与最强稳定基线相比，FBID将个体客户端OOD检测率(DR)相对提升最多7.66%，F1分数相对提升最多5.08%，并增强了对未见攻击类别的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有PFL入侵检测方法高度依赖客户端侧自调整，在非IID异构IoT环境下容易过度个性化，导致对分布外(OOD)攻击的检测性能明显下降；需要服务端可控的个性化机制来平衡全局知识与本地适应。
Method: FBID在服务端使用上下文多臂老虎机(contextual multi-armed bandit)根据客户端观察到的行为和更新质量动态调节其本地训练强度；同时引入基于信任的混合机制(trust-based blending)，为每个客户端推导全局模型与本地模型之间的插值系数，保留全局攻击检测知识同时允许有益的本地特化。
Result: 在CICIoT2023数据集、异构客户端分布和OOD压力测试设置下，FBID相比最强稳定基线将个体客户端OOD检测率(DR)相对提升最多7.66%，F1分数相对提升最多5.08%，并改善了对未见攻击类别的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为服务端个性化控制与基于信任的模型混合可缓解PFL的过个性化问题，提升IoT入侵检测对OOD攻击的鲁棒性；摘要未提及跨数据集泛化或训练开销等局限性。

papers.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Table-to-Multimodal Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatically generating professional multimodal reports comprising both textual analysis and visual charts from structured tabular data is a critical challenge in data intelligence. Existing methods suffer from fixed linear pipelines and isolated subtask processing, which hinder joint optimization of factual accuracy, visual quality, and narrative coherence. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCTS-Report, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-driven framework that formulates multimodal table-to-report generation as a progressive construction process over a structured search space. The core idea is to decompose report generation into atomic actions, including chapter planning, visualization task identification, chart generation, insight organization, and narrative refinement, each executed by an LLM based on dynamic reasoning conditioned on the current report state. We use an LLM to generate step-by-step reasoning and actions during MCTS, storing the reasoning trajectory in each node for context-aware, coherent report construction. To guide the search, we design a multi-dimensional reward function that jointly evaluates numerical fact consistency (via SQL), chart quality, chart-text alignment, and structural completeness, while incorporating a diversity penalty to suppress repeated charts and a precondition check to prune invalid actions. We also construct MMRBench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising real-world tables from six domains, paired with expert-refined reference report structures and verifiable key insights. Experiments on MMRBench demonstrate that MCTS-Report significantly outperforms strong baselines across structural completeness, numerical accuracy, chart-text alignment, and insight novelty, achieving a 77.9 overall score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MCTS-Report，一个基于蒙特卡洛树搜索 (Monte Carlo Tree Search, MCTS) 的框架，用于从结构化表格数据自动生成包含文本分析与可视化图表的专业多模态报告。该方法将报告生成拆解为原子动作序列，由 LLM 在搜索过程中逐步推理并执行，并设计了多维奖励函数来联合优化数值事实一致性、图表质量、图文对齐与结构完整性。作者还构建了 MMRBench 基准，实验表明该方法在多项指标上显著优于强基线，总体得分为 77.9。
Motivation: 现有表格到多模态报告的生成方法依赖固定线性流水线，且将各子任务孤立处理，难以对事实准确性、视觉质量与叙事连贯性进行联合优化。
Method: 提出 MCTS-Report 框架，将多模态报告生成建模为结构化搜索空间上的渐进式构建过程；将生成分解为章节规划、可视化任务识别、图表生成、洞察组织与叙事精炼等原子动作，每个动作由 LLM 基于当前报告状态动态推理执行，并在 MCTS 节点中保存推理轨迹以保证上下文感知的连贯构建。搜索由多维奖励函数引导，包括基于 SQL 的数字事实一致性、图表质量、图文对齐、结构完整性，并加入多样性惩罚与前置条件检查以抑制重复图表和剪除无效动作；同时构建包含六个领域真实表格及专家精炼参考结构的 MMRBench 基准。
Result: 在 MMRBench 上的实验表明，MCTS-Report 在结构完整性、数值准确性、图文对齐与洞察新颖性上均显著优于强基线，取得 77.9 的总体得分。
Conclusion: 作者认为以 MCTS 驱动的渐进式搜索框架可以有效实现报告生成中多个目标的联合优化，并为该任务提供了可验证的基准与参考结构。摘要未明确提及方法在推理成本或跨领域泛化方面的局限。

papers.title: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: How do you verify a long-horizon agent when its own state and self-reports are exactly what you cannot trust? We present an agent instrument built so that verification is structural rather than post-hoc. A deterministic Executive owns all belief; a language model may only file typed proposals, and a claim is admitted only when a prediction pre-registered before acting is matched against observation by code. Two properties make the instrument a verifier of its own science, not just of the agent: every run invalidates itself when per-organ write-error, render-size, or salted-canary-echo floors are breached (four of the first eight architecture runs were invalidated, each localizing a real defect); and a render-invisible shadow reference compiles the plan the full system would have committed in every ablation cell, so drift metrics are defined even where the mechanism under test has been removed. Using this instrument we report a clean, single-variable result on a failure every long-horizon agent suffers: ablating the commitment mechanism flips goal-abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error stays flat at 0.00 (three seeds per cell, up to 394 reference beats per run, every run gated valid). The binding channel, by contrast, does not reappear as per-beat drift when its repair is ablated -- because binding is code-owned, the failure class is structurally absorbed, its only residue appearing one layer upstream as a collapse in hypothesis formation. We report these under full disclosure that task efficacy is null (zero level completions across 52 gated runs on ARC-AGI-3), pre-registered as a structural defeater. The contribution is a verification methodology for agent development and the drift decomposition it makes measurable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长周期智能体 (long-horizon agent) 的自验证问题，提出一种结构化验证的智能体仪器：确定性执行器 (Executive) 拥有全部信念，语言模型只能提交类型化提案，声明仅在行动前预注册的预测被代码与观察匹配后才被接受。作者用该仪器做了单变量消融实验，发现移除承诺机制 (commitment mechanism) 会使目标放弃率从 0.00 翻转为 1.00，而绑定误差 (binding error) 保持 0.00；同时任务效能为零 (ARC-AGI-3 上 52 次门控运行零完成)。
Motivation: 在智能体自身状态和自我报告不可信时，如何验证长周期智能体是一个核心问题；作者认为验证应当是结构性的而非事后 (post-hoc) 的。
Method: 构建一个智能体仪器：确定性 Executive 拥有全部信念，LLM 只能提交类型化提案，声明的准入由预先注册的预测与代码观测匹配决定；通过每组织写错误、渲染尺寸、带盐金丝雀回显 (salted-canary-echo) 下限使无效运行自我失效，并用渲染不可见的影子参考 (render-invisible shadow reference) 在消融单元中编译完整系统本应提交的计划，从而在机制被移除时仍可定义漂移度量。
Result: 前八次架构运行中有四次被判定无效，且每次均定位到真实缺陷；消融承诺机制使目标放弃从 0.00 翻转为 1.00，而绑定误差保持 0.00；消融绑定修复后，绑定通道不会以逐拍漂移形式重现，其残差出现在上游的假设形成崩溃中。摘要同时披露任务效能为零 (ARC-AGI-3 上 52 次门控运行零完成)，并将其预先注册为结构性挫败条件 (structural defeater)。
Conclusion: 本文的贡献是智能体开发的验证方法论，以及可测量的漂移分解 (drift decomposition)；作者强调绑定由代码持有，因此该类失败被结构性吸收。
Relevance: 2
