papers.title: An Inline Control Architecture for Language Models in Intelligent Transportation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) systems increasingly incorporate large language models (LLMs) for semantic tasks such as message summarization, operator assistance, and decision support at roadside units and edge nodes. Although these components are not part of safety-critical control loops, they introduce prompt-level attack surfaces that are not addressed by traditional V2X security mechanisms focused on authentication and message integrity. This paper presents Guarded-V2X, an inline semantic guardrail architecture for securing LLM-enabled V2X services under real-time constraints. The proposed system integrates rule-based ingress filtering, a lightweight safety classifier, policy-constrained structured generation, trusted-only retrieval, and post-decision adjudication to enforce machine-checkable safety boundaries prior to downstream execution. Guarded-V2X is evaluated using a four-stage experimental pipeline encompassing intrusion vulnerability analysis, calibration and latency benchmarking, guardrail validation, and robustness under adversarial stress. Experiments are conducted on a V2X-aligned simulated dataset derived from RSU advisories, operator messages, and annotated V2X message summaries. Results show that unguarded and prompt-only baselines retain residual vulnerability under multi-turn adversarial trials, while Guarded-V2X consistently reduces intrusion acceptance success rates and eliminates observed unsafe completions in two-turn settings, without exceeding latency budgets for V2X semantic advisory paths.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guarded-V2X，一种用于智能交通系统中 LLM 服务的内联语义护栏架构。该架构结合规则型入口过滤、轻量级安全分类器、策略约束的结构化生成、仅可信检索与事后裁决，在下游执行前强制执行机器可检查的安全边界。在基于 RSU 建议和 V2X 消息摘要的模拟数据集上评估，结果显示相比无护栏与仅提示基线，Guarded-V2X 持续降低入侵接受成功率，并在两轮设置中消除不安全完成，同时满足 V2X 语义咨询路径的延迟预算。
Motivation: V2X 系统越来越普遍地集成 LLM 用于消息摘要、操作员辅助和决策支持等语义任务，但传统 V2X 安全机制仅关注认证和消息完整性，未覆盖提示级攻击面。尽管这些组件不在安全关键控制回路中，它们仍引入了新的攻击途径。
Method: 提出 Guarded-V2X 内联语义护栏架构，集成规则型入口过滤、轻量级安全分类器、策略约束的结构化生成、仅可信检索以及事后裁决，以执行机器可检查的安全边界。评估采用四阶段实验流程，涵盖入侵漏洞分析、校准与延迟基准测试、护栏验证以及对抗压力下的鲁棒性测试。
Result: 在由 RSU 建议、操作员消息和带标注的 V2X 消息摘要构成的模拟数据集上，未加护栏和仅提示基线在多轮对抗试验中仍存在残余漏洞；Guarded-V2X 持续降低入侵接受成功率，并在两轮设置中消除了观察到的+不安全完成，且未超出 V2X 语义咨询路径的延迟预算。

papers.title: Advancing Utility Pole and Sign Detection Through Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Utility poles are an essential part of the infrastructure used to support power distribution systems and other critical public services. Their regular inspection is crucial to ensure the stability and safety of the electrical grid. A deep learning framework is presented for the automated detection, segmentation and lean angle estimation of wooden utility poles, and classification of attached electrical warning signs, using ground-level imagery. The system is trained on a custom dataset of 4,570 annotated images extracted from Google Street View, featuring challenging real-world scenes with visually ambiguous wooden poles lacking distinctive features. The proposed model is based on the Detection Transformer (DETR), suitably modified and trained on the custom dataset. The model outperforms standard object detectors (RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, YOLOv3-Tiny), achieving a mean average precision of 90.43% for pole detection and 88.26% for sign detection. Extending this model with a segmentation head enables per-instance mask generation, which is then used to estimate pole lean angle. The model accurately estimates lean for 1,367 out of 1,433 test-set poles, with a mean absolute error of 1.01 degrees. Moreover, the custom dataset created in this work is also made publicly available to be used as a benchmark.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 36th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2025), BMVA, Paper 976, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Detection Transformer (DETR) 的深度学习框架，用于从地面图像中自动检测、分割木制电线杆，估计其倾斜角度，并对附着电气警示标志进行分类。模型在自定义的 4,570 张 Google Street View 标注图像上训练，电线杆检测 mAP 达 90.43%，标志检测 mAP 达 88.26%，倾斜角度估计的平均绝对误差为 1.01 度，同时公开了该数据集作为基准。
Motivation: 电线杆是电力分配系统等关键基础设施的组成部分，其定期巡检对电网安全和稳定至关重要。现有通用目标检测器在视觉特征模糊、缺乏明显纹理的木制电线杆场景下检测效果有限，且缺乏针对倾斜角度估计和标志分类的专用方案。
Method: 提出基于 DETR 的检测模型，并针对自定义街景数据集进行修改和训练；通过扩展分割头实现逐实例掩码生成，再利用掩码估计电线杆的倾斜角度。
Result: 在自定义数据集上，该方法在电线杆检测和标志检测上分别取得 90.43% 和 88.26% 的 mAP，优于 RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN 和 YOLOv3-Tiny；在 1,433 根测试杆中准确估计了 1,367 根的倾斜角度，MAE 为 1.01 度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法能在具有挑战性的真实街景图像上可靠地完成电线杆检测、分割、倾斜估计与标志分类，并指出所构建的数据集已公开可用，可作为后续基准。

papers.title: SJEPA: Learning Elegant Latent Dynamics with Hybrid Symbolic-Neural Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn abstract states by predicting target embeddings from context embeddings, but their transition models are typically opaque neural maps. We introduce SJEPA, a reconstruction-free JEPA framework that learns predictive representations whose induced dynamics admit compact symbolic descriptions. Its hybrid transition combines a symbolic law with a regularised neural correction for dynamics outside the selected grammar. The central principle is to learn the simplest adequate dynamics: representation constraints preserve informative, non-collapsed predictive coordinates, while operator compression favours low-complexity symbolic-neural transitions that remain predictively adequate. We formalise this principle through induced-dynamics complexity, analyse predictive-coordinate non-identifiability, and show that unconstrained operator compression creates a direct shortcut to representation collapse. The framework supports both alternating representation-equation learning and symbolic dynamics fitted to fixed representations. In controlled pendulum experiments, joint learning discovers substantially simpler symbolic dynamics with lower long-horizon rollout error and divergence than post-hoc fitting, while an unconstrained one-step diagnostic realises the predicted collapse shortcut. Under grammar misspecification, correction regularisation preserves the representable symbolic mechanism and directs the neural component towards residual dynamics. The results expose a controllable trade-off among predictive fidelity, representation quality, symbolic parsimony, and symbolic-neural allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SJEPA，一种免重建的 JEPA 框架，通过学习潜在动力学使诱导出来的状态转移具有紧凑的符号化描述。其混合转移模型由符号规律和经过正则化的神经修正项组成，并以诱导动力学复杂度为中心原则：在保持预测坐标不塌缩的同时，偏好低复杂度的符号-神经转移。受控摆锤实验中，联合学习相比事后拟合得到更简单的符号动力学和更低的长期 rollout 误差。
Motivation: 现有联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA) 的转移模型通常是不透明的神经映射，难以解释且缺乏简洁的动力学描述；同时无约束的算子压缩会直接导致表示塌缩的捷径。
Method: 提出混合符号-神经预测器，包含一个符号规律与一个正则化神经修正项；通过诱导动力学复杂度形式化“最简单充分动力学”原则，分析预测坐标的非可辨识性，并支持交替的表示-方程联合学习或对固定表示拟合符号动力学。
Result: 在摆锤实验中，联合学习相比事后拟合发现显著更简单的符号动力学，并具有更低的长期 rollout 误差与发散；无约束的一步诊断实验验证了预测的塌缩捷径。在语法误设下，修正正则化保留可表达的符号机制，并将神经组件导向残差动力学。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果展示了预测保真度、表示质量、符号简洁性与符号-神经分配之间可调控的权衡。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LaPrune: Controllable Differentiable Sparsity at Million Scale
papers.abstract_en: Top-$k$ selection determines which components of a sparse model remain active. Hard selection blocks gradients, while continuous relaxations often couple mask hardness to the selected mass. We introduce LaPrune, a mathematically exact-budget differentiable layer that controls the normalized second moment while preserving the selected mass. A LapSum barrier preserves the selection mass, and a normalized second-moment constraint moves the mask from a dense equal-mass allocation toward hard top-$k$ at each budget. We derive a population prediction of the saturated fraction, a near-binary limiting law, and a tight worst-case guarantee on the near-zero fraction. The normalized hardness parameter is invariant to score scale, while a fixed LapSum temperature is not.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaPrune，一种满足精确预算（exact budget）的可微稀疏化层，用于 top-k 选择。该层通过 LapSum 势垒保持被选质量，并用归一化二阶矩约束使掩码从稠密的等质量分配逐步趋于硬 top-k。作者推导了饱和比例的总体预测、近二值极限律以及近零比例的紧致最坏情况保证，并指出归一化硬度参数对分数尺度不变，而固定 LapSum 温度不具备该性质。
Motivation: 硬选择（hard selection）会阻断梯度，而连续松弛（continuous relaxation）通常会把掩码硬度与所选质量耦合，导致无法在保持预算的同时独立控制稀疏化的硬度。
Method: 引入 LaPrune 可微层，在保持选定质量的同时控制归一化二阶矩；利用 LapSum 势垒维持选择质量，并通过归一化二阶矩约束使分配从稠密等质量转向硬 top-k，每个预算下均可调节。
Result: 摘要报告推导了饱和比例的总体预测、近二值（near-binary）极限律，以及近零比例的紧致最坏情况保证；还证明归一化硬度参数对分数尺度不变，而固定 LapSum 温度则不然。
Conclusion: LaPrune 提供了一种数学上精确预算且可控硬度的可微稀疏化机制，其尺度不变性使其在实际使用中优于固定温度方案。

papers.title: Learning Sexism Detection Using Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: When people label text for sexism, they often disagree, and not because some of them are wrong: they genuinely perceive sexism differently. Most NLP systems discard this disagreement by collapsing it into a majority vote. We propose the Multi-Agent Perspectivist Preference Optimization (MAP-PO) framework to keep these different perspectives. On the EXIST 2024 dataset of labeled English and Spanish tweets, we first cluster annotators by their labeling behavior rather than their demographic attributes. We then fine-tune one Large Language Model agent per cluster to reproduce that cluster's annotation behavior, and coordinate the agents with preference optimization that combines individual and team-level rewards. We evaluate MAP-PO in four settings defined by two languages and two backbone language models, asking whether each agent reproduces the annotations of its own cluster and whether the agents together reproduce the majority label. Two findings hold in all four settings. First, without fine-tuning the agents behave almost identically, so cluster-specific training is necessary. Second, we show that training each agent only on the labels of its own cluster pushes the agents far beyond the clusters they should represent, while adding a shared team-level training signal consistently keeps each agent calibrated to its cluster.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 12 figures, 14 tables. Preprint; under review at EACL 2027 (ACL Rolling Review, August 2026 cycle). Code and data: https://github.com/mohammadi-hadi/MAP-PO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体视角偏好优化框架 MAP-PO，用于保留标注者在性别歧视检测中的不同视角，而不是用多数投票抹平分歧。基于 EXIST 2024 的英语和西班牙语推文数据，作者先按标注行为而非人口属性对标注者聚类，再为每个聚类微调一个 LLM 智能体，并用结合个体与团队奖励的偏好优化协调这些智能体。实验在两种语言和两种骨干语言模型的四种设置中验证每个智能体能否复现所属聚类的标注、以及整体能否复现多数标签。
Motivation: 不同标注者对文本是否构成性别歧视存在真实感知差异，但多数 NLP 系统通过多数投票丢弃这种分歧；论文针对这一信息丢失问题，主张保留并建模多种标注视角。
Method: 提出 MAP-PO 框架：先在 EXIST 2024 数据集上依据标注行为对标注者聚类，为每个聚类微调一个 LLM 智能体以复现该聚类的标注行为，再利用同时包含个体奖励和团队级奖励的偏好优化来协调多个智能体。
Result: 在两种语言与两种骨干模型组成的四种设置中，两个结论一致成立：未微调时各智能体行为几乎相同，说明聚类特定训练必不可少；仅用各自聚类标签训练会使智能体严重偏离其应代表的聚类，而加入共享的团队级训练信号能让每个智能体持续保持对其聚类的校准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，若要保留标注者的多元视角，既需要基于标注行为聚类的逐聚类微调，也需要团队级共享训练信号来防止智能体过度偏离其代表的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unifying quantum measurement constructions via a relative-entropy minimum change principle
papers.abstract_en: The minimum change principle provides an information-theoretic characterization of the Bayes reversal channel in classical probability theory and has recently been proposed as a framework for extending Bayes' rule to quantum information theory. Using quantum relative entropy, we investigate a minimum change principle for the setting of quantum statistical inference. Specifically, we consider a forward process based on a classical-to-quantum preparation channel and a reverse process based on a quantum-to-classical measurement channel. We establish a closed-form characterization of measurements that are optimal for this principle, and this optimal measurement can be found via a dual formulation involving a single unconstrained Hermitian variable. This perspective allows us to recover some notable measurements within the same framework, including pretty good measurements and Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements, and we use it to discover a novel family that we call softmin thermal measurements. We further show that softmin thermal measurements arise as optimal solutions to entropy-regularized semidefinite optimization problems, demonstrating that they play a role for measurements analogous to that of thermal states in statistical mechanics. Finally, we prove an additivity property for the relative-entropy minimum change principle and investigate the performance of Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements for quantum hypothesis testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在量子统计推断设定下研究最小变化原理 (minimum change principle) 的量子版本。作者以经典到量子的制备信道为前向过程、量子到经典的测量信道为反向过程，用量子相对熵 (quantum relative entropy) 刻画测量信道的最优性，并建立最优测量的闭式刻画，求解只需借助一个无约束厄米变量 (Hermitian variable) 的对偶形式。该框架统一恢复了不少著名测量族，包括 pretty good measurements 和 Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements，并催生新的 softmin thermal measurements 家族，最后证明该原理具有可加性 (additivity) 并分析 Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements 在量子假设检验中的表现。
Motivation: 经典概率论中的最小变化原理为 Bayes 逆向信道提供了信息论刻画，近期被提议作为把 Bayes 规则推广到量子信息论的框架；但该原理在量子统计推断情形下的具体形式以及何种测量最优仍缺少统一而清晰的刻画。
Method: 提出基于量子相对熵的最小变化原理，将前向过程设为经典到量子的制备信道、反向过程设为量子到经典的测量信道；通过包含单个无约束厄米变量的对偶问题得到最优测量的闭式解，并将该原理联系到熵正则化半定优化 (entropy-regularized semidefinite optimization)，从而发现新的测量族。
Result: 给出相对熵最小变化原理下最优测量的闭式刻画；从同一框架恢复 pretty good measurements 与 Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements，并发现新的 softmin thermal measurements 家族；证明该原理满足可加性，同时考察 Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements 在量子假设检验中的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 softmin thermal measurements 之于测量理论的角色可类比 thermal states 之于统计力学，并表明这一相对熵最小变化原理为多种量子测量构造提供了统一的信息论视角。摘要未对适用范围或局限做进一步说明。

papers.title: Modality Agreement- and Conflict-Aware Prototype Hypergraph Learning for Multimodal Intent Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal intent recognition requires understanding not only what textual, acoustic, and visual signals share, but also how they disagree. Such disagreement is frequently class-informative; for example, lexical positivity accompanied by incongruent vocal or facial behavior may indicate sarcasm or taunting, yet most fusion methods either encourage modality alignment or treat inconsistency as uncertainty to be suppressed. We propose MACH (Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph), a hierarchical prototype-hypergraph framework that represents multimodal agreement and conflict as distinct, recurring relational structures. MACH progressively composes unimodal representations into bimodal and trimodal abstractions. At each applicable level, modality-composition anchors activate sparse agreement prototype hypergraphs that capture reusable consensus patterns, while a separate conflict pathway maps cross-modal discrepancies to dedicated conflict prototype hypergraphs. The two pathways are combined through a feature-wise, sample-adaptive arbitration mechanism, enabling the model to preserve informative disagreement while suppressing incidental modality noise. A progressive optimization strategy stabilizes the interdependent hierarchy before joint agreement-conflict learning. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed formulation, while component and robustness analyses validate the distinct roles of hierarchical composition, prototype-mediated semantic refinement, and agreement-conflict arbitration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MACH（Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph），一种面向多模态意图识别 (multimodal intent understanding) 的分层原型超图框架。该框架把模态间的一致与冲突建模为不同的可复用关系结构，通过逐层组合单模态表示得到双模态和三模态抽象，并用样本自适应仲裁机制融合一致与冲突两条通路。实验在基准数据集上验证了该框架的有效性，并通过组件与鲁棒性分析确认了层次组合、原型介导语义细化和一致-冲突仲裁各自的贡献。
Motivation: 多模态意图识别不能只关注文本、声学和视觉信号共享的信息，模态间不一致往往携带类别信息（如词汇积极但声调或面部表情不一致可能表示讽刺）。现有融合方法要么鼓励模态对齐，要么把不一致当作需要抑制的不确定性，缺少对模态冲突的显式建模。
Method: 提出 MACH（Modality Agreement- and Conflict-aware prototype Hypergraph）分层原型超图框架：逐级把单模态表示组合为双模态和三模态抽象；在每一层，模态组合锚点激活稀疏的一致原型超图以捕捉可复用共识模式，同时单独的冲突通路把跨模态差异映射到专属冲突原型超图；两条通路通过特征级、样本自适应的仲裁机制结合，并采用渐进优化策略先稳定层次结构再进行联合一致-冲突学习。
Result: 摘要报告在基准数据集上的实验证明了所提框架的有效性；组件分析和鲁棒性分析验证了层次组合、原型介导语义细化以及一致-冲突仲裁各自的独立作用。
Conclusion: 作者强调保留信息性模态不一致、同时抑制偶然模态噪声对多模态意图理解是有效的，并指出这种一致-冲突双通路加自适应仲裁的建模方式优于单纯鼓励对齐或压制不一致的融合思路。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AgentAntibody: An Adaptive Immune System for Defending LLM Agents against Prompt Injection
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection remains a critical threat to LLM agents, yet existing defenses treat each task as a self-contained problem, independent of previous encounters. In practice, user requests are often underspecified: they describe the desired outcome without fully specifying acceptable behavior. An injection can exploit this ambiguity, causing the agent to complete the task in a way the user would reject. As the user's expectations become clearer through concrete cases, a defense should learn from each encounter and apply what it learns to the next. Inspired by adaptive immunity, we propose AgentAntibody, which equips LLM agents with a self-evolving immune system against prompt injection. AgentAntibody represents its evolving understanding of the user's security boundary as a persistent library of antibodies. At runtime, the library recognizes threats to this boundary and mounts corresponding immune responses. Across encounters, it evolves to strengthen the agent's immunity to future attacks. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks and four backbone LLMs show that, by learning the user's boundary through experience, AgentAntibody outperforms existing defenses in preventing harmful actions while preserving legitimate task completion, even when the harmful and legitimate actions are both compatible with the stated task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentAntibody，一个受适应性免疫启发的自进化防御系统，用于保护 LLM 智能体免受提示注入 (prompt injection) 攻击。系统将用户安全边界的动态理解表示为一个持久化的抗体库，运行时识别威胁并触发免疫响应，并在多次交互中不断进化以增强对未来攻击的免疫力。摘要报告在三个基准和四个骨干大语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在阻止有害行为的同时保持合法任务完成方面优于现有防御。
Motivation: 现有防御将每个任务视为自包含问题，无法从先前遭遇中学习；而用户请求常常未完全指定，注入攻击可利用这种模糊性使智能体以用户会拒绝的方式完成任务。
Method: AgentAntibody 为 LLM 智能体配备自进化免疫系统，将其对用户安全边界的持续理解建模为持久化的抗体库；运行时该库识别对边界的威胁并触发相应免疫反应，并在多次遭遇中进化以强化对该子攻击的免疫能力。
Result: 在三个基准和四个骨干 LLM 上的实验显示，通过学习用户边界，AgentAntibody 在防止有害动作的同时保持合法任务完成方面优于现有防御，即使有害动作与合法动作都与既定任务相容。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过经验学习用户的安全边界可以增强智能体对未来提示注入攻击的免疫力，其适用场景为 LLM 智能体的提示注入防御。

papers.title: When Modalities Fail to Tango: Conformal Backdoor Detection in Multimodal Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks in multimodal contrastive learning (MCL) have garnered growing attention in recent years, as many downstream tasks critically depend on pre-trained MCL models. Existing detection-based defenses predominantly rely on the CLIPScore metric, under the assumption that poisoned pairs exhibit lower semantic similarity between the image and the caption. However, we identify two critical flaws remaining in existing methods: (1) the substantial overlap between CLIPScore distributions of benign and poisoned pairs undermines the reliability of this metric, and (2) fixed-threshold detection cannot provide statistical guarantees for ambiguous samples within overlapping regions. To overcome these limitations, we propose integrating conformal prediction (CP), a statistical framework that quantifies uncertainty through nonconformity scores (NCSs), to establish provable confidence bounds for detecting poisoned image-caption pairs. Building on CP, we introduce CASCADE, a novel two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Conformal Backdoor Detection framework. The coarse-grained stage uses cross-modality consistency to identify high-confidence benign and poisoned pairs. In the fine-grained stage, a reference set is constructed from high-confidence poisoned pairs, and instance-level NCSs based on text-space similarity are computed for each sample in the unidentified subset. These NCSs measure conformity to the poisoning distribution and enable precise identification of latent poisoned pairs within the unidentified subset. Extensive experiments on the large-scale CC3M dataset demonstrate that CASCADE achieves an average FPR of 5.79% at 100% TPR and an average AUROC of 0.9867 across diverse attacks, while remaining effective against adaptive attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态对比学习（MCL）中的后门攻击检测问题，指出现有基于CLIPScore的检测方法存在分数分布重叠和固定阈值缺乏统计保证两个缺陷，提出结合保形预测（conformal prediction, CP）的CASCADE两阶段粗到细检测框架。在CC3M大规模数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多种攻击下达到100% TPR时平均FPR为5.79%，平均AUROC为0.9867，并对自适应攻击保持有效。
Motivation: 多模态对比学习预训练模型的下游任务依赖性强，而后门攻击检测至关重要。现有基于CLIPScore的检测方法假设中毒对的图文语义相似度较低，但良性与中毒对的CLIPScore分布存在显著重叠，且固定阈值无法对重叠区域内的模糊样本提供统计保证。
Method: 提出CASCADE框架，将保形预测引入后门检测以建立可证明的置信界。粗粒度阶段利用跨模态一致性识别高置信度的良性和中毒对；细粒度阶段由高置信度中毒对构建参考集，并基于文本空间相似度计算未识别子集中每个样本的实例级非一致性分数（NCS），以度量其与中毒分布的符合程度。
Result: 在CC3M数据集上的大量实验显示，CASCADE在多种攻击下实现100% TPR时平均FPR为5.79%，平均AUROC为0.9867，且对自适应攻击依然有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为将保形预测的统计保证与多模态一致性相结合，能够弥补CLIPScore阈值检测在重叠区域的不足，为MCL后门检测提供更可靠的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAMP: A Cycle-Aware Multi-Scale Patch Mixer for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series are often governed by recurring patterns, but their dominant periods may vary across datasets, forecasting settings, and individual input windows. Existing cycle-aware forecasters commonly rely on a single period selected at the dataset level, which can be restrictive when periodic behavior changes over time or when multiple cycles coexist. Moreover, patch-based models typically process all patch positions uni- formly, although patches farther from the forecast boundary may require broader contextual refinement, while recent patches contain information that should be preserved more directly. Af- ter cyclic behavior is removed, the remaining dynamics may also span multiple temporal resolutions and cannot be adequately de- scribed at a single scale. We introduce CAMP, a Cycle-Aware Multi-Scale Patch Mixer designed to address these challenges. The Adaptive Cycle Learning module identifies dominant fre- quencies separately for each input window and generates both historical and future cyclic components without requiring a pre- defined cycle length. The Horizon-Guided Patch Mixer intro- duces position-dependent refinement, allowing earlier patches to incorporate broader temporal context while preserving infor- mation close to the forecast boundary. CAMP further models the de-cycled residual through temporally aligned multi-resolution representations, enabling complementary dynamics at different scales to be captured within one forecasting framework. Across seven long-term forecasting benchmarks, CAMP achieves the best average MSE on six datasets and the best or tied-best MAE on six. It also obtains the highest MSE win count across sixteen settings on four PEMS traffic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAMP，一个面向长期时间序列预测的循环感知多尺度补丁混合器（Cycle-Aware Multi-Scale Patch Mixer）。其 Adaptive Cycle Learning 模块按每个输入窗口分别识别主频率并生成历史与未来循环分量，无需预设周期长度；Horizon-Guided Patch Mixer 按位置差异化处理补丁，使远离预测边界的补丁获取更广上下文；并用时间对齐的多分辨率表示刻画去循环后的残差动态。在七个长时预测基准上，CAMP 在六个数据集上取得最佳平均 MSE、六个上取得最佳或并列最佳 MAE，并在四个 PEMS 交通基准的十六个设置中获得最高 MSE 胜出次数。
Motivation: 现实时间序列常由周期模式支配，但其主周期会随数据集、预测设置和输入窗口变化。现有循环感知预测器多在数据集层面选择单一周期，难以处理周期随时间变化或多个周期并存的情况；补丁模型又对所有补丁位置一视同仁，未能区分靠近预测边界与远离边界补丁的不同信息需求。
Method: CAMP 包含 Adaptive Cycle Learning 模块，逐窗口识别主频率并生成历史与未来的周期分量，无需预设周期长度；Horizon-Guided Patch Mixer 依据补丁位置进行差异化细化，让早期补丁吸收更宽时间上下文并保留近期信息；同时通过时间对齐的多分辨率表示对去周期残差建模，在单一框架内捕捉多尺度互补动态。
Result: 在七个长期预测基准上，CAMP 在六个数据集上取得最佳平均 MSE，在六个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳 MAE；在四个 PEMS 交通基准的十六个设置中，取得最高的 MSE 胜出次数。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，按窗口自适应识别周期、按位置差异化混合补丁以及多尺度残差建模的组合，可以有效提升长期时间序列预测的精度。摘要未讨论方法在天气或降水数据上的表现。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: FM4WiFi: Flow Matching for Multi-AP Coordination in Dense Deployments of Beyond Wi-Fi 8 Networks
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi networks are moving beyond random channel access toward tightly coordinated operation across access points (APs), a shift reflected in Wi-Fi 8's multi-AP coordination (MAPC). However, the current MAPC specification restricts cooperation to AP pairs, fundamentally limiting the gains achievable in dense deployments and calling for scalable, network-wide coordination in beyond Wi-Fi 8 systems. We target coordinated spatial reuse (Co-SR), where APs transmit concurrently at reduced power. Effective Co-SR demands joint selection and configuration of AP-station transmissions, yet existing approaches simply do not scale: they rely on heavy signaling, slow convergence, unrealistic assumptions, and often require computation time that explodes with network size. We introduce FM4WiFi, a generative ML pipeline that addresses these limitations by producing high-quality Co-SR configurations in a single inference step. FM4WiFi integrates (i) an autoencoder that learns compact latent representations of network states, (ii) a flow-matching generative model that synthesizes feasible Co-SR configurations (including rate control, absent from prior work), and (iii) a surrogate rate predictor that allows rapid, large-scale Co-SR candidate evaluation without dependence on a live system or digital twin. Across extensive evaluations (including experimental validation), FM4WiFi matches or exceeds state-of-the-art baselines at medium-to-large scales and scales to 30+ APs with sub-second inference. Extensive ablation studies validate each modeling and optimization choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FM4WiFi，一个面向超 Wi-Fi 8 密集部署中多 AP 协调 (MAPC) 的生成式机器学习流程，能在单次推理中生成高质量的协调空间复用 (Co-SR) 配置。该方法整合自编码器、流匹配 (flow matching) 生成模型和代理速率预测器，据称在中到大规模场景下匹配或超过现有基线，并支持 30+ AP 的亚秒级推理。摘要还包含实验验证与消融研究，并指出速率控制是相对先前工作的新增内容。
Motivation: 现有 MAPC 规范仅支持 AP 两两协作，限制了密集部署中可获得的增益；而现有 Co-SR 方法依赖重信令、收敛慢、假设不现实，计算时间随网络规模爆炸，难以实现可扩展的网络级协调。
Method: FM4WiFi 采用三部分管道：自编码器学习网络状态的紧凑潜在表示；流匹配生成模型合成可行的 Co-SR 配置（包括速率控制）；代理速率预测器支持无需实时系统或数字孪生的大规模候选配置快速评估。整个过程在一个推理步骤内完成。
Result: 在广泛评估（含实验验证）中，FM4WiFi 在中等至大规模场景下匹配或超过现有最优基线，可扩展到 30+ AP 且推理时间低于 1 秒；消融研究验证了各建模与优化选择的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为生成式单步推理为超 Wi-Fi 8 的网络级 Co-SR 协调提供了可扩展方案，并将速率控制纳入生成配置以弥补先前工作的空白；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Statistical learning theory and Occam's razor: Regularization
papers.abstract_en: The principle of Occam's razor, which instructs us to prefer simplicity in inductive inference, has attracted much scrutiny both in the philosophy of science and in machine learning. In either field, however, a justification for the principle has been elusive. In this paper, building on an earlier "core argument," I spell out a justification from statistical learning theory for the procedure of regularization: for trading off fit for simplicity. The means-ends argument is that in order to profit from theoretical reliability and "what-you-see-is-what-you-get" guarantees, one must implement a certain preference for simplicity over fit. This is a genuine methodological justification, which neither collapses to a purely pragmatic principle that we prefer simplicity for its own sake, nor to an ontological assumption that the truth is simple.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计学习理论出发，为机器学习中的正则化（regularization）程序提供一种基于此前“核心论证”的辩护。作者认为，为了获得理论可靠性与“所见即所得”（what-you-see-is-what-you-get）保证，必须对简单性相对于拟合施加偏好；这构成一种真正的方法论辩护，既不归结为纯粹实用主义地偏好简单性，也不依赖“真相是简单的”这一本体论假设。
Motivation: 奥卡姆剃刀原则建议在归纳推理中偏好简单性，但无论在科学哲学还是机器学习中，该原则都缺乏令人满意的辩护。本文目标是给出对“为拟合而权衡简单性”的正则化程序的一种合理论证。
Method: 基于作者早前提出的“核心论证”，从统计学习理论的理论可靠性保证出发，逻辑上推导出必须实现某种对简单性优先于拟合的偏好，从而为正则化程序提供依据。
Result: 摘要未报告实证结果，而是给出一个纯理论论证：为获得理论可靠性保证，需要偏好简单性胜过拟合，且该论证不依赖任何关于世界简单性的本体论假设。
Conclusion: 作者将其主张视为一个真正的方法论辩护，既不坍缩为纯粹实用原则，也不预设“真相是简单的”这一本体论承诺。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Recurrent Residual Quantization: A Progressive Multi-Precision Representation for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models (LLMs) under diverse deployment constraints requires flexible trade-offs between accuracy, memory footprint, and throughput. However, conventional quantization methods typically require a separate checkpoint for each target bit-width. We introduce Recurrent Residual Quantization (RRQ), a post-training quantization (PTQ) framework that represents weights as a low-bit quantized base together with a sequence of quantized residual corrections, enabling multiple effective precisions from a single checkpoint. Starting from a 2-bit model obtained via post-training quantization (PTQ) or round-to-nearest (RTN), RRQ progressively adds lightweight 2-bit residuals generated via RTN to construct 4-, 6-, and 8-bit representations. The method is calibration-free and avoids joint multi-bit optimization. In our Qwen3-8B setup, the full all-RTN 2-/4-/6-/8-bit package is constructed in 1,293 seconds, 3.3 times faster than the measured MatGPTQ construction. Experiments on six recent LLMs show competitive accuracy at 6 and 8 bits, with model-dependent behavior at 4 bits. The code will be made publicly available upon publication.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 submission; 14 tables, 1 algorithm, and no figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Recurrent Residual Quantization (RRQ)，一种面向大语言模型 (LLM) 的后训练量化 (PTQ) 框架，将权重表示为低比特量化基加上一系列量化残差校正，使单个 checkpoint 支持 2-bit 到 8-bit 等多种有效精度。RRQ 先通过 PTQ 或 round-to-nearest (RTN) 得到 2-bit 模型，再逐步添加 RTN 生成的轻量 2-bit 残差来构造 4/6/8-bit 表示，整个过程无需校准数据，也避免联合多位优化。摘要报告在 Qwen3-8B 上全 RTN 的 2/4/6/8-bit 包构建耗时 1,293 秒，比 MatGPTQ 快 3.3 倍，并在六个近期 LLM 上展现有竞争力的 6/8-bit 精度。
Motivation: 常规量化方法通常需要为每个目标位宽单独保存一份 checkpoint，难以在部署时灵活权衡精度、内存占用与吞吐量。RRQ 针对这一缺口，旨在从单一 checkpoint 出发获得多种有效精度，简化多精度部署。
Method: RRQ 以低比特量化的基权重为起点，通过 RTN 逐级构造一系列 2-bit 量化残差校正，渐进叠加生成更高的有效位宽表示。该方法是 calibration-free 的，并且明确避免联合多位优化，降低构建复杂度。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 设置下，完整的全 RTN 2/4/6/8-bit 包构建耗时 1,293 秒，为测量所得 MatGPTQ 构建耗时的 3.3 分之一。在六个近期 LLM 上的实验表明 6 位和 8 位精度具有竞争力，而 4 位精度呈现模型相关的行为。
Conclusion: 摘要将 RRQ 定位为一种 calibration-free 的多精度 PTQ 方案，用单个 checkpoint 覆盖多种位宽以服务多样化部署约束；作者同时指出 4-bit 表现依赖具体模型，并计划在论文发表后公开代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond the QBER Threshold: A Temporal QBER Based Machine Learning Framework for Multi Attack Detection in BB84 QKD
papers.abstract_en: Conventional BB84 Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems rely on a fixed 11% Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) threshold to detect eavesdropping. However, stealthy attacks can remain below this threshold while still compromising channel security. This paper proposes a temporal QBER based machine learning framework for detecting and classifying eavesdropping attacks in BB84 QKD systems. Rather than relying on average session level QBER, the framework extracts 63 physics-informed temporal features capturing burst behavior, temporal instability, basis dependent asymmetry, and QBER loss interactions. Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machine with a Radial Basis Function kernel (SVM-RBF) classifiers are evaluated on seven eavesdropping attacks and a normal channel scenario under noisy and lossy conditions. Averaged over ten independent runs, XGBoost achieves the best performance with 88.01% (0.47%) accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.8803, while SVM-RBF performs comparably, confirming the robustness of the proposed features. Evaluated as a binary attack-versus-normal detector for comparison with conventional monitoring, a fixed 11% QBER threshold achieves only 25.82% accuracy with a False Negative Rate (FNR) of 0.8477, whereas the proposed framework reduces the FNR to 0.0198, substantially improving detection of stealthy attacks that evade threshold-based monitoring. SHapley Additive exPlanations based (SHAP) explainability shows that physics-informed temporal and channel derived features are highly discriminative for identifying eavesdropping strategies. These results demonstrate that temporal QBER driven machine learning provides an accurate, explainable, and practical framework for multi attack security monitoring in BB84 QKD systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于时间 QBER（temporal QBER）的机器学习框架，用于 BB84 QKD 系统中多窃听攻击的检测与分类。传统固定 11% QBER 阈值无法捕获低于阈值的隐蔽攻击，该框架提取 63 个物理信息时间特征，并在七种窃听攻击和正常信道场景下评估 Random Forest、XGBoost 和 SVM-RBF。十次独立运行平均下 XGBoost 最佳，准确率 88.01%、宏 F1 0.8803，且将攻击检测的假阴性率从阈值法的 0.8477 降至 0.0198。
Motivation: BB84 QKD 传统上用固定 11% QBER 阈值检测窃听，但隐蔽攻击可保持在阈值以下同时危害信道安全，需要超越平均会话级 QBER 的更强检测手段。
Method: 提出基于时间 QBER 的机器学习框架，不依赖平均会话级 QBER，而是提取 63 个物理信息时间特征（突发行为、时间不稳定性、基不对称性和 QBER 损失交互），并比较 Random Forest、XGBoost 与 SVM-RBF 分类器在七种攻击及正常信道上的表现。
Result: 十次独立运行平均，XGBoost 取得 88.01%（标准差 0.47%）准确率和 0.8803 宏 F1，SVM-RBF 性能相近；作为二分类攻击-正常检测器，固定 11% QBER 阈值准确率仅 25.82%、FNR 0.8477，而所提框架将 FNR 降至 0.0198。SHAP 可解释性表明物理信息时间特征与信道特征对识别窃听策略具有高度判别力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为时间 QBER 驱动的机器学习为 BB84 QKD 提供了准确、可解释且实用的多攻击安全监控框架，显著改善对绕过阈值监测的隐蔽攻击的检测。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于时间 QBER（temporal QBER）的机器学习框架，用于 BB84 QKD 系统中多窃听攻击的检测与分类。传统固定 11% QBER 阈值无法捕获低于阈值的隐蔽攻击，该框架提取 63 个物理信息时间特征，并在七种窃听攻击和正常信道场景下评估 Random Forest、XGBoost 和 SVM-RBF。十次独立运行平均下 XGBoost 最佳，准确率 88.01%、宏 F1 0.8803，且将攻击检测的假阴性率从阈值法的 0.8477 降至 0.0198。
summary_sections.motivation: BB84 QKD 传统上用固定 11% QBER 阈值检测窃听，但隐蔽攻击可保持在阈值以下同时危害信道安全，需要超越平均会话级 QBER 的更强检测手段。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于时间 QBER 的机器学习框架，不依赖平均会话级 QBER，而是提取 63 个物理信息时间特征（突发行为、时间不稳定性、基不对称性和 QBER 损失交互），并比较 Random Forest、XGBoost 与 SVM-RBF 分类器在七种攻击及正常信道上的表现。
summary_sections.result: 十次独立运行平均，XGBoost 取得 88.01%（标准差 0.47%）准确率和 0.8803 宏 F1，SVM-RBF 性能相近；作为二分类攻击-正常检测器，固定 11% QBER 阈值准确率仅 25.82%、FNR 0.8477，而所提框架将 FNR 降至 0.0198。SHAP 可解释性表明物理信息时间特征与信道特征对识别窃听策略具有高度判别力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为时间 QBER 驱动的机器学习为 BB84 QKD 提供了准确、可解释且实用的多攻击安全监控框架，显著改善对绕过阈值监测的隐蔽攻击的检测。

papers.title: The Cost of Binarizing Survival Outcomes in Clinical Prognostic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis is an established framework for analyzing time-to-event data, yet many clinical machine learning studies still binarize the outcome before model training. This practice excludes censored patients, collapses temporal information into a single threshold, and can affect which features are selected as prognostically relevant. We examine the cost of this binarization in the context of Bayesian network (BN) feature selection, using two recent publications as case studies: one that applies BN-based feature selection to a head-and-neck cancer cohort and a second surgical cohort study that, while not BN-based, likewise binarizes its survival endpoint. We replace the binary scoring function with the Cox partial log-likelihood for feature-to-outcome edges, a modification we call the Survival-Aware Bayesian network, and recover prognostic features that binarization misses. Our ablation experiment confirms that the improvement is driven by the time-to-event scoring formulation rather than by retaining more patients. The results generalize across five endpoint-cohort combinations in head-and-neck cancer and extend to three further cancer types (breast, colorectal, and kidney). We propose that clinical studies with survival outcomes should use time-to-event methods by default, as binarization discards the prognostic signal retained by survival analysis.
papers.comment: Accepted to Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究临床预后建模中将生存结局二值化的代价，并以两个近期研究为案例，用 Cox 偏对数似然替换二值评分函数用于特征-结局边，提出 Survival-Aware Bayesian network。结果表明该方法能恢复被二值化遗漏的预后特征，消融实验证实改进来自时间-事件评分而非保留更多患者，并在头颈癌及乳腺癌、结直肠癌、肾癌等多个终点-队列组合中成立。
Motivation: 许多临床机器学习研究在训练前将生存结局二值化，这会排除删失患者、将时间信息压缩为单一阈值，并可能影响预后相关特征的选择，从而丢失生存分析保留的预后信号。
Method: 在贝叶斯网络特征选择框架下，将特征到结局边的评分函数从二值评分替换为 Cox 偏对数似然 (Cox partial log-likelihood)，形成 Survival-Aware Bayesian network，以利用完整的生存时间-事件信息。
Result: 在头颈癌队列及一个外科手术队列的案例研究中，该方法恢复了二值化遗漏的预后特征；消融实验证明改进源于时间-事件评分公式而非患者数量增加；结果在头颈癌的五个终点-队列组合以及乳腺癌、结直肠癌、肾癌三种额外癌症类型中均可推广。
Conclusion: 作者提出临床生存结局研究应默认使用时间-事件方法，因为二值化会丢弃生存分析所保留的预后信号。

papers.title: Robust and Personalized Federated Learning for Aircraft-Engine Prognostics under Benign and Adversarial Client Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables aircraft fleet operators to jointly train remaining-useful-life (RUL) models from engine sensor telemetry without sharing raw data. This study examines two complementary challenges: benign heterogeneity, where honest operators observe different operating conditions and fault modes, and adversarial heterogeneity, where compromised operators submit poisoned updates. We conduct a controlled, safety-oriented evaluation using a multi-task one-dimensional convolutional neural network and a structurally non-IID partition of the Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS) benchmark. We compare four remedies for benign heterogeneity and evaluate five attacks against four aggregation methods, including a physically motivated sensor-value backdoor designed to mask engine degradation. Shared-representation personalization closes approximately 70% of the local-to-centralized root-mean-square-error gap, compared with 21% for proximal regularization and 10% for server-side reweighting. The backdoor achieves a 94.9% attack success rate against standard averaging while leaving clean accuracy statistically unchanged, demonstrating that accuracy alone cannot certify model safety and that attack success must be evaluated explicitly. Krum reduces attack success by an order of magnitude and is the only evaluated aggregator that withstands coordinated attackers, whereas personalization alone provides no protection. Combining personalization with robust aggregation restores robustness (2.8% attack success) with only a small accuracy cost, revealing a trade-off between robust update selection and collaborative representation learning. Results remain consistent across client counts and on a harder six-condition dataset. Code and data partitions are released for reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对飞机发动机剩余使用寿命 (RUL) 联邦学习中的两类客户端异质性——良性异质性（不同运行条件与故障模式）和对抗性异质性（投毒更新）——进行受控的安全性导向评估。作者使用多任务一维卷积神经网络和 C-MAPSS 基准的结构化非 IID 划分，比较四种良性异质性应对方案，并评估五种攻击对四种聚合方法的影响，其中包括一种物理动机驱动的传感器值后门攻击。结果表明共享表征个性化显著优于近端正则化与服务端重加权，而仅靠个性化无法抵御攻击，需与鲁棒聚合结合。
Motivation: 飞机机队运营方希望在不共享原始遥测数据的前提下联合训练 RUL 模型，但联邦学习同时面临诚实客户端数据分布差异（良性异质性）和恶意客户端投毒（对抗性异质性）的挑战，现有方法缺乏针对这两个问题的系统安全性评估。
Method: 采用多任务一维卷积神经网络，并在 C-MAPSS 上构造结构化的非 IID 数据划分；针对良性异质性比较共享表征个性化、近端正则化 (proximal regularization) 和服务端重加权；针对对抗性异质性评估五种攻击与四种聚合方法，包括用于掩盖发动机退化的传感器数值后门。
Result: 共享表征个性化填补了约 70% 的本地到集中式 RMSE 差距，而近端正则化仅填补 21%、服务端重加权仅 10%；传感器后门对标准平均聚合达到 94.9% 的攻击成功率且不显著改变干净准确率。Krum 将攻击成功率降低一个数量级，是唯一能抵御协同攻击者的聚合器；将个性化与鲁棒聚合结合后攻击成功率降至 2.8%，仅付出少量准确率代价。结果在多种客户端数量和一个更难的六工况数据集上保持一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调仅凭准确率无法证明模型安全性，必须显式评估攻击成功率；鲁棒更新选择与协作表征学习之间存在权衡，而个性化与鲁棒聚合的组合可在小幅精度损失下恢复鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tactus: Open-Vocabulary Object Recognition from Low-Cost Pressure Arrays
papers.abstract_en: Resistive pressure arrays are the cheapest and most widely shipped tactile sensors, yet tactile representation learning has concentrated on optical sensors that image a deforming gel. We present Tactus, an open model that answers text queries from pressure data alone: on the STAG benchmark (27 objects, held-out recordings), it reaches 0.771 +/- 0.062 top-1 over four runs (top-3 0.935), matching, and at best exceeding, the dataset's supervised closed-set CNN at 0.76, with no trained classifier head. The recipe is small-data: 187 training recordings, masked-autoencoder pretraining on 144k unlabeled same-sensor frames, and the sensor's own calibration affine, which recovered more accuracy than every architecture change combined. The released model's errors concentrate in a few contact-ambiguous classes, are uncorrelated with text-target geometry (Spearman rho <= 0.05 over 702 class pairs), and survive paraphrased and even bare-name queries within one point; two diverse frames recover 89% of eight-frame accuracy. Failures are reported with equal precision: cross-sensor pretraining pooling gave no gain, vision co-training degraded touch, and a mis-normalized input pipeline silently discarded 97% of the sensor's dynamic range while producing plausible intermediate results. Weights, code, and the memory layer the model plugs into are released openly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tactus 是一个直接从低成本电阻式压力阵列进行开放词表物体识别 (open-vocabulary object recognition) 的开放模型。在 STAG 基准上，仅凭压力数据回答文本查询，四次运行达到 0.771±0.062 的 top-1（top-3 为 0.935），与数据集上有监督闭集 CNN 的 0.76 持平甚至略优，且无需训练分类头。配方为小数据：187 条训练记录、在 14.4 万无标注同传感器帧上的掩码自编码预训练，以及传感器自身的校准仿射变换，后者带来的收益超过所有架构改动之和。
Motivation: 电阻式压力阵列是最便宜、出货量最大的触觉传感器，但现有触觉表征学习主要集中在给形变凝胶成像的光学传感器上。作者的目标是填补这一空白，让低成本压力阵列也能支持开放词表的文本查询。
Method: 提出 Tactus 开放模型：仅用压力数据回答文本查询，不训练分类头；采用掩码自编码器 (masked autoencoder) 在 14.4 万无标注同传感器帧上预训练，并引入传感器自身的校准仿射变换。模型还接入一个开放的 memory layer，权重和代码均公开。
Result: 在 STAG 基准（27 个物体、留出记录）上达到 0.771±0.062 top-1（四次运行），top-3 为 0.935，匹配并在最佳情况下超过数据集有监督闭集 CNN 的 0.76。错误集中在少数接触歧义类别，与文本目标的几何形状无关（702 个类别对上 Spearman rho≤0.05），对释义甚至裸名称查询仍保持在一个点以内；两帧不同帧可恢复八帧准确率的 89%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调小数据配方有效，并同样精确地报告失败模式：跨传感器预训练池化无增益、视觉协同训练反而损害触觉性能、一个归一化错误的输入管线静默丢弃了传感器 97% 的动态范围却仍产出看似合理的中间结果。模型权重、代码和所接入的 memory layer 均以开放方式发布。

papers.title: An Explainable LLM Agent Layer for Open-World Anomaly Detection in Oil Wells
papers.abstract_en: Open-World Learning (OWL) pipelines for oil well anomaly detection have recently been shown to combine autoencoder-based detection, multiclass classification, and Mahalanobis-based novelty detection on the public 3W dataset. These pipelines answer \textit{what happened}, but they do not explain \textit{why the model believes it} or \textit{what the operator should do next}, and they do not put a human-readable name on the novelty clusters they discover. This paper evaluates a Large Language Model (LLM) agent layer placed downstream of the OWL pipeline, designed as a \textbf{companion} to the published upstream methods rather than a replacement. Using the Qwen3.5-397B-A17B Mixture-of-Experts model served via NVIDIA NIM, the agent receives structured sensor metrics and upstream classification or novelty assertions, and returns natural-language justifications, confidence-ranked critiques, and consolidated names for detected novelties. Across three studies spanning 989 real well-file segments from the 3W dataset, the agent achieved $35.1\%$ top-1 / $63.9\%$ top-3 (95\% CI [56.9, 70.4]) classification on all nine classes, $71.7\%$ top-2 validation [64.8, 77.6] with precision $0.91$ [0.84, 0.95] across 7 probed classes, and $89.7\%$ novelty detection [87.0, 91.9] with stable cluster naming on 5 of 7 hidden classes. The agent is not a standalone classifier. Its role is to: (1) confirm upstream decisions when sensor evidence supports them, (2) justify decisions in sensor-grounded language operators can audit, (3) flag disagreement when upstream labels are implausible, and (4) name novelties so that clustered unlabeled events arrive at the engineer with a consolidated human-readable label. The goal is to close the explainability gap that currently blocks deployment of OWL pipelines in operational settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估一个位于开放世界学习（OWL）油井异常检测管道下游的大语言模型（LLM）代理层，作为已发布上游方法的配套而非替代。代理接收结构化传感器指标与上游分类或新异类断言，通过 NVIDIA NIM 部署的 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 混合专家模型返回自然语言解释、置信度排序的批评以及新异类簇的合并命名。在 3W 数据集的 989 个真实井段上进行三项研究，报告了分类、验证与新异类检测指标。
Motivation: 现有 OWL 管道能回答“发生了什么”，但不能解释“为什么模型这么认为”或“操作员下一步该怎么做”，也无法给发现的新异类簇赋予人类可读的名称，这阻碍了其在实际运营环境中的部署。
Method: 在 OWL 管道（自编码器检测、多类分类、基于马氏距离的新异类检测）之后加入 LLM 代理层；代理接收结构化传感器指标和上游分类/新颖性断言，输出传感器可审计的自然语言理由、置信度排序的批评，以及新异类的合并命名。

papers.title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which augments large language model (LLM) generation with information retrieved from databases, has become a widely used approach for knowledge-intensive applications. Modern RAG systems, however, expose many configuration choices, such as retrieval indexes, model selections, and how models invoke retrieval. Each configuration yields a different trade-off between answer quality and serving performance, making it challenging to choose the optimal setting for a specific application deployment. We present RAG-Stack, a framework for efficiently discovering quality-performance Pareto frontiers across diverse RAG applications and serving systems. RAG-Stack consists of RAG-PE, an iterative design-space exploration algorithm that selects the next RAG configuration to evaluate; RAG-IR, a workload abstraction for diverse RAG algorithms; and RAG-CM, a performance model that predicts the optimal deployment and serving performance on the given hardware. Together, these components allow RAG-Stack to search the joint algorithm-system configuration space without deploying every candidate and to transfer an existing Pareto frontier to a new serving system. Given the same number of optimization iterations across diverse datasets, the Pareto frontiers found by RAG-Stack cover 52.5% to 153.2% more of the normalized quality-performance space than those found by state-of-the-art configuration-search methods evaluated over the same RAG design space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAG-Stack，一个用于联合优化检索增强生成 (RAG) 服务质量与部署性能的框架，通过高效搜索算法与系统配置的 Pareto 前沿来避免部署全部候选组合。框架包含三个组件：迭代设计空间探索算法 RAG-PE、面向不同 RAG 算法的工作负载抽象 RAG-IR、以及预测给定硬件上最优部署与性能的模型 RAG-CM。在相同优化迭代次数下，RAG-Stack 发现的 Pareto 前沿在归一化质量-性能空间覆盖比现有配置搜索方法多 52.5% 到 153.2%。
Motivation: 现代 RAG 系统存在大量配置选择，如检索索引、模型选择、模型调用检索的方式，每种配置在答案质量与服务性能之间产生不同权衡，导致为特定应用选择最优配置十分困难。
Method: 提出 RAG-Stack 框架，包含三部分：RAG-PE 迭代式设计空间探索算法，用于选择下一个待评估的 RAG 配置；RAG-IR 工作负载抽象，用于统一多种 RAG 算法；RAG-CM 性能模型，用于预测给定硬件上的最优部署与服务水平。三者联合搜索算法-系统联合配置空间，无需部署每个候选配置，并能将已有 Pareto 前沿迁移到新服务系统。
Result: 在多种数据集上，给定相同的优化迭代次数，RAG-Stack 发现的 Pareto 前沿比同设计空间下最先进的配置搜索方法覆盖多 52.5% 至 153.2% 的归一化质量-性能空间。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 RAG-Stack 可高效发现并迁移 RAG 应用的质量-性能 Pareto 前沿，但未讨论其对具体 RAG 算法质量指标或极端部署场景的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HALT: Verification-Aware Stopping for Retrieval-Augmented Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented search agents answer multi-hop questions by repeatedly issuing search queries and accumulating evidence. This creates a stopping problem: after the necessary evidence has appeared, further retrieval often adds cost, latency, and distracting context rather than useful information. We frame stopping as evidence coverage rather than generator confidence, and introduce HALT, a lightweight verification-aware policy that leaves the search agent unchanged. Given expected hop claims, HALT stops only when cumulative evidence supports each required claim. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks, HALT reduces redundant search while largely preserving exact match. We separate a deployable setting, where hop claims are generated from the question, from a diagnostic upper bound that uses gold supporting-fact annotations: generated claims give smaller but still exact-match-preserving savings, while gold claims show the larger savings available when hop targets are clean. Baseline comparisons and ablations show that this behavior is driven by claim-evidence alignment rather than generic sufficiency, fixed stop positions, or lexical overlap. Open-corpus pilots further suggest that HALT abstains when coverage cannot be reliably verified. Overall, evidence coverage provides a practical runtime control signal for improving retrieval-augmented agents without retraining or modifying the host agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HALT，一种轻量级、验证感知的停止策略，用于检索增强搜索代理（retrieval-augmented search agents）。作者将停止问题重新框定为证据覆盖（evidence coverage）而非生成器置信度，并仅在累积证据支持每个预期跳跃主张时停止。在三个多跳问答基准上，HALT 减少冗余搜索的同时基本保持精确匹配；摘要还区分了从问题生成主张的可部署设置与使用金标支持事实标注的诊断上界。
Motivation: 检索增强代理通过反复发出搜索查询并累积证据来回答多跳问题，但在必要证据已出现后继续检索只会增加成本、延迟和干扰性上下文。现有方法基于生成器置信度决定停止，作者认为这不能正确刻画证据是否足够。
Method: 将停止视为证据覆盖问题，引入 HALT，一个不修改宿主搜索代理的轻量级验证感知策略。给定预期的跳跃主张（hop claims），HALT 仅在累积证据支持每个所需主张时停止；同时区分可部署设置（主张从问题生成）与使用金标支持事实标注的诊断上界。
Result: 在三个多跳 QA 基准上，HALT 减少冗余搜索并大体保持 exact match。生成式主张带来较小但仍保持精确匹配的节省，而金标主张显示更大的节省空间。基线比较与消融表明，收益源于主张-证据对齐（claim-evidence alignment），而非通用充分性、固定停止位置或词汇重叠。开放语料试点还显示 HALT 在覆盖无法可靠验证时会弃权（abstain）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调证据覆盖可作为实用的运行时控制信号，在不重训练或不修改宿主代理的前提下改进检索增强代理的检索效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized MeanFlow loss that is used for the remainder of pretraining and for rectification-based post-training. In protein backbone generation, SE(3)-MeanFlow matches or exceeds flow-matching baselines that use several times more sampling steps, and its advantage widens in the few-step regime, where rectification lets it lead at every matched budget - at a modest cost in diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SE(3)-MeanFlow，一个在 Lie 群 SE(3)^N 上的少步生成框架，用于蛋白质骨架生成。它把 MeanFlow 从欧氏空间扩展到蛋白质 frame 的 Lie 群几何，在 so(3) 与 R^3 中推导出旋转和平移的平均速度闭式恒等式，从而获得免模拟训练目标。摘要报告其在少步采样下匹配或超越使用更多采样步数的 flow-matching 基线。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质骨架扩散和 flow-matching 模型需要数值积分 ODE，涉及数百次网络评估与 Lie 群指数映射，成为高通量设计流程的推理瓶颈。
Method: 在 Lie 代数 so(3) 和 R^3 中工作，推导旋转和平移的闭式平均速度恒等式；引入 SE(3) alpha-Flow 目标以移除旋转分支中的 Jacobian-vector product 并作为 warm-up 阶段，随后切换到小 t 稳定的 MeanFlow 损失用于预训练和 rectification 后训练。
Result: 在蛋白质骨架生成中，SE(3)-MeanFlow 在匹配或更少采样步数下达到或超过 flow-matching 基线，且优势在少步区域扩大；rectification 使其在每个匹配预算下领先，但以一定的多样性为代价。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架在 Lie 群几何上的免模拟训练目标与 rectification 后训练，使少步蛋白质骨架生成成为可能，主要代价是生成多样性略有下降。

papers.title: Shieldstral
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Shieldstral，一个 3B 参数的策略自适应 (policy-adaptive) 多模态安全分类器。它将内容审核形式化为二元问答 (binary question-answering) 任务，统一了不同审核子任务和异构安全数据集，并给出了约 54.1M 样本的数据构建配方与细粒度评估集。摘要报告其在文本安全基准上匹配或超越近 7 倍规模的模型，并在多模态安全分类上达到新的最优水平。
Motivation: 内容安全审核需要适应不同平台的内容政策，且现有方法面对标签体系 (taxonomy) 各异的安全数据集时难以统一训练；同时大模型推理成本高，需要更小的可自适应模型。
Method: 将内容审核建模为二元的 yes/no 问答任务，使多种审核任务在一个统一训练框架下合并；通过整理与生成约 54.1M 个样本，并构建细粒度评估集来支持策略自适应能力。
Result: 在文本安全基准上匹配或超过接近自身 7 倍规模的模型，并在多模态安全分类上刷新当前最优成绩。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合统一的双元问答形式与大规模数据构建配方，可以让小型自适应模型在安全审核任务上匹敌甚至超越大得多的模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What Matters: Supervising Global Context Pruning with Causal Evidence Sets
papers.abstract_en: Pruning a long context means committing to the blocks a model will keep, and the usual selector is distilled from a dense teacher's attention. That assumes attention shows which context the answer depends on. We test the assumption on retrieval tasks where the evidence is known exactly, by masking context and measuring whether the answer changes. Attention and causal dependence disagree, and selectors inherit the disagreement: teachers attend to outdated facts that answer-preserving restrictions drop, and attend differently across training runs that use the same evidence. In a two-step reference task, a selector distilled from attention routes at 36% to 98% depending on the training run, the same selector trained on causal evidence sets reaches 99% or better on every one, and dense accuracy does not say which teacher you have. On the topologies our estimator covers, the causal sets need no annotation: masking alone recovers them from the frozen teacher. Pretrained models show the same conflict. Qwen2.5-3B attends more to an outdated fact than its replacement on 58% of the examples it answers correctly (48% past a first-token attention sink), a causal router lifts Gemma-2-9B from 56% to 98%, and no readout we test recovers a two-hop chain that all three tested models solve. On our teachers a one-pass cross-layer trace supervises chains as well as the annotated sets, so the readout fails rather than the weights; interventions alone separate current from obsolete evidence, survive redundancy, and stay stable across training runs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长上下文修剪（context pruning）中如何选择保留哪些块，并检验常见假设：从稠密教师注意力蒸馏出的选择器能反映答案真正依赖的上下文。作者用证据完全已知的检索任务做掩码实验，发现注意力与因果依赖并不一致，注意力既会关注过时事实，也会在同一证据的不同训练运行间变化；改用因果证据集（causal evidence sets）监督后，同一选择器在所有训练运行上都达到更高且稳定的路由准确率。摘要还报告该方法无需标注，可由冻结教师仅通过掩码恢复因果集，并在预训练模型上复现了同样的冲突。
Motivation: 现有上下文修剪选择器通常从稠密教师注意力蒸馏，隐含假设注意力能指示答案依赖的上下文；该假设未被严格检验。作者通过精确已知证据的检索任务测试该假设，发现注意力与因果依赖分歧，选择器因而继承错误，且稠密教师准确率并不能反映教师质量。
Method: 通过掩码上下文并观察答案是否改变，构造因果证据集作为上下文修剪选择器的监督信号；该因果集无需标注，掩码操作即可从冻结教师中恢复。作者还提出单遍跨层追踪（cross-layer trace）以监督推理链，并用干预（intervention）区分当前证据与过时证据。
Result: 在两步参考任务中，注意力蒸馏选择器的路由准确率随训练运行在36%到98%间波动，而用因果证据集训练的同一选择器在每次运行上都达到99%或更高。Qwen2.5-3B在其正确回答的58%样本上更关注过时事实而非替换事实（扣除首token注意力汇集效应后为48%）；因果路由器将Gemma-2-9B从56%提升到98%。摘要还称没有测试的读出方法能恢复三个模型都能求解的两跳链。
Conclusion: 作者认为问题出在读出信号或监督方式而非模型权重：干预能区分当前与过时证据、对冗余稳健且跨训练运行稳定。该结论的范围限于其估计器所覆盖的拓扑结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixing-Free and Signal-Optimal Learning of Gaussian Graphical Models from Glauber Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian graphical model selection is usually studied under independent sampling, but in many applications the data arise as a single trajectory of a dependent stochastic process. We study exact recovery of the graph from one trajectory of random-scan Gaussian Glauber dynamics. Existing techniques for this problem either inherit the mixing time of the chain, which can be super-polynomial in the dimension $p$ without strong assumptions, or are suboptimal in the minimum normalized edge strength $κ$. We propose two algorithms that are mixing-free and attain the $κ^{-2}$ dependence of the information-theoretic lower bounds. Both instantiate a shared dueling-neighborhood search meta-algorithm with a local statistic built directly from the update sequence. For every fixed precision matrix and deterministic initialization, the first algorithm fits a least-squares regression at the updates of each node and has pointwise recovery horizon $\widetilde O(pd^{2}/κ^{2})$, where $d$ is the maximum degree. Its horizon depends logarithmically on a local conditioning quantity and on the initialization potential. The second algorithm is based on counting occurences of a specific update pattern and requires $\widetilde O(pd^{4}/κ^{2})$ updates, with no dependence on any condition number. The central technical challenge is that both statistics are built from dependent, non-stationary observations. Our analysis tackles this by demonstrating how to extract fresh Gaussian innovations from the update sequence, which yields mixing-free control of appropriate quantities. Neither the algorithms nor their analyses invoke stationarity, a spectral gap, or mixing conditions.
papers.comment: Minor correction to the proof of Lemma 15 (the statement and implications remain the same). For clarity and completeness: (1) separated pointwise recovery horizon guarantees from uniform ones, and (2) rewrote slow-mixing proposition (Proposition 2) over the class of problems with bounded initialization energy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从随机扫描高斯 Glauber 动力学的单一轨迹中精确恢复高斯图模型（Gaussian graphical model）。作者提出两种无混合（mixing-free）的算法，均达到信息论下界所要求的 κ^{-2} 依赖（κ 为最小归一化边强度），避免了以往方法对混合时间的依赖或次优的 κ 阶。两种算法共享一个决斗邻域搜索（dueling-neighborhood search）元算法，分别基于节点更新的最小二乘回归和特定更新模式的计数。
Motivation: 高斯图模型选择通常在独立采样假设下研究，但实际数据常是依赖随机过程的单条轨迹。现有从单轨迹恢复图的方法要么继承链的混合时间（在无强假设时可关于维度 p 为超多项式），要么在最小归一化边强度 κ 上不最优。
Method: 提出两种无混合算法：第一种对每个节点更新处的观测拟合最小二乘回归，得到点态恢复 horizon \widetilde O(pd^2/κ^2)，其中 d 为最大度，horizon 仅对数地依赖局部条件量和初始化势；第二种基于特定更新模式出现次数计数，需 \widetilde O(pd^4/κ^2) 个更新，且不依赖任何条件数。分析的核心是从相依非平稳更新序列中提取新鲜高斯创新（fresh Gaussian innovations），从而获得无混合的控制。
Result: 两种算法都达到信息论下界中的 κ^{-2} 依赖，且不依赖平稳性、谱间隙或混合条件。第一算法点态恢复 horizon 为 \widetilde O(pd^2/κ^2)，第二算法样本复杂度为 \widetilde O(pd^4/κ^2)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，算法及其分析均不调用平稳性、谱间隙或混合条件，表明从 Glauber 动力学轨迹进行图的精确恢复可以避免混合时间惩罚并达到信号最优的 κ 依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TerraZero: Procedural Driving Simulation for Zero-Demonstration Self-Play at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Training robust autonomous driving agents requires a simulator fast enough for reinforcement learning at scale, realistic enough to ground behavior in real-world map structure, and diverse enough to cover the safety-critical long tail that logged data rarely contains. We present TerraZero, a procedural driving simulator and self-play training stack that meets these goals. A configurable C engine runs simulation on the CPU and policy inference on the GPU over a zero-copy path, sustaining 1.3M agent-steps per second on a single server-grade GPU, far faster than existing object-level simulators, while keeping fidelity lighter single-agent systems omit: heterogeneous agents, multiple dynamics models, and full traffic-rule enforcement. TerraZero uses logged data only as a source of real-world map geometry, populating each map with randomized rule-based road users and signal controllers and randomizing agent dynamics, rewards, and sizes per episode, so one map yields an effectively unbounded set of scenarios. Every reported policy trains from scratch by reinforcement learning alone, with zero human demonstrations, no imitation, no logged trajectories, and no fallback planner at inference, on a compute-efficient self-play recipe scaled across GPUs. The policies generalize zero-shot across cities and datasets, including emergent left-hand-traffic driving without explicit supervision. As an ego policy, a single checkpoint is, to our knowledge, the first fully learned policy to top both val14 and the interactive long-tail InterPlan suite. On Waymo Open Sim Agents realism the same recipe outperforms other demonstration-free methods and is competitive with the strongest reference-anchored self-play method. One stack serves both roles: state-of-the-art demonstration-free driving policies across dynamics for cars and trucks, and sim agents that jointly control vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists.
papers.comment: Technical Report from Applied Intuition Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TerraZero，一个面向零示范（zero-demonstration）自博弈（self-play）训练的程序化驾驶模拟器与训练栈。模拟器用可配置的 C 引擎在 CPU 上运行仿真、在 GPU 上通过零拷贝路径做策略推理，单张服务器级 GPU 上达到每秒 130 万 agent-steps；真实日志数据仅用于提供地图几何，场景通过随机化规则型道路使用者、信号控制器以及每 episode 的动力学、奖励与尺寸生成。摘要报告策略完全由强化学习从零训练，不使用人类示范、模仿学习、已记录轨迹或推理时的后备规划器，并零样本泛化到多个城市与数据集。
Motivation: 训练鲁棒的自动驾驶智能体需要同时满足三个条件的仿真器：足够快到支持大规模强化学习、足够真实以锚定真实世界地图结构、足够多样以覆盖日志数据中罕见的安全关键长尾场景。现有面向对象的模拟器虽快但保真度有限，而高保真的轻量级单智能体系统又缺乏异构智能体、多种动力学模型与完整交通规则执行。
Method: TerraZero 采用程序化仿真与自博弈训练栈：C 引擎在 CPU 上运行仿真，GPU 上通过零拷贝路径执行策略推理；日志仅提供地图几何，每张地图被填充随机化的基于规则的道路使用者与信号控制器，并在每个 episode 随机化智能体动力学、奖励与尺寸。所有策略仅通过强化学习从零训练，无人类示范、无模仿学习、无日志轨迹、推理时无后备规划器，并使用跨 GPU 扩展的计算高效自博弈配方。
Result: 摘要报告 TerraZero 在单张服务器级 GPU 上维持每秒 130 万 agent-steps，远快于现有对象级模拟器。单个 checkpoint 的 ego 策略据作者所知是首个同时在 val14 与交互式长尾 InterPlan 套件上排名第一的完全学习策略；在 Waymo Open Sim Agents 真实性指标上，该配方优于其他无示范方法，并与最强的参考锚定自博弈方法竞争力相当。同一栈既可训练轿车与卡车的驾驶策略，也可训练联合控制车辆、行人与骑行者的仿真智能体。
Conclusion: 作者认为一个统一的模拟器与自博弈训练栈足以同时产出两种角色：跨动力学达到先进水平的无示范驾驶策略，以及联合控制多类交通参与者的仿真智能体。摘要未讨论具体局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forgetful Attention: An Auditable Support-Vector Memory for Selective Retention and Verified Deletion
papers.abstract_en: Auditable memory requires a precise contract: which output is preserved, relative to which reference solve, and across which updates. We introduce Support Vector Attention (SV-Attention), a one-class support vector data description (SVDD) gate whose coefficients enter the readout. Zero-coefficient keys are reserve; positive-coefficient keys are active. Removing a reserve token without re-solving preserves the current readout. Maintained deletion, which updates the existing solver state, targets a fresh retained-key fit under the same coefficient cap C. Across 1,200 fp64 deletion/refit trials on Gaussian, redundant, MIMIC-IV, and learned keys, 1,199 complete. Median maximum gate-score discrepancy over declared probes ranges from 4.5e-13 to 5.7e-7, and fresh refitting is 24-223 times slower than maintained deletion on the reference CPU. A deterministic example shows that current reserve status does not guarantee equivalence after future admissions. At matched token counts, rare-group recall is 0.861 versus 0.319 for an oracle attention-mass proxy (H2O-style). In a held-out-channel ICU control, SpO2 below 90 percent defines events but SpO2 is excluded from every selector; event-hour retention is 0.464 versus 0.225 for an RBF-density baseline. A separate batched approximation supports end-to-end training; at 3.22M parameters, seven paired seeds yield mean best-validation bits per character of 2.178 versus 2.383 (p=0.001). The contracts are point-in-time and fixed-C; future-safe streaming and general-purpose performance remain open, and larger fixed-step runs suggest slower optimization.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Substantive v2: formalizes point-in-time reserve removal and its future-admission counterexample; reports fixed-C deletion coverage, tolerance, latency, and a held-out ICU control; separates verification and training paths
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Support Vector Attention (SV-Attention)，用一类支持向量数据描述 (SVDD) 的门控机制将系数纳入读出，实现可选择保留与可验证删除的审计型记忆。摘要报告在 1,200 次 fp64 删除/重拟合试验中 1,199 次完成，门控分数偏差极小，且维护式删除比全新重拟合快 24–223 倍；在稀有组召回和 ICU 事件小时保留率上优于基线，端到端训练也带来更好的验证困惑度。
Motivation: 可审计记忆需要精确的契约，即相对于哪个参考解、在哪些更新之后输出应被保留；现有方法缺乏对选择性保留与已删除内容可验证性的系统处理。
Method: SV-Attention 使用 SVDD 门控，零系数键为保留 (reserve)、正系数键为激活 (active)；不重新求解即可移除保留 token 以维持当前读出，而维护式删除在固定系数上限 C 下更新求解器状态。另设计分离的批量近似以支持端到端训练。
Result: 摘要报告 1,199/1,200 次删除/重拟合试验完成，声明的探针上最大门控分数偏差中位数在 4.5e-13 到 5.7e-7 之间；维护式删除比全新重拟合快 24–223 倍；匹配 token 数下稀有组召回率为 0.861 对 0.319，ICU 事件小时保留率为 0.464 对 0.225；3.22M 参数时七个配对种子的最佳验证 bits-per-character 为 2.178 对 2.383 (p=0.001)。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些契约是时点性 (point-in-time) 和固定-C 的，未来安全的流式处理与通用性能仍是开放问题，且更大的固定步长运行显示优化更慢。

summary_sections.motivation: 可审计记忆需要精确的契约，即相对于哪个参考解、在哪些更新之后输出应被保留；现有方法缺乏对选择性保留与已删除内容可验证性的系统处理。
summary_sections.method: SV-Attention 使用 SVDD 门控，零系数键为保留 (reserve)、正系数键为激活 (active)；不重新求解即可移除保留 token 以维持当前读出，而维护式删除在固定系数上限 C 下更新求解器状态。另设计分离的批量近似以支持端到端训练。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 1,199/1,200 次删除/重拟合试验完成，声明的探针上最大门控分数偏差中位数在 4.5e-13 到 5.7e-7 之间；维护式删除比全新重拟合快 24–223 倍；匹配 token 数下稀有组召回率为 0.861 对 0.319，ICU 事件小时保留率为 0.464 对 0.225；3.22M 参数时七个配对种子的最佳验证 bits-per-character 为 2.178 对 2.383 (p=0.001)。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调这些契约是时点性 (point-in-time) 和固定-C 的，未来安全的流式处理与通用性能仍是开放问题，且更大的固定步长运行显示优化更慢。

papers.title: Leveraging Interpretable Tsetlin Machine for PDF Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: In the digital era, Portable Document Format (PDF) is one of the most widely used file formats for storing and exchanging digital documents due to its platform independence and rich functionality. However, these same capabilities have also made PDF files an attractive attack vector for cyberattackers, who embed malicious code within seemingly legitimate documents to compromise target systems. This paper presents a novel interpretable Tsetlin Machine (TM)-based framework for PDF malware detection. The proposed framework extracts salient features from PDF documents through static analysis without executing the files and employs rule-based learning to accurately classify benign and malicious PDF documents. Numerical evaluation on the RIT-PDFMal-2026 dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 98.02%, outperforming several state-of-the-art machine learning classifiers. Moreover, the proposed framework provides intrinsic interpretability by transparently explaining its classification decisions. Edge deployment on a Raspberry Pi further supports real-time, on-device PDF malware detection. The combination of better accuracy, computational efficiency, and intrinsic interpretability makes the proposed framework a promising solution for practical PDF malware detection.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 17 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence, 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可解释 Tsetlin Machine (TM) 的 PDF 恶意软件检测框架，通过静态分析提取 PDF 文档特征，在不执行文件的情况下用规则学习区分良性与恶意文档。在 RIT-PDFMal-2026 数据集上达到 98.02% 的准确率，优于多个现有机器学习分类器，并在 Raspberry Pi 上支持实时边缘部署。作者强调该方法同时具备较高准确率、计算效率和内在可解释性。
Motivation: PDF 因平台无关性和丰富功能被广泛使用，但也成为嵌入恶意代码的攻击载体；现有检测方法可能缺乏可解释性或难以在资源受限设备上部署，因此需要一种准确、高效且能透明解释决策的检测方案。
Method: 提出基于 Tsetlin Machine 的规则学习框架：通过静态分析提取 PDF 的显著特征，避免执行文件；由 TM 学习可解释的分类规则，对良性或恶意 PDF 做出透明决策，并支持在 Raspberry Pi 等边缘设备上运行。
Result: 在 RIT-PDFMal-2026 数据集上的数值评估显示，该框架达到 98.02% 的准确率，超过若干 state-of-the-art 机器学习分类器；边缘部署实验表明可在 Raspberry Pi 上实现实时、设备端 PDF 恶意软件检测。
Conclusion: 作者认为准确率、计算效率与内在可解释性的结合使该框架成为实际 PDF 恶意软件检测中一个有前景的解决方案。

papers.title: War in the Abstract: The Rise and Consequences of Militarized Language in Scientific Communication
papers.abstract_en: Scientists do not, by profession, wage war. Yet warfare's vocabulary consistently appears in their abstracts. To quantify the extent to which warfare's vocabulary pervades scientific abstracts, we analyze 21.4 million papers (2010-2025; OpenAlex, PubMed). We additionally run a within-subject war-framing experiment ($N = 801$; 32{,}040 trials) designed to provide causal insight into the effects of militaristic language on persuasion. Between 2010 and 2025, the presence of militaristic terms in scientific abstracts rose 48\% in OpenAlex and 32\% in PubMed, with the rise accelerating sharply after 2019 (cross-database $r = 0.96$, $p < 10^{-8}$). The prevalence of militaristic language is conflict-aligned at both country and annual scales (Uppsala Conflict Data Program; $r = 0.77$-$0.84$), with the abstracts from the Global South displaying the fastest rise in militaristic language. Among disciplines, social sciences leads in level of such language while engineering and computer science lead in growth. The COVID and post-2022 large-language-model eras also accelerated the rise and narrowed the language gap between native-English-speaking and non-English-speaking countries. In our follow-up experiment, we found that war framing reduced credibility (mean shift $-0.176$ Likert units, 95\% CI $[-0.21, -0.14]$; $d_z = -0.28$, $p < 10^{-20}$), funding willingness ($d_z = -0.12$) and policy support ($d_z = -0.08$), with a trend-level increase in sense of urgency ($d_z = +0.07$). Collectively, findings reveal that while scientific abstracts drift toward warfare, the use of militaristic language may erode credibility, funding willingness, and policy support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析2010-2025年间OpenAlex与PubMed的2140万篇论文摘要，量化了科学摘要中军事化词汇（militaristic language）的蔓延趋势，并用一个被试内实验（N=801；32,040次试验）检验战争框架对说服效果的因果影响。结果显示军事术语在OpenAlex中上升48%、在PubMed中上升32%，2019年后加速；实验发现战争框架降低可信度、资助意愿和政策支持。
Motivation: 科学家并非职业作战者，但战争词汇频繁出现在论文摘要中；该文旨在量化这种军事化语言在科学传播中的普遍程度及其对读者说服效果的影响。
Method: 对OpenAlex和PubMed共2140万篇摘要（2010–2025）进行大规模语料分析，并对照Uppsala冲突数据检验国家与年度尺度的相关性；同时设计被试内战争框架（war-framing）实验以提供因果证据。
Result: 军事术语出现率在OpenAlex中上升48%、PubMed中上升32%，2019年后明显加速（跨库r=0.96，p<10^-8）；与冲突数据在国家和年度尺度上相关（r=0.77–0.84），全球南方摘要上升最快，社会科学拥有最高水平而工程与计算机科学增长最快；实验显示战争框架使可信度下降（均值位移-0.176 Likert单位，95% CI [-0.21, -0.14]；d_z=-0.28，p<10^-20），资助意愿下降（d_z=-0.12）、政策支持下降（d_z=-0.08），紧迫感呈趋势性上升（d_z=+0.07）。
Conclusion: 科学摘要日益趋向战争隐喻，但军事化语言可能削弱可信度、资助意愿与政策支持，作者强调这一传播实践与受众反应之间的张力。

papers.title: Delta-Diffusion: Modeling Longitudinal Brain Amyloid-PET Trajectories via Conditional Poisson Diffusion Bridge
papers.abstract_en: While longitudinal brain PET imaging is the gold standard for quantifying the spatiotemporal accumulation of Beta-amyloid, its widespread clinical utility is constrained by high operational costs and cumulative radiation risks. Recent deep generative models show promise in longitudinal image synthesis; however, they often fail to capture subtle pathological progression due to identity drift and a persistent bias toward trivially replicating baseline signal intensities rather than modeling temporal transition. To this end, we propose Delta-Diffusion, a novel progression-aware framework that redefines longitudinal PET synthesis as a conditional Poisson Diffusion Bridge (PDB) process. Unlike standard diffusion models that start from Gaussian noise, our PDB formulation is mathematically anchored to the subject's baseline PET, effectively transforming the generative task into a conditional distribution transition of the amyloid trajectory. To handle heteroscedastic nature of PET imaging, we introduce a physically-grounded Poisson perturbation within a Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This architecture uses adaptive scale-shift modulation to precisely calibrate the synthesis with the elapsed clinical interval and structural MRI context. A volume-of-interest balanced objective is designed to emphasize sparse, high-risk regions of amyloid accumulation. Validated on two cohorts with 542 subjects, Delta-Diffusion demonstrates superior performance in capturing longitudinal variations in amyloid deposition compared to state-of-the-art methods, offering a robust computational framework for tracking disease progression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Delta-Diffusion，一个用于纵向脑淀粉样蛋白 PET 图像合成的进展感知框架，将任务重新定义为条件泊松扩散桥 (Poisson Diffusion Bridge, PDB) 过程。与标准扩散模型不同，该方法以受试者基线 PET 为数学锚点，并引入基于物理的泊松扰动来处理 PET 成像的异方差特性。在两个队列共 542 名受试者上，该方法在捕捉淀粉样沉积的纵向变化方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 纵向脑 PET 成像是量化 Beta-淀粉样蛋白时空积累的金标准，但存在成本高和辐射风险的问题；现有深度生成模型在纵向图像合成中常因身份漂移以及对基线信号强度的复制偏差而无法捕捉细微的病理进展。
Method: 提出条件泊松扩散桥框架，将纵向 PET 合成建模为以受试者基线 PET 为条件的分布转移；在 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 中引入物理启发的泊松扰动，使用自适应尺度-移位调制来校准临床间隔和结构 MRI 上下文，并设计体积感兴趣区 (volume-of-interest) 平衡目标以强调稀疏的高风险淀粉样累积区域。
Result: 在两个包含 542 名受试者的队列中，Delta-Diffusion 在捕捉淀粉样沉积纵向变化方面优于现有方法 (state-of-the-art methods)。
Conclusion: 该方法为跟踪疾病进展提供了一个稳健的计算框架，但其适用范围仅针对纵向脑 PET 成像。

papers.title: Sequential Kernel-based Conditional Independence Testing via Adaptive Betting
papers.abstract_en: Testing conditional independence is fundamental yet intrinsically difficult: without additional assumptions, Type I error control is impossible in general. The "Model-X'' paradigm addresses this difficulty by assuming exact knowledge of a relevant conditional distribution. While small deviations from this assumption can sometimes be tolerated in classical one-shot testing, existing sequential conditional independence tests typically require the Model-X conditional to be known exactly, making them fragile when it must instead be estimated. We propose a new approach that is substantially more robust to such estimation error. Our method applies testing-by-betting to an adaptively optimized Kernel Conditional Independence statistic, together with a normalization scheme and a truncate-and-shift calibration strategy. These modifications greatly reduce Type I error inflation while preserving high power across high-dimensional synthetic benchmarks and real-world fairness tasks, outperforming existing sequential Model-X approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/he-zh/SKCI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 adaptive betting 的顺序条件独立性检验方法，核心思想是对自适应优化的核条件独立性统计量 (kernel conditional independence statistic) 应用 testing-by-betting，并配合归一化方案与截断-平移校准 (truncate-and-shift calibration)。摘要称该方法在 Model-X 条件分布只能被估计而非精确已知时，能大幅抑制 Type I error 膨胀，同时在高维合成基准与真实公平性任务上保持高功效，优于现有顺序 Model-X 方法。
Motivation: 条件独立性检验在无额外假设下无法普遍控制 Type I error，Model-X 范式通过假定确切知道相关条件分布来绕开这一困难；但现有顺序条件独立性检验通常要求该分布精确已知，当条件分布需要从数据估计时性能会变得脆弱。
Method: 将 testing-by-betting 框架应用到自适应优化的核条件独立性统计量上，并加入归一化方案以及截断-平移 (truncate-and-shift) 校准策略，以增强对 Model-X 条件分布估计误差的稳健性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法显著降低因条件分布估计误差引起的 Type I error 膨胀，并在高维合成基准和真实世界公平性任务上保持较高统计功效，表现优于已有的顺序 Model-X 方法；代码已公开。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法相比现有顺序 Model-X 方法对 Model-X 条件分布的估计误差更稳健，从而放宽了顺序条件独立性检验对该假设精确性的依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Necessary, Decodable and Reversible, Yet Not Transferable: A Stress Test for Attention-Head Role Claims
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic studies often assign a component a role when removing it damages a behavior, its activation linearly encodes task information, and restoring that activation repairs the damage. We test the stronger implication: can the same activation carry the requested computation into another prompt? In the roughly 8 of 15 model-family cells receiving our full matched-control transfer assay, covering three 7-8B instruction-tuned models and 5 single-step computation families, tested attention-head states did not produce clean computation transfer. Same-answer and matched-context controls instead exposed inert or broad effects. Positive controls bound this result rather than eliminating its caveats: the instrument recovers known function vectors when writing into an underspecified prompt, and recovers a compact override-capable residual state in one of three controlled-model seeds. Neither control proves sensitivity to the object carried by real-model attention during prompt override. On two composed forms in Qwen, a strongly decodable operation direction also failed to steer the generated answer under passing gates; the corresponding cross-model test was invalid. These results show that necessity, decodability, same-prompt repair, and cross-prompt transfer are separable evidence. They do not establish that a portable selection state is absent from untested components or settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对机械可解释性中“注意力头承担某种角色”的常见证据（必要性、线性可解码性、同一提示内修复）提出压力测试，检验更强的含义：同一激活能否把计算迁移到另一个提示。在对三个 7-8B 指令微调模型、5 类单步计算族的 15 个模型-族单元中约 8 个完整匹配对照迁移实验里，注意力头状态未产生干净的计算迁移；对照实验显示效应为惰性或宽泛。作者据此认为必要性、可解码性、同提示修复与跨提示可迁移性是相互独立的证据。
Motivation: 现有机制研究常以“移除组件损害行为、激活线性编码任务信息、恢复激活修复损害”来赋予组件角色，但这种证据是否蕴含跨提示的计算可迁移性仍未得到检验。
Method: 设计完整匹配对照迁移分析 (matched-control transfer assay)，把同一激活写入另一个提示以考察其是否携带所需计算；并设置同答案、匹配上下文等对照，以及函数向量等正向控制来界定测量仪器的敏感性。
Result: 在约 8/15 个模型-族单元中，注意力头状态未产生干净的计算迁移；同答案和匹配上下文对照暴露的是惰性或宽泛效应。正向控制可在欠指定提示中恢复已知函数向量，并在三个受控模型种子之一恢复可覆盖的残差状态，但两者都不能证明仪器对真实模型注意力所携带对象敏感。在 Qwen 的两个复合形式中，强可解码的操作方向也未能通过传递门控 (passing gates) 引导生成答案，对应跨模型测试无效。
Conclusion: 结果表明必要性、可解码性、同提示修复和跨提示迁移是可分离的证据类别；同时作者强调这并不排除未测试组件或设置中存在可移植的选择状态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trivium: Temporal Regret as a First-Class Objective for Causal-Memory Controllers
papers.abstract_en: Many agentic systems and LLM pipelines correct mistakes by optimizing outcome reward. This addresses only the what of failure; the why and when may go unlogged, allowing the same error to recur across episodes. We propose long-horizon temporal regret alongside outcome regret and epistemic regret. These are diagnostic quantities, not standard comparator-based online-learning regrets. Temporal regret captures how long an unresolved or incorrect causal model is tolerated; epistemic regret captures posterior error over that model. Over a stream of E episodes, we prove three conditional results under explicit probing, persistence, and detectability assumptions. First, under observationally equivalent confounding, outcome-only learning cannot separate causal from spurious structure, so miscalibration can persist after outcome regret reaches zero. Second, with a persistent causal log and budgeted probes, total probe complexity is logarithmic in E, inducing O(log E) delayed-identification temporal regret. The implemented clipped soft score adds a linear numerical floor, so this logarithmic claim applies only to identification delay. Third, under K detectable change-points, the rate extends to O(K log E). We instantiate Trivium and state five falsifiable predictions. On CausalBench-Seq, a hard structural readout records 7.8+-2.9 misidentified episodes per seed over 500 episodes and 20 seeds, with zero observed stationary errors, while outcome-only controllers remain misidentified throughout. Audit ablations show that continued posterior updating, not detector reopening or local repair, drives posterior recovery; local repair instead reduces committed-graph dispatch exposure. The prior logarithmic-envelope verdict based on a clipped soft score is withdrawn. A pilot real-LLM stream provides external evidence. Self-learning here means revising an external causal model, not retraining LLM weights.
papers.comment: Note on version 2 (closure). This version corrects errors in v1. The use of the term "regret'' also caused confusion because the quantities defined here are not standard comparator-based online-learning regret. Subsequent work will use "liability'' or "debt'' to be clear
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向智能体系统与 LLM 流水线中的错误修正问题，提出将长时域时间遗憾 (long-horizon temporal regret) 与认识论遗憾 (epistemic regret) 作为因果记忆控制器 (causal-memory controller) 的诊断量。作者在显式探测、持久性与可检测性假设下证明了三个条件性结论：观测等价混杂下仅凭结果学习无法区分因果与虚假结构；在持久因果日志与预算探测下总探测复杂度为 O(log E)，对应 O(log E) 延迟识别时间遗憾；存在 K 个可检测变化点时扩展为 O(K log E)。文中实例化为 Trivium，并在 CausalBench-Seq 上报告了 500 个 episode、20 个种子下每种子 7.8±2.9 个误识别 episode，且观测到零平稳错误。v2 注释指出对数包络结论仅适用于识别延迟，先前的裁剪软分数结论已被撤回。
Motivation: 现有智能体与 LLM 流水线通过优化结果奖励来纠错，只处理失败的 what，不记录 why 和 when，导致同一错误可能跨 episode 重演。需要能够刻画错误因果模型被容忍时长的诊断性度量。
Method: 提出 temporal regret 与 epistemic regret，并明确它们不是标准 comparator-based 的在线学习遗憾，而是诊断量。通过显式探测、持久性和可检测性假设给出条件性证明，并将方法实例化为 Trivium；另在真实 LLM 流上做试点验证。
Result: 摘要报告：观测等价混杂下，outcome-only 学习在 outcome regret 归零后仍可能持续错误校准；在持久因果日志与预算探测下总探测复杂度为 O(log E)，产生 O(log E) 延迟识别时间遗憾；K 个可检测变化点下扩展为 O(K log E)。CausalBench-Seq 上硬结构读出记录每种子 7.8±2.9 个误识别 episode（500 episode、20 种子），零平稳错误，而 outcome-only 控制器全程保持误识别；消融显示持续后验更新驱动后验恢复，局部修复减少已提交图的分派暴露。
Conclusion: 作者强调对数包络结论只适用于识别延迟，因为所实现的裁剪软分数 (clipped soft score) 引入线性数值下限，因此撤回先前基于该分数的对数包络判定；并明确此处的自学习指修订外部因果模型，而非重训 LLM 权重。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seeing through boxes: Non-Line-of-Sight 3D Reconstruction from Radar Signals
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing object geometry from radio frequency (RF) signals is fundamentally challenging due to the lensless imaging nature of RF sensing, which leads to low spatial resolution and high noise. Unlike light signals, RF signals can penetrate occlusions and thus capture information about hidden scenes. Existing Non-Line-of-Sight (NLoS) 3D neural reconstruction methods can recover coarse surfaces inside enclosed environments but often suffer from unstable optimization, noisy surface geometry, and surface ambiguity, failing to produce accurate zero-level sets from the signed distance field (SDF). These limitations largely stem from neglecting the role of Line-of-Sight (LoS) geometry outside the enclosed region, which provides valuable physical constraints for modeling signal propagation. In this paper, we introduce a Unified LoS and NLoS neural geometry reconstruction framework GeRaF 2.0 that leverages the outside LoS geometry to model and guide RF propagation from the LoS region into the NLoS region. By integrating visual LoS priors into the neural field formulation, GeRaF 2.0 achieves stable training and physically consistent reconstruction of both visible and hidden geometry, setting a new state-of-the-art in RF-based geometry reconstruction.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对射频（RF）信号非视距（NLoS）三维几何重建中SDF零水平集不准确的问题，提出统一LoS与NLoS的神经几何重建框架GeRaF 2.0。该方法利用封闭区域外的视距（LoS）几何约束来建模并引导RF传播进入NLoS区域，同时整合视觉LoS先验进入神经场表示，以实现稳定训练和物理一致的可见与隐藏几何重建。摘要称该方法在RF几何重建上达到新的最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有NLoS 3D神经重建方法能恢复封闭环境内的粗略表面，但常因忽略LoS区域几何而导致优化不稳定、表面噪声大和表面模糊，难以从SDF生成准确的零水平集；LoS几何其实提供了信号传播的物理约束。
Method: 提出统一LoS与NLoS的神经几何重建框架GeRaF 2.0，利用外部LoS几何建模并引导RF信号从LoS区域传播到NLoS区域，并将视觉LoS先验集成进神经场（neural field）的表示中。
Result: 摘要报告GeRaF 2.0在稳定训练和物理一致的可见与隐藏几何重建方面取得进步，并在RF几何重建中达到新的最先进水平，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为整合外部LoS几何约束可以显著改善RF信号驱动的NLoS三维重建，为可见与隐藏场景提供一致的几何表示。
Relevance: 0
