papers.title: GeRaF: Neural Geometry Reconstruction from Radio Frequency Signals
papers.abstract_en: GeRaF is the first method to use neural implicit learning for near-range 3D geometry reconstruction from radio frequency (RF) signals. Unlike RGB or LiDAR-based methods, RF sensing can see through occlusion but suffers from low resolution and noise due to its lensless imaging nature. While lenses in RGB imaging constrain sampling to 1D rays, RF signals propagate through the entire space, introducing significant noise and leading to cubic complexity in volumetric rendering. Moreover, RF signals interact with surfaces via specular reflections, requiring fundamentally different modeling. To address these challenges, GeRaF (1) introduces filter-based rendering to suppress irrelevant signals, (2) implements a physics-based RF volumetric rendering pipeline, and (3) proposes a novel lensless sampling and lensless alpha blending strategy that makes full-space sampling feasible during training. By learning signed distance functions, reflectiveness, and signal power through MLPs and trainable parameters, GeRaF takes the first step towards reconstructing millimeter-level geometry from RF signals in real-world settings.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 (2026): 94200-94230
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeRaF 是首个利用神经隐式学习（neural implicit learning）从射频（RF）信号进行近程 3D 几何重建的方法。针对 RF 信号无透镜成像导致的分辨率低、噪声大、体渲染三次方复杂度以及镜面反射等问题，该方法引入滤波渲染、物理基础的 RF 体渲染管线，以及无透镜采样与无透镜 alpha 混合策略，并通过 MLP 学习符号距离函数、反射率和信号功率。
Motivation: RF 感知能穿透遮挡物，但受限于无透镜成像特性，分辨率低且噪声严重；同时 RF 信号在全空间传播而非像 RGB 那样被限制在 1D 光线上，导致体渲染计算量呈三次方增长，且表面镜面反射需要不同于光学成像的建模方式。
Method: 提出三类关键技术：(1) 基于滤波的渲染（filter-based rendering）抑制无关信号；(2) 物理基础的 RF 体渲染管线（physics-based RF volumetric rendering）；(3) 无透镜采样与无透镜 alpha 混合（lensless sampling and lensless alpha blending）策略，使训练阶段的全空间采样可行。模型通过 MLP 和可训练参数学习符号距离函数、反射率与信号功率。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅声明 GeRaF 是在真实场景中从 RF 信号重建毫米级几何的第一步。
Conclusion: GeRaF 证明了神经隐式表示可用于 RF 信号驱动的近程三维几何重建，为后续在真实环境中实现毫米级重建提供了基础框架。

papers.title: The Hamilton-Jacobi Theory of Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, training a neural network is identified, exactly, as a search through Hamilton--Jacobi initial-value problems: each gradient step selects the initial data of a viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equation whose Hopf--Cole propagator best fits the observations; at inference, the input is the spatial point at which that solution is evaluated and the initial condition is already encoded in the weights. The correspondence is exact for log-sum-exp layers, with ReLU, sigmoid, SiLU, and GELU each an exact limit, gradient, or moment of the same object, and exact in composition across depth and width, with a quantified error at finite depth that vanishes in the joint limit. It is structural for residual networks, transformers, and recurrent networks (RNNs, LSTMs, SSMs), each discretizing the same class of equations, at a named and quantified approximation error. A single deformation parameter $\varepsilon$ unifies all four perspectives (network, tropical algebra, viscous PDE, convex optimization) in a commutative diagram closed under Lipschitz conditions. Quantitative consequences include: the minimax optimal generalization rate $O(n^{-1/(d+2)})$ for fixed $t$; adversarial robustness controlled by $\varepsilon$; backpropagation as the co-state equation of the Hamiltonian system for residual networks (Pontryagin Maximum Principle); scaling exponents consistent with data intrinsic dimension via PDE quadrature; and a closed-form $O(N)$ influence function (softmax attribution weights $π_j$) whose entropy landscape undergoes fold bifurcations as $\varepsilon$ increases, each merging attribution basins.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有深度学习理论缺乏把训练与推理统一纳入同一类动力系统或 PDE 的精确描述。本文旨在建立神经网络与粘性 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程之间的严格对应，并在此框架下给出泛化、鲁棒性、反向传播与可解释性等方面的定量结论。

papers.title: Tree of Thoughts as a Classical Heuristic Search Problem: Formal Foundations and Design Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet their standard generation process -- auto-regressive token prediction -- is inherently myopic and prone to cascading errors. To address this, the Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) framework creates a search space over intermediate reasoning steps, allowing search models to explore, look ahead, and backtrack. However, current ToT research remains fragmented across Natural Language Processing and Automated Planning communities, often using inconsistent terminology and ad-hoc implementations. Consequently, we synthesize the ToT landscape through a unified taxonomy based on classical heuristic search terminology. We map LLM-based reasoning to classical search components: state representation (granularity of thoughts), successor generation (prompting operators), and heuristic evaluation (self-assessment of progress). We analyze existing work within the context of our taxonomy and identify emerging design patterns: systematic search (Best-First Search) for shallow, deterministic tasks and lookahead-heavy strategies (DFS, MCTS) for deep multi-step reasoning. We conclude by identifying open algorithmic challenges at the intersection of heuristic search and LLM reasoning, and call on the heuristic search community to engage with this emerging domain.
papers.comment: Extended version of the SoCS 2026 paper. Includes appendices omitted from the proceedings version
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Nineteenth International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SoCS 2026), AAAI Press, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是SoCS 2026论文的扩展版，作者用经典启发式搜索术语统一了Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT)研究。文章将LLM推理映射为搜索组件：状态表示（思维粒度）、后继生成（提示算子）和启发式评估（自我评估），并基于这一统一分类法分析现有工作，识别出设计模式：浅层确定性任务适合Best-First Search，深层多步推理适合DFS、MCTS等lookahead-heavy策略，最后指出开放算法挑战并呼吁启发式搜索社区参与。
Motivation: LLM的标准自回归生成过程本质上是短视的，容易产生级联错误。ToT框架通过构造中间推理步骤的搜索空间来支持探索、前瞻和回溯，但当前ToT研究在NLP与自动规划社区之间碎片化，术语不一致、实现多为特设，缺乏统一的理论视角。
Method: 提出一个基于经典启发式搜索术语的统一分类法（unified taxonomy），将LLM推理映射到搜索组件：状态表示（granularity of thoughts）、后继生成（prompting operators）和启发式评估（self-assessment of progress），并以此分类法系统分析已有工作，归纳设计模式。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字，而是通过分类法识别出两类设计模式：对于浅层、确定性任务采用系统性搜索（Best-First Search），对于深层多步推理采用前瞻密集型策略（DFS、MCTS）。
Conclusion: 文章指出启发式搜索与LLM推理交叉处存在开放算法挑战，并呼吁启发式搜索社区进入这一新兴研究领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Bits Break Recourse: Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Model quantization is widely used to reduce memory, latency, and deployment cost, and is typically judged by whether predictive accuracy is preserved. In decision systems that provide algorithmic recourse, however, accuracy preservation is not sufficient: a small actionable change that flips the decision of a full-precision model may fail after quantization, or require a substantially larger intervention. This paper studies this deployment mismatch and introduces counterfactual sensitivity under quantization, a framework for measuring how compression changes recourse behavior. We propose two metrics: Validity Drop (VD), which measures the fraction of full-precision recourse actions that no longer achieve the target outcome after quantization, and Counterfactual Recourse Gap (CRG), which measures the increase in minimal recourse cost under the quantized model. To mitigate this failure mode, we introduce Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization (CFQ), a quantization-aware training method that jointly learns quantizer parameters and mixed-precision bit allocation while preserving the target prediction at teacher-generated recourse points. CFQ is compatible with standard LSQ/PACT-style quantizers and mixed-precision policies, and can also be instantiated as a training-free calibration procedure for post-training quantization. Experiments on Adult, German Credit, and COMPAS show that standard QAT and mixed-precision baselines can preserve accuracy while substantially degrading recourse stability. At matched accuracy and bit budget, CFQ consistently reduces VD and CRG; for example, on Adult, CFQ reduces VD/CRG from $0.121/0.162$ for an accuracy-centric mixed-precision baseline to $0.061/0.071$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型量化对算法反事实解释（algorithmic recourse）的影响，指出仅保持预测精度不足以保证决策系统在量化后的反事实行为稳定。作者提出两个度量指标——有效性下降（Validity Drop, VD）和反事实补救缺口（Counterfactual Recourse Gap, CRG），并设计量化感知训练方法 Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization（CFQ），在保持目标预测的同时学习量化器参数与混合精度位分配。实验在 Adult、German Credit 和 COMPAS 上显示标准 QAT 和混合精度基线在保持精度的同时会显著损害反事实稳定性，而 CFQ 在相同精度和位预算下一致降低 VD 和 CRG。
Motivation: 现有量化方法通常只以预测精度是否保持来评判，但在提供算法反事实解释的决策系统中，全精度模型下有效的微小行动改动在量化后可能失效或需要更大干预，造成部署偏差，而这一问题尚未被系统研究。
Method: 提出反事实敏感性框架，定义 VD（量化后不再达成目标结果的全精度补救行动占比）和 CRG（量化模型下最小补救成本的增加量）；在此基础上提出 CFQ，一种量化感知训练方法，联合学习量化器参数和混合精度位分配，并在教师生成的反事实点上保持目标预测；该方法兼容 LSQ/PACT 风格量化器，也可实例化为训练无关的后训练量化校准过程。
Result: 在 Adult、German Credit 和 COMPAS 上的实验显示，标准 QAT 和混合精度基线能在保持精度的同时大幅降低反事实稳定性；在匹配精度和位预算条件下，CFQ 一致降低 VD 与 CRG，例如在 Adult 上将 VD/CRG 从精度导向混合精度基线的 0.121/0.162 降至 0.061/0.071。
Conclusion: 论文强调量化部署必须考虑反事实行为而不能只看精度，CFQ 能在不牺牲精度与位预算的前提下改善量化后的反事实稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Code Language Models for Security Patch Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automated detection of vulnerability-fixing commits (\vfcs) is critical for timely security patch deployment, as advisory databases lag patch releases by a median of 25 days and many fixes never receive advisories. Code language models are increasingly adopted for identifying VFCs, yet whether they can recognize a security fix from the code change itself remains unclear, as reported performance is shaped by commit messages, project-level data leakage, and uncertain data quality. We present a rigorous re-evaluation that jointly controls these factors through a unified framework consolidating 20 fragmented datasets spanning more than 180000 commits. Training 270 models from 125M to 80B parameters, we isolate the code signal under group-stratified code-only evaluation and assess the impact of model capacity and additional code context, ranging from intra-procedural enrichment to inter-procedural repository context. Model capacity yields clear but insufficient gains, and the evaluated context signals provide no reliable improvement under strict false positive budgets. At a false positive rate of 0.5%, every evaluated fine-tuned code-only model misses at least 80% of vulnerability fixes. A manual expert audit further shows that label error concentrates in commits lacking CVE association and primarily distorts evaluation. We derive concrete recommendations for evaluating on aggregated VFC datasets and release our unified framework and evaluation suite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对代码语言模型在漏洞修复提交（VFC，vulnerability-fixing commits）检测上的能力进行了系统性再评估，通过统一框架整合20个碎片化数据集、覆盖约18万提交，训练了270个模型（参数规模125M到80B），并在分组分层、仅代码（code-only）的评测设置下隔离代码信号。摘要报告：模型容量带来明确但不足的增益，在0.5%假阳性率下，所有被评估的微调代码模型至少漏掉80%的漏洞修复；人工专家审计还发现标签错误集中在缺乏CVE关联的提交中，并主要扭曲了评测结果。
Motivation: VFC自动检测对于及时部署安全补丁至关重要，因为公告数据库平均滞后补丁发布25天，且许多修复从未获得公告。现有代码语言模型在此任务上的报告性能受提交信息、项目级数据泄漏和不确定数据质量的影响，模型能否仅从代码变更本身识别安全修复仍不清楚。
Method: 构建统一评测框架，整合20个碎片化数据集共超过180000个提交，训练270个模型（125M到80B参数），采用按组分层（group-stratified）的仅代码评测以隔离代码信号，并评估模型容量以及额外代码上下文（从过程内增强到过程间仓库上下文）的影响；此外进行了人工专家审计以检查标签质量。
Result: 模型容量带来清晰但不足的提升，所评估的上下文信号在严格的假阳性预算下没有提供可靠改进。在0.5%假阳性率下，所有被评估的微调代码模型都至少漏掉80%的漏洞修复；标签错误集中在缺乏CVE关联的提交中，并主要扭曲评测准确性。
Conclusion: 作者给出了在聚合VFC数据集上进行评测的具体建议，并发布了统一框架和评测套件；摘要强调现有模型仅凭代码信号检测安全修复的能力仍存在显著瓶颈。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DeepImagine: Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction via Stepwise Local Counterfactual Imaginations
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the outcomes of prospective clinical trials remains a major challenge. Clinical trial outcomes result from complex interactions among experimental factors such as drug interventions, participant demographics, and protocols. Here, we introduce DeepImagine, a framework that predicts target trial outcomes through stepwise counterfactual imagination anchored on historical trials with observed results. Starting from a relevant historical trial, DeepImagine sequentially modifies one differing experimental factor at a time. With each step a large language model (LLM) is posed a local counterfactual: how would the current imagined outcome change with this single perturbation? The updated result is carried forward as the input to the next step, until the historical configuration exactly matches the target, yielding the final prediction. Empirically, DeepImagine consistently outperforms direct one-step prediction across several off-the-shelf LLMs, with further gains when multiple imagination pathways, initiated from different historical anchors, are aggregated. We also construct natural counterfactuals augmented with synthetic reasoning traces and train a family of specialized language models, each dedicated to learning one factor's local counterfactual transition. Integrating these learned local operators into DeepImagine yields substantial improvements over general-purpose LLM baselines. Our findings position stepwise counterfactual imagination, distinct from both correlational prediction and explicit structural causal modeling, as a promising direction for clinical trial outcome prediction. All code, training scripts, and evaluation scripts are available at \href{https://github.com/deepimagine-counterfactual/DeepImagine}{https://github.com/deepimagine-counterfactual/DeepImagine}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepImagine，一种基于逐步反事实想象（stepwise counterfactual imagination）的临床试验结局预测框架。它以有观测结果的历史试验为锚点，每次只修改一个实验因素，并用大语言模型（LLM）回答局部反事实，逐步把当前想象结局更新为与目标配置一致，从而得到最终预测。摘要报告该框架在多个现成 LLM 上一致优于一步直接预测，并可通过聚合多条反事实路径进一步提升；训练专门学习各因素局部转移的专用语言模型还能带来明显改进。
Motivation: 临床试验结局由药物干预、受试者人口学特征、试验方案等实验因素复杂交互决定，直接预测仍具有挑战；需要一种能显式利用历史试验和逐因素干预推理的预测方法。
Method: 从相关历史试验出发，逐步修改与目标试验不同的单个实验因素；每一步用 LLM 提出局部反事实问题，即单一扰动会如何改变当前想象结局，并把更新后的结果作为下一步输入，直到历史配置与目标完全一致。还构造带合成推理轨迹的自然反事实数据，训练一系列分别学习单一因素局部反事实转移的专用语言模型，并将这些局部算子整合进 DeepImagine。
Result: 摘要称 DeepImagine 在多种现成 LLM 上一致优于直接一步预测；从不同历史锚点发起的多条想象路径聚合可进一步提升；集成专用局部算子相比通用 LLM 基线带来实质性改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为逐步反事实想象不同于相关性预测和显式结构因果建模，是临床试验结局预测的有前景方向；代码与训练/评估脚本已公开。摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent Denoising Improves Visual Alignment in Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as LLaVA are typically trained with an autoregressive language modeling objective, providing only indirect supervision to visual tokens. This often yields weak internal visual representations and brittle behavior under distribution shift. Inspired by recent progress on latent denoising for learning high-quality visual tokenizers, we show that the same principle provides an effective form of visual supervision for improving internal visual feature alignment and multimodal understanding in LMMs. We propose a latent denoising framework that corrupts projected visual tokens using a saliency-aware mixture of masking and Gaussian noising. The LMM is trained to denoise these corrupted tokens by recovering clean teacher patch features from hidden states at a selected intermediate LLM layer using a decoder. To prevent representation collapse, our framework also preserves the teacher's intra-image similarity structure and applies intra-image contrastive patch distillation. During inference, corruption and auxiliary heads are disabled, introducing no additional inference-time overhead. Across a broad suite of standard multimodal benchmarks, our method consistently improves visual understanding and reasoning over strong baselines, and yields clear gains on compositional robustness benchmarks (e.g., NaturalBench). Moreover, under ImageNet-C-style non-adversarial common corruptions applied to benchmark images, our method maintains higher accuracy and exhibits reduced degradation at both moderate and severe corruption levels. Our code is available at https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型多模态模型（LMM，如 LLaVA）中视觉 token 仅受自回归语言建模目标间接监督的问题，提出一种潜在去噪（latent denoising）框架作为视觉监督信号。该方法对投影后的视觉 token 施加显著性感知（saliency-aware）的掩码与高斯噪声混合破坏，并用解码器从中间 LLM 层的隐藏状态恢复干净的 teacher patch 特征，同时引入图像内对比补丁蒸馏（intra-image contrastive patch distillation）防止表征坍缩。推理时移除破坏与辅助头，不增加额外开销，并在多个多模态基准及 NaturalBench、ImageNet-C 风格损坏场景下取得稳定提升。
Motivation: 现有 LMM 以自回归语言建模目标训练，对视觉 token 只提供间接监督，导致内部视觉表征较弱，并在分布偏移下表现脆弱。
Method: 提出潜在去噪框架：用显著性感知的掩码加高斯噪声破坏投影视觉 token，训练 LMM 从选定中间 LLM 层的隐藏状态经解码器恢复干净 teacher patch 特征；为防表征坍缩，保留 teacher 的图像内相似性结构并施加图像内对比补丁蒸馏。推理时禁用破坏与辅助头。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在广泛的多模态基准上一致优于强基线，并在组合鲁棒性基准（如 NaturalBench）上取得明显提升；在 ImageNet-C 风格常见损坏下，中度和严重损坏级别均保持更高准确率且退化更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调潜在去噪可为 LMM 提供有效的视觉监督，改善内部视觉特征对齐与多模态理解，且不引入推理开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks but remain prone to hallucinations in knowledge-intensive scenarios. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) mitigates this by grounding generation in Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, most multi-hop KBQA methods rely on explicit edge traversal, making them fragile to KG incompleteness. In this paper, we proposed a novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning. Specifically, we employ a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode extracted structural subgraphs into soft prompts, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage paradigm that reduces computational cost while preserving good performance: a lightweight LLM first leverages the soft prompts to identify question-relevant entities and relations, followed by a more powerful LLM for evidence-aware answer generation. Experiments on four multi-hop KBQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three of them, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对知识图谱问答（KBQA）在多跳推理中对图谱不完整敏感的缺陷，提出基于图的软提示（graph-based soft prompting）框架GraSP，将推理从节点级路径遍历转向子图级推理，并用GNN把结构子图编码为软提示供LLM使用。论文还提出两阶段范式，先用轻量LLM基于软提示筛选与问题相关的实体和关系，再用更强的LLM进行基于证据的答案生成。在四个多跳KBQA基准上，该方法在其中三个上取得当前最优性能（SOTA）。
Motivation: 现有大多数多跳KBQA方法依赖显式边遍历，对知识图谱的边缺失（KG incompleteness）非常脆弱，容易导致推理失败或幻觉；同时LLM在知识密集型场景下仍易产生幻觉，需要更强的结构化 grounding。
Method: 提出图基软提示框架GraSP：用GNN将抽取的结构化子图编码为软提示（soft prompts），使LLM能在更丰富的结构上下文中推理、识别超出直接邻居的相关实体，从而降低对缺失边的敏感度；配合两阶段流程（轻量LLM先做问题相关实体和关系识别，强大LLM再做证据感知的答案生成）降低计算成本并保持性能。
Result: 在四个多跳KBQA基准上的实验显示，该方法在其中三个基准上达到状态最优（state-of-the-art）性能，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 论文认为把推理范式从节点级路径遍历转向子图级推理，并借助图神经网络软提示，能有效缓解KBQA对知识图谱不完整的脆弱性；代码已公开。

papers.title: Generative Experiences for Digital Mental Health Interventions: Evidence from a Randomized Study
papers.abstract_en: Digital mental health (DMH) tools have extensively explored personalization of interventions to users' needs and contexts. However, this personalization often targets what support is provided, not how it is experienced. Even well-matched content can fail when the interaction format misaligns with how someone can engage. We introduce generative experience as an approach to DMH support, where the intervention experience is composed at runtime. We instantiate this in GUIDE, a system that generates personalized intervention content and multimodal interaction structure through rubric-guided generation of modular components. In a preregistered study with N=237 participants, GUIDE significantly reduced stress (p=.02) and improved user experience (p=.04) compared to an LLM-based cognitive restructuring control. GUIDE also supported diverse forms of reflection and action through varied interaction flows, while revealing tensions around personalization across the interaction sequence. This work lays the foundation for interventions that dynamically shape how support is experienced and enacted in digital settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式体验 (generative experience) 作为数字心理健康干预的新思路，即在运行时动态组合干预体验。作者将其实例化为 GUIDE 系统，通过 rubric 引导的模块化生成方式产生个性化干预内容和多模态交互结构。在 N=237 参与者的预注册随机研究中，GUIDE 相比基于 LLM 的认知重构对照组显著降低压力 (p=.02) 并改善用户体验 (p=.04)，同时支持多种反思与行动形式。
Motivation: 现有数字心理健康工具的个性化主要针对提供何种支持内容，而未关注用户如何体验这些内容；当交互格式与用户的参与方式不匹配时，即使内容匹配也可能失效。
Method: 提出 GUIDE 系统，采用 rubric 引导的模块化组件生成，在运行时组合个性化干预内容与多模态交互结构，从而实现生成式体验。
Result: 预注册随机研究 (N=237) 显示，GUIDE 相比 LLM 认知重构对照组显著降低压力 (p=.02) 并提升用户体验 (p=.04)；摘要还报告其通过多种交互流程支持不同类型的反思与行动，同时暴露出交互序列中个性化方面的张力。
Conclusion: 本文为在数字环境中动态塑造支持体验与实施方式的干预奠定基础；摘要强调个性化在交互序列中仍存在张力，但未明确列出研究局限性。

papers.title: SimMOF: AI agent for Automated MOF Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a vast design space, and as such, computational simulations play a critical role in predicting their structural and physicochemical properties. However, MOF simulations remain difficult to access because reliable analysis require expert decisions for workflow construction, parameter selection, tool interoperability, and the preparation of computational ready structures. Here, we introduce SimMOF, a large language model based multi agent framework that automates end-to-end MOF simulation workflows from natural language queries. SimMOF translates user requests into dependency aware plans, generates runnable inputs, orchestrates multiple agents to execute simulations, and summarizes results with analysis aligned to the user query. Through representative case studies, we show that SimMOF enables adaptive and cognitively autonomous workflows that reflect the iterative and decision driven behavior of human researchers and as such provides a scalable foundation for data driven MOF research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SimMOF，一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的多智能体框架，用于将自然语言查询自动转化为端到端的金属有机框架 (MOF) 模拟工作流。SimMOF 将用户请求翻译为依赖感知的计划，生成可运行的输入文件，协调多个智能体执行模拟，并结合用户查询给出结果分析。代表性案例研究表明，该框架能够呈现具备自适应性和认知自主性的工作流，反映人类研究者的迭代与决策驱动行为。
Motivation: MOF 计算模拟对预测材料结构至关重要，但工作流构建、参数选择、工具互操作以及计算就绪结构准备都依赖专家经验，导致模拟难以普及。
Method: 提出一个 LLM 驱动的多智能体框架 SimMOF：将自然语言输入转化为依赖感知的执行计划，自动生成可运行输入，编排多个智能体完成模拟执行，并按用户查询生成分析与总结。
Result: 基于代表性案例研究，SimMOF 能实现自适应、认知自主的模拟工作流，模拟人类研究者迭代决策的行为，为数据驱动的 MOF 研究提供可扩展的基础。

papers.title: The Luna Bound Propagator for Formal Analysis of Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The parameterized CROWN analysis, a.k.a., alpha-CROWN has emerged as a practically successful abstract interpretation method for neural network verification. However, existing implementations of alpha-CROWN are limited to Python, which complicates integration into existing DNN verifiers and long-term production-level systems. We introduce Luna, a new abstract-interpretation-based bound propagator implemented in C++. Luna supports Interval Bound Propagation, the DeepPoly/CROWN analysis, and the alpha-CROWN analysis over a general computational graph. We describe the architecture of Luna and show that it outperforms the state-of-the-art alpha-CROWN implementation in terms of both bound tightness and computational efficiency on supported benchmarks from VNN-COMP 2025. Luna is publicly available at https://github.com/ai-ar-research/luna.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Luna，一个用 C++ 实现的基于抽象解释 (abstract interpretation) 的边界传播器，支持 Interval Bound Propagation、DeepPoly/CROWN 分析和 alpha-CROWN 分析，面向通用计算图。相比现有 alpha-CROWN 的 Python 实现，Luna 在 VNN-COMP 2025 支持基准上同时提升了边界紧致性和计算效率，并已开源。
Motivation: 现有 alpha-CROWN 的实现局限于 Python，难以集成到已有的 DNN 验证器和长期生产级系统中，因此需要一种更高效、更易集成的实现。
Method: Luna 是一个用 C++ 实现的抽象解释边界传播器，在通用计算图上支持 Interval Bound Propagation、DeepPoly/CROWN 分析和 alpha-CROWN 分析。
Result: 在 VNN-COMP 2025 的支持基准上，Luna 在边界紧致性和计算效率两方面都优于现有 alpha-CROWN 实现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Luna 作为开源的 C++ 实现可以改善 alpha-CROWN 的实际可用性和集成性，但未涉及任何天气或降水相关应用。

papers.title: MME: Mixture of Mesh Experts with Random Walk Transformer Gating
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, various methods have been proposed for mesh analysis, each offering distinct advantages and often excelling on different object classes. We present a novel Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework designed to harness the complementary strengths of these diverse approaches. We propose a new gate architecture that encourages each expert to specialise in the classes it excels in. Our design is guided by two key ideas: (1) random walks over the mesh surface effectively capture the regions that individual experts attend to, and (2) an attention mechanism that enables the gate to focus on the areas most informative for each expert's decision-making. To further enhance performance, we introduce a dynamic loss balancing scheme that adjusts a trade-off between diversity and similarity losses throughout the training, where diversity prompts expert specialization, and similarity enables knowledge sharing among the experts. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art results in mesh classification, retrieval, and semantic segmentation tasks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/amirbelder/MME-Mixture-of-Mesh-Experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于网格 (mesh) 分析的混合专家 (Mixture of Experts, MoE) 框架 MME，目标是把多种现有网格分析方法的互补优势结合起来。作者设计了一种新的门控架构，利用网格表面上的随机游走捕捉各专家关注的区域，并用注意力机制聚焦对专家决策最有效的信息；同时引入动态损失平衡，在训练中调节多样性损失与相似性损失。摘要称该方法在网格分类、检索和语义分割任务上取得了先进结果，并公开了代码。
Motivation: 已有的多种网格分析方法各具优势，并且往往在不同对象类别上表现更好；目前缺少一种有效机制来组合这些互补能力，从而在整体上超越单一方法。
Method: 提出 MoE 框架，其门控基于两点：(1) 在网格表面进行随机游走，以捕捉每个专家实际关注的区域；(2) 使用注意力机制使门控聚焦于对每个专家决策最有信息量的区域。训练中使用动态损失平衡方案，调节多样性损失与相似性损失之间的权衡，前者推动专家专门化，后者促进专家间知识共享。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在网格分类、检索和语义分割任务上取得最先进 (state-of-the-art) 的结果，并公开代码仓库。
Conclusion: 摘要强调随机游走 Transformer 门控结合动态损失平衡能有效利用多样化专家的互补优势，在专门化与知识共享之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Wedge Sampling: Efficient Tensor Completion with Nearly-Linear Sample Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Wedge Sampling, a new non-adaptive sampling scheme for low-rank tensor completion. We study recovery of an order-$k$ low-rank tensor of dimension $n\times\cdots\times n$ from structured observations of its entries. Unlike the standard uniform entry model (i.e., i.i.d. samples from $[n]^k$), wedge sampling allocates observations to structured length-two patterns (wedges) in an associated bipartite sampling graph. By directly promoting these length-two connections, the sampling design strengthens the spectral signal that underlies efficient initialization, in regimes where uniform sampling is too sparse to generate enough informative correlations. Our main result shows that this change in sampling paradigm enables polynomial-time algorithms to achieve both weak and exact recovery with nearly linear sample complexity in $n$. The approach is also plug-and-play: wedge-sampling-based spectral initialization can be combined with existing refinement procedures (e.g., spectral or gradient-based methods) using only an additional $\tilde O(n)$ uniformly sampled entries, substantially improving over the $\tilde O(n^{k/2})$ sample complexity typically required under uniform entry sampling for efficient methods. We also formulate a noisy wedge-sampling extension for additive Gaussian observations and analyze both the spectral and gradient-descent procedures under suitable signal-to-noise conditions. Thus, the computational barrier in tensor completion is sensitive to the observation model: while it persists under uniform entry sampling, it can be bypassed by non-adaptive structured designs that provide a stronger initialization.
papers.comment: 88 pages, 5 figures. Includes new results on noisy tensor completion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非自适应采样方案 Wedge Sampling，用于低秩张量补全。与标准的均匀条目采样不同，wedge sampling 将观测分配到关联二分采样图中长度为 2 的结构化模式（楔形），从而增强支撑高效初始化的谱信号。作者证明，在该采样范式下，多项式时间算法能够以近乎线性的样本复杂度实现弱恢复与精确恢复，并且可以即插即用地与现有精化流程结合。
Motivation: 在均匀条目采样下，可高效计算的张量补全方法通常需要 \tilde O(n^{k/2}) 的样本复杂度；当均匀采样过于稀疏时，难以产生足够的信息性相关性来支撑高效初始化。作者希望说明张量补全的计算瓶颈对观测模型敏感，并可能被非自适应结构化设计所绕过。
Method: 提出 wedge sampling，将观测分配到关联二分图中的长度为 2 的模式，并基于它构造谱初始化；仅需额外 \tilde O(n) 个均匀采样条目即可与现有谱方法或梯度下降等精化流程结合。此外还给出加性高斯噪声下的 noisy wedge-sampling 扩展，并在合适的信噪比条件下分析谱方法和梯度下降过程。
Result: 主要结果显示，该采样方式使多项式时间算法能够以近乎线性的样本复杂度实现弱恢复和精确恢复，相比均匀采样下高效方法通常需要的 \tilde O(n^{k/2}) 样本复杂度有显著改进。
Conclusion: 张量补全中的计算障碍对观测模型敏感：在均匀条目采样下该障碍仍然存在，但可以通过提供更强初始化的非自适应结构化设计予以绕过。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Event Driven Clustering Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel asynchronous, event-driven algorithm for real-time detection of small event clusters in event camera data. Similar to hierarchical agglomerative clustering methods, the proposed algorithm detects clusters based on their spatio-temporal proximity. However, it explicitly leverages the asynchronous structure of event camera data and employs a simple yet efficient decision mechanism, achieving a linear time complexity of $Θ(N)$, where $N$ is the number of events. Furthermore, the runtime is independent of the sensor resolution, i.e., the number of pixels.
papers.comment: ~10 pages, 2 figures, under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异步、事件驱动 (event-driven) 的聚类算法，用于实时检测事件相机 (event camera) 数据中的小型事件簇。算法借鉴层次凝聚聚类 (hierarchical agglomerative clustering) 的思路，基于时空邻近性检测簇，同时显式利用事件数据的异步结构，并采用简单高效的决策机制。摘要报告其时间复杂度为 Θ(N)，且运行时间与传感器分辨率（像素数）无关。
Motivation: 事件相机产生异步、稀疏的事件流，现有聚类方法未能充分显式利用这种异步结构，难以满足实时检测小型事件簇的需求。
Method: 提出一种异步的事件驱动聚类算法，类似于层次凝聚聚类，依据事件的时空邻近性判断簇归属；通过简单的决策机制利用异步事件结构，避免依赖传感器分辨率。
Result: 摘要称该算法实现 Θ(N) 的线性时间复杂度（N 为事件数），并且运行时间与传感器分辨率（像素数）无关。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在事件相机数据上达到线性时间复杂度和与分辨率无关的运行时间，适合实时小簇检测。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Survey of Agent Memory in the Second Half: Towards Self-Evolving and Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Research in artificial intelligence is shifting from model innovations and benchmark scores towards problem definition and rigorous real-world evaluation. As the field enters the "second half," the central challenge becomes real utility in long-horizon, dynamic, and user-dependent settings such as agentic coding, deep research, and computer use, where LLM-based agents face context explosion beyond fixed context windows and must continuously accumulate, manage, and selectively reuse information across extended interactions. Memory, with hundreds of papers released in 2025, therefore emerges as the critical solution to fill this utility gap. Beyond passive storage, memory is increasingly the substrate through which agents self-evolve: short-term memory gates which experiences are perceived and abstracted during execution, while long-term memory consolidates them into reusable knowledge and skills, forming the loop through which agents improve from their own experience. In this survey, we provide a unified view of foundation agent memory along three dimensions: memory substrate (internal parametric state and external retrieval-augmented stores), cognitive mechanism (sensory, working, episodic, semantic, and procedural), and memory subject (user-centric personalization and agent-centric experience). We then analyze how memory is operated under single- and multi-agent topologies and highlight learning policies over memory operations, showing how memory management itself is becoming a trainable capability spanning reinforcement-learned context curation, experience consolidation at decision time, and the emerging ecosystem of portable, shareable agent skills. Finally, we review evaluation benchmarks and metrics for memory utility, and outline open challenges and future directions.
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) with Survey Certification. Project page: https://github.com/AgentMemoryWorld/Awesome-Agent-Memory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于基础智能体记忆 (foundation agent memory) 的综述，提出从记忆基质 (memory substrate)、认知机制 (cognitive mechanism) 和记忆主体 (memory subject) 三个维度统一审视智能体记忆，并讨论单/多智能体拓扑下的记忆操作、记忆操作上的学习策略、评测基准与开放挑战。摘要认为记忆正从被动存储演变为智能体自我进化 (self-evolving) 的载体，用于解决长时程、动态、用户依赖场景中的上下文爆炸问题。
Motivation: AI 研究正从模型创新和基准分数转向问题定义与真实世界评估，而基于 LLM 的智能体在长时程、动态和用户依赖场景中面临固定上下文窗口之外的上下文爆炸，需要持续积累、管理和选择性复用信息，记忆因此成为填补实用差距的关键。
Method: 综述沿三条主线展开：记忆基质（内部参数状态与外部检索增强存储）、认知机制（感觉、工作、情景、语义、程序性记忆）、记忆主体（用户中心个性化与智能体中心经验），并分析单/多智能体拓扑下的记忆操作以及记忆管理本身作为可训练能力的强化学习策展、决策时经验整合和可迁移智能体技能生态。
Result: 该工作为综述性研究，无新实验结果；摘要回顾了记忆效用的评测基准和指标，并列出开放挑战与未来方向。
Conclusion: 摘要强调记忆管理正成为智能体可训练的能力，并指出可移植、可共享的智能体技能生态是未来方向；同时该综述仅基于 2025 年已有文献进行系统梳理，未提出新的记忆架构。

summary_sections.motivation: AI 研究正从模型创新和基准分数转向问题定义与真实世界评估，而基于 LLM 的智能体在长时程、动态和用户依赖场景中面临固定上下文窗口之外的上下文爆炸，需要持续积累、管理和选择性复用信息，记忆因此成为填补实用差距的关键。
summary_sections.method: 综述沿三条主线展开：记忆基质（内部参数状态与外部检索增强存储）、认知机制（感觉、工作、情景、语义、程序性记忆）、记忆主体（用户中心个性化与智能体中心经验），并分析单/多智能体拓扑下的记忆操作以及记忆管理本身作为可训练能力的强化学习策展、决策时经验整合和可迁移智能体技能生态。
summary_sections.result: 该工作为综述性研究，无新实验结果；摘要回顾了记忆效用的评测基准和指标，并列出开放挑战与未来方向。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调记忆管理正成为智能体可训练的能力，并指出可移植、可共享的智能体技能生态是未来方向；同时该综述仅基于 2025 年已有文献进行系统梳理，未提出新的记忆架构。

papers.title: RingSQL: Schema-Independent Synthetic Data Generation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-SQL have been driven by larger models, better datasets, and new training methods like RLVR. However, progress remains limited by scarce high-quality training data, a problem RLVR is especially sensitive to since noisy data can produce spurious rewards. Manual data creation is expensive, and existing synthetic methods trade off reliability for scalability: template-based approaches guarantee correct SQL but need schema-specific templates and lack diversity, while LLM-based generation scales easily but lacks quality guarantees. We introduce RingSQL, a hybrid framework for generating question-SQL pairs that combines schema-independent query templates with LLM-based paraphrasing of natural language questions. By grounding question generation in complete template questions, RingSQL preserves question-query correctness across all levels of query complexity, a property purely LLM-based methods fail to maintain. RingSQL also produces the only synthetic dataset that improves RLVR training performance across all tested model architectures and benchmarks, achieving 69.8% average accuracy and surpassing both the next-best synthetic dataset by 2.1% and human-annotated data from Spider and BIRD. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nu-c3lab/RingSQL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RingSQL，一个面向 text-to-SQL 强化学习（RLVR）的混合式合成数据生成框架。它把 schema 无关的查询模板与基于 LLM 的自然语言问题释义结合起来，生成问句-SQL 对，从而在各类查询复杂度下保持问题与查询间的正确性。摘要报告该方法在全部测试模型架构和基准上提升 RLVR 训练性能，平均准确率达 69.8%，比次优合成数据集高 2.1%，并超过 Spider 和 BIRD 的人工标注数据。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据稀缺限制了 text-to-SQL 的进展，而 RLVR 对噪声数据尤其敏感，噪声会产生虚假奖励；人工标注成本高，现有模板法需要 schema 特定模板且缺乏多样性，LLM 生成法可扩展但缺少质量保证。
Method: 提出混合框架：用 schema 无关的查询模板生成正确的 SQL，再让 LLM 基于完整模板问题进行释义以生成自然语言问题，从而在所有查询复杂度级别上保持 question-query 正确性，兼顾可靠性与可扩展性。
Result: 摘要称 RingSQL 是唯一在所有测试模型架构和基准上改善 RLVR 训练性能的合成数据集，平均准确率 69.8%，超过次优合成数据集 2.1%，也优于 Spider 与 BIRD 的人工标注数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把问题生成锚定在完整模板问题上可以保持正确性并实现可扩展生成，且代码与数据已开源；其适用范围为 text-to-SQL 的 RLVR 合成数据。

papers.title: From Brute Force to Semantic Insight: Performance-Guided Data Transformation Design with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved notable performance in code synthesis; however, data-aware augmentation remains a limiting factor, handled via heuristic design or brute-force approaches. We introduce a performance-aware, closed-loop solution in the NNGPT ecosystem of projects that enables LLMs to autonomously engineer optimal transformations by internalizing empirical performance cues. We fine-tune LLMs with Low-Rank Adaptation on a novel repository of more than 6,000 empirically evaluated PyTorch augmentation functions, each annotated solely by downstream model accuracy. Training uses pairwise performance ordering (better-worse transformations), enabling alignment through empirical feedback without reinforcement learning, reward models, or symbolic objectives. This reduces the need for exhaustive search, achieving up to 600x times fewer evaluated candidates than brute-force discovery while maintaining competitive peak accuracy and shifting generation from random synthesis to task-aligned design. Ablation studies show that structured Chain-of-Thought prompting introduces syntactic noise and degrades performance, whereas direct prompting ensures stable optimization in performance-critical code tasks. Qualitative and quantitative analyses demonstrate that the model internalizes semantic performance cues rather than memorizing syntax. These results show that LLMs can exhibit task-level reasoning through non-textual feedback loops, bypassing explicit symbolic rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个性能感知的闭环方案，让大语言模型 (LLM) 通过经验性能反馈自主设计数据增强变换。作者在 NNGPT 项目生态中收集了 6,000 多个仅以模型准确率标注的 PyTorch 增强函数，用低秩适配 (LoRA) 微调 LLM，并用成对性能排序进行对齐，无需强化学习或符号奖励。摘要报告该方法比暴力搜索最多减少 600 倍的候选评估次数，同时保持有竞争力的峰值准确率。
Motivation: 数据感知的数据增强设计仍是限制因素，现有方法依赖启发式设计或暴力搜索，缺乏让 LLM 内化经验性能信号的机制。
Method: 构建包含 6,000 多个经验评估的 PyTorch 增强函数的仓库，仅用下游模型准确率标注；通过更好-更差变换的成对性能排序微调 LLM（使用 LoRA），使模型从经验反馈中对齐，而不使用强化学习、奖励模型或符号目标。
Result: 相比暴力发现，最多只需评估 600 分之一数量的候选即可达到有竞争力的峰值准确率；消融实验表明结构化 Chain-of-Thought 提示会引入语法噪声并降低性能，而直接提示在性能关键代码任务中保证稳定优化；定性与定量分析显示模型内化了语义性能线索而非记忆语法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 可以通过非文本反馈回路展现任务级推理，绕过显式符号奖励；该方法的适用范围是性能关键的代码合成与数据增强设计任务。

papers.title: Energy-Tweedie: Score meets Score, Energy meets Energy
papers.abstract_en: Denoising and score estimation are classically linked through Tweedie's formula, which relates the posterior mean under Gaussian noise to the Stein score of the noisy marginal. In this work, we extend this perspective beyond Gaussian noise to a broad class of Gibbs (energy-based) noise distributions, with the generalized Gaussian family as the running example. We derive the Energy-Tweedie identity: when the denoising posterior is viewed through the lens of scoring rules, the path derivative of a kernel scoring rule defined by the noise potential recovers the Stein score of the noisy marginal. The rule's propriety is determined by the noise potential alone. Thus, the familiar correspondence between Gaussian noise, posterior means, squared loss, and Tweedie's formula is lifted to a distributional correspondence between Gibbs noise distributions, full posterior laws, kernel scoring rules, and the Energy-Tweedie identity, yielding one Tweedie-style relation for each noise potential. Among its consequences, this identity gives a posterior-samples-to-score route to score estimation, yields a principled criterion for estimating unknown noise parameters, and enables diffusion-style sampling along user-chosen paths through the noise-parameter space, supplying the score-based perspective on recent generative methods trained with scoring rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把 Tweedie 公式从高斯噪声推广到 Gibbs（能量基）噪声分布族，提出 Energy-Tweedie 恒等式：当去噪后验通过评分规则 (scoring rules) 刻画时，由噪声势定义的核评分规则沿路径的导数恢复噪声边际分布的 Stein score。该恒等式把高斯噪声、后验均值、平方损失与 Tweedie 公式之间的经典对应抬高为 Gibbs 噪声、完整后验分布、核评分规则与 Energy-Tweedie 恒等式之间的分布级对应，并为每个噪声势给出一个 Tweedie 式关系。全文以广义高斯族为运行示例，属于理论性工作。
Motivation: 经典 Tweedie 公式只在高斯噪声下把去噪后验均值与 Stein score 联系起来；本文希望将这种去噪与 score 估计的联系推广到更广的噪声分布，尤其是能量基 (energy-based) Gibbs 噪声分布，从而为 score 估计和生成式采样提供统一的理论框架。
Method: 作者从评分规则的角度审视去噪后验，推导 Energy-Tweedie 恒等式；该恒等式表明，由噪声势定义的核评分规则沿噪声参数路径的导数恰好恢复噪声边际分布的 Stein score，且评分规则的 propriety 仅由噪声势决定。基于此，文章给出从后验样本估计 score、估计未知噪声参数，以及沿用户选择的噪声参数空间路径进行 diffusion 式采样的理论方案。
Result: 摘要报告的是一组理论结果：建立了广义 Tweedie 式恒等式，将高斯噪声下已知的对应关系逐项推广到 Gibbs 噪声分布族，并为每个噪声势导出一个 Tweedie 式关系；这些结果还提供了对近期用评分规则训练的生成方法的 score-based 视角。摘要未给出具体实验数据或数值基准。
Conclusion: 作者强调这一恒等式为去噪与 score 估计的联系提供了更一般的形式，并指出其在 score 估计、噪声参数估计和 diffusion 式采样中的理论价值；全文为 54 页的理论推导，应用层面主要体现在对现有生成方法的统一解释。

papers.title: PSI3D: Plug-and-Play 3D Stochastic Inference with Slice-wise Latent Diffusion Prior
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are highly expressive image priors for Bayesian inverse problems. However, most diffusion models cannot operate on large-scale, high-dimensional data due to high training and inference costs. In this work, we introduce a Plug-and-play algorithm for 3D stochastic inference with latent diffusion prior (PSI3D) to address massive ($1024\times 1024\times 128$) volumes. Specifically, we formulate a Markov chain Monte Carlo approach to reconstruct each two-dimensional (2D) slice by sampling from a 2D latent diffusion model. To enhance inter-slice consistency, we also incorporate total variation (TV) regularization stochastically along the concatenation axis. We evaluate our performance on optical coherence tomography (OCT) super-resolution. Our method significantly improves reconstruction quality for large-scale scientific imaging compared to traditional and learning-based baselines, while providing robust and credible reconstructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PSI3D，一种用于大规模三维贝叶斯反问题的即插即用 (plug-and-play) 随机推断算法。该方法将 1024×1024×128 的大体积数据分解为二维切片，通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 从二维潜空间扩散模型 (latent diffusion prior) 中逐片采样重建，并沿拼接轴随机引入全变分 (TV) 正则化以增强层间一致性。在光学相干断层扫描 (OCT) 超分辨任务上，该方法相比传统与基于学习的方法显著提升重建质量，并提供稳健可信的重建结果。
Motivation: 扩散模型是贝叶斯反问题中表达能力很强的图像先验，但多数扩散模型因训练和推断成本过高而无法处理大规模、高维数据，尤其是海量三维体积。
Method: 提出 PSI3D 即插即用算法，将大规模三维体积按切片处理，利用二维潜空间扩散模型对每个二维切片进行随机采样，并在拼接方向以随机方式加入总变分正则化来保证切面间一致性。
Result: 在 OCT 超分辨任务上，该方法相比传统基线和基于学习的基线显著提升重建质量，同时生成稳健且可信的重建结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为大规模科学成像中的三维随机推断提供了一种可行方案，能够在保持可信度的同时改善重建质量；摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: BIM-Native Tokenization for Constraint-Aware Room Layout Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present a BIM-native tokenization for room-level layout synthesis in Building Information Modeling (BIM) scenes. The core contribution is representational: we encode each room as a sequence of BIM-Token Bundles, realized as columns of a sparse attribute-feature matrix that unifies categorical and continuous attributes of walls, openings, and entities under wall-referenced (translation/scale-invariant) coordinates. A mixed-type embedding module produces a unified token vector from this matrix; a single Transformer backbone is then trained in two modes: encoder-only for room embeddings and retrieval, and encoder-decoder for autoregressive entity placement, which we call Data-Driven Entity Prediction (DDEP). On a controlled same-data benchmark with shared ontology and evaluation harness, DDEP outperforms ATISS and BLT baselines bridged into our representation, with ablations identifying joint continuous-feature embedding and entity ordering as primary drivers. Encoder embeddings cluster rooms by type more tightly than large general-purpose text encoders, which in turn retain an edge on within-type ranking. We frame this work as evidence that modestly sized, domain-specific sequence models over well-designed BIM tokenizations are a useful primitive for constraint-aware spatial generation, complementary to general-purpose LLMs/VLMs which we also benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 Building Information Modeling (BIM) 场景的、以房间为单位的布局合成 tokenization 方法。核心表示是把每个房间编码为 BIM-Token Bundles 序列，用稀疏属性-特征矩阵统一墙体、开口和实体的类别与连续属性，并采用墙参考坐标实现平移/尺度不变性。一个 Transformer 骨干以两种模式训练：encoder-only 用于房间嵌入与检索，encoder-decoder 用于自回归实体放置 (DDEP)。在受控同数据基准上 DDEP 优于桥接到该表示的 ATISS 和 BLT 基线，消融实验表明联合连续特征嵌入与实体排序是主要驱动因素，且 encoder 嵌入比大型通用文本编码器更紧密地按房间类型聚类，但通用编码器在类型内排序上略占优势。
Motivation: 现有房间布局合成方法多依赖通用表示或大型通用模型，缺少面向 BIM 场景、约束感知的专用 tokenization。作者希望验证中等规模、领域专用的序列模型配合精心设计的 BIM tokenization，能否成为约束感知空间生成的有效基础组件，并与通用 LLM/VLM 互补。
Method: 提出 BIM-native tokenization：将每个房间编码为 BIM-Token Bundles 序列，表现为稀疏属性-特征矩阵的列，统一表示墙体、开口和实体在墙参考（平移/尺度不变）坐标下的类别与连续属性。混合类型嵌入模块将该矩阵转换为统一 token 向量，单个 Transformer 骨干以 encoder-only（房间嵌入与检索）和 encoder-decoder（自回归实体放置，即 DDEP）两种模式训练。
Result: 在受控同数据基准（共享本体与评估框架）上，DDEP 优于桥接到该表示的 ATISS 和 BLT 基线；消融实验识别出联合连续特征嵌入 (joint continuous-feature embedding) 与实体排序 (entity ordering) 是主要性能驱动因素。房间嵌入按类型聚类的紧密程度超过大型通用文本编码器，后者在类型内排序 (within-type ranking) 上仍保持优势。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为证据：适度规模的领域专用序列模型配合精心设计的 BIM tokenization，是约束感知空间生成的有用原语，可补充通用 LLM/VLM，并对通用 LLM/VLM 也做了基准测试。

papers.title: Revisiting Generalization Across Difficulty Levels: It's Not So Easy
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) generalize across different task difficulties, a key question for effective data curation and evaluation. Existing research is mixed regarding whether training on easier or harder data leads to better results, and whether those gains come on easier or harder test data. We address this question by conducting a systematic evaluation of LLMs' generalization across models, datasets, and fine-grained groups of example difficulty. We rank examples in six datasets using the outputs of thousands of different LLMs and Item Response Theory (IRT), a well-established difficulty metric in educational testing. Unlike prior work, our difficulty ratings are therefore determined solely by the abilities of many different LLMs, excluding human opinions of difficulty. With a more objective, larger-scale, and finer-grained analysis, we show that cross-difficulty generalization is often limited; training on either easy or hard data cannot achieve consistent improvements across the full range of difficulties. These results show the importance of having a range of difficulties in both training and evaluation data for LLMs, and that taking shortcuts with respect to difficulty is risky.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统考察大语言模型（LLM）在不同任务难度之间的泛化能力，使用 Item Response Theory（IRT）和数千个不同 LLM 的输出为六个数据集的示例标注难度，排除了人类主观难度判断。作者发现跨难度泛化常常受限，仅在简单或困难数据上训练都无法在整个难度范围内取得一致提升，说明训练与评估数据都应覆盖多样化的难度范围。
Motivation: 现有关于在更简单或更难数据上训练哪个更优、以及收益出现在简单还是困难测试数据上的研究结论不一致，缺乏客观、大规模且细粒度的难度泛化分析。
Method: 基于数千个不同 LLM 的输出，利用教育测量中成熟的难度指标 Item Response Theory（IRT）对六个数据集的示例进行难度排序，从而在排除人类主观难度判断的前提下做系统评估。
Result: 摘要报告称跨难度泛化通常有限：仅在简单或困难数据上训练，都无法在整个难度范围内取得一致的性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调训练和评估数据都应包含多样的难度水平，在难度上走捷径是有风险的。

papers.title: DSeq-JEPA: Discriminative Sequential Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in self-supervised visual representation learning have demonstrated the effectiveness of predictive latent-space objectives for learning transferable features. In particular, Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) learns representations by predicting latent embeddings of masked target regions from visible context. However, it predicts target regions in parallel and all at once, lacking ability to order predictions meaningfully. Inspired by human visual perception, which attends selectively and progressively from primary to secondary cues, we propose Dseq-JEPA, a Discriminative Sequential Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that bridges latent predictive and autoregressive self-supervised learning. Specifically, Dseq-JEPA integrates a discriminatively ordered sequential process with JEPA-style learning objective. This is achieved by (i) identifying primary discriminative regions using an attention-derived saliency map that serves as a proxy for visual importance, and (ii) predicting subsequent regions in discriminative order, inducing a curriculum-like semantic progression from primary to secondary cues in pre-training. Extensive experiments across tasks -- image classification (ImageNet), fine-grained visual categorization (iNaturalist21, CUB, Stanford Cars), detection/segmentation (MS-COCO, ADE20K), and low-level reasoning (CLEVR) -- show that Dseq-JEPA consistently learns more discriminative and generalizable representations compared to I-JEPA variants.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://dseqjepa-project.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSeq-JEPA 提出一种结合判别式顺序建模与 JEPA 风格预测目标的自监督视觉表示学习方法。与并行预测掩码区域的 I-JEPA 不同，该方法利用注意力导出的显著性图识别主要判别区域，并按判别顺序依次预测后续区域，从而引入从主要到次要线索的课程式语义进展。在图像分类、细粒度识别、检测/分割和低层推理等任务上的实验表明，其学到的表示相比 I-JEPA 变体更具判别性和泛化性。
Motivation: I-JEPA 等基于图像的联合嵌入预测架构并行且一次性预测所有目标区域，无法对预测进行有意义的排序，这与人类视觉从主要到次要线索的选择性、渐进式感知过程不符。
Method: 提出 DSeq-JEPA，将判别性顺序过程融入 JEPA 式学习目标：先用注意力导出的显著性图 (saliency map) 作为视觉重要性的代理来识别主要判别区域，再按判别顺序预测后续区域，在预训练中形成从主要到次要线索的类课程语义进展。
Result: 摘要报告在图像分类 (ImageNet)、细粒度识别 (iNaturalist21、CUB、Stanford Cars)、检测/分割 (MS-COCO、ADE20K) 和低层推理 (CLEVR) 等任务上，DSeq-JEPA 一致地学习到比 I-JEPA 变体更具判别性和可泛化性的表示。
Conclusion: 作者认为将潜伏空间预测与自回归式的判别顺序过程结合，是提升自监督视觉表示质量的有效方向。摘要未明确给出方法的适用范围或局限。

papers.title: Inferring Relative Consequences of Mechanical Ventilation from Observational Data Using Game-Based Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the effects of mechanical ventilation (MV) protocols in critical care requires analyzing data from heterogeneous patient-ventilator systems in the clinical decision-making environment. Multiscale interactions among these coupled components generate a high-dimensional state space that remains sparsely sampled despite extensive data collection. Analysis of existing data is essential for understanding current respiratory management practices and generating testable hypotheses about improvement. The scale and complexity of available data motivate the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to explore data-consistent counterfactual trajectories. However, formulating RL in practical applications requires a spatiotemporally dependent reward process that defines state-to-consequence relationships, their context dependence, and the delays over which consequences emerge. These poorly understood elements are not known \emph{a priori} and inferred from data via hypotheses. To that end, categorized observed states are contrasted according to their relative consequences by solving a game-based inverse problem that identifies a comparison model required for downstream probabilistic and stochastic methods such as reinforcement learning for seeking MV optimization and personalization. The inverted-game inference is validated on synthetic data to reveal potential caveats before proceeding to real-world ICU data applications that expose complexities of the data-generating process. Clinical data applications revealed that both breath-type consequences and their relative ordering are inherently context- and time-dependent, varying across patient subgroups, time, and comparison quantities, and effect timescale. The discussion includes potential developments toward a state transition model for simulating the effects of MV management actions using empirical data and game-inferred comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于博弈反问题 (game-based inverse problem) 的方法，从观察性 ICU 数据中推断机械通气 (mechanical ventilation) 方案对患者状态的相对后果，为后续强化学习 (RL) 等概率与随机方法提供所需的比较模型。作者先在合成数据上验证该推断方法以揭示潜在注意事项，再应用于真实 ICU 数据，发现呼吸类型后果及其相对排序具有上下文和时间依赖性。讨论进一步指向构建状态转移模型，以利用经验数据与博弈推断的比较来模拟机械通气管理动作的效果。
Motivation: 识别重症监护中机械通气方案的效应需要分析异质患者-呼吸机耦合系统的数据，其高维状态空间即使大量采集仍被稀疏采样；而实际应用 RL 需要先验未知的时空依赖奖励过程、状态-后果关系及其延迟，因此有必要先从数据中推断可用的相对后果比较模型。
Method: 通过求解一个博弈反问题，将分类后的观察状态按相对后果进行比较，从而识别下游概率与随机方法（如用于 MV 优化与个性化的强化学习）所需的比较模型。
Result: 合成数据验证揭示了该推断方法在进入真实数据前需要注意的潜在问题；真实 ICU 数据应用显示，呼吸类型后果及其相对排序在患者亚组、时间、比较量和效应时间尺度上均是上下文和时间依赖的。
Conclusion: 讨论提出向状态转移模型发展的方向，即结合经验数据和博弈推断比较来模拟机械通气管理动作的效果；摘要未报告量化基准结果。

papers.title: Contrastive Diffusion Alignment: Learning Structured Latents for Controllable Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at generation, but their latent spaces are high dimensional and not explicitly organized for interpretation or control. We introduce ConDA (Contrastive Diffusion Alignment), a plug-and-play geometry layer that applies contrastive learning to pretrained diffusion latents using auxiliary variables (e.g., time, stimulation parameters, facial action units). ConDA learns a low-dimensional embedding whose directions align with underlying dynamical factors, consistent with recent contrastive learning results on structured and disentangled representations. In this embedding, simple nonlinear trajectories support smooth interpolation, extrapolation, and counterfactual editing while rendering remains in the original diffusion space. ConDA separates editing and rendering by lifting embedding trajectories back to diffusion latents with a neighborhood-preserving kNN decoder and is robust across inversion solvers. Across fluid dynamics, neural calcium imaging, therapeutic neurostimulation, facial expression dynamics, and monkey motor cortex activity, ConDA yields more interpretable and controllable latent structure than linear traversals and conditioning-based baselines, indicating that diffusion latents encode dynamics-relevant structure that can be exploited by an explicit contrastive geometry layer.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConDA（Contrastive Diffusion Alignment），一种即插即用的几何层，对预训练扩散模型的潜变量施加对比学习，利用辅助变量（如时间、刺激参数、面部动作单元）学习低维嵌入，使嵌入方向与底层动力学因素对齐，并支持平滑插值、外推和反事实编辑。实验覆盖流体动力学、神经钙成像、治疗性神经刺激、面部表情动力学和猴运动皮层活动，显示其比线性遍历和基于条件化的基线更可解释、可控。
Motivation: 扩散模型擅长生成，但其潜空间高维且未显式组织用于解释和控制，现有方法难以在保持渲染质量的同时对生成过程进行结构化编辑。
Method: ConDA 在预训练扩散潜变量上应用对比学习，使用辅助变量构造正负样本，学习低维嵌入；编辑发生在嵌入空间，再通过保持邻域的 kNN 解码器将嵌入轨迹升回扩散潜空间，从而将编辑与渲染分离，且对不同反演求解器鲁棒。
Result: 在流体动力学、神经钙成像、神经刺激、面部表情和猴运动皮层等多个数据集上，ConDA 相比线性遍历和基于条件化的基线产生更可解释、更可控的潜结构。
Conclusion: 摘要认为扩散潜变量编码了与动力学相关的结构，可被显式对比几何层利用；ConDA 作为插件式方法具有较强的跨领域通用性，但并未涉及气象或降水领域。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dynamic Jailbreaking Attack
papers.abstract_en: Existing gradient-based jailbreak attacks typically optimize a fixed-length adversarial suffix toward a predefined target response with a static optimization strategy. However, this fully static formulation undermines the effectiveness, efficiency and flexibility of gradient-based jailbreaking because (i) A predefined target usually lies in the low-probability region of a safety-aligned LLM's conditional output distribution, forcing the optimization to pursue an unlikely response pattern; (ii) Simple affirmative targets may even mislead LLMs to generate affirmative responses that are not highly relevant to the prompts; (iii) Fixed optimization strategy and suffix length treat all prompts equally, leading to limited attack capability for hard prompts and redundant capacity for easy ones. To address these limitations, we propose Dynamic Jailbreaking Attack (DJA), a parameter-free gradient-based jailbreak framework using dynamic candidate exploration, dynamic relevant targets and dynamic optimization strategy to craft adversarial prompts. In each optimization round, DJA samples multiple candidate target responses directly from the LLM's distribution conditioned on the current adversarial prompt. Among these candidates, DJA employs a multi-objective scorer to select an optimal target that satisfies multi-dimensional criteria such as harmfulness, relevance, and usefulness. Moreover, DJA introduces a parameter-free dynamic optimization strategy that allocates adversarial effort based on real-time feedback, adapting suffix length, candidate sampling capacity, and optimization iterations according to the difficulty of each harmful prompt. In an extensive evaluation of 40 safety-aligned LLMs (12 model families, scaling from 0.5B to 32B), DJA achieves a 100% ASR across all LLMs, requiring only 13.68 optimization rounds on average (10 iterations per round).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamic Jailbreaking Attack（DJA），一种参数无关的梯度式越狱攻击框架，针对现有静态优化策略的三个缺陷：预定义目标落在安全对齐 LLM 的低概率区域、简单肯定目标可能与提示不相关、固定后缀长度和优化策略无法适应不同难度提示。DJA 通过动态候选探索、动态相关目标和动态优化策略来生成对抗提示，在 40 个安全对齐 LLM 上达到 100% 攻击成功率（ASR）。
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的越狱攻击通常采用固定长度对抗后缀、预定义目标响应和静态优化策略，这种全静态设定限制了攻击的有效性、效率和灵活性，例如预定义目标常处于低概率区域，且固定策略对困难提示能力不足、对简单提示冗余。
Method: DJA 在每个优化轮次从当前对抗提示条件下的 LLM 分布中采样多个候选目标响应，并用多目标评分器选择满足有害性、相关性、有用性等维度的最优目标；同时引入参数无关的动态优化策略，依据实时反馈调整后缀长度、候选采样容量和优化迭代次数以匹配每个有害提示的难度。
Result: 在 40 个安全对齐 LLM（12 个模型家族，规模从 0.5B 到 32B）的广泛评估中，DJA 对所有模型均达到 100% ASR，平均仅需约 13.68 个优化轮次（每轮 10 次迭代）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将候选目标探索、相关目标选择和按难度分配对抗预算三者动态化，能够在不引入额外参数的前提下显著提升梯度式越狱攻击的效率和普适性。

papers.title: ResPlan: A Large-Scale Vector-Graph Dataset of 17,000 Residential Floor Plans
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ResPlan, a dataset of 17,000 residential floor plans with vector geometry, room-connectivity graphs, and metric-scale coordinates. Each plan annotates walls, doors, windows, and functional spaces (kitchens, bedrooms, bathrooms, balconies, and others) under a 17-class taxonomy, with polygons in pixel and meter coordinates. Four typed edges (via_door, adjacency, direct, via_window) accompany every plan, supporting graph-based generation and spatial reasoning. Compared with RPLAN (Wu et al., 2019), which is raster-only with about 6.7 rooms per plan and an observed maximum of 8 functional rooms in our converted split, and MSD (van Engelenburg et al., 2024), which is floor-plate-level and requires extraction, ResPlan provides self-contained unit-level layouts averaging 8.1 functional rooms and 9.2 graph nodes, spanning apartments, villas, and multi-wing residences. The release includes the dataset, loading and post-processing code, a canonical split, and baselines for three benchmark tasks: semantic room labeling, constrained floor-plan generation, and plan-to-graph extraction. The dataset and code are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ResPlan，一个包含 17,000 张住宅平面图的数据集，提供矢量几何、房间连接图 (room-connectivity graphs) 和公制坐标。每张图在 17 类分类法下标注墙壁、门、窗和功能空间，并为每张平面图提供四种类型的边 (via_door, adjacency, direct, via_window)。相比仅光栅且房间数较少的 RPLAN 以及楼层板级且需额外提取的 MSD，ResPlan 提供自包含的单元级布局，平均 8.1 个功能房间和 9.2 个图节点，覆盖公寓、别墅和多翼住宅。发布内容包括数据集、加载与后处理代码、规范划分，以及三个基准任务（语义房间标注、约束平面图生成、平面图到图提取）的基线。
Motivation: 现有住宅平面图数据集存在不足：RPLAN 仅有光栅图像，平均约 6.7 个房间且转换后最多 8 个功能房间；MSD 为楼层板级需要额外提取。缺少自包含的单元级矢量图数据集，限制了基于图的生成与空间推理研究。
Method: 构建 ResPlan 数据集：为 17,000 张住宅平面图提供像素和米制坐标下的多边形标注，包含 17 类功能空间分类和四种类型边；同时发布数据加载与后处理代码、规范划分，并为三个基准任务提供基线实现。
Result: 摘要报告 ResPlan 平均每张图有 8.1 个功能房间和 9.2 个图节点，超过 RPLAN 与 MSD 的代表性指标；提供语义房间标注、约束平面图生成和平面图到图提取三个任务的基准。
Conclusion: 数据集与代码公开可用，旨在为基于图的住宅平面图生成和空间推理提供更完整、自包含的资源。摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Generative neural physics enables quantitative volumetric ultrasound of tissue mechanics
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound Tomography (UT) is a radiation-free, high-resolution modality, but remains limited for musculoskeletal imaging due to the high computational cost and instability of full-waveform inversion in strongly scattering media. We propose a generative neural physics framework that couples generative networks with physics-informed neural simulation for fast, high-fidelity 3D UT. By learning a compact surrogate of ultrasonic wave propagation from a limited set of cross-modality images, our method merges the accuracy of wave modeling with the efficiency and stability of deep learning. This enables accurate quantitative imaging of in vivo musculoskeletal tissues, producing spatial maps of acoustic properties beyond reflection-mode images. On synthetic and in vivo data of breasts, arms, and legs, we reconstruct 3D maps of tissue parameters in under ten minutes, with sensitivity to acoustic variations in musculoskeletal tissues and resolution comparable to MRI. By overcoming computational bottlenecks in strongly scattering regimes, this approach demonstrates the feasibility of quantitative UT for musculoskeletal imaging and advances its development toward future routine clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成式神经物理框架，将生成网络与物理信息神经模拟结合，用于快速、高保真的三维超声断层成像 (Ultrasound Tomography, UT)。摘要称该方法在强散射介质中避免了全波形反演的高计算成本和不稳定性，可在十分钟内从合成及在体（乳房、手臂、腿部）数据重建组织声学参数的三维空间图谱，分辨率接近 MRI。作者认为这为定量 UT 用于肌肉骨骼成像及未来常规临床使用铺平了道路。
Motivation: 超声断层成像是无辐射、高分辨率的成像方式，但在强散射介质中全波形反演计算成本高且不稳定，限制了其在肌肉骨骼成像中的应用。
Method: 提出生成式神经物理框架：从有限的跨模态图像中学习超声波动传播的紧凑替代模型，将波动建模的精度与深度学习的高效性和稳定性结合，以生成方式重建定量声学参数图。
Result: 在合成数据以及乳房、手臂、腿部的在体数据上，该方法能在十分钟内重建组织参数的三维图谱，对肌肉骨骼组织的声学变化敏感，分辨率与 MRI 相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法克服了强散射机制下的计算瓶颈，证明定量 UT 用于肌肉骨骼成像的可行性，并推动其向常规临床使用发展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Knowledge-guided machine learning for disentangling Pacific sea surface temperature variability across timescales
papers.abstract_en: Global weather and climate patterns are strongly influenced by dominant modes of anomalous Pacific sea surface temperature (SST) variability, including the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO), Pacific Meridional Mode (PMM), and Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO). However, disentangling these modes of variability remains challenging due to their spatial overlap and nonlinear coupling, which violate the assumptions of traditional linear methods. We develop a Knowledge-Guided AutoEncoder (KGAE) that uses spatiotemporal constraints and a gradient-based sparsity incentive to identify physically interpretable modes of detrended SST variability, each defined by a single broad characteristic timescale, without the need for predefined temporal filters or thresholds. The KGAE separates ENSO-like modes on 2- and 3-7-year timescales, as well as a decadal mode with characteristics reminiscent of the PDO and PMM, each with distinct spatial patterns. We perturb each latent dimension and use finite differences to characterize the state-independent and state-dependent sensitivities. We demonstrate that the decadal mode modulates ENSO diversity (central versus eastern Pacific) through both interference and nonlinear state dependence, and that a quasibiennial mode interacts with the interannual mode to characterize ENSO onset and decay. We assess the robustness of the KGAEs to random initialization and training stochasticity, to sampling bias induced by a time-stratified cross-validation scheme, and to unseen data (generalization). When applied to climate model output, KGAEs reveal model-specific biases in ENSO diversity and seasonal timing. Our results highlight how machine learning can uncover physically meaningful modes of Earth system variability and characterize their complex interactions across models and timescales.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the American Meteorological Society journal "Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems". Copyright in this Work may be transferred without further notice; 45 main-text pages, 9 main-text figures, 2 tables, 8 supplemental figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种知识引导自编码器 (Knowledge-Guided AutoEncoder, KGAE)，利用时空约束和基于梯度的稀疏性激励，将去趋势的太平洋海表温度 (SST) 变率分解为具有单一宽时间尺度、物理可解释的模态，无需预定义时间滤波或阈值。模型分离出 2 年与 3-7 年时间尺度的类 ENSO 模态，以及一个特征类似 PDO 和 PMM 的年代际模态；通过扰动潜变量并用有限差分刻画状态依赖敏感性，揭示年代际模态对 ENSO 多样性 (中部型与东部型) 的调制，以及准两年模态与年际模态对 ENSO 发生和衰减的相互作用。作者还评估了对随机初始化、训练随机性、时间分层交叉验证采样偏差和未见数据的稳健性，并展示应用于气候模式输出时可揭示模式在 ENSO 多样性与季节时相上的特定偏差。
Motivation: 太平洋海表温度变率的主导模态 (ENSO、PMM、PDO) 在空间上重叠且存在非线性耦合，违反传统线性方法的基本假设，使得分离这些模态十分困难。
Method: 开发 KGAE，使用时空约束和基于梯度的稀疏性激励，使每个潜变量对应一个以单一特征时间尺度刻画的模态，无需预定义时间滤波器或阈值；随后扰动每个潜维度并用有限差分表征状态无关与状态相关的敏感性。
Result: KGAE 分离出 2 年和 3-7 年尺度的类 ENSO 模态，以及具有 PDO/PMM 特征的年代际模态；结果显示年代际模态通过干涉和非线性状态依赖调制 ENSO 多样性，准两年模态与年际模态共同刻画 ENSO 的发生与衰减。模型对随机初始化、训练随机性、时间分层交叉验证的采样偏差及未见数据表现出稳健性，并能在气候模式输出中揭示针对 ENSO 多样性和季节时相的模式特定偏差。
Conclusion: 作者强调机器学习能够识别具有物理意义的地球系统变率模态，并刻画其跨模式、跨时间尺度的复杂相互作用；该工作聚焦于模态分解与相互作用诊断，而非预测应用。
Relevance: 30

summary_sections.result: KGAE 分离出 2 年和 3-7 年尺度的类 ENSO 模态，以及具有 PDO/PMM 特征的年代际模态；结果显示年代际模态通过干涉和非线性状态依赖调制 ENSO 多样性，准两年模态与年际模态共同刻画 ENSO 的发生与衰减。模型对随机初始化、训练随机性、时间分层交叉验证的采样偏差及未见数据表现出稳健性，并能在气候模式输出中揭示针对 ENSO 多样性和季节时相的模式特定偏差。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调机器学习能够识别具有物理意义的地球系统变率模态，并刻画其跨模式、跨时间尺度的复杂相互作用；该工作聚焦于模态分解与相互作用诊断，而非预测应用。

papers.title: HCRide: Harmonizing Passenger Fairness and Driver Preference for Human-Centered Ride-Hailing
papers.abstract_en: Order dispatch systems play a vital role in ride-hailing services, which directly influence operator revenue, driver profit, and passenger experience. Most existing work focuses on improving system efficiency in terms of operator revenue, which may cause a bad experience for both passengers and drivers. Hence, in this work, we aim to design a human-centered ride-hailing system by considering both passenger fairness and driver preference without compromising the overall system efficiency. However, it is nontrivial to achieve this target due to the potential conflicts between passenger fairness and driver preference since optimizing one may sacrifice the other. To address this challenge, we design HCRide, a Human-Centered Ride-hailing system based on a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm called Harmonization-oriented Actor-Bi-Critic (Habic), which includes three major components (i.e., a multi-agent competition mechanism, a dynamic Actor network, and a Bi-Critic network) to optimize system efficiency and passenger fairness with driver preference consideration. We extensively evaluate our HCRide using two real-world ride-hailing datasets from Shenzhen and New York City. Experimental results show our HCRide effectively improves system efficiency by 2.02%, fairness by 5.39%, and driver preference by 10.21% compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: Uncertainty-aware Predict-Then-Optimize Framework for Equitable Post-Disaster Power Restoration
papers.abstract_en: The increasing frequency of extreme weather events, such as hurricanes, highlights the urgent need for efficient and equitable power system restoration. Many electricity providers make restoration decisions primarily based on the volume of power restoration requests from each region. However, our data-driven analysis reveals significant disparities in request submission volume, as disadvantaged communities tend to submit fewer restoration requests. This disparity makes the current restoration solution inequitable, leaving these communities vulnerable to extended power outages. To address this, we aim to propose an equity-aware power restoration strategy that balances both restoration efficiency and equity across communities. However, achieving this goal is challenging for two reasons: the difficulty of predicting repair durations under dataset heteroscedasticity, and the tendency of reinforcement learning agents to favor low-uncertainty actions, which potentially undermine equity. To overcome these challenges, we design a predict-then-optimize framework called EPOPR with two key components: (1) Equity-Conformalized Quantile Regression for uncertainty-aware repair duration prediction, and (2) Spatial-Temporal Attentional RL that adapts to varying uncertainty levels across regions for equitable decision-making. Experimental results show that our EPOPR effectively reduces the average power outage duration by 3.60% and decreases inequity between different communities by 14.19% compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对灾后电力恢复的公平性问题，提出一个预测-然后-优化 (predict-then-optimize) 框架 EPOPR，旨在同时兼顾恢复效率与不同社区之间的公平性。框架包含两个关键组件：Equity-Conformalized Quantile Regression 用于不确定性感知的修复时长预测，以及 Spatial-Temporal Attentional RL 用于适应不同区域不确定性水平的公平决策。实验表明，相比最先进基线，EPOPR 使平均停电时长降低 3.60%，社区间不公平性降低 14.19%。该文被 IJCAI 2025 的 AI and Social Good Track 接收。
Motivation: 现有电力恢复决策主要依据各地区提交的恢复请求量，但数据驱动分析显示弱势社区提交的请求更少，导致这些社区面临更长停电，恢复方案不公平。此外，修复时长预测存在数据集异方差性 (heteroscedasticity)，且强化学习智能体倾向于选择低不确定性动作，可能损害公平性。
Method: 提出 EPOPR 框架，由两部分组成：Equity-Conformalized Quantile Regression 对修复时长进行不确定性感知预测，以及 Spatial-Temporal Attentional RL 根据区域间不确定性差异进行公平决策。整体采用先预测后优化的范式。
Result: 摘要报告，相比最先进基线，EPOPR 将平均停电时长降低 3.60%，并将不同社区间的不公平性降低 14.19%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，明确建模请求提交量差异并引入不确定性感知的预测与公平性导向的强化学习，可以有效改善灾后电力恢复的效率与公平性。摘要未提及方法在其他场景或更大规模系统中的适用范围与局限。

papers.title: MoCA: Multi-modal Cross-masked Autoencoder for Digital Health Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Wearable devices enable continuous multi-modal physiological and behavioral monitoring, yet analysis of these data streams faces fundamental challenges including the lack of gold-standard labels and incomplete sensor data. While self-supervised learning approaches have shown promise for addressing these issues, existing multi-modal extensions present opportunities to better leverage the rich temporal and cross-modal correlations inherent in simultaneously recorded wearable sensor data. We propose the Multi-modal Cross-masked Autoencoder (MoCA), a self-supervised learning framework that combines transformer architecture with masked autoencoder (MAE) methodology, using a principled cross-modality masking scheme that explicitly leverages correlation structures between sensor modalities. MoCA demonstrates strong performance boosts across reconstruction and downstream classification tasks on diverse benchmark datasets. We further establish theoretical guarantees by establishing a fundamental connection between multi-modal MAE loss and kernelized canonical correlation analysis through a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space framework, providing principled guidance for correlation-aware masking strategy design. Our approach offers a novel solution for leveraging unlabeled multi-modal wearable data while handling missing modalities, with broad applications across digital health domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoCA（Multi-modal Cross-masked Autoencoder），一个用于数字健康可穿戴设备多模态数据的自监督学习框架，结合 Transformer 架构与掩码自编码器（MAE）方法，采用跨模态掩码方案显式利用传感器模态间的相关结构。在多个基准数据集上，MoCA 在重建与下游分类任务上均取得显著性能提升。理论上，作者通过再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）框架建立了多模态 MAE 损失与核化典型相关分析之间的基本联系，为相关性感知掩码策略设计提供原则性指导。
Motivation: 可穿戴设备能够连续采集多模态生理与行为数据，但这些数据流缺乏金标准标签且传感器数据常不完整；现有自监督学习的多模态扩展未能充分利用同时记录的传感器数据中丰富的时间与跨模态相关性。
Method: 提出 Multi-modal Cross-masked Autoencoder (MoCA)，将 Transformer 架构与 MAE 方法结合，设计一种有原则的跨模态掩码方案，显式利用传感器模态之间的相关结构来训练表征。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，MoCA 在重建和下游分类任务上表现出明显的性能提升；理论上建立了多模态 MAE 损失与核化典型相关分析（kernelized canonical correlation analysis）之间的基本联系。
Conclusion: 该方法为利用无标签多模态可穿戴数据并处理缺失模态提供了一种新方案，适用于数字健康多个场景；理论结果可为相关性感知掩码策略的设计提供指导。

papers.title: Review Text as a Leading Indicator of Displayed Reputation in Platform Rating Systems: Evidence from 34 U.S. Short-Term Rental Markets
papers.abstract_en: Rating systems on accommodation platforms suffer from a familiar problem: nearly every listing displays a nearly perfect score, so the number that is supposed to separate good listings from bad ones barely varies. Whether the review text accumulating beneath those scores still carries usable information is an open question. I ask a dynamic version of it: does the text guests have already written predict where a listing's displayed rating moves next? Treating text and ratings as parallel channels that aggregate guest experience at different speeds, I construct a prespecified sentiment index from the complete review history of each listing in a two-wave panel of more than two hundred thousand listings across 34 U.S. markets. Because the broader project had explored these data before, I locked the model and its falsification checks in advance and reserved half of the markets, untouched, for a single confirmatory estimation. On those held-out markets, warmer past text predicts a small but precisely estimated upward movement of the displayed rating over the following year. Listings that received no new reviews show no such movement, the association survives host fixed effects, and no single market drives it. The results indicate that the platform's rating aggregation discards information its own review text retains. I discuss what this leading-indicator property implies for the design of reputation displays. The text index is a defined dictionary-based instrument that has not been validated against human judgment, and I state that boundary plainly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究短租平台上评分与评论文字的信息关系：几乎所有房源都显示接近满分的评分，因此该数字几乎不再区分好坏。作者把评论文字和评分视为以不同速度聚合住客体验的两条平行渠道，基于34个美国市场、超过20万个房源的两波面板数据，用预先锁定的词典式情感指数检验评论文字能否预测后续评分变动。在保留的确认样本（held-out markets）上，更温暖的过往文字预测展示评分在接下来一年内出现小幅但估计精确的上行移动；没有新评论的房源无此现象，结果在房源固定效应下稳健且不由单一市场驱动。
Motivation: 平台评分系统普遍存在评分压缩问题，几乎所有房源都显示近乎满分的评分，导致该数字难以区分好坏；开放问题是评分之下的评论文字是否仍携带可用信息，本文提出动态版本：住客已写下的文字能否预测展示评分的下一步移动。
Method: 将评论文字与评分视为以不同速度聚合住客体验的两条平行渠道，从每个房源的完整评论历史构建预先设定的词典式情感指数（dictionary-based sentiment index），利用34个美国市场、超过20万个房源的两波面板数据，提前锁定模型与证伪检验，并保留一半市场用于单一确认性估计（confirmatory estimation）。
Result: 在保留市场上，更温暖的过往文字预测展示评分在接下来一年内出现小幅但精确估计的上行移动；没有收到新评论的房源无此移动；该关联在加入房源固定效应（host fixed effects）后仍成立，且不由单一市场驱动。
Conclusion: 结果表明平台对评分的聚合丢弃了其自身评论文字仍保留的信息；作者讨论这一领先指标性质对声誉展示设计的启示，并明确说明该文本指数未经过人工判断验证这一边界。

papers.title: Reconstructing Persistent Worlds from Narratives for Narrative-Grounded Interactive Experiences
papers.abstract_en: Designing narrative-grounded interactive experiences remains labor-intensive because interactive content must align with the underlying world implied by the narrative. Existing approaches formulate problems such as narrative planning, scene generation, and gameplay generation, each constructing computational representations tailored to specific downstream tasks rather than explicitly reconstructing and maintaining the persistent world that grounds them. We investigate reconstructing explicit persistent worlds from narrative descriptions as the central computational objective for narrative-grounded interactive realization. Rather than treating the world as an implicit by-product of downstream generation, our approach reconstructs and maintains persistent entities, locations, semantic relationships, and evolving world states while inferring only the contextual information required to support coherent interactive experiences. To investigate this perspective, we develop a reference prototype that reconstructs structured persistent world representations from narrative descriptions and subsequently instantiates playable tile-based environments. Through three representative case studies spanning a procedural scenario, an original fantasy narrative, and an adapted public-domain story, we demonstrate the feasibility of reconstructing persistent worlds and show how a shared world representation supports coherent gameplay while remaining grounded in the source narrative. By explicitly reconstructing persistent worlds prior to interactive realization, this work bridges computational narrative understanding and interactive content generation, providing a semantic foundation for AI-assisted game authoring, mixed-initiative design, educational simulations, and narrative-grounded interactive experiences.

papers.title: CheckOne: Lightweight Fault Detection and Mitigation for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The wide adoption of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in safety-critical applications raises reliability concerns related to hardware faults. Algorithm-Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT) methods have emerged as lightweight and symmetric protection mechanisms for DNNs. However, they are particularly challenging for ViTs due to their significant computational requirements. This work comprehensively evaluates the reliability of ViTs, emphasizing the need for symmetric protection in their layers. Furthermore, we present CheckOne, a novel, cost-effective method for fault detection and mitigation in ViTs that significantly reduces the computational cost compared to conventional ABFT. Through extensive experiments with multiple ViTs, CheckOne mitigates critical faults by up to $26\times$ and achieves an average 3.8x higher performance than ABFT in ViTs.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE DFTS'26, 4 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Vision Transformer (ViT) 在安全关键应用中的硬件故障可靠性问题，评估了 ViT 各层的可靠性，并提出名为 CheckOne 的轻量级故障检测与缓解方法。相比传统基于算法式容错 (Algorithm-Based Fault Tolerance, ABFT) 的方法，CheckOne 显著降低计算成本，并在多个 ViT 上实现关键故障缓解与性能提升。
Motivation: ViT 在安全关键场景中的广泛应用带来硬件故障可靠性隐患，而 ABFT 虽轻量且对称，但因 ViT 计算需求大而难以直接应用，需要更低成本且有效的故障保护方案。
Method: 工作对 ViT 进行全面的可靠性评估，强调各层需要对称保护 (symmetric protection)；在此基础上提出 CheckOne，一种面向 ViT 的故障检测与缓解方法，相比传统 ABFT 显著降低计算开销。
Result: 在多个 ViT 上的大量实验中，CheckOne 对关键故障的缓解效果最高提升 26 倍，平均性能比 ABFT 高 3.8 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 CheckOne 可作为 ViT 中传统 ABFT 的计算高效替代方案，为安全关键部署提供更轻量的容错保护。

papers.title: EDATracer: An Agentic Framework for Large-Scale EDA Artifact Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern chip design relies on electronic design automation (EDA) tools that generate large, heterogeneous artifacts, including source files, scripts, logs, netlists, and reports. Analyzing these artifacts is critical for debugging, optimization, and design-flow understanding, but remains difficult because relevant evidence is often distributed across many artifact types and design stages. Although LLM agents show promise for EDA assistance, existing approaches lack public benchmarks for large-scale cross-artifact analysis and often struggle to ground reasoning in tool-generated evidence. We present EDATracer, an agentic framework for evidence-grounded EDA artifact analysis. EDATracer organizes design artifacts into a knowledge graph paired with a semantic vector index, enabling LLM agents to retrieve evidence across source files, logs, netlists, and reports. We curate an 18.9 GB dataset of 2,787 synthesizable open-source chip designs and introduce a 90-question benchmark spanning factual, statistical, and reasoning tasks. Across evaluated agents, EDATracer achieves the best pass@1 accuracy, outperforming Cursor and Claude Code by 6.4 and 7.2 percentage points on average, while using 2.0-3.2x fewer tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EDATracer，一个用于大规模 EDA 工件分析的 agentic 框架。它将设计工件组织成知识图谱并配语义向量索引，使 LLM 代理能跨源文件、脚本、日志、网表和报告检索证据。作者构建了一个 18.9 GB、包含 2,787 个可综合开源芯片设计的数据集，并引入 90 题的基准，涵盖事实型、统计型和推理型任务。结果显示 EDATracer 在 pass@1 准确率上优于 Cursor 和 Claude Code 平均 6.4 和 7.2 个百分点，同时使用 2.0-3.2 倍更少的 token。
Motivation: 芯片设计中 EDA 工具生成大量异构工件，相关证据分散在多种工件类型和设计阶段，导致调试、优化和设计流理解困难。现有 LLM 代理缺乏大规模跨工件分析的公开基准，且难以在工具生成的证据上进行 grounded 推理。
Method: 提出 EDATracer，将设计工件组织为知识图谱并配合语义向量索引，使 LLM 代理能够跨源文件、日志、网表和报告检索证据；同时构建 18.9 GB 的数据集和 90 题基准，用于评估事实、统计和推理任务。
Result: 在评估的代理中，EDATracer 取得最佳 pass@1 准确率，平均超过 Cursor 6.4 个百分点、超过 Claude Code 7.2 个百分点，同时 token 消耗减少 2.0-3.2 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，证据 grounded 的检索结构能提升 LLM 代理在大规模 EDA 工件分析中的准确性和效率，并提供公开数据集和基准以支持后续研究。

papers.title: Statistical Mechanics of Learning on Product Wasserstein Manifolds
authors: Srinivasa Rao P Vangmayi P Reddy
papers.abstract_en: Normally the statistical mechanics of learning treats constraints on weight distributions as restrictions that shrink the space of possible solutions. Therefore, it reduces model capacity. In this paper we would like to take a contrary approach, which, however, is based on the earlier work on distribution-constrained perceptrons. Rather than treating a prescribed weight distribution as a mere restriction, we propose that it defines the intrinsic geometry upon which learning naturally unfolds. We formulate both deep neural networks and variational quantum circuits as gradient flows on a product of Wasserstein manifolds -- one classical Wasserstein space for each layer and one quantum Wasserstein space for the circuit parameters. Within this geometry, the capacity reduction, which was previously associated with distributional constraints, appears as the metric structure of the constraint manifold itself. We develop a hierarchical mean-field description for deep networks, extend the framework to the quantum setting using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1, and introduce two such practical algorithms, Hierarchical DisCo-SGD and Quantum DisCo, that follow approximate geodesics on the manifold of the product itself. Experiments on teacher-student problems, standard image classification tasks, and small variational quantum classifiers show that respecting these distributional geometries improves generalization, stabilizes training, and reduces the severity of barren plateaus compared with unconstrained and purely norm-based baselines. This approach firstly reframes structural constraints as geometric priors and suggests a route for incorporating biological, spectral, or hardware-derived distributional information into both learning systems, viz., classical and quantum learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将深度神经网络与变分量子电路视为在乘积 Wasserstein 流形上的梯度流，其中每一层对应一个经典 Wasserstein 空间，电路参数对应一个量子 Wasserstein 空间。作者将原本被视为容量限制的分布约束重新解释为约束流形自身的度量结构，并给出层次平均场描述以及 Hierarchical DisCo-SGD 与 Quantum DisCo 两种沿近似测地线更新的算法。实验表明该方法在 teacher-student 问题、图像分类与小规模变分量子分类器上改善了泛化、稳定了训练并缓解了贫瘠高原 (barren plateaus)。
Motivation: 传统观点认为对权重分布的约束会缩小解空间、降低模型容量；本文试图反转这一视角，主张分布约束定义了学习自然发生的内在几何，而非单纯限制。
Method: 将深度网络和变分量子电路建模为经典/量子 Wasserstein 流形乘积上的梯度流，发展深度网络的层次平均场描述，并引入遵循一阶量子 Wasserstein 距离的两种实用算法：Hierarchical DisCo-SGD 与 Quantum DisCo。
Result: 在 teacher-student 问题、标准图像分类任务和小规模变分量子分类器上的实验显示，相比无约束和纯范数约束基线，该方法改善了泛化、稳定了训练并减轻了贫瘠高原的严重程度。
Conclusion: 该框架将结构约束重新表述为几何先验，为把生物、谱或硬件来源的分布信息引入经典与量子学习系统提供了路径。
Relevance: 5
