papers.title: NuclearDiffusion: Text-to-Image Foundation Models for Learning Nuclear Energy Concepts
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed text-to-image synthesis, yet its ability to represent specialized engineering domains remains largely unexplored. As an exmaple in nuclear engineering, general-purpose foundation models frequently generate physically incorrect or conceptually inconsistent images because they lack domain-specific knowledge. This work presents one of the first systematic studies of domain adaptation for nuclear text-to-image generation through fine-tuning of open-source diffusion models. We curate a dataset of 1,000 captioned nuclear energy images spanning reactors, fuel cycles, radiation, and related concepts, and use it to fine-tune three state-of-the-art open-source models: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL), SD-v3.5-Medium, and the flow-matching Flux.1 model. Their performance is evaluated using both quantitative image-similarity metrics and qualitative expert assessment against the corresponding zero-shot models. Fine-tuning substantially improves the fidelity of SDXL, provides only limited gains for SD-v3.5-Medium, and yields no measurable improvement for Flux.1, demonstrating that adaptation effectiveness depends strongly on the underlying generative architecture rather than model scale alone. We further compare the fine-tuned models against three leading commercial systems--GPT-Image-2, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Image, and Midjourney. Although GPT-Image-2 and Gemini generate convincing images for broad nuclear concepts, they frequently fail on specialized engineering prompts, where the fine-tuned open-source models produce more accurate and technically consistent outputs. These results establish domain-specific fine-tuning as a practical pathway for developing trustworthy generative AI tools for domain-specific applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面向核工程领域的文本到图像生成，提出通过微调开源扩散模型来适应核能概念（反应堆、燃料循环、辐射等）。作者构建了1,000张带标题的核能图像数据集，分别微调SDXL、SD-v3.5-Medium和Flux.1三个模型，并与零样本版本及商用系统进行比较。结果显示微调显著提升SDXL的保真度，对SD-v3.5-Medium提升有限，对Flux.1无提升，且微调后的开源模型在专业工程提示上优于商用系统。
Motivation: 通用基础模型在核工程等专业领域常常生成物理上错误或概念不一致的图像，因为缺乏领域特定知识；针对该领域的文本到图像适应研究尚属空白。
Method: 构建包含1,000张核能图像及标题的数据集，覆盖反应堆、燃料循环、辐射等概念；对三个开源扩散模型（SDXL、SD-v3.5-Medium、Flux.1）进行领域微调，并与零样本模型及三个商用系统（GPT-Image-2、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Image、Midjourney）对比。
Result: 定量图像相似度指标和定性专家评估表明，微调显著提升SDXL的保真度，SD-v3.5-Medium仅有限提升，Flux.1无显著改善；GPT-Image-2和Gemini对宽泛核概念能生成令人信服的图像，但在专业工程提示上常失败，微调后的开源模型输出更准确、技术一致性更好。
Conclusion: 领域特定微调是开发面向专业领域可信生成式AI工具的可行路径，但适应效果强烈依赖底层生成架构，而非仅取决于模型规模。

papers.title: Lindblad-Inspired Multi-Timescale Reservoir Computing with Separable Rotation and Dissipation
papers.abstract_en: Echo-state networks enable efficient temporal learning by fixing the recurrent dynamics and training only a linear readout. However, conventional reservoirs typically accommodate signal mixing, memory retention, and stability within a single random recurrent matrix. Existing structured designs improve topology, norm preservation, leakage, or depth, but generally do not provide separate modal control of reversible mixing and irreversible forgetting together with a direct global stability guarantee. We introduce a classical Lindblad-inspired multi-timescale reservoir that bridges open-system dynamical principles with structured state-space modeling. The recurrent operator is assembled from exactly discretized damped rotational modes, so rotation and decay become independent design variables governing phase mixing and memory loss. Orthogonal mode mixing preserves normality, while the decay spectrum directly determines the echo-state stability margin without post-hoc spectral-radius rescaling. We evaluate the method over ten aligned seeds against standard, leaky, deep, orthogonal, cycle, and next-generation reservoirs, together with a compact trained gated recurrent unit, across linear memory, nonlinear recurrence, chaotic forecasting, delayed logic, and real sensor calibration. Across the benchmark suite, the proposed reservoir achieves the best fixed-reservoir performance on bounded NARMA-20 and the lowest mean error on Lorenz-63, matches the strongest linear-memory result, and remains broadly competitive across broad range of benchmarks. Ablation studies show that rotation increases state diversity, whereas dissipation provides controlled forgetting and improves predictive conditioning. The resulting framework offers an interpretable recurrent architecture in which mixing, memory, and stability are explicit and independently tunable design variables.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受 Lindblad 方程启发的多时间尺度储层计算 (reservoir computing) 架构，将回声状态网络 (echo-state network) 的循环算子构造为精确离散化的阻尼旋转模态，使旋转 (rotation) 与耗散 (dissipation) 成为独立的设计变量。作者在十个对齐随机种子下与多种标准储层及紧凑 GRU 比较，报告该方法在 NARMA-20 上取得最优固定储层性能、在 Lorenz-63 上取得最低平均误差，并与最强线性记忆结果持平。消融实验表明旋转提升状态多样性，耗散则提供受控遗忘并改善预测条件性。
Motivation: 传统储层通常把信号混合、记忆保持与稳定性压缩在单个随机循环矩阵中，现有结构化设计虽能改善拓扑、范数保持、泄漏或深度，但缺少对可逆混合与不可逆遗忘的独立模态控制，也没有直接的全局稳定性保证。
Method: 该方法将循环算子由精确离散化的阻尼旋转模态组装而成，旋转和衰减分别决定相位混合与记忆丢失；正交模态混合保持正规性，衰减谱直接决定回声状态稳定裕度，无需事后调整谱半径。
Result: 在涵盖线性记忆、非线性递归、混沌预测、延迟逻辑和真实传感器校准的基准套件上，该方法在 NARMA-20 上取得最佳固定储层性能、在 Lorenz-63 上取得最低平均误差，并匹配最强线性记忆结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架提供可解释的循环架构，使混合、记忆和稳定性成为显式且可独立调节的设计变量。

papers.title: Learning to Resolve Neutron Resonances with Fully Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the feasibility of augmenting traditional R-Matrix codes with a robust machine learning framework for automatically detecting neutron resonances in transmission spectra. Neutron transmission data are often complex and noisy, making them difficult to analyze using traditional peak-identification methods. The state-of-the-art R-Matrix codes currently used by physicists to fit these data often depend on prior evaluations and require substantial manual effort. This preliminary study demonstrates a method for accelerating the post-experimental processing of neutron transmission data and reducing bias associated with dependence on prior evaluations. We employ a fully convolutional neural network to classify individual points as belonging to resonance or non-resonance regions in seven transmission spectra---two evaluated and five experimental. Although the model achieves classification accuracies in the range of 93\%, further analysis shows that this metric overstates its ability to generalize. Building on our prior analysis in PHYSOR 2026, we find that, despite the inclusion of additional training data, the method does not generalize reliably to previously unseen isotopes. To address these limitations, future work should evaluate whether a larger and more diverse training dataset can produce a generalizable model and should incorporate known physical characteristics of neutron resonances to improve model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索用全卷积神经网络（fully convolutional neural network）自动识别中子透射谱中的共振区域，作为传统 R-Matrix 拟合流程的辅助。模型对七个透射谱（两个评估谱、五个实验谱）逐点分类为共振或非共振，达到约 93% 的分类准确率。但进一步分析表明该指标夸大了泛化能力，即使加入额外训练数据，方法仍不能可靠推广到未见过的同位素。
Motivation: 中子透射数据复杂且有噪声，传统峰值识别方法难以直接分析；当前主流的 R-Matrix 拟合代码依赖先验评估且需要大量人工干预。作者希望加速实验后处理并减少对先验评估的依赖带来的偏差。
Method: 采用全卷积神经网络对透射谱中每个点进行分类，判断其属于共振还是非共振区域；训练数据来自两个评估谱和五个实验谱，并将其作为传统 R-Matrix 代码的机器学习增强框架。
Result: 模型在七个谱上的分类准确率约为 93%；但后续分析指出该指标高估了泛化能力，尽管加入了更多训练数据，方法仍无法可靠推广到未出现过的同位素。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是一项初步研究，指出当前方法的主要局限是跨同位素泛化不足；未来工作应考虑使用更大更多样的训练数据集，并引入中子共振的已知物理特征来提升模型性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Trust-region Framework for Moment Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a trust-region framework for understanding the behavior of adaptive moment estimation mechanisms, such as \textsc{Adam}, in stochastic gradient optimization. Specifically, in this framework, the magnitude of the update step for each individual weight is constrained within a trust-region governed by a moment constraint of order $p\in[2,4]$. The resulting derivation then leads to a family of learning-rate mechanisms based on second-moment estimation and a normalized $p$-th moment estimation. When $p=4$, this involves kurtosis-like estimation. The general mechanism, referred to as \textsc{Gmake}, provides a unified interpretation of normalization by moment estimation, learning-rate scheduling, spectral lowpass filtering as momentum, and operator-level spectral normalization within a common trust-region framework. Experiments on GPT2-124M trained on FineWeb-Edu and TinyStories suggest that the fourth-moment realization provides its greatest benefit when trust-region constraints are weak. As progressively stronger trust-region controls are introduced, the second-moment realization becomes increasingly competitive, often achieving slightly lower validation loss than its corresponding fourth-moment realization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个信任域 (trust-region) 框架来理解 Adam 等自适应矩估计机制在随机梯度优化中的行为，将每个权重更新步长限制在由 p 阶矩约束（p∈[2,4]）控制的区域中，并由此导出通用学习率机制 Gmake。该框架把矩估计归一化、学习率调度、动量形式的谱低通滤波以及算子级谱归一化统一到同一视角下。GPT2-124M 在 FineWeb-Edu 和 TinyStories 上的实验表明，四阶矩实现在信任域约束较弱时收益最大，而随着约束增强，二阶矩实现逐渐更具竞争力。
Motivation: 自适应矩估计机制（如 Adam）的行为缺乏一个统一的理论解释框架，现有理解往往将归一化、学习率调度、动量和谱归一化视为相互独立的机制。
Method: 建立信任域框架，对每个权重施加 p 阶矩约束（p∈[2,4]）以限制更新步长幅度，由此推导出一族基于二阶矩估计和归一化 p 阶矩估计的学习率机制；p=4 时涉及类峰度 (kurtosis-like) 估计，整体机制命名为 Gmake。
Result: 在 GPT2-124M 上于 FineWeb-Edu 和 TinyStories 训练的实验显示，四阶矩实现在信任域约束较弱时带来最大收益；当逐步引入更强的信任域控制后，二阶矩实现变得更有竞争力，常获得略低的验证损失。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为矩估计归一化、学习率调度、动量式谱低通滤波与算子级谱归一化提供统一解释；实验证据基于 GPT2-124M 和两个数据集，并且结论依赖于信任域约束强度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Multi-Cohort Validation of Censoring-Aware Conformal Lower Predictive Bounds for Pathology Survival Models
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide survival models commonly provide risk rankings without calibrated statements about individual event times. We evaluate fixed-cutoff drcosarc, a post-hoc conformal wrapper for discrete-time multiple-instance learning survival heads using frozen UNI2-h representations, in an internal 18-configuration sweep across five TCGA cohorts and an external five-configuration evaluation across three CPTAC cohorts. We distinguish configuration--fold--split summaries of the inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted (IPCW) estimate and median lower predictive bound (LPB) from a hierarchy-aware patient-ensemble estimand of the mean drcosarc--naive LPB difference. At $α=0.1$, the drcosarc IPCW estimate was nearest 0.90 in KIRC, LUAD, and STAD. Patient-ensemble drcosarc--naive intervals excluded zero in KIRC, KIRP, STAD, UCEC, and CPTAC-CCRCC, but included zero in internal LUAD, CPTAC-LUAD, CPTAC-UCEC, and the internal LUSC extension. In a 20-replicate low-censoring semi-synthetic setting with known event times, drcosarc empirical coverage was 0.9129 [0.9053, 0.9207]. An exploratory analysis supported a head-error-by-censoring interaction within that data-generating process. In a two-cohort ABMIL sensitivity analysis, increasing the hazard grid to $K=16$ raised localized marginal IPCW estimates above the prespecified 0.87 threshold and yielded positive paired LPB differences, although worst-group estimates remained below 0.87. Overall, performance was cohort dependent, and its interpretation changed with the patient-level unit, estimand, and censoring assumptions.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 2 main tables, and supplementary material. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对名为 drcosarc 的修正后验保形包装器 (post-hoc conformal wrapper) 进行多队列验证，该包装器用于离散时间多实例学习 (discrete-time multiple-instance learning) 的病理生存模型，基于冻结的 UNI2-h 表示。验证包含五个 TCGA 队列的内部 18 配置扫描和三个 CPTAC 队列的外部五配置评估，并区分逆删失加权 (IPCW) 估计与中位下预测界 (LPB) 的多种汇总方式。结果显示在 α=0.1 下 KIRC、LUAD、STAD 的 IPCW 估计最接近 0.90，半合成低删失场景的经验覆盖率为 0.9129 [0.9053, 0.9207]，总体性能具有队列依赖性。
Motivation: 全切片生存模型通常只提供风险排序，而缺乏关于个体事件时间的校准性陈述。作者希望验证一种能够为事件时间提供校准下界的后处理保形方法，并说明其表现如何随队列、患者层面单位、估计量和删失假设而变化。
Method: 采用 post-hoc 的 drcosarc 保形包装器，适配离散时间多实例学习生存头，内部在五个 TCGA 队列进行 18 配置扫描，外部在三个 CPTAC 队列进行五配置评估；区分配置-折-分割的 IPCW 估计和中位 LPB，与基于层级感知的患者集成估计量对 drcosarc-naive LPB 差异进行比较。额外进行 20 次重复的低删失半合成实验，以及两队列 ABMIL 敏感性分析（将 hazard 网格增至 K=16）。
Result: α=0.1 时，drcosarc 的 IPCW 估计在 KIRC、LUAD、STAD 中最接近 0.90；患者集成 drcosarc-naive 区间在 KIRC、KIRP、STAD、UCEC、CPTAC-CCRCC 排除零，但在内部 LUAD、CPTAC-LUAD、CPTAC-UCEC 和内部 LUSC 扩展中包含零。半合成低删失设置下经验覆盖率为 0.9129 [0.9053, 0.9207]，并观察到头误差与删失的交互作用。敏感性分析中 K=16 提高了局部边际 IPCW 估计超过预设 0.87 阈值并产生正的成对 LPB 差异，但最差组估计仍低于 0.87。
Conclusion: 摘要强调整体性能是队列依赖的，其解释会随患者层面单位、估计量和删失假设的改变而改变。

papers.title: Informational Frustration in Neural Manifolds: Shannon Bottlenecks and the Limits of Learnability
papers.abstract_en: Why overparameterised deep networks generalise so remarkably well remains one of the most stubborn open questions in machine learning theory. Classical frameworks like VC dimension and Rademacher complexity predict catastrophic overfitting in modern models, leaving a massive theoretical gap between theory and reality. In this paper, we bridge this divide by introducing a unified framework that links information theory, topology, and statistical mechanics to map the hard limits of deep learning. Central to our approach is the Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH): a fundamental law stating that a network can only truly learn a target function if the Shannon entropy of the data manifold outpaces the topological entropy of the function's decision boundary, balanced by the von Neumann entropy of the network's weight space. We establish the Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem, proving that when a target boundary's geometric complexity exceeds this informational horizon, the system undergoes a sudden entropic phase transition. It falls into a state of Informational Frustration - a glassy, rigid memorization phase where generalization becomes thermodynamically impossible. Using this lens, we show that the enigmatic phenomenon of "grokking" is actually an Entropic Release, where weights abruptly reorganise to unlock the bottleneck. Finally, we translate this theory into practice with Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD), an optimization algorithm that dynamically manages weight entropy to keep learning on track. Ultimately, this work repositions entropy not just as a tool for tracking uncertainty but as the fundamental physical currency that dictates whether a machine can learn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将信息论、拓扑与统计力学结合起来，试图解释过参数化深度网络为何能良好泛化。核心概念是 Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH)，即网络能真正学习目标函数的条件：数据流形的 Shannon 熵需要超过函数决策边界的拓扑熵，并与权重空间的 von Neumann 熵相平衡。作者证明 Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem，说明当边界几何复杂度超过该信息地平线时，系统进入一种称为 Informational Frustration 的玻璃态刚性记忆相，此时泛化在热力学上不可能；grokking 现象被解释为 Entropic Release，并据此提出 Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD) 优化算法。
Motivation: VC 维和 Rademacher 复杂度等经典框架预测现代过参数化模型会灾难性过拟合，这与深度网络在实践中的出色泛化表现存在巨大理论差距。作者希望弥合这一理论与现实之间的鸿沟。
Method: 建立以熵为中心的理论框架：定义 Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH)，用数据流形的 Shannon 熵、目标决策边界的拓扑熵以及网络权重空间的 von Neumann 熵来描述可学习性边界；证明 Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem；并将该理论落实到 Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD) 这一动态管理权重熵的优化算法中。
Result: 摘要称证明了当目标边界的几何复杂度超过信息地平线时，系统会发生突然的熵相变，落入泛化在热力学上不可能的 Informational Frustration 状态；grokking 被刻画为权重突然重组的 Entropic Release 过程。
Conclusion: 作者将熵重新定位为决定机器能否学习的根本物理量，而非仅用于追踪不确定性的工具。该工作属于理论性较强的学习理论框架。

papers.title: Monsoon Mayhem to Market Waves: Forecasting Fisheries Resilience in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: Sri Lanka's fisheries sector is important for jobs and food supply. Between 2019 and 2025, it faced several major problems at the same time, and how these events together affected fish production and prices is still not well understood. This study develops a framework to connect weather changes, major disruption events, fish production, and prices, with the goal of helping policymakers, traders, and supply chain managers make better decisions. Seasonal patterns are studied using STL decomposition. Spearman lag correlation is used to find delayed effects of climate on production. Interrupted Time Series (ITS) regression measures the impact of major events. SARIMAX models predict monthly production and prices. Hotspot detection identifies unusual patterns. The results show that marine and inland fisheries behave differently in terms of seasons and climate effects. Major disruptions caused different levels of impact, and in some cases, one sector helped compensate for another. These findings can support better planning, for example, improving infrastructure in high-risk areas, strengthening cold storage systems, and using early warning alerts for unusual events. Price forecasting tools should be used as decision-support tools, not as direct market signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对斯里兰卡渔业在 2019-2025 年间遭遇多重并发干扰、但其对产量和价格的综合影响尚不清楚的问题，构建了一个连接天气变化、重大干扰事件、鱼类产量与价格的框架。方法上使用 STL 分解研究季节性、Spearman 滞后相关分析气候的延迟效应、中断时间序列 (Interrupted Time Series) 回归衡量重大事件影响、SARIMAX 预测月度产量与价格，并用热点检测识别异常模式。结果显示海洋渔业与内陆渔业在季节性和气候影响上表现不同，重大干扰的影响程度各异，某些情况下一个部门对另一个部门起到了补偿作用。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡渔业对就业和粮食供给很重要，但 2019-2025 年间多重重大问题同时发生，这些事件如何共同影响鱼类产量和价格仍未被充分理解，决策者缺乏相应的量化依据。
Method: 提出一个分析框架：用 STL 分解考察季节性模式，用 Spearman 滞后相关识别气候对产量的延迟效应，用中断时间序列 (ITS) 回归度量重大事件的冲击，用 SARIMAX 模型预测月度产量和价格，并结合热点检测发现异常模式。
Result: 摘要报告海洋与内陆渔业在季节性和气候效应上表现出不同行为；重大干扰造成不同程度的冲击，且在某些情况下一个部门能补偿另一个部门的损失。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现可以支持更好的规划，例如改善高风险地区基础设施、加强冷链系统、针对异常事件使用早期预警；同时强调价格预测工具应作为决策支持工具而非直接的市场信号。

papers.title: When More Becomes Less: Position-Dependent Repetition Effects in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cloze-style probes that vary how often a target token appears implicitly assume that more copies of a target affect prediction the same way regardless of where the readout slot sits. We show this assumption fails. Our two-probe design holds a repeated-target prefix fixed and varies only the readout position: the adjacent probe places the slot immediately after the repeated block; the displaced probe places it inside a fresh sentence frame. Adjacent repetition behaves as priming intuition predicts: $P(\text{target})$ climbs with $N$ and plateaus. Displaced repetition produces an inverted-U: $P(\text{target})$ rises to an early peak and then declines as more copies are added. The displaced inverted-U shows a per-word drop with bootstrap CI excluding zero in all 13 open-access encoder and decoder models we test, and replicates across Spanish, Chinese, German, and French in 42 of 42 multilingual cells. A six-condition causal ablation isolates the effect to exact lexical repetition rather than length, generic redundancy, or semantic-neighbour exposure. A frame-pragmatics control rules out an artefact of the readout frame. Internally, per-target-token attention falls with $N$ while the total budget assigned to the repeated block grows in causal LMs but not in the masked LM we probe. Probes that vary repetition count cannot treat the readout position as orthogonal to what they measure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型中重复目标词对预测概率的影响是否依赖于读出位置。作者设计了相邻（adjacent）与错位（displaced）两种探针：重复块后紧跟读出槽时，目标概率随重复次数 N 上升并趋于平台；而将读出槽放入新句子框架时，概率呈现先升后降的倒 U 形。该倒 U 形效应在 13 个开放编码器/解码器模型及 42/42 个多语言单元中稳定复现，并通过因果消融定位到精确词汇重复。
Motivation: 常见的完形填空式探针隐含假设：无论读出槽位于何处，增加目标词副本对预测的影响方式相同。作者指出该假设不成立，重复计数效应与读出位置存在交互，忽略这一点会误导对模型内部表示的测量。
Method: 采用双探针设计：固定重复目标词前缀，仅改变读出位置（相邻 vs 错位）；并辅以六条件因果消融以区分精确词汇重复、长度、冗余和语义邻近暴露，另设框架语用控制排除读出框架伪影，最后分析逐目标 token 的注意力分配。
Result: 相邻重复表现为类似启动的单调上升并饱和；错位重复呈倒 U 形，在 13 个模型中每个词的下降量 bootstrap CI 均排除零，并在西班牙语、中文、德语、法语的 42/42 个多语言单元中复现。因果消融将效应归因于精确词汇重复；在因果 LM 中，每个目标 token 的注意力随 N 下降而重复块总预算增加，掩码 LM 中未观察到该模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调，改变重复次数的探针不能把读出位置当作与测量无关的正交变量，否则可能得出误导性结论；本研究的倒 U 形效应与注意力预算变化为探针设计提供方法论警示。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Governing Execution Risk in Agentic AI Systems: A Trajectory-Guided Framework for Red Teaming
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly embedded in organizational workflows, where they interact with external information sources and invoke digital tools to perform operational tasks. As organizations adopt such systems, a critical challenge is identifying and mitigating risks arising from malicious or untrusted external information that can steer agents toward unintended actions. Existing red-teaming approaches largely rely on fixed attack templates or final attack outcomes, providing limited visibility into how attacks unfold through multi-step reasoning and tool use. We argue that agent execution risk should be understood as a trajectory-level phenomenon. Building on this perspective, we propose TrajRed, a trajectory-guided red-teaming framework that uses execution trajectories to uncover vulnerabilities in agentic AI systems. We further develop TrajGuard, a runtime governance layer that uses high-risk trajectories discovered during red teaming to monitor and intervene in ongoing workflows. Experiments on AgentDojo across four organizational task suites show that TrajRed identifies substantially stronger vulnerabilities than fixed-template and automatic red-team baselines. Building on these vulnerability findings, TrajGuard reduces attack success across all evaluated attack methods to near zero while preserving benign task utility. Together, the results demonstrate that execution trajectories provide a practical foundation for both red teaming and risk control in agentic AI systems. This work highlights the importance of governing agent execution in organizational AI deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrajRed，一个以执行轨迹（execution trajectories）为导向的智能体 AI 系统红队测试框架，并配套提出 TrajGuard 运行时治理层。作者主张智能体执行风险应被理解为轨迹级现象，而非仅由最终攻击结果刻画。在 AgentDojo 的四个组织任务套件上，TrajRed 发现的漏洞强于固定模板和自动红队基线，TrajGuard 则将各攻击方法的攻击成功率降至接近零，同时保持良性任务效用。
Motivation: 组织工作流中部署的 AI 智能体会读取不可信外部信息并调用工具，可能被恶意内容诱导产生非预期行为。现有红队方法多依赖固定攻击模板或仅关注最终攻击结果，难以观察攻击如何在多步推理和工具调用过程中逐步展开。
Method: 提出轨迹引导的红队框架 TrajRed，利用执行轨迹来发现智能体系统漏洞；在此基础上构建运行时治理层 TrajGuard，将红队过程中发现的高风险轨迹用于监控和干预正在进行的智能体工作流。
Result: 在 AgentDojo 的四个组织任务套件上，TrajRed 识别出的漏洞显著强于固定模板与自动红队基线；基于这些漏洞，TrajGuard 将评估中所有攻击方法的攻击成功率降至接近零，且不损害良性任务效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为执行轨迹为智能体 AI 系统的红队测试与风险控制提供了实用基础，并强调在组织级 AI 部署中治理智能体执行过程的重要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI-driven Multimodal Representation Learning for Latent Mediation Structure Discovery of Socioeconomic Disadvantage, Psychosocial Factors, and Cardiometabolic Multimorbidity: Insights from the All of Us Research Program
papers.abstract_en: Social disadvantage is associated with multimorbidity, but the pathways linking social conditions to disease burden remain poorly understood. We developed an AI-driven multimodal mediation framework that integrates socioeconomic, psychosocial, clinical, laboratory, behavioral, and genomic data from the All of Us Research Program. Modality-specific variational autoencoders were used to derive latent representations of each data domain, and mediation analyses were subsequently performed in latent space to evaluate indirect associations between socioeconomic disadvantage, psychosocial factors, and multimorbidity. The final analytic cohort included 20,804 participants with complete multimodal data. Across 800 exposure--mediator--outcome combinations, mediation signals were concentrated within a small number of latent dimensions. The strongest indirect association linked a socioeconomic disadvantage dimension, a psychosocial vulnerability dimension, and a cardiometabolic multimorbidity dimension (NIE = 0.002517). The psychosocial dimension was characterized by poorer mental health, greater loneliness, lower social well-being, and lower health literacy, whereas the outcome dimension was associated with hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidemia, obesity, chronic kidney disease, and heart disease. Bootstrap analyses supported the stability of the leading pathway. These findings suggest that psychosocial vulnerability was strongly represented in the dominant latent pathway linking socioeconomic disadvantage and cardiometabolic multimorbidity. More broadly, the proposed framework illustrates how AI-based representation learning can be used to investigate complex relationships across high-dimensional multimodal health data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 AI 驱动的多模态中介分析框架，整合 All of Us Research Program 中 20,804 名参与者的社会经济、心理社会、临床、实验室、行为和基因组数据，通过模态特定变分自编码器 (variational autoencoder) 学习各数据域的潜在表示，并在潜在空间进行中介分析。在 800 个暴露-中介-结局组合中，中介信号集中于少数潜在维度，最强间接关联的 NIE 为 0.002517，bootstrap 分析支持该通路的稳定性。
Motivation: 社会劣势与多发病相关，但社会条件与疾病负担之间的通路仍不清楚，需要一种能够处理高维多模态健康数据并发现潜在中介结构的方法。
Method: 开发了 AI 驱动的多模态中介框架：先为每个数据模态训练独立的变分自编码器以得到潜在表示，再在潜在空间中执行中介分析，评估社会经济劣势、心理社会因素与心脏代谢多发病之间的间接关联。

papers.title: On Hamming-Lipschitz Type Stability of the Subdominant (Minmax) Ultrametric: Theory and Simple Proofs
papers.abstract_en: The subdominant (minmax) ultrametric is a canonical tree-structured summary of a dissimilarity matrix, arising equivalently as the ultrametric induced by single-linkage clustering. While its classical stability theory is usually formulated in $\ell_\infty$ or Gromov--Hausdorff terms, such bounds are poorly suited to sparse perturbations that alter only a few pairwise distances. We develop an $\ell_0$-type stability theory for this operator. Our analysis shows that sparse edits propagate only through the minimum spanning tree (MST): a pairwise ultrametric value can change only if its tree path crosses an edited edge or a cut newly exposed by an edited off-tree edge. This yields a sharp per-edit exposed-cut score and a tree-only global envelope, leading to Hamming--Lipschitz bounds on the number of ultrametric entries that can change. We also prove sharpness results showing that this dependence on tree geometry is unavoidable: under strict cut separation the tree-edge bound is attained exactly, and for off-tree edits there are explicit families in which one edited distance changes $Θ(n^2)$ ultrametric entries. In addition, we prove a conditional near-additivity principle for multiple edits under certified large per-edit changed regions and negligible aggregate overlap. Experiments on deep-embedding graphs show that the resulting structural scores provide useful vulnerability diagnostics for hierarchical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究次优势 (subdominant/minmax) ultrametric（即单连接聚类诱导的 ultrametric）在稀疏扰动下的稳定性，提出一种 ℓ0 型稳定性理论。分析表明稀疏编辑只沿最小生成树 (MST) 传播：成对 ultrametric 值改变当且仅当其树路径穿过被编辑的边，或穿过被编辑的离树边新暴露的割。作者据此给出逐编辑暴露割分数 (exposed-cut score) 与仅依赖树的全局包络，得到 Hamming–Lipschitz 型界，并证明该树几何依赖不可避免的 sharpness 结果以及多重编辑的条件近可加性原理，最后在深度嵌入图上验证结构分数可用于层级表征的脆弱性诊断。
Motivation: 经典稳定性理论通常以 ℓ∞ 或 Gromov–Hausdorff 形式表述，这类界不适合只改变少数成对距离的稀疏扰动，因此需要面向稀疏编辑的稳定性刻画。
Method: 建立算子级 ℓ0 型稳定性分析，证明稀疏编辑的传播路径被限制在最小生成树的编辑边或离树编辑边暴露的割上；据此导出逐编辑暴露割分数、树限定全局包络以及 Hamming–Lipschitz 界，并证明多重编辑下的条件近可加性原理。
Result: 摘要报告了 sharpness 证明：在严格割分离条件下树边界的界被精确达到；对离树编辑存在显式族，其中单个被编辑距离可改变 Θ(n²) 个 ultrametric 条目。深度嵌入图实验表明所得结构分数可为层级表示提供有用的脆弱性诊断。
Conclusion: 论文强调该稳定性对树几何的依赖不可消除，并给出多重编辑近可加性成立的条件（每个编辑改变区域大且总重叠可忽略）；其适用场景为层级表示（如单连接聚类结果）的脆弱性诊断。

papers.title: C$^2$MOE: Consistency and Complementarity-guided Mixture of Experts for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversations (MERC) highlight its reliance on complete multimodal inputs. However, real-world data often suffer from missing modalities due to transmission errors or user behavior, severely degrading model performance. Existing methods enhance robustness via cross-modal consistency learning but largely ignore modality complementarity, leading to biased reconstructions. To address this limitation, we propose C$2$MOE, a novel Consistency and Complementarity-guided Mixture of Experts framework for incomplete multimodal emotion learning. Our approach unifies representation learning and missing modality imputation within a principled information-theoretic framework. Specifically, multimodal knowledge is factorized into consistency and complementarity components via interaction-aware experts. Consistency is captured by maximizing cross-modal predictability, while complementarity is preserved by maximizing conditional entropy between modalities. Building upon this decomposition, C$2$MOE introduces a dual-branch prediction mechanism for robust imputation under missing modalities. The consistency branch aligns imputed features with the joint distribution by minimizing uncertainty, and the complementarity branch exploits modality-unique cues via entropy maximization. Finally, C$2$MOE employs a learnable reweighting module that dynamically assigns importance scores to each expert's output, yielding a robust and adaptive fusion for imputation. Extensive experiments on multiple MERC benchmarks demonstrate that C$2$MOE consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods across various missing-modality settings, validating its robustness and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对话多模态情感识别（MERC）中模态缺失导致性能严重下降的问题，提出 C$^2$MOE 框架，将表示学习与缺失模态插补统一在信息论框架下。该方法通过交互感知专家把多模态知识分解为一致性与互补性成分，并引入双分支预测和可学习重加权模块进行鲁棒插补和自适应融合。多个 MERC 基准上的实验表明，该方法在不同缺失模态设置下均优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有 MERC 方法依赖完整多模态输入，而真实数据常因传输错误或用户行为缺失模态，导致模型性能大幅下降。已有方法通过跨模态一致性学习增强鲁棒性，但忽略了模态互补性，容易产生有偏的插补结果。
Method: 提出 C$^2$MOE 框架，将多模态知识分解为一致性和互补性成分：一致性通过最大化跨模态可预测性捕获，互补性通过最大化条件熵保留。在此基础上引入双分支预测机制，一致性分支通过最小化不确定性将插补特征对齐到联合分布，互补性分支通过熵最大化利用模态独有线索；最后用可学习重加权模块动态分配各专家输出的重要性分数，实现自适应融合。
Result: 在多个 MERC 基准上的大量实验表明，C$^2$MOE 在各种缺失模态设置下一致超越现有最先进方法，验证了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时利用模态一致性和互补性能显著改善不完整多模态情感学习中的缺失模态插补质量，并声称框架具有良好的鲁棒性与泛化性。

papers.title: A Long-Run Persistence Theory for AI Systems under the Redundancy-Adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS)
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly expected to operate over repeated cycles of interaction, adaptation, and update rather than through isolated one-shot outputs. This raises a fundamental theoretical question: can an AI system persist indefinitely without incurring unbounded structural aging? This paper develops a long-run persistence framework for AI systems based on the redundancy-adjusted Artificial Age Score (AAS). The model extends AAS from a static evaluative measure into a cycle-level functional that generates an age sequence across repeated operation. At each cycle, structural age is defined through a weighted, redundancy-aware logarithmic penalty over component consistency levels. Within this framework, cycle-level age is shown to be well defined and uniformly bounded, thereby excluding explosive pointwise aging. On this basis, the paper defines a hierarchy of asymptotic regimes, including burdened persistence, zero-burden persistence, oscillatory persistence, and cumulative terminal burden. It also establishes comparative ordering, sensitivity bounds, convergence under componentwise stabilization, persistence under finite total variation, geometric stabilization under damped inter-cycle perturbations, and a zero-burden characterization under nondegenerate redundancy conditions. The main result is that indefinite cyclic continuation does not require unbounded structural aging: an AI system may pass through infinitely many cycles while its structural age remains bounded, while under stronger regularity conditions its marginal aging vanishes and, in the strongest regime, its cycle-level burden converges to zero. The framework thus provides a formal basis for analyzing long-run artificial persistence as a problem of bounded structural burden rather than inevitable cumulative deterioration.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架，将冗余调整的人工年龄分数（AAS）从静态评估指标扩展为循环级泛函，用于分析 AI 系统在重复交互、适应和更新过程中的长期持久性。作者证明循环级结构年龄是良定义且一致有界的，从而排除爆炸式逐点老化，并据此定义负担化持久、零负担持久、振荡持久和累积终末负担等渐近状态。核心结论是：无限循环延续并不要求无界结构老化，系统可以在经历无穷多个循环的同时保持结构年龄有界；在更强正则条件下，边际老化趋于消失，最强状态下循环级负担收敛到零。
Motivation: AI 系统越来越需要经历反复的交互、适应和更新循环，而非一次性输出；现有 AAS 只是一个静态评估量，无法刻画系统在多轮运行中的长期结构老化问题。论文要回答的核心理论问题是：AI 系统能否无限持久而不积累无界结构老化。
Method: 将 AAS 扩展为循环级泛函，在每个循环中通过加权的、冗余感知的对数惩罚（logarithmic penalty over component consistency levels）定义结构年龄，从而生成跨循环的年龄序列。在此框架下建立渐近状态层级，并推导一组定理，包括比较序、敏感性界、分量稳定化下的收敛、有限全变差下的持久性、阻尼循环间扰动下的几何稳定化，以及非退化冗余条件下的零负担刻画。
Result: 主要结果是：无限循环延续不要求无界结构老化；在更强正则条件下，边际老化随循环增加而消失；在最强状态下，循环级负担收敛到零。论文还建立了多种渐近状态之间的层级关系与定量边界。
Conclusion: 论文将长期人工持久性重新表述为有界结构负担问题，而非不可避免的累积恶化问题，为分析 AI 系统的长期运行提供了形式化基础。这是一篇纯理论论文（38 页，无图，含定理与证明），不涉及实验验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards a New Grammar of Reasoning for Artificial Legal Intelligence and the Mecelle as Its Semantic Protocol
papers.abstract_en: This article examines the enduring epistemic and methodological crisis of traditional legal practice in light of the opportunities and constraints introduced by artificial intelligence. It proposes an ontologically grounded framework termed the Mecellem semantic protocol as a response to this crisis. The analysis focuses on the structural tension within law between maintaining normative coherence and adapting to evolving social and institutional conditions, and shows why approaches based solely on codification, positivist systematization, or quantitative methods such as jurimetrics are insufficient. The article argues that legal reasoning cannot be reduced to data retrieval or statistical pattern recognition. Instead, it is grounded in the premise that meaning is context-dependent and must be dynamically reconstructed through ontologically defined entity categories and differentiated layers of knowledge. Within this perspective, Mecellem reconceptualizes law not as a fixed system of rules, but as an ontodynamic architecture structured along the interconnected axes of ontology, epistemology, and methodology. The transition from jurimetrics to a semantic protocol is presented not merely as a technical shift, but as a transformation in the foundations of legal knowledge. The article further argues that neurosymbolic systems, knowledge graphs, and agentic artificial intelligence can effectively address persistent legal challenges only when embedded within such an ontodynamic framework. By understanding law as a domain of ongoing formation rather than a completed rational totality, Mecellem advances a context-sensitive, auditable, and coherent model for legal meaning production at both human and machine levels, offering a comprehensive framework for rethinking legal reasoning in the age of artificial intelligence.

papers.title: Temporal Context Awareness: A Defense Framework Against Multi-turn Manipulation Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly vulnerable to sophisticated multi-turn manipulation attacks, where adversaries strategically build context through seemingly benign conversational turns to circumvent safety measures and elicit harmful or unauthorized responses. These attacks exploit the temporal nature of dialogue to evade single-turn detection methods, representing a critical security vulnerability with significant implications for real-world deployments. This paper introduces the Temporal Context Awareness (TCA) framework, a novel defense mechanism designed to address this challenge by continuously analyzing semantic drift, cross-turn intention consistency and evolving conversational patterns. The TCA framework integrates dynamic context embedding analysis, cross-turn consistency verification, and progressive risk scoring to detect and mitigate manipulation attempts effectively. Preliminary evaluations on simulated adversarial scenarios demonstrate the framework's potential to identify subtle manipulation patterns often missed by traditional detection techniques, offering a much-needed layer of security for conversational AI systems. In addition to outlining the design of TCA , we analyze diverse attack vectors and their progression across multi-turn conversation, providing valuable insights into adversarial tactics and their impact on LLM vulnerabilities. Our findings underscore the pressing need for robust, context-aware defenses in conversational AI systems and highlight TCA framework as a promising direction for securing LLMs while preserving their utility in legitimate applications. We make our implementation available to support further research in this emerging area of AI security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型 (LLM) 面临的多轮操控攻击 (multi-turn manipulation attacks) 提出 Temporal Context Awareness (TCA) 防御框架。该框架通过持续分析语义漂移 (semantic drift)、跨轮意图一致性 (cross-turn intention consistency) 与演化中的对话模式，结合动态上下文嵌入分析、跨轮一致性验证和渐进风险评分来检测并缓解操控。初步模拟评估表明 TCA 能识别传统检测方法常漏掉的微妙操控模式，作者同时分析了多种攻击向量在多轮对话中的演化，并开源了实现。
Motivation: LLM 在真实部署中面临越来越复杂的多轮操控攻击，攻击者通过看似良性的对话轮次逐步构建上下文以绕过安全措施。这类攻击利用对话的时间性规避单轮检测，现有防御手段难以应对，构成严重安全漏洞。
Method: 提出 TCA 框架，整合三个组件：动态上下文嵌入分析 (dynamic context embedding analysis)、跨轮一致性验证 (cross-turn consistency verification) 和渐进风险评分 (progressive risk scoring)，用于连续监控对话语义漂移与意图变化，并在多轮对话中累积评估威胁。
Result: 摘要报告在模拟对抗场景上的初步评估显示，TCA 能够识别传统检测技术经常遗漏的微妙操控模式，说明该框架具备检测多轮操控的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调对话式 AI 系统亟需鲁棒的上下文感知防御，并认为 TCA 框架是兼顾安全性与合法应用效用的有前景方向；实现已开源以支持 AI 安全领域的进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TourSynbio-Search: A Large Language Model Driven Agent Framework for Unified Search Method for Protein Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The exponential growth in protein-related databases and scientific literature, combined with increasing demands for efficient biological information retrieval, has created an urgent need for unified and accessible search methods in protein engineering research. We present TourSynbio-Search, a novel bioinformatics search agent framework powered by the TourSynbio-7B protein multimodal large language model (LLM), designed to address the growing challenges of information retrieval across rapidly expanding protein databases and corresponding online research literature. The agent's dual-module architecture consists of PaperSearch and ProteinSearch components, enabling comprehensive exploration of both scientific literature and protein data across multiple biological databases. At its core, TourSynbio-Search employs an intelligent agent system that interprets natural language queries, optimizes search parameters, and executes search operations across major platforms including UniProt, PDB, ArXiv, and BioRxiv. The agent's ability to process intuitive natural language queries reduces technical barriers, allowing researchers to efficiently access and analyze complex biological data without requiring extensive bioinformatics expertise. Through detailed case studies in literature retrieval and protein structure visualization, we demonstrate TourSynbio-Search's effectiveness in streamlining biological information retrieval and enhancing research productivity. This framework represents an advancement in bridging the accessibility gap between complex biological databases and researchers, potentially accelerating progress in protein engineering applications. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/tsynbio/Toursynbio-Search
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TourSynbio-Search，一个由 TourSynbio-7B 蛋白质多模态大语言模型 (multimodal LLM) 驱动的生物信息学检索智能体框架，采用 PaperSearch 和 ProteinSearch 双模块架构，支持自然语言查询并在 UniProt、PDB、arXiv、BioRxiv 等平台执行检索。通过文献检索和蛋白质结构可视化案例，作者展示了该框架在简化生物信息检索、提升研究生产力方面的有效性。
Motivation: 蛋白质相关数据库和科学文献呈指数增长，而现有检索方法缺乏统一且易用的途径，研究者需要较多生物信息学专业知识才能访问和分析复杂生物数据，存在明显的信息检索可及性差距。
Method: 基于 TourSynbio-7B 蛋白质多模态大语言模型构建双模块智能体 (PaperSearch 与 ProteinSearch)，由智能系统解释自然语言查询、优化搜索参数，并跨多个主要数据库执行检索操作。
Result: 通过文献检索与蛋白质结构可视化两方面的详细案例研究，摘要报告该框架能有效简化生物信息检索流程并提升研究效率。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在弥合复杂生物数据库与研究者之间的可及性差距，有望加速蛋白质工程应用；代码已开源。

papers.title: AutoProteinEngine: A Large Language Model Driven Agent Framework for Multimodal AutoML in Protein Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Protein engineering is important for biomedical applications, but conventional approaches are often inefficient and resource-intensive. While deep learning (DL) models have shown promise, their training or implementation into protein engineering remains challenging for biologists without specialized computational expertise. To address this gap, we propose AutoProteinEngine (AutoPE), an agent framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for multimodal automated machine learning (AutoML) for protein engineering. AutoPE innovatively allows biologists without DL backgrounds to interact with DL models using natural language, lowering the entry barrier for protein engineering tasks. Our AutoPE uniquely integrates LLMs with AutoML to handle model selection for both protein sequence and graph modalities, automatic hyperparameter optimization, and automated data retrieval from protein databases. We evaluated AutoPE through two real-world protein engineering tasks, demonstrating substantial performance improvements compared to traditional zero-shot and manual fine-tuning approaches. By bridging the gap between DL and biologists' domain expertise, AutoPE empowers researchers to leverage DL without extensive programming knowledge. Our code is available at https://github.com/tsynbio/AutoPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoProteinEngine (AutoPE)，一个利用大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动蛋白质工程多模态 AutoML 的 agent 框架。它允许没有深度学习背景的生物学家通过自然语言与 DL 模型交互，自动完成蛋白质序列与图模态的模型选择、超参数优化以及蛋白质数据库检索。作者在两个真实蛋白质工程任务上评估，报告相比零样本和手动微调方法有显著性能提升，并开源了代码。
Motivation: 传统蛋白质工程方法效率低且资源密集，而深度学习模型的训练和实施对缺乏计算专长的生物学家来说门槛很高，这限制了 DL 在蛋白质工程中的应用。
Method: AutoPE 将 LLM 与 AutoML 结合，统一处理蛋白质序列和蛋白质图两种模态下的模型选择、自动超参数优化以及从蛋白质数据库自动检索数据，并以自然语言作为生物学家与 DL 模型的交互界面。
Result: 在两个真实世界蛋白质工程任务上，AutoPE 相比传统零样本与手动微调方法取得了可观的性能提升。
Conclusion: AutoPE 通过弥合深度学习与生物学家领域知识之间的鸿沟，使研究者无需大量编程知识即可使用 DL；代码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Leveraging Machine Learning to Gain Insights on Quantum Thermodynamic Entropy
papers.abstract_en: We present a thermodynamic analysis of a quantum engine that uses a single quantum particle as its working fluid, inspired by Szilard's classical single-particle engine. Our design is modeled after the classically-chaotic Szilard Map and involves a thermodynamic cycle of measurement, thermal-energy extraction, and memory reset. Our focus is on investigating the thermodynamic costs associated with observing and controlling the particle and comparing these costs in the quantum and classical limits. Through our study, we aim to shed light on the thermodynamic trade-offs that arise from Lindauer's Principle for information-processing-induced thermodynamic dissipation in both the quantum and classical regimes. Using machine learning methods, we demonstrate that energy analysis can be performed and the quantum engine can be simulated according to the Szilard engine based Second Law of Thermodynamics in its working condition. However, we note that the quantum engine operates using significantly different mechanisms than its classical counterpart, where the cost of inserting partitions plays a critical role in the quantum implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对以单个量子粒子为工质的量子热机进行热力学分析，其设计仿照经典混沌的 Szilard Map，循环包含测量、热能提取和记忆重置。作者关注观测与控制粒子的热力学代价在量子与经典极限下的比较，并借助机器学习方法展示可按 Szilard 引擎版本的熵增第二定律对工作条件进行能量分析与模拟。摘要特别指出量子热机的工作机制与经典版本显著不同，插入隔板的代价在量子实现中起关键作用。
Motivation: 论文针对信息处理诱导的热力学耗散（即 Lindauer 原理）在量子与经典机制中的热力学权衡问题，希望阐明单粒子量子引擎中观测与控制过程带来的热力学代价。
Method: 采用受经典混沌 Szilard Map 启发的量子引擎设计，构建包含测量、热能提取与记忆重置的热力学循环，并结合机器学习方法进行能量分析与引擎模拟。
Result: 摘要报告机器学习方法能够按照基于 Szilard 引擎的第二定律在正常工作条件下执行能量分析并模拟量子引擎，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调量子引擎与其经典对应物运行机制显著不同，在量子实现中插入隔板的成本对热力学过程至关重要。
Relevance: 3
